written_solution: Nested red(2) frames: fill enclosed 0-regions by size (≤8→8, ≤24→4, else→3)
program_solution:
(rule!
 (lambda (grid)
   ;; Treat each 4-connected zero component independently.
   (reduce
    (lambda (out region)
      (let* ((cell (first region))
             (size (length region))
             (fill-color
              (cond
               ((<= size 8) 8)
               ((<= size 24) 4)
               (else 3))))
        ;; Border-connected zero is exterior; recolor only enclosed regions.
        (if (enclosed? grid (first cell) (second cell))
            (recolor-cells out region fill-color)
            out)))
    grid
    (find-0-regions grid))))

written_solution: Replicate cross shape in marker directions with stride = shape_size + 1
program_solution:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g))
                (objs (objects-8 g 0))
                (sorted (sort-by objs (lambda (o) (* -1 (obj-size o)))))
                (cross (first sorted))
                (markers (filter (lambda (o) (!= o cross)) sorted))
                (cb (obj-bbox cross))
                (cr (/ (+ (nth cb 0) (nth cb 2)) 2))
                (cc (/ (+ (nth cb 1) (nth cb 3)) 2))
                (ch (+ 1 (- (nth cb 2) (nth cb 0))))
                (cw (+ 1 (- (nth cb 3) (nth cb 1)))))
           (reduce (lambda (grid marker)
                     (let* ((mb (obj-bbox marker))
                            (mr (/ (+ (nth mb 0) (nth mb 2)) 2))
                            (mc (/ (+ (nth mb 1) (nth mb 3)) 2))
                            (color (obj-color marker))
                            (ddr (cond ((< mr cr) -1) ((> mr cr) 1) (else 0)))
                            (ddc (cond ((< mc cc) -1) ((> mc cc) 1) (else 0)))
                            (stride-r (if (!= ddr 0) (* ddr (+ ch 1)) 0))
                            (stride-c (if (!= ddc 0) (* ddc (+ cw 1)) 0)))
                       (reduce (lambda (g2 step)
                                 (let ((nr (+ cr (* stride-r step)))
                                       (nc (+ cc (* stride-c step))))
                                   (reduce (lambda (g3 cell)
                                             (let* ((cell-r (+ nr (- (fst cell) cr)))
                                                    (cell-c (+ nc (- (snd cell) cc))))
                                               (if (and
                                                     (>= cell-r 0)
                                                     (< cell-r h)
                                                     (>= cell-c 0)
                                                     (< cell-c w)
                                                     (zero? (at g3 cell-r cell-c)))
                                                   (set-cell g3 cell-r cell-c color)
                                                   g3)))
                                           g2
                                           (obj-cells cross))))
                               grid
                               (range 1 10))))
                   g
                   markers))))

written_solution: Cross-hatch: normalize→vertical, yellow(4)→green(3), fill to sep, cyan(8) through red(2), red(2) to edge
program_solution:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((h-sep-rows (filter (lambda (r)
                                        (all? (lambda (c) (= (at g r c) 8)) (range 0 w)))
                                      (range 0 h)))
                  (h-sep (and (> (length h-sep-rows) 0) (first h-sep-rows)))
                  (is-horiz (and h-sep #t))
                  (ng (if is-horiz (transpose g) g))
                  (nh (rows ng))
                  (nw (cols ng))
                  (sep (find-first (lambda (c)
                                     (all? (lambda (r) (= (at ng r c) 8)) (range 0 nh)))
                                   (range 0 nw)))
                  (ly (for/sum ((r (range 0 nh)))
                        (for/sum ((c (range 0 sep))) (if (= (at ng r c) 4) 1 0))))
                  (ry (for/sum ((r (range 0 nh)))
                        (for/sum ((c (range (+ sep 1) nw))) (if (= (at ng r c) 4) 1 0))))
                  (yl (> ly ry))
                  (result (build-grid nh
                                      nw
                                      (r c)
                                      (let* ((v (at ng r c))
                                             (yr (if yl
                                                     (range 0 sep)
                                                     (range (+ sep 1) nw)))
                                             (rr (if yl
                                                     (range (+ sep 1) nw)
                                                     (range 0 sep)))
                                             (yc (filter (lambda (c2)
                                                           (= (at ng r c2) 4))
                                                         yr))
                                             (hy (> (length yc) 0))
                                             (rc (filter (lambda (c2)
                                                           (= (at ng r c2) 2))
                                                         rr))
                                             (nr (length rc)))
                                        (if hy
                                            (cond
                                              ((= v 4) 3)
                                              ((= c sep) 8)
                                              ((and
                                                 yl
                                                 (< c sep)
                                                 (> c (nth yc (- (length yc) 1)))) 4)
                                              ((and (not yl) (> c sep) (< c (first yc))) 4)
                                              ((and yl (> c sep) (< c (- nw nr))) 8)
                                              ((and (not yl) (< c sep) (>= c nr)) 8)
                                              ((and yl (>= c (- nw nr))) 2)
                                              ((and (not yl) (< c nr)) 2)
                                              (else v))
                                            v)))))
             (if is-horiz (transpose result) result)))))

written_solution: Noisy periodic grid: choose period with fewest edits, majority vote per period position
program_solution:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((candidates (flatmap (lambda (r0)
                                         (flatmap (lambda (pr)
                                                    (map (lambda (pc) (list r0 pr pc))
                                                         (range 5 11)))
                                                  (range 4 9)))
                                       (range 0 3)))
                  (valid (filter (lambda (cand)
                                   (let* ((r0 (first cand))
                                          (pr (second cand))
                                          (pc (third cand))
                                          (rr (quotient (- h r0) pr))
                                          (cc (quotient w pc)))
                                     (and (>= rr 2) (>= cc 2))))
                                 candidates))
                  (candidate-val (lambda (cand r c)
                                   (let* ((r0 (first cand))
                                          (pr (second cand))
                                          (pc (third cand))
                                          (rr-count (quotient (- h r0) pr))
                                          (cc-count (quotient w pc))
                                          (active-r (+ r0 (* rr-count pr)))
                                          (active-c (* cc-count pc)))
                                     (if (and (>= r r0) (< r active-r) (< c active-c))
                                         (let* ((rr (mod (- r r0) pr))
                                                (cc (mod c pc))
                                                (vals (flatmap (lambda (kr)
                                                                 (map (lambda (kc)
                                                                        (at g
                                                                            (+ r0
                                                                               (* kr pr)
                                                                               rr)
                                                                            (+ (* kc pc)
                                                                               cc)))
                                                                      (range 0 cc-count)))
                                                               (range 0 rr-count))))
                                           (mode-list vals))
                                         0))))
                  (scored (map (lambda (cand)
                                 (list (for/sum ((r (range 0 h)))
                                         (for/sum ((c (range 0 w)))
                                           (if (= (candidate-val cand r c) (at g r c))
                                               0
                                               1)))
                                       (first cand)
                                       (second cand)
                                       (third cand)))
                               valid))
                  (best (first (sort-by scored first))))
             (cellmap g
                      (r c v)
                      (candidate-val (list (second best) (third best) (fourth best))
                                     r
                                     c))))))

written_solution: Fixed color mapping: {1:5, 2:6, 3:4, 4:3, 5:1, 6:2, 8:9, 9:8} Lattice connect-dots: same-colored markers connected along shared rows/cols in lattice cells
program_solution:
(rule! (lambda (g)
  ;; The modal color is the one-pixel lattice divider; 0 is empty cell interior.
  (let* ((lc (mode g))
         (mcolors (filter (lambda (kc) (and (!= kc 0) (!= kc lc)))
                    (unique (flatmap (lambda (r) r) (grid->list g))))))
    (reduce (lambda (acc mc)
      ;; Collapse each 2x2 marker block to its coarse lattice coordinate.
      (let* ((positions (find-color g mc))
             (cpositions (map (lambda (p)
                 (list (floor (/ (+ (fst p) 1) 3))
                       (floor (/ (+ (snd p) 1) 3))))
               positions))
             (crow-set (unique (map fst cpositions)))
             (ccol-set (unique (map snd cpositions)))
             ;; In every coarse row, fill from the leftmost to rightmost
             ;; same-color marker; rows with fewer than two markers do nothing.
             (acc2 (reduce (lambda (a cr)
               (let* ((cols-here (map snd
                                  (filter (lambda (cp) (= (fst cp) cr)) cpositions))))
                 (if (< (length cols-here) 2) a
                   (let* ((cmin (min-list cols-here))
                          (cmax (max-list cols-here)))
                     (reduce (lambda (a2 cc)
                       (let* ((pr (* 3 cr)) (pc (* 3 cc)))
                         (set-cell (set-cell (set-cell (set-cell a2 pr pc mc)
                           pr (+ pc 1) mc) (+ pr 1) pc mc) (+ pr 1) (+ pc 1) mc)))
                       a (range cmin (+ cmax 1)))))))
             acc crow-set)))
        ;; Apply the same interval rule independently down every coarse column.
        ;; Singleton or off-line markers therefore remain untouched.
        (reduce (lambda (a cc)
          (let* ((rows-here (map fst
                             (filter (lambda (cp) (= (snd cp) cc)) cpositions))))
            (if (< (length rows-here) 2) a
              (let* ((rmin (min-list rows-here))
                     (rmax (max-list rows-here)))
                (reduce (lambda (a2 cr)
                  (let* ((pr (* 3 cr)) (pc (* 3 cc)))
                    (set-cell (set-cell (set-cell (set-cell a2 pr pc mc)
                      pr (+ pc 1) mc) (+ pr 1) pc mc) (+ pr 1) (+ pc 1) mc)))
                  a (range rmin (+ rmax 1)))))))
          acc2 ccol-set)))
      g mcolors))))

         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g))

written_solution: Noisy grid with solid colored rectangles: extract rectangle colors in grid order
program_solution:
(rule! (lambda (g)
  ;; Keep only large, nearly solid non-background components.
  (let* ((objs (objects g 0))
         (rects (filter (lambda (obj)
             (and (>= (obj-size obj) 9)
               (let* ((cells (obj-cells obj))
                      (rs (map fst cells)) (cs (map snd cells))
                      (oh (+ (- (max-list rs) (min-list rs)) 1))
                      (ow (+ (- (max-list cs) (min-list cs)) 1)))
                 (>= (/ (obj-size obj) (* oh ow)) 0.9))))
           objs))
         ;; Record each rectangle by center row, center column, and color.
         (centers (sort-by
           (map (lambda (obj)
             (let* ((rs (map fst (obj-cells obj)))
                    (cs (map snd (obj-cells obj))))
               (list (/ (+ (min-list rs) (max-list rs)) 2)
                     (/ (+ (min-list cs) (max-list cs)) 2)
                     (obj-color obj))))
             rects)
           first))
         (row-groups (list))
         (cur-row (list))
         (last-r #f))
    ;; Consecutive centers less than four rows apart belong to one output row.
    (for-each (lambda (entry)
      (if (or (not last-r) (< (- (first entry) last-r) 4))
          (set! cur-row (append cur-row (list entry)))
          (begin
            (set! row-groups (append row-groups (list (sort-by cur-row second))))
            (set! cur-row (list entry))))
      (set! last-r (first entry)))
      centers)
    (unless (empty? cur-row)
      (set! row-groups (append row-groups (list (sort-by cur-row second)))))
    ;; Emit the three rectangle colors in left-to-right order for every row.
    (let* ((nrows (length row-groups)) (ncols 3))
      (grid-from-fn nrows ncols (lambda (r c)
        (nth (nth (nth row-groups r) c) 2)))))))

program_solution:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((objs (objects-multicolor g 0))
                  (nz (filter (lambda (p) (!= (third p) 0)) (grid-cells g)))
                  (t-order (list 0 1 2 3 4 5 6 7)))
             (define (orth-neighbor? r c)
               (any? (lambda (d)
                       (let ((rr (+ r (first d)))
                             (cc (+ c (second d))))
                         (and (in-bounds? rr cc h w) (!= (at g rr cc) 0))))
                     (list (list -1 0) (list 1 0) (list 0 -1) (list 0 1))))
             (define (source? o)
               (any? (lambda (p) (orth-neighbor? (first p) (second p))) (obj-cells o)))
             (define sources (filter source? objs))
             (define markers
               (filter (lambda (p) (not (orth-neighbor? (first p) (second p)))) nz))
             (define (local-valued obj)
               (let* ((bb (obj-bbox obj))
                      (r0 (first bb))
                      (c0 (second bb)))
                 (map (lambda (p)
                        (list (- (first p) r0)
                              (- (second p) c0)
                              (at g (first p) (second p))))
                      (obj-cells obj))))
             (define (mapped t r c)
               (cond
                 ((zero? t) (list r c))
                 ((= t 1) (list r (- 0 c)))
                 ((= t 2) (list (- 0 r) c))
                 ((= t 3) (list (- 0 r) (- 0 c)))
                 ((= t 4) (list c r))
                 ((= t 5) (list c (- 0 r)))
                 ((= t 6) (list (- 0 c) r))
                 (else (list (- 0 c) (- 0 r)))))
             (define (transform-cells cells t)
               (let* ((raw (map (lambda (cell)
                                  (let ((p (mapped t (first cell) (second cell))))
                                    (list (first p) (second p) (third cell))))
                                cells))
                      (mr (min-of first raw))
                      (mc (min-of second raw)))
                 (map (lambda (cell)
                        (list (- (first cell) mr) (- (second cell) mc) (third cell)))
                      raw)))
             (define (marker-at? r c v)
               (not (null? (filter (lambda (m)
                                     (and
                                       (= (first m) r)
                                       (= (second m) c)
                                       (= (third m) v)))
                                   markers))))
             (define (in-bounds-cells? tr tc cells)
               (all? (lambda (cell)
                       (let ((r (+ tr (first cell)))
                             (c (+ tc (second cell))))
                         (and (>= r 0) (< r h) (>= c 0) (< c w))))
                     cells))
             (define (valid? tr tc specs cells)
               (and
                 (in-bounds-cells? tr tc cells)
                 (all? (lambda (sp)
                         (marker-at? (+ tr (first sp)) (+ tc (second sp)) (third sp)))
                       specs)))
             (define (candidate obj)
               (let* ((base (local-valued obj))
                      (main (mode-list (map third base)))
                      (cands (flatmap (lambda (t)
                                        (let* ((tcells (transform-cells base t))
                                               (specs (filter (lambda (cell)
                                                                (!= (third cell) main))
                                                              tcells)))
                                          (filter (lambda (cand)
                                                    (valid? (first cand)
                                                            (second cand)
                                                            specs
                                                            tcells))
                                                  (flatmap (lambda (sp)
                                                             (map (lambda (m)
                                                                    (list (- (first m)
                                                                             (first sp))
                                                                          (- (second m)
                                                                             (second sp))
                                                                          tcells))
                                                                  (filter (lambda (m)
                                                                            (= (third m)
                                                                               (third sp)))
                                                                          markers)))
                                                           specs))))
                                      t-order)))
                 (first cands)))
             (reduce (lambda (acc obj)
                       (let ((cand (candidate obj)))
                         (stamp-normalized-cells acc
                                                 (third cand)
                                                 (first cand)
                                                 (second cand))))
                     (cellmap g (r c v) 0)
                     sources)))))

written_solution: Expand colored singleton spines into prioritized diagonal rays and domino wedges
program_solution:
(rule!
 ;; A SPINE of single colored cells (all in one column, else one row)
 ;; plus 2-cell dominoes, one color each. On a blank canvas each domino
 ;; paints a triangular wedge that grows from the spine toward it; then
 ;; each spine cell shoots diagonal rays (4-way inside the domino span,
 ;; 2-way spine-ward beyond it), farthest spine cell painted first.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define (shape-of color)
       ;; single -> (s r c color) ; domino -> (h color row cmin cmax)
       ;; or (v color rmin rmax c) ; anything else -> #f
       (let ((cells (find-color g color)))
         (cond ((= (length cells) 1)
                (list 's (first (first cells)) (second (first cells)) color))
               ((= (length cells) 2)
                (let ((r1 (first (first cells))) (c1 (second (first cells)))
                      (r2 (first (second cells))) (c2 (second (second cells))))
                  (cond ((and (= r1 r2) (= (abs (- c1 c2)) 1))
                         (list 'h color r1 (min c1 c2) (max c1 c2)))
                        ((and (= c1 c2) (= (abs (- r1 r2)) 1))
                         (list 'v color (min r1 r2) (max r1 r2) c1))
                        (else #f))))
               (else #f))))
     (define records
       (filter (lambda (x) x)
               (map shape-of (sort (filter (lambda (v) (> v 0))
                                           (grid-colors g))
                                   <))))
     (define singles  ;; (r c color), ascending color
       (map rest (filter (lambda (rec) (eq? (first rec) 's)) records)))
     (define dominoes
       (filter (lambda (rec) (not (eq? (first rec) 's))) records))
     (define spine-vertical?
       (= (length (unique (map second singles))) 1))
     (define spine-row (first (first singles)))
     (define spine-col (second (first singles)))
     (define rmin (min-of first singles))
     (define rmax (max-of first singles))
     (define cmin (min-of second singles))
     (define cmax (max-of second singles))
     (define (dot out r c color)
       (if (in-bounds? r c h w) (set-cell out r c color) out))
     (define (wedge-h out d)  ;; horizontal domino above/below the spine
       (let ((color (second d)) (rr (third d)) (c1 (fourth d)))
         (cond
           (spine-vertical?
            (cond ((< rr rmin)
                   (for*/fold ((acc out))
                              ((r (range rr rmin))
                               (c (let ((k (- (- rmin 1) r)))
                                    (range (- spine-col k)
                                           (+ spine-col k 1)))))
                     (dot acc r c color)))
                  ((> rr rmax)
                   (for*/fold ((acc out))
                              ((r (range (+ rmax 1) (+ rr 1)))
                               (c (let ((k (- r (+ rmax 1))))
                                    (range (- spine-col k)
                                           (+ spine-col k 1)))))
                     (dot acc r c color)))
                  (else out)))
           ((< rr spine-row)
            (for*/fold ((acc out))
                       ((r (range rr spine-row))
                        (c (let ((k (- (- spine-row 1) r)))
                             (range (- c1 k) (+ c1 k 1)))))
              (dot acc r c color)))
           ((> rr spine-row)
            (for*/fold ((acc out))
                       ((r (range (+ spine-row 1) (+ rr 1)))
                        (c (let ((k (- r (+ spine-row 1))))
                             (range (- c1 k) (+ c1 k 1)))))
              (dot acc r c color)))
           (else out))))
     (define (wedge-v out d)  ;; vertical domino beside the spine
       (let ((color (second d)) (r1 (third d)) (r2 (fourth d))
             (cc (list-ref d 4)))
         (cond
           (spine-vertical?
            (cond ((> cc spine-col)
                   (let ((inner (+ spine-col 2)))
                     (for*/fold ((acc out))
                                ((c (range inner (+ cc 1)))
                                 (r (let ((k (- c inner)))
                                      (range (- r1 k) (+ r2 k 1)))))
                       (dot acc r c color))))
                  ((< cc spine-col)
                   (let ((inner (- spine-col 2)))
                     (for*/fold ((acc out))
                                ((c (range cc (+ inner 1)))
                                 (r (let ((k (- inner c)))
                                      (range (- r1 k) (+ r2 k 1)))))
                       (dot acc r c color))))
                  (else out)))
           ((< cc cmin)
            (let ((inner (+ cc 2)))
              (for*/fold ((acc out))
                         ((c (range cc (+ inner 1)))
                          (r (let ((k (- inner c)))
                               (range (- spine-row k) (+ spine-row k 1)))))
                (dot acc r c color))))
           ((> cc cmax)
            (let ((inner (- cc 2)))
              (for*/fold ((acc out))
                         ((c (range inner (+ cc 1)))
                          (r (let ((k (- c inner)))
                               (range (- spine-row k) (+ spine-row k 1)))))
                (dot acc r c color))))
           (else out))))
     (define (ray-paint out r c dr dc color)
       (let loop ((acc out) (rr (+ r dr)) (cc (+ c dc)))
         (if (in-bounds? rr cc h w)
             (loop (set-cell acc rr cc color) (+ rr dr) (+ cc dc))
             acc)))
     (define r-edge  ;; last 4-way row: first v-domino's bottom (else spine end)
       (let ((vd (filter (lambda (d) (eq? (first d) 'v)) dominoes)))
         (if (empty? vd) rmax (fourth (first vd)))))
     (define c-edge  ;; last 4-way col: first h-domino's left (else spine end)
       (let ((hd (filter (lambda (d) (eq? (first d) 'h)) dominoes)))
         (if (empty? hd) cmax (fourth (first hd)))))
     (define (spray out s)
       (let* ((r (first s)) (c (second s)) (color (third s))
              (dirs (if (if spine-vertical? (<= r r-edge) (<= c c-edge))
                        diagonal-deltas
                        (if spine-vertical?
                            (list (list 1 -1) (list 1 1))
                            (list (list -1 1) (list 1 1))))))
         (foldl (lambda (d acc)
                  (ray-paint acc r c (first d) (second d) color))
                (dot out r c color)
                dirs)))
     (foldl (lambda (s acc) (spray acc s))
            (foldl (lambda (d acc)
                     (if (eq? (first d) 'h) (wedge-h acc d) (wedge-v acc d)))
                   (empty-grid h w 0)
                   dominoes)
            (reverse (sort-by singles (if spine-vertical? first second)))))))

         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((hh (rows g))
                  (ww (cols g))
                  (bg 7)
                  (red (for*/list ((r (range 0 hh)) (c (range 0 ww)) #:when (= (at g r c) 2))
                         (list r c)))
                  (gray (for*/list ((r (range 0 hh)) (c (range 0 ww)) #:when (= (at g r c) 5))
                          (list r c)))
                  (gray-set (make-hash))
                  (d0 (for ((p gray)) (hash-set! gray-set p #t)))
                  (rcr (quotient (for/sum ((p red)) (first p)) (length red)))
                  (rcc (quotient (for/sum ((p red)) (second p)) (length red)))
                  (gcr (quotient (for/sum ((p gray)) (first p)) (length gray)))
                  (gcc (quotient (for/sum ((p gray)) (second p)) (length gray)))
                  (dr (- gcr rcr))
                  (dc (- gcc rcc))
                  (horiz (> (abs dc) (abs dr)))
                  (rr1 (min-of first red))
                  (rc1 (min-of second red))
                  (red-norm (map (lambda (p)
                                   (list (- (first p) rr1) (- (second p) rc1)))
                                 red))
                  (rh (+ 1 (max-of first red-norm)))
                  (rw (+ 1 (max-of second red-norm)))
                  (gray-shape (if horiz
                                  (map (lambda (p)
                                         (list (first p) (- (- rw 1) (second p))))
                                       red-norm)
                                  (map (lambda (p)
                                         (list (- (- rh 1) (first p)) (second p)))
                                       red-norm)))
                  (sdr (if horiz 0 (if (> dr 0) 1 -1)))
                  (sdc (if horiz (if (> dc 0) 1 -1) 0))
                  (cur-red red)
                  (d1 (for ((step (range 0 (max hh ww))))
                        (let* ((next-red (map (lambda (p)
                                                (list (+ (first p) sdr)
                                                      (+ (second p) sdc)))
                                              cur-red))
                               (overlap (for/or ((p next-red))
                                                (hash-has-key? gray-set p)))
                               (adj (for/or ((p next-red))
                                            (for/or ((d cardinal-deltas))
                                                    (hash-has-key? gray-set
                                                                   (list (+ (first p)
                                                                            (first d))
                                                                         (+ (second p)
                                                                            (second d))))))))
                          (unless
                            overlap
                            (set! cur-red next-red)
                            (when adj (set! step (max hh ww)))))))
                  (cr1 (min-of first cur-red))
                  (cc1 (min-of second cur-red))
                  (cr2 (max-of first cur-red))
                  (cc2 (max-of second cur-red))
                  (goff-r (cond
                            ((and horiz (> dc 0)) cr1)
                            ((and horiz (< dc 0)) cr1)
                            ((> dr 0) (+ cr2 1))
                            (else (- cr1 rh))))
                  (goff-c (cond
                            ((and horiz (> dc 0)) (+ cc2 1))
                            ((and horiz (< dc 0)) (- cc1 rw))
                            (else cc1)))
                  (gray-placed (map (lambda (p)
                                      (list (+ (first p) goff-r) (+ (second p) goff-c)))
                                    gray-shape))
                  (result (build-grid hh ww (r c) bg)))

written_solution: Draw the missing-corner triangle implied by 5 markers, preserving markers
program_solution:
(rule! (lambda (g)
  (let* ((h (rows g))
         (w (cols g))
         ;; Exactly four gray cells are present: three square-bbox corners and
         ;; one interior distractor. The bbox extremes identify the square.
         (marks (find-color g 5))
         (r0 (min-of fst marks))
         (r1 (max-of fst marks))
         (c0 (min-of snd marks))
         (c1 (max-of snd marks))
         (d (- r1 r0))
         (tl? (= (at g r0 c0) 5))
         (tr? (= (at g r0 c1) 5))
         (bl? (= (at g r1 c0) 5))
         ;; The absent bbox corner determines the triangle orientation.
         (missing (cond ((not tl?) 0)
                        ((not tr?) 1)
                        ((not bl?) 2)
                        (else 3))))
    ;; Paint only orange background cells, preserving all four gray clues.
    (define (paint-if-bg acc r c)
      (if (and (in-bounds? r c h w) (= (at acc r c) 7))
          (set-cell acc r c 8)
          acc))
    (define (paint-h acc r ca cb)
      (reduce (lambda (a c) (paint-if-bg a r c))
              acc
              (range ca (+ cb 1))))
    (define (paint-v acc c ra rb)
      (reduce (lambda (a r) (paint-if-bg a r c))
              acc
              (range ra (+ rb 1))))
    (define (paint-diag-down acc)
      (reduce (lambda (a k) (paint-if-bg a (+ r0 k) (+ c0 k)))
              acc
              (range 0 (+ d 1))))
    (define (paint-diag-up acc)
      (reduce (lambda (a k) (paint-if-bg a (+ r0 k) (- c1 k)))
              acc
              (range 0 (+ d 1))))
    ;; Draw the two square sides incident to the missing corner and the
    ;; diagonal joining the other two present corners.
    (cond
      ((zero? missing)
       (paint-diag-up (paint-v (paint-h g r0 c0 c1) c0 r0 r1)))
      ((= missing 1)
       (paint-diag-down (paint-v (paint-h g r0 c0 c1) c1 r0 r1)))
      ((= missing 2)
       (paint-diag-down (paint-v (paint-h g r1 c0 c1) c0 r0 r1)))
      (else
       (paint-diag-up (paint-v (paint-h g r1 c0 c1) c1 r0 r1)))))))

(rule! (lambda (g)
  ;; A gray(5) blob = 2x2 "nodes" joined by 1-wide arms. Recolor node cells cyan(8)
  ;; and arm cells red(2). Each arm is a straight run of exactly 3 cells: seeded at
  ;; a degree-1 tip (extend 3 toward its neighbor) or, for a bridge thin cell (not
  ;; in any 2x2), extend 3 toward a thick neighbor (tie-break up,left,down,right).
  (let* ((h (rows g)) (w (cols g))
         (dirs (list (cons -1 0) (cons 0 -1) (cons 1 0) (cons 0 1))))
    (define (sh? a b) (and (>= a 0) (< a h) (>= b 0) (< b w) (= (cell-at g a b) 5)))
    (define (in2x2? a b)
      (for*/or ((da (list -1 0)) (db (list -1 0)))
        (and (sh? (+ a da 0) (+ b db 0)) (sh? (+ a da 0) (+ b db 1))
             (sh? (+ a da 1) (+ b db 0)) (sh? (+ a da 1) (+ b db 1)))))
    (define red (make-hash))
    (define (add-arm a b da db)
      (for ((k (list 0 1 2)))
        (let ((x (+ a (* da k))) (y (+ b (* db k))))
          (when (sh? x y) (hash-set! red (cons x y) #t)))))
    ;; tip arms
    (for* ((a (range h)) (b (range w)))
      (when (sh? a b)
        (let ((nb (filter (lambda (d) (sh? (+ a (car d)) (+ b (cdr d)))) dirs)))
          (when (= (length nb) 1)
            (add-arm a b (car (first nb)) (cdr (first nb)))))))
    ;; bridge arms: thin cells not yet covered
    (for* ((a (range h)) (b (range w)))
      (when (and (sh? a b) (not (in2x2? a b)) (not (hash-has-key? red (cons a b))))
        (let ((chosen (findf (lambda (d)
                               (and (sh? (+ a (car d)) (+ b (cdr d)))
                                    (in2x2? (+ a (car d)) (+ b (cdr d)))))
                             dirs)))
          (when chosen (add-arm a b (car chosen) (cdr chosen))))))
    (grid-from-fn h w
      (lambda (r c)

 ;; the loose non-gray objects are PIECES. Backtracking-search an exact
 ;; cover of every hole by translated pieces (largest pieces first,
 ;; ties by position), then draw containers + placed pieces (in their
 ;; own colors) on a blank canvas. Gray(5) objects are scaffolding and
 ;; disappear.

   (let ()
     (define (sort-cells cells)
       (sort-by cells (lambda (p) (+ (* 100 (first p)) (second p)))))
     (define (holes-of obj)
       ;; 4-connected bg pockets inside the bbox that never reach its edge
       (let* ((r1 (obj-r1 obj)) (c1 (obj-c1 obj))
              (own (obj-cells obj))
              (mask (grid-from-fn (obj-h obj) (obj-w obj)
                                  (lambda (r c)
                                    (if (and (zero? (at g (+ r1 r) (+ c1 c)))
                                             (not (member (list (+ r1 r)
                                                                (+ c1 c))
                                                          own)))
                                        1 0)))))
         (map (lambda (o)
                (sort-cells (map (lambda (p) (list (+ r1 (first p))
                                                   (+ c1 (second p))))
                                 (obj-cells o))))
              (filter (lambda (o) (and (> (obj-r1 o) 0) (> (obj-c1 o) 0)
                                       (< (obj-r2 o) (- (obj-h obj) 1))
                                       (< (obj-c2 o) (- (obj-w obj) 1))))
                      (objects mask 0)))))
     (define objs (objects g 0))
     (define records
       (for/list ((idx (range 0 (length objs))))
         (list idx (list-ref objs idx) (holes-of (list-ref objs idx)))))
     (define containers
       (filter (lambda (rec) (and (not (= (obj-color (second rec)) 5))
                                  (not (empty? (third rec)))))
               records))
     (define container-ids (map first containers))
     ;; piece = (id color shape bbox size)
     (define pieces
       (map (lambda (rec)
              (let ((obj (second rec)))
                (list (first rec) (obj-color obj)
                      (normalize-cells (obj-cells obj))
                      (obj-bbox obj) (obj-size obj))))
            (filter (lambda (rec)
                      (and (not (= (obj-color (second rec)) 5))
                           (not (member (first rec) container-ids))))
                    records)))
     (define (piece-id p) (first p))
     (define (piece-color p) (second p))
     (define (piece-shape p) (third p))
     (define all-holes
       (sort-by (flatmap third containers)
                (lambda (cells)
                  (let ((bb (bbox-of-cells cells)))
                    (+ (* 10000 (first bb)) (* 100 (second bb))
                       (length cells))))))
     (define (translate-shape shape dr dc)
       (sort-cells (map (lambda (p) (list (+ (first p) dr)
                                          (+ (second p) dc)))
                        shape)))

        (filter (lambda (placed) (all? (lambda (p) (member p hole)) placed))

(rule!
 ;; A blue(1) wall has gap OPENINGS — 0-pockets under its top edge,
 ;; walled in on both sides. Gray(5) pieces are keys: a piece turns
 ;; red(2) if it BRANCHES (some cell has 3+ gray neighbors) or if its
 ;; top rows (as tall as an opening) match that opening's shape,
 ;; directly or mirrored. All other cells stay as they are.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define (blue? r c) (and (in-bounds? r c h w) (= (at g r c) 1)))
     (define wall-rows
       (filter (lambda (r) (any? (lambda (c) (blue? r c)) (range 0 w)))
               (range 0 h)))
     (define rmin (apply min wall-rows))
     (define rmax (apply max wall-rows))
     (define opencells
       (for*/list ((r (in-range rmin (+ rmax 1))) (c (in-range 0 w))
                   #:when (and (= (at g r c) 0)
                               (any? (lambda (r2) (blue? r2 c))
                                     (range rmin r))
                               (any? (lambda (c2) (blue? r c2))
                                     (range 0 c))
                               (any? (lambda (c2) (blue? r c2))
                                     (range (+ c 1) w))))
         (list r c)))
     (define openings
       (map obj-cells
            (objects (paint-cells (empty-grid h w 0) opencells 1) 0)))
     (define op-norm (map normalize-cells openings))
     (define op-flip
       (map (lambda (ns) (normalize-cells (flip-cells-lr ns))) op-norm))
     (define op-heights
       (map (lambda (o) (+ 1 (- (max-of first o) (min-of first o))))
            openings))
     (define pieces
       (map obj-cells
            (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) 5)) (objects g 0))))
     (define (branched? piece)
       (any? (lambda (rc)
               (>= (count-if (lambda (d)
                               (member (list (+ (first rc) (first d))
                                             (+ (second rc) (second d)))
                                       piece))
                             cardinal-deltas)
                   3))
             piece))
     (define (matches? piece)
       (let ((top-r (min-of first piece)))
         (any? (lambda (idx)
                 (let ((tn (normalize-cells
                            (filter (lambda (rc)
                                      (< (first rc)
                                         (+ top-r (nth op-heights idx))))
                                    piece))))
                   (or (cells-equal? tn (nth op-norm idx))
                       (cells-equal? tn (nth op-flip idx)))))
               (range 0 (length openings)))))
     (recolor-cells g
                    (flatmap (lambda (piece)
                               (if (or (branched? piece) (matches? piece))
                                   piece
                                   (list)))
                             pieces)
                    2))))

(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (begin
             (define (any-nonzero-row? r) (for/or ((c (range 0 w))) (!= (at g r c) 0)))
             (define (any-nonzero-col? c) (for/or ((r (range 0 h))) (!= (at g r c) 0)))
             (define (runs xs)
               (let loop
                    ((remaining xs) (cur (list)) (acc (list)))
                    (cond
                      ((null? remaining) (reverse (if (null? cur) acc (cons (reverse cur) acc))))
                      ((or (null? cur) (= (first remaining) (+ (first cur) 1))) (loop (rest remaining) (cons (first remaining) cur) acc))
                      (else (loop (rest remaining)
                                  (list (first remaining))
                                  (cons (reverse cur) acc))))))
             (define row-runs (runs (filter any-nonzero-row? (range 0 h))))
             (define col-runs (runs (filter any-nonzero-col? (range 0 w))))
             (define nr (length row-runs))
             (define nc (length col-runs))
             (define th (length (first row-runs)))
             (define tw (length (first col-runs)))
             (define vals
               (filter (lambda (v) (!= v 0))
                       (for*/list ((r (range 0 h)) (c (range 0 w))) (at g r c))))
             (define base (mode-list vals))
             (define slots
               (for*/list ((ri (range 0 nr)) (ci (range 0 nc))) (list ri ci)))
             (define (slot-has-marker? slot)
               (let ((rs (list-ref row-runs (first slot)))
                     (cs (list-ref col-runs (second slot))))
                 (for*/or ((r rs) (c cs))
                          (let ((v (at g r c))) (and (!= v 0) (!= v base))))))
             (define marker-slot (find-first slot-has-marker? slots))
             (define clean-slot
               (find-first (lambda (slot) (not (slot-has-marker? slot))) slots))
             (define mrs (list-ref row-runs (first marker-slot)))
             (define mcs (list-ref col-runs (second marker-slot)))
             (define crs (list-ref row-runs (first clean-slot)))
             (define ccs (list-ref col-runs (second clean-slot)))
             (define (mask? lr lc) (= (at g (list-ref crs lr) (list-ref ccs lc)) base))
             (define (slot-color ri ci)
               (let* ((lr (+ 1 (* 2 ri)))
                      (lc (+ 1 (* 2 ci)))
                      (v (at g (list-ref mrs lr) (list-ref mcs lc))))
                 (if (zero? v) base v)))
             (build-grid (+ (* nr th) (- nr 1))
                         (+ (* nc tw) (- nc 1))
                         (r c)
                         (let ((period-r (+ th 1))
                               (period-c (+ tw 1)))
                           (if (or
                                 (= (modulo r period-r) th)
                                 (= (modulo c period-c) tw))
                               base
                               (let* ((ri (quotient r period-r))
                                      (ci (quotient c period-c))
                                      (lr (modulo r period-r))
                                      (lc (modulo c period-c)))
                                 (if (mask? lr lc) (slot-color ri ci) base)))))))))

                                            (hash-has-key? visited (list cr cc))
                                            (< cr 0)
                                            (>= cr h)
                                            (< cc 0)
                                            (>= cc w)

                       (fill-color (second pass-info)))

                              (cmax (max-of second cells))

                (redray (lambda (cr cc dr dc)

written_solution: Rectangular blocks on bg=7: mark center of odd-dimensioned blocks with cross color. Cross (+shape, minority color) removed if odd blocks <= even blocks, kept otherwise.

(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((bg 7)
                  (colors (filter (lambda (c) (!= c bg)) (grid-colors g)))
                  (counts (map (lambda (c) (list c (length (find-color g c)))) colors))
                  (sorted-counts (sort-by counts (lambda (p) (nth p 1))))
                  (marker-color (nth (first sorted-counts) 0))
                  (block-color (nth (last sorted-counts) 0))
                  (objs (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) block-color))
                                (objects g bg)))
                  (odd-count (count-where (lambda (o)
                                            (let* ((bb (obj-bbox o))
                                                   (h (+ 1 (- (nth bb 2) (nth bb 0))))
                                                   (w (+ 1 (- (nth bb 3) (nth bb 1)))))
                                              (and (= (mod h 2) 1) (= (mod w 2) 1))))
                                          objs))
                  (even-count (- (length objs) odd-count))
                  (keep-cross (> odd-count even-count))
                  (g2 (if keep-cross g (recolor g marker-color bg)))
                  (result (reduce (lambda (acc obj)
                                    (with-bbox obj
                                               (r1 c1 r2 c2)
                                               (let* ((h (+ 1 (- r2 r1)))
                                                      (w (+ 1 (- c2 c1))))
                                                 (if (and
                                                       (= (mod h 2) 1)
                                                       (= (mod w 2) 1))
                                                     (set-cell acc
                                                               (+ r1 (/ (- r2 r1) 2))
                                                               (+ c1 (/ (- c2 c1) 2))
                                                               marker-color)
                                                     acc))))
                                  g2
                                  objs)))
             result))))

(rule!
  (let ((maxd (+ h w))
        (dirs (list (list -1 0) (list 1 0) (list 0 -1) (list 0 1))))
    (define (move-for gp dir)
      (let* ((gr (first gp))
             (gc (second gp))
             (dr (first dir))
             (dc (second dir))
             (k-step
              (find-first
               (lambda (i)
                 (let ((nr (+ gr (* dr i)))
                       (nc (+ gc (* dc i))))
                   (and (in-bounds? nr nc h w)
                        (zero? (at g nr nc)))))
               (range 1 maxd)))
             (k-valid
              (and k-step
                   (for/and ((j (range 1 k-step)))
                     (= (at g (+ gr (* dr j)) (+ gc (* dc j))) 2)))))
        (and
         k-valid
         (let* ((kr (+ gr (* dr k-step)))
                (kc (+ gc (* dc k-step)))
                (tail-end
                 (find-first
                  (lambda (i)
                    (let ((nr (+ kr (* dr i)))
                          (nc (+ kc (* dc i))))
                      (or (not (in-bounds? nr nc h w))
                          (!= (at g nr nc) 2))))

                (pdr (if (zero? dc) 0 (if (< kr (/ h 2)) 1 -1)))
                (pdc (if (zero? dr) 0 (if (< kc (/ w 2)) 1 -1))))

    (let ((moves
           (filter
            (lambda (m) m)
            (flatmap
             (lambda (gp)
               (map (lambda (dir) (move-for gp dir)) dirs))
             (find-color g 5)))))
      (cellmap
       g (r c v)

                         (= c (+ (second m) (* (nth m 5) (+ i 1)))))))

                             (c1 (obj-c1 o))
                             (height (obj-h o))
                             (width (obj-w o))
                             (top (if (= height 1)
                                      (if (zero? r1) 2 1)
                                      (if after-tall 1 baseline)))

                                                (set-cell acc
                                                          (+ top (- (first cell) r1))
                                                          (+ x (- (second cell) c1))
                                                          (obj-color o)))
                                              out
                                              (obj-cells o))))
                        (pack (rest remaining)
                              (+ x width)
                              (or after-tall (>= height 3))
                              painted))))))))

(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((hh (rows g))
                  (ww (cols g))
                  (result (make-hash))
                  (marked (make-hash)))
             (for* ((r (range 0 hh)) (c (range 0 ww)))
                   (hash-set! result (list r c) (at g r c)))
             (for* ((r1 (range 0 (- hh 3))) (c1 (range 0 (- ww 3))))
                   (unless
                     (hash-has-key? marked (list r1 c1))
                     (let* ((color (at g r1 c1))
                            (max-c c1))
                       (let wloop
                            ((mc c1))
                            (when
                              (and (< mc ww) (= (at g r1 mc) color))
                              (set! max-c mc)
                              (wloop (+ mc 1))))
                       (set! max-c (+ max-c 1))
                       (let* ((min-w (- max-c c1))
                              (best-r2 r1)
                              (best-c2 (- max-c 1))
                              (best-area 0))
                         (let rloop
                              ((r (+ r1 1)) (mw min-w))
                              (when
                                (< r hh)
                                (let cloop
                                     ((c c1) (row-w 0))
                                     (if (and (< c (+ c1 mw)) (= (at g r c) color))
                                         (cloop (+ c 1) (+ row-w 1))
                                         (let ((new-mw (min mw row-w)))
                                           (when
                                             (>= new-mw 4)
                                             (let ((area (* (+ 1 (- r r1)) new-mw)))
                                               (when
                                                 (and
                                                   (> area best-area)
                                                   (>= (+ 1 (- r r1)) 4))
                                                 (set! best-area area)
                                                 (set! best-r2 r)
                                                 (set! best-c2 (+ c1 new-mw -1))))
                                             (rloop (+ r 1) new-mw)))))))
                         (when
                           (and (>= (+ 1 (- best-r2 r1)) 4) (>= (+ 1 (- best-c2 c1)) 4))
                           (let ((solid #t))
                             (for* ((dr (range 0 (+ 1 (- best-r2 r1)))) (dc (range 0 (+ 1 (- best-c2 c1)))))

                                     (!= (at g (+ r1 dr) (+ c1 dc)) color)

written_solution: Complete missing patterned cells in separator grids by 2x2 flip symmetry
program_solution:
(rule!
 ;; A separator lattice holds tiles. In every 2x2 block of tiles where
 ;; exactly ONE is empty and the other three share a single color, the
 ;; empty tile receives the mirror of its neighbor — flipped
 ;; up-down across the horizontal axis, left-right across the vertical.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define sep-rows
       (filter (lambda (r) (and (> (at g r 0) 0) (row-uniform? g r)))
               (range 0 h)))
     (define sep-cols
       (filter (lambda (c) (and (> (at g 0 c) 0) (col-uniform? g c)))
               (range 0 w)))
     (define rb (append (list -1) sep-rows (list h)))
     (define cb (append (list -1) sep-cols (list w)))
     (define (tr0 ri) (+ (nth rb ri) 1))
     (define (tr1 ri) (- (nth rb (+ ri 1)) 1))
     (define (tc0 ci) (+ (nth cb ci) 1))
     (define (tc1 ci) (- (nth cb (+ ci 1)) 1))
     (define (tile ri ci)
       (subgrid g (tr0 ri) (tc0 ci) (tr1 ri) (tc1 ci)))
     (define (tile-vals ri ci)
       (for*/list ((r (range (tr0 ri) (+ (tr1 ri) 1)))
                   (c (range (tc0 ci) (+ (tc1 ci) 1))))
         (at g r c)))
     (define (empty-tile? ri ci)
       (all? (lambda (v) (zero? v)) (tile-vals ri ci)))
     (define (tile-color ri ci)
       (let ((vals (filter (lambda (v) (> v 0)) (tile-vals ri ci))))
         (if (empty? vals) 0 (first vals))))
     (define (paste out ri ci patch)
       (if (and (= (rows patch) (+ 1 (- (tr1 ri) (tr0 ri))))
                (= (cols patch) (+ 1 (- (tc1 ci) (tc0 ci)))))
           (for/fold ((a out)) ((p (grid-positions patch)))
             (set-cell a (+ (tr0 ri) (first p))
                       (+ (tc0 ci) (second p))
                       (at patch (first p) (second p))))
           out))
     (for*/fold ((out g)) ((ri (range 0 (- (length rb) 2)))
                           (ci (range 0 (- (length cb) 2))))
       (let* ((quads (list (list ri ci) (list ri (+ ci 1))
                           (list (+ ri 1) ci)
                           (list (+ ri 1) (+ ci 1))))
              (empties (filter (lambda (q) (empty-tile? (first q)
                                                        (second q)))
                               quads))
              (fills (filter (lambda (q) (not (empty-tile? (first q)
                                                           (second q))))
                             quads))
              (colors (remove-duplicates
                       (map (lambda (q) (tile-color (first q)
                                                    (second q)))
                            fills))))
         (if (and (= (length empties) 1) (= (length fills) 3)
                  (= (length colors) 1) (> (first colors) 0))
             (let ((er (first (first empties)))
                   (ec (second (first empties))))
               (paste out er ec
                      (cond ((and (= er ri) (= ec ci))
                             (flip-ud (tile (+ ri 1) ci)))
                            ((and (= er ri) (= ec (+ ci 1)))
                             (flip-lr (tile ri ci)))
                            ((and (= er (+ ri 1)) (= ec ci))
                             (flip-ud (tile ri ci)))
                            (else (flip-ud (tile ri (+ ci 1)))))))
             out))))))

(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((l-comps (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-size o) 3)) (objects g 0)))
                (l-colors (map obj-color l-comps))
                (color-counts (map (lambda (c)
                                     (cons c
                                           (length (filter (lambda (x) (= x c))
                                                           l-colors))))
                                   (unique l-colors)))
                (frame-color (fst (find (lambda (p) (= (snd p) 3)) color-counts)))
                (cross-color (fst (find (lambda (p) (= (snd p) 1)) color-counts)))
                (all-l-cells (flatmap obj-cells l-comps))
                (bb (bbox-of-cells all-l-cells))
                (rmin (first bb))
                (cmin (second bb))
                (rmax (third bb))
                (cmax (fourth bb))
                (scan-col (lambda (c r1 r2)
                            (let ((step (if (>= r2 r1) 1 -1)))
                              (let loop
                                   ((i r1))
                                   (cond
                                     ((or
                                        (and (= step 1) (> i r2))
                                        (and (= step -1) (< i r2))) #f)
                                     ((!= (at g i c) 0) (at g i c))
                                     (else (loop (+ i step))))))))
                (scan-row (lambda (r c1 c2)
                            (let ((step (if (>= c2 c1) 1 -1)))
                              (let loop
                                   ((i c1))
                                   (cond
                                     ((or
                                        (and (= step 1) (> i c2))
                                        (and (= step -1) (< i c2))) #f)
                                     ((!= (at g r i) 0) (at g r i))
                                     (else (loop (+ i step)))))))))
           (cellmap g
                    (r c v)
                    (cond
                      ((and (>= r rmin) (<= r rmax) (>= c cmin) (<= c cmax)) (if (or (= r rmin) (= r rmax) (= c cmin) (= c cmax))
                            frame-color
                            cross-color))
                      ((and (>= c cmin) (<= c cmax) (< r rmin)) (let ((m (scan-col c r (- rmin 1)))) (if m m cross-color)))
                      ((and (>= c cmin) (<= c cmax) (> r rmax)) (let ((m (scan-col c r (+ rmax 1)))) (if m m cross-color)))
                      ((and (>= r rmin) (<= r rmax) (< c cmin)) (let ((m (scan-row r c (- cmin 1)))) (if m m cross-color)))
                      ((and (>= r rmin) (<= r rmax) (> c cmax)) (let ((m (scan-row r c (+ cmax 1)))) (if m m cross-color)))
                      (else v))))))

written_solution: Stamp key-centered cross patterns at matching markers inside large rectangles
program_solution:
(rule!
 ;; Rectangles of the second-most-common color hold marker dots. A KEY
 ;; glyph sits outside them (rooted at the densest marker): its cells
 ;; two steps out from the center give the four ARM colors, its whole
 ;; footprint is the STAMP. For every marker inside a rectangle, draw
 ;; the arms out to the rectangle's edges in the arm colors, then stamp
 ;; the key pattern around the marker (clipped to the rectangle's
 ;; bbox). The key itself is erased.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define all-colors (grid-colors g -999))
     (define bg (pick-max all-colors (lambda (c) (count-color g c))))
     (define rect-color
       (pick-max (filter (lambda (c) (not (= c bg))) all-colors)
                 (lambda (c) (count-color g c))))
     (define rects
       (filter (lambda (o) (and (= (obj-color o) rect-color)
                                (>= (obj-size o) 10)))
               (objects g bg)))
     (define (inside? r c rect)
       (and (>= r (obj-r1 rect)) (<= r (obj-r2 rect))
            (>= c (obj-c1 rect)) (<= c (obj-c2 rect))))
     (define (inside-any? r c)
       (any? (lambda (rect) (inside? r c rect)) rects))
     (define marker-color
       (mode-list (for*/list ((rect rects)
                              (r (range (obj-r1 rect) (+ (obj-r2 rect) 1)))
                              (c (range (obj-c1 rect) (+ (obj-c2 rect) 1)))
                              #:when (let ((v (at g r c)))
                                       (and (not (= v bg))
                                            (not (= v rect-color)))))
                    (at g r c))))
     (define key-center  ;; the outside marker in the densest 5x5 patch
       (pick-max (filter (lambda (p)
                           (and (= (at g (first p) (second p)) marker-color)
                                (not (inside-any? (first p) (second p)))))
                         (grid-positions g))
                 (lambda (p)
                   (for*/sum ((r (range (max 0 (- (first p) 2))
                                        (min h (+ (first p) 3))))
                              (c (range (max 0 (- (second p) 2))
                                        (min w (+ (second p) 3)))))
                     (if (= (at g r c) bg) 0 1)))))
     (define key-cells
       (connected-region g (first key-center) (second key-center)
                         (lambda (r c v) (and (not (= v bg))
                                              (not (inside-any? r c))))
                         8))
     (define offsets  ;; key footprint relative to its center, with colors
       (map (lambda (p) (list (- (first p) (first key-center))
                              (- (second p) (second key-center))
                              (at g (first p) (second p))))
            key-cells))
     (define (offset-color dr dc)
       (let ((hit (find-first (lambda (e) (and (= (first e) dr)
                                               (= (second e) dc)))
                              offsets)))
         (and hit (third hit))))
     (define arm-dirs  ;; (dr dc color) for each arm the key defines
       (filter third
               (list (list -1 0 (offset-color -2 0))
                     (list 1 0 (offset-color 2 0))
                     (list 0 -1 (offset-color 0 -2))
                     (list 0 1 (offset-color 0 2)))))
     (define (paint-arm out rect mr mc dir)
       (let ((dr (first dir)) (dc (second dir)) (color (third dir)))
         (cond ((= dr -1)
                (for/fold ((acc out)) ((r (range (obj-r1 rect) mr)))
                  (set-cell acc r mc color)))
               ((= dr 1)
                (for/fold ((acc out)) ((r (range (+ mr 1)
                                                 (+ (obj-r2 rect) 1))))
                  (set-cell acc r mc color)))
               ((= dc -1)
                (for/fold ((acc out)) ((c (range (obj-c1 rect) mc)))
                  (set-cell acc mr c color)))
               (else
                (for/fold ((acc out)) ((c (range (+ mc 1)
                                                 (+ (obj-c2 rect) 1))))
                  (set-cell acc mr c color))))))
     (define (paint-stamp out rect mr mc)
       (for/fold ((acc out)) ((e offsets))
         (let ((rr (+ mr (first e))) (cc (+ mc (second e))))
           (if (inside? rr cc rect)
               (set-cell acc rr cc (third e))
               acc))))
     (for/fold ((out (erase-cells g key-cells bg))) ((rect rects))
       (for/fold ((acc out))
                 ((m (for*/list ((r (range (obj-r1 rect)
                                           (+ (obj-r2 rect) 1)))
                                 (c (range (obj-c1 rect)
                                           (+ (obj-c2 rect) 1)))
                                 #:when (= (at g r c) marker-color))
                       (list r c))))
         (paint-stamp (for/fold ((a acc)) ((dir arm-dirs))
                        (paint-arm a rect (first m) (second m) dir))
                      rect (first m) (second m)))))))

                     (range 0 h)))

written_solution: extrapolate the next panel in the growing-shape sequence
program_solution:
(rule!
 ;; Panels (3 stacked vertically when h divides into 7-11 rows, else 5
 ;; or 3 across) animate a payload shape moving over a constant
 ;; backdrop. Take the last two panels holding the MAIN payload color,
 ;; read the step between them, and extrapolate one more step onto the
 ;; next blank panel: pure growth extends along the bbox drift, a rigid
 ;; move repeats (additions doubled ahead). A far-apart horizontal pair
 ;; instead fills the shape's column span solid and dots the companion
 ;; color down its center column.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define vertical?
       (and (zero? (modulo h 3))
            (member? (quotient h 3) (list 7 8 9 10 11))))
     (define ph (if vertical? (quotient h 3) h))
     (define pw (if vertical?
                    w
                    (if (zero? (modulo w 5)) (quotient w 5) (quotient w 3))))
     (define (panel-at r0 c0)
       (build-grid ph pw (r c) (at g (+ r0 r) (+ c0 c))))
     (define panels
       (if vertical?
           (for/list ((r0 (range 0 h ph))) (panel-at r0 0))
           (for/list ((c0 (range 0 w pw))) (panel-at 0 c0))))
     (define (colors-of p) (remove-duplicates (map third (grid-cells p))))
     (define common  ;; backdrop colors present in every panel
       (for/fold ((acc (colors-of (first panels)))) ((p (rest panels)))
         (filter (lambda (x) (member x acc)) (colors-of p))))
     (define payload
       (filter (lambda (v) (not (member v common)))
               (remove-duplicates (apply append (map colors-of panels)))))
     (define (count-in p color)
       (count-if (lambda (cell) (= (third cell) color)) (grid-cells p)))
     (define main
       (first (sort payload
                    (lambda (a b) (> (count-in (first panels) a)
                                     (count-in (first panels) b))))))
     (define selected  ;; panels where the main color appears
       (filter (lambda (idx) (> (count-in (list-ref panels idx) main) 0))
               (range 0 (length panels))))
     (define ai (list-ref selected (- (length selected) 2)))
     (define bi (list-ref selected (- (length selected) 1)))
     (define A (list-ref panels ai))
     (define B (list-ref panels bi))
     (define selected-colors
       (filter (lambda (v) (not (member v common)))
               (remove-duplicates (append (colors-of A) (colors-of B)))))
     (define (blank? p)
       (not (for/or ((v payload)) (> (count-in p v) 0))))
     (define base  ;; the panel the next frame lands on
       (let ((after (filter (lambda (idx) (blank? (list-ref panels idx)))
                            (range (+ bi 1) (length panels)))))
         (if (empty? after) B (list-ref panels (first after)))))
     (define clean-base  ;; base with stray payload scrubbed to backdrop
       (let ((fill (mode-list (filter (lambda (v) (member v common))
                                      (map third (grid-cells base))))))
         (build-grid ph pw (r c)
                     (if (member (at base r c) payload)
                         fill
                         (at base r c)))))
     (define (subset-cells? a b) (for/and ((p a)) (member p b)))
     (define (remove-cells a b)
       (filter (lambda (p) (not (member p b))) a))
     (define (shift-cells cells dr dc)
       (filter (lambda (p) (in-bounds? (first p) (second p) ph pw))
               (map (lambda (p) (list (+ (first p) dr) (+ (second p) dc)))
                    cells)))
     (define (bbox-cells cells)
       (list (min-of first cells) (max-of first cells)
             (min-of second cells) (max-of second cells)))
     (define (infer-shift a b)  ;; smallest rigid move taking a into b
       (let ((cands (filter identity
                            (for*/list ((dr (range -4 5)) (dc (range -4 5)))
                              (and (not (and (zero? dr) (zero? dc)))
                                   (subset-cells? (shift-cells a dr dc) b)
                                   (= (length (shift-cells a dr dc))
                                      (length a))
                                   (list (+ (abs dr) (abs dc)) dr dc
                                         (shift-cells a dr dc)))))))
         (if (empty? cands) #f (pick-min cands first))))
     (define (next-cells ca cb)  ;; extrapolate frame B -> next frame
       (cond ((empty? ca) cb)
             ((subset-cells? ca cb)  ;; growth: extend along bbox drift
              (let* ((added (remove-cells cb ca))
                     (ba (bbox-cells ca)) (bb (bbox-cells cb))
                     (dr (cond ((< (first bb) (first ba)) -1)
                               ((> (second bb) (second ba)) 1)
                               (else 0)))
                     (dc (cond ((< (third bb) (third ba)) -1)
                               ((> (fourth bb) (fourth ba)) 1)
                               (else 0))))
                (remove-duplicates (append cb (shift-cells added dr dc)))))
             (else  ;; rigid move (+ additions carried twice as far)
              (let ((move (infer-shift ca cb)))
                (if move
                    (let* ((dr (second move)) (dc (third move))
                           (added (remove-cells cb (fourth move))))
                      (remove-duplicates
                       (append (shift-cells cb dr dc) added
                               (shift-cells added (* 2 dr) (* 2 dc)))))
                    cb)))))
     (if (and (not vertical?) (> (- bi ai) 1))
         (let* ((bb (bbox-cells (cells-of-color B main)))
                (other (find-first (lambda (v) (not (= v main)))
                                   selected-colors))
                (center-col (mode-list (map second (cells-of-color B other))))
                (filled (for*/fold ((out clean-base))
                                   ((r (range 1 (- ph 1)))
                                    (c (range (third bb) (+ (fourth bb) 1))))
                          (set-cell out r c main))))
           (for/fold ((out filled)) ((r (range 1 (- ph 1) 2)))
             (set-cell out r center-col other)))
         (let ((plans  ;; biggest shape painted first (others overlay)
                (sort (map (lambda (color)
                             (let ((cells (next-cells
                                           (cells-of-color A color)
                                           (cells-of-color B color))))
                               (list (length cells) color cells)))
                           selected-colors)
                      (lambda (a b) (> (first a) (first b))))))
           (for/fold ((out clean-base)) ((plan plans))
             (recolor-cells out (third plan) (second plan))))))))

         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (begin
             (define frame-color (mode g 0))
             (define frame-objs
               (filter (lambda (obj)
                         (and (= (obj-color obj) frame-color) (> (obj-size obj) 4)))
                       (objects g 0)))
             (define (full-frame-row? obj r)
               (all? (lambda (c) (= (at g r c) frame-color))
                     (range (obj-c1 obj) (+ (obj-c2 obj) 1))))
             (define (full-frame-col? obj c)
               (all? (lambda (r) (= (at g r c) frame-color))
                     (range (obj-r1 obj) (+ (obj-r2 obj) 1))))
             (define (cuts->intervals cuts)
               (for/list ((i (range 0 (- (length cuts) 1))) #:when
                   (<= (+ (list-ref cuts i) 1) (- (list-ref cuts (+ i 1)) 1)))
                 (list (+ (list-ref cuts i) 1) (- (list-ref cuts (+ i 1)) 1))))
             (define (row-intervals obj)
               (cuts->intervals (for/list ((r (range (obj-r1 obj) (+ (obj-r2 obj) 1))) #:when
                                    (full-frame-row? obj r))
                                  r)))
             (define (col-intervals obj)
               (cuts->intervals (for/list ((c (range (obj-c1 obj) (+ (obj-c2 obj) 1))) #:when
                                    (full-frame-col? obj c))
                                  c)))
             (define records
               (map (lambda (obj) (list obj (row-intervals obj) (col-intervals obj)))
                    frame-objs))
             (define (slot-values ri ci)
               (flatmap (lambda (rec)
                          (let ((rs (second rec))
                                (cs (third rec)))
                            (if (and (< ri (length rs)) (< ci (length cs)))
                                (let ((rr (list-ref rs ri))
                                      (cc (list-ref cs ci)))

                                          (for*/list ((r (range (first rr) (+ (second rr) 1))) (c (range (first cc) (+ (second cc) 1))))
                                            (at g r c))))
                                (list))))
                        records))
             (define (slot-color ri ci)
               (let ((vals (slot-values ri ci))) (if (empty? vals) #f (mode-list vals))))
             (foldl (lambda (rec acc)
                      (let ((rs (second rec))
                            (cs (third rec)))
                        (for*/fold ((out acc))
                                   ((ri (range 0 (length rs))) (ci (range 0 (length cs))))
                                   (let ((color (slot-color ri ci)))
                                     (if color
                                         (let ((rr (list-ref rs ri))
                                               (cc (list-ref cs ci)))
                                           (for*/fold ((out2 out))
                                                      ((r (range (first rr)
                                                                 (+ (second rr) 1))) (c (range (first cc)
                                                                  (+ (second cc) 1))))
                                                      (if (zero? (at g r c))
                                                          (set-cell out2 r c color)
                                                          out2)))
                                         out)))))
                    g
                    records)))))

written_solution: Border ring replication: colored segment repeats at 2× its length intervals around border.
program_solution:
(rule!
 (lambda (g)
   (let* ((h (rows g))
          (w (cols g))
          (bg 8)
          (ring-len (- (+ (* 2 h) (* 2 w)) 4))
          ;; Number the perimeter clockwise: top left-to-right, right downward,
          ;; bottom right-to-left, then left upward back toward the origin.
          (pos->rc
           (lambda (p)
             (cond
               ((< p w) (list 0 p))
               ((< p (+ w (- h 1)))
                (list (+ 1 (- p w)) (- w 1)))
               ((< p (+ (* 2 w) (- h 2)))
                (list (- h 1) (- (+ (- (* 2 w) 3) h) p)))
               (else
                (list (- (+ (- (* 2 w) 4) (* 2 h)) p) 0)))))
          ;; Read the one monochrome source segment in that ring coordinate.
          (colored-pos
           (filter
            (lambda (p)
              (let ((rc (pos->rc p)))
                (!= (at g (first rc) (snd rc)) bg)))
            (range 0 ring-len)))
          (color-val
           (let ((rc (pos->rc (first colored-pos))))
             (at g (first rc) (snd rc))))
          (n (length colored-pos))
          (stride (* 2 n))
          ;; Offsets preserve the cyclic source shape, including a segment that
          ;; crosses the top-left wrap from ring-len-1 back to position 0.
          (base-offsets
           (map (lambda (p) (- p (first colored-pos))) colored-pos))
          ;; Traverse one full ring at stride 2N.  When stride divides the ring
          ;; length the final start duplicates the first, which is harmless.
          (all-starts
           (map
            (lambda (k)
              (mod (+ (first colored-pos) (* k stride)) ring-len))
            (range 0 (+ 1 (/ ring-len stride)))))
          ;; Retain the source segment and paint every repeated copy.
          (result
           (reduce
            (lambda (acc start)
              (reduce
               (lambda (out offset)
                 (let* ((p (mod (+ start offset) ring-len))
                        (rc (pos->rc p)))
                   (set-cell out (first rc) (snd rc) color-val)))
               acc
               base-offsets))
            g
            all-starts)))
     result)))

(rule! (lambda (g)
  (let* ((h (rows g))
         (w (cols g))
         ;; The unique vertical key column contains only cyan 8 and blue 1.
         (vc (find (lambda (c)
                     (not (find (lambda (r)
                                  (let ((v (at g r c)))
                                    (not (or (= v 8) (= v 1)))))
                                (range 0 h))))
                   (range 0 w)))
         ;; Any non-key column exposes each horizontal stripe's source color.
         (sc (if (zero? vc) 1 0))
         (stripes
          (filter (lambda (p) p)
                  (for/list ((r (range 0 h)))
                    (let ((v (at g r sc)))
                      (and (!= v 7) (!= v 8) (!= v 1)
                           (list r v))))))
         ;; Stripe rows become blue. Other rows inherit the nearest stripe
         ;; colors; an odd gap between different colors gets a blue midpoint.
         (row-info
          (for/list ((r (range 0 h)))
            (let ((sm (find (lambda (s) (= r (first s))) stripes)))
              (if sm
                  (list 1 #t)
                  (let ((above (filter (lambda (s) (< (first s) r)) stripes))
                        (below (filter (lambda (s) (> (first s) r)) stripes)))
                    (list
                     (cond
                       ((empty? above) (second (first below)))
                       ((empty? below) (second (last above)))
                       (else
                        (let* ((sa (last above))
                               (sb (first below))
                               (ra (first sa))
                               (ca (second sa))
                               (rb (first sb))
                               (cb (second sb))
                               (gap (- rb ra 1))
                               (pos (- r ra 1)))
                          (if (= ca cb)
                              ca
                              (if (zero? (remainder gap 2))
                                  (if (< pos (quotient gap 2)) ca cb)
                                  (let ((mid (quotient gap 2)))
                                    (cond ((< pos mid) ca)
                                          ((= pos mid) 1)
                                          (else cb))))))))
                     #f)))))))
    ;; Swap the key-column roles: stripe rows show 8, all other rows show 1.
    (cellmap g (r c v)
      (let* ((info (nth row-info r))
             (fill (first info))
             (stripe-row? (second info)))
        (if (= c vc)
            (if stripe-row? 8 1)
            fill))))))
