written_solution: Connect 2x2 blocks along the longest visible orthogonal path from the start block
program_solution:
(rule!
 ;; 2x2 blocks are nodes: the red(2) one is the start, cyan(8) the
 ;; rest. Two nodes connect when axis-aligned with no node between.
 ;; Walk the LONGEST simple path from the start (ties broken by
 ;; direction priority right, down, left, up) and pave orange(7)
 ;; corridors between consecutive nodes.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define (block? r c)  ;; top-left corner of a 2x2 block
       (let ((v (at g r c)))
         (and (or (= v 2) (= v 8))
              (= (at g r (+ c 1)) v)
              (= (at g (+ r 1) c) v)
              (= (at g (+ r 1) (+ c 1)) v)
              (or (zero? r)
                  (not (and (= (at g (- r 1) c) v)
                            (= (at g (- r 1) (+ c 1)) v))))
              (or (zero? c)
                  (not (and (= (at g r (- c 1)) v)
                            (= (at g (+ r 1) (- c 1)) v)))))))
     (define nodes
       (for*/list ((r (range 0 (- h 1))) (c (range 0 (- w 1)))
                   #:when (block? r c))
         (list r c (at g r c))))
     (define start (find-first (lambda (n) (= (third n) 2)) nodes))
     (define (between? x a b) (and (> x (min a b)) (< x (max a b))))
     (define (adjacent? a b)  ;; same line of sight, nothing between
       (or (and (= (first a) (first b))
                (not (any? (lambda (n)
                             (and (not (equal? n a)) (not (equal? n b))
                                  (= (first n) (first a))
                                  (between? (second n) (second a)
                                            (second b))))
                           nodes)))
           (and (= (second a) (second b))
                (not (any? (lambda (n)
                             (and (not (equal? n a)) (not (equal? n b))
                                  (= (second n) (second a))
                                  (between? (first n) (first a)
                                            (first b))))
                           nodes)))))
     (define (dir-priority a b)  ;; right 0, down 1, left 2, up 3
       (cond ((= (first a) (first b))
              (if (< (second a) (second b)) 0 2))
             ((< (first a) (first b)) 1)
             (else 3)))
     (define (dir-list path)
       (if (or (empty? path) (empty? (rest path)))
           (list)
           (cons (dir-priority (first path) (second path))
                 (dir-list (rest path)))))
     (define (lex-less? xs ys)
       (cond ((empty? xs) #f)
             ((< (first xs) (first ys)) #t)
             ((> (first xs) (first ys)) #f)
             (else (lex-less? (rest xs) (rest ys)))))
     (define (better-path? a b)
       (cond ((> (length a) (length b)) #t)
             ((< (length a) (length b)) #f)
             (else (lex-less? (dir-list a) (dir-list b)))))
     (define (best-path-from current visited)  ;; exhaustive DFS
       (let ((candidates
              (map (lambda (n)
                     (cons current
                           (best-path-from n (cons n visited))))
                   (filter (lambda (n)
                             (and (not (member n visited))
                                  (adjacent? current n)
                                  (not (equal? n current))))
                           nodes))))
         (if (empty? candidates)
             (list current)
             (first (sort candidates better-path?)))))
     (define (corridor out a b)  ;; orange fill between two blocks
       (cond ((= (first a) (first b))
              (for*/fold ((acc out))
                         ((rr (range (first a) (+ (first a) 2)))
                          (cc (range (+ (min (second a) (second b)) 2)
                                     (max (second a) (second b)))))
                (set-cell acc rr cc 7)))
             ((= (second a) (second b))
              (for*/fold ((acc out))
                         ((rr (range (+ (min (first a) (first b)) 2)
                                     (max (first a) (first b))))
                          (cc (range (second a) (+ (second a) 2))))
                (set-cell acc rr cc 7)))
             (else out)))
     (let loop ((path (best-path-from start (list start))) (out g))
       (if (or (empty? path) (empty? (rest path)))
           out
           (loop (rest path)
                 (corridor out (first path) (second path))))))))

written_solution: Two anchor blocks plus local top/side keys generate the repeated rectangular frame
program_solution:
(rule!
 ;; Two solid same-size anchor squares (top-left A, bottom-right B) fix
 ;; the corners of a rectangular truss; nearby sample cells define its
 ;; palette. Rebuild the whole truss on a blank canvas: solid top and
 ;; bottom chords one row outside the anchor rows, dash-4 patterned
 ;; rows through the anchor bands, all four corner anchors, and side
 ;; rails between the bands cycling solid rung / rail+inner rung / bare
 ;; rails on a 4-row phase.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define bg (mode g -1))
     (define objs (objects g bg))
     (define (solid? o) (= (obj-size o) (* (obj-h o) (obj-w o))))
     (define anchor-color  ;; a color with two same-size solid rects
       (find-first
        (lambda (color)
          (let ((same (filter (lambda (o) (and (= (obj-color o) color)
                                               (solid? o)))
                              objs)))
            (any? (lambda (a)
                    (any? (lambda (b)
                            (and (not (equal? (obj-bbox a) (obj-bbox b)))
                                 (= (obj-h a) (obj-h b))
                                 (= (obj-w a) (obj-w b))))
                          same))
                  same)))
        (grid-colors g bg)))
     (define anchors
       (sort-by (filter (lambda (o) (and (= (obj-color o) anchor-color)
                                         (solid? o)))
                        objs)
                (lambda (o) (+ (* 1000 (obj-r1 o)) (obj-c1 o)))))
     (define a (first anchors))
     (define b (last anchors))
     (define ar1 (obj-r1 a)) (define ac1 (obj-c1 a))
     (define ar2 (obj-r2 a)) (define ac2 (obj-c2 a))
     (define br1 (obj-r1 b)) (define bc1 (obj-c1 b))
     (define br2 (obj-r2 b)) (define bc2 (obj-c2 b))
     (define top-color (at g ar1 (+ ac2 1)))
     (define horiz-color  ;; second color along A's top row
       (for/first ((c (range (+ ac2 2) w))
                   #:when (let ((v (at g ar1 c)))
                            (and (not (= v bg))
                                 (not (= v anchor-color))
                                 (not (= v top-color)))))
         (at g ar1 c)))
     (define side-color  ;; first color below A
       (for*/first ((r (range (+ ar2 1) h)) (c (range ac1 (+ ac2 1)))
                    #:when (let ((v (at g r c)))
                             (and (not (= v bg))
                                  (not (= v anchor-color)))))
         (at g r c)))
     (define side-inner  ;; second color below A
       (for*/first ((r (range (+ ar2 1) h)) (c (range ac1 (+ ac2 1)))
                    #:when (let ((v (at g r c)))
                             (and (not (= v bg))
                                  (not (= v anchor-color))
                                  (not (= v side-color)))))
         (at g r c)))
     (define (paint-rect out r1 c1 r2 c2 color)
       (for*/fold ((acc out)) ((r (range r1 (+ r2 1)))
                               (c (range c1 (+ c2 1))))
         (if (in-bounds? r c h w) (set-cell acc r c color) acc)))
     (define gap-c1 (+ ac2 1))
     (define gap-c2 (- bc1 1))
     (define chords  ;; solid lines just outside the anchor rows
       (paint-rect (paint-rect (empty-grid h w bg)
                               (- ar1 1) gap-c1 (- ar1 1) gap-c2 top-color)
                   (+ br2 1) gap-c1 (+ br2 1) gap-c2 top-color))
     (define banded  ;; dash-4 pattern through both anchor bands
       (foldl (lambda (r acc)
                (for/fold ((out acc)) ((c (range gap-c1 (+ gap-c2 1))))
                  (set-cell out r c
                            (let ((phase (modulo (- c gap-c1) 4)))
                              (cond ((zero? phase) top-color)
                                    ((= phase 2) horiz-color)
                                    (else bg))))))
              chords
              (append (range ar1 (+ ar2 1)) (range br1 (+ br2 1)))))
     (define cornered
       (paint-rect (paint-rect (paint-rect (paint-rect banded
                                                       ar1 ac1 ar2 ac2
                                                       anchor-color)
                                           ar1 bc1 ar2 bc2 anchor-color)
                               br1 ac1 br2 ac2 anchor-color)
                   br1 bc1 br2 bc2 anchor-color))
     (foldl (lambda (r acc)  ;; side rails between the bands, phase 4
              (let ((phase (modulo (- r (+ ar2 1)) 4)))
                (cond ((zero? phase)  ;; full rungs
                       (paint-rect (paint-rect acc
                                               r (- ac1 1) r ac2
                                               side-color)
                                   r bc1 r (+ bc2 1) side-color))
                      ((= phase 2)  ;; rails + inner rungs
                       (paint-rect
                        (paint-rect
                         (paint-rect
                          (paint-rect acc r (- ac1 1) r (- ac1 1)
                                      side-color)
                          r ac1 r ac2 side-inner)
                         r bc1 r bc2 side-inner)
                        r (+ bc2 1) r (+ bc2 1) side-color))
                      (else  ;; bare rails
                       (paint-rect (paint-rect acc
                                               r (- ac1 1) r (- ac1 1)
                                               side-color)
                                   r (+ bc2 1) r (+ bc2 1) side-color)))))
            cornered
            (range (+ ar2 1) br1)))))

written_solution: Sections separated by gray(5) rows show progressive change; output = next step via shifted diff
program_solution:
(rule! (lambda (g)
  (let* ((h (rows g)) (w (cols g))
         (seps (filter (lambda (r) (= (at g r 0) 5)) (range 0 h)))
         (sec-h (first seps))
         (starts (append (list 0) (map (lambda (s) (+ s 1)) seps)))
         (ns (length starts))
         (sec (lambda (si)
           (let* ((start (nth starts si)))
             (for/list ((r (range start (+ start sec-h))))
               (for/list ((c (range 0 w))) (at g r c))))))
         (s-last (sec (- ns 1)))
         (s-prev (sec (- ns 2)))
         (s-pprev (sec (- ns 3)))
         ;; Diff: changed cells between two sections
         (diff (lambda (sa sb)
           (filter (lambda (d) d)
             (for*/list ((r (range 0 sec-h)) (c (range 0 w)))
               (let* ((va (nth (nth sa r) c)) (vb (nth (nth sb r) c)))
                 (and (!= va vb) (list r c va vb)))))))
         (d-prev (diff s-pprev s-prev))
         (d-last (diff s-prev s-last))
         (d-last-rows (unique (map first d-last)))
         (carry-diffs (filter (lambda (d) (not (find (lambda (r) (= r (first d))) d-last-rows))) d-prev))
         ;; Column shift between consecutive diffs
         (col-shift (if (or (empty? d-prev) (empty? d-last)) 0
           (- (reduce (lambda (a b) (if (< a b) a b))
                (second (first d-last)) (map second (rest d-last)))
              (reduce (lambda (a b) (if (< a b) a b))
                (second (first d-prev)) (map second (rest d-prev)))))))
    ;; Apply shifted diff to last section
    (grid-from-fn sec-h w (lambda (r c)
      (let* ((m (find (lambda (d) (and (= (first d) r)
              (= (+ (second d) col-shift) c))) d-last))
             (m2 (find (lambda (d)
                  (and (= (first d) r)
                       (> c (second d))
                       (= (nth (nth s-last r) c) (third d))
                       (not (for/or ((cc (range (+ (second d) 1) c)))
                              (= (nth (nth s-last r) cc) (third d))))))
                carry-diffs)))
          (cond
            [(and m (= (nth (nth s-last r) c) (third m))) (fourth m)]
            [m2 (fourth m2)]
            [else (nth (nth s-last r) c)])))))))

written_solution: copy the complete accent template onto matching 4-shapes under D4 transforms
program_solution:
(rule!
 ;; Yellow(4) skeletons repeat around the board; the richest one (most
 ;; decoration colors) is the BASE. For each plain copy, find the
 ;; dihedral orientation mapping the base skeleton onto it — a red(2)
 ;; cell breaks symmetric ties — and stamp the base's decorations
 ;; through that orientation.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define (val p) (at g (first p) (second p)))
     (define comps
       (filter (lambda (o) (any? (lambda (p) (= (val p) 4))
                                 (obj-cells o)))
               (objects-multicolor g 0)))
     (define (deco-colors o)
       (remove-duplicates (filter (lambda (v) (not (= v 4)))
                                  (map val (obj-cells o)))))
     (define base (pick-max comps (lambda (o) (length (deco-colors o)))))
     (define (spin p idx)  ;; the 8 dihedral images of a cell
       (let ((r (first p)) (c (second p)))
         (cond ((zero? idx) (list r c))
               ((= idx 1) (list c (- r)))
               ((= idx 2) (list (- r) (- c)))
               ((= idx 3) (list (- c) r))
               ((= idx 4) (list r (- c)))
               ((= idx 5) (list (- c) (- r)))
               ((= idx 6) (list (- r) c))
               (else (list c r)))))
     (define (sort-pos cells) (sort cells cell<))
     (define (yellows o) (filter (lambda (p) (= (val p) 4))
                                 (obj-cells o)))
     (define (rel cells r0 c0)
       (map (lambda (p) (list (- (first p) r0) (- (second p) c0)))
            cells))
     (define base-y (yellows base))
     (define by-r0 (min-of first base-y))
     (define by-c0 (min-of second base-y))
     (define base-yrel (sort-pos (rel base-y by-r0 by-c0)))
     (define base-deco  ;; (dr dc color) for the base's decorations
       (map (lambda (p) (list (- (first p) by-r0)
                              (- (second p) by-c0)
                              (val p)))
            (filter (lambda (p) (not (= (val p) 4))) (obj-cells base))))
     (define base-twos
       (map (lambda (e) (list (first e) (second e)))
            (filter (lambda (e) (= (third e) 2)) base-deco)))
     (define (rel-after idx p)  ;; spin, then re-anchor on the skeleton
       (let* ((raws (map (lambda (q) (spin q idx)) base-yrel))
              (raw (spin p idx)))
         (list (- (first raw) (min-of first raws))
               (- (second raw) (min-of second raws)))))
     (for/fold ((out g)) ((obj (in-list comps)))
       (if (> (length (deco-colors obj)) 1)
           out
           (let* ((ys (yellows obj))
                  (tr0 (min-of first ys))
                  (tc0 (min-of second ys))
                  (target-yrel (sort-pos (rel ys tr0 tc0)))
                  (target-twos
                   (sort-pos (rel (filter (lambda (p) (= (val p) 2))
                                          (obj-cells obj))
                                  tr0 tc0)))
                  (idx (find-first
                        (lambda (idx)
                          (and (equal? (sort-pos
                                        (map (lambda (p)
                                               (rel-after idx p))
                                             base-yrel))
                                       target-yrel)
                               (or (empty? target-twos)
                                   (any? (lambda (bp)
                                           (member (rel-after idx bp)
                                                   target-twos))
                                         base-twos))))
                        (range 0 8))))
             (if idx
                 (for/fold ((gg out)) ((e (in-list base-deco)))
                   (let ((p (rel-after idx (list (first e)
                                                 (second e)))))
                     (if (in-bounds? (+ tr0 (first p))
                                     (+ tc0 (second p)) h w)
                         (set-cell gg (+ tr0 (first p))
                                   (+ tc0 (second p)) (third e))
                         gg)))
                 out)))))))

(rule!
 ;; Count monochrome 8-connected objects separately for every nonzero color.
 ;; Select the color with the most objects, then use its first object in
 ;; reading order as the anchor. Copy that color from the anchor's top-left
 ;; 3x3 window; all other output cells are background.
 (lambda (g)
   (let* ((h (rows g))
          (w (cols g))
          (colors
           (filter (lambda (v) (!= v 0))
                   (unique
                    (flatmap (lambda (r)
                               (map (lambda (c) (at g r c))
                                    (range 0 w)))
                             (range 0 h)))))
          (all-objs (objects-8 g 0))
          (color-obj-counts
           (map (lambda (color)
                  (cons color
                        (count-if (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) color))
                                  all-objs)))
                colors))
          (best (fst (pick-max color-obj-counts snd)))
          (obj (find-first (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) best)) all-objs))
          (bb (obj-bbox obj))
          (r1 (nth bb 0))
          (c1 (nth bb 1)))
     (build-grid 3
                 3

                 (let* ((nr (+ r1 r))
                        (nc (+ c1 c)))
                   (if (and (< nr h)
                            (< nc w)
                            (= (at g nr nc) best))
                       best
                       0))))))

written_solution: copy the colored 3x3-neighborhood template around every matching macro-cell
program_solution:
(rule!
 ;; Separator lines split the board into a MACRO lattice (each block's
 ;; value = its modal color). One block has the richest set of colored
 ;; neighbors — that neighborhood is the LESSON: copy it (as relative
 ;; offsets) around every other block of the same color, filling only
 ;; empty blocks. Paint the result back through the lattice.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define (full-row? r)
       (and (not (= (at g r 0) 0))
            (all? (lambda (c) (= (at g r c) (at g r 0))) (range 0 w))))
     (define (full-col? c)
       (and (not (= (at g 0 c) 0))
            (all? (lambda (r) (= (at g r c) (at g 0 c))) (range 0 h))))
     (define all-full-rows (filter full-row? (range 0 h)))
     (define all-full-cols (filter full-col? (range 0 w)))
     (define sep
       (if (empty? all-full-rows)
           (at g 0 (first all-full-cols))
           (at g (first all-full-rows) 0)))
     (define sep-rows
       (filter (lambda (r) (= (at g r 0) sep)) all-full-rows))
     (define sep-cols
       (filter (lambda (c) (= (at g 0 c) sep)) all-full-cols))
     (define (intervals n seps)  ;; block spans between separators
       (let loop ((rem seps) (start 0) (acc (list)))
         (cond ((empty? rem)
                (reverse (if (<= start (- n 1))
                             (cons (list start (- n 1)) acc)
                             acc)))
               ((<= start (- (first rem) 1))
                (loop (rest rem) (+ (first rem) 1)
                      (cons (list start (- (first rem) 1)) acc)))
               (else (loop (rest rem) (+ (first rem) 1) acc)))))
     (define ris (intervals h sep-rows))
     (define cis (intervals w sep-cols))
     (define R (length ris))
     (define C (length cis))
     (define (index-in ints x)
       (let loop ((idx 0) (xs ints))
         (cond ((empty? xs) #f)
               ((and (>= x (first (first xs)))
                     (<= x (second (first xs))))
                idx)
               (else (loop (+ idx 1) (rest xs))))))
     (define macro
       (build-grid R C (i j)
                   (let ((vals (for*/list ((r (range (first (nth ris i))
                                                     (+ (second (nth ris i))
                                                        1)))
                                           (c (range (first (nth cis j))
                                                     (+ (second (nth cis j))
                                                        1)))
                                           #:when (and (not (= (at g r c)
                                                               0))
                                                       (not (= (at g r c)
                                                               sep))))
                                 (at g r c))))
                     (if (empty? vals) 0 (mode-list vals)))))
     (define (neighborhood i j target)  ;; (dr dc color) of other colors
       (for*/list ((dr (list -1 0 1)) (dc (list -1 0 1))
                   #:when (and (not (and (zero? dr) (zero? dc)))
                               (in-bounds? (+ i dr) (+ j dc) R C)
                               (not (= (at macro (+ i dr) (+ j dc)) 0))
                               (not (= (at macro (+ i dr) (+ j dc))
                                       target))))
         (list dr dc (at macro (+ i dr) (+ j dc)))))
     (define best  ;; the block with the richest neighborhood
       (pick-max (filter (lambda (e) (> (first e) 0))
                         (for*/list ((i (range 0 R)) (j (range 0 C)))
                           (let* ((target (at macro i j))
                                  (pat (if (zero? target)
                                           (list)
                                           (neighborhood i j target))))
                             (list (length pat) i j target pat))))
                 first))
     (define filled  ;; replicate the lesson around every target block
       (for*/fold ((m macro)) ((i (range 0 R)) (j (range 0 C)))
         (if (= (at m i j) (fourth best))
             (for/fold ((mm m)) ((e (in-list (fifth best))))
               (if (and (in-bounds? (+ i (first e)) (+ j (second e)) R C)
                        (zero? (at mm (+ i (first e)) (+ j (second e)))))
                   (set-cell mm (+ i (first e)) (+ j (second e))
                             (third e))
                   mm))
             m)))
     (cellmap g (r c v)
              (if (or (member r sep-rows) (member c sep-cols))
                  v
                  (let ((ri (index-in ris r)) (ci (index-in cis c)))
                    (if (and ri ci) (at filled ri ci) v)))))))

         (cells (positions-of g (lambda (v) (!= v 0))))

         (c2 (fourth bb))

         (ic2 (fourth ibb))

         (inner-w (+ 1 (- ic2 ic1)))

         (nc1 (- c1 thick))

               (>= c nc1) (<= c nc2)
               (not (and (>= r r1) (<= r r2)

                (non-bg (filter (lambda (p) (not (= (car p) 0))) color-pairs))
                (sorted-pairs (sort-by non-bg (lambda (p) (- (cdr p)))))
                (wall (car (first sorted-pairs)))
                (mc (car (first (filter (lambda (p) (not (= (car p) wall)))

                                 (let loop

                                              (if ray-cells
                                                  (foldl (lambda (rc accc)
                                                           (set-cell accc

(rule! (lambda (g)
  (let* ((w (cols g))
         ;; Four monochrome 3-row masks are stacked vertically. Project them
         ;; onto one 3-row frame without letting color identity encode priority.
         (band (lambda (j r c) (at g (+ (* j 3) r) c))))
    (build-grid 3 w (r c)
      ;; First nonzero wins in priority order 0 > 1 > 3 > 2.
      (let ((v0 (band 0 r c))
            (v1 (band 1 r c))
            (v3 (band 3 r c))
            (v2 (band 2 r c)))
        (cond
          ((!= v0 0) v0)
          ((!= v1 0) v1)
          ((!= v3 0) v3)
          ((!= v2 0) v2)
          (else 0)))))))

written_solution: Pick the zero component aligned with the 5 object, remove its stem, and paint the facing side 6
program_solution:
(rule!
 ;; On an orange(7) field, pick the empty(0) region best aligned with
 ;; the gray(5) block (row overlap >> column overlap >> size, penalized
 ;; by distance). Trim it to its MAIN solid rectangle (the larger of
 ;; the fullest-rows and fullest-cols rectangles; stray cells refill
 ;; orange) and paint magenta(6) along the rectangle edge facing the
 ;; gray block.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define fcells (find-color g 5))
     (define fr0 (min-of first fcells))
     (define fr1 (max-of first fcells))
     (define fc0 (min-of second fcells))
     (define fc1 (max-of second fcells))
     (define (overlap a0 a1 b0 b1)
       (max 0 (+ 1 (- (min a1 b1) (max a0 b0)))))
     (define (score obj)
       (+ (* (overlap (obj-r1 obj) (obj-r2 obj) fr0 fr1) 100000)
          (* (overlap (obj-c1 obj) (obj-c2 obj) fc0 fc1) 100)
          (obj-size obj)
          (- (* (max 0 (- (obj-c1 obj) fc1) (- fc0 (obj-c2 obj)))
                1000))
          (- (max 0 (- (obj-r1 obj) fr1) (- fr0 (obj-r2 obj))))))
     (define (main-rect cells)  ;; the region's dominant solid rectangle
       (let* ((rs (unique (map first cells)))
              (cs (unique (map second cells)))
              (row-count (lambda (r) (count-if (lambda (p)
                                                 (= (first p) r))
                                               cells)))
              (col-count (lambda (c) (count-if (lambda (p)
                                                 (= (second p) c))
                                               cells)))
              (a-rows (filter (lambda (r) (= (row-count r)
                                             (max-of row-count rs)))
                              rs))
              (a-cols (filter (lambda (c)
                                (all? (lambda (r)
                                        (member? (list r c) cells))
                                      a-rows))
                              cs))
              (b-cols (filter (lambda (c) (= (col-count c)
                                             (max-of col-count cs)))
                              cs))
              (b-rows (filter (lambda (r)
                                (all? (lambda (c)
                                        (member? (list r c) cells))
                                      b-cols))
                              rs)))
         (if (>= (* (length a-rows) (length a-cols))
                 (* (length b-rows) (length b-cols)))
             (list (min-list a-rows) (min-list a-cols)
                   (max-list a-rows) (max-list a-cols))
             (list (min-list b-rows) (min-list b-cols)
                   (max-list b-rows) (max-list b-cols)))))
     (let* ((z (select-object-by
                (filter (lambda (o) (and (zero? (obj-color o))
                                         (> (obj-size o) 1)))
                        (objects g 7))
                score 'max))
            (bb (main-rect (obj-cells z)))
            (r0 (first bb)) (c0 (second bb))
            (r1 (third bb)) (c1 (fourth bb))
            (rect (positions-in-rect r0 c0 r1 c1))
            (cleared (paint-cells g
                                  (filter (lambda (p)
                                            (not (member? p rect)))
                                          (obj-cells z))
                                  7))
            (dr (- (+ fr0 fr1) (+ r0 r1)))
            (dc (- (+ fc0 fc1) (+ c0 c1))))
       (cond ((>= (abs dc) (abs dr))
              (paint-cells cleared
                           (map (lambda (r) (list r (if (> dc 0) c1 c0)))
                                (range r0 (+ r1 1)))
                           6))
             ((> dr 0)
              (paint-cells cleared
                           (map (lambda (c) (list r1 c))
                                (range c0 (+ c1 1)))
                           6))
             (else
              (paint-cells cleared
                           (map (lambda (c) (list r0 c))
                                (range c0 (+ c1 1)))
                           6)))))))

written_solution: Column cells form pyramid at grid bottom. Total=k^2 cells decomposed into layers 1,3,...,2k-1. Colors stacked bottom=lowest-in-input, each filling layers by count.
program_solution:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((result (make-hash)))
             (for* ((r (range 0 h)) (c (range 0 w))) (hash-set! result (list r c) 0))
             (for ((col (range 0 w)))
               (let* ((cells (for/list ((r (range 0 h)) #:when (!= (at g r col) 0))
                               (list r (at g r col))))
                      (total (length cells)))
                 (when
                   (> total 0)
                   (let* ((k (inexact->exact (floor (sqrt (+ 0.0 total)))))
                          (colors-rev (list))
                          (seen (make-hash))
                          (dummy (for ((cell (reverse cells)))
                                   (let ((color (second cell)))
                                     (unless
                                       (hash-has-key? seen color)
                                       (hash-set! seen color #t)
                                       (set! colors-rev
                                             (append colors-rev (list color)))))))
                          (ccounts (make-hash))
                          (dummy2 (for ((cell cells))
                                    (hash-set! ccounts
                                               (second cell)
                                               (+ 1 (hash-ref ccounts (second cell) 0)))))
                          (layers (for/list ((i (range 0 k))) (- (- (* 2 k) 1) (* 2 i))))
                          (cidx 0)
                          (rem (hash-ref ccounts (list-ref colors-rev 0) 0))
                          (layer-colors (for/list ((lw layers))
                                          (begin
                                            (when
                                              (<= rem 0)
                                              (set! cidx (+ cidx 1))
                                              (set! rem
                                                    (hash-ref ccounts
                                                              (list-ref colors-rev cidx)
                                                              0)))
                                            (set! rem (- rem lw))
                                            (list-ref colors-rev cidx)))))
                     (for ((i (range 0 k)))
                       (let* ((lw (list-ref layers i))
                              (color (list-ref layer-colors i))
                              (row (- (- h 1) i))
                              (start (- col (quotient lw 2))))
                         (for ((dc (range 0 lw)))
                           (let ((c (+ start dc)))
                             (when
                               (and (>= c 0) (< c w))
                               (hash-set! result (list row c) color))))))))))
             (cellmap g (r c v) (hash-ref result (list r c) 0))))))

written_solution: Fixed borders + aligned inner mapping (top-align if no bottom border, proportional otherwise)
program_solution:
(rule!
 ;; TEMPLATE objects (bbox holds another color) show how each color's
 ;; block is decorated. Every PLAIN block copies its color's template
 ;; interior (largest template per color wins): sides where the template
 ;; border is missing align to that edge, bordered axes scale
 ;; proportionally. A plain block whose color has NO template instead
 ;; takes a symmetric striped row pattern (first=last=its color) with
 ;; the middle run stretched to the block's width.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define objs (objects g 0))
     (define (has-inner? o)
       (not (all? (lambda (p)
                    (let ((v (at g (first p) (second p))))
                      (or (= v 0) (= v (obj-color o)))))
                  (positions-in-rect (obj-r1 o) (obj-c1 o)
                                     (obj-r2 o) (obj-c2 o)))))
     (define plains (filter (lambda (o) (not (has-inner? o))) objs))
     (define tmpls  ;; one template per color, largest first
       (let loop ((rem (sort-by (filter has-inner? objs)
                                (lambda (o) (- (obj-size o)))))
                  (seen (list)) (acc (list)))
         (cond ((empty? rem) (reverse acc))
               ((member? (obj-color (first rem)) seen)
                (loop (rest rem) seen acc))
               (else (loop (rest rem)
                           (cons (obj-color (first rem)) seen)
                           (cons (first rem) acc))))))
     (define tmpl-colors (map obj-color tmpls))
     (define (runs vals)  ;; run-length encode: ((value count) ...)
       (if (empty? vals)
           (list)
           (let loop ((rem (rest vals)) (cur (first vals)) (n 1)
                      (acc (list)))
             (cond ((empty? rem) (reverse (cons (list cur n) acc)))
                   ((= (first rem) cur) (loop (rest rem) cur (+ n 1) acc))
                   (else (loop (rest rem) (first rem) 1
                               (cons (list cur n) acc)))))))
     (define stripes  ;; rows: solid nonzero span, symmetric, >=3 odd runs
       (filter values
               (for/list ((r (range 0 h)))
                 (let ((cs (filter (lambda (c) (> (at g r c) 0))
                                   (range 0 w))))
                   (if (empty? cs)
                       #f
                       (let ((vals (for/list ((c (range (min-list cs)
                                                        (+ (max-list cs) 1))))
                                     (at g r c))))
                         (if (and (all? (lambda (v) (> v 0)) vals)
                                  (> (length (remove-duplicates vals)) 1)
                                  (= (first vals) (last vals))
                                  (odd? (length (runs vals)))
                                  (>= (length (runs vals)) 3))
                             vals
                             #f)))))))
     (define (fit-center-run vals target-w)
       ;; same runs, middle run stretched so the total width = target-w
       (let* ((rs (runs vals)) (n (length rs)) (mid (quotient n 2))
              (mid-len (- target-w
                          (for/sum ((i (range 0 n))
                                    #:when (not (= i mid)))
                            (second (nth rs i))))))
         (if (< mid-len 1)
             #f
             (apply append
                    (for/list ((i (range 0 n)))
                      (make-list (if (= i mid) mid-len (second (nth rs i)))
                                 (first (nth rs i))))))))
     (define (depth limit full-at?)  ;; solid border thickness from an edge
       (let loop ((d 0))
         (if (and (< d limit) (full-at? d)) (loop (+ d 1)) d)))
     (define (dress out tmpl)
       (let* ((pc (obj-color tmpl))
              (tr1 (obj-r1 tmpl)) (tc1 (obj-c1 tmpl))
              (tr2 (obj-r2 tmpl)) (tc2 (obj-c2 tmpl))
              (row-full (lambda (r) (all? (lambda (c) (= (at g r c) pc))
                                          (range tc1 (+ tc2 1)))))
              (col-full (lambda (c) (all? (lambda (r) (= (at g r c) pc))
                                          (range tr1 (+ tr2 1)))))
              (top-b (depth (obj-h tmpl) (lambda (d) (row-full (+ tr1 d)))))
              (bot-b (depth (obj-h tmpl) (lambda (d) (row-full (- tr2 d)))))
              (left-b (depth (obj-w tmpl) (lambda (d) (col-full (+ tc1 d)))))
              (right-b (depth (obj-w tmpl) (lambda (d) (col-full (- tc2 d)))))
              (ti-r1 (+ tr1 top-b)) (ti-r2 (- tr2 bot-b))
              (ti-c1 (+ tc1 left-b)) (ti-c2 (- tc2 right-b))
              (ti-h (+ 1 (- ti-r2 ti-r1))) (ti-w (+ 1 (- ti-c2 ti-c1)))
              (scale (lambda (i span-in span-out)
                       (min (inexact->exact
                             (round (* (/ (+ 0.0 i)
                                          (+ 0.0 (max 1 span-in)))
                                       span-out)))
                            span-out))))
         (for/fold ((acc out))
                   ((plain (in-list (filter (lambda (p)
                                              (= (obj-color p) pc))
                                            plains))))
           (let* ((pi-r1 (+ (obj-r1 plain) top-b))
                  (pi-r2 (- (obj-r2 plain) bot-b))
                  (pi-c1 (+ (obj-c1 plain) left-b))
                  (pi-c2 (- (obj-c2 plain) right-b))
                  (pi-h (+ 1 (- pi-r2 pi-r1)))
                  (pi-w (+ 1 (- pi-c2 pi-c1))))
             (if (and (> ti-h 0) (> ti-w 0) (> pi-h 0) (> pi-w 0))
                 (for*/fold ((a acc)) ((r (range pi-r1 (+ pi-r2 1)))
                                       (c (range pi-c1 (+ pi-c2 1))))
                   (let* ((sr (cond ((zero? bot-b)
                                     (min (+ ti-r1 (- r pi-r1)) ti-r2))
                                    ((zero? top-b)
                                     (max ti-r1 (- ti-r2 (- pi-r2 r))))
                                    (else (+ ti-r1 (scale (- r pi-r1)
                                                          (- pi-h 1)
                                                          (- ti-h 1))))))
                          (sc (cond ((zero? right-b)
                                     (min (+ ti-c1 (- c pi-c1)) ti-c2))
                                    ((zero? left-b)
                                     (max ti-c1 (- ti-c2 (- pi-c2 c))))
                                    (else (+ ti-c1 (scale (- c pi-c1)
                                                          (- pi-w 1)
                                                          (- ti-w 1))))))
                          (lc (at g sr sc)))
                     (if (and (> lc 0) (not (= lc pc)))
                         (set-cell a r c lc)
                         a)))
                 acc)))))
     (define (stripe out plain)
       (let ((pc (obj-color plain)) (pw (obj-w plain)))
         (if (member? pc tmpl-colors)
             out
             (let ((fitted
                    (find-first (lambda (x) x)
                                (map (lambda (vals)
                                       (if (and (= (first vals) pc)
                                                (= (last vals) pc))
                                           (fit-center-run vals pw)
                                           #f))
                                     stripes))))
               (if fitted
                   (for*/fold ((a out))
                              ((r (range (obj-r1 plain)
                                         (+ (obj-r2 plain) 1)))
                               (i (range 0 pw)))
                     (set-cell a r (+ (obj-c1 plain) i) (nth fitted i)))
                   out)))))
     (for/fold ((out (for/fold ((o g)) ((t (in-list tmpls))) (dress o t))))
               ((p (in-list plains)))
       (stripe out p)))))

                (ow (+ 1 (- c2 c1)))

(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((n (rows g))
                  (sep (find-first (lambda (r) (member? 2 (row g r))) (range 0 n)))
                  (odd-cols (filter (lambda (c) (= (modulo c 2) 1)) (range 0 n))))
             (define (count8 c) (count-where (lambda (r) (= (at g r c) 8)) (range 0 n)))
             (define top-count (max-of count8 odd-cols))
             (define (lead7 c)
               (let loop ((r 0)) (if (or (= r n) (!= (at g r c) 7)) r (loop (+ r 1)))))
             (cellmap g
                      (r c v)
                      (if (zero? (modulo c 2))
                          (cond ((= r sep) 2) ((= r (+ sep 1)) 5) (else 7))
                          (let* ((bottom-count (max 0
                                                    (- (+ (lead7 c) (count8 c)) sep 1)))
                                 (top-start (+ (- sep top-count) 1)))
                            (cond
                              ((and (>= r top-start) (<= r sep)) 8)
                              ((>= r (- n bottom-count)) 9)
                              ((> r sep) 1)
                              (else 7)))))))))

written_solution: Concentric L-corner rings: each shape becomes a ring sized by max bbox dim, L arm from input shape, output dim 2n+1 or 2n-1 if center exists
program_solution:
(rule!
 ;; Each color draws a corner glyph: an L whose ARM length shows how
 ;; thick its ring's corners are. Nest all colors as concentric square
 ;; rings (sizes 1,3,5,... when some glyph is a single cell, else
 ;; 3,5,7,...): a glyph needs a ring at least as big as itself; glyphs
 ;; that exactly match a ring size claim theirs largest-first. Draw
 ;; each assigned ring as four corner Ls of the glyph's arm length.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define bg (at g 0 0))
     (define (count-ext col from-r from-c dr dc)
       (let loop ((i 0))
         (let ((nr (+ from-r (* i dr))) (nc (+ from-c (* i dc))))
           (if (and (in-bounds? nr nc h w) (= (at g nr nc) col))
               (loop (+ i 1))
               i))))
     (define (corner-arm col cell dr dc)
       (min (count-ext col (first cell) (second cell) 0 dc)
            (count-ext col (first cell) (second cell) dr 0)))
     (define (color-info c)  ;; (color max-dim arm)
       (let* ((cells (find-color g c))
              (bb (bbox-of-cells cells)))
         (list c
               (max (+ 1 (- (third bb) (first bb)))
                    (+ 1 (- (fourth bb) (second bb))))
               (max-of (lambda (cell)
                         (max (corner-arm c cell 1 1)
                              (corner-arm c cell 1 -1)
                              (corner-arm c cell -1 1)
                              (corner-arm c cell -1 -1)))
                       cells))))
     (define infos
       (map color-info (filter (lambda (c) (not (= c bg)))
                               (grid-colors g))))
     (define n (length infos))
     (define has-center (any? (lambda (i) (= (second i) 1)) infos))
     (define out-size (if has-center (- (* 2 n) 1) (+ (* 2 n) 1)))
     (define ring-sizes
       (map (lambda (i) (+ (if has-center 1 3) (* 2 i))) (range 0 n)))
     (define (exact? info) (member? (second info) ring-sizes))
     (define (assign shps available acc)
       ;; each shape takes the smallest ring that still fits it
       (if (null? shps)
           (list acc available)
           (let ((target (find (lambda (r) (>= r (second (first shps))))
                               available)))
             (assign (rest shps)
                     (filter (lambda (r) (not (= r target))) available)
                     (cons (list (first shps) target) acc)))))
     (define assignments  ;; loose fits first, exact matches biggest-first
       (let* ((step1 (assign (filter (lambda (i) (not (exact? i))) infos)
                             ring-sizes (list)))
              (step2 (assign (sort-by (filter exact? infos)
                                      (lambda (i) (- 0 (second i))))
                             (second step1) (first step1))))
         (reverse (first step2))))
     (define out-mid (quotient out-size 2))
     (define (l-cells arm size)  ;; 4 corner Ls of a size x size ring
       (let ((tl (append (map (lambda (i) (list 0 i)) (range 0 arm))
                         (map (lambda (i) (list i 0)) (range 0 arm)))))
         (append tl
                 (map (lambda (p) (list (first p)
                                        (- (- size 1) (second p))))
                      tl)
                 (map (lambda (p) (list (- (- size 1) (first p))
                                        (second p)))
                      tl)
                 (map (lambda (p) (list (- (- size 1) (first p))
                                        (- (- size 1) (second p))))
                      tl))))
     (define (place-ring gg assn)
       (let* ((shape (first assn))
              (ring-size (second assn))
              (offset (- out-mid (quotient ring-size 2))))
         (recolor-cells gg
                        (map (lambda (p) (list (+ (first p) offset)
                                               (+ (second p) offset)))
                             (l-cells (min (third shape) ring-size)
                                      ring-size))
                        (first shape))))
     (reduce place-ring (empty-grid out-size out-size bg)
             (sort-by assignments (lambda (a) (- 0 (second a))))))))

(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g))

                                 (all? (lambda (c) (zero? (at g r c))) (range 0 w)))
                               (range 0 h)))
                (cseps (filter (lambda (c)
                                 (all? (lambda (r) (zero? (at g r c))) (range 0 h)))
                               (range 0 w))))
           (define (spans seps limit)
             (let loop
                  ((xs seps) (start 0) (acc (list)))
                  (if (empty? xs)
                      (reverse (if (< start limit)
                                   (cons (list start (- limit 1)) acc)
                                   acc))
                      (let* ((sep (fst xs)))
                        (loop (cdr xs)
                              (+ sep 1)
                              (if (< start sep) (cons (list start (- sep 1)) acc) acc))))))
           (define rbands (spans rseps h))
           (define cbands (spans cseps w))
           (define tiles
             (filter (lambda (tile) (!= (third tile) 0))
                     (flatmap (lambda (rb)
                                (map (lambda (cb) (list rb cb (at g (fst rb) (fst cb))))
                                     cbands))
                              rbands)))
           (define (has-offset? color dr dc)
             (any? (lambda (tile)
                     (let* ((rb (fst tile))
                            (cb (snd tile))
                            (r (+ (fst rb) dr))
                            (c (+ (fst cb) dc)))
                       (and

                     (let* ((rb (fst tile))
                            (cb (snd tile))
                            (color (third tile))
                            (r0 (fst rb))
                            (r1 (snd rb))
                            (c0 (fst cb))
                            (c1 (snd cb))
                            (offsets (flatmap (lambda (dr)
                                                (map (lambda (dc) (list dr dc))
                                                     (range 0 (+ 1 (- c1 c0)))))
                                              (range 0 (+ 1 (- r1 r0))))))
                       (reduce (lambda (a off)

                               offsets)))

(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g))
                (groups (list))
                (in-grp #f)
                (start 0))
           (for ((c (range 0 w)))
             (let* ((has-red (for/or ((r (range 0 h))) (= (at g r c) 2))))
               (cond
                 ((and has-red (not in-grp)) (set! start c) (set! in-grp #t))
                 ((and (not has-red) in-grp) (set! groups (append groups (list (list start (- c 1)))))
                   (set! in-grp #f)))))
           (when in-grp (set! groups (append groups (list (list start (- w 1))))))
           (let* ((group-data (for/list ((grp groups))
                                (let* ((c1 (first grp))
                                       (c2 (second grp))
                                       (holes (for/sum ((r (range 0 h)))
                                                (for/sum ((c (range c1 (+ c2 1))))
                                                  (if (zero? (at g r c)) 1 0)))))
                                  (list holes c1 c2))))
                  (sorted (sort group-data (lambda (a b) (< (first a) (first b)))))
                  (result (make-hash)))
             (for* ((r (range 0 h)) (c (range 0 w))) (hash-set! result (list r c) 0))
             (for ((i (range 0 (length sorted))))
               (let* ((entry (list-ref sorted i))
                      (src-c1 (second entry))
                      (src-c2 (third entry))
                      (gwidth (+ 1 (- src-c2 src-c1)))
                      (dest-grp (list-ref groups i))
                      (dst-c1 (first dest-grp)))
                 (for* ((r (range 0 h)) (dc (range 0 gwidth)))
                       (hash-set! result (list r (+ dst-c1 dc)) (at g r (+ src-c1 dc))))))
             (cellmap g (r c v) (hash-ref result (list r c) 0))))))

(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g))
                (first-empty-row (let loop
                                      ((r 0))
                                      (cond
                                        ((>= r h) h)
                                        ((for/and ((c (range 0 w))) (zero? (at g r c))) r)
                                        (else (loop (+ r 1))))))
                (top-h first-empty-row)
                (runs (let loop
                           ((cx 0) (acc (list)))
                           (cond
                             ((>= cx w) (reverse acc))
                             ((zero? (at g 0 cx)) (loop (+ cx 1) acc))
                             (else (let* ((run-color (at g 0 cx))
                                          (run-end (let find-end
                                                        ((cc cx))
                                                        (cond
                                                          ((>= cc w) cc)
                                                          ((zero? (at g 0 cc)) cc)
                                                          (else (find-end (+ cc 1)))))))
                                     (loop run-end
                                           (cons (list cx (- run-end 1) run-color) acc)))))))
                (swatches (filter (lambda (r) (!= (third r) 5)) runs))
                (template-bounds (filter (lambda (r) (= (third r) 5)) runs))
                (template-mats (for/list ((tb template-bounds))
                                 (let* ((cs (first tb))
                                        (ce (second tb)))
                                   (for/list ((r (range 0 top-h)))
                                     (for/list ((cx (range cs (+ ce 1)))) (at g r cx))))))
                (swatch-colors (map third swatches))
                (color-to-template (make-hash)))
           (for ((i (range 0 (length swatch-colors))))
             (hash-set! color-to-template
                        (list-ref swatch-colors i)
                        (list-ref template-mats i)))
           (let* ((layout-cells (for*/list ((r (range first-empty-row h)) (cx (range 0 w))
                                    #:when
                                    (!= (at g r cx) 0))
                                  (list r cx)))
                  (layout-rs (map first layout-cells))
                  (layout-cs (map second layout-cells))
                  (l-r1 (min-list layout-rs))
                  (l-r2 (max-list layout-rs))
                  (l-c1 (min-list layout-cs))
                  (l-c2 (max-list layout-cs))
                  (layout-h (+ 1 (- l-r2 l-r1)))
                  (layout-w (+ 1 (- l-c2 l-c1)))
                  (tmpl-h top-h)
                  (tmpl-w (+ 1
                             (- (second (first template-bounds))
                                (first (first template-bounds))))))
             (build-grid (* layout-h tmpl-h)
                         (* layout-w tmpl-w)
                         (r c)
                         (let* ((lr (quotient r tmpl-h))
                                (lc (quotient c tmpl-w))

                                (tmpl-val (list-ref (list-ref template tr) tc)))
                           (casev tmpl-val (hash 5 layout-color) 0)))))))

written_solution: template (1-shape + 2-markers) gets scaled and stamped at each standalone 2-block; scale = block side length, aligned by matching 2-markers
program_solution:
(rule!
 ;; A TEMPLATE shape (blue 1 body with red 2 marker cells stuck to it)
 ;; plus scattered solid red squares. Each red square is one marker of
 ;; a scaled-up phantom copy (square side = scale): find the marker
 ;; whose implied origin puts EVERY template marker on a red square,
 ;; then stamp the whole template there at that scale. Keep the
 ;; template and squares; everything else clears.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define one-cells (find-color g 1))
     (define two-cells (find-color g 2))
     (define template-twos  ;; red cells touching the blue body
       (filter (lambda (tc)
                 (any? (lambda (d) (member (list (+ (first tc) (first d))
                                                 (+ (second tc)
                                                    (second d)))
                                           one-cells))
                       cardinal-deltas))
               two-cells))
     (define standalone-twos
       (filter (lambda (c) (not (member c template-twos))) two-cells))
     (define tmpl-box (bbox-of-cells (append one-cells template-twos)))
     (define tmpl  ;; normalized template: 1 body / 2 marker / 0 empty
       (grid-from-fn (+ 1 (- (third tmpl-box) (first tmpl-box)))
                     (+ 1 (- (fourth tmpl-box) (second tmpl-box)))
                     (lambda (r c)
                       (let ((gr (+ (first tmpl-box) r))
                             (gc (+ (second tmpl-box) c)))
                         (cond ((= (at g gr gc) 1) 1)
                               ((member (list gr gc) template-twos) 2)
                               (else 0))))))
     (define markers
       (filter (lambda (p) (= (at tmpl (first p) (second p)) 2))
               (grid-positions tmpl)))
     (define blocks  ;; 4-connected components of the standalone reds
       (map obj-cells
            (objects (paint-cells (empty-grid h w 0) standalone-twos 1)
                     0)))
     (define (stamp out origin-r origin-c scale)
       (for*/fold ((acc out)) ((p (grid-positions tmpl))
                               (dr (range 0 scale)) (dc (range 0 scale)))
         (let ((tv (at tmpl (first p) (second p)))
               (pr (+ origin-r (* (first p) scale) dr))
               (pc (+ origin-c (* (second p) scale) dc)))
           (if (and (> tv 0) (in-bounds? pr pc h w))
               (set-cell acc pr pc tv)
               acc))))
     (define base
       (paint-cells (paint-cells (empty-grid h w 0) one-cells 1)
                    (append template-twos standalone-twos) 2))
     (let loop ((bs blocks) (placed (list)) (out base))
       (if (null? bs)
           out
           (let* ((bb (bbox-of-cells (first bs)))
                  (scale (+ 1 (- (third bb) (first bb))))
                  (hit  ;; (key stamp?) for the first origin already
                        ;; placed or fully landing on red squares
                   (let try ((ms markers))
                     (if (null? ms)
                         #f
                         (let ((key (list (- (first bb)
                                             (* (first (first ms)) scale))
                                          (- (second bb)
                                             (* (second (first ms)) scale))
                                     scale)))
                           (cond ((member key placed) (list key #f))
                                 ((all? (lambda (m)
                                          (member
                                           (list (+ (first key)
                                                    (* (first m) scale))
                                                 (+ (second key)
                                                    (* (second m) scale)))
                                           standalone-twos))
                                        markers)
                                  (list key #t))
                                 (else (try (rest ms)))))))))
             (if (and hit (second hit))
                 (loop (rest bs) (cons (first hit) placed)
                       (stamp out (first (first hit)) (second (first hit))
                              scale))
                 (loop (rest bs) placed out))))))))

written_solution: Self-similar fractal tiling: shape arrangement mirrors shape itself, block N marks cell N with cyan(8)
program_solution:
(rule!
 ;; One tile sits somewhere on a separator lattice (green marks are
 ;; noise). Build the tile's FRACTAL: blocks laid out like the tile's
 ;; own nonzero cells, each holding a copy of the tile, colored cyan(8)
 ;; at the cell whose rank inside the tile equals the block's rank
 ;; among the blocks (the self-position) and red(2) everywhere else.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define clean (cellmap g (r c v) (if (= v 3) 0 v)))
     (define sep-rows
       (filter (lambda (r) (all? (lambda (c) (zero? (at clean r c)))
                                 (range 0 w)))
               (range 0 h)))
     (define sep-cols
       (filter (lambda (c) (all? (lambda (r) (zero? (at clean r c)))
                                 (range 0 h)))
               (range 0 w)))
     (define first-row
       (find-first (lambda (r) (any? (lambda (c) (> (at clean r c) 0))
                                     (range 0 w)))
                   (range 0 h)))
     (define first-col
       (find-first (lambda (c) (any? (lambda (r) (> (at clean r c) 0))
                                     (range 0 h)))
                   (range 0 w)))
     (define th
       (let ((nxt (find-first (lambda (r) (> r first-row)) sep-rows)))
         (if nxt (- nxt first-row) (- h first-row))))
     (define tw
       (let ((nxt (find-first (lambda (c) (> c first-col)) sep-cols)))
         (if nxt (- nxt first-col) (- w first-col))))
     (define n-brows (quotient (+ h 1) (+ th 1)))
     (define n-bcols (quotient (+ w 1) (+ tw 1)))
     (define tile  ;; the one block with content
       (find-first
        (lambda (sub) (any? (lambda (v) (> v 0)) (apply append sub)))
        (for*/list ((br (range 0 n-brows)) (bc (range 0 n-bcols)))
          (subgrid clean (* br (+ th 1)) (* bc (+ tw 1))
                   (+ (* br (+ th 1)) (- th 1))
                   (+ (* bc (+ tw 1)) (- tw 1))))))
     (define tile-cells  ;; nonzero tile positions, row-major
       (filter (lambda (p) (> (at tile (first p) (second p)) 0))
               (positions-in-rect 0 0 (- th 1) (- tw 1))))
     (define (rank-of rr cc)  ;; row-major rank among the tile cells
       (count-if (lambda (p) (or (< (first p) rr)
                                 (and (= (first p) rr)
                                      (< (second p) cc))))
                 tile-cells))
     (build-grid h w (r c)
                 (let ((br (quotient r (+ th 1)))
                       (bc (quotient c (+ tw 1)))
                       (tr (remainder r (+ th 1)))
                       (tc (remainder c (+ tw 1))))
                   (if (and (< br n-brows) (< bc n-bcols)
                            (< tr th) (< tc tw)
                            (> (at tile br bc) 0)
                            (> (at tile tr tc) 0))
                       (if (= (rank-of br bc) (rank-of tr tc)) 8 2)
                       0))))))

written_solution: Place other (non-matching, non-T) shape above/below bottom shape based on T stem direction
program_solution:
(rule!
 ;; A gray(5) divider row splits the board. Above it sit a red(2)
 ;; ARROW (its solid bar row marks the direction it points) and a
 ;; colored ATTACHMENT shape; below sits the BASE shape. Output the
 ;; bottom half with the attachment glued to the base — beneath it
 ;; when the arrow points down (bar on top), above when up — aligned
 ;; to the base's left edge.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define divider
       (find-first (lambda (r) (all? (lambda (c) (= (at g r c) 5))
                                     (range 0 w)))
                   (range 0 h)))
     (define (cells-in r1 r2 color)
       (filter (lambda (p) (and (>= (first p) r1) (< (first p) r2)))
               (find-color g color)))
     (define (region-colors r1 r2)
       (remove-duplicates
        (filter (lambda (v) (and (> v 0) (not (= v 5))))
                (flatmap (lambda (r) (row g r)) (range r1 r2)))))
     (define bottom-color (first (region-colors (+ divider 1) h)))
     (define other-color
       (find-first (lambda (c) (and (not (= c 2))
                                    (not (= c bottom-color))))
                   (region-colors 0 divider)))
     (define t-cells (cells-in 0 divider 2))
     (define bar-row  ;; the arrow's solid bar = its most crowded row
       (pick-max (remove-duplicates (map first t-cells))
                 (lambda (r) (count-if (lambda (p) (= (first p) r))
                                       t-cells))))
     (define t-down (= bar-row (min-of first t-cells)))
     (define b-cells (cells-in (+ divider 1) h bottom-color))
     (define o-cells (cells-in 0 divider other-color))
     (define o-r1 (min-of first o-cells))
     (define o-c1 (min-of second o-cells))
     (define o-h (+ 1 (- (max-of first o-cells) o-r1)))
     (define new-b-r1 (- (min-of first b-cells) divider 1))
     (define new-o-r1
       (if t-down
           (+ new-b-r1 (+ 1 (- (max-of first b-cells)
                               (min-of first b-cells))))
           (- new-b-r1 o-h)))
     (define new-o-c1 (min-of second b-cells))
     (define out-h (- h divider 1))
     (for/fold ((out (subgrid g (+ divider 1) 0 (- h 1) (- w 1))))
               ((p (in-list o-cells)))
       (let ((nr (+ (- (first p) o-r1) new-o-r1))
             (nc (+ (- (second p) o-c1) new-o-c1)))
         (if (in-bounds? nr nc out-h w)
             (set-cell out nr nc other-color)
             out))))))

written_solution: parse 3x3 macro-cells and swap/fill panels according to internal 4 dividers

(rule!
 ;; The grid is a MACRO board: bands of rows/cols that contain a run of
 ;; exactly 3 equal nonzero cells are macro cells (value = modal color).
 ;; Full uniform non-0/non-4 lines between bands split the board into
 ;; PANELS. Inside a panel, an all-yellow(4) gap strip is a mirror mark:
 ;; swap the macro columns (or rows) on its two sides pairwise. Panels
 ;; with no mark and exactly one color besides 0/1 replace their 1s with
 ;; that color. Paint the new macro values back into the bands.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define (has-run3? vals)
       ;; any maximal run of equal nonzero values of length exactly 3?
       (let loop ((xs vals) (cur 0) (n 0))
         (cond ((empty? xs) (and (> cur 0) (= n 3)))
               ((= (first xs) cur) (loop (rest xs) cur (+ n 1)))
               (else (or (and (> cur 0) (= n 3))
                         (if (zero? (first xs))
                             (loop (rest xs) 0 0)
                             (loop (rest xs) (first xs) 1)))))))
     (define (intervals flags)  ;; maximal #t runs -> ((start end) ...)
       (let loop ((i 0) (xs flags) (start #f) (acc (list)))
         (cond ((empty? xs)
                (reverse (if start (cons (list start (- i 1)) acc) acc)))
               ((first xs) (loop (+ i 1) (rest xs) (or start i) acc))
               (else (loop (+ i 1) (rest xs) #f
                           (if start
                               (cons (list start (- i 1)) acc)
                               acc))))))
     (define ris
       (intervals (for/list ((r (range 0 h))) (has-run3? (row g r)))))
     (define cis
       (intervals (for/list ((c (range 0 w))) (has-run3? (col g c)))))
     (define R (length ris))
     (define C (length cis))
     (define (band lst k) (list-ref lst k))
     (define (span iv) (range (first iv) (+ (second iv) 1)))
     (define macro
       (build-grid R C (i j)
                   (let ((vals (for*/list ((r (span (band ris i)))
                                           (c (span (band cis j)))
                                           #:when (> (at g r c) 0))
                                 (at g r c))))
                     (if (empty? vals) 0 (mode-list vals)))))
     (define (separator? uniform? head)  ;; full non-0/non-4 line
       (and uniform? (> head 0) (not (= head 4))))
     (define (cut-rows k)  ;; a separator row in the gap after band k?
       (for/or ((r (range (+ (second (band ris k)) 1)
                          (first (band ris (+ k 1))))))
         (separator? (row-uniform? g r) (at g r 0))))
     (define (cut-cols k)
       (for/or ((c (range (+ (second (band cis k)) 1)
                          (first (band cis (+ k 1))))))
         (separator? (col-uniform? g c) (at g 0 c))))
     (define (groups n cuts)  ;; split 0..n-1 at the cut indices
       (let loop ((rem cuts) (start 0) (acc (list)))
         (if (empty? rem)
             (reverse (cons (list start (- n 1)) acc))
             (loop (rest rem) (+ (first rem) 1)
                   (cons (list start (first rem)) acc)))))
     (define row-groups (groups R (filter cut-rows (range 0 (- R 1)))))
     (define col-groups (groups C (filter cut-cols (range 0 (- C 1)))))
     (define (all-4? cells)
       (and (not (empty? cells))
            (all? (lambda (p) (= (at g (first p) (second p)) 4)) cells)))
     (define (v-mark? rg j)  ;; yellow strip in the col gap after band j
       (let ((cstart (+ (second (band cis j)) 1))
             (cend (- (first (band cis (+ j 1))) 1)))
         (and (<= cstart cend)
              (all-4? (positions-in-rect (first (band ris (first rg)))
                                         cstart
                                         (second (band ris (second rg)))
                                         cend)))))
     (define (h-mark? cg i)
       (let ((rstart (+ (second (band ris i)) 1))
             (rend (- (first (band ris (+ i 1))) 1)))
         (and (<= rstart rend)
              (all-4? (positions-in-rect rstart
                                         (first (band cis (first cg)))
                                         rend
                                         (second (band cis (second cg))))))))
     (define (swap-cols acc rg cg j)  ;; pairwise across the mark (from macro)
       (let ((lefts (range (first cg) (+ j 1)))
             (rights (range (+ j 1) (+ (second cg) 1))))
         (if (not (= (length lefts) (length rights)))
             acc
             (for*/fold ((mm acc)) ((i (range (first rg)
                                              (+ (second rg) 1)))
                                    (pair (zip-lists lefts rights)))
               (let ((a (first pair)) (b (second pair)))
                 (set-cell (set-cell mm i a (at macro i b))
                           i b (at macro i a)))))))
     (define (swap-rows acc rg cg i)
       (let ((tops (range (first rg) (+ i 1)))
             (bots (range (+ i 1) (+ (second rg) 1))))
         (if (not (= (length tops) (length bots)))
             acc
             (for*/fold ((mm acc)) ((pair (zip-lists tops bots))
                                    (j (range (first cg)
                                              (+ (second cg) 1))))
               (let ((a (first pair)) (b (second pair)))
                 (set-cell (set-cell mm a j (at macro b j))
                           b j (at macro a j)))))))
     (define (fill-panel acc rg cg)  ;; lone non-0/1 color claims the 1s
       (let ((non1 (remove-duplicates
                    (for*/list ((i (range (first rg) (+ (second rg) 1)))
                                (j (range (first cg) (+ (second cg) 1)))
                                #:when (and (> (at macro i j) 0)
                                            (not (= (at macro i j) 1))))
                      (at macro i j)))))
         (if (= (length non1) 1)
             (for*/fold ((mm acc)) ((i (range (first rg)
                                              (+ (second rg) 1)))
                                    (j (range (first cg)
                                              (+ (second cg) 1))))
               (if (= (at macro i j) 1)
                   (set-cell mm i j (first non1))
                   mm))
             acc)))
     (define new-macro
       (for*/fold ((acc macro)) ((rg row-groups) (cg col-groups))
         (let* ((vjs (filter (lambda (j) (v-mark? rg j))
                             (range (first cg) (second cg))))
                (his (filter (lambda (i) (h-mark? cg i))
                             (range (first rg) (second rg))))
                (swapped (for/fold ((mm (for/fold ((m0 acc)) ((j vjs))
                                          (swap-cols m0 rg cg j))))
                                   ((i his))
                           (swap-rows mm rg cg i))))
           (if (or (not (empty? vjs)) (not (empty? his)))
               swapped
               (fill-panel acc rg cg)))))
     (define (index-in ints x)
       (let loop ((idx 0) (xs ints))
         (cond ((empty? xs) #f)
               ((and (>= x (first (first xs))) (<= x (second (first xs))))
                idx)
               (else (loop (+ idx 1) (rest xs))))))
     (cellmap g (r c v)
              (let ((ri (index-in ris r)) (ci (index-in cis c)))
                (if (and ri ci) (at new-macro ri ci) v))))))

(rule!
 ;; Uniform divider lines split the board into PANELS. A panel carrying
 ;; cyan(8) marks defines a MASK (its cyan cell positions). Same-size
 ;; panels that agree with it outside the mask and hold ONE nonzero
 ;; color under it are matches: the first match's color is the target,
 ;; and every panel in the marked panel's row/col lattice that is
 ;; target-colored under the mask gets the cyan mask stamped in. A mask
 ;; of FULL cyan rows instead stamps, in each same-column panel, the
 ;; single row made entirely of the modal uniform-row color.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define (ranges-between dividers total)  ;; gaps between divider lines
       (let loop ((prev -1) (ds dividers) (acc (list)))
         (cond ((null? ds)
                (reverse (if (<= (+ prev 1) (- total 1))
                             (cons (list (+ prev 1) (- total 1)) acc)
                             acc)))
               (else (loop (first ds) (rest ds)
                           (if (<= (+ prev 1) (- (first ds) 1))
                               (cons (list (+ prev 1) (- (first ds) 1))
                                     acc)
                               acc))))))
     (define row-ranges
       (ranges-between (filter (lambda (r) (row-uniform? g r)) (range 0 h))
                       h))
     (define col-ranges
       (ranges-between (filter (lambda (c) (col-uniform? g c)) (range 0 w))
                       w))
     ;; panel = (ri ci r1 c1 pat has8?)
     (define panels
       (map (lambda (idx)
              (let* ((rr (nth row-ranges (first idx)))
                     (cr (nth col-ranges (second idx)))
                     (pat (subgrid g (first rr) (first cr)
                                   (second rr) (second cr))))
                (list (first idx) (second idx) (first rr) (first cr) pat
                      (any? (lambda (p) (= (at pat (first p) (second p)) 8))
                            (grid-positions pat)))))
            (positions-in-rect 0 0 (- (length row-ranges) 1)
                               (- (length col-ranges) 1))))
     (define (p-ri p) (first p))
     (define (p-ci p) (second p))
     (define (p-r1 p) (third p))
     (define (p-c1 p) (fourth p))
     (define (p-pat p) (fifth p))
     (define (p-has8 p) (sixth p))
     (define (p-h p) (rows (p-pat p)))
     (define (p-w p) (cols (p-pat p)))
     (define (stamp-for out marked)
       (if (not (p-has8 marked))
           out
           (let* ((pat (p-pat marked))
                  (mask (filter (lambda (pos)
                                  (= (at pat (first pos) (second pos)) 8))
                                (grid-positions pat)))
                  (same-shape? (lambda (o)
                                 (and (not (p-has8 o))
                                      (= (p-h o) (p-h marked))
                                      (= (p-w o) (p-w marked)))))
                  (agrees-outside?
                   (lambda (o)
                     (all? (lambda (pos)
                             (= (at pat (first pos) (second pos))
                                (at (p-pat o) (first pos) (second pos))))
                           (filter (lambda (pos) (not (member pos mask)))
                                   (grid-positions pat)))))
                  (mask-val
                   (lambda (o)
                     (let ((u (remove-duplicates
                               (map (lambda (pos)
                                      (at (p-pat o) (first pos)
                                          (second pos)))
                                    mask))))
                       (and (= 1 (length u)) (first u)))))
                  (matches (filter (lambda (o)
                                     (and (same-shape? o)
                                          (agrees-outside? o)
                                          (let ((v (mask-val o)))
                                            (and v (> v 0)))))
                                   panels))
                  (primary
                   (lambda (out2)
                     (let* ((target (mask-val (first matches)))
                            (target-rows
                             (remove-duplicates
                              (cons (p-ri marked)
                                    (map p-ri
                                         (filter (lambda (o)
                                                   (and (= (p-ci o)
                                                           (p-ci marked))
                                                        (= (mask-val o)
                                                           target)))
                                                 matches)))))
                            (target-cols
                             (remove-duplicates
                              (cons (p-ci marked)
                                    (map p-ci
                                         (filter (lambda (o)
                                                   (and (= (p-ri o)
                                                           (p-ri marked))
                                                        (= (mask-val o)
                                                           target)))
                                                 matches))))))
                       (for/fold ((g2 out2)) ((o (in-list panels)))
                         (if (and (member? (p-ri o) target-rows)
                                  (member? (p-ci o) target-cols)
                                  (same-shape? o)
                                  (all? (lambda (pos)
                                          (= (at (p-pat o) (first pos)
                                                 (second pos))
                                             target))
                                        mask))
                             (paint-cells g2
                                          (map (lambda (pos)
                                                 (list (+ (p-r1 o)
                                                          (first pos))
                                                       (+ (p-c1 o)
                                                          (second pos))))
                                               mask)
                                          8)
                             g2)))))
                  (secondary
                   (lambda (out2)
                     (if (null? (filter (lambda (dr)
                                          (all? (lambda (v) (= v 8))
                                                (row pat dr)))
                                        (range 0 (p-h marked))))
                         out2
                         (let* ((col-mates
                                 (filter (lambda (o)
                                           (and (not (p-has8 o))
                                                (= (p-ci o) (p-ci marked))
                                                (= (p-w o) (p-w marked))))
                                         panels))
                                (uniform-vals
                                 (flatmap
                                  (lambda (o)
                                    (flatmap
                                     (lambda (dr)
                                       (let ((rv (row (p-pat o) dr)))
                                         (if (= 1 (length
                                                   (remove-duplicates rv)))
                                             (list (first rv))
                                             (list))))
                                     (range 0 (p-h o))))
                                  col-mates))
                                (base (mode-list uniform-vals)))
                           (if (eq? base #f)
                               out2
                               (for/fold ((g2 out2))
                                         ((o (in-list col-mates)))
                                 (let ((hits (filter
                                              (lambda (dr)
                                                (all? (lambda (v)
                                                        (= v base))
                                                      (row (p-pat o) dr)))
                                              (range 0 (p-h o)))))
                                   (if (= 1 (length hits))
                                       (paint-cells
                                        g2
                                        (positions-in-rect
                                         (+ (p-r1 o) (first hits))
                                         (p-c1 o)
                                         (+ (p-r1 o) (first hits))
                                         (+ (p-c1 o) (p-w o) -1))
                                        8)
                                       g2)))))))))
             (if (null? matches) (secondary out) (primary out)))))
     (for/fold ((out g)) ((m (in-list panels)))
       (stamp-for out m)))))

;; Matching side colors step once inward; blocked or unmatched cells stay put.

  (let ((h (rows g)) (w (cols g)))

                (map (lambda (r) (map (lambda (c) (at g r c)) (range 1 (- w 1)))) (range 1 (- h 1)))))
              (lambda (v) (- 0 (for/sum ((r (range 1 (- h 1))))
                                  (for/sum ((c (range 1 (- w 1))))
                                    (if (= (at g r c) v) 1 0)))))))))
      (let ((top-c (at g 0 (/ w 2)))
            (bot-c (at g (- h 1) (/ w 2)))
            (left-c (at g (/ h 2) 0))
            (right-c (at g (/ h 2) (- w 1))))
        (let ((base (grid-from-fn h w (lambda (r c)
                (if (or (zero? r) (= r (- h 1)) (zero? c) (= c (- w 1)))
                  (at g r c) bg)))))

            (reduce (lambda (acc2 c)
              (let ((v (at g r c)))

                  (let ((dr (if (= v top-c) -1 (if (= v bot-c) 1 (if (= v left-c) 0 (if (= v right-c) 0 0)))))

                      (if (and (>= nr 1) (<= nr (- h 2)) (>= nc 1) (<= nc (- w 2)))

                        (if (or (not (zero? dr)) (not (zero? dc)))
                          (set-cell acc2 r c v)
                          (set-cell acc2 r c v))))))))
              acc (range 1 (- w 1))))
            base (range 1 (- h 1)))))))))
