written_solution: Diagonal 8 seed traces forward as 3, bouncing once off the 2 wall or grid edge
program_solution:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let ((seeds (sort-by (find-color g 8)
                                 (lambda (p) (+ (* 1000 (fst p)) (snd p))))))
             (if (< (length seeds) 2)
                 g
                 (let* ((a (fst seeds))
                        (b (nth seeds (- (length seeds) 1)))
                        (sgn (lambda (x) (cond ((< x 0) -1) ((> x 0) 1) (else 0))))
                        (dr (sgn (- (fst b) (fst a))))
                        (dc (sgn (- (snd b) (snd a))))
                        (trace (lambda (start step-r step-c)
                                 (let loop
                                      ((r (fst start)) (c (snd start))
                                        (cr step-r)
                                        (cc step-c)
                                        (bounced #f)
                                        (cells (list))
                                        (fuel (* h w)))
                                      (if (<= fuel 0)
                                          cells
                                          (let ((nr (+ r cr))
                                                (nc (+ c cc)))
                                            (cond
                                              ((not (in-bounds? nr nc h w)) cells)
                                              ((zero? (at g nr nc)) (loop nr
                                                      nc
                                                      cr
                                                      cc
                                                      bounced
                                                      (append cells (list (list nr nc)))
                                                      (- fuel 1)))
                                              (bounced cells)
                                              (else (let* ((side-block (or
                                                                         (not (in-bounds? r
                                                                                          (+ c
                                                                                             cc)
                                                                                          h
                                                                                          w))
                                                                         (!= (at g
                                                                                 r
                                                                                 (+ c
                                                                                    cc))
                                                                             0)))
                                                           (vert-block (or
                                                                         (not (in-bounds? (+ r
                                                                                             cr)
                                                                                          c
                                                                                          h
                                                                                          w))
                                                                         (!= (at g
                                                                                 (+ r
                                                                                    cr)
                                                                                 c)
                                                                             0)))
                                                           (ncr (if vert-block
                                                                    (- cr)
                                                                    cr))
                                                           (ncc (if side-block
                                                                    (- cc)
                                                                    cc))
                                                           (rr (+ r ncr))
                                                           (rc (+ c ncc)))
                                                      (if (and
                                                            (in-bounds? rr rc h w)
                                                            (zero? (at g rr rc)))
                                                          (loop rr
                                                                rc
                                                                ncr
                                                                ncc
                                                                #t
                                                                (append cells
                                                                        (list (list rr
                                                                                    rc)))
                                                                (- fuel 1))
                                                          cells)))))))))
                        (path1 (trace b dr dc))
                        (path2 (trace a (- dr) (- dc)))
                        (chosen (if (>= (length path1) (length path2)) path1 path2)))
                   (paint-cells g chosen 3)))))))

written_solution: checkerboard with removed color: extract tile, cycle colors by 1 step in first-appearance order, tile output
program_solution:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((all-colors (filter (lambda (c) (!= c 0)) (grid-colors g)))
                  (removed (for/first ((color all-colors) #:when
                                        (for/or ((r (range 0 h)))
                                                (for/or ((c (range 0 (- w 1))))
                                                        (and
                                                          (= (at g r c) color)
                                                          (= (at g r (+ c 1)) color)))))
                                      color))
                  (period (for/first ((pr (range 2 (+ h 1))) #:when
                                       (for/first ((pc (range 2 (+ w 1))) #:when
                                                    (for*/and ((r (range 0 h)) (c (range 0 w)))
                                                              (let ((v (at g r c))
                                                                    (v2 (at g
                                                                            (remainder r
                                                                                       pr)
                                                                            (remainder c
                                                                                       pc))))
                                                                (or
                                                                  (= v removed)
                                                                  (= v2 removed)
                                                                  (= v v2)))))
                                                  (list pr pc)))
                                     (for/first ((pc (range 2 (+ w 1))) #:when
                                                  (for*/and ((r (range 0 h)) (c (range 0 w)))
                                                            (let ((v (at g r c))
                                                                  (v2 (at g
                                                                          (remainder r
                                                                                     (first (list pr
                                                                                                  pc)))
                                                                          (remainder c
                                                                                     pc))))
                                                              (or
                                                                (= v removed)
                                                                (= v2 removed)
                                                                (= v v2)))))
                                                (list pr pc))))
                  (pr (first period))
                  (pc (second period))
                  (tile (make-hash)))
             (for* ((r (range 0 h)) (c (range 0 w)))
                   (when
                     (!= (at g r c) removed)
                     (hash-set! tile
                                (list (remainder r pr) (remainder c pc))
                                (at g r c))))
             (let* ((cycle-order (let loop
                                      ((r 0) (c 0) (seen (list)) (order (list)))
                                      (cond
                                        ((>= r pr) (reverse order))
                                        ((>= c pc) (loop (+ r 1) 0 seen order))
                                        (else (let ((v (hash-ref tile (list r c) #f)))
                                                (cond
                                                  ((or (not v) (member v order)) (loop r (+ c 1) seen order))
                                                  (else (loop r
                                                              (+ c 1)
                                                              (cons v seen)
                                                              (cons v order)))))))))
                    (n (length cycle-order))
                    (color-map (make-hash)))
               (for ((i (range 0 n)))
                 (hash-set! color-map
                            (list-ref cycle-order i)
                            (list-ref cycle-order (remainder (+ i 1) n))))
               (cellmap g
                        (r c v)
                        (let ((v (hash-ref tile
                                           (list (remainder r pr) (remainder c pc))
                                           #f)))
                          (hash-ref color-map v 0))))))))

written_solution: Recolor each magenta(6) shape with nearest marker, stack vertically or horizontally based on input orientation
program_solution:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((all-objs (objects g 0))
                  (shapes (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) 6)) all-objs))
                  (markers (let ((s (list)))
                             (for* ((r (range 0 h)) (c (range 0 w)))
                                   (let ((v (at g r c)))
                                     (when
                                       (and (!= v 0) (!= v 6))
                                       (set! s (cons (list r c v) s)))))
                             s))
                  (dist-to-bbox (lambda (mr mc r1 r2 c1 c2)
                                  (let ((dr (if (and (<= r1 mr) (<= mr r2))
                                                0
                                                (min (abs (- mr r1)) (abs (- mr r2)))))
                                        (dc (if (and (<= c1 mc) (<= mc c2))
                                                0
                                                (min (abs (- mc c1)) (abs (- mc c2))))))
                                    (+ dr dc))))
                  (shape-info (map (lambda (shape)
                                     (let* ((cells (obj-cells shape)))
                                       (with-bbox shape
                                                  (r1 c1 r2 c2)
                                                  (let* ((best-marker (let loop
                                                                           ((ms markers) (best #f)
                                                                             (best-dist 99999))
                                                                           (cond
                                                                             ((null? ms) best)
                                                                             (else (let* ((m (car ms))
                                                                                          (d (dist-to-bbox (first m)
                                                                                                           (second m)
                                                                                                           r1
                                                                                                           r2
                                                                                                           c1
                                                                                                           c2)))
                                                                                     (if (< d
                                                                                            best-dist)
                                                                                         (loop (cdr ms)
                                                                                               m
                                                                                               d)
                                                                                         (loop (cdr ms)
                                                                                               best
                                                                                               best-dist))))))))
                                                    (list cells
                                                          r1
                                                          r2
                                                          c1
                                                          c2
                                                          (third best-marker))))))
                                   shapes))
                  (is-vertical (> h w))
                  (sorted-shapes (sort shape-info
                                       (lambda (a b)
                                         (if is-vertical
                                             (< (second a) (second b))
                                             (< (fourth a) (fourth b))))))
                  (n (length sorted-shapes))
                  (out-h (if is-vertical (* n 4) 4))
                  (out-w (if is-vertical 4 (* n 4))))
             (build-grid out-h
                         out-w
                         (gr gc)
                         (let* ((idx (if is-vertical (quotient gr 4) (quotient gc 4)))
                                (base-r (if is-vertical (* idx 4) 0))
                                (base-c (if is-vertical 0 (* idx 4)))
                                (lr (- gr base-r))
                                (lc (- gc base-c))
                                (shape (list-ref sorted-shapes idx))
                                (cells (first shape))
                                (sr1 (second shape))
                                (sc1 (fourth shape))
                                (color (sixth shape)))
                           (let check
                                ((cs cells))
                                (cond
                                  ((null? cs) 0)
                                  ((and
                                     (= (first (car cs)) (+ sr1 lr))
                                     (= (second (car cs)) (+ sc1 lc))) color)
                                  (else (check (cdr cs)))))))))))

written_solution: Diagonal cluster slides N steps + grows by 1 along its diagonal direction

(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((cr (/ h 2))
                  (cc (/ w 2))
                  (reds (sort-by (find-color g 2) (lambda (p) (fst p))))
                  (n (length reds))
                  (first-p (first reds))
                  (last-p (nth reds (- n 1)))
                  (sdr2 (if (= n 1)
                            (if (> (fst first-p) cr) -1 1)
                            (* -1 (if (> (fst last-p) (fst first-p)) 1 -1))))
                  (sdc2 (if (= n 1)
                            (if (> (snd first-p) cc) -1 1)
                            (* -1 (if (> (snd last-p) (snd first-p)) 1 -1))))
                  (new-bot-r (+ (fst last-p) (* n sdr2)))
                  (new-bot-c (+ (snd last-p) (* n sdc2)))
                  (new-cells (map (lambda (i)
                                    (cons (+ new-bot-r (* i sdr2))
                                          (+ new-bot-c (* i sdc2))))
                                  (range 0 (+ n 1))))
                  (cleared (recolor-cells g reds 7)))
             (recolor-cells cleared new-cells 2)))))

written_solution: recolor 3-cells that match the 8-cell stencil, using rotations before reflected matches
program_solution:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (begin
             (define (norm cells)
               (let* ((rs (map first cells))
                      (cs (map second cells))
                      (r0 (min-list rs))
                      (c0 (min-list cs)))
                 (sort (map (lambda (p) (list (- (first p) r0) (- (second p) c0)))
                            cells)
                       (lambda (a b)
                         (or
                           (< (first a) (first b))
                           (and (= (first a) (first b)) (< (second a) (second b))))))))
             (define (rot cells)
               (norm (map (lambda (p) (list (second p) (- (first p)))) cells)))
             (define (flip cells)
               (norm (map (lambda (p) (list (first p) (- (second p)))) cells)))
             (define (shape-h shape) (+ 1 (max-of first shape)))
             (define (shape-w shape) (+ 1 (max-of second shape)))
             (define matches (list))
             (for ((obj (objects-8 g 0)))
               (when
                 (= (obj-color obj) 8)
                 (define base (norm (obj-cells obj)))
                 (define r1 (rot base))
                 (define r2 (rot r1))
                 (define r3 (rot r2))
                 (define variants
                   (list (list 0 base)
                         (list 0 r1)
                         (list 0 r2)
                         (list 0 r3)
                         (list 1 (flip base))
                         (list 1 (flip r1))
                         (list 1 (flip r2))
                         (list 1 (flip r3))))
                 (for ((var variants))
                   (define flip-rank (first var))
                   (define shape (second var))
                   (define mh (shape-h shape))
                   (define mw (shape-w shape))
                   (for* ((r0 (range 0 (+ 1 (- h mh)))) (c0 (range 0 (+ 1 (- w mw)))))
                         (define cells
                           (map (lambda (p) (list (+ r0 (first p)) (+ c0 (second p))))
                                shape))
                         (when
                           (for/and ((p cells)) (= (at g (first p) (second p)) 3))
                           (set! matches (cons (list flip-rank r0 c0 cells) matches)))))))
             (define sorted-matches
               (sort matches
                     (lambda (a b)
                       (cond
                         ((< (first a) (first b)) #t)
                         ((> (first a) (first b)) #f)
                         ((< (second a) (second b)) #t)
                         ((> (second a) (second b)) #f)
                         (else (< (third a) (third b)))))))
             (define used (make-hash))
             (for/fold ((out g))
               ((m sorted-matches))
               (define cells (fourth m))
               (if (for/or ((p cells)) (hash-has-key? used p))
                   out
                   (begin
                     (for ((p cells)) (hash-set! used p #t))
                     (paint-cells out cells 8))))))))

             (cellmap g (r c v) (hash-ref result (list r c) bg))))))

written_solution: Rectangles mirror across a full-span line, gaps between rects and line filled with line color
program_solution:
(rule!
 ;; A full one-color LINE mirrors the board. Every solid rectangle (4+
 ;; cells, not line-colored) reflects across it, and line-colored beams
 ;; connect BOTH the rectangle and its mirror image to the line (rows
 ;; strictly between, per rectangle row). Normalize so the line is
 ;; vertical — transpose in and out when it is horizontal.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define (line-col grid)  ;; first full uniform non-bg column
       (let ((bg (mode grid -1)))
         (find-first (lambda (c)
                       (and (not (= (at grid 0 c) bg))
                            (all? (lambda (r) (= (at grid r c)
                                                 (at grid 0 c)))
                                  (range 0 (rows grid)))))
                     (range 0 (cols grid)))))
     (define (solve grid)
       (let* ((ww (cols grid))
              (bg (mode grid -1))
              (pos (line-col grid))
              (line-color (at grid 0 pos))
              (mirror (lambda (c) (- (* 2 pos) c)))
              (rects (filter (lambda (o)
                               (and (not (= (obj-color o) line-color))
                                    (>= (obj-size o) 4)
                                    (= (obj-size o)
                                       (* (obj-h o) (obj-w o)))))
                             (objects grid bg)))
              (mirrored
               (for/fold ((out grid)) ((o rects))
                 (for*/fold ((acc out))
                            ((r (range (obj-r1 o) (+ (obj-r2 o) 1)))
                             (c (range (obj-c1 o) (+ (obj-c2 o) 1))))
                   (if (and (>= (mirror c) 0) (< (mirror c) ww))
                       (set-cell acc r (mirror c) (obj-color o))
                       acc)))))
         (for/fold ((out mirrored)) ((o rects))
           (for/fold ((acc out))
                     ((r (range (obj-r1 o) (+ (obj-r2 o) 1))))
             (let ((own (if (< (obj-c2 o) pos)
                            (range (+ (obj-c2 o) 1) pos)
                            (range (+ pos 1) (obj-c1 o))))
                   (refl (if (> (mirror (obj-c2 o)) pos)
                             (range (+ pos 1) (mirror (obj-c2 o)))
                             (range (+ (mirror (obj-c1 o)) 1) pos))))
               (for/fold ((a2 acc)) ((c (append own refl)))
                 (set-cell a2 r c line-color)))))))
     (if (line-col g)
         (solve g)
         (transpose (solve (transpose g)))))))

written_solution: Staircase diagonal pattern tiled to 2N×2N: output(r,c) = diag[max(r,c) % period]
program_solution:
(rule! (lambda (g)
  (let* ((h (rows g))
         (w (cols g))
         ;; Each nested L-band is named by the main-diagonal cell it crosses.
         (diag (for/list ((i (range 0 (min h w))))
                 (at g i i)))
         ;; Trailing zero bands are padding; the nonzero prefix is the period.
         (active-diag
          (let loop ((d diag))
            (if (or (empty? d) (!= (last d) 0))
                d
                (loop (take d (- (length d) 1))))))
         (period (length active-diag))
         (oh (* h 2))
         (ow (* w 2)))
    ;; Continue the staircase in both axes by cycling the active diagonal.
    (build-grid oh ow (r c)
      (nth active-diag (remainder (max r c) period))))))

written_solution: h×w input → w×w square by tiling pattern with detected period and column translate
program_solution:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g))
                (fnz (lambda (r) (find (lambda (c) (!= (at g r c) 0)) (range 0 w))))
                (result (find (lambda (pair) pair)
                              (for/list ((p (range 1 h)))
                                (let* ((f0 (fnz 0))
                                       (fp (fnz p)))
                                  (and
                                    (and f0 fp)
                                    (let* ((s (- fp f0)))
                                      (and
                                        (for/and ((r (range 0 (- h p))))
                                                 (for/and ((c (range 0 w)))
                                                          (let* ((sc (+ c s)))
                                                            (if (and (>= sc 0) (< sc w))
                                                                (= (at g r c)
                                                                   (at g (+ r p) sc))
                                                                (zero? (at g r c))))))
                                        (list p s))))))))
                (period (if result (first result) h))
                (shift (if result (second result) 0)))
           (build-grid w
                       w
                       (r c)
                       (let* ((src-c (- c (* shift (quotient r period)))))
                         (if (and (>= src-c 0) (< src-c w))
                             (at g (remainder r period) src-c)
                             0))))))

written_solution: Move multicolor L-shapes to the standalone marker matching their embedded color
program_solution:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((bg 0))
             (define (components4)
               (define visited (make-hash))
               (define comps (list))
               (for* ((r (in-range h)) (c (in-range w)))
                     (when
                       (and (!= (at g r c) bg) (not (hash-has-key? visited (cons r c))))
                       (let ((cells (connected-region g
                                                      r
                                                      c
                                                      (lambda (rr cc v) (!= v bg))
                                                      4)))
                         (for ((p (in-list cells)))
                           (hash-set! visited (cons (first p) (second p)) #t))
                         (set! comps (cons cells comps)))))
               (reverse comps))
             (define comps (components4))
             (define (cell-color p) (at g (first p) (second p)))
             (define singles
               (map (lambda (cells)
                      (let ((p (first cells)))
                        (list (cell-color p) (first p) (second p))))
                    (filter (lambda (cells) (= (length cells) 1)) comps)))
             (define (move-for cells)
               (let* ((vals (map cell-color cells))
                      (colors (unique vals)))
                 (if (<= (length colors) 1)
                     #f
                     (let* ((body (mode-list vals))
                            (special (find-first (lambda (color) (!= color body))
                                                 colors))
                            (target (find-first (lambda (s) (= (first s) special))
                                                singles)))
                       (and
                         target
                         (let* ((bb (bbox-of-cells cells))
                                (r1 (first bb))
                                (c1 (second bb))
                                (r2 (third bb))
                                (c2 (fourth bb))
                                (corners (list (list 'tl r1 c1)
                                               (list 'tr r1 c2)
                                               (list 'bl r2 c1)
                                               (list 'br r2 c2)))
                                (missing (find-first (lambda (corner)
                                                       (!= (at g
                                                               (second corner)
                                                               (third corner))
                                                           body))
                                                     corners))
                                (anchor (cond
                                          ((eq? (first missing) 'tl) (list r2 c2))
                                          ((eq? (first missing) 'tr) (list r2 c1))
                                          ((eq? (first missing) 'bl) (list r1 c2))
                                          (else (list r1 c1)))))
                           (list cells
                                 (second target)
                                 (third target)
                                 (first anchor)
                                 (second anchor))))))))
             (define moves (filter (lambda (m) m) (map move-for comps)))
             (define erased (paint-cells g (flatmap (lambda (m) (first m)) moves) bg))
             (define moved-cells
               (flatmap (lambda (m)
                          (let* ((cells (first m))
                                 (tr (second m))
                                 (tc (third m))
                                 (ar (fourth m))
                                 (ac (fifth m))
                                 (dr (- tr ar))
                                 (dc (- tc ac)))
                            (map (lambda (p)
                                   (list (+ (first p) dr)
                                         (+ (second p) dc)
                                         (cell-color p)))
                                 cells)))
                        moves))
             (paint-cells erased moved-cells)))))

                                 (for*/list ((r (range 1 (- h 1))) (c (range 1 (- w 1))))
                                   (and
                                     (and
                                       (= (at g r c) 3)
                                       (= (at g (- r 1) c) 3)
                                       (= (at g (+ r 1) c) 3)
                                       (= (at g r (- c 1)) 3)
                                       (= (at g r (+ c 1)) 3))
                                     (list r c)))))
                (n (length centers)))
           (reduce (lambda (acc i)
                     (reduce (lambda (acc2 j)
                               (if (<= j i)

                                   (let* ((r1 (first (nth centers i)))

                                                   acc2

                             acc

written_solution: each non-9 component slides away from its nearest 9 cell until hitting grid edge (dominant cardinal direction)
program_solution:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((bg 7)
                  (all-objs (objects g bg))
                  (nine-objs (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) 9)) all-objs))
                  (other-objs (filter (lambda (o) (!= (obj-color o) 9)) all-objs))
                  (all-9-cells (apply append (map obj-cells nine-objs)))
                  (abs-int (lambda (x) (if (< x 0) (- 0 x) x)))
                  (base (cellmap g (r c v) bg))
                  (g1 (for/fold ((out base))
                        ((cell all-9-cells))
                        (set-cell out (first cell) (second cell) 9))))
             (for/fold ((out g1))
               ((o other-objs))
               (let* ((cells (obj-cells o))
                      (col (obj-color o))
                      (crs (map first cells))
                      (ccs (map second cells))
                      (cr1 (min-list crs))
                      (cr2 (max-list crs))
                      (cc1 (min-list ccs))
                      (cc2 (max-list ccs))
                      (best (for*/fold ((best (list 999999
                                                    (first all-9-cells)
                                                    (first cells))))
                                       ((me cells) (nine all-9-cells))
                                       (let ((d (+ (abs-int (- (first me) (first nine)))
                                                   (abs-int (- (second me)
                                                               (second nine))))))
                                         (cond
                                           ((< d (first best)) (list d nine me))
                                           (else best)))))
                      (best-nine (second best))
                      (best-me (third best))
                      (dr-raw (- (first best-me) (first best-nine)))
                      (dc-raw (- (second best-me) (second best-nine)))

written_solution: Snake path on cyan(8) bg: trace connected path from endpoint, reverse the color sequence, keep positions same
program_solution:
(rule! (lambda (g)
  (let* ((h (rows g))
         (w (cols g))
         (bg 8)
         ;; The non-cyan cells are one unbranched path. Find its cells and
         ;; choose either degree-one endpoint as the traversal start.
         (cells
          (for*/list ((r (range 0 h))
                      (c (range 0 w))
                      #:when (not (= (cell-at g r c) bg)))
            (list r c)))
         (cell-set (make-hash))
         (seed-cell-set
          (for ((cell cells))
            (hash-set! cell-set cell #t)))
         (start #f)
         (find-endpoint
          (for ((cell cells))
            (let ((degree
                   (count-if
                    (lambda (neighbor) (hash-has-key? cell-set neighbor))
                    (list (list (- (first cell) 1) (second cell))
                          (list (+ (first cell) 1) (second cell))
                          (list (first cell) (- (second cell) 1))
                          (list (first cell) (+ (second cell) 1))))))
              (when (and (not start) (= degree 1))
                (set! start cell)))))
         ;; Trace the unique path and collect its positions in endpoint order.
         (path (list))
         (visited (make-hash))
         (trace-path
          (let trace ((current start))
            (when (and current
                       (hash-has-key? cell-set current)
                       (not (hash-has-key? visited current)))
              (hash-set! visited current #t)
              (set! path (append path (list current)))
              (let ((next
                     (find
                      (lambda (neighbor)
                        (and (hash-has-key? cell-set neighbor)
                             (not (hash-has-key? visited neighbor))))
                      (list (list (- (first current) 1) (second current))
                            (list (+ (first current) 1) (second current))
                            (list (first current) (- (second current) 1))
                            (list (first current) (+ (second current) 1))))))
                (trace next)))))
         ;; Reverse only the color sequence; every path coordinate is retained.
         (path-colors
          (map (lambda (position)
                 (cell-at g (first position) (second position)))
               path))
         (reversed-colors (reverse path-colors))
         (result (make-hash)))
    (for* ((r (range 0 h)) (c (range 0 w)))
      (hash-set! result (list r c) bg))
    (for ((i (range 0 (length path))))
      (hash-set! result (list-ref path i) (list-ref reversed-colors i)))
    (grid-from-fn h w
                  (lambda (r c) (hash-ref result (list r c) bg))))))

(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((objs (objects-multicolor g 0))
                (cell-color (lambda (p) (at g (fst p) (snd p))))
                (is-rect-color (lambda (cells color)
                                 (let* ((cc (filter (lambda (p)
                                                      (= color (cell-color p)))
                                                    cells))
                                        (n (length cc)))
                                   (if (zero? n)
                                       #t
                                       (let ((bb (bbox-of-cells cc)))
                                         (= n
                                            (* (+ 1 (- (third bb) (first bb)))
                                               (+ 1 (- (fourth bb) (second bb))))))))))
                (is-seed (lambda (obj)
                           (let* ((cells (obj-cells obj))
                                  (colors (unique (map cell-color cells))))
                             (and
                               (<= (length colors) 2)
                               (all? (lambda (c) (is-rect-color cells c)) colors)))))
                (template (find-first (lambda (o) (not (is-seed o))) objs))
                (seeds (filter is-seed objs))
                (t-cells (obj-cells template))
                (t-colors (unique (map cell-color t-cells)))
                (t-mnr (min-of fst t-cells))
                (t-mnc (min-of snd t-cells))
                (apply-seed (lambda (out seed)
                              (let* ((s-cells (obj-cells seed))
                                     (s-colors (unique (map cell-color s-cells)))
                                     (common (find-first (lambda (c)
                                                           (member? c s-colors))
                                                         t-colors))
                                     (t-other (find-first (lambda (c) (!= c common))
                                                          t-colors))
                                     (new-color (find-first (lambda (c) (!= c common))
                                                            s-colors))
                                     (s-common-cells (filter (lambda (p)
                                                               (= common (cell-color p)))
                                                             s-cells))
                                     (scb (bbox-of-cells s-common-cells))
                                     (sc-mnr (first scb))
                                     (sc-mnc (second scb))
                                     (sc-mxr (third scb))
                                     (sc-mxc (fourth scb))
                                     (sc-h (+ 1 (- sc-mxr sc-mnr)))
                                     (sc-w (+ 1 (- sc-mxc sc-mnc)))
                                     (t-common-cells (filter (lambda (p)
                                                               (= common (cell-color p)))
                                                             t-cells))
                                     (tcb (bbox-of-cells t-common-cells))
                                     (tc-mnr (first tcb))
                                     (tc-mnc (second tcb))
                                     (tc-mxr (third tcb))
                                     (tc-mxc (fourth tcb))
                                     (tc-h (+ 1 (- tc-mxr tc-mnr)))
                                     (tc-w (+ 1 (- tc-mxc tc-mnc)))
                                     (scale (let ((sh (/ sc-h tc-h))
                                                  (sw (/ sc-w tc-w)))
                                              (if (> sh sw) sh sw)))
                                     (cleared (recolor-cells out s-cells 0))
                                     (t-common-lr (- tc-mnr t-mnr))
                                     (t-common-lc (- tc-mnc t-mnc))
                                     (out-tl-r (- sc-mnr (* t-common-lr scale)))
                                     (out-tl-c (- sc-mnc (* t-common-lc scale))))
                                (reduce (lambda (o p)
                                          (let* ((tr (fst p))
                                                 (tc (snd p))
                                                 (v (cell-color p))
                                                 (new-v (if (= v t-other) new-color v))
                                                 (lr (- tr t-mnr))
                                                 (lc (- tc t-mnc)))
                                            (reduce (lambda (o2 dd)
                                                      (let* ((dr (fst dd))
                                                             (dc (snd dd))
                                                             (nr (+ out-tl-r
                                                                    (* lr scale)
                                                                    dr))
                                                             (nc (+ out-tl-c
                                                                    (* lc scale)
                                                                    dc)))
                                                        (if (in-bounds? nr nc h w)
                                                            (set-cell o2 nr nc new-v)
                                                            o2)))
                                                    o
                                                    (positions-in-rect 0
                                                                       0
                                                                       (- scale 1)
                                                                       (- scale 1)))))
                                        cleared
                                        t-cells)))))
           (reduce apply-seed g seeds))))

written_solution: Find marker-free rect; pick widest marker rect as source; anchor each marker to closest corner (with tie handling) and apply to empty rect dimensions
program_solution:
(rule!
 ;; Two rectangles: a plain EMPTY one and a (widest) SOURCE stamped
 ;; with marker dots. Rebuild the empty rectangle with the markers
 ;; transferred edge-relative: each marker keeps its distance to its
 ;; NEAREST edge on each axis; an exact tie mirrors it to both sides.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define bg (at g 0 0))
     (define objs (objects-multicolor g bg))
     (define (colors-of o)
       (unique (map (lambda (p) (at g (first p) (second p)))
                    (obj-cells o))))
     (define blank (find (lambda (o) (= 1 (length (colors-of o)))) objs))
     (define blank-color (first (colors-of blank)))
     (define eh (obj-h blank))
     (define ew (obj-w blank))
     (define source
       (pick-max (filter (lambda (o) (> (length (colors-of o)) 1)) objs)
                 obj-w))
     (define rect-color  ;; the source's majority (frame) color
       (pick-max (colors-of source)
                 (lambda (c) (count-if (lambda (p)
                                         (= (at g (first p) (second p))
                                            c))
                                       (obj-cells source)))))
     (define marker-color
       (find-first (lambda (c) (not (= c rect-color)))
                   (colors-of source)))
     (define markers  ;; marker positions relative to the source bbox
       (map (lambda (p) (list (- (first p) (obj-r1 source))
                              (- (second p) (obj-c1 source))))
            (filter (lambda (p) (= (at g (first p) (second p))
                                   marker-color))
                    (obj-cells source))))
     (define (anchors mr mc)  ;; landing spots in the empty rectangle
       (let* ((bot (- (obj-h source) 1 mr))
              (right (- (obj-w source) 1 mc))
              (rrs (cond ((< mr bot) (list mr))
                         ((> mr bot) (list (- eh 1 bot)))
                         (else (list mr (- eh 1 bot)))))
              (ccs (cond ((< mc right) (list mc))
                         ((> mc right) (list (- ew 1 right)))
                         (else (list mc (- ew 1 right))))))
         (filter (lambda (rc) (in-bounds? (first rc) (second rc) eh ew))
                 (for*/list ((r rrs) (c ccs)) (list r c)))))
     (paint-cells (empty-grid eh ew blank-color)
                  (flatmap (lambda (m) (anchors (first m) (second m)))
                           markers)
                  marker-color))))

written_solution: Stamp-tile-canvas: red(2)/cyan(8) stamp shape, bg/cyan(8) tile pattern, stamp placed where tile has cyan(8), scaled to canvas
program_solution:
(rule!
 ;; Three pieces: a STAMP (bbox of the red-2 markers, extended downward through
 ;; non-empty rows), a TEMPLATE of 8s+bg right of the first 0-gap in the
 ;; stamp's top row, and a solid bg TARGET RECT below the template. The rect is
 ;; a fund grid of stamp-sized cells; the (possibly upscaled) template says
 ;; which cells receive the stamp (red prints as bg, everything else as-is).
 ;; bg = the first non-{0,2,8} cell in row-major order.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define h (rows g))
     (define w (cols g))
     (define (bbox pts)
       (list (apply min (map first pts)) (apply min (map second pts))
             (apply max (map first pts)) (apply max (map second pts))))
     (define bg
       (let ((p (find-first (lambda (p) (not (member (at g (first p) (second p))
                                                     '(0 2 8))))
                            (grid-positions g))))
         (at g (first p) (second p))))
     (define red-bb (bbox (find-color g 2)))
     (define sr1 (first red-bb))
     (define sc1 (second red-bb))
     (define sc2 (fourth red-bb))
     (define (row-nonempty? r)
       (ormap (lambda (c) (not (= (at g r c) 0))) (range sc1 (+ sc2 1))))
     (define sr2                      ; extend below the red bbox; a scan that
       (let loop ((r (+ (third red-bb) 1)))   ; falls off the grid reverts to it
         (cond ((>= r h) (third red-bb))
               ((row-nonempty? r) (loop (+ r 1)))
               (else (- r 1)))))
     (define sh (+ 1 (- sr2 sr1)))
     (define sw (+ 1 (- sc2 sc1)))
     (define stamp (subgrid g sr1 sc1 sr2 sc2))
     (define sep-c
       (let loop ((c (+ sc2 1)))
         (cond ((>= c w) sc2)
               ((= (at g sr1 c) 0) c)
               (else (loop (+ c 1))))))
     (define tile-8 (filter (lambda (p) (>= (second p) sep-c)) (find-color g 8)))
     (define t8-bb (bbox tile-8))
     (define tile-bg
       (filter (lambda (p) (and (<= (first t8-bb) (first p) (third t8-bb))
                                (<= (second t8-bb) (second p) (fourth t8-bb))))
               (find-color g bg)))
     (define tile-bb (bbox (append tile-8 tile-bg)))
     (define rect-bb
       (bbox (filter (lambda (p) (> (first p) (third tile-bb))) (find-color g bg))))
     (define rect-h (+ 1 (- (third rect-bb) (first rect-bb))))
     (define rect-w (+ 1 (- (fourth rect-bb) (second rect-bb))))
     (define cell-h (quotient (+ 1 (- (third tile-bb) (first tile-bb)))
                              (quotient rect-h sh)))
     (define cell-w (quotient (+ 1 (- (fourth tile-bb) (second tile-bb)))
                              (quotient rect-w sw)))
     (grid-from-fn rect-h rect-w
       (lambda (r c)
         (let ((tile-val (at g (+ (first tile-bb) (* (quotient r sh) cell-h))
                             (+ (second tile-bb) (* (quotient c sw) cell-w)))))
           (if (= tile-val 8)
               (let ((sv (at stamp (modulo r sh) (modulo c sw))))
                 (if (= sv 2) bg sv))
               bg)))))))

written_solution: 2x2 color key at corner: marker cells recolored by quadrant position using key mapping. Key at any corner, marker = key color found in main grid.
program_solution:
(rule! (lambda (g)
  (let* ((h (rows g))
         (w (cols g))
         ;; Scan the four 2x2 corner slots in reading order.  The first slot
         ;; whose top edge is neither background 0 nor separator 8 is the key.
         (key-r #f)
         (key-c #f)
         (key-scan
          (for ((pos (list (list 0 0)
                           (list 0 (- w 2))
                           (list (- h 2) 0)
                           (list (- h 2) (- w 2)))))
            (let ((kr (first pos)) (kc (second pos)))
              (when (and (not key-r)
                         (!= (at g kr kc) 0)
                         (!= (at g kr kc) 8)
                         (!= (at g kr (+ kc 1)) 0)
                         (!= (at g kr (+ kc 1)) 8))
                (set! key-r kr)
                (set! key-c kc)))))
         ;; The four key cells are the output colors for TL/TR/BL/BR.
         (k00 (at g key-r key-c))
         (k01 (at g key-r (+ key-c 1)))
         (k10 (at g (+ key-r 1) key-c))
         (k11 (at g (+ key-r 1) (+ key-c 1)))
         (key-set (make-hash))
         (key-set-init
          (begin
            (hash-set! key-set (list key-r key-c) #t)
            (hash-set! key-set (list key-r (+ key-c 1)) #t)
            (hash-set! key-set (list (+ key-r 1) key-c) #t)
            (hash-set! key-set (list (+ key-r 1) (+ key-c 1)) #t)))
         ;; The first non-key, non-0/8 cell in reading order names the marker
         ;; color.  Later body colors are distractors and must stay unchanged.
         (marker #f)
         (marker-scan
          (for* ((r (range 0 h)) (c (range 0 w)))
            (when (and (not marker)
                       (!= (at g r c) 0)
                       (!= (at g r c) 8)
                       (not (hash-has-key? key-set (list r c))))
              (set! marker (at g r c)))))
         ;; Zeros count toward the body bbox; only separator 8 and the key are
         ;; excluded.  Exact midpoint cells therefore belong bottom/right.
         (body-cells
          (for*/list ((r (range 0 h)) (c (range 0 w))
                      #:when (and (!= (at g r c) 8)
                                  (not (hash-has-key? key-set (list r c)))))
            (list r c)))
         (r1 (min-of first body-cells))
         (r2 (max-of first body-cells))
         (c1 (min-of second body-cells))
         (c2 (max-of second body-cells))
         (mid-r2 (+ r1 r2))
         (mid-c2 (+ c1 c2)))
    (build-grid h w (r c)
      (let ((v (at g r c)))
        (if (and (= v marker)
                 (not (hash-has-key? key-set (list r c))))
            (let ((qr (if (< (* 2 r) mid-r2) 0 1))
                  (qc (if (< (* 2 c) mid-c2) 0 1)))
              (cond ((and (zero? qr) (zero? qc)) k00)
                    ((and (zero? qr) (= qc 1)) k01)
                    ((and (= qr 1) (zero? qc)) k10)
                    (else k11)))
            v))))))

written_solution: Two bar-pairs (green(3)+cyan(8)) spread outward bidirectionally, step=bar_height, magenta(6) at intersections
program_solution:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (begin
             (define (find-bar color)
               (let* ((cells (find-color g color)))
                 (if (null? cells)
                     #f
                     (let* ((r1 (min-of first cells))
                            (r2 (max-of first cells))
                            (cl (min-of second cells))
                            (cr (max-of second cells)))
                       (list r1 (+ 1 (- r2 r1)) cl cr)))))
             (define (bar-reaches? bar r c)
               (and
                 bar
                 (let* ((r1 (first bar))
                        (bh (second bar))
                        (cl (third bar))
                        (cr (fourth bar))
                        (dr (- r r1))
                        (k (if (>= dr 0)
                               (quotient dr bh)
                               (quotient (+ (- 0 dr) (- bh 1)) bh))))
                   (or (= c (- cl k)) (= c (+ cr k))))))
             (let* ((gb (find-bar 3))
                    (cb (find-bar 8)))
               (cellmap g
                        (r c v)
                        (let* ((has-g (bar-reaches? gb r c))
                               (has-c (bar-reaches? cb r c)))
                          (cond ((and has-g has-c) 6) (has-g 3) (has-c 8) (else 0)))))))))

(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (begin
             (define palette
               (filter identity
                       (for/list ((r (range 0 (- h 1))))
                         (let ((src (at g r 0))
                               (frame (at g r 1)))
                           (and
                             (and
                               (!= src 0)
                               (!= frame 0)
                               (= (safe-at g (+ r 1) 0 -1) src)
                               (= (safe-at g (+ r 1) 1 -1) frame))
                             (list src frame))))))
             (define (paint-entry base entry)
               (define src (first entry))
               (define frame (second entry))
               (define mask (cellmap g (r c v) (if (= v src) src 0)))
               (for/fold ((out base))
                 ((obj (objects mask 0)))
                 (define r1 (obj-r1 obj))
                 (define r2 (obj-r2 obj))
                 (define c1 (obj-c1 obj))
                 (define c2 (obj-c2 obj))
                 (if (and (<= c1 1) (<= c2 1))
                     out
                     (let* ((er1 (max 0 (- r1 1)))
                            (er2 (min (- h 1) (+ r2 1)))
                            (ec1 (max 0 (- c1 1)))
                            (ec2 (min (- w 1) (+ c2 1)))
                            (border (remove-duplicates (append (for/list ((r (range er1
                                                                            (+ er2 1))) #:when
                                                                   (zero? (at g r ec1)))
                                                                 (list r ec1))
                                                               (for/list ((r (range er1
                                                                            (+ er2 1))) #:when
                                                                   (zero? (at g r ec2)))
                                                                 (list r ec2))
                                                               (for/list ((c (range ec1
                                                                            (+ ec2 1))) #:when
                                                                   (zero? (at g er1 c)))
                                                                 (list er1 c))
                                                               (for/list ((c (range ec1
                                                                            (+ ec2 1))) #:when
                                                                   (zero? (at g er2 c)))
                                                                 (list er2 c)))))
                            (exterior (remove-duplicates (apply append
                                                                (cons (list)
                                                                      (map (lambda (p)
                                                                             (connected-region g
                                                                                               (first p)
                                                                                               (second p)
                                                                                               (lambda (rr cc
                                                                                                     v)
                                                                                                 (and
                                                                                                   (zero? v)
                                                                                                   (>= rr
                                                                                                       er1)
                                                                                                   (<= rr
                                                                                                       er2)
                                                                                                   (>= cc
                                                                                                       ec1)
                                                                                                   (<= cc
                                                                                                       ec2)))
                                                                                               4))
                                                                           border))))))
                       (for/fold ((acc out))
                         ((p exterior))
                         (if (zero? (at acc (first p) (second p)))
                             (set-cell acc (first p) (second p) frame)

written_solution: horizontal runs of len>=2 are keys; isolated dots get expanded into the matching key with the dot's color aligned at its key index
program_solution:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (begin
             (define (extend2 r c2 acc)
               (if (and (< c2 w) (!= (at g r c2) 0))
                   (extend2 r (+ c2 1) (cons (at g r c2) acc))
                   (list (reverse acc) c2)))
             (define (rrloop r c acc)
               (cond
                 ((>= c w) (reverse acc))
                 ((zero? (at g r c)) (rrloop r (+ c 1) acc))
                 (else (let* ((res (extend2 r c (list)))
                              (cells (first res))
                              (next (second res)))
                         (rrloop r next (cons (list r c cells) acc))))))
             (define (row-runs r) (rrloop r 0 (list)))
             (define runs (flatmap row-runs (range 0 h)))
             (define keys (filter (lambda (rn) (>= (length (third rn)) 2)) runs))
             (define dots (filter (lambda (rn) (= (length (third rn)) 1)) runs))
             (define (find-idx-loop i cs target)
               (cond
                 ((null? cs) -1)
                 ((= (first cs) target) i)
                 (else (find-idx-loop (+ i 1) (cdr cs) target))))
             (define (try-keys-loop ks target)
               (if (null? ks)
                   #f
                   (let* ((k (first ks))
                          (cells (third k))
                          (idx (find-idx-loop 0 cells target)))
                     (if (= idx -1) (try-keys-loop (cdr ks) target) (list k idx)))))
             (define (find-key-and-idx target) (try-keys-loop keys target))
             (define (place-key gg dot)
               (let* ((dr (first dot))
                      (dc (second dot))
                      (color (first (third dot)))
                      (ki (find-key-and-idx color)))
                 (if ki
                     (let* ((k (first ki))
                            (idx (second ki))
                            (key-cells (third k))
                            (start-col (- dc idx)))
                       (reduce (lambda (g2 i)
                                 (let ((cc (+ start-col i))
                                       (v (nth key-cells i)))
                                   (if (and (>= cc 0) (< cc w))
                                       (set-cell g2 dr cc v)
                                       g2)))
                               gg
                               (range 0 (length key-cells))))
                     gg)))
             (reduce place-key g dots)))))

written_solution: mirror each 4-axis component from its denser side, preserving marker cells
program_solution:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (begin
             (define (cell-color p) (at g (first p) (second p)))
             (define (put gg r c v) (if (in-bounds? r c h w) (set-cell gg r c v) gg))
             (define comps
               (filter (lambda (o)
                         (let ((vals (map cell-color (obj-cells o))))
                           (and (member 4 vals) (for/or ((v vals)) (!= v 4)))))
                       (objects-multicolor g 0)))
             (define (avg-round xs)
               (let ((n (length xs)) (s (apply + xs))) (quotient (+ (* 2 s) n) (* 2 n))))
             (for/fold ((out g))
               ((comp comps))
               (define cells (obj-cells comp))
               (define fours (filter (lambda (p) (= (cell-color p) 4)) cells))
               (define payload (filter (lambda (p) (!= (cell-color p) 4)) cells))
               (define main-color (mode-list (map cell-color payload)))
               (define frs (map first fours))
               (define fcs (map second fours))
               (define span-r (- (max-list frs) (min-list frs)))
               (define span-c (- (max-list fcs) (min-list fcs)))
               (define cleared (paint-cells out payload 0))
               (if (> span-c span-r)
                   (let* ((axis (avg-round frs))
                          (above (count-if (lambda (p)
                                             (and
                                               (= (cell-color p) main-color)
                                               (< (first p) axis)))
                                           payload))
                          (below (count-if (lambda (p)
                                             (and
                                               (= (cell-color p) main-color)
                                               (> (first p) axis)))
                                           payload))
                          (choose-above (>= above below))
                          (source (filter (lambda (p)
                                            (or
                                              (= (first p) axis)
                                              (if choose-above
                                                  (< (first p) axis)
                                                  (> (first p) axis))))
                                          cells)))
                     (for/fold ((gg cleared))
                       ((p source))
                       (define r (first p))
                       (define c (second p))
                       (define rr (- (* 2 axis) r))
                       (define v (cell-color p))
                       (put (put gg r c v) rr c v)))
                   (let* ((axis (avg-round fcs))
                          (left (count-if (lambda (p)
                                            (and
                                              (= (cell-color p) main-color)
                                              (< (second p) axis)))
                                          payload))
                          (right (count-if (lambda (p)
                                             (and
                                               (= (cell-color p) main-color)
                                               (> (second p) axis)))
                                           payload))
                          (choose-left (>= left right))
                          (source (filter (lambda (p)
                                            (or
                                              (= (second p) axis)
                                              (if choose-left
                                                  (< (second p) axis)
                                                  (> (second p) axis))))
                                          cells)))
                     (for/fold ((gg cleared))
                       ((p source))
                       (define r (first p))
                       (define c (second p))
                       (define cc (- (* 2 axis) c))
                       (define v (cell-color p))
                       (put (put gg r c v) r cc v)))))))))

(rule!
 ;; A rectangular frame of four colored lines holds scattered dots
 ;; whose color matches ONE side. Crop to the frame; inside, every
 ;; occupied scan line smears solid toward the matching wall: dots
 ;; colored like the top wall fill from the wall down to their last
 ;; dot, like the bottom wall from their first dot to the wall, and
 ;; the left/right walls likewise along rows.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define (line? vals total)
       (let* ((colors (filter (lambda (v) (> v 0)) vals))
              (m (mode-list colors)))
         (and (>= (length colors) (- total 2))
              (not (eq? m #f))
              (>= (count-if (lambda (v) (= v m)) colors) (- total 2)))))
     (define line-rows
       (filter (lambda (r) (line? (row g r) w)) (range 0 h)))
     (define line-cols
       (filter (lambda (c) (line? (col g c) h)) (range 0 w)))
     (define top-r (first line-rows))
     (define bot-r (second line-rows))
     (define left-c (first line-cols))
     (define right-c (second line-cols))
     (define (line-mode vals)
       (mode-list (filter (lambda (v) (> v 0)) vals)))
     (define scatter-color
       (mode-list (map (lambda (p) (at g (first p) (second p)))
                       (filter (lambda (p)
                                 (and (> (first p) top-r)
                                      (< (first p) bot-r)
                                      (> (second p) left-c)
                                      (< (second p) right-c)
                                      (> (at g (first p) (second p)) 0)))
                               (grid-positions g)))))
     (define dir  ;; matched wall, checked in the original priority
       (cond ((= scatter-color (line-mode (row g top-r))) 'top)
             ((= scatter-color (line-mode (row g bot-r))) 'bot)
             ((= scatter-color (line-mode (col g left-c))) 'left)
             ((= scatter-color (line-mode (col g right-c))) 'right)
             (else #f)))
     (define vert? (member? dir (list 'top 'bot)))
     (define from-wall? (member? dir (list 'top 'left)))
     (build-grid (+ 1 (- bot-r top-r)) (+ 1 (- right-c left-c)) (orr oc)
                 (cond ((zero? orr) (at g top-r (+ left-c oc)))
                       ((= orr (- bot-r top-r)) (at g bot-r (+ left-c oc)))
                       ((zero? oc) (at g (+ top-r orr) left-c))
                       ((= oc (- right-c left-c))
                        (at g (+ top-r orr) right-c))
                       ((not dir) 0)
                       (else
                        (let* ((ir (+ top-r orr))
                               (ic (+ left-c oc))
                               (occ (if vert?
                                        (filter (lambda (r)
                                                  (> (at g r ic) 0))
                                                (range (+ top-r 1) bot-r))
                                        (filter (lambda (c)
                                                  (> (at g ir c) 0))
                                                (range (+ left-c 1)
                                                       right-c))))
                               (pos (if vert? ir ic)))
                          (if (and (not (null? occ))
                                   (if from-wall?
                                       (<= pos (max-list occ))
                                       (>= pos (min-list occ))))
                              scatter-color
                              0))))))))

written_solution: detect 6x6 hexagon circles by color; determine blockers (colors at missing hex positions); topological sort (unblocked first); output 6-wide vertical stack of complete hexagon outlines
program_solution:
(rule!
 ;; Overlapping rings all share one 6x6 stencil (12 cells). Each
 ;; color's visible cells anchor its stencil copy; stencil cells it is
 ;; MISSING are hidden under rings lying on top. Order the colors so
 ;; every ring comes after the rings covering it (topmost first), then
 ;; print each ring complete in its own 6x6 tile, stacked vertically.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define bg (mode g 0))
     (define stencil
       (list (list 0 2) (list 0 3) (list 1 1) (list 1 4) (list 2 0)
             (list 2 5) (list 3 0) (list 3 5) (list 4 1) (list 4 4)
             (list 5 2) (list 5 3)))
     (define (anchor-of cells)  ;; stencil offset covering every cell
       (let ((bb (bbox-of-cells cells)))
         (and (<= (- (third bb) (first bb)) 5)
              (<= (- (fourth bb) (second bb)) 5)
              (find-first
               (lambda (t)
                 (all? (lambda (cell)
                         (member (list (- (first cell) (first t))
                                       (- (second cell) (second t)))
                                 stencil))
                       cells))
               (for*/list ((tr (range (max 0 (- (third bb) 5))
                                      (+ (first bb) 1)))
                           (tc (range (max 0 (- (fourth bb) 5))
                                      (+ (second bb) 1))))
                 (list tr tc))))))
     (define circles  ;; (color blockers) per ring color found
       (filter (lambda (x) x)
               (map (lambda (col)
                      (let ((cells (find-color g col)))
                        (and (>= (length cells) 4)
                             (let ((t (anchor-of cells)))
                               (and t
                                    (let* ((rel (map (lambda (cl)
                                                       (list (- (first cl)
                                                                (first t))
                                                             (- (second cl)
                                                                (second t))))
                                                     cells))
                                           (hidden
                                            (filter
                                             (lambda (pos)
                                               (and (not (member pos rel))
                                                    (in-bounds?
                                                     (+ (first pos)
                                                        (first t))
                                                     (+ (second pos)
                                                        (second t))
                                                     h w)))
                                             stencil)))
                                      (list col
                                            (remove-duplicates
                                             (filter
                                              (lambda (v)
                                                (and (not (= v bg))
                                                     (not (= v col))))
                                              (map (lambda (pos)
                                                     (at g
                                                         (+ (first pos)
                                                            (first t))
                                                         (+ (second pos)
                                                            (second t))))
                                                   hidden))))))))))
                    (filter (lambda (c) (not (= c bg))) (grid-colors g)))))
     (define ring-colors (map first circles))
     (define (covered-by col)  ;; ring colors sitting on top of col
       (filter (lambda (b) (member? b ring-colors))
               (second (find (lambda (ci) (= (first ci) col)) circles))))
     (define order  ;; topmost ring first, base ring last
       (let loop ((rem ring-colors) (acc (list)))
         (if (null? rem)
             (reverse acc)
             (let ((next (find-first
                          (lambda (c)
                            (all? (lambda (b) (member? b acc))
                                  (covered-by c)))
                          rem)))
               (if next
                   (loop (remove next rem) (cons next acc))
                   (loop (rest rem) (cons (first rem) acc)))))))
     (for/fold ((out (empty-grid (* (length order) 6) 6 bg)))
               ((i (range 0 (length order))))
       (paint-cells out
                    (map (lambda (pos) (list (+ (first pos) (* i 6))
                                             (second pos)))
                         stencil)
                    (nth order i))))))

written_solution: 2-wide diagonal staircase from red(2) to top-right; blue(1) cells translate path right with bridge rows
program_solution:
(rule!
 ;; A bottom-row red seed grows a two-cell-wide staircase up and right.
 ;; Blue cells matter only when they occupy either prospective step cell:
 ;; skip to the first column beyond that blocker run, then bridge the shift
 ;; horizontally on the row below. Off-path blue cells remain unchanged.
 (lambda (g)
   (let* ((hh (rows g))
          (ww (cols g))
          (red-r #f)
          (red-c #f)
          (blue-map (make-hash))
          (scan-input
           (for* ((r (range 0 hh)) (c (range 0 ww)))
             (cond
               ((= (at g r c) 2)
                (set! red-r r)
                (set! red-c c))
               ((= (at g r c) 1)
                (hash-set! blue-map r
                  (cons c (hash-ref blue-map r (list))))))))
          (result (make-hash))
          (copy-input
           (for* ((r (range 0 hh)) (c (range 0 ww)))
             (hash-set! result (list r c) (at g r c))))
          (left-cols (make-hash))
          (cl red-c)
          ;; First determine the left column of every reachable step.
          (trace-path
           (let process ((row (- red-r 1)))
             (if (or (< row 0) (>= cl ww))
                 (+ row 1)
                 (begin
                   (let ((blues (hash-ref blue-map row (list))))
                     (let shift-past-run ((again #t))
                       (when (or (member cl blues) (member (+ cl 1) blues))
                         (set! cl
                           (+ 1
                              (max-list
                               (filter
                                (lambda (bc)
                                  (or (= bc cl) (= bc (+ cl 1))))
                                blues))))
                         (shift-past-run #f))))
                   (hash-set! left-cols row cl)
                   (set! cl (+ cl 1))
                   (process (- row 1))))))
          (prev-cl red-c)
          ;; Paint each two-cell step, adding a bridge only after a deflection.
          (paint-path
           (let paint-row ((row (- red-r 1)))
             (when (and (>= row 0) (hash-has-key? left-cols row))
               (let ((cl-here (hash-ref left-cols row)))
                 (when (> cl-here (+ prev-cl 1))
                   (let ((bridge-row (+ row 1)))
                     (for ((c (range (+ prev-cl 1) (+ cl-here 1))))
                       (when (and (>= c 0)
                                  (< c ww)
                                  (zero? (hash-ref result
                                                   (list bridge-row c)
                                                   0)))
                         (hash-set! result (list bridge-row c) 2)))))
                 (when (< cl-here ww)
                   (hash-set! result (list row cl-here) 2))
                 (when (< (+ cl-here 1) ww)
                   (hash-set! result (list row (+ cl-here 1)) 2))
                 (set! prev-cl cl-here)
                 (paint-row (- row 1)))))))
     (build-grid hh ww (r c)
       (hash-ref result (list r c) 0)))))

                 ((obj gray-objs))
                 (for/fold ((a acc))

                              (zero? (at g rr cc))

                          (let ((ar (- r0 1))

             (define (first-placement acc shape)
               (for*/first ((r0 (range 1 h)) (c0 (range 0 w))
                             #:when
                             (fits? acc shape r0 c0))
                           (list r0 c0)))
