written_solution: Template marker ports choose a D4 transform; scaled fill cells stamp between paired markers
program_solution:
(rule!
 ;; A multicolor TEMPLATE (majority fill color + 2 marker cells of other
 ;; colors) shows a shape at unit scale. Loose marker-colored objects
 ;; pair up (nearest gap first, different colors): each pair anchors a
 ;; scaled-up ghost of the template under some rotation/flip — the two
 ;; markers must land exactly on the two objects. Paint the ghost's
 ;; fill cells (scaled to the objects' size) onto the background.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define bg (mode g -1))
     (define (obj-colors obj)
       (unique (map (lambda (p) (at g (first p) (second p)))
                    (obj-cells obj))))
     (define template
       (first (sort-by (filter (lambda (o) (>= (length (obj-colors o)) 3))
                               (objects-multicolor g bg))
                       (lambda (o) (+ (* 1000 (obj-size o))
                                      (* 30 (obj-r1 o)) (obj-c1 o))))))
     (define th (obj-h template))
     (define tw (obj-w template))
     (define fill-color
       (mode-list (map (lambda (p) (at g (first p) (second p)))
                       (obj-cells template))))
     (define template-cells  ;; (r c v) normalized to the template bbox
       (map (lambda (p) (list (- (first p) (obj-r1 template))
                              (- (second p) (obj-c1 template))
                              (at g (first p) (second p))))
            (obj-cells template)))
     (define marker-cells
       (filter (lambda (p) (not (= (third p) fill-color))) template-cells))
     (define fill-cells
       (filter (lambda (p) (= (third p) fill-color)) template-cells))
     (define marker-objs
       (sort-by (filter (lambda (o)
                          (and (not (for/or ((p (obj-cells o)))
                                      (member p (obj-cells template))))
                               (member (obj-color o)
                                       (filter (lambda (c)
                                                 (not (= c fill-color)))
                                               (obj-colors template)))))
                        (objects g bg))
                (lambda (o) (+ (* 1000 (obj-r1 o)) (obj-c1 o)))))
     (define (gap-dist a b)  ;; bbox gap, manhattan
       (+ (max 0 (- (max (obj-r1 a) (obj-r1 b))
                    (min (obj-r2 a) (obj-r2 b)) 1))
          (max 0 (- (max (obj-c1 a) (obj-c1 b))
                    (min (obj-c2 a) (obj-c2 b)) 1))))
     (define pairs  ;; greedy nearest-first, different colors, each used once
       (first
        (foldl (lambda (cand state)
                 (let ((i (second cand)) (j (third cand)))
                   (if (or (member i (second state))
                           (member j (second state)))
                       state
                       (list (append (first state)
                                     (list (list (nth marker-objs i)
                                                 (nth marker-objs j))))
                             (append (second state) (list i j))))))
               (list (list) (list))
               (sort-by (for*/list ((i (range 0 (length marker-objs)))
                                    (j (range (+ i 1)
                                              (length marker-objs)))
                                    #:when (not (= (obj-color
                                                    (nth marker-objs i))
                                                   (obj-color
                                                    (nth marker-objs j)))))
                          (list (gap-dist (nth marker-objs i)
                                          (nth marker-objs j))
                                i j))
                        first))))
     (define (xform cell t)  ;; the 8 dihedral images of a template cell
       (let ((r (first cell)) (c (second cell)))
         (cond ((zero? t) (list r c))
               ((= t 1) (list c (- th 1 r)))
               ((= t 2) (list (- th 1 r) (- tw 1 c)))
               ((= t 3) (list (- tw 1 c) r))
               ((= t 4) (list r (- tw 1 c)))
               ((= t 5) (list (- th 1 r) c))
               ((= t 6) (list c r))
               (else (list (- tw 1 c) (- th 1 r))))))
     (define (placement-at t asg a)  ;; anchor if both markers agree
       (let* ((ms (map (lambda (m) (xform m t)) marker-cells))
              (sh (obj-h a)) (sw (obj-w a))
              (anchor (lambda (m o) (list (- (obj-r1 o) (* (first m) sh))
                                          (- (obj-c1 o) (* (second m) sw)))))
              (s1 (anchor (first ms) (first asg)))
              (s2 (anchor (second ms) (second asg))))
         (and (equal? s1 s2)
              (list (first s1) (second s1)
                    (map (lambda (p) (xform p t)) fill-cells)))))
     (define (find-placement a b)
       (and (= (obj-h a) (obj-h b)) (= (obj-w a) (obj-w b))
            (find-first (lambda (x) x)
                        (for*/list ((t (range 0 8))
                                    (asg (list (list a b) (list b a))))
                          (placement-at t asg a)))))
     (define (paint-fill out placement a)
       (if placement
           (let ((sr (first placement)) (sc (second placement))
                 (sh (obj-h a)) (sw (obj-w a)))
             (for*/fold ((acc out))
                        ((p (third placement))
                         (r (range (+ sr (* (first p) sh))
                                   (+ sr (* (+ (first p) 1) sh))))
                         (c (range (+ sc (* (second p) sw))
                                   (+ sc (* (+ (second p) 1) sw)))))
               (if (and (in-bounds? r c h w) (= (at acc r c) bg))
                   (set-cell acc r c fill-color)
                   acc)))
           out))
     (for/fold ((out g)) ((pair (in-list pairs)))
       (paint-fill out (find-placement (first pair) (second pair))
                   (first pair))))))

(rule! (lambda (g)

           (let* ((top-line? (for/and ((c (range 0 w))) (= (at g 0 c) 2)))
                  (bot-line? (for/and ((c (range 0 w))) (= (at g (- h 1) c) 2)))
                  (left-line? (for/and ((r (range 0 h))) (= (at g r 0) 2)))
                  (right-line? (for/and ((r (range 0 h))) (= (at g r (- w 1)) 2)))
                  (dir (cond
                         (top-line? 'up)
                         (bot-line? 'down)
                         (left-line? 'left)
                         (right-line? 'right)))
                  (non-2-objs (filter (lambda (o) (!= (obj-color o) 2)) (objects g 0)))
                  (sorted (sort non-2-objs
                                (lambda (a b)
                                  (let ((aa (obj-bbox a))

                                      ((eq? dir 'up) (< (first aa) (first bb)))
                                      ((eq? dir 'down) (> (third aa) (third bb)))
                                      ((eq? dir 'left) (< (second aa) (second bb)))
                                      (else (> (fourth aa) (fourth bb))))))))
                  (base (cellmap g (r c v) (if (= v 2) 2 0)))
                  (occupied (make-hash))
                  (_init (for ((r (range 0 h)))
                           (for ((c (range 0 w)))

             (for/fold ((out base))
               ((shape sorted))

                      (cells-colored (map (lambda (c)
                                            (list (first c)
                                                  (second c)
                                                  (at g (first c) (second c))))
                                          cells))
                      (slide-d (let loop
                                    ((d 0))
                                    (let* ((dr (cond
                                                 ((eq? dir 'up) (- 0 (+ d 1)))
                                                 ((eq? dir 'down) (+ d 1))
                                                 (else 0)))
                                           (dc (cond
                                                 ((eq? dir 'left) (- 0 (+ d 1)))
                                                 ((eq? dir 'right) (+ d 1))
                                                 (else 0)))
                                           (can-move (for/and ((c cells))
                                                              (let ((nr (+ (first c) dr))
                                                                    (nc (+ (second c)
                                                                           dc)))

                                                                  (< nc w)
                                                                  (not (hash-has-key? occupied
                                                                                      (list nr
                                                                                            nc))))))))
                                      (cond (can-move (loop (+ d 1))) (else d)))))
                      (fdr (cond
                             ((eq? dir 'up) (- 0 slide-d))
                             ((eq? dir 'down) slide-d)
                             (else 0)))
                      (fdc (cond
                             ((eq? dir 'left) (- 0 slide-d))
                             ((eq? dir 'right) slide-d)
                             (else 0))))
                 (for/fold ((o out))
                   ((cc cells-colored))
                   (let ((nr (+ (first cc) fdr))
                         (nc (+ (second cc) fdc))
                         (col (third cc)))
                     (hash-set! occupied (list nr nc) #t)
                     (set-cell o nr nc col)))))))))

(rule!
  ;; Laser from a 2-cell green(3) seed: beams start at every seed cell along
  ;; the seed's axis (one shared row -> horizontal, else vertical), paint
  ;; traversed orange(7) green, SPLIT perpendicular at cyan(8) walls, and stop
  ;; at grid edges. Pure worklist over (r c dr dc) beam states.
  (lambda (g)
    (let* ((h (rows g))
           (w (cols g))
           (open? (lambda (r c) (and (in-bounds? r c h w) (!= (at g r c) 8))))
           (seeds (find-color g 3))
           (horiz (= 1 (length (unique (map first seeds)))))
           (dirs (if horiz
                     (list (list 0 1) (list 0 -1))
                     (list (list 1 0) (list -1 0))))
           (start (flatmap (lambda (p)
                             (map (lambda (d)
                                    (list (first p) (second p) (first d) (second d)))
                                  dirs))
                           seeds))
           (filled
             (let run ((stack start) (visited (list)) (acc seeds))
               (cond
                 ((null? stack) acc)
                 ((member (first stack) visited)
                  (run (rest stack) visited acc))
                 (else
                  (let* ((head (first stack))
                         (dr (third head))
                         (dc (fourth head))
                         (seen (cons head visited)))
                    (let march ((cr (first head)) (cc (second head)) (hit acc))

                        (cond
                          ((open? nr nc) (march nr nc (cons (list nr nc) hit)))
                          ((and (in-bounds? nr nc h w) (= (at g nr nc) 8))
                           (let* ((perp (if (!= dc 0)
                                            (list (list 1 0) (list -1 0))
                                            (list (list 0 1) (list 0 -1))))
                                  (splits (map (lambda (d)
                                                 (list cr cc (first d) (second d)))
                                               (filter (lambda (d)
                                                         (open? (+ cr (first d))
                                                                (+ cc (second d))))
                                                       perp))))
                             (run (append splits (rest stack)) seen hit)))

written_solution: 3x3 frame shapes (8 blue(1) cells with center hole) → plus shape in red(2). Other blue(1) shapes unchanged.
program_solution:
(rule! (lambda (g)
  (let* ((h (rows g))
         (w (cols g))
         ;; Start from an exact copy so every non-target blue shape is preserved.
         (result (make-hash)))
    (for* ((r (range 0 h)) (c (range 0 w)))
      (hash-set! result (list r c) (at g r c)))
    ;; A target is exactly a 3x3 blue(1) frame surrounding a zero center.
    (for* ((r (range 1 (- h 1))) (c (range 1 (- w 1))))
      (when (and (zero? (at g r c))
                 (= (at g (- r 1) (- c 1)) 1)
                 (= (at g (- r 1) c) 1)
                 (= (at g (- r 1) (+ c 1)) 1)
                 (= (at g r (- c 1)) 1)
                 (= (at g r (+ c 1)) 1)
                 (= (at g (+ r 1) (- c 1)) 1)
                 (= (at g (+ r 1) c) 1)
                 (= (at g (+ r 1) (+ c 1)) 1))
        ;; Replace that frame with a red(2) plus: erase corners, paint cross.
        (hash-set! result (list (- r 1) (- c 1)) 0)
        (hash-set! result (list (- r 1) (+ c 1)) 0)
        (hash-set! result (list (+ r 1) (- c 1)) 0)
        (hash-set! result (list (+ r 1) (+ c 1)) 0)
        (hash-set! result (list (- r 1) c) 2)
        (hash-set! result (list r (- c 1)) 2)
        (hash-set! result (list r c) 2)
        (hash-set! result (list r (+ c 1)) 2)
        (hash-set! result (list (+ r 1) c) 2)))
    ;; Construct a fresh result grid; the input object is never mutated.
    (cellmap g (r c v) (hash-ref result (list r c) 0)))))

(rule!
  (let* ((target-color
          (find-first
           (lambda (color)
             (let* ((cells (find-color g color))
                    (row-count (length (remove-duplicates (map first cells))))
                    (col-count (length (remove-duplicates (map second cells)))))
               (and (= (length cells) 4)
                    (<= row-count 3)
                    (<= col-count 3))))
           (filter (lambda (color) (!= color 0)) (grid-colors g))))
         (target-cells (find-color g target-color))
         (target-rows (remove-duplicates (map first target-cells)))
         (target-cols (remove-duplicates (map second target-cells)))
         (row-pairs
          (filter
           (lambda (row)
             (= (count-where (lambda (cell) (= (first cell) row)) target-cells) 2))
           target-rows))
         (col-pairs
          (filter
           (lambda (col)
             (= (count-where (lambda (cell) (= (second cell) col)) target-cells) 2))
           target-cols))
         (rectangle? (and (= (length row-pairs) 2) (= (length col-pairs) 2)))
         (horizontal
          (if rectangle?
              (if (> (abs (- (second col-pairs) (first col-pairs)))
                     (abs (- (second row-pairs) (first row-pairs))))
                  row-pairs
                  (list))
              row-pairs))
         (vertical
          (if rectangle?
              (if (> (abs (- (second col-pairs) (first col-pairs)))
                     (abs (- (second row-pairs) (first row-pairs))))
                  (list)
                  col-pairs)
              col-pairs)))
    (cellmap
     g (r c v)
     (if (or (find (lambda (row) (= row r)) horizontal)
             (find (lambda (col) (= col c)) vertical))
         target-color
         0))))

written_solution: L-trominos: find open corner of 2x2 bbox, draw diagonal ray from open corner away from L, extending to grid edge
program_solution:
(rule!
  (let ()
    ;; alt: identify each 3-cell L by its missing corner in the 2x2 bbox,
    ;; then march one diagonal step farther in that same direction.
    (define (has-cell? cells r c)
      (member? (list r c) cells))
    (define (paint-ray out color r c dr dc)
      (let loop ([acc out] [rr (+ r dr)] [cc (+ c dc)])
        (if (in-bounds? rr cc (rows g) (cols g))
            (loop (set-cell acc rr cc color) (+ rr dr) (+ cc dc))
            acc)))
    (define (paint-l out obj)
      (let* ([cells (obj-cells obj)]
             [bb (obj-bbox obj)]
             [r0 (first bb)]
             [c0 (second bb)]
             [color (obj-color obj)]
             [misses
              (filter (lambda (p) (not (has-cell? cells (first p) (second p))))
                      (list (list r0 c0)
                            (list r0 (+ c0 1))
                            (list (+ r0 1) c0)
                            (list (+ r0 1) (+ c0 1))))])
        (if (empty? misses)
            out
            (let* ([m (first misses)]
                   [mr (first m)]
                   [mc (second m)]
                   [corner-r (if (= mr r0) (+ r0 1) r0)]
                   [corner-c (if (= mc c0) (+ c0 1) c0)]
                   [dr (- mr corner-r)]
                   [dc (- mc corner-c)])
              (paint-ray out color mr mc dr dc)))))
    (for/fold ([out g])
              ([obj (in-list (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-size o) 3))
                                     (objects g 0)))])
      (paint-l out obj))))

(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((mcomps (objects-multicolor g 0))
                  (templates (filter (lambda (o)
                                       (let ((colors (remove-duplicates (map (lambda (c)
                                                                               (at g
                                                                                   (first c)
                                                                                   (second c)))
                                                                             (obj-cells o)))))
                                         (>= (length colors) 2)))
                                     mcomps))
                  (tmpl-rels (map (lambda (t)
                                    (let* ((cells (obj-cells t))
                                           (bb (bbox-of-cells cells))
                                           (r1 (first bb))
                                           (c1 (second bb)))
                                      (map (lambda (c)
                                             (list (- (first c) r1)
                                                   (- (second c) c1)
                                                   (at g (first c) (second c))))
                                           cells)))
                                  templates))
                  (tmpl-set (make-hash))
                  (_1 (for ((t templates))
                        (for ((c (obj-cells t)))
                          (hash-set! tmpl-set (list (first c) (second c)) #t))))
                  (partials (reverse (fold-cells g
                                                 (list)
                                                 (lambda (acc r c v)
                                                   (if (and
                                                         (!= v 0)
                                                         (not (hash-has-key? tmpl-set
                                                                             (list r c))))
                                                       (cons (list r c v) acc)
                                                       acc)))))
                  (partial-set (make-hash))
                  (_2 (for ((p partials))
                        (hash-set! partial-set (list (first p) (second p)) (third p))))
                  (candidates (apply append
                                     (map (lambda (p)
                                            (apply append
                                                   (map (lambda (t-rel)
                                                          (map (lambda (tc)
                                                                 (list (- (first p)
                                                                          (first tc))
                                                                       (- (second p)
                                                                          (second tc))
                                                                       t-rel))
                                                               (filter (lambda (tc)
                                                                         (= (third tc)
                                                                            (third p)))
                                                                       t-rel)))
                                                        tmpl-rels)))
                                          partials)))
                  (scored (filter (lambda (x) x)
                                  (map (lambda (cand)
                                         (let* ((off-r (first cand))
                                                (off-c (second cand))
                                                (t-rel (third cand))
                                                (abs-cells (map (lambda (tc)
                                                                  (list (+ (first tc)
                                                                           off-r)
                                                                        (+ (second tc)
                                                                           off-c)
                                                                        (third tc)))
                                                                t-rel))
                                                (valid (let check
                                                            ((cs abs-cells))
                                                            (cond
                                                              ((null? cs) #t)
                                                              (else (let* ((c (car cs))
                                                                           (ar (first c))
                                                                           (ac (second c))
                                                                           (av (third c)))
                                                                      (cond
                                                                        ((not (in-bounds? ar
                                                                                          ac
                                                                                          h
                                                                                          w)) #f)
                                                                        ((hash-has-key? tmpl-set
                                                                                        (list ar
                                                                                              ac)) #f)
                                                                        ((let ((gv (at g
                                                                                       ar
                                                                                       ac)))
                                                                           (or
                                                                             (zero? gv)
                                                                             (= gv av))) (check (cdr cs)))
                                                                        (else #f)))))))
                                                (covered (if valid
                                                             (filter (lambda (ac)
                                                                       (hash-has-key? partial-set
                                                                                      (list (first ac)
                                                                                            (second ac))))
                                                                     abs-cells)
                                                             '
                                                             ())))
                                           (and
                                             (and valid (> (length covered) 0))
                                             (list (length covered) covered abs-cells))))
                                       candidates)))
                  (sorted (sort scored (lambda (a b) (> (first a) (first b)))))
                  (used (make-hash)))
             (for/fold ((out g))
               ((c sorted))
               (let* ((covered (second c))
                      (abs-cells (third c))
                      (overlap (let check
                                    ((cs covered))
                                    (cond
                                      ((null? cs) #f)
                                      ((hash-has-key? used
                                                      (list (first (car cs))
                                                            (second (car cs)))) #t)
                                      (else (check (cdr cs)))))))
                 (cond
                   (overlap out)
                   (else (for ((cov covered))
                           (hash-set! used (list (first cov) (second cov)) #t))
                         (paint-cells out abs-cells)))))))))

(rule!
  ;; alt: filter `(objects g 0)` by LR symmetry, sort by `obj-size`, then crop the winner's bbox.
  (lambda (g)
    (define objs (objects g 0))
    (define (bbox-lr-symmetric? bb)
      (let* ((r0 (first bb))
             (c0 (second bb))
             (r1 (third bb))
             (c1 (fourth bb))
             (w (+ 1 (- c1 c0))))

             (for*/and ((r (in-range r0 (+ r1 1)))
                        (c (in-range c0 (+ c1 1))))
               (= (at g r c)
                  (at g r (- (+ c0 c1) c)))))))

      (filter (lambda (o) (bbox-lr-symmetric? (obj-bbox o))) objs))
    (define chosen
      (if (empty? symmetric-objs)

          (first (sort symmetric-objs
                       (lambda (a b) (> (obj-size a) (obj-size b)))))))

           (c0 (second bb))
           (r1 (third bb))
           (c1 (fourth bb)))

  ;; Every yellow (4) cell moves down 1 row. A cell that started exactly 2 rows

         (fours (find-color g 4))

                           (go (- nr 1) (+ c 1) ul))))

                     (gc1 (if key-left (+ cross-c 1) 0))

                       (k10 (cell-at g (+ kr1 1) kc1))

(rule! (lambda (g)

           (let* ((sixes (find-color g 6))
                  (sr1 (min-of first sixes))
                  (sr2 (max-of first sixes))
                  (sc1 (min-of second sixes))
                  (sc2 (max-of second sixes))
                  (sep-rows (filter (lambda (r)
                                      (all? (lambda (c) (zero? (at g r c))) (range 0 w)))
                                    (range 1 (- h 1))))
                  (sep-cols (filter (lambda (c)
                                      (all? (lambda (r) (zero? (at g r c))) (range 0 h)))
                                    (range 1 (- w 1))))
                  (has-rsep (not (null? sep-rows)))
                  (has-csep (not (null? sep-cols))))
             (define (count-seps pos bmin bmax seps)
               (let ((lo (min pos bmin))
                     (hi (max pos bmax)))
                 (count-if (lambda (s) (and (> s lo) (< s hi))) seps)))
             (cellmap g
                      (r c v)
                      (let ((v v))
                        (if (!= v 8)
                            v
                            (let* ((d-pr (max 0 (- sr1 r) (- r sr2)))
                                   (d-pc (max 0 (- sc1 c) (- c sc2))))
                              (if (or (zero? d-pr) (zero? d-pc))
                                  8
                                  (let* ((d-rb (if has-rsep
                                                   (count-seps r sr1 sr2 sep-rows)
                                                   0))
                                         (d-cb (if has-csep
                                                   (count-seps c sc1 sc2 sep-cols)
                                                   0))
                                         (stay (cond
                                                 ((and has-rsep has-csep) (and
                                                     (<= d-pc (* 2 (max 0 (- d-rb 1))))
                                                     (<= d-pr (* 2 (max 0 (- d-cb 1))))))
                                                 (has-rsep (<= d-pc
                                                               (* 2 (max 0 (- d-rb 1)))))
                                                 (has-csep (<= d-pr
                                                               (* 2 (max 0 (- d-cb 1)))))
                                                 (else #f))))
                                    (if stay 8 4)))))))))))

(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (begin
             (define ones (positions-of g (lambda (v) (= v 1))))
             (define r0 (min-of first ones))
             (define r1 (max-of first ones))
             (define c0 (min-of second ones))
             (define c1 (max-of second ones))
             (define base
               (filter identity
                       (for*/list ((r (range r0 (+ r1 1))) (c (range c0 (+ c1 1))))
                         (let ((v (at g r c)))
                           (and (or (= v 1) (= v 4)) (list (- r r0) (- c c0) v))))))
             (define all4 (positions-of g (lambda (v) (= v 4))))
             (define (transform-pos p idx)
               (let ((r (first p))
                     (c (second p)))
                 (cond
                   ((zero? idx) (list r c))
                   ((= idx 1) (list c (- r)))
                   ((= idx 2) (list (- r) (- c)))
                   ((= idx 3) (list (- c) r))
                   ((= idx 4) (list r (- c)))
                   ((= idx 5) (list (- c) (- r)))
                   ((= idx 6) (list (- r) c))
                   (else (list c r)))))
             (define (entries-after idx)
               (let* ((raws (map (lambda (e) (transform-pos e idx)) base))
                      (mr (min-of first raws))
                      (mc (min-of second raws)))
                 (map (lambda (e)
                        (let ((p (transform-pos e idx)))
                          (list (- (first p) mr) (- (second p) mc) (third e))))
                      base)))
             (define (valid-candidate? entries ar ac)
               (let* ((placed4 (filter (lambda (p)
                                         (in-bounds? (first p) (second p) h w))
                                       (map (lambda (e)
                                              (list (+ ar (first e)) (+ ac (second e))))
                                            (filter (lambda (e) (= (third e) 4))
                                                    entries))))
                      (placed1 (filter (lambda (p)
                                         (in-bounds? (first p) (second p) h w))
                                       (map (lambda (e)
                                              (list (+ ar (first e)) (+ ac (second e))))
                                            (filter (lambda (e) (= (third e) 1))
                                                    entries)))))
                 (and
                   (>= (length placed4) 2)
                   (for/and ((p placed4)) (member p all4))
                   (for/and ((p placed1))
                            (let ((v (at g (first p) (second p))))
                              (or (zero? v) (= v 1)))))))
             (define candidates
               (flatmap (lambda (idx)
                          (let* ((entries (entries-after idx))
                                 (maxr (max-of first entries))
                                 (maxc (max-of second entries)))
                            (filter identity
                                    (for*/list ((ar (range (- maxr) h)) (ac (range (- maxc) w)))
                                      (and
                                        (valid-candidate? entries ar ac)
                                        (map (lambda (e)
                                               (list (+ ar (first e)) (+ ac (second e))))
                                             (filter (lambda (e) (= (third e) 1))
                                                     entries)))))))
                        (range 0 8)))
             (for/fold ((out g))
               ((cells candidates))
               (for/fold ((gg out))
                 ((p cells))
                 (if (and
                       (in-bounds? (first p) (second p) h w)
                       (zero? (at g (first p) (second p))))
                     (set-cell gg (first p) (second p) 1)
                     gg)))))))

(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (begin
             (define (in-b r c) (and (>= r 0) (< r h) (>= c 0) (< c w)))
             (define ones (find-color g 1))
             (define p1 (first ones))
             (define p2
               (find (lambda (p)
                       (and
                         (!= p p1)
                         (= 1 (abs (- (first p) (first p1))))
                         (= 1 (abs (- (second p) (second p1))))))
                     ones))
             (define dir
               (if p2
                   (list (- (first p2) (first p1)) (- (second p2) (second p1)))
                   (list 1 1)))
             (define (wall-orient r c)
               (let ((up (and (in-b (- r 1) c) (= (at g (- r 1) c) 2)))
                     (dn (and (in-b (+ r 1) c) (= (at g (+ r 1) c) 2))))
                 (if (or up dn) 'vertical 'horizontal)))
             (define max-steps (* h w 4))
             (define (walk gg r c dr dc fuel)
               (if (<= fuel 0)
                   gg
                   (let ((nr (+ r dr))
                         (nc (+ c dc)))
                     (cond
                       ((not (in-b nr nc)) gg)
                       ((= (at g nr nc) 2) (let* ((orient (wall-orient nr nc))
                                (ndr (if (= orient 'horizontal) (- dr) dr))
                                (ndc (if (= orient 'vertical) (- dc) dc)))
                           (walk gg r c ndr ndc (- fuel 1))))
                       (else (walk (set-cell gg nr nc 1) nr nc dr dc (- fuel 1)))))))
             (define sorted-by-row (sort-by ones (lambda (p) (first p))))
             (define start-bwd (first sorted-by-row))
             (define start-fwd (nth sorted-by-row (- (length sorted-by-row) 1)))
             (define after-fwd
               (walk g
                     (first start-fwd)
                     (second start-fwd)
                     (first dir)
                     (second dir)
                     max-steps))
             (walk after-fwd
                   (first start-bwd)
                   (second start-bwd)
                   (- 0 (first dir))
                   (- 0 (second dir))
                   max-steps)))))

written_solution: staircase path between 2 endpoints through stripe markers; transpose for vertical stripes; path goes horizontal-vertical alternating through waypoint middle columns
program_solution:
(rule!
 ;; Two endpoint dots (the color appearing exactly twice) and a stack
 ;; of stripe walls, each pierced by waypoint marks. Route the path:
 ;; drop from the upper endpoint, elbow one row above each stripe over
 ;; to its waypoint column (middle mark when several), punch through,
 ;; and finally hook over to the lower endpoint. Vertical stripes are
 ;; solved by transposing in and out.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define freq (color-frequency g))
     (define bg (mode g))
     (define ep-color
       (find-first (lambda (c) (= (hash-ref freq c 0) 2))
                   (grid-colors g)))
     (define others
       (filter (lambda (c) (and (not (= c bg)) (not (= c ep-color))))
               (grid-colors g)))
     (define stripe-color
       (find-first (lambda (c) (> (hash-ref freq c 0) 30)) others))
     (define wp-color
       (find-first (lambda (c) (and (not (= c stripe-color))
                                    (< (hash-ref freq c 0) 30)
                                    (> (hash-ref freq c 0) 2)))
                   others))
     (define horiz
       (let ((cells (find-color g stripe-color)))
         (> (max-of (lambda (r) (count-if (lambda (p) (= (first p) r))
                                          cells))
                    (remove-duplicates (map first cells)))
            (max-of (lambda (c) (count-if (lambda (p) (= (second p) c))
                                          cells))
                    (remove-duplicates (map second cells))))))
     (define (solve gg)
       (let* ((hh (rows gg)) (ww (cols gg))
              (stripe-rows
               (filter (lambda (r)
                         (>= (count-if (lambda (c) (= (at gg r c)
                                                      stripe-color))
                                       (range 0 ww))
                             (- ww 5)))
                       (range 0 hh)))
              (eps (find-color gg ep-color))
              (upper? (< (first (first eps)) (first (second eps))))
              (start (if upper? (first eps) (second eps)))
              (goal (if upper? (second eps) (first eps)))
              (wp-cells (find-color gg wp-color))
              (marker-col
               (lambda (sr)
                 (let ((cols (sort (map second
                                        (filter (lambda (p)
                                                  (= (first p) sr))
                                                wp-cells))
                                   <)))
                   (cond ((null? cols) -1)
                         ((= (length cols) 1) (first cols))
                         (else (nth cols (quotient (length cols) 2)))))))
              (vseg (lambda (out r1 r2 c)  ;; inclusive vertical run
                      (recolor-cells out
                                     (map (lambda (r) (list r c))
                                          (range (min r1 r2)
                                                 (+ (max r1 r2) 1)))
                                     ep-color)))
              (hseg (lambda (out r c1 c2)  ;; inclusive horizontal run
                      (recolor-cells out
                                     (map (lambda (c) (list r c))
                                          (range (min c1 c2)
                                                 (+ (max c1 c2) 1)))
                                     ep-color))))
         (let loop ((cur-r (+ (first start) 1))
                    (cur-c (second start))
                    (stripes (map (lambda (sr) (list sr (marker-col sr)))
                                  stripe-rows))
                    (out gg))
           (if (null? stripes)
               (hseg (recolor-cells out
                                    (map (lambda (r) (list r cur-c))
                                         (range cur-r (first goal)))
                                    ep-color)
                     (first goal) cur-c (second goal))
               (let ((sr (first (first stripes)))
                     (mc (second (first stripes))))
                 (loop (+ sr 1) mc (rest stripes)
                       (set-cell (hseg (vseg out cur-r (- sr 1) cur-c)
                                       (- sr 1) cur-c mc)
                                 sr mc ep-color)))))))
     (if horiz (solve g) (transpose (solve (transpose g)))))))

(rule!
  ;; Marker gravity: the struct color is the least-common color of the BOTTOM
  ;; ROW; the marker color is the least-common color overall (excluding
  ;; struct); the remaining color is the background. Every marker object falls
  ;; as a rigid unit until its cells would enter a row that is struct (or sits
  ;; directly above struct), or collide with another marker object. Objects
  ;; relax one step at a time, in order, until nothing moves.
  (lambda (g)
    (let* ((h (rows g))
           (counts (color-frequency g))
           (struct-c (pick-min (unique (row g (- h 1)))
                               (lambda (v) (hash-ref counts v))))
           (rest1 (filter (lambda (v) (!= v struct-c)) (grid-colors g)))
           (mcolor (pick-min rest1 (lambda (v) (hash-ref counts v))))
           (bg (first (filter (lambda (v) (!= v mcolor)) rest1)))
           (struct? (lambda (r c) (and (< r h) (= (at g r c) struct-c))))
           (blocked? (lambda (r c) (or (>= (+ r 1) h) (struct? r c) (struct? (+ r 1) c))))
           (marker-mask (cellmap g (r c v) (if (= v mcolor) mcolor bg)))
           (objs (map obj-cells (objects marker-mask bg)))
           (settled
             (let relax ((groups objs))
               (let ((next
                       (let step ((idx 0) (cur groups))
                         (if (>= idx (length cur))
                             cur
                             (let* ((o (list-ref cur idx))
                                    (others (flatmap (lambda (i)
                                                       (if (= i idx) (list) (list-ref cur i)))
                                                     (range 0 (length cur))))
                                    (movable
                                      (all? (lambda (p)
                                              (let ((nr (+ (first p) 1)) (nc (second p)))
                                                (and (< nr h)
                                                     (not (blocked? nr nc))
                                                     (not (member (list nr nc) others)))))
                                            o))
                                    (o2 (if movable
                                            (map (lambda (p) (list (+ (first p) 1) (second p))) o)
                                            o)))
                               (step (+ idx 1) (list-set cur idx o2)))))))
                 (if (equal? next groups) groups (relax next))))))
      (recolor-cells (cellmap g (r c v) (if (= v mcolor) bg v))
                     (flatmap (lambda (o) o) settled)
                     mcolor))))

written_solution: classify border fragments by oriented bbox edges and repack them into the smallest square
program_solution:
(rule!
 ;; Scattered frame pieces reassemble into an n-by-n border. Classify
 ;; each piece by which full edges it owns: 1-row strips are TOP runs,
 ;; corner pieces own a full row plus a full column (top-left,
 ;; bottom-left, bottom-right), everything else is a SIDE piece. n =
 ;; the widest assembled edge. Corners and strips chain left-to-right
 ;; along their edge; each side piece climbs up from the bottom corner
 ;; it sat closest to in the input.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define bg
       (mode-list (for*/list ((r (range 0 h)) (c (range 0 w)))
                    (at g r c))))
     (define (full-row? cells r ww)
       (all? (lambda (c) (member (list r c) cells)) (range 0 ww)))
     (define (full-col? cells c hh)
       (all? (lambda (r) (member (list r c) cells)) (range 0 hh)))
     (define (classify cells hh ww)
       (cond ((and (= hh 1) (> ww 1)) 'top)
             ((and (> hh 1) (> ww 1)
                   (full-row? cells 0 ww) (full-col? cells 0 hh))
              'top-left)
             ((and (> hh 1) (> ww 1)
                   (full-row? cells (- hh 1) ww) (full-col? cells 0 hh))
              'bottom-left)
             ((and (> hh 1) (> ww 1)
                   (full-row? cells (- hh 1) ww)
                   (full-col? cells (- ww 1) hh))
              'bottom-right)
             (else 'side)))
     ;; entry = (type obj cells hh ww color), cells normalized
     (define entries
       (map (lambda (o)
              (let* ((cells (normalize-cells (obj-cells o)))
                     (hh (+ 1 (max-of first cells)))
                     (ww (+ 1 (max-of second cells))))
                (list (classify cells hh ww) o cells hh ww (obj-color o))))
            (objects g bg)))
     (define (eobj e) (second e))
     (define (ecells e) (third e))
     (define (eh e) (fourth e))
     (define (ew e) (fifth e))
     (define (ecolor e) (sixth e))
     (define (of-type sym)
       (sort (filter (lambda (e) (eq? (first e) sym)) entries)
             (lambda (a b) (< (obj-c1 (eobj a)) (obj-c1 (eobj b))))))
     (define (sum-w xs) (apply + (cons 0 (map ew xs))))
     (define top-lefts (of-type 'top-left))
     (define tops (of-type 'top))
     (define bottom-lefts (of-type 'bottom-left))
     (define bottom-rights (of-type 'bottom-right))
     (define sides (of-type 'side))
     (define n
       (max (+ (sum-w top-lefts) (sum-w tops))
            (+ (sum-w bottom-lefts) (sum-w bottom-rights))
            (max-of (lambda (e) (max (eh e) (ew e))) entries)))
     (define (place out e tr tc)
       (paint-cells out
                    (map (lambda (p) (list (+ tr (first p))
                                           (+ tc (second p))))
                         (ecells e))
                    (ecolor e)))
     (define (chain-right out xs r c)  ;; pieces side by side along a row
       (for/fold ((gg out) (cc c) #:result gg) ((e xs))
         (values (place gg e r cc) (+ cc (ew e)))))
     (define (chain-bottom-right out xs)
       (for/fold ((gg out) (cc n) #:result gg) ((e (reverse xs)))
         (define nc (- cc (ew e)))
         (values (place gg e (- n (eh e)) nc) nc)))
     (define (center2 e) (+ (obj-c1 (eobj e)) (obj-c2 (eobj e))))
     (define bl-center
       (if (null? bottom-lefts) -9999 (center2 (first bottom-lefts))))
     (define br-center
       (if (null? bottom-rights) 9999 (center2 (first bottom-rights))))
     (define bl-start
       (if (null? bottom-lefts) n (- n (eh (first bottom-lefts)))))
     (define br-start
       (if (null? bottom-rights) n (- n (eh (first bottom-rights)))))
     (define (left-side? e)  ;; climb the wall of the nearer bottom corner
       (cond ((= (length (ecells e)) 1) #f)
             ((null? bottom-lefts) #f)
             ((null? bottom-rights) #t)
             (else (<= (abs (- (center2 e) bl-center))
                       (abs (- (center2 e) br-center))))))
     (let* ((g1 (chain-right (empty-grid n n bg) top-lefts 0 0))
            (g2 (chain-right g1 tops 0 (sum-w top-lefts)))
            (g3 (for/fold ((gg g2) (cc 0) #:result gg) ((e bottom-lefts))
                  (values (place gg e (- n (eh e)) cc) (+ cc (ew e)))))
            (g4 (chain-bottom-right g3 bottom-rights)))
       (for/fold ((gg g4)) ((e sides))
         (if (left-side? e)
             (place gg e (max 1 (- bl-start (eh e))) 0)
             (place gg e (max 1 (- br-start (eh e))) (- n (ew e)))))))))

(rule!
 ;; Crop the largest multicolor object as the canvas.  Every smaller piece
 ;; shares one marker color with that canvas; paste it at the unique window
 ;; whose marker cells match exactly.  Process pieces largest-first.
 (lambda (g)
   (define bg (mode g))
   (define objs
     (sort (objects-multicolor g bg)
           (lambda (a b) (> (obj-size a) (obj-size b)))))
   (define container (first objs))
   (define c-fill (mode-in (obj-cells container) g bg))
   (define (palette grid)
     (reverse

(rule! (lambda (g)
  (let* ((h (rows g))
         (w (cols g)))
    ;; Read the unique nonzero seed that anchors the periodic pattern.
    (let* ((cells (filter

                    (grid-positions g)))
           (seed (fst cells))
           (color (at g (fst seed) (snd seed)))
           (sc (snd seed))

           (base (reduce
                   (lambda (acc c)
                     (reduce
                       (lambda (a r) (set-cell a r c color))
                       acc
                       (range 0 h)))
                   (cellmap g (r c v) 0)
                   (filter
                     (lambda (c) (zero? (remainder (- c sc) 2)))
                     (range sc w)))))
      ;; Fill intervening columns with gray markers, alternating top/bottom.
      (reduce
        (lambda (acc i)
          (let ((gc (+ sc 1 (* 2 i))))
            (if (>= gc w)
                acc
                (set-cell
                  acc
                  (if (zero? (remainder i 2)) 0 (- h 1))
                  gc
                  5))))
        base
        (range 0 w))))))

written_solution: markers in chains (gap 3): directional chains; staggered rows use earlier marker evidence
program_solution:
(rule!
 ;; Markers on the busiest row either FALL as full columns or LIE DOWN
 ;; as 3-long floor runs: a 3-spaced marker chain marked with blue(1)
 ;; goes horizontal, the rest drop. In STAGGERED inputs (busiest row
 ;; below the top) each column starts at its own first marker, loose
 ;; blue cells become floor runs reaching toward the next column, and
 ;; single floor gaps between red(2) runs close up.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define (row-markers r)
       (filter (lambda (c) (> (at g r c) 0)) (range 0 w)))
     (define nonzero-rows
       (filter (lambda (r) (not (empty? (row-markers r)))) (range 0 h)))
     (if (empty? nonzero-rows)
         (empty-grid h w 0)
         (let* ((max-count (max-of (lambda (r)
                                     (length (row-markers r)))
                                   nonzero-rows))
                (active-row (find-first
                             (lambda (r) (>= (length (row-markers r))
                                             (- max-count 1)))
                             nonzero-rows))
                (markers (row-markers active-row))
                (staggered (> active-row 0)))
           (define (chain-left c)
             (let loop ((x c))
               (if (member? (- x 3) markers) (loop (- x 3)) x)))
           (define (chain-right c)
             (let loop ((x c))
               (if (member? (+ x 3) markers) (loop (+ x 3)) x)))
           (define (chain-cols c)
             (let ((leftmost (chain-left c))
                   (rightmost (chain-right c)))
               (filter (lambda (m) (and (>= m leftmost)
                                        (<= m rightmost)
                                        (zero? (modulo (- m leftmost)
                                                       3))))
                       markers)))
           (define (chain-start c)  ;; stop before a 2->1 handoff
             (let loop ((x c))
               (let ((prev (- x 3)))
                 (if (and (member? prev markers)
                          (not (and (= 2 (at g active-row prev))
                                    (= 1 (at g active-row x)))))
                     (loop prev)
                     x))))
           (define (horizontal? c)
             (if staggered
                 (any? (lambda (cc) (= 1 (at g active-row cc)))
                       (chain-cols c))
                 (= 1 (at g active-row (chain-start c)))))
           (define (first-row-at-col c)
             (let ((hits (filter (lambda (r) (> (at g r c) 0))
                                 nonzero-rows)))
               (if (empty? hits) active-row (first hits))))
           (define vertical-cols
             (filter (lambda (c) (not (horizontal? c))) markers))
           (define base
             (for/fold ((out (empty-grid h w 0))) ((m markers))
               (let ((color (at g active-row m)))
                 (if (horizontal? m)
                     (recolor-cells out
                                    (map (lambda (cc) (list (- h 1) cc))
                                         (range m (min w (+ m 3))))
                                    color)
                     (recolor-cells out
                                    (map (lambda (r) (list r m))
                                         (range (if staggered
                                                    (first-row-at-col m)
                                                    0)
                                                h))
                                    color)))))
           (if (not staggered)
               base
               (let ((with-ones  ;; loose blues run along the floor
                      (for*/fold ((out base))
                                 ((r (range (+ active-row 1) h))
                                  (c (range 0 w)))
                        (if (and (= 1 (at g r c))
                                 (not (member? c markers)))
                            (let* ((next-vs (filter (lambda (vc)
                                                      (> vc c))
                                                    vertical-cols))
                                   (end-c (if (empty? next-vs)
                                              (min (- w 1) (+ c 2))
                                              (min (- w 1)
                                                   (- (first next-vs)
                                                      2)))))
                              (if (>= end-c c)
                                  (recolor-cells
                                   out
                                   (map (lambda (cc)
                                          (list (- h 1) cc))
                                        (range c (+ end-c 1)))
                                   1)
                                  out))
                            out))))
                 (for/fold ((out with-ones)) ((c (range 1 (- w 1))))
                   (if (and (zero? (at out (- h 1) c))
                            (= 2 (at out (- h 1) (- c 1)))
                            (= 2 (at out (- h 1) (+ c 1))))
                       (set-cell out (- h 1) c 2)
                       out)))))))))

(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((all-cells (flatmap (lambda (r)
                                        (map (lambda (c) (list r c)) (range 0 w)))
                                      (range 0 h)))
                  (best #f))
             (define (segment? c r0 r1)
               (and
                 (!= (at g r0 c) 0)
                 (= (at g r0 c) (at g r1 c))
                 (all? (lambda (r) (!= (at g r c) 0)) (range r0 (+ r1 1)))))
             (define (guide-cell? p r0 r1 cL cR)
               (and (>= (fst p) r0) (<= (fst p) r1) (or (= (snd p) cL) (= (snd p) cR))))
             (define (pat-cells r0 r1 cL cR)
               (filter (lambda (p)
                         (and
                           (!= (at g (fst p) (snd p)) 0)
                           (not (guide-cell? p r0 r1 cL cR))))
                       all-cells))
             (define (try-pair r0 r1 cL cR)
               (let* ((oh (+ 1 (- r1 r0)))
                      (ow (+ 1 (- cR cL)))
                      (cells (pat-cells r0 r1 cL cR)))
                 (unless
                   (empty? cells)
                   (let* ((pr0 (min-of fst cells))
                          (pr1 (max-of fst cells))
                          (pc0 (min-of snd cells))
                          (pc1 (max-of snd cells)))
                     (when
                       (and
                         (= (+ 1 (- pr1 pr0)) (- oh 2))
                         (= (+ 1 (- pc1 pc0)) (- ow 2)))
                       (set! best (list r0 r1 cL cR pr0 pr1 pc0 pc1)))))))
             (for* ((r0 (range 0 h)) (r1 (range (+ r0 2) h))
                     (cA (range 0 w))
                     (cB (range (+ cA 1) w)))
                   (when
                     (and (not best) (segment? cA r0 r1) (segment? cB r0 r1))
                     (try-pair r0 r1 cA cB)))
             (let* ((r0 (first best))
                    (r1 (second best))
                    (cL (third best))
                    (cR (fourth best))
                    (pr0 (fifth best))
                    (pc0 (seventh best))
                    (pc1 (eighth best))
                    (oh (+ 1 (- r1 r0)))
                    (ow (+ 1 (- cR cL)))
                    (ih (- oh 2))
                    (iw (- ow 2))
                    (left (at g (+ r0 1) cL))
                    (right (at g (+ r0 1) cR))
                    (offsets (flatmap (lambda (dr)
                                        (map (lambda (dc) (list dr dc)) (range 0 iw)))
                                      (range 0 ih))))
               (define (src-val off flip?)
                 (let ((dr (fst off))
                       (dc (snd off)))
                   (at g (+ pr0 dr) (if flip? (- pc1 dc) (+ pc0 dc)))))
               (define (score flip?)
                 (count-if (lambda (off)
                             (let ((dc (snd off))
                                   (v (src-val off flip?)))
                               (or
                                 (and (< dc (quotient iw 2)) (= v left))
                                 (and (>= dc (quotient (+ iw 1) 2)) (= v right)))))
                           offsets))
               (let ((flip? (> (score #t) (score #f))))
                 (build-grid oh
                             ow
                             (r c)
                             (cond
                               ((zero? c) (at g (+ r0 r) cL))
                               ((= c (- ow 1)) (at g (+ r0 r) cR))
                               ((or (zero? r) (= r (- oh 1))) 0)
                               (else (src-val (list (- r 1) (- c 1)) flip?))))))))))

(rule! (lambda (g)

                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((hh (rows g))
                  (ww (cols g))
                  (red-row #f)
                  (d0 (for ((r (range 0 hh)))
                        (when
                          (and
                            (not red-row)
                            (for/and ((c (range 0 ww))) (= (at g r c) 2)))
                          (set! red-row r))))
                  (vis (make-hash))
                  (shapes (list))
                  (d1 (for* ((r (range 0 red-row)) (c (range 0 ww)))
                            (when
                              (and
                                (= (at g r c) 1)
                                (not (hash-has-key? vis (list r c))))
                              (let ((comp (list))
                                    (stack (list (list r c))))
                                (let bfs
                                     ((stk stack))
                                     (unless
                                       (null? stk)
                                       (let* ((cur (car stk))
                                              (rest (cdr stk))
                                              (cr (first cur))
                                              (cc (second cur)))
                                         (if (or
                                               (< cr 0)
                                               (>= cr red-row)
                                               (< cc 0)
                                               (>= cc ww)
                                               (!= (at g cr cc) 1)
                                               (hash-has-key? vis (list cr cc)))
                                             (bfs rest)
                                             (begin
                                               (hash-set! vis (list cr cc) #t)
                                               (set! comp (cons (list cr cc) comp))
                                               (bfs (append (list (list (- cr 1) cc)
                                                                  (list (+ cr 1) cc)
                                                                  (list cr (- cc 1))
                                                                  (list cr (+ cc 1)))
                                                            rest)))))))
                                (set! shapes (cons comp shapes))))))
                  (result (build-grid hh
                                      ww
                                      (r c)
                                      (if (and (< r red-row) (= (at g r c) 1))
                                          8
                                          (at g r c))))
                  (pass-cols (make-hash))
                  (d2 (for ((shape shapes))
                        (let* ((rmin (min-of first shape))
                               (rmax (max-of first shape))
                               (cmin (min-of second shape))
                               (cmax (max-of second shape)))
                          (define (row-count rr)
                            (for/sum ((p shape)) (if (= (first p) rr) 1 0)))
                          (define wide-rows
                            (filter (lambda (rr) (> (row-count rr) 1))
                                    (range rmin (+ rmax 1))))
                          (define no-wide (null? wide-rows))
                          (define dr
                            (if no-wide
                                (- (- hh 1) rmax)
                                (- (- red-row 1) (max-list wide-rows))))
                          (when
                            no-wide
                            (for ((cell shape)) (hash-set! pass-cols (second cell) #t)))
                          (for ((cell shape))
                            (let ((nr (+ (first cell) dr))
                                  (nc (second cell)))
                              (when
                                (in-bounds? nr nc hh ww)
                                (set! result (set-cell result nr nc 1))))))))
                  (d3 (for ((c (hash-keys pass-cols)))
                        (set! result (set-cell result red-row c 8)))))
             result))))

written_solution: 2x2 red(2) blocks: rotate corners CCW, extend diagonally through 0-cells, stop near other blocks
program_solution:
(rule! (lambda (g)
  (let* ((h (rows g))
         (w (cols g)))
    (begin
      ;; Copy the input, then locate every solid 2x2 color-2 block.
      (define result (cellmap g (r c v) v))
      (define blocks
        (filter
          (lambda (b) b)
          (for*/list ((rr (range 0 (- h 1)))
                      (cc (range 0 (- w 1))))
            (and (= (at g rr cc) 2)
                 (= (at g rr (+ cc 1)) 2)
                 (= (at g (+ rr 1) cc) 2)
                 (= (at g (+ rr 1) (+ cc 1)) 2)
                 (list rr cc)))))

      (for ((bi (range 0 (length blocks))))
        (define b (nth blocks bi))
        (define rr (first b))
        (define cc (second b))
        (define tl-v (at g (- rr 1) (- cc 1)))
        (define tr-v (at g (- rr 1) (+ cc 2)))
        (define bl-v (at g (+ rr 2) (- cc 1)))
        (define br-v (at g (+ rr 2) (+ cc 2)))

        ;; Rotate corner VALUES one corner forward:
        ;; old TL -> new TR -> new BR -> new BL -> new TL.
        (set! result (set-cell result (- rr 1) (- cc 1) bl-v))
        (set! result (set-cell result (- rr 1) (+ cc 2) tl-v))
        (set! result (set-cell result (+ rr 2) (- cc 1) br-v))
        (set! result (set-cell result (+ rr 2) (+ cc 2) tr-v))

        ;; Extend a rotated corner value along its outward diagonal. Reads are
        ;; always from g, so earlier writes never become obstacles. The narrow
        ;; blocked-skimmer condition is part of the selected canonical rule.
        (define (do-ext sr sc dr dc val)
          (define nr (+ sr dr))
          (define nc (+ sc dc))
          (when (and (>= nr 0) (< nr h)
                     (>= nc 0) (< nc w)
                     (zero? (at g nr nc)))
            (define opp-c (- nc dc))
            (define opp-is-2
              (and (>= opp-c 0) (< opp-c w)
                   (= (at g nr opp-c) 2)))
            (define next-r (+ nr dr))
            (define next-c (+ nc dc))
            (define rem1
              (and (>= next-r 0) (< next-r h)
                   (>= next-c 0) (< next-c w)
                   (zero? (at g next-r next-c))))
            (define next2-r (+ nr (* 2 dr)))
            (define next2-c (+ nc (* 2 dc)))
            (define rem2
              (and rem1
                   (>= next2-r 0) (< next2-r h)
                   (>= next2-c 0) (< next2-c w)
                   (zero? (at g next2-r next2-c))))
            (define blocked (and opp-is-2 rem1 (not rem2)))
            (unless blocked
              (set! result (set-cell result nr nc val))
              (do-ext nr nc dr dc val))))

        (do-ext (- rr 1) (- cc 1) -1 -1 bl-v)
        (do-ext (- rr 1) (+ cc 2) -1 1 tl-v)
        (do-ext (+ rr 2) (- cc 1) 1 -1 br-v)
        (do-ext (+ rr 2) (+ cc 2) 1 1 tr-v))

(rule!
 ;; Green(3) marks sketch V-shaped triangles: an apex plus points along its
 ;; two 45-degree arms (grouped when within Chebyshev distance 2 along a
 ;; row, column, or exact diagonal). For every group, apex, depth and
 ;; orientation where both arms are attested (>=1 mark each, >=3 total,
 ;; and some mark sits at full depth), the whole solid triangle is filled
 ;; with cyan(8). The marks themselves stay green.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define marks (find-color g 3))
     (define max-d (max h w))
     (define (near? a b)  ;; aligned or diagonal within Chebyshev 2
       (let ((dr (abs (- (first a) (first b))))
             (dc (abs (- (second a) (second b)))))
         (and (<= (max dr dc) 2)
              (or (= dr dc) (zero? dr) (zero? dc)))))
     (define groups  ;; connected components of marks under near?
       (for/fold ((gs (list))) ((m marks))
         (let ((touch? (lambda (grp) (any? (lambda (x) (near? m x)) grp))))
           (cons (cons m (apply append (filter touch? gs)))
                 (filter (lambda (grp) (not (touch? grp))) gs)))))
     (define (arm-cell orient ar ac k side)  ;; k-th cell of one arm
       (cond ((zero? orient) (list (+ ar k) (+ ac (if (zero? side) (- k) k))))
             ((= orient 1) (list (- ar k) (+ ac (if (zero? side) (- k) k))))
             ((= orient 2) (list (+ ar (if (zero? side) (- k) k)) (+ ac k)))
             (else (list (+ ar (if (zero? side) (- k) k)) (- ac k)))))
     (define (arm-count orient ar ac d side grp)
       (count-if (lambda (k)
                   (let ((p (arm-cell orient ar ac k side)))
                     (and (in-bounds? (first p) (second p) h w)
                          (member? p grp))))
                 (range 1 (+ d 1))))
     (define (far-supported? orient ar ac d grp)
       (any? (lambda (side)
               (let ((p (arm-cell orient ar ac d side)))
                 (and (in-bounds? (first p) (second p) h w)
                      (member? p grp))))
             (list 0 1)))
     (define (valid? orient apex d grp)
       (let ((a (arm-count orient (first apex) (second apex) d 0 grp))
             (b (arm-count orient (first apex) (second apex) d 1 grp)))
         (and (>= (+ 1 a b) 3) (>= a 1) (>= b 1)
              (far-supported? orient (first apex) (second apex) d grp))))
     (define tris  ;; every attested (orient apex d), over all groups
       (flatmap (lambda (grp)
                  (flatmap (lambda (apex)
                             (flatmap (lambda (d)
                                        (filter values
                                                (map (lambda (orient)
                                                       (and (valid? orient apex d grp)
                                                            (list orient apex d)))
                                                     (list 0 1 2 3))))
                                      (range 1 (+ max-d 1))))
                           grp))
                groups))
     (define (inside? orient apex d r c)  ;; cell within the solid triangle
       (let ((ar (first apex)) (ac (second apex)))
         (cond ((zero? orient)
                (and (>= r ar) (<= r (+ ar d))
                     (<= (abs (- c ac)) (- r ar))))
               ((= orient 1)
                (and (<= r ar) (>= r (- ar d))
                     (<= (abs (- c ac)) (- ar r))))
               ((= orient 2)
                (and (>= c ac) (<= c (+ ac d))
                     (<= (abs (- r ar)) (- c ac))))
               (else
                (and (<= c ac) (>= c (- ac d))
                     (<= (abs (- r ar)) (- ac c)))))))

(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (begin
             (define bg 8)
             (define objs (objects g bg))
             (define frame (argmax obj-size objs))
             (define fr1 (obj-r1 frame))
             (define fc1 (obj-c1 frame))
             (define fr2 (obj-r2 frame))
             (define fc2 (obj-c2 frame))
             (define frame-color (obj-color frame))
             (define inner-h (- fr2 fr1 1))
             (define inner-w (- fc2 fc1 1))
             (define fill-values
               (for*/list ((r (range (+ fr1 1) fr2)) (c (range (+ fc1 1) fc2))
                   #:when
                   (let ((v (at g r c))) (and (!= v bg) (!= v frame-color))))
                 (at g r c)))
             (define fill-color (mode-list fill-values))
             (define existing-fill
               (for*/list ((r (range (+ fr1 1) fr2)) (c (range (+ fc1 1) fc2))
                   #:when
                   (= (at g r c) fill-color))
                 (list (- r fr1 1) (- c fc1 1))))
             (define top-glyphs
               (filter (lambda (obj)
                         (and
                           (< (obj-r2 obj) fr1)
                           (!= (obj-color obj) bg)
                           (!= (obj-color obj) frame-color)
                           (!= (obj-color obj) fill-color)))
                       (objects-8 g bg)))
             (define (glyph-cell? glyph gr gc)
               (member (list gr gc) (normalize-cells (obj-cells glyph))))
             (define (glyph-allows? glyph rel-r rel-c)
               (let* ((gh (+ 1 (- (obj-r2 glyph) (obj-r1 glyph))))
                      (gw (+ 1 (- (obj-c2 glyph) (obj-c1 glyph)))))
                 (and
                   (zero? (modulo inner-h gh))
                   (zero? (modulo inner-w gw))
                   (let ((bh (quotient inner-h gh))
                         (bw (quotient inner-w gw)))
                     (glyph-cell? glyph (quotient rel-r bh) (quotient rel-c bw))))))
             (define candidates
               (filter (lambda (glyph)
                         (let ((gh (+ 1 (- (obj-r2 glyph) (obj-r1 glyph))))
                               (gw (+ 1 (- (obj-c2 glyph) (obj-c1 glyph)))))
                           (and
                             (> gh 0)
                             (> gw 0)
                             (zero? (modulo inner-h gh))
                             (zero? (modulo inner-w gw))
                             (all? (lambda (p)
                                     (glyph-allows? glyph (first p) (second p)))
                                   existing-fill))))
                       top-glyphs))
             (define glyph
               (first (sort-by candidates
                               (lambda (obj) (+ (* 1000 (obj-r1 obj)) (obj-c1 obj))))))
             (define gh (+ 1 (- (obj-r2 glyph) (obj-r1 glyph))))
             (define gw (+ 1 (- (obj-c2 glyph) (obj-c1 glyph))))
             (define bh (quotient inner-h gh))
             (define bw (quotient inner-w gw))
             (build-grid (+ 1 (- fr2 fr1))
                         (+ 1 (- fc2 fc1))
                         (r c)
                         (cond
                           ((or (zero? r) (zero? c) (= r (- fr2 fr1)) (= c (- fc2 fc1))) frame-color)
                           ((glyph-cell? glyph
                                         (quotient (- r 1) bh)
                                         (quotient (- c 1) bw)) fill-color)
                           (else bg)))))))

(rule! (lambda (g)
  ;; The single colored cell in the 3x3 input anchors a 9x9 CLOCKWISE SQUARE SPIRAL: marker at
  ;; (r,c) -> spiral anchor (4r,4c). The turtle starts NORTH and walks segments of 2,2,4,4,6,6,...
  ;; cells, turning clockwise after each; cells outside the canvas are clipped. Drawn in the
  ;; marker's color on a blank 9x9.
  (let* ((mk (first (positions-of g (lambda (v) (!= v 0)))))
         (color (at g (first mk) (second mk)))
         (dirs (list (list -1 0) (list 0 1) (list 1 0) (list 0 -1)))
         (ar (* 4 (first mk))) (ac (* 4 (second mk)))
         (cells
          (let walk ((k 1) (r ar) (c ac) (d 0) (acc (list (list ar ac))))
            (if (> k 30) acc
                (let* ((dr (first (list-ref dirs d))) (dc (second (list-ref dirs d))))
                  (let seg ((i 0) (rr r) (cc c) (a acc))
                    (if (= i (* 2 (quotient (+ k 1) 2)))
                        (walk (+ k 1) rr cc (modulo (+ d 1) 4) a)
                        (seg (+ i 1) (+ rr dr) (+ cc dc)
                             (cons (list (+ rr dr) (+ cc dc)) a)))))))))
    (recolor-cells (empty-grid 9 9)
                   (filter (lambda (p) (in-bounds? (first p) (second p) 9 9)) cells)
                   color))))

(rule!
 ;; A blob has one-cell DENTS (notches: 3 blob neighbors, walled
 ;; flanks) and one-cell BUMPS (warts/hairs that pruning weak cells —
 ;; degree <= 1, to fixpoint — strips away). Each mark reflects
 ;; straight through the clean body: a dent paints a fg cell just past
 ;; the far side, a bump erases the far edge cell on its line.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define bg (mode g -1))
     (define fg
       (find-first (lambda (v) (not (= v bg))) (grid-colors g -999)))
     (define bmask (cellmap g (r c v) (if (= v fg) 1 0)))
     (define (in? mask r c) (= (safe-at mask r c 0) 1))
     (define (nb mask r c)
       (count-if (lambda (d) (in? mask (+ r (first d)) (+ c (second d))))
                 cardinal-deltas))
     (define dents
       (filter
        (lambda (p)
          (let* ((r (first p)) (c (second p))
                 (miss (filter (lambda (d)
                                 (not (in? bmask (+ r (first d))
                                           (+ c (second d)))))
                               cardinal-deltas)))
            (and (not (in? bmask r c))
                 (= (length miss) 1)
                 (let ((o (first miss)))
                   (all? (lambda (pd)
                           (and (in? bmask (+ r (first pd))
                                     (+ c (second pd)))
                                (not (in? bmask
                                          (+ r (first pd) (first o))
                                          (+ c (second pd) (second o))))))
                         (if (zero? (first o))
                             (list (list -1 0) (list 1 0))
                             (list (list 0 -1) (list 0 1))))))))
        (grid-positions g)))
     (define clean  ;; dents filled, then weak cells pruned to fixpoint
       (let strip ((mask (paint-cells bmask dents 1)))
         (let ((weak (filter (lambda (p)
                               (<= (nb mask (first p) (second p)) 1))
                             (find-color mask 1))))
           (if (null? weak) mask (strip (erase-cells mask weak 0))))))
     (define (walk r c dr dc)  ;; ride clean to its far edge cell
       (if (in? clean (+ r dr) (+ c dc))
           (walk (+ r dr) (+ c dc) dr dc)
           (list r c)))
     (define bump-acts  ;; blob cells the pruning removed
       (filter (lambda (x) x)
               (map (lambda (p)
                      (let ((att (filter (lambda (d)
                                           (in? clean (+ (first p)
                                                         (first d))
                                                (+ (second p)
                                                   (second d))))
                                         cardinal-deltas)))
                        (and (= (length att) 1)
                             (append (walk (first p) (second p)
                                           (first (first att))
                                           (second (first att)))
                                     (list bg)))))
                    (filter (lambda (p)
                              (not (in? clean (first p) (second p))))
                            (find-color bmask 1)))))
     (define dent-acts
       (filter (lambda (x) x)
               (map (lambda (p)
                      (let ((ext (filter (lambda (d)
                                           (not (in? clean
                                                     (+ (first p)
                                                        (first d))
                                                     (+ (second p)
                                                        (second d)))))
                                         cardinal-deltas)))
                        (and (= (length ext) 1)
                             (let* ((o (first ext))
                                    (end (walk (first p) (second p)
                                               (- (first o))
                                               (- (second o)))))
                               (list (- (first end) (first o))
                                     (- (second end) (second o))
                                     fg)))))
                    dents)))
     (for/fold ((out g)) ((a (append bump-acts dent-acts)))
       (set-cell out (first a) (second a) (third a))))))
