written_solution: merge 4-conn 8-components whose row OR column bbox ranges overlap; fill each merged shape's bbox with 2 in bg cells
program_solution:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (begin
             (define comps (objects g 0))
             (define (cells-bbox cells)
               (let ((rs (map first cells))
                     (cs (map second cells)))
                 (list (min-list rs) (min-list cs) (max-list rs) (max-list cs))))
             (define (boxes-overlap? b1 b2)
               (let ((r1a (first b1))
                     (c1a (second b1))
                     (r1b (third b1))
                     (c1b (nth b1 3))
                     (r2a (first b2))
                     (c2a (second b2))
                     (r2b (third b2))
                     (c2b (nth b2 3)))
                 (or
                   (not (or (< r1b r2a) (< r2b r1a)))
                   (not (or (< c1b c2a) (< c2b c1a))))))
             (define groups (map obj-cells comps))
             (define (do-merge gs)
               (if (or (null? gs) (null? (cdr gs)))
                   gs
                   (let* ((cur (first gs))
                          (rest (cdr gs))
                          (bb-cur (cells-bbox cur))
                          (matches (filter (lambda (g)
                                             (boxes-overlap? bb-cur (cells-bbox g)))
                                           rest))
                          (non-matches (filter (lambda (g)
                                                 (not (boxes-overlap? bb-cur
                                                                      (cells-bbox g))))
                                               rest)))
                     (if (null? matches)
                         (cons cur (do-merge rest))
                         (do-merge (cons (apply append (cons cur matches)) non-matches))))))
             (define (merge-fixed gs)
               (let ((m (do-merge gs)))
                 (if (= (length m) (length gs)) m (merge-fixed m))))
             (define merged-groups (merge-fixed groups))
             (reduce (lambda (gg group)
                       (let* ((bb (cells-bbox group))
                              (r1 (first bb))
                              (c1 (second bb))
                              (r2 (third bb))
                              (c2 (nth bb 3))
                              (cells (flatmap (lambda (r)
                                                (map (lambda (c) (list r c))
                                                     (range c1 (+ c2 1))))
                                              (range r1 (+ r2 1)))))
                         (reduce (lambda (gg2 rc)
                                   (if (zero? (at g (first rc) (second rc)))
                                       (set-cell gg2 (first rc) (second rc) 2)
                                       gg2))
                                 gg
                                 cells)))
                     g
                     merged-groups)))))

written_solution: replicate marker to same-parity cells in lattice grid
program_solution:
(rule!
 ;; Full lines of the dominant color rule the board into lattice cells.
 ;; One cell (the last in scan order holding anything) carries a marker
 ;; pattern: stamp that pattern into every cell sharing its row AND
 ;; column parity, clipped to each cell.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define line-color
       (pick-max (filter (lambda (v) (> v 0))
                         (remove-duplicates
                          (map (lambda (p) (at g (first p) (second p)))
                               (grid-positions g))))
                 (lambda (v) (length (find-color g v)))))
     (define row-bounds
       (append (list -1)
               (filter (lambda (r) (all? (lambda (c) (= (at g r c)
                                                        line-color))
                                         (range 0 w)))
                       (range 0 h))
               (list h)))
     (define col-bounds
       (append (list -1)
               (filter (lambda (c) (all? (lambda (r) (= (at g r c)
                                                        line-color))
                                         (range 0 h)))
                       (range 0 w))
               (list w)))
     (define (spans bounds)
       (filter (lambda (p) (<= (first p) (second p)))
               (map (lambda (i) (list (+ 1 (nth bounds i))
                                      (- (nth bounds (+ i 1)) 1)))
                    (range 0 (- (length bounds) 1)))))
     (define row-spans (spans row-bounds))
     (define col-spans (spans col-bounds))
     (define (pattern-at cr cc)  ;; non-line cells relative to the cell
       (let ((rr (nth row-spans cr)) (cs (nth col-spans cc)))
         (for*/list ((r (range (first rr) (+ (second rr) 1)))
                     (c (range (first cs) (+ (second cs) 1)))
                     #:when (let ((v (at g r c)))
                              (and (not (= v 0))
                                   (not (= v line-color)))))
           (list (- r (first rr)) (- c (first cs)) (at g r c)))))
     (define marker  ;; LAST populated cell in scan order: (cr cc pat)
       (for*/fold ((best (list -1 -1 (list))))
                  ((cr (range 0 (length row-spans)))
                   (cc (range 0 (length col-spans))))
         (let ((pat (pattern-at cr cc)))
           (if (null? pat) best (list cr cc pat)))))
     (for*/fold ((out g))
                ((cr (range 0 (length row-spans)))
                 (cc (range 0 (length col-spans)))
                 #:when (and (= (modulo cr 2) (modulo (first marker) 2))
                             (= (modulo cc 2)
                                (modulo (second marker) 2))))
       (let ((rr (nth row-spans cr)) (cs (nth col-spans cc)))
         (for/fold ((gg out)) ((p (third marker)))
           (let ((r2 (+ (first rr) (first p)))
                 (c2 (+ (first cs) (second p))))
             (if (and (<= r2 (second rr)) (<= c2 (second cs)))
                 (set-cell gg r2 c2 (third p))
                 gg))))))))

                                              (begin

                                                                  #:when
                                                                  (!= (at g rr cc) 0))
                                                                (list rr cc)))
                                                       (color (if (null? cells)
                                                                  0
                                                                  (at g
                                                                      (first (car cells))
                                                                      (second (car cells))))))
                                                  (unless
                                                    (null? cells)
                                                    (let ((rmin (min-of first cells))
                                                          (cmin (min-of second cells)))
                                                      (set! shapes

written_solution: Find symmetry that maps panel inner corners to scattered cells arrangement; apply to panel
program_solution:
(rule!
 ;; A framed panel (blue border) has four distinct interior corner
 ;; colors; scattered dots outside repeat those colors at the corners
 ;; of THEIR bounding box, in some orientation. Output the panel
 ;; rotated/flipped so its corners land like the dots' (missing dots
 ;; read as border blue 1).
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define bb (bbox-of-cells (find-color g 1)))
     (define pr1 (first bb)) (define pc1 (second bb))
     (define pr2 (third bb)) (define pc2 (fourth bb))
     (define panel (subgrid g pr1 pc1 pr2 pc2))
     (define ph (rows panel))
     (define pw (cols panel))
     (define A (at panel 1 1))
     (define B (at panel 1 (- pw 2)))
     (define C (at panel (- ph 2) 1))
     (define D (at panel (- ph 2) (- pw 2)))
     (define scattered
       (filter (lambda (p) (let ((r (first p)) (c (second p)))
                             (and (> (at g r c) 0)
                                  (or (< r pr1) (> r pr2)
                                      (< c pc1) (> c pc2)))))
               (grid-positions g)))
     (define sbb (bbox-of-cells scattered))
     (define (dot r c)  ;; scattered color there, else border blue
       (if (member (list r c) scattered) (at g r c) 1))
     (define signature
       (list (dot (first sbb) (second sbb))
             (dot (first sbb) (fourth sbb))
             (dot (third sbb) (second sbb))
             (dot (third sbb) (fourth sbb))))
     (define transforms  ;; (corner-signature transform), identity first
       (list (list (list A B C D) (lambda (p) p))
             (list (list B A D C) flip-lr)
             (list (list C D A B) flip-ud)
             (list (list D C B A) rotate-180)
             (list (list A C B D) transpose)
             (list (list D B C A)
                   (lambda (p) (rotate-180 (transpose p))))
             (list (list C A D B) rotate-cw)
             (list (list B D A C) rotate-ccw)))
     ((second (find-first (lambda (t) (equal? (first t) signature))
                          transforms))
      panel))))

  ;; alt: identify color-5 divider rows/cols, derive macro-cell ranges, and paint the three diagonal ranges via `cellmap`.
  (lambda (g)
    (let* ((h (rows g))
           (w (cols g))
           (div-rows (filter (lambda (r)
                               (all? (lambda (c) (= (at g r c) 5))
                                     (range 0 w)))
                             (range 0 h)))
           (div-cols (filter (lambda (c)
                               (all? (lambda (r) (= (at g r c) 5))
                                     (range 0 h)))
                             (range 0 w)))
           (segments (lambda (n divs)
                       (filter (lambda (p) (<= (first p) (second p)))
                               (map list
                                    (cons 0 (map add1 divs))
                                    (append (map sub1 divs) (list (- n 1)))))))
           (row-ranges (segments h div-rows))
           (col-ranges (segments w div-cols))
           (mid-r (quotient (length row-ranges) 2))
           (mid-c (quotient (length col-ranges) 2))
           (targets (list (list (first row-ranges) (first col-ranges) 1)
                          (list (list-ref row-ranges mid-r) (list-ref col-ranges mid-c) 2)
                          (list (last row-ranges) (last col-ranges) 3))))
      (cellmap g (r c v)
        (let ((hit (find-first

                           (<= (first (first t)) r (second (first t)))
                           (<= (first (second t)) c (second (second t)))))

written_solution: gray(5) frame interior filled with 2x2 checkerboard of marker colors. Each marker at a corner determines diagonal quadrants via parity
program_solution:
(rule! (lambda (g)
  (let* ((h (rows g)) (w (cols g))
         ;; Positions of every gray(5) cell
         (gray-cells (find-color g 5))
         ;; Top edge of the gray bbox
         (fr1 (apply min (map first gray-cells)))
         ;; Left edge of the gray bbox
         (fc1 (apply min (map second gray-cells)))
         ;; Bottom edge of the gray bbox
         (fr2 (apply max (map first gray-cells)))
         ;; Right edge of the gray bbox
         (fc2 (apply max (map second gray-cells)))
         (ir1 (+ fr1 1)) (ic1 (+ fc1 1))
         (ir2 (- fr2 1)) (ic2 (- fc2 1))
         ;; Positions matching a per-cell condition
         (markers (for*/list ((r (range 0 h)) (c (range 0 w))
                    #:when (and (not (= (cell-at g r c) 0)) (not (= (cell-at g r c) 5))))
                   (list r c (cell-at g r c))))
         (m1 (first markers)) (m2 (second markers))
         (cr (quotient (+ fr1 fr2) 2))
         (cc (quotient (+ fc1 fc2) 2))
         (m1qr (if (< (first m1) cr) 0 1))
         (m1qc (if (< (second m1) cc) 0 1))
         (m1p (remainder (+ m1qr m1qc) 2))
         ;; Mutable lookup table for result
         (result (make-hash)))
    (for* ((r (range 0 h)) (c (range 0 w)))
      (hash-set! result (list r c) (cell-at g r c)))
    (let ((hmid (quotient (+ ir1 ir2) 2))
          (wmid (quotient (+ ic1 ic2) 2)))
      (for* ((r (range ir1 (+ ir2 1))) (c (range ic1 (+ ic2 1))))
        (let* ((qr (if (< r (+ hmid 1)) 0 1))
               (qc (if (< c (+ wmid 1)) 0 1))
               (p (remainder (+ qr qc) 2))
               (color (if (= p m1p) (third m1) (third m2))))
          (hash-set! result (list r c) color))))
    (grid-from-fn h w
      (lambda (r c) (hash-ref result (list r c) 0))))))

written_solution: local scattered-marker recolor cycle by 5x5 context
program_solution:
(rule! (lambda (g)
  ;; Scattered single-cell markers on orange (7). Their input colors are IRRELEVANT: the output
  ;; recolors them by cycling 2 -> 8 -> 5 along the markers' SPREAD axis — scanned row-major when
  ;; they span at least as many distinct rows as columns, else column-major.
  (let* ((ms (positions-of g (lambda (v) (!= v 7))))
         (nrows (length (unique (map first ms))))
         (ncols (length (unique (map second ms))))
         (row-major< (lambda (a b) (or (< (first a) (first b))
                                       (and (= (first a) (first b)) (< (second a) (second b))))))
         (col-major< (lambda (a b) (or (< (second a) (second b))
                                       (and (= (second a) (second b)) (< (first a) (first b))))))
         (order (sort ms (if (>= nrows ncols) row-major< col-major<)))
         (cycle (list 2 8 5)))
    (for/fold ((out g)) (((p i) (in-indexed order)))
      (set-cell out (first p) (second p) (list-ref cycle (modulo i 3)))))))

                (w (cols g)))

(rule!
 ;; A red(2) rectangle outline holds a few interior pixels; loose
 ;; EXTERIOR pixels shoot into the box along their row or column,
 ;; painting their color from just inside the near wall up to (but not
 ;; through) the first interior pixel — or the far wall.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define (row-span r)  ;; (left right) red walls of the row
       (let ((cs (filter (lambda (c) (= (at g r c) 2)) (range 0 w))))
         (and (>= (length cs) 2) (list (min-list cs) (max-list cs)))))
     (define (col-span c)
       (let ((rs (filter (lambda (r) (= (at g r c) 2)) (range 0 h))))
         (and (>= (length rs) 2) (list (min-list rs) (max-list rs)))))
     (define (pixel? r c)
       (let ((v (at g r c)))
         (and (not (= v 0)) (not (= v 2)))))
     (define (interior? r c)
       (let ((sp (row-span r)))
         (and sp (< (first sp) c) (< c (second sp)))))
     (define (interior-pixel? p)
       (and (pixel? (first p) (second p))
            (interior? (first p) (second p))))
     (define (ray from to step pos-of)  ;; stop at wall or a pixel
       (let loop ((x from) (acc (list)))
         (cond ((if (> step 0) (>= x to) (<= x to)) (reverse acc))
               ((interior-pixel? (pos-of x)) (reverse acc))
               (else (loop (+ x step) (cons (pos-of x) acc))))))
     (for/fold ((out g))
               ((p (filter (lambda (p)
                             (and (pixel? (first p) (second p))
                                  (not (interior? (first p)
                                                  (second p)))))
                           (grid-positions g))))
       (let* ((er (first p)) (ec (second p)) (ev (at g er ec))
              (cs (col-span ec))
              (rs (row-span er)))
         (cond (cs (cond ((< er (first cs))
                          (paint-cells out

  (let* ((h (rows g)) (w (cols g)) (bg (mode g -1))
         (body (mode-list (filter (lambda (v) (!= v bg)) (row g 0))))
         (cs (filter (lambda (c) (= (at g 0 c) body)) (range w)))
         (tip (find-first (lambda (v) (and (!= v bg) (!= v body)))
                          (map (lambda (c) (at g 2 c)) cs)))
         (gray (find-first
                (lambda (v) (and (!= v bg) (!= v body) (!= v tip)))
                (grid-colors g)))
         (ups (list)))
    (define (add r c v) (set! ups (cons (list r c v) ups)))
    (define (gray-rows c)
      (filter (lambda (r) (and (> r 2) (= (at g r c) gray))) (range h)))
    (for* ((c cs) (r (range 3))) (add r c bg))
    (for ((c cs))
      (let ((v (at g 2 c)) (hits (gray-rows c)))
        (if (= v tip)
            (let ((land (if (empty? hits) (- h 1) (- (first hits) 1))))
              (add (- land 2) c body)
              (add (- land 1) c body)
              (add land c tip))
            (let ((lc c))
              (when (and (not (empty? hits)) (>= (last hits) (- h 2)))
                (let* ((blob (connected-region
                              g (last hits) c
                              (lambda (r cc value) (= value gray)) 4))
                       (cnt (make-hash)))

                  (let* ((mx (apply max (hash-values cnt)))

                    (set! lc (argmin
                              (lambda (cc) (+ (* 1000 (abs (- cc c))) cc))

                      (let* ((r (first (first blob)))

                             (nl (count-where (lambda (cc) (< cc lc)) cols*))
                             (nr (count-where (lambda (cc) (> cc lc)) cols*))
                             (step (if (>= nr nl) 1 -1)))
                        (for ((k (range 1 (length cs))))

                                       (= (at g r cc) gray))
                              (add r cc bg)))))))))

(rule! (lambda (g)
  ;; A red (2) edge marker fires a stream into the grid (down from a top marker, right from a
  ;; left-edge marker). Each bar it lands on STEERS it by color: blue (1) deflects the stream to
  ;; its own LEFT hand, green (3) to its RIGHT; it slides past the bar's end and flows on. A
  ;; left-edge task is solved as its transpose — transposing mirrors chirality, so blue's step
  ;; flips sign.
  (define (flow gg blue-step)
    (let* ((h (rows gg)) (w (cols gg))
           (mk (first (find-color gg 2)))
           (free? (lambda (r c) (and (>= c 0) (< c w) (zero? (at gg r c))))))
      (let fall ((r (first mk)) (c (second mk)) (cells (list mk)))
        (cond ((= r (- h 1)) (recolor-cells gg cells 2))
              ((free? (+ r 1) c) (fall (+ r 1) c (cons (list (+ r 1) c) cells)))
              (else
               (let* ((step (if (= (at gg (+ r 1) c) 1) blue-step (- blue-step))))
                 (let slide ((cc (+ c step)) (acc cells))
                   (if (free? (+ r 1) cc)
                       (fall (+ r 1) cc (cons (list (+ r 1) cc) (cons (list r cc) acc)))
                       (slide (+ cc step) (cons (list r cc) acc))))))))))
  (let* ((mk (first (find-color g 2))))
    (if (and (zero? (second mk)) (!= (first mk) 0))
        (transpose (flow (transpose g) -1))
        (flow g 1)))))

                        ((r (range (obj-r1 obj) (+ (obj-r2 obj) 1)))
                         (c (range (obj-c1 obj) (+ (obj-c2 obj) 1))))

program_solution:
(rule!
 ;; The biggest multicolor object is a PLATE whose holes are rimmed in
 ;; red(2); loose KEY tiles elsewhere carry red teeth. For each hole
 ;; region, find a key rotation whose teeth plug it exactly — teeth on
 ;; empty cells, key body on the red rim — and stamp it: teeth turn
 ;; red where empty, body colors overwrite the rim. Output the plate.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define objs
       (sort-by (objects-multicolor g 0) (lambda (o) (- (obj-size o)))))
     (define plate (first objs))
     (define interior
       (subgrid g (obj-r1 plate) (obj-c1 plate)
                (obj-r2 plate) (obj-c2 plate)))
     (define ih (rows interior))
     (define iw (cols interior))
     (define (key-info kg)  ;; (grid teeth body-cells kh kw)
       (let* ((pos (grid-positions kg))
              (teeth (filter (lambda (p) (= (at kg (first p)
                                               (second p))
                                            2))
                             pos)))
         (list kg teeth
               (filter (lambda (p)
                         (let ((v (at kg (first p) (second p))))
                           (and (not (= v 2)) (not (= v 0)))))
                       pos)
               (rows kg) (cols kg))))
     (define oriented-keys
       (flatmap (lambda (obj)
                  (let ((kg (subgrid g (obj-r1 obj) (obj-c1 obj)
                                     (obj-r2 obj) (obj-c2 obj))))
                    (map key-info
                         (list kg (rotate-cw kg) (rotate-180 kg)
                               (rotate-ccw kg)))))
                (rest objs)))
     (define (match-for hole acc)  ;; (grid dr dc kh kw) plugging hole
       (let ((hsize (obj-size hole))
             (hr (min-of first (obj-cells hole)))
             (hc (min-of second (obj-cells hole))))
         (find-first
          (lambda (x) x)
          (map (lambda (ki)
                 (and (= (length (second ki)) hsize)
                      (let* ((dr (- hr (min-of first (second ki))))
                             (dc (- hc (min-of second (second ki))))
                             (ok? (lambda (cells want)
                                    (all? (lambda (rc)
                                            (let ((tr (+ (first rc) dr))
                                                  (tc (+ (second rc)
                                                         dc)))
                                              (and (in-bounds? tr tc
                                                               ih iw)
                                                   (= (at acc tr tc)
                                                      want))))
                                          cells))))
                        (and (ok? (second ki) 0)
                             (ok? (third ki) 2)
                             (list (first ki) dr dc (fourth ki)
                                   (nth ki 4))))))
               oriented-keys))))
     (for/fold ((acc interior))
               ((hole (in-list (objects-8 interior 2))))
       (let ((hit (match-for hole acc)))
         (if hit
             (let ((kg (first hit)) (dr (second hit)) (dc (third hit))
                   (kh (fourth hit)) (kw (nth hit 4)))
               (build-grid ih iw (r c)
                           (let ((kr (- r dr)) (kc (- c dc)))
                             (if (and (>= kr 0) (< kr kh)
                                      (>= kc 0) (< kc kw))
                                 (let ((kv (at kg kr kc)))
                                   (cond ((and (= kv 2)
                                               (zero? (at acc r c)))
                                          2)
                                         ((and (not (= kv 2))
                                               (not (= kv 0)))
                                          kv)
                                         (else (at acc r c))))
                                 (at acc r c)))))
             acc))))))

written_solution: Move the gray(5) marker to the selected endpoint of the nearest straight background/zero boundary run
program_solution:
(rule! (lambda (g)
  (define h (rows g))
  (define w (cols g))
  ;; Position of the first gray(5) cell
  (define marker (fst (find-color g 5)))
  (define mr (fst marker))
  (define mc (snd marker))
  (define (md p) (+ (abs (- (fst p) mr)) (abs (- (snd p) mc))))
  (define (bnd? r c)
    (and (in-bounds? r c h w)
         (= (at g r c) 7)
         (for/or ((d cardinal-deltas))
           (let ((nr (+ r (fst d))) (nc (+ c (snd d))))
             (and (in-bounds? nr nc h w) (= (at g nr nc) 0))))))
  (define (run-from r c dr dc)
    (let loop ((rr r) (cc c) (acc (list)))
      (if (bnd? rr cc)
        (loop (+ rr dr) (+ cc dc) (append acc (list (list rr cc))))
        acc)))
  (define dirs (list (list 0 1) (list 1 0) (list 1 1) (list 1 -1)))
  (define infos
    (apply append
      (map (lambda (d)
        (filter (lambda (info) (and (not (empty? info)) (>= (length (fst info)) 2)))
          (map (lambda (p)
            (let* ((r (fst p)) (c (snd p)) (dr (fst d)) (dc (snd d))
                   (pr (- r dr)) (pc (- c dc)))
              (if (and (bnd? r c) (not (bnd? pr pc)))
                (list (run-from r c dr dc) dr dc)
                (list))))
            (grid-positions g))))
        dirs)))
  (if (empty? infos) g
    (let* ((best (fst (sort infos (lambda (a b)
             (let ((da (min-list (map md (fst a)))) (db (min-list (map md (fst b)))))
               (if (= da db)
                 (> (length (fst a)) (length (fst b)))
                 (< da db)))))))
           (run (fst best))
           (dr (snd best))
           (dc (nth best 2))
           (ends (list (fst run) (nth run (- (length run) 1))))
           (dest (fst (sort ends (lambda (a b)
             (if (and (not (= dr 0)) (not (= dc 0)))
               (> (md a) (md b))
               (< (md a) (md b))))))))
      (set-cell (set-cell g mr mc 7) (fst dest) (snd dest) 5)))))

             (define (row-count r color)
               (for/sum ((c (range 0 w))) (if (= (at g r c) color) 1 0)))
             (define (row-mid-right r)
               (for/fold ((best -1))
                 ((c (range 0 w)))
                 (if (= (at g r c) mid-color) c best)))
             (define anchor-right
               (min-list (filter (lambda (v) (>= v 0)) (map row-mid-right (range 0 h)))))
             (cellmap g
                      (r c v)
                      (let* ((left-count (row-count r left-color))
                             (mid-count (row-count r mid-color))
                             (right-count (row-count r right-color))
                             (left-kept (min left-count
                                             (max 0 (- (+ anchor-right 1) mid-count))))
                             (mid-end (+ left-kept mid-count))
                             (left-spill (+ mid-end (- left-count left-kept))))
                        (cond
                          ((< c left-kept) left-color)
                          ((< c mid-end) mid-color)
                          ((< c left-spill) left-color)
                          (else right-color))))))))

written_solution: stretch each 3x3 motif toward the matching colored bar and repeat its center marker
program_solution:
(rule!
 ;; 3x3 motifs -- a solid ring of one color around a single center cell --
 ;; reach toward a partner: the nearest object of the CENTER color that
 ;; lies outside the motif but shares its row-band or column-band. The
 ;; ring color is painted as a 3-wide corridor from the motif to one cell
 ;; past the partner, and center-color dots repeat every 3rd cell along
 ;; the corridor's middle line (aligned with the motif center).
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define bg (mode-list (map third (grid-cells g))))
     (define (overlap? a1 a2 b1 b2) (<= (max a1 b1) (min a2 b2)))
     (define motifs  ;; (r c ring-color center-color), row-major scan
       (filter values
               (for*/list ((r (range (- h 2))) (c (range (- w 2))))
                 (let* ((ring (for*/list ((dr (range 3)) (dc (range 3))
                                          #:when (not (and (= dr 1) (= dc 1))))
                                (at g (+ r dr) (+ c dc))))
                        (o (first ring))
                        (center (at g (+ r 1) (+ c 1))))
                   (and (!= o bg) (!= center bg) (!= o center)
                        (all? (lambda (v) (= v o)) ring)
                        (list r c o center))))))
     (define (color-objects color)  ;; objects of one color on a bg canvas
       (objects (cellmap g (r c v) (if (= v color) color bg)) bg))
     (define (inside-motif? o mr mc)
       (all? (lambda (p) (and (>= (first p) mr) (<= (first p) (+ mr 2))
                              (>= (second p) mc) (<= (second p) (+ mc 2))))
             (obj-cells o)))
     (define (gap o mr mc)  ;; box distance from the motif's 3x3 box
       (+ (max 0 (- (obj-c1 o) (+ mc 2)) (- mc (obj-c2 o)))
          (max 0 (- (obj-r1 o) (+ mr 2)) (- mr (obj-r2 o)))))
     (define (best-object color mr mc)  ;; nearest banded partner, or #f
       (let ((cands (filter (lambda (o)
                              (and (not (inside-motif? o mr mc))
                                   (or (overlap? (obj-r1 o) (obj-r2 o)
                                                 mr (+ mr 2))
                                       (overlap? (obj-c1 o) (obj-c2 o)
                                                 mc (+ mc 2)))))
                            (color-objects color))))
         (and (not (null? cands))
              (first (sort cands
                           (lambda (a b)
                             (cond ((not (= (gap a mr mc) (gap b mr mc)))
                                    (< (gap a mr mc) (gap b mr mc)))
                                   ((not (= (obj-r1 a) (obj-r1 b)))
                                    (< (obj-r1 a) (obj-r1 b)))
                                   (else (< (obj-c1 a) (obj-c1 b))))))))))
     (define (paint-h out mr mc ring center o)  ;; corridor along the row band
       (let* ((start (if (< (obj-c2 o) mc) (max 0 (- (obj-c2 o) 1)) mc))
              (end (if (> (obj-c1 o) (+ mc 2))
                       (min (- w 1) (+ (obj-c1 o) 1))
                       (+ mc 2)))
              (band (for*/fold ((gg out)) ((r (range mr (+ mr 3)))
                                           (c (range start (+ end 1))))
                      (set-cell gg r c ring))))
         (for/fold ((gg band)) ((c (range start (+ end 1))))
           (if (zero? (modulo (- c (+ mc 1)) 3))
               (set-cell gg (+ mr 1) c center)
               gg))))
     (define (paint-v out mr mc ring center o)  ;; corridor along the col band
       (let* ((start (if (< (obj-r2 o) mr) (max 0 (- (obj-r2 o) 1)) mr))
              (end (if (> (obj-r1 o) (+ mr 2))
                       (min (- h 1) (+ (obj-r1 o) 1))
                       (+ mr 2)))
              (band (for*/fold ((gg out)) ((r (range start (+ end 1)))
                                           (c (range mc (+ mc 3))))
                      (set-cell gg r c ring))))
         (for/fold ((gg band)) ((r (range start (+ end 1))))
           (if (zero? (modulo (- r (+ mr 1)) 3))
               (set-cell gg r (+ mc 1) center)
               gg))))
     (for/fold ((out g)) ((m motifs))
       (let* ((mr (first m)) (mc (second m))
              (ring (third m)) (center (fourth m))
              (o (best-object center mr mc)))
         (cond ((not o) out)
               ((overlap? (obj-r1 o) (obj-r2 o) mr (+ mr 2))
                (paint-h out mr mc ring center o))
               (else (paint-v out mr mc ring center o))))))))

written_solution: clear source motif and draw each marker color's fixed line glyph on its marker row
program_solution:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (begin
             (define border (at g 0 0))
             (define base
               (cellmap g (r c v) (if (or (zero? c) (= c (- w 1))) border 0)))
             (define (row-color-count r color)
               (count-if (lambda (c) (= (at g r c) color)) (range 1 (- w 1))))
             (define markers
               (filter identity
                       (for/list ((r (range 0 h)))
                         (let ((color (at g r 1)))
                           (and
                             (and
                               (!= color 0)
                               (!= color border)
                               (= (at g r (- w 2)) color)
                               (= (row-color-count r color) 2))
                             (list r color))))))
             (define (put gg r c v) (if (in-bounds? r c h w) (set-cell gg r c v) gg))
             (define (line-cell? color c)
               (and
                 (>= c 1)
                 (< c (- w 1))
                 (not (and (= color 6) (= c 3)))
                 (not (and (= color 3) (>= c 4) (<= c 6)))))
             (define (paint-line gg r color)
               (for/fold ((out gg))
                 ((c (range 1 (- w 1))))
                 (if (line-cell? color c) (put out r c color) out)))
             (define (offsets color)
               (cond
                 ((= color 6) (list (list -2 2)
                         (list -2 3)
                         (list -2 4)
                         (list -1 2)
                         (list -1 4)
                         (list 1 2)
                         (list 1 4)
                         (list 2 2)
                         (list 2 4)
                         (list 3 2)
                         (list 3 3)
                         (list 3 4)))
                 ((= color 7) (list (list -2 13)
                         (list -2 15)
                         (list -1 13)
                         (list -1 15)
                         (list 1 13)
                         (list 1 15)
                         (list 2 13)
                         (list 2 15)))
                 ((= color 2) (list (list -2 6)
                         (list -2 8)
                         (list -1 7)
                         (list 1 7)
                         (list 2 6)
                         (list 2 8)))
                 ((= color 1) (list (list -1 14) (list -1 16) (list 1 14) (list 1 16)))
                 ((= color 3) (list (list -2 5)
                         (list -1 4)
                         (list -1 6)
                         (list 1 4)
                         (list 1 6)
                         (list 2 5)))
                 (else (list))))
             (for/fold ((out base))
               ((marker markers))
               (let* ((r (first marker))
                      (color (second marker))
                      (with-line (paint-line out r color)))
                 (for/fold ((gg with-line))
                   ((off (offsets color)))
                   (put gg (+ r (first off)) (second off) color))))))))

written_solution: remove tail from connected shape, slide body until touching the other rectangle
program_solution:
(rule!
 ;; Two objects: a solid rectangle WALL and a creature made of a solid
 ;; BODY with a tail sticking out one side. The tail points AWAY from
 ;; travel: the body slides toward the wall until flush against it, and
 ;; the tail is consumed. Background elsewhere unchanged.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define objs (objects g 0))
     (define wall (find-first solid-rect? objs))
     (define creature
       (find-first (lambda (o) (not (solid-rect? o))) objs))
     (define cells (obj-cells creature))
     (define body  ;; largest solid rectangle inside the creature
       (rest
        (for*/fold ((best (list 0 0 0 0 0)))
                   ((r1 (range (obj-r1 creature)
                               (+ (obj-r2 creature) 1)))
                    (r2 (range (obj-r1 creature)
                               (+ (obj-r2 creature) 1)))
                    (c1 (range (obj-c1 creature)
                               (+ (obj-c2 creature) 1)))
                    (c2 (range (obj-c1 creature)
                               (+ (obj-c2 creature) 1))))
          (if (and (<= r1 r2) (<= c1 c2)
                   (> (* (+ 1 (- r2 r1)) (+ 1 (- c2 c1))) (first best))
                   (all? (lambda (p) (member p cells))
                         (positions-in-rect r1 c1 r2 c2)))
              (list (* (+ 1 (- r2 r1)) (+ 1 (- c2 c1))) r1 r2 c1 c2)
              best))))
     (define br1 (first body))
     (define br2 (second body))
     (define bc1 (third body))
     (define bc2 (fourth body))
     (define tail  ;; creature cells outside the body rect
       (filter (lambda (p) (not (and (>= (first p) br1)
                                     (<= (first p) br2)
                                     (>= (second p) bc1)
                                     (<= (second p) bc2))))
               cells))
     (define dr (cond ((any? (lambda (p) (< (first p) br1)) tail) -1)
                      ((any? (lambda (p) (> (first p) br2)) tail) 1)
                      (else 0)))
     (define dc (cond ((any? (lambda (p) (< (second p) bc1)) tail) -1)
                      ((any? (lambda (p) (> (second p) bc2)) tail) 1)
                      (else 0)))
     (define steps  ;; distance until flush against the wall
       (cond ((> dc 0) (- (obj-c1 wall) 1 bc2))
             ((< dc 0) (- bc1 (+ (obj-c2 wall) 1)))
             ((> dr 0) (- (obj-r1 wall) 1 br2))
             ((< dr 0) (- br1 (+ (obj-r2 wall) 1)))
             (else 0)))
     (paint-cells (erase-cells g cells 0)
                  (positions-in-rect (+ br1 (* dr steps))
                                     (+ bc1 (* dc steps))
                                     (+ br2 (* dr steps))
                                     (+ bc2 (* dc steps)))
                  (obj-color creature)))))

written_solution: Draw path from red(2) to blue(1): 1 diagonal, then straights in dominant direction, then diagonals to end
program_solution:
(rule! (lambda (g)
  (let* ((h (rows g))
         (w (cols g))
         ;; Locate the unique red source endpoint.
         (red-pos
          (let loop ((r 0) (c 0))
            (cond
              ((>= r h) #f)
              ((>= c w) (loop (+ r 1) 0))
              ((= (at g r c) 2) (list r c))
              (else (loop r (+ c 1))))))
         ;; Locate the unique blue destination endpoint.
         (blue-pos
          (let loop ((r 0) (c 0))
            (cond
              ((>= r h) #f)
              ((>= c w) (loop (+ r 1) 0))
              ((= (at g r c) 1) (list r c))
              (else (loop r (+ c 1))))))
         (rr (first red-pos))
         (rc (second red-pos))
         (br (first blue-pos))
         (bc (second blue-pos))
         ;; Unit signs point from red toward blue.
         (drow (if (> br rr) 1 -1))
         (dcol (if (> bc rc) 1 -1))
         (dr-abs (abs (- br rr)))
         (dc-abs (abs (- bc rc)))
         (max-d (if (> dr-abs dc-abs) dr-abs dc-abs))
         ;; The gap difference is the dominant-axis middle phase length.
         (straights (- max-d (if (> dr-abs dc-abs) dc-abs dr-abs)))
         (is-vert (> dr-abs dc-abs))
         ;; Build interior cells in order: one diagonal, dominant-axis
         ;; straights, then the remaining diagonals into blue.
         (path-cells
          (let loop ((step 1) (cur-r rr) (cur-c rc) (acc (list)))
            (cond
              ((>= step max-d) (reverse acc))
              (else
               (let* ((new-r-c
                       (cond
                         ;; Phase 1: the mandatory first diagonal.
                         ((= step 1) (list (+ cur-r drow) (+ cur-c dcol)))
                         ;; Phase 2: contiguous dominant-axis steps.
                         ((<= step (+ 1 straights))
                          (if is-vert
                              (list (+ cur-r drow) cur-c)
                              (list cur-r (+ cur-c dcol))))
                         ;; Phase 3: trailing diagonals.
                         (else (list (+ cur-r drow) (+ cur-c dcol)))))
                      (nr (first new-r-c))
                      (nc (second new-r-c)))
                 (loop (+ step 1) nr nc (cons (list nr nc) acc))))))))
    ;; Paint only path interiors green; keep both endpoint colors unchanged.
    (for/fold ((out g)) ((cell path-cells))
      (set-cell out (first cell) (second cell) 3)))))

program_solution:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((sec (lambda (si)
                         (flatmap (lambda (r)
                                    (map (lambda (c) (at g r (+ (* si 5) c)))
                                         (range 0 4)))
                                  (range 0 h))))
                  (classify (lambda (si)
                              (let* ((cells (sec si))
                                     (zeros (filter (lambda (i) (zero? (nth cells i)))
                                                    (range 0 (length cells)))))
                                (if (zero? (length zeros))
                                    2
                                    (let* ((zero-cols (map (lambda (i) (mod i 4)) zeros))
                                           (ucols (unique zero-cols)))
                                      (cond
                                        ((= ucols (list 1 2)) (let ((zero-rows (map (lambda (i) (/ i 4))
                                                                zeros)))
                                            (if (and
                                                  (find (lambda (r) (= r 1)) zero-rows)
                                                  (find (lambda (r) (= r 2)) zero-rows)
                                                  (not (find (lambda (r) (zero? r))
                                                             zero-rows))
                                                  (not (find (lambda (r) (= r 3))
                                                             zero-rows)))
                                                8
                                                4)))
                                        ((= ucols (list 0 3)) 3)
                                        (else 2))))))))
             (build-grid 3 3 (r c) (classify r))))))

written_solution: Each creature (4-center body + 1-tail): rotate body 180, translate opposite to tail until front edge hits wall
program_solution:
(rule!
 ;; Creatures: a yellow(4) heart with four colored petals and a blue(1)
 ;; tail rooted two cells out. Each creature flies flush to the wall
 ;; OPPOSITE its tail direction and turns around — petals swap across
 ;; the heart (up<->down, left<->right) — with the tail riding along.
 ;; Vacated cells refill with the cyan(8) background.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define bg 8)
     (define (creature center)
       (let* ((cr (first center)) (cc (second center))
              (dir (cond ((and (in-bounds? (- cr 2) cc h w)
                               (= (at g (- cr 2) cc) 1)) 'up)
                         ((and (in-bounds? (+ cr 2) cc h w)
                               (= (at g (+ cr 2) cc) 1)) 'down)
                         ((and (in-bounds? cr (- cc 2) h w)
                               (= (at g cr (- cc 2)) 1)) 'left)
                         ((and (in-bounds? cr (+ cc 2) h w)
                               (= (at g cr (+ cc 2)) 1)) 'right)
                         (else 'none)))
              (seed (cond ((eq? dir 'up) (list (- cr 2) cc))
                          ((eq? dir 'down) (list (+ cr 2) cc))
                          ((eq? dir 'left) (list cr (- cc 2)))
                          ((eq? dir 'right) (list cr (+ cc 2)))
                          (else (list cr cc))))
              (tail (connected-region g (first seed) (second seed)
                                      (lambda (r c v) (= v 1)) 8))
              (body (list (list cr cc) (list (- cr 1) cc)
                          (list (+ cr 1) cc) (list cr (- cc 1))
                          (list cr (+ cc 1))))
              (bb (bbox-of-cells (append body tail)))
              (dr (cond ((eq? dir 'down) (- 0 (first bb)))
                        ((eq? dir 'up) (- (- h 1) (third bb)))
                        (else 0)))
              (dc (cond ((eq? dir 'right) (- 0 (second bb)))
                        ((eq? dir 'left) (- (- w 1) (fourth bb)))
                        (else 0))))
         (list (append body tail)
               ;; petals mirror across the heart: the creature turns
               (list (list (+ cr dr) (+ cc dc) 4)
                     (list (+ cr dr -1) (+ cc dc) (cell-down g cr cc))
                     (list (+ cr dr 1) (+ cc dc) (cell-up g cr cc))
                     (list (+ cr dr) (+ cc dc -1) (cell-right g cr cc))
                     (list (+ cr dr) (+ cc dc 1) (cell-left g cr cc)))
               (map (lambda (p) (list (+ (first p) dr)
                                      (+ (second p) dc)))
                    tail))))
     (define creatures
       (map creature
            (filter (lambda (p) (= (at g (first p) (second p)) 4))
                    (grid-positions g))))
     (for/fold ((out (erase-cells g (flatmap first creatures) bg)))
               ((c (in-list creatures)))
       (paint-cells (paint-cells out (third c) 1) (second c))))))

written_solution: chain-replicate template shape per marker with gap-spacing
program_solution:
(rule!
 ;; The largest object is a TEMPLATE; the loose dots (one shares its
 ;; color — the anchor) list stamp colors along a row or column. Stamp
 ;; one template copy per dot in that dot's color, chained from the
 ;; anchor edge-to-edge with the dots' own gaps as spacing.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define objs (sort (objects-8 g 0)
                        (lambda (a b) (> (obj-size a) (obj-size b)))))
     (define template (first objs))
     (define t-r1 (obj-r1 template))
     (define t-c1 (obj-c1 template))
     (define t-h (obj-h template))
     (define t-w (obj-w template))
     (define pattern (normalize-cells (obj-cells template)))
     (define raw-ms  ;; (color r c) per dot
       (map (lambda (m)
              (let ((c (first (obj-cells m))))
                (list (obj-color m) (first c) (second c))))
            (rest objs)))
     (define horiz?
       (= 1 (length (remove-duplicates (map second raw-ms)))))
     (define ms
       (sort raw-ms (lambda (a b) (if horiz?
                                      (< (third a) (third b))
                                      (< (second a) (second b))))))
     (define n (length ms))
     (define anchor
       (find-first (lambda (i) (= (first (nth ms i))
                                  (obj-color template)))
                   (range 0 n)))
     (define (gap i j)
       (if horiz?
           (- (third (nth ms i)) (third (nth ms j)))
           (- (second (nth ms i)) (second (nth ms j)))))
     (define positions  ;; template corner per dot, chained from anchor
       (let ((fwd (let loop ((i (+ anchor 1)) (prev (list t-r1 t-c1))
                             (acc (list)))
                    (if (>= i n)
                        (reverse acc)
                        (let ((pos (if horiz?
                                       (list t-r1
                                             (+ (second prev) t-w -1
                                                (gap i (- i 1))))
                                       (list (+ (first prev) t-h -1
                                                (gap i (- i 1)))
                                             t-c1))))
                          (loop (+ i 1) pos (cons pos acc))))))
             (bwd (let loop ((i (- anchor 1)) (next (list t-r1 t-c1))
                             (acc (list)))
                    (if (< i 0)
                        acc
                        (let ((pos (if horiz?
                                       (list t-r1
                                             (+ (- (second next)
                                                   (gap (+ i 1) i)
                                                   t-w)
                                                1))
                                       (list (+ (- (first next)
                                                   (gap (+ i 1) i)
                                                   t-h)
                                                1)
                                             t-c1))))
                          (loop (- i 1) pos (cons pos acc)))))))
         (append bwd (list (list t-r1 t-c1)) fwd)))
     (for/fold ((out g)) ((i (range 0 n)))
       (if (= i anchor)
           out
           (paint-cells out
                        (map (lambda (p)
                               (list (+ (first (nth positions i))
                                        (first p))
                                     (+ (second (nth positions i))
                                        (second p))))
                             pattern)
                        (first (nth ms i))))))))

             (let ((h-split (let loop
                                 ((r 1))
                                 (if (>= r h)
                                     #f
                                     (let ((curr (let lp
                                                      ((c 0))
                                                      (if (!= (at g r c) 2)
                                                          (at g r c)
                                                          (lp (+ c 1))))))
                                       (if (!= tl curr) r (loop (+ r 1)))))))
                   (v-split (let loop
                                 ((c 1))
                                 (if (>= c w)
                                     #f
                                     (let ((curr (let lp
                                                      ((r 0))
                                                      (if (!= (at g r c) 2)
                                                          (at g r c)
                                                          (lp (+ r 1))))))
                                       (if (!= tl curr) c (loop (+ c 1))))))))
               (define (bg-of r c)
                 (if h-split
                     (if (< r h-split) tl (if (= tl 8) 1 8))
                     (if (< c v-split) tl (if (= tl 8) 1 8))))
               (define (rc1 r c) (if v-split (if (< c v-split) 0 v-split) 0))
               (define (rc2 r c) (if v-split (if (< c v-split) v-split w) w))
               (define (red-count r reg-c1 reg-c2)
                 (let loop
                      ((c reg-c1) (cnt 0))
                      (if (>= c reg-c2)
                          cnt
                          (loop (+ c 1) (if (= (at g r c) 2) (+ cnt 1) cnt)))))
               (cellmap g
                        (r c v)
                        (let* ((bg (bg-of r c))
                               (c1 (rc1 r c))
                               (c2 (rc2 r c))
                               (cnt (red-count r c1 c2)))

                              bg
                              (if (= bg 8)
                                  (if (< c (+ c1 cnt)) 2 bg)
                                  (if (>= c (- c2 cnt)) 2 bg))))))))))

(rule!
  ;; Two containers (bg colors BG1/BG2) each hold a blob of the same inner
  ;; color IN, decorated with 2-cell TABS (IN protrusions or bg dents). A
  ;; tab's TIP is a cell with four in-bounds neighbors splitting 3-vs-1
  ;; between two colors, itself carrying the minority color; its partner is
  ;; the single like-colored neighbor, fully surrounded by that color. Every
  ;; tab is repainted with the OTHER container's background.
  (lambda (g)
    (let* ((h (rows g))
           (w (cols g))
           (nbrs (lambda (r c)
                   (filter (lambda (p) (in-bounds? (first p) (second p) h w))
                           (map (lambda (d) (list (+ r (first d)) (+ c (second d))))
                                cardinal-deltas))))
           (vals (lambda (ps) (map (lambda (p) (at g (first p) (second p))) ps)))
           (tip-at
             (lambda (p)
               (let* ((r (first p))
                      (c (second p))
                      (vs (vals (nbrs r c))))
                 (if (!= 4 (length vs))
                     (list)
                     (let ((uniq (unique vs)))
                       (if (!= 2 (length uniq))
                           (list)
                           (let* ((x (first uniq))
                                  (y (second uniq))
                                  (cx (count-if (lambda (v) (= v x)) vs))
                                  (a (if (= cx 3) x y))
                                  (b (if (= cx 3) y x)))
                             (if (or (and (!= cx 1) (!= cx 3)) (!= (at g r c) b))
                                 (list)
                                 (let ((partner (find-first
                                                  (lambda (q) (= (at g (first q) (second q)) b))
                                                  (nbrs r c))))
                                   (if (and partner
                                            (all? (lambda (v) (= v b))
                                                  (vals (nbrs (first partner) (second partner)))))
                                       (list (list r c a b partner))
                                       (list)))))))))))
           (tips (flatmap tip-at (grid-positions g)))
           (pairs (map (lambda (t) (list (third t) (fourth t))) tips))
           (colors (unique (flatmap (lambda (pr) pr) pairs)))
           (inner (find-first (lambda (col) (all? (lambda (pr) (member col pr)) pairs))
                              colors))
           (bgs (filter (lambda (col) (!= col inner)) colors)))
      (if (or (null? tips) (not inner) (!= 2 (length bgs)))
          g
          (reduce
            (lambda (acc t)
              (let* ((pr (list (third t) (fourth t))))
                (if (not (member inner pr))
                    acc
                    (let* ((own-bg (if (= (third t) inner) (fourth t) (third t)))
                           (other (find-first (lambda (col) (!= col own-bg)) bgs))
                           (partner (fifth t)))
                      (set-cell (set-cell acc (first t) (second t) other)
                                (first partner) (second partner) other)))))
            g
            tips)))))

written_solution: 4 icons + checkerboard + dots; answer = icon adjacent to most-common dot color
program_solution:
(rule!
 ;; 3x3 ICONS (uniform ring around a distinct center) and 3x3
 ;; checkerboard decoys float among scattered dots. The most common
 ;; dot color VOTES: output the icon that such a dot touches, rebuilt
 ;; as its clean 3x3.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define flat (apply append g))
     (define bg
       (pick-max (remove-duplicates flat)
                 (lambda (c) (count-if (lambda (x) (= x c)) flat))))
     (define icons  ;; (r c ring-color center-color)
       (filter (lambda (x) x)
               (for*/list ((r (range 0 (- h 2))) (c (range 0 (- w 2))))
                 (let ((ring (map (lambda (d) (at g (+ r (first d))
                                                  (+ c (second d))))
                                  (list (list 0 0) (list 0 1)
                                        (list 0 2) (list 1 0)
                                        (list 1 2) (list 2 0)
                                        (list 2 1) (list 2 2))))
                       (ctr (at g (+ r 1) (+ c 1))))
                   (and (not (= (first ring) bg))
                        (not (= ctr bg))
                        (not (= ctr (first ring)))
                        (all? (lambda (v) (= v (first ring))) ring)
                        (list r c (first ring) ctr))))))
     (define checkers
       (filter (lambda (x) x)
               (for*/list ((r (range 0 (- h 2))) (c (range 0 (- w 2))))
                 (let ((a (at g r c)) (b (at g r (+ c 1))))
                   (and (not (= a bg)) (not (= b bg)) (not (= a b))
                        (= (at g r (+ c 2)) a)
                        (= (at g (+ r 1) c) b)
                        (= (at g (+ r 1) (+ c 1)) a)
                        (= (at g (+ r 1) (+ c 2)) b)
                        (= (at g (+ r 2) c) a)
                        (= (at g (+ r 2) (+ c 1)) b)
                        (= (at g (+ r 2) (+ c 2)) a)
                        (list r c))))))
     (define special  ;; every cell inside a detected 3x3 block
       (flatmap (lambda (blk)
                  (for*/list ((dr (range 0 3)) (dc (range 0 3)))
                    (list (+ (first blk) dr) (+ (second blk) dc))))
                (append icons checkers)))
     (define dots
       (filter (lambda (p)
                 (and (not (= (at g (first p) (second p)) bg))
                      (not (member p special))))
               (grid-positions g)))
     (define mc  ;; the majority dot color
       (pick-max (remove-duplicates
                  (map (lambda (p) (at g (first p) (second p))) dots))
                 (lambda (v) (count-if (lambda (p)
                                         (= (at g (first p) (second p))
                                            v))
                                       dots))))
     (define hit
       (find (lambda (ic)
               (any? (lambda (p)
                       (any? (lambda (d)
                               (let ((nr (+ (first p) (first d)))
                                     (nc (+ (second p) (second d))))
                                 (and (in-bounds? nr nc h w)
                                      (not (member (list nr nc)
                                                   special))
                                      (= (at g nr nc) mc))))
                             cardinal-deltas))
                     (for*/list ((dr (range 0 3)) (dc (range 0 3)))
                       (list (+ (first ic) dr) (+ (second ic) dc)))))
             icons))
     (let ((b (third hit)) (ctr (fourth hit)))
       (list (list b b b) (list b ctr b) (list b b b))))))

written_solution: mirror yellow(4) shape; direction from 6 shape orientation (square=horizontal, wide=vertical), side away from 6 if fits
program_solution:
(rule!
 ;; A yellow(4) shape and a magenta(6) bar. Mirror the shape across its
 ;; own bbox edge on the side AWAY from the bar (falling back to the
 ;; near side when the reflection would leave the grid); the bar
 ;; disappears. A vertical bar mirrors horizontally — handled by
 ;; transposing in and out.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define (solve gg)  ;; horizontal bar: mirror across a row edge
       (let* ((yellow (find-color gg 4))
              (yb (bbox-of-cells yellow))
              (ry1 (first yb))
              (ry2 (third yb))
              (six-below (> (first (bbox-of-cells (find-color gg 6)))
                            ry2))
              (up (lambda (r) (- (- (* 2 ry1) 1) r)))
              (down (lambda (r) (- (+ (* 2 ry2) 1) r)))
              (fits? (lambda (mirror)
                       (all? (lambda (p)
                               (let ((nr (mirror (first p))))
                                 (and (>= nr 0) (< nr (rows gg)))))
                             yellow)))
              (mirror (cond ((and six-below (fits? up)) up)
                            (six-below down)
                            ((fits? down) down)
                            (else up))))
         (for/fold ((out (cellmap gg (r c v) (if (= 4 v) 4 0))))
                   ((p yellow))
           (let ((nr (mirror (first p))))
             (if (and (>= nr 0) (< nr (rows gg)))
                 (set-cell out nr (second p) 4)
                 out)))))
     (define sb (bbox-of-cells (find-color g 6)))
     (if (> (- (fourth sb) (second sb)) (- (third sb) (first sb)))
         (solve g)
         (transpose (solve (transpose g)))))))

written_solution: each 5-line + adjacent seed defines rectangle, fill by tiling seed
program_solution:
(rule!
 ;; Each gray(5) line has a decorated pattern hugging one side. The
 ;; pattern (its 4-connected non-gray region) tiles periodically along
 ;; the line's full span, repeating its own bbox as the unit cell.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define (pattern? r c)
       (and (in-bounds? r c h w)
            (let ((v (at g r c)))
              (and (> v 0) (not (= v 5))))))
     (define (tile-line out line)
       (let* ((r1 (obj-r1 line)) (c1 (obj-c1 line))
              (r2 (obj-r2 line)) (c2 (obj-c2 line))
              (horiz (= r1 r2))
              (seeds  ;; pattern cells on the side the pattern hugs
               (if horiz
                   (let ((sr (find-first
                              (lambda (sr)
                                (any? (lambda (c) (pattern? sr c))
                                      (range c1 (+ c2 1))))
                              (list (+ r1 1) (- r1 1)))))
                     (filter (lambda (p) (pattern? (first p) (second p)))
                             (map (lambda (c) (list sr c))
                                  (range c1 (+ c2 1)))))
                   (let ((sc (find-first
                              (lambda (sc)
                                (any? (lambda (r) (pattern? r sc))
                                      (range r1 (+ r2 1))))
                              (list (+ c1 1) (- c1 1)))))
                     (filter (lambda (p) (pattern? (first p) (second p)))
                             (map (lambda (r) (list r sc))
                                  (range r1 (+ r2 1)))))))
              (region (remove-duplicates
                       (flatmap (lambda (p)
                                  (connected-region
                                   g (first p) (second p)
                                   (lambda (r c v)
                                     (and (> v 0) (not (= v 5))))
                                   4))
                                seeds)))
              (sb (bbox-of-cells region))
              (sh (+ 1 (- (third sb) (first sb))))
              (sw (+ 1 (- (fourth sb) (second sb))))
              (rect (if horiz
                        (list (first sb) c1 (third sb) c2)
                        (list r1 (second sb) r2 (fourth sb)))))
         (paint-cells
          out
          (map (lambda (p)
                 (list (first p) (second p)
                       (at g
                           (+ (first sb)
                              (mod (- (first p) (first sb)) sh))
                           (+ (second sb)
                              (mod (- (second p) (second sb)) sw)))))
               (positions-in-rect (first rect) (second rect)
                                  (third rect) (fourth rect))))))
     (reduce tile-line g
             (filter (lambda (o) (= 5 (obj-color o))) (objects g 0))))))

written_solution: complete 3x3 red(2) fragments into boxes with yellow(4) centers and purple fill
program_solution:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (begin
             (define (rect-cells r c) (positions-in-rect r c (+ r 2) (+ c 2)))
             (define (all-2-or-5? cells)
               (for/and ((p cells))
                        (let ((v (at g (first p) (second p)))) (or (= v 2) (= v 5)))))
             (define candidates
               (sort (filter identity
                             (for*/list ((r (range 0 (- h 2))) (c (range 0 (- w 2))))
                               (let* ((cells (rect-cells r c))
                                      (covered-twos (filter (lambda (p)
                                                              (= (at g
                                                                     (first p)
                                                                     (second p))
                                                                 2))
                                                            cells)))
                                 (and
                                   (and
                                     (not (empty? covered-twos))
                                     (= (at g (+ r 1) (+ c 1)) 5)
                                     (all-2-or-5? cells))
                                   (list r c cells covered-twos (length covered-twos))))))
                     (lambda (a b)
                       (let ((ca (fifth a))
                             (cb (fifth b)))
                         (or
                           (> ca cb)
                           (and
                             (= ca cb)
                             (or
                               (< (first a) (first b))
                               (and (= (first a) (first b)) (< (second a) (second b))))))))))
             (define selected
               (let loop
                    ((cs candidates) (covered (list)) (sel (list)))
                    (if (empty? cs)
                        (reverse sel)
                        (let* ((cand (first cs))
                               (ctwos (fourth cand))
                               (overlap? (for/or ((p ctwos)) (member p covered))))
                          (if overlap?

(rule!
 ;; A small MOVER faces a wider solid WALL (nearest such pair wins,
 ;; bigger wall on ties). The mover teleports through: a doorway its
 ;; own width is cut through the wall, the wall grows sideways by half
 ;; the mover's size (at least 1), and the mover reappears flush on the
 ;; far side (or tucked inside when the wall hugs the grid edge).
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define bg
       (mode-list (for*/list ((r (range 0 h)) (c (range 0 w)))
                    (at g r c))))
     (define objs (objects g bg))
     (define (overlap? a1 a2 b1 b2) (and (<= a1 b2) (<= b1 a2)))
     (define (put gg r c v)
       (if (in-bounds? r c h w) (set-cell gg r c v) gg))
     (define candidates  ;; (gap wall-size dir mover wall)
       (filter (lambda (x) x)
               (for*/list ((m objs) (t objs) #:when (not (eq? m t)))
                 (and (solid-rect? t)
                      (cond ((and (> (obj-r1 t) (obj-r2 m))
                                  (overlap? (obj-c1 m) (obj-c2 m)
                                            (obj-c1 t) (obj-c2 t))
                                  (> (obj-w t) (obj-w m)))
                             (list (- (obj-r1 t) (obj-r2 m) 1)
                                   (obj-size t) 'down m t))
                            ((and (> (obj-r1 m) (obj-r2 t))
                                  (overlap? (obj-c1 m) (obj-c2 m)
                                            (obj-c1 t) (obj-c2 t))
                                  (> (obj-w t) (obj-w m)))
                             (list (- (obj-r1 m) (obj-r2 t) 1)
                                   (obj-size t) 'up m t))
                            ((and (> (obj-c1 t) (obj-c2 m))
                                  (overlap? (obj-r1 m) (obj-r2 m)
                                            (obj-r1 t) (obj-r2 t))
                                  (> (obj-h t) (obj-h m)))
                             (list (- (obj-c1 t) (obj-c2 m) 1)
                                   (obj-size t) 'right m t))
                            ((and (> (obj-c1 m) (obj-c2 t))
                                  (overlap? (obj-r1 m) (obj-r2 m)
                                            (obj-r1 t) (obj-r2 t))
                                  (> (obj-h t) (obj-h m)))
                             (list (- (obj-c1 m) (obj-c2 t) 1)
                                   (obj-size t) 'left m t))
                            (else #f))))))
     (define ranked
       (sort candidates
             (lambda (a b) (cond ((< (first a) (first b)) #t)
                                 ((> (first a) (first b)) #f)
                                 (else (> (second a) (second b)))))))
     (if (null? ranked)
         g
         (let* ((cand (first ranked))
                (dir (third cand))
                (m (fourth cand))
                (t (fifth cand))
                (m-cells (map (lambda (p)
                                (list (first p) (second p)
                                      (at g (first p) (second p))))
                              (obj-cells m)))
                (pad-v (max 1 (quotient (obj-w m) 2)))
                (pad-h (max 1 (quotient (obj-h m) 2)))
                (cleared (paint-cells g (obj-cells m) bg))
                (paint-mover
                 (lambda (gg dr dc)
                   (for/fold ((out gg)) ((cv m-cells))
                     (put out (+ dr (- (first cv) (obj-r1 m)))
                          (+ dc (- (second cv) (obj-c1 m)))
                          (third cv))))))
           (if (member? dir (list 'down 'up))
               (let* ((cut  ;; doorway through the wall, mover-wide
                       (for*/fold ((out cleared))
                                  ((r (range (obj-r1 t)
                                             (+ (obj-r2 t) 1)))
                                   (c (range (obj-c1 m)
                                             (+ (obj-c2 m) 1))))

                      (grown  ;; wall widens by pad-v on both flanks
                       (for*/fold ((out cut))
                                  ((r (range (obj-r1 t)
                                             (+ (obj-r2 t) 1)))
                                   (d (range 1 (+ pad-v 1))))
                         (put (put out r (- (obj-c1 t) d)
                                   (obj-color t))
                              r (+ (obj-c2 t) d) (obj-color t))))
                      (dest-r (if (eq? dir 'up)
                                  (max 0 (- (obj-r1 t) (obj-h m)))
                                  (if (= (obj-r2 t) (- h 1))
                                      (+ (- (obj-r2 t) (obj-h m)) 1)
                                      (+ (obj-r2 t) 1)))))
                 (paint-mover grown dest-r (obj-c1 m)))
               (let* ((cut
                       (for*/fold ((out cleared))

                                             (+ (obj-r2 m) 1)))
                                   (c (range (obj-c1 t)

(rule! (lambda (g)
	  (let* ((h (rows g))

	         (bg (mode g))
	         (objs (objects g bg))
	         (bounded (lambda (cells)
	                    (filter (lambda (p) (in-bounds? (first p) (second p) h w)) cells)))
	         ;; Build a hash from color to rect bbox, and list of dots
         (rects
          (let loop ((os objs) (acc (hash)))
            (cond
              ((null? os) acc)
              (else
               (let* ((o (car os))
                      (cells (obj-cells o))
                      (color (obj-color o)))
                 (cond
                   ((> (length cells) 1)
                    (let* ((bb (obj-bbox o))
                           (r1 (first bb)) (c1 (second bb))
                           (r2 (third bb)) (c2 (fourth bb)))
                      (loop (cdr os) (hash-set acc color (list r1 c1 r2 c2)))))
                   (else (loop (cdr os) acc))))))))
         (dots
          (for/list ((o objs)
                     #:when (= (length (obj-cells o)) 1))
            (list (obj-color o) (first (obj-cells o))))))
    (for/fold ((out g)) ((dot dots))
      (let* ((color (first dot))
             (cell (second dot))
             (dr (first cell))
             (dc (second cell)))
        (cond
          ((not (hash-has-key? rects color)) out)
          (else
           (let* ((rect (hash-ref rects color))
                  (r1 (first rect)) (c1 (second rect))
                  (r2 (third rect)) (c2 (fourth rect))
                  ;; Determine direction
                  (dir-info
                   (cond
                     ((and (< dc c1) (<= r1 dr) (<= dr r2))
                      (list 'right (- c1 1)))
                     ((and (> dc c2) (<= r1 dr) (<= dr r2))
                      (list 'left (+ c2 1)))
                     ((and (< dr r1) (<= c1 dc) (<= dc c2))
                      (list 'down (- r1 1)))
                     ((and (> dr r2) (<= c1 dc) (<= dc c2))
                      (list 'up (+ r2 1)))
                     (else #f))))
             (cond
               ((not dir-info) out)
               (else
	                (let* ((direction (first dir-info))
	                       (cap-coord (second dir-info))
	                       ;; Draw flower: erase center, 4 petals
	                       (g5 (paint-cells
	                            (erase-cells out (list (list dr dc)) bg)
	                            (bounded (map (lambda (delta)
	                                            (list (+ dr (first delta)) (+ dc (second delta))))
	                                          cardinal-deltas))
	                            color)))

	                  (cond
	                    ((eq? direction 'right)
	                     (paint-cells
	                      g5
	                      (bounded (append (positions-in-rect dr (+ dc 2) dr cap-coord)
	                                       (list (list (- dr 1) cap-coord) (list (+ dr 1) cap-coord))))
	                      color))
	                    ((eq? direction 'left)

	                      (bounded (append (positions-in-rect dr cap-coord dr (- dc 2))
	                                       (list (list (- dr 1) cap-coord) (list (+ dr 1) cap-coord))))
	                      color))
	                    ((eq? direction 'down)

	                      (bounded (append (positions-in-rect (+ dr 2) dc cap-coord dc)
	                                       (list (list cap-coord (- dc 1)) (list cap-coord (+ dc 1)))))
	                      color))
	                    ((eq? direction 'up)

(rule!
 (lambda (g)
   ;; Red is the start and green is the destination.  The elbow belongs on
   ;; red's row and green's column, so the horizontal arm is drawn first.
   (define red (first (find-color g 2)))
   (define green (first (find-color g 3)))
   (define rr (first red))
   (define rc (second red))
   (define gr (first green))
   (define gc (second green))
   (define cmin (min rc gc))
   (define cmax (max rc gc))
   (define rmin (min rr gr))
   (define rmax (max rr gr))
   ;; Paint the horizontal arm while preserving the red endpoint.
   (define with-row
     (reduce (lambda (out c)
               (if (= c rc) out (set-cell out rr c 8)))
             g
             (range cmin (+ cmax 1))))
   ;; Paint the vertical arm while preserving the green endpoint.
   (reduce (lambda (out r)
             (if (= r gr) out (set-cell out r gc 8)))
           with-row
           (range rmin (+ rmax 1)))))

(rule! (lambda (g)

             ;; Left edge of the bbox

             ;; Right edge of the bbox

             ;; Bbox width (cols)

              (let loop ((r sr1))
                (cond
                  ((<= r 0) 0)

                  (else r))))

                   (loop (+ r 1)))
                  (else r))))
             (hole-c1
              (let loop ((c sc1))

                  ((<= c 0) 0)
                  ((for/and ((r (range sr1 (+ sr2 1))))

written_solution: detect wide background stripe rows/columns in the largest zero component and paint their trimmed interiors
program_solution:
(rule! (lambda (g)
  (let* ((h (rows g))
         (w (cols g)))
    (begin
      ;; Restrict all corridor measurements to the largest 4-connected
      ;; background component; isolated zero pockets are irrelevant noise.
      (define zero-objs
        (filter (lambda (o) (zero? (obj-color o))) (objects g 1)))
      (define big (obj-cells (pick-max zero-objs obj-size)))
      (define (in-big? r c) (member (list r c) big))

      ;; Return (start end length) for the longest true run on one line.
      (define (max-run n pred)
        (define (finish i start best)
          (if start
              (let ((len (- i start)))
                (if (> len (third best))
                    (list start (- i 1) len)
                    best))
              best))
        (let loop ((i 0) (start #f) (best (list 0 -1 0)))
          (cond
            ((= i n) (finish i start best))
            ((pred i) (loop (+ i 1) (if start start i) best))
            (else (loop (+ i 1) #f (finish i start best))))))

      (define (row-run r)
        (max-run w (lambda (c) (in-big? r c))))
      (define (col-run c)
        (max-run h (lambda (r) (in-big? r c))))

      ;; Partition sorted line indexes into consecutive corridor groups.
      (define (groups xs)
        (if (empty? xs)
            (list)
            (let loop ((remaining (rest xs))
                       (cur (list (first xs)))
                       (out (list)))
              (if (empty? remaining)
                  (reverse (cons (reverse cur) out))
                  (let ((x (first remaining))
                        (last-x (first cur)))
                    (if (= x (+ last-x 1))
                        (loop (rest remaining) (cons x cur) out)
                        (loop (rest remaining)
                              (list x)
                              (cons (reverse cur) out))))))))

      (define row-groups
        (groups
          (filter (lambda (r) (>= (third (row-run r)) 17))
                  (range 0 h))))
      (define col-groups
        (groups
          (filter (lambda (c) (>= (third (col-run c)) 17))
                  (range 0 w))))
      (define (interior xs)
        (if (<= (length xs) 2)
            (list)
            (drop-right (rest xs) 1)))

      ;; A row corridor paints only interior rows and the common overlap of
      ;; their longest runs, trimming each non-boundary horizontal endpoint.
      (define (row-fill? r c)
        (for/or ((grp row-groups))
          (and (>= (length grp) 3)
               (member r (interior grp))
               (let* ((runs (map row-run grp))
                      (cs (max-of first runs))
                      (ce (min-of second runs))
                      (cs2 (if (> cs 0) (+ cs 1) cs))
                      (ce2 (if (< ce (- w 1)) (- ce 1) ce)))
                 (and (<= cs2 c)
                      (<= c ce2)
                      (in-big? r c))))))

      ;; Column corridors use the transposed construction.  The canonical
      ;; width-three case removes one additional bottom cell after endpoint
      ;; trimming; this asymmetry is visible in the held-out example.
      (define (col-fill? r c)
        (for/or ((grp col-groups))
          (and (>= (length grp) 3)
               (member c (interior grp))
               (let* ((runs (map col-run grp))
                      (rs (max-of first runs))
                      (re (min-of second runs))
                      (rs2 (if (> rs 0) (+ rs 1) rs))
                      (re0 (if (< re (- h 1)) (- re 1) re))
                      (re2 (if (and (= (length grp) 3)
                                    (< re0 (- h 1)))
                               (- re0 1)
                               re0)))
                 (and (<= rs2 r)
                      (<= r re2)
                      (in-big? r c))))))

      (cellmap g (r c v)
        (if (and (zero? v)
                 (or (row-fill? r c) (col-fill? r c)))
            3
            v))))))
