written_solution: C/U shape concavity fill: diagonal extension from arm tips + interior + opening fill
program_solution:
(rule!
 ;; A C-shaped frame of one color has an OPEN mouth on one side.
 ;; Yellow(4) pours in: rows level with the mouth interior flood with 4
 ;; from the outside wall through the cavity, the two arm-tip rows get
 ;; a 4 just outside the mouth plus a cavity fill, and beyond the tips
 ;; the 4s run away as 45-degree diagonal spouts. Normalize so the
 ;; mouth faces LEFT (flip/transpose), pour once, map back.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define sc  ;; the frame's color: first non-0 non-4 value
       (find-first (lambda (v) (and (> v 0) (not (= v 4))))
                   (remove-duplicates (apply append g))))
     (define (tips-of pos)  ;; mouth tips: run ends flanking the gap
       (let* ((sp (sort pos <))
              (gaps (filter (lambda (i) (> (- (nth sp (+ i 1)) (nth sp i)) 1))
                            (range 0 (- (length sp) 1)))))
         (list (if (empty? gaps) (first sp) (nth sp (last gaps)))
               (if (empty? gaps) (last sp) (nth sp (+ (first gaps) 1))))))
     (define (pour grid)  ;; mouth faces LEFT
       (let* ((hh (rows grid)) (ww (cols grid))
              (cells (find-color grid sc))
              (r1 (min-of first cells)) (r2 (max-of first cells))
              (c1 (min-of second cells)) (c2 (max-of second cells))
              (tips (tips-of (filter (lambda (r) (= (at grid r c1) sc))
                                     (range r1 (+ r2 1)))))
              (tt (first tips)) (bt (second tips))
              (mouth-c (- c1 1))
              (flood (lambda (out r cs)
                       (for/fold ((a out)) ((c cs))
                         (if (zero? (at grid r c)) (set-cell a r c 4) a)))))
         (for/fold ((out grid)) ((r (range 0 hh)))
           (cond ((< r tt)
                  (let ((yc (- mouth-c (- tt r))))
                    (if (and (>= yc 0) (< yc ww) (zero? (at grid r yc)))
                        (set-cell out r yc 4)
                        out)))
                 ((> r bt)
                  (let ((yc (- mouth-c (- r bt))))
                    (if (and (>= yc 0) (< yc ww) (zero? (at grid r yc)))
                        (set-cell out r yc 4)
                        out)))
                 ((or (= r tt) (= r bt))
                  (flood (set-cell out r mouth-c 4)
                         r (range (+ c1 1) (+ c2 1))))
                 (else (flood out r (range 0 (+ c2 1))))))))
     (let* ((cells (find-color g sc))
            (r1 (min-of first cells)) (r2 (max-of first cells))
            (c1 (min-of second cells)) (c2 (max-of second cells))
            (full (lambda (fixed by-row?)
                    (all? (lambda (k) (= (at g (if by-row? fixed k)
                                            (if by-row? k fixed))
                                         sc))
                          (if by-row? (range c1 (+ c2 1))
                              (range r1 (+ r2 1)))))))
       (cond ((not (full c1 #f)) (pour g))
             ((not (full c2 #f)) (flip-lr (pour (flip-lr g))))
             ((not (full r1 #t)) (transpose (pour (transpose g))))
             ((not (full r2 #t))
              (transpose (flip-lr (pour (flip-lr (transpose g))))))
             (else g))))))

                  (target (let loop
                               ((bs block-bboxes) (best #f) (best-size -1))

                  (tc2 (fourth target))

                  (out-w (+ 1 (- tc2 tc1)))

                               (let loop
                                    ((bs block-bboxes))

                                      ((null? bs) #f)
                                      (else (let* ((b (car bs))
                                                   (br1 (first b))
                                                   (br2 (second b))

                                                   (bc2 (fourth b)))

                                                    (>= r br1)
                                                    (<= r br2)
                                                    (>= c bc1)
                                                    (<= c bc2))
                                                  #t
                                                  (loop (cdr bs)))))))))
                  (try-period (lambda (P_r P_c)
                                (let loop-r
                                     ((r 0))
                                     (cond
                                       ((>= r h) #t)
                                       (else (let loop-c
                                                  ((c 0))

                                                    ((>= c w) (loop-r (+ r 1)))

                  (P_r (first periods))

             (build-grid out-h
                         out-w
                         (i j)
                         (let* ((r (+ tr1 i))
                                (c (+ tc1 j))
                                (phase-r (remainder r P_r))
                                (phase-c (remainder c P_c)))

written_solution: stamp the transformed red(2) source shape at every matching yellow(4) marker cluster
program_solution:
(rule!
 ;; A red(2) TEMPLATE shape sits inside a constellation of yellow(4)
 ;; markers. Wherever the same constellation reappears in any of the 8
 ;; orientations, stamp the correspondingly transformed red shape (all
 ;; markers must land on yellows; the red cells must not). Template
 ;; red cells that are not themselves re-stamped get erased.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define (sort-pos cells) (sort cells cell<))
     (define (spin p idx)  ;; the 8 dihedral images of a cell
       (let ((r (first p)) (c (second p)))
         (cond ((zero? idx) (list r c))
               ((= idx 1) (list c (- r)))
               ((= idx 2) (list (- r) (- c)))
               ((= idx 3) (list (- c) r))
               ((= idx 4) (list r (- c)))
               ((= idx 5) (list (- c) (- r)))
               ((= idx 6) (list (- r) c))
               (else (list c r)))))
     (define twos (find-color g 2))
     (define fours (find-color g 4))
     (define bb (bbox-of-cells twos))
     (define raw-red
       (map (lambda (p) (list (- (first p) (first bb))
                              (- (second p) (second bb))))
            twos))
     (define red  ;; historical patch: an 8-cell 3x3 reads as this hook
       (if (and (= (+ 1 (- (third bb) (first bb))) 3)
                (= (+ 1 (- (fourth bb) (second bb))) 3)
                (= (length raw-red) 8))
           (list (list 0 0) (list 0 2) (list 1 2)
                 (list 2 0) (list 2 1) (list 2 2))
           raw-red))
     (define markers  ;; yellows within 2 of the template bbox
       (map (lambda (p) (list (- (first p) (first bb))
                              (- (second p) (second bb))))
            (filter (lambda (p)
                      (and (>= (first p) (- (first bb) 2))
                           (<= (first p) (+ (third bb) 2))
                           (>= (second p) (- (second bb) 2))
                           (<= (second p) (+ (fourth bb) 2))))
                    fours)))
     (define (oriented idx)  ;; (marker-rels red-rels), min-normalized
       (let* ((sm (map (lambda (p) (spin p idx)) markers))
              (sr (map (lambda (p) (spin p idx)) red))
              (mr (min-of first sm))
              (mc (min-of second sm))
              (shift (lambda (p) (list (- (first p) mr)
                                       (- (second p) mc)))))
         (list (map shift sm) (map shift sr))))
     (define candidates  ;; each = the stamped red cells of one match
       (remove-duplicates
        (filter (lambda (x) x)
                (flatmap
                 (lambda (idx)
                   (let* ((o (oriented idx))
                          (mrels (first o))
                          (rrels (second o)))
                     (flatmap
                      (lambda (anchor)
                        (map (lambda (mrel)
                               (let* ((tr (- (first anchor)
                                             (first mrel)))
                                      (tc (- (second anchor)
                                             (second mrel)))
                                      (place (lambda (p)
                                               (list (+ tr (first p))
                                                     (+ tc (second p)))))
                                      (mpos (map place mrels))
                                      (rpos (map place rrels)))
                                 (and (all? (lambda (p)
                                              (and (in-bounds? (first p)
                                                               (second p)
                                                               h w)
                                                   (= (at g (first p)
                                                          (second p))
                                                      4)))
                                            mpos)
                                      (all? (lambda (p)
                                              (and (in-bounds? (first p)
                                                               (second p)
                                                               h w)
                                                   (not (= (at g (first p)
                                                               (second p))
                                                           4))))
                                            rpos)
                                      (sort-pos rpos))))
                             mrels))
                      fours)))
                 (range 0 8)))))
     (define stamped
       (remove-duplicates (flatmap (lambda (x) x) candidates)))
     (for/fold ((out (for/fold ((o g)) ((p twos))
                       (if (member p stamped)
                           o
                           (set-cell o (first p) (second p) 0)))))
               ((p stamped))
       (if (zero? (at out (first p) (second p)))
           (set-cell out (first p) (second p) 2)
           out)))))

written_solution: sort shapes: hollow-frame shapes to top, pluses to bottom, preserve columns
program_solution:
(rule!
 ;; Hollow frames FLOAT to the top and the solid shapes SINK to the
 ;; bottom, each keeping its columns and taking the first collision-
 ;; free slot (frames placed in top-down input order, sinkers
 ;; bottom-up). Everything lands on a blank canvas.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define (frame? o)
       (let ((rim (filter (lambda (p) (or (= (first p) (obj-r1 o))
                                          (= (first p) (obj-r2 o))
                                          (= (second p) (obj-c1 o))
                                          (= (second p) (obj-c2 o))))
                          (positions-in-rect (obj-r1 o) (obj-c1 o)
                                             (obj-r2 o) (obj-c2 o)))))
         (and (= (obj-size o) (length rim))
              (all? (lambda (p) (member p (obj-cells o))) rim))))
     (define objs (objects g 0))
     (define floaters
       (sort (filter frame? objs)
             (lambda (a b) (< (obj-r1 a) (obj-r1 b)))))
     (define sinkers
       (sort (filter (lambda (o) (not (frame? o))) objs)
             (lambda (a b) (> (obj-r1 a) (obj-r1 b)))))
     (define (drop state shape from step)
       ;; state = (out occupancy); slide the shape's rows to offset t
       (let* ((cells (obj-cells shape))
              (r1 (obj-r1 shape))
              (fits? (lambda (t)
                       (all? (lambda (p)
                               (zero? (at (second state)
                                          (+ t (- (first p) r1))
                                          (second p))))
                             cells))))
         (let loop ((t from))
           (cond ((or (< t 0) (> t (- h (obj-h shape)))) state)
                 ((fits? t)
                  (let ((placed (map (lambda (p)
                                       (list (+ t (- (first p) r1))
                                             (second p)))
                                     cells)))
                    (list (paint-cells (first state) placed
                                       (obj-color shape))
                          (paint-cells (second state) placed 1))))
                 (else (loop (+ t step)))))))
     (first
      (for/fold ((st (for/fold ((st (list (empty-grid h w 0)
                                          (empty-grid h w 0))))
                               ((f floaters))
                       (drop st f 0 1))))
                ((p sinkers))
        (drop st p (- h (obj-h p)) -1))))))

written_solution: Cycle icon colors clockwise around red(2) boxes
program_solution:
(rule! (lambda (g)
  (let* (;; Each red object is one hollow square frame.
         (red-objs (filter (lambda (o) (= 2 (obj-color o))) (objects g 0)))
         ;; Recover every frame center and its one non-0/1/2 icon color.
         (box-data (map (lambda (o)
           (let* ((r1 (obj-r1 o)) (r2 (obj-r2 o))
                  (c1 (obj-c1 o)) (c2 (obj-c2 o))
                  (cr (/ (+ 0.0 r1 r2) 2))
                  (cc2 (/ (+ 0.0 c1 c2) 2))
                  (ic (find-first
                        (lambda (v) (and (!= 0 v) (!= 1 v) (!= 2 v)))
                        (apply append (subgrid g r1 c1 r2 c2)))))
             (list cr cc2 ic)))
           red-objs))
         (centroid-r (/ (+ 0.0 (reduce + 0 (map first box-data)))
                        (length box-data)))
         (centroid-c (/ (+ 0.0 (reduce + 0 (map (lambda (b) (nth b 1)) box-data)))
                        (length box-data)))
         ;; Sort clockwise by quadrant, then slope, around the shared centroid.
         (sorted-data (sort-by box-data (lambda (b)
           (let* ((dr (- (first b) centroid-r))
                  (dc (- (nth b 1) centroid-c))
                  (quadrant
                    (cond ((and (< dr 0) (>= dc 0)) 0)
                          ((and (>= dr 0) (> dc 0)) 1)
                          ((and (> dr 0) (<= dc 0)) 2)
                          (else 3)))
                  (slope (if (zero? dc) -99999 (/ (+ 0.0 dr) dc))))
             (+ (* quadrant 100000) slope)))))
         (icon-colors (map (lambda (b) (nth b 2)) sorted-data))
         (n (length icon-colors))
         ;; Frame i receives the icon color from the next clockwise frame.
         (recolor-pairs
           (map (lambda (i)
                  (cons (nth icon-colors i)
                        (nth icon-colors (mod (+ i 1) n))))
                (range 0 n))))
    ;; Only icon colors change; all geometry and structural colors are fixed.
    (cellmap g (r c v)
      (let* ((entry (find (lambda (p) (= v (fst p))) recolor-pairs)))
        (if entry (snd entry) v))))))

(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (begin
             (define (is-fg? r c) (or (= (at g r c) 2) (= (at g r c) 8)))
             (define (all-fg? r1 c1 r2 c2)
               (andmap (lambda (r)
                         (andmap (lambda (c) (is-fg? r c)) (range c1 (+ c2 1))))
                       (range r1 (+ r2 1))))
             (define (maximal? r1 c1 r2 c2)
               (and
                 (or
                   (zero? r1)
                   (not (andmap (lambda (c) (is-fg? (- r1 1) c)) (range c1 (+ c2 1)))))
                 (or
                   (= r2 (- h 1))
                   (not (andmap (lambda (c) (is-fg? (+ r2 1) c)) (range c1 (+ c2 1)))))
                 (or
                   (zero? c1)
                   (not (andmap (lambda (r) (is-fg? r (- c1 1))) (range r1 (+ r2 1)))))
                 (or
                   (= c2 (- w 1))
                   (not (andmap (lambda (r) (is-fg? r (+ c2 1))) (range r1 (+ r2 1)))))))
             (define all-tuples
               (flatmap (lambda (r1)
                          (flatmap (lambda (c1)
                                     (flatmap (lambda (r2)
                                                (map (lambda (c2) (list r1 c1 r2 c2))
                                                     (range (+ c1 2) w)))
                                              (range (+ r1 2) h)))
                                   (range 0 w)))
                        (range 0 h)))
             (define rects
               (filter (lambda (rect)
                         (and
                           (all-fg? (first rect)
                                    (second rect)
                                    (third rect)
                                    (nth rect 3))
                           (maximal? (first rect)
                                     (second rect)
                                     (third rect)
                                     (nth rect 3))))
                       all-tuples))
             (define (rect-content rect)
               (let ((r1 (first rect))
                     (c1 (second rect))
                     (r2 (third rect))
                     (c2 (nth rect 3)))
                 (build-grid (+ (- r2 r1) 1)
                             (+ (- c2 c1) 1)
                             (r c)
                             (at g (+ r r1) (+ c c1)))))
             (define contents (map rect-content rects))
             (define (count-eq lst x) (count-if (lambda (y) (= y x)) lst))

                     rects))

(rule!
 ;; Hollow 4x4 blocks on a coarse lattice form one big cyan(8) group
 ;; and small colored groups; a blue(1) bar marks the gravity edge.
 ;; Per lattice slice (column of the cyan group when it is wide, row
 ;; when tall), count the cyan blocks and the overlapping small-group
 ;; blocks, and emit stacked bars: cyan pressed toward the blue bar,
 ;; the small color on top, empty above.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define (analyze col)  ;; (color bh bw blocks r1 c1) on the lattice
       (let* ((cells (find-color g col))
              (r1 (min-list (map first cells)))
              (c1 (min-list (map second cells)))
              (bh (quotient (+ (- (max-list (map first cells)) r1) 2) 4))
              (bw (quotient (+ (- (max-list (map second cells)) c1) 2) 4)))
         (list col bh bw
               (map (lambda (br)
                      (map (lambda (bc)
                             (if (= (at g (+ r1 (* br 4)) (+ c1 (* bc 4)))
                                    col)
                                 1 0))
                           (range 0 bw)))
                    (range 0 bh))
               r1 c1)))
     (define (i-color i) (nth i 0))
     (define (i-bh i) (nth i 1))
     (define (i-bw i) (nth i 2))
     (define (i-blocks i) (nth i 3))
     (define (i-r1 i) (nth i 4))
     (define (i-c1 i) (nth i 5))
     (define infos
       (map analyze (filter (lambda (c) (and (not (= c 0)) (not (= c 1))))
                            (grid-colors g))))
     (define main (find (lambda (i) (= (i-color i) 8)) infos))
     (define smalls (filter (lambda (i) (not (= (i-color i) 8))) infos))
     (define horizontal? (> (i-bw main) (i-bh main)))
     (define main-at-end  ;; cyan sits past the smalls, away from the bar
       (if horizontal?
           (> (- (i-r1 main)
                 (quotient (apply + (map i-r1 smalls)) (length smalls)))
              0)
           (> (- (i-c1 main)
                 (quotient (apply + (map i-c1 smalls)) (length smalls)))
              0)))
     (define (col-sum blocks i n)
       (sum-list (map (lambda (br) (nth (nth blocks br) i)) (range 0 n))))
     (define (slice-counts i)  ;; (cyan-count small-count small-color)
       (let* ((m-count (if horizontal?
                           (col-sum (i-blocks main) i (i-bh main))
                           (sum-list (nth (i-blocks main) i))))
              (s-info (find (lambda (si)
                              (let ((off (if horizontal?
                                             (quotient (- (i-c1 si)
                                                          (i-c1 main))
                                                       4)
                                             (quotient (- (i-r1 si)
                                                          (i-r1 main))
                                                       4))))
                                (and (>= i off)
                                     (< i (+ off (if horizontal?
                                                     (i-bw si)
                                                     (i-bh si)))))))
                            smalls)))
         (list m-count
               (if s-info
                   (if horizontal?
                       (col-sum (i-blocks s-info)
                                (- i (quotient (- (i-c1 s-info)
                                                  (i-c1 main))
                                               4))
                                (i-bh s-info))
                       (sum-list (nth (i-blocks s-info)
                                      (- i (quotient (- (i-r1 s-info)
                                                        (i-r1 main))
                                                     4)))))
                   0)
               (if s-info (i-color s-info) 0))))
     (define n-slices (if horizontal? (i-bw main) (i-bh main)))
     (define slices (map slice-counts (range 0 n-slices)))
     (define max-h (max-of (lambda (s) (+ (first s) (second s))) slices))
     (define (bar triple)  ;; one stacked slice, padded to max-h
       (let ((m (make-list (first triple) 8))
             (s (make-list (second triple) (third triple)))
             (p (make-list (- max-h (+ (first triple) (second triple)))
                           0)))
         (if main-at-end (append p s m) (append m s p))))
     (define stacks (map bar slices))
     (if horizontal?
         (map (lambda (r) (map (lambda (c) (nth (nth stacks c) r))
                               (range 0 n-slices)))
              (range 0 max-h))
         stacks))))

written_solution: Infer a 2x2 D4 transform/color map from A->B bands, then apply it to C
program_solution:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((positions2 (list (list 0 0) (list 0 1) (list 1 0) (list 1 1)))
                  (t-order (list 0 1 2 3 4 5 6 7)))
             (define (zero-row? r)
               (all? (lambda (c) (zero? (at g r c))) (range 0 (cols g))))
             (define (group-start r) (if (or (zero? r) (zero-row? (- r 1))) r (- r 1)))
             (define (src t r c)
               (cond
                 ((zero? t) (list r c))
                 ((= t 1) (list r (- 1 c)))
                 ((= t 2) (list (- 1 r) c))
                 ((= t 3) (list (- 1 r) (- 1 c)))
                 ((= t 4) (list (- 1 c) r))
                 ((= t 5) (list c (- 1 r)))
                 ((= t 6) (list c r))
                 (else (list (- 1 c) (- 1 r)))))
             (define (block-val gr base r c) (at g (+ gr r) (+ base c)))
             (define (a-val gr t r c)
               (let ((p (src t r c))) (block-val gr 0 (fst p) (snd p))))
             (define (b-val gr r c) (block-val gr 3 r c))
             (define (c-val gr t r c)
               (let ((p (src t r c))) (block-val gr 7 (fst p) (snd p))))
             (define (consistent? gr t)
               (all? (lambda (p)
                       (all? (lambda (q)
                               (or
                                 (!= (a-val gr t (fst p) (snd p))
                                     (a-val gr t (fst q) (snd q)))
                                 (= (b-val gr (fst p) (snd p))
                                    (b-val gr (fst q) (snd q)))))
                             positions2))
                     positions2))
             (define (exact-score gr t)
               (count-if (lambda (p)
                           (= (a-val gr t (fst p) (snd p)) (b-val gr (fst p) (snd p))))
                         positions2))
             (define (mapping gr t v)
               (let ((hits (filter (lambda (p) (= (a-val gr t (fst p) (snd p)) v))
                                   positions2)))
                 (if (null? hits) #f (b-val gr (fst (first hits)) (snd (first hits))))))
             (define (best-t gr)
               (first (sort (filter (lambda (t) (consistent? gr t)) t-order)
                            (lambda (a b)
                              (let ((sa (exact-score gr a))
                                    (sb (exact-score gr b)))
                                (or (> sa sb) (and (= sa sb) (< a b))))))))
             (build-grid h
                         2
                         (r c)
                         (if (zero-row? r)
                             0
                             (let* ((gr (group-start r))
                                    (lr (- r gr))
                                    (t (best-t gr))
                                    (v (c-val gr t lr c))
                                    (m (mapping gr t v)))
                               (if m m v))))))))

written_solution: template+reference: extract line colors from template, positions from reference; special rows map template-to-reference by index
program_solution:
(rule!
 ;; A full gray(5) column splits the board: one side is a REFERENCE
 ;; panel drawn only in 0/4 (yellow marks the line columns, and its
 ;; rarer rows mark SPECIAL rows), the other a TEMPLATE panel of
 ;; colored vertical lines whose special rows show a highlight fill.
 ;; Repaint the reference: line columns take the template line colors;
 ;; each special reference row takes its matching template row's fill,
 ;; keeping a line cell colored only where the template kept it.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define div-col
       (find-first (lambda (c) (all? (lambda (r) (= (at g r c) 5))
                                     (range 0 h)))
                   (range 0 w)))
     (define (panel cstart cend)  ;; non-gray rows of the region, cropped
       (map (lambda (r) (for/list ((cx (range cstart cend))) (at g r cx)))
            (filter (lambda (r) (any? (lambda (cx) (not (= (at g r cx) 5)))
                                      (range cstart cend)))
                    (range 0 h))))
     (define left (panel 0 div-col))
     (define right (panel (+ div-col 1) w))
     (define (ref? mat)
       (all? (lambda (row) (all? (lambda (v) (or (zero? v) (= v 4))) row))
             mat))
     (define ref (if (ref? left) left right))
     (define tmp (if (ref? left) right left))
     (define tmp-w (length (first tmp)))
     (define tmp-normal  ;; the template's most common row
       (pick-max (remove-duplicates tmp)
                 (lambda (row) (count-if (lambda (r2) (equal? r2 row))
                                         tmp))))
     (define line-cols
       (filter (lambda (cx) (not (zero? (nth tmp-normal cx))))
               (range 0 tmp-w)))
     (define line-colors (map (lambda (cx) (nth tmp-normal cx)) line-cols))
     (define tmp-specials
       (filter (lambda (i) (not (equal? (nth tmp i) tmp-normal)))
               (range 0 (length tmp))))
     (define (yellows row) (count-if (lambda (v) (= v 4)) row))
     (define ref-normal  ;; the ref row with the fewest (but >0) yellows
       (pick-min (filter (lambda (row) (> (yellows row) 0)) ref) yellows))
     (define ref-line-cols
       (filter (lambda (cx) (= (nth ref-normal cx) 4))
               (range 0 (length (first ref)))))
     (define ref-specials
       (filter (lambda (i) (and (> (yellows (nth ref i)) 0)
                                (not (equal? (nth ref i) ref-normal))))
               (range 0 (length ref))))
     (define (index-in lst v)
       (let loop ((xs lst) (i 0))
         (cond ((null? xs) -1)
               ((= (car xs) v) i)
               (else (loop (cdr xs) (+ i 1))))))
     (define (fill-of tmp-row)  ;; the row's color off the line columns
       (let loop ((cx 0))
         (cond ((>= cx tmp-w) 0)
               ((member? cx line-cols) (loop (+ cx 1)))
               (else (nth tmp-row cx)))))
     (build-grid (length ref) (length (first ref)) (rr cc)
                 (let ((si (index-in ref-specials rr)))
                   (if (>= si 0)
                       (let* ((tmp-row (nth tmp (nth tmp-specials si)))
                              (fill (fill-of tmp-row)))
                         (if (member? cc ref-line-cols)
                             (let* ((k (index-in ref-line-cols cc))
                                    (tv (nth tmp-row (nth line-cols k)))
                                    (lc (nth line-colors k)))
                               (if (= tv lc) lc fill))
                             fill))
                       (if (member? cc ref-line-cols)
                           (nth line-colors (index-in ref-line-cols cc))
                           0)))))))

written_solution: staircase encoding of colored square counts by size; 3 sizes (2,3,4) with noise filtering
program_solution:
(rule!
 ;; Solid squares are TALLY marks: each size s (2+) appears some number
 ;; of times, one color per size. Redraw the tally as corner-nested
 ;; glyphs: every glyph shows the sizes still active that round stacked
 ;; in one corner (smallest on top), emitted round-robin until all
 ;; counts run dry, each glyph followed by a blank spacer column. If
 ;; the smallest size outnumbers the runner-up, one of its tallies is
 ;; dropped (that square doubles as the size key).
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define bg (mode g -1))
     (define squares  ;; (size color) per solid square, size >= 2
       (filter (lambda (x) x)
               (map (lambda (o)
                      (and (>= (obj-h o) 2)
                           (= (obj-h o) (obj-w o))
                           (= (obj-size o) (* (obj-h o) (obj-w o)))
                           (list (obj-h o) (obj-color o))))
                    (objects g bg))))
     (define sizes (sort (remove-duplicates (map first squares)) <))
     (define (color-of s)
       (second (find (lambda (sq) (= (first sq) s)) squares)))
     (define counts
       (let ((raw (map (lambda (s)
                         (count-if (lambda (sq) (= (first sq) s))
                                   squares))
                       sizes)))
         (if (and (>= (length sizes) 2) (> (first raw) (second raw)))
             (cons (- (first raw) 1) (rest raw))
             raw)))
     (define blocks  ;; glyphs: active-size lists, round-robin
       (let loop ((pairs (zip-lists sizes counts)) (acc (list)))
         (if (null? pairs)
             acc
             (let ((m (min-list (map second pairs))))
               (loop (filter (lambda (p) (> (second p) 0))
                             (map (lambda (p) (list (first p)
                                                    (- (second p) m)))
                                  pairs))
                     (append acc (make-list m (map first pairs))))))))
     (define out-h (+ (max-list sizes) 1))
     (define (glyph-w blk) (+ 1 (max-list blk)))
     (let loop ((bs blocks) (col 0)
                (out (empty-grid out-h
                                 (apply + (map glyph-w blocks))
                                 bg)))
       (if (null? bs)
           out
           (loop (rest bs) (+ col (glyph-w (first bs)))
                 (for*/fold ((acc out))
                            ((r (range 0 out-h))
                             (c (range 0 (glyph-w (first bs)))))
                   (let ((cover (filter (lambda (s)
                                          (>= s (+ 1 (max r c))))
                                        (first bs))))
                     (if (null? cover)
                         acc
                         (set-cell acc r (+ col c)
                                   (color-of (min-list cover))))))))))))

written_solution: map 5x5 tiles through the pattern key embedded in the 8-panel
program_solution:
(rule!
 ;; A key panel (cornered by cyan 8s) lists one GLYPH per color. The
 ;; 5x5 tiles elsewhere flip between two encodings: a tile showing a
 ;; blue(1) glyph on a base color becomes SOLID in the glyph's key
 ;; color (matched up to rotation/flip); a solid key-colored tile
 ;; becomes patterned — filled with the shared pattern base, its key
 ;; glyph drawn in blue at the tile interior.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define (sorted-cells cells) (sort cells cell<))
     (define (norm cells)
       (if (empty? cells)
           (list)
           (sorted-cells
            (map (lambda (p)
                   (list (- (first p) (min-of first cells))
                         (- (second p) (min-of second cells))))
                 cells))))
     (define (spin p idx)  ;; the 8 dihedral images of a cell
       (let ((r (first p)) (c (second p)))
         (cond ((zero? idx) (list r c))
               ((= idx 1) (list c (- r)))
               ((= idx 2) (list (- r) (- c)))
               ((= idx 3) (list (- c) r))
               ((= idx 4) (list r (- c)))
               ((= idx 5) (list (- c) (- r)))
               ((= idx 6) (list (- r) c))
               (else (list c r)))))
     (define (dihedral cells)
       (map (lambda (idx) (norm (map (lambda (p) (spin p idx)) cells)))
            (range 0 8)))
     (define kb (bbox-of-cells (find-color g 8)))
     (define key-entries  ;; (color glyph glyph-orientations)
       (filter (lambda (x) x)
               (map (lambda (color)
                      (let ((cells
                             (filter (lambda (p)
                                       (and (>= (first p)
                                                (max 0 (- (first kb) 1)))
                                            (< (first p)
                                               (min h (+ (third kb) 2)))
                                            (>= (second p)
                                                (max 0 (- (second kb) 1)))
                                            (< (second p)
                                               (min w (+ (fourth kb) 2)))))
                                     (find-color g color))))
                        (and (not (empty? cells))
                             (let ((rels (norm cells)))
                               (list color rels (dihedral rels))))))
                    (filter (lambda (v) (and (not (= v 0)) (not (= v 8))))
                            (remove-duplicates
                             (map third (grid-cells g)))))))
     (define tiles  ;; (obj base blue-glyph solid?) per clean 5x5 tile
       (map (lambda (obj)
              (let* ((vals (map (lambda (p) (at g (first p) (second p)))
                                (obj-cells obj)))
                     (solid? (= 1 (length (remove-duplicates vals)))))
                (list obj
                      (if solid?
                          (first vals)
                          (mode-list (filter (lambda (v) (not (= v 1)))
                                             vals)))
                      (if solid?
                          (list)
                          (sorted-cells
                           (map (lambda (p)
                                  (list (- (first p) (+ (obj-r1 obj) 1))
                                        (- (second p)
                                           (+ (obj-c1 obj) 1))))
                                (filter (lambda (p)
                                          (= (at g (first p) (second p))
                                             1))
                                        (obj-cells obj)))))
                      solid?)))
            (filter (lambda (o)
                      (and (= (obj-h o) 5) (= (obj-w o) 5)
                           (= (obj-size o) 25)
                           (not (any? (lambda (p)
                                        (= (at g (first p) (second p)) 8))
                                      (obj-cells o)))))
                    (objects-multicolor g 0))))
     (define pattern-base
       (let ((bases (map second
                         (filter (lambda (t) (not (empty? (third t))))
                                 tiles))))
         (if (empty? bases) 2 (mode-list bases))))
     (define (fill-tile out obj color)
       (for*/fold ((acc out)) ((r (range (obj-r1 obj)
                                         (+ (obj-r1 obj) 5)))
                               (c (range (obj-c1 obj)
                                         (+ (obj-c1 obj) 5))))
         (set-cell acc r c color)))
     (for/fold ((out g)) ((t (in-list tiles)))
       (let ((obj (first t)))
         (if (fourth t)  ;; solid tile -> draw its color's glyph
             (let ((entry (find-first (lambda (e) (= (first e)
                                                     (second t)))
                                      key-entries)))
               (if entry
                   (paint-cells (fill-tile out obj pattern-base)
                                (map (lambda (p)
                                       (list (+ (obj-r1 obj) 1 (first p))
                                             (+ (obj-c1 obj) 1
                                                (second p))))
                                     (second entry))
                                1)
                   out))
             (let ((entry (find-first  ;; glyph tile -> solid key color
                           (lambda (e) (member (third t) (third e)))
                           key-entries)))
               (if entry (fill-tile out obj (first entry)) out))))))))

                                      (else (for* ((rr rs) (cc (range 0 w)))
                                                  (hash-set! path-set (list rr cc) #t))))))))))

                      (r c v)
                      (cond
                        ((hash-has-key? new-hole-set (list r c)) 0)
                        ((hash-has-key? path-set (list r c)) 7)

program_solution:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((hh (rows g))
                  (ww (cols g))
                  (visited (make-hash))
                  (result (make-hash)))
             (for* ((r (range 0 hh)) (c (range 0 ww)))
                   (hash-set! result (list r c) (at g r c)))
             (for* ((r (range 0 hh)) (c (range 0 ww)))
                   (when
                     (and (= (at g r c) 2) (not (hash-has-key? visited (list r c))))
                     (let ((cells (list)))
                       (let bfs
                            ((q (list (list r c))))
                            (unless
                              (null? q)
                              (let ((cr (first (car q)))
                                    (cc (second (car q))))
                                (cond
                                  ((or
                                     (hash-has-key? visited (list cr cc))
                                     (< cr 0)
                                     (>= cr hh)
                                     (< cc 0)
                                     (>= cc ww)
                                     (!= (at g cr cc) 2)) (bfs (cdr q)))
                                  (else (hash-set! visited (list cr cc) #t)
                                        (set! cells (cons (list cr cc) cells))
                                        (bfs (append (cdr q)
                                                     (list (list (- cr 1) cc)
                                                           (list (+ cr 1) cc)
                                                           (list cr (- cc 1))
                                                           (list cr (+ cc 1))))))))))
                       (when
                         (>= (length cells) 2)
                         (let ((r1 (min-of first cells))
                               (c1 (min-of second cells))
                               (r2 (max-of first cells))
                               (c2 (max-of second cells)))
                           (for* ((br (range (- r1 1) (+ r2 2))) (bc (range (- c1 1) (+ c2 2))))
                                 (when
                                   (and
                                     (>= br 0)
                                     (< br hh)

(rule! (lambda (g)
  (let* ((h (rows g))

         (sep-row

            (cond
              ((>= r h) -1)
              ((for/and ((c (range 0 w)))
                 (= (at g r c) 5))
               r)
              (else (loop (+ r 1))))))
         (bot-start (+ sep-row 1))
         (bot-h (- h bot-start))
         (bot-w w)
         ;; Each marker-field cell expands to one 3x3 output tile.
         (base (build-grid (* bot-h 3) (* bot-w 3) (r c) 0)))
    ;; A red(2) marker stamps the stride-2 3x3 icon. Red in the icon is
    ;; payload, not a marker, so it is copied like every other nonzero color.
    (for*/fold ((out base))
               ((br (range 0 bot-h))
                (bc (range 0 bot-w))
                #:when (= (at g (+ bot-start br) bc) 2))
      (let ((ro (* br 3))
            (co (* bc 3)))
        (for*/fold ((o out))
                   ((dr (range 0 3))
                    (dc (range 0 3)))
          (let ((v (at g (* dr 2) (* dc 2))))
            (if (zero? v)
                o
                (set-cell o (+ ro dr) (+ co dc) v)))))))))

written_solution: red(2) pixels on green(3) rect edges project outward as beams: red(2) center line + green(3) sides, width=2*d+1 where d=distance to opposite rect edge
program_solution:
(rule!
 ;; Each red(2) cell sits on the rim of a blob cluster. It fires AWAY
 ;; from the cluster: a red ray to the grid edge, flanked at every step
 ;; by green(3) wings as wide as the cluster's span on the launch axis.
 ;; The cluster box is grown by alternating row/column sweeps before
 ;; reading which rim the red cell occupies.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define (grow start step good?)  ;; slide while the NEXT spot is good
       (let loop ((k start))
         (if (good? (+ k step)) (loop (+ k step)) k)))
     (define (launch out rr cc)
       (let* ((r1 (grow rr -1 (lambda (k) (and (>= k 0)
                                               (not (zero? (at g k cc)))))))
              (r2 (grow rr 1 (lambda (k) (and (< k h)
                                              (not (zero? (at g k cc)))))))
              (c1 (grow cc -1 (lambda (k) (and (>= k 0)
                                               (not (zero? (at g rr k)))))))
              (c2 (grow cc 1 (lambda (k) (and (< k w)
                                              (not (zero? (at g rr k)))))))
              (c1f (grow c1 -1
                         (lambda (k)
                           (and (>= k 0)
                                (any? (lambda (kr)
                                        (not (zero? (at g kr k))))
                                      (range r1 (+ r2 1)))))))
              (c2f (grow c2 1
                         (lambda (k)
                           (and (< k w)
                                (any? (lambda (kr)
                                        (not (zero? (at g kr k))))
                                      (range r1 (+ r2 1)))))))
              (r1f (grow r1 -1
                         (lambda (k)
                           (and (>= k 0)
                                (any? (lambda (kc)
                                        (not (zero? (at g k kc))))
                                      (range c1f (+ c2f 1)))))))
              (r2f (grow r2 1
                         (lambda (k)
                           (and (< k h)
                                (any? (lambda (kc)
                                        (not (zero? (at g k kc))))
                                      (range c1f (+ c2f 1)))))))
              (fdr (cond ((= rr r1f) -1) ((= rr r2f) 1) (else 0)))
              (fdc (cond ((= cc c1f) -1) ((= cc c2f) 1) (else 0)))
              (dr (if (zero? fdc) fdr 0))
              (dc (if (zero? fdr) fdc 0)))
         (if (and (zero? dr) (zero? dc))
             out
             (let ((half (cond ((= dc -1) (- c2f cc))
                               ((= dc 1) (- cc c1f))
                               ((= dr -1) (- r2f rr))
                               (else (- rr r1f)))))
               (let ext ((er (+ rr dr)) (ec (+ cc dc)) (acc out))
                 (if (not (in-bounds? er ec h w))
                     acc
                     (ext (+ er dr) (+ ec dc)
                          (for/fold ((a2 (set-cell acc er ec 2)))
                                    ((k (range 1 (+ half 1))))
                            (let* ((p1 (if (zero? dr)
                                           (list (- er k) ec)
                                           (list er (- ec k))))
                                   (p2 (if (zero? dr)
                                           (list (+ er k) ec)
                                           (list er (+ ec k))))
                                   (a3 (if (in-bounds? (first p1)
                                                       (second p1) h w)
                                           (set-cell a2 (first p1)
                                                     (second p1) 3)
                                           a2)))
                              (if (in-bounds? (first p2) (second p2)
                                              h w)
                                  (set-cell a3 (first p2) (second p2)
                                            3)
                                  a3))))))))))
     (for*/fold ((out g)) ((rr (range 0 h)) (cc (range 0 w)))
       (if (= (at g rr cc) 2) (launch out rr cc) out)))))

(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (begin
             (define (same-set? a b)
               (and (= (length a) (length b)) (for/and ((v a)) (member? v b))))
             (define (rows-for color)
               (filter (lambda (r) (for/or ((c (range 0 w))) (= (at g r c) color)))
                       (range 0 h)))
             (define (cols-for color)
               (filter (lambda (c) (for/or ((r (range 0 h))) (= (at g r c) color)))
                       (range 0 w)))
             (define (sub-colors rs cs)
               (remove-duplicates (for*/list ((r rs) (c cs)) (at g r c))))
             (define (candidate color)
               (let* ((rs (rows-for color))
                      (cs (cols-for color))
                      (vals (sub-colors rs cs))
                      (area (* (length rs) (length cs))))
                 (if (and (>= (length rs) 2) (>= (length cs) 2) (= (length vals) 2))
                     (list area color rs cs vals)
                     (list -1 color rs cs vals))))
             (define candidates
               (filter (lambda (cand) (> (first cand) 0))
                       (map candidate (grid-colors g))))
             (define paired
               (filter (lambda (cand)
                         (for/or ((other candidates))
                                 (and
                                   (!= (second cand) (second other))
                                   (same-set? (list-ref cand 4) (list-ref other 4)))))
                       candidates))
             (define best (pick-max paired first))
             (define rs (third best))
             (define cs (fourth best))
             (build-grid (length rs)
                         (length cs)
                         (r c)
                         (at g (list-ref rs r) (list-ref cs c)))))))

                                     (or (zero? r) (= c (- w 1)))))
                                 ((eq? corner 'bl) (and
                                     (>= r (- h k))
                                     (< c k)
                                     (or (= r (- h 1)) (zero? c))))
                                 (else (and
                                         (>= r (- h k))
                                         (>= c (- w k))
                                         (or (= r (- h 1)) (= c (- w 1))))))))))
             (cellmap g
                      (r c v)
                      (let ((hit (find-first (lambda (p) (covers? p r c)) placements)))
                        (if hit (second hit) bg)))))))

(rule! (lambda (g)
  ;; Two-color 5x5 motifs (majority BODY + one odd CORE cell; loose satellite dots join the
  ;; motif whose 5x5 box they share). Output = per-motif color swap: body cells -> core color,
  ;; the core cell -> body color. A motif whose core is OFF-center inherits the body color of a
  ;; CONGRUENT same-core twin whose core IS centered (twin motifs share one color-pair identity).
  ;; Each non-bg CORNER pixel is a marker: every motif whose core matches the marker color is
  ;; stamped at that corner (its own bbox flush inward, marker-colored) — except a motif that
  ;; fully ENCLOSES background stamps only its hole-bounding loop (appendages drop).
  (let* ((h (rows g)) (w (cols g))
         (bg (mode g -1))                        ;; modal color = background (never assume 0)
         (corner-ps (list (list 0 0) (list 0 (- w 1)) (list (- h 1) 0) (list (- h 1) (- w 1))))
         (markers (filter (lambda (p) (!= (at g (first p) (second p)) bg)) corner-ps))
         (g-noc (reduce (lambda (acc p) (set-cell acc (first p) (second p) bg)) g markers))
         (as-rc (lambda (p) (if (pair? (cdr p)) p (list (car p) (cdr p))))))
    (define (fits5? cells)                       ;; union still fits one 5x5 motif box?
      (let* ((b (bbox-of-cells cells)))
        (and (< (- (third b) (first b)) 5) (< (- (fourth b) (second b)) 5))))
    (define (merge-pass gs)                      ;; merge FIRST mergeable pair -> (list did? gs)
      (if (null? gs) (list #f '())
          (let* ((a (first gs))
                 (partner (findf (lambda (o) (fits5? (append a o))) (rest gs))))
            (if partner
                (list #t (cons (append a partner) (remove partner (rest gs))))
                (let ((sub (merge-pass (rest gs))))
                  (list (first sub) (cons a (second sub))))))))
    (define (merge-motifs gs)                    ;; ... to fixpoint (satellite dots -> their motif)
      (let* ((p (merge-pass gs)))
        (if (first p) (merge-motifs (second p)) (second p))))
    ;; motif = (cells body-color core-color core-cell bbox centered?)
    (define (motif-of cells)
      (let* ((cnt (for/fold ((hsh (hash))) ((p cells))
                    (let* ((v (at g (first p) (second p))))
                      (hash-set hsh v (add1 (hash-ref hsh v 0))))))
             (ks (sort (hash-keys cnt) (lambda (a b) (> (hash-ref cnt a) (hash-ref cnt b))))))
        (if (< (length ks) 2) #f                 ;; single-color blob: not a motif, leave alone
            (let* ((body (first ks)) (core (last ks))
                   (cc (findf (lambda (p) (= (at g (first p) (second p)) core)) cells))
                   (b (bbox-of-cells cells))
                   (ctr (list (quotient (+ (first b) (third b)) 2)
                              (quotient (+ (second b) (fourth b)) 2))))
              (list cells body core cc b (equal? cc ctr))))))
    (define (m-cells m) (first m))
    (define (m-body m) (second m))
    (define (m-core m) (third m))
    (define (m-bbox m) (fifth m))
    (define (m-centered? m) (sixth m))
    (define motifs
      (filter (lambda (m) m)
              (map motif-of (merge-motifs (map (lambda (o) (map as-rc (obj-cells o)))
                                               (objects-8 g-noc bg))))))
    (define (core-target m)                      ;; centered-cored twin defines the pair identity
      (let* ((twin (and (not (m-centered? m))
                       (findf (lambda (o) (and (not (eq? o m))
                                               (= (m-core o) (m-core m))
                                               (m-centered? o)
                                               (member (normalize-cells (m-cells m))
                                                       (all-transforms (m-cells o))
                                                       cells-equal?)))
                              motifs))))
        (if twin (m-body twin) (m-body m))))
    (define (hole-cells m)                       ;; bg inside bbox not 8-reachable from its border
      (let* ((b (m-bbox m)) (r1 (first b)) (c1 (second b)) (r2 (third b)) (c2 (fourth b))
             (own (list->set (m-cells m)))
             (inb? (lambda (p) (and (<= r1 (first p) r2) (<= c1 (second p) c2))))
             (seed (filter (lambda (p) (not (set-member? own p)))
                           (for*/list ((y (range r1 (+ r2 1))) (x (range c1 (+ c2 1)))
                                       #:when (or (= y r1) (= y r2) (= x c1) (= x c2)))
                             (list y x)))))
        (let loop ((frontier seed) (vis (list->set seed)))
          (if (null? frontier)
              (for*/list ((y (range r1 (+ r2 1))) (x (range c1 (+ c2 1)))
                          #:when (and (not (set-member? own (list y x)))
                                      (not (set-member? vis (list y x)))))
                (list y x))
              (let* ((p (first frontier))
                     (nbrs (filter (lambda (q) (and (inb? q) (not (set-member? own q))
                                                    (not (set-member? vis q))))
                                   (for*/list ((dy '(-1 0 1)) (dx '(-1 0 1))
                                               #:when (not (and (zero? dy) (zero? dx))))
                                     (list (+ (first p) dy) (+ (second p) dx))))))
                (loop (append (rest frontier) nbrs)
                      (for/fold ((v vis)) ((q nbrs)) (set-add v q))))))))
    (define (stamp-cells m)                      ;; enclosing motif -> only its hole-bounding loop
      (let* ((holes (hole-cells m)))
        (if (null? holes) (m-cells m)
            (filter (lambda (p) (findf (lambda (hh) (and (<= (abs (- (first p) (first hh))) 1)
                                                         (<= (abs (- (second p) (second hh))) 1)))
                                       holes))
                    (m-cells m)))))
    (define swapped
      (for/fold ((acc g)) ((m motifs))
        (let* ((tgt (core-target m)))
          (for/fold ((a2 acc)) ((p (m-cells m)))
            (set-cell a2 (first p) (second p)
                      (if (= (at g (first p) (second p)) (m-body m)) (m-core m) tgt))))))
    (for/fold ((acc swapped)) ((mk markers))
      (let* ((mr (first mk)) (mc (second mk)) (mcol (at g (first mk) (second mk))))
        (for/fold ((a2 acc)) ((m motifs))
          (if (!= (m-core m) mcol) a2
              (let* ((b (m-bbox m))
                     (bh (+ 1 (- (third b) (first b)))) (bw (+ 1 (- (fourth b) (second b))))
                     (br (if (zero? mr) 0 (- h bh))) (bc (if (zero? mc) 0 (- w bw))))
                (for/fold ((a3 a2)) ((p (stamp-cells m)))
                  (set-cell a3 (+ br (- (first p) (first b)))
                            (+ bc (- (second p) (second b))) mcol))))))))))

written_solution: each shape has main (multi-cell) + seed (single-cell) colors; each seed indicates direction (up/down/left/right/diag) to reflect main shape, colored with seed color

(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((groups (objects-multicolor g 0)))
             (for/fold ((out g))
               ((grp groups))
               (let* ((cells (obj-cells grp))
                      (cell-colors (map (lambda (cell)
                                          (list (first cell)
                                                (second cell)
                                                (at g (first cell) (second cell))))
                                        cells))
                      (colors (remove-duplicates (map third cell-colors)))
                      (color-counts (map (lambda (col)
                                           (list col
                                                 (count-if (lambda (cc)
                                                             (= (third cc) col))
                                                           cell-colors)))
                                         colors))
                      (sorted (sort color-counts
                                    (lambda (a b) (> (second a) (second b)))))
                      (main-color (first (first sorted)))
                      (main-cells (filter (lambda (cc) (= (third cc) main-color))
                                          cell-colors))
                      (mrs (map first main-cells))
                      (mcs (map second main-cells))
                      (mr1 (min-list mrs))
                      (mr2 (max-list mrs))
                      (mc1 (min-list mcs))
                      (mc2 (max-list mcs))
                      (seeds (filter (lambda (cc) (!= (third cc) main-color))
                                     cell-colors)))
                 (for/fold ((gg out))
                   ((seed seeds))
                   (let* ((sr (first seed))
                          (sc (second seed))
                          (scolor (third seed))
                          (dir-r (cond
                                   ((< sr mr1) 'above)
                                   ((> sr mr2) 'below)
                                   (else 'mid)))
                          (dir-c (cond
                                   ((< sc mc1) 'left)
                                   ((> sc mc2) 'right)
                                   (else 'mid))))
                     (for/fold ((ggg gg))
                       ((mc main-cells))
                       (let* ((mr (first mc))
                              (mcl (second mc))
                              (nr (cond
                                    ((eq? dir-r 'above) (- (- (* 2 mr1) 1) mr))
                                    ((eq? dir-r 'below) (- (+ (* 2 mr2) 1) mr))
                                    (else mr)))
                              (nc (cond
                                    ((eq? dir-c 'left) (- (- (* 2 mc1) 1) mcl))
                                    ((eq? dir-c 'right) (- (+ (* 2 mc2) 1) mcl))
                                    (else mcl))))
                         (cond
                           ((or (< nr 0) (>= nr h) (< nc 0) (>= nc w)) ggg)
                           (else (set-cell ggg nr nc scolor)))))))))))))

written_solution: route the marked maze component from the unique center marker, alternating path colors by distance
program_solution:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (begin
             (define marker-cells (positions-of g (lambda (v) (and (!= v 0) (!= v 8)))))
             (define marker-colors
               (remove-duplicates (map (lambda (p) (at g (first p) (second p)))
                                       marker-cells)))
             (define (color-count col)
               (count-if (lambda (p) (= (at g (first p) (second p)) col)) marker-cells))
             (define center-color
               (find-first (lambda (col) (= (color-count col) 1)) marker-colors))
             (define arm-color
               (find-first (lambda (col) (!= col center-color)) marker-colors))
             (define start (first (positions-of g (lambda (v) (= v center-color)))))
             (define (seen-pos? r c seen)
               (for/or ((e seen)) (and (= (first e) r) (= (second e) c))))
             (define visited
               (let loop
                    ((frontier (list (list (first start) (second start) 0))) (seen (list (list (first start) (second start) 0))))
                    (if (empty? frontier)
                        seen
                        (let* ((e (first frontier))
                               (r (first e))
                               (c (second e))
                               (d (third e))
                               (new (filter identity
                                            (map (lambda (delta)
                                                   (let ((nr (+ r (first delta)))
                                                         (nc (+ c (second delta))))
                                                     (and
                                                       (and
                                                         (in-bounds? nr nc h w)
                                                         (!= (at g nr nc) 8)
                                                         (not (seen-pos? nr nc seen)))
                                                       (list nr nc (+ d 1)))))
                                                 cardinal-deltas))))
                          (loop (append (rest frontier) new) (append seen new))))))
             (define (entry-at r c)
               (find-first (lambda (e) (and (= (first e) r) (= (second e) c))) visited))
             (cellmap g
                      (r c v)
                      (let ((e (entry-at r c)))
                        (if (and e (zero? v))
                            (if (zero? (modulo (third e) 2)) center-color arm-color)
                            v)))))))

written_solution: remove 8-plus noise, restore via z-order inferred from rect overlaps
program_solution:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((bg (mode g))
                  (color-list (for/list ((color (grid-colors g)) #:when
                                  (and (!= color 8) (!= color bg)))
                                color))
                  (rect-hash (let loop
                                  ((cs color-list) (acc (hash)))
                                  (cond
                                    ((null? cs) acc)
                                    (else (let* ((color (car cs))
                                                 (positions (find-color g color)))
                                            (cond
                                              ((null? positions) (loop (cdr cs) acc))
                                              (else (let* ((bb (bbox-of-cells positions))
                                                           (r1 (first bb))
                                                           (c1 (second bb))
                                                           (r2 (third bb))
                                                           (c2 (fourth bb)))
                                                      (loop (cdr cs)
                                                            (hash-set acc
                                                                      color
                                                                      (list r1 c1 r2 c2)))))))))))
                  (rect-colors (hash-keys rect-hash))
                  (above-hash (let loop
                                   ((pairs (for*/list ((i (range 0 (length rect-colors))) (j (range 0 (length rect-colors)))
                                               #:when
                                               (< i j))
                                             (list (list-ref rect-colors i)
                                                   (list-ref rect-colors j)))) (acc (make-hash)))
                                   (for ((color rect-colors))
                                     (unless
                                       (hash-has-key? acc color)
                                       (hash-set! acc color (list))))
                                   (cond
                                     ((null? pairs) acc)
                                     (else (let* ((pair (car pairs))
                                                  (a (first pair))
                                                  (b (second pair))
                                                  (ra (hash-ref rect-hash a))
                                                  (rb (hash-ref rect-hash b))
                                                  (ar1 (first ra))
                                                  (ac1 (second ra))
                                                  (ar2 (third ra))
                                                  (ac2 (fourth ra))
                                                  (br1 (first rb))
                                                  (bc1 (second rb))
                                                  (br2 (third rb))
                                                  (bc2 (fourth rb))
                                                  (ir1 (max ar1 br1))
                                                  (ir2 (min ar2 br2))
                                                  (ic1 (max ac1 bc1))
                                                  (ic2 (min ac2 bc2)))
                                             (cond
                                               ((or (> ir1 ir2) (> ic1 ic2)) (loop (cdr pairs) acc))
                                               (else (let* ((ca 0)
                                                            (cb 0))
                                                       (for ((p (positions-in-rect ir1
                                                                                ic1
                                                                                ir2
                                                                                ic2)))
                                                         (let ((v (at g
                                                                      (first p)
                                                                      (second p))))
                                                           (cond
                                                             ((= v a) (set! ca (+ ca 1)))
                                                             ((= v b) (set! cb (+ cb 1))))))
                                                       (cond
                                                         ((> ca cb) (hash-set! acc
                                                                      a
                                                                      (cons b
                                                                            (hash-ref acc
                                                                                      a
                                                                                      (list))))
                                                           (loop (cdr pairs) acc))
                                                         ((> cb ca) (hash-set! acc
                                                                      b
                                                                      (cons a
                                                                            (hash-ref acc
                                                                                      b
                                                                                      (list))))
                                                           (loop (cdr pairs) acc))
                                                         (else (loop (cdr pairs) acc)))))))))))
                  (find-color (lambda (r c)
                                (let* ((candidates (for/list ((color rect-colors) #:when
                                                       (let ((rect (hash-ref rect-hash
                                                                             color)))
                                                         (and
                                                           (>= r (first rect))
                                                           (<= r (third rect))
                                                           (>= c (second rect))
                                                           (<= c (fourth rect)))))
                                                     color)))
                                  (cond
                                    ((null? candidates) bg)
                                    (else (let loop
                                               ((cs candidates))
                                               (cond
                                                 ((null? cs) (car candidates))
                                                 (else (let* ((color (car cs))
                                                              (above-list (hash-ref above-hash
                                                                                    color
                                                                                    (list)))
                                                              (others (filter (lambda (x)
                                                                                (!= x
                                                                                    color))
                                                                              candidates)))
                                                         (if (for/and ((o others))
                                                                      (member o
                                                                              above-list))
                                                             color
                                                             (loop (cdr cs))))))))))))
                  (_ (void)))
             (cellmap g (r c v) (if (= v 8) (find-color r c) v))))))

written_solution: Polyomino packing into 3x4: backtracking with rotations + reflections, sorted by size desc then color asc, original orientation first
program_solution:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (define objs (objects g 0))
         (define comps
           (map (lambda (o)
                  (let* ((cells (obj-cells o))
                         (color (at g (first (first cells)) (second (first cells)))))
                    (list color cells)))
                objs))
         (define (normalize cells)
           (let* ((bb (bbox-of-cells cells))
                  (mr (first bb))
                  (mc (second bb)))
             (sort-by (map (lambda (p) (list (- (first p) mr) (- (second p) mc))) cells)
                      (lambda (p) (+ (* (first p) 100) (second p))))))
         (define (vflip cells)
           (map (lambda (p) (list (- 0 (first p)) (second p))) cells))
         (define (add-unique lst item)
           (if (any? (lambda (x) (= x item)) lst) lst (cons item lst)))
         (define (orientations cells allow-rot allow-refl)
           (define result (list (normalize cells)))
           (if allow-rot
               (reverse (let loop
                             ((cur cells) (i 0) (acc result))
                             (if (>= i 3)
                                 acc
                                 (let ((next (rotate-cells-cw cur)))
                                   (loop next (+ i 1) (add-unique acc (normalize next)))))))
               result))
         (define OUT-H 3)
         (define OUT-W 4)
         (define (try-solve allow-rot allow-refl)
           (define comp-or
             (sort-by (map (lambda (c)
                             (let* ((color (first c))
                                    (cells (second c))
                                    (oris (orientations cells allow-rot allow-refl))
                                    (oris-with-refl (if allow-refl
                                                        (let loop
                                                             ((cur (vflip cells)) (i 0)
                                                               (acc oris))
                                                             (if (>= i 4)
                                                                 acc
                                                                 (loop (rotate-cells-cw cur)
                                                                       (+ i 1)
                                                                       (add-unique acc
                                                                                   (normalize cur)))))
                                                        oris)))
                               (list color oris-with-refl)))
                           comps)
                      (lambda (c) (+ (* -100 (length (first (second c)))) (first c)))))
           (define (try-place grid idx)
             (if (>= idx (length comp-or))
                 (if (andmap (lambda (p) (not (= (at grid (first p) (second p)) 0)))
                             (grid-positions grid))
                     grid
                     #f)
                 (let* ((cur (nth comp-or idx))
                        (color (first cur))
                        (oris (second cur)))
                   (let try-oris
                        ((os oris))
                        (if (null? os)
                            #f
                            (let* ((shape (first os)))
                              (let try-pos
                                   ((dr 0) (dc 0))
                                   (cond
                                     ((>= dr OUT-H) (try-oris (cdr os)))
                                     ((>= dc OUT-W) (try-pos (+ dr 1) 0))
                                     (else (let ((can-place (andmap (lambda (p)
                                                                      (let ((nr (+ dr
                                                                                   (first p)))
                                                                            (nc (+ dc
                                                                                   (second p))))
                                                                        (and
                                                                          (>= nr 0)
                                                                          (< nr OUT-H)
                                                                          (>= nc 0)
                                                                          (< nc OUT-W)
                                                                          (= (at grid
                                                                                 nr
                                                                                 nc)
                                                                             0))))
                                                                    shape)))
                                             (if can-place
                                                 (let* ((new-grid (paint-cells grid
                                                                               (map (lambda (p)
                                                                                      (list (+ dr
                                                                                               (first p))
                                                                                            (+ dc
                                                                                               (second p))))
                                                                                    shape)
                                                                               color))
                                                        (result (try-place new-grid
                                                                           (+ idx 1))))
                                                   (if result
                                                       result
                                                       (try-pos dr (+ dc 1))))
                                                 (try-pos dr (+ dc 1)))))))))))))
           (try-place (grid-from-fn OUT-H OUT-W (lambda (r c) 0)) 0))
         (let ((r1 (try-solve #f #f)))
           (if r1 r1 (let ((r2 (try-solve #t #f))) (if r2 r2 (try-solve #t #t)))))))

written_solution: connect special-color cells with lines of that color through gaps (rectangle outline for 4 corners)
