(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g))
                (colors (filter (lambda (c) (not (= c 0))) (grid-colors g)))
                (color-counts (map (lambda (col) (list col (length (find-color g col))))
                                   colors))
                (sorted-colors (sort-by color-counts (lambda (p) (- 0 (second p)))))
                (frame-color (first (first sorted-colors)))
                (center-colors (filter (lambda (c) (not (= c frame-color))) colors))
                (center-counts (map (lambda (col)
                                      (list col (length (find-color g col))))
                                    center-colors))
                (center-sorted (sort-by center-counts (lambda (p) (- 0 (second p)))))
                (default-center (first (first center-sorted)))
                (special-colors (filter (lambda (c) (not (= c default-center)))
                                        center-colors)))
           (reduce (lambda (grid color)
                     (let* ((all-objs (objects g 0))
                            (color-objs (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) color))
                                                all-objs))
                            (bboxes (map (lambda (o)
                                           (let ((bb (obj-bbox o)))
                                             (list (nth bb 0)
                                                   (nth bb 1)
                                                   (nth bb 2)
                                                   (nth bb 3))))
                                         color-objs))
                            (n (length bboxes)))
                       (let loop-i
                            ((i 0) (gr grid))
                            (if (>= i n)
                                gr
                                (let loop-j
                                     ((j (+ i 1)) (gr2 gr))
                                     (if (>= j n)
                                         (loop-i (+ i 1) gr2)
                                         (let* ((b1 (nth bboxes i))
                                                (b2 (nth bboxes j))
                                                (r1a (nth b1 0))
                                                (c1a (nth b1 1))
                                                (r2a (nth b1 2))
                                                (c2a (nth b1 3))
                                                (r1b (nth b2 0))
                                                (c1b (nth b2 1))
                                                (r2b (nth b2 2))
                                                (c2b (nth b2 3))
                                                (same-rows (and (= r1a r1b) (= r2a r2b)))
                                                (same-cols (and (= c1a c1b) (= c2a c2b))))
                                           (let* ((gr3 (if same-rows
                                                           (let* ((left-c2 (if (< c1a
                                                                                  c1b)
                                                                               c2a
                                                                               c2b))
                                                                  (right-c1 (if (< c1a
                                                                                   c1b)
                                                                                c1b
                                                                                c1a)))
                                                             (paint-cells gr2
                                                                          (filter (lambda (p)
                                                                                    (= (at gr2
                                                                                           (first p)
                                                                                           (second p))
                                                                                       0))
                                                                                  (positions-in-rect r1a
                                                                                                     (+ left-c2
                                                                                                        1)
                                                                                                     r2a
                                                                                                     (- right-c1
                                                                                                        1)))
                                                                          color))
                                                           gr2))
                                                  (gr4 (if same-cols
                                                           (let* ((top-r2 (if (< r1a
                                                                                 r1b)
                                                                              r2a
                                                                              r2b))
                                                                  (bot-r1 (if (< r1a
                                                                                 r1b)
                                                                              r1b
                                                                              r1a)))
                                                             (paint-cells gr3
                                                                          (filter (lambda (p)
                                                                                    (= (at gr3
                                                                                           (first p)
                                                                                           (second p))
                                                                                       0))
                                                                                  (positions-in-rect (+ top-r2
                                                                                                        1)
                                                                                                     c1a
                                                                                                     (- bot-r1
                                                                                                        1)
                                                                                                     c2a))
                                                                          color))
                                                           gr3)))
                                             (loop-j (+ j 1) gr4)))))))))

written_solution: Connect rectangles via MST: corridors with walls at extremes of bbox interior overlap, holes in facing walls
program_solution:
(rule!
 ;; Hollow rooms get joined by corridors. Every horizontally/vertically
 ;; facing room pair with an unobstructed gap is a candidate edge
 ;; (cost = gap width, corridor spanning the shared interior rows/
 ;; cols); Kruskal's MST keeps the cheapest set that connects all
 ;; rooms. Each kept corridor draws its two green(3) side walls across
 ;; the gap and knocks door holes through both facing room walls.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define boxes (map obj-bbox (objects g 0)))
     (define n (length boxes))
     (define (box i) (nth boxes i))
     (define (r1 b) (nth b 0))
     (define (c1 b) (nth b 1))
     (define (r2 b) (nth b 2))
     (define (c2 b) (nth b 3))
     (define (edge-h i j)  ;; i strictly left of j, corridor unblocked
       (let ((bi (box i)) (bj (box j)))
         (and (< (c2 bi) (c1 bj))
              (let ((lo (max (+ (r1 bi) 1) (+ (r1 bj) 1)))
                    (hi (min (- (r2 bi) 1) (- (r2 bj) 1))))
                (and (<= lo hi)
                     (not (any? (lambda (k)
                                  (and (not (= k i)) (not (= k j))
                                       (>= (c2 (box k)) (+ (c2 bi) 1))
                                       (<= (c1 (box k)) (- (c1 bj) 1))
                                       (<= (max (+ (r1 (box k)) 1) lo)
                                           (min (- (r2 (box k)) 1) hi))))
                                (range 0 n)))
                     (list (- (c1 bj) (c2 bi) 1) i j 'h lo hi))))))
     (define (edge-v i j)  ;; i strictly above j
       (let ((bi (box i)) (bj (box j)))
         (and (< (r2 bi) (r1 bj))
              (let ((lo (max (+ (c1 bi) 1) (+ (c1 bj) 1)))
                    (hi (min (- (c2 bi) 1) (- (c2 bj) 1))))
                (and (<= lo hi)
                     (not (any? (lambda (k)
                                  (and (not (= k i)) (not (= k j))
                                       (>= (r2 (box k)) (+ (r2 bi) 1))
                                       (<= (r1 (box k)) (- (r1 bj) 1))
                                       (<= (max (+ (c1 (box k)) 1) lo)
                                           (min (- (c2 (box k)) 1) hi))))
                                (range 0 n)))
                     (list (- (r1 bj) (r2 bi) 1) i j 'v lo hi))))))
     (define edges  ;; (gap i j dir lo hi), cheapest first
       (sort-by (filter (lambda (e) e)
                        (flatmap (lambda (i)
                                   (flatmap (lambda (j)
                                              (if (= i j)
                                                  (list)
                                                  (list (edge-h i j)
                                                        (edge-v i j))))
                                            (range 0 n)))
                                 (range 0 n)))
                first))
     (define mst  ;; Kruskal over list components
       (let loop ((comps (map (lambda (i) (list i)) (range 0 n)))
                  (eds edges) (acc (list)))
         (if (null? eds)
             (reverse acc)
             (let* ((e (first eds))
                    (find-comp (lambda (x)
                                 (find (lambda (c) (member? x c)) comps)))
                    (ci (find-comp (second e)))
                    (cj (find-comp (third e))))
               (if (equal? ci cj)
                   (loop comps (rest eds) acc)
                   (loop (cons (append ci cj)
                               (filter (lambda (c)
                                         (and (not (equal? c ci))
                                              (not (equal? c cj))))
                                       comps))
                         (rest eds) (cons e acc)))))))
     (define (corridor out e)
       (let ((bi (box (second e))) (bj (box (third e)))
             (lo (fifth e)) (hi (nth e 5)))
         (if (eq? (fourth e) 'h)
             (let ((gc1 (+ (c2 bi) 1)) (gc2 (- (c1 bj) 1)))
               (paint-cells
                (paint-cells (paint-cells out
                                          (positions-in-rect lo gc1 lo gc2)
                                          3)
                             (positions-in-rect hi gc1 hi gc2) 3)
                (append (positions-in-rect (+ lo 1) (c2 bi)
                                           (- hi 1) (c2 bi))
                        (positions-in-rect (+ lo 1) (c1 bj)
                                           (- hi 1) (c1 bj)))
                0))
             (let ((gr1 (+ (r2 bi) 1)) (gr2 (- (r1 bj) 1)))
               (paint-cells
                (paint-cells (paint-cells out
                                          (positions-in-rect gr1 lo gr2 lo)
                                          3)
                             (positions-in-rect gr1 hi gr2 hi) 3)
                (append (positions-in-rect (r2 bi) (+ lo 1)
                                           (r2 bi) (- hi 1))
                        (positions-in-rect (r1 bj) (+ lo 1)
                                           (r1 bj) (- hi 1)))
                0)))))
     (reduce corridor g mst))))

written_solution: L-shaped border moves 1 cell inward; old L→bg, new L→border, old/new corners→8, new interior→8 with bg-color diagonal in min-square at corner adjacent to new L
program_solution:
(rule! (lambda (g)
  (let* ((h (rows g))
         (w (cols g)))
    (begin
      ;; Read the two input roles and the corner occupied by the outer L.
      (define bg (mode g))
      (define border (find (lambda (c) (!= c bg)) (grid-colors g)))
      (define top? (= (at g 0 (quotient w 2)) border))
      (define left? (= (at g (quotient h 2) 0) border))
      (define lc-r (if top? 0 (- h 1)))
      (define lc-c (if left? 0 (- w 1)))
      (define dr (if top? 1 -1))
      (define dc (if left? 1 -1))
      (define nlc-r (+ lc-r dr))
      (define nlc-c (+ lc-c dc))
      (define (range-inc a b)
        (if (<= a b) (range a (+ b 1)) (range b (+ a 1))))

      ;; Erase the old L, then draw its two arms one cell inward.
      (define s1 (cellmap g (r c v) bg))
      (define nlrow-cstart (+ lc-c (* 2 dc)))
      (define nlrow-cend (if (= dc 1) (- w 1) 0))
      (define nlrow-cells
        (map (lambda (c) (list nlc-r c))
             (range-inc nlrow-cstart nlrow-cend)))
      (define nlcol-rstart (+ lc-r (* 2 dr)))
      (define nlcol-rend (if (= dr 1) (- h 1) 0))
      (define nlcol-cells
        (map (lambda (r) (list r nlc-c))
             (range-inc nlcol-rstart nlcol-rend)))
      (define s2
        (recolor-cells s1 (append nlrow-cells nlcol-cells) border))

      ;; Fill the region beyond the inward L cyan, reserving both L corners.
      (define ni-rstart (+ nlc-r dr))
      (define ni-rend (if (= dr 1) (- h 1) 0))
      (define ni-cstart (+ nlc-c dc))
      (define ni-cend (if (= dc 1) (- w 1) 0))
      (define ni-cells
        (flatmap
          (lambda (r)
            (map (lambda (c) (list r c))
                 (range-inc ni-cstart ni-cend)))
          (range-inc ni-rstart ni-rend)))
      (define s3 (recolor-cells s2 ni-cells 8))
      (define s4 (set-cell s3 lc-r lc-c 8))
      (define s5 (set-cell s4 nlc-r nlc-c 8))

      ;; Restore a background-colored diagonal through the cyan rectangle.
      (define ni-h (+ 1 (abs (- ni-rend ni-rstart))))
      (define ni-w (+ 1 (abs (- ni-cend ni-cstart))))
      (define m (min ni-h ni-w))
      (define diag-cells
        (map (lambda (i)
               (list (+ ni-rstart (* i dr))
                     (+ ni-cstart (* i dc))))
             (range 0 m)))
      (recolor-cells s5 diag-cells bg)))))

(rule! (lambda (g)
  ;; Big solid mono-color "cups" carve thin single-color-bounded notches into
  ;; the noise. Each notch holds a marker line of color M (M = the color common
  ;; to every notch, tie-broken by rarest globally). Fill every notch (size >= 3)
  ;; entirely with M.
  (let* ((h (rows g)) (w (cols g))
         (dirs (list (cons 1 0) (cons -1 0) (cons 0 1) (cons 0 -1))))

    (define (inb r c) (and (>= r 0) (< r h) (>= c 0) (< c w)))
    (define gcount (make-hash))
    (for* ((r (range h)) (c (range w)))
      (hash-update! gcount (cv r c) add1 0))
    ;; wall mask: cells in a same-color component of size >= 8
    (define wall (make-hash))
    (define seenW (make-hash))
    (for* ((r (range h)) (c (range w)))
      (unless (hash-has-key? seenW (cons r c))
        (let ((col (cv r c)) (cells '()))
          (hash-set! seenW (cons r c) #t)
          (let loop ((stk (list (cons r c))))
            (when (pair? stk)
              (let* ((p (car stk)) (pr (car p)) (pc (cdr p)))
                (set! cells (cons p cells))
                (let ((nx (cdr stk)))
                  (for ((d dirs))
                    (let ((nr (+ pr (car d))) (nc (+ pc (cdr d))))
                      (when (and (inb nr nc)
                                 (not (hash-has-key? seenW (cons nr nc)))
                                 (= (cv nr nc) col))
                        (hash-set! seenW (cons nr nc) #t)
                        (set! nx (cons (cons nr nc) nx)))))
                  (loop nx)))))
          (when (>= (length cells) 8)
            (for ((p cells)) (hash-set! wall p #t))))))
    (define (wall? r c) (hash-has-key? wall (cons r c)))
    ;; regions of non-wall cells; keep those bounded by exactly one wall color
    (define seenR (make-hash))
    (define notches '())
    (for* ((r (range h)) (c (range w)))
      (when (and (not (wall? r c)) (not (hash-has-key? seenR (cons r c))))
        (let ((cells '()) (wcols (make-hash)))
          (hash-set! seenR (cons r c) #t)
          (let loop ((stk (list (cons r c))))
            (when (pair? stk)
              (let* ((p (car stk)) (pr (car p)) (pc (cdr p)))
                (set! cells (cons p cells))
                (let ((nx (cdr stk)))
                  (for ((d dirs))
                    (let ((nr (+ pr (car d))) (nc (+ pc (cdr d))))
                      (when (inb nr nc)
                        (if (wall? nr nc)
                            (hash-set! wcols (cv nr nc) #t)
                            (unless (hash-has-key? seenR (cons nr nc))
                              (hash-set! seenR (cons nr nc) #t)
                              (set! nx (cons (cons nr nc) nx)))))))
                  (loop nx)))))
          (when (= (hash-count wcols) 1)
            (set! notches (cons cells notches))))))
    ;; M = color common to all notches, rarest globally
    (define common #f)
    (for ((cells notches))
      (let ((cset (make-hash)))
        (for ((p cells)) (hash-set! cset (cv (car p) (cdr p)) #t))
        (if (not common)
            (set! common cset)
            (let ((nc (make-hash)))
              (for ((k (hash-keys common)))
                (when (hash-has-key? cset k) (hash-set! nc k #t)))
              (set! common nc)))))
    (define M
      (if (or (not common) (= (hash-count common) 0))
          -1
          (argmin (lambda (k) (hash-ref gcount k 0)) (hash-keys common))))
    (define fillset (make-hash))
    (when (>= M 0)
      (for ((cells notches))
        (when (>= (length cells) 3)
          (for ((p cells)) (hash-set! fillset p #t)))))
    (grid-from-fn h w
      (lambda (r c)
        (if (hash-has-key? fillset (cons r c)) M (cv r c)))))))

program_solution:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((rseps (map fst (full-rows g)))
                  (cseps (map fst (full-cols g))))
             (define (spans seps limit)
               (let loop
                    ((xs seps) (start 0) (acc (list)))
                    (if (empty? xs)
                        (reverse (if (< start limit)
                                     (cons (list start (- limit 1)) acc)
                                     acc))
                        (let ((sep (fst xs)))
                          (loop (cdr xs)
                                (+ sep 1)
                                (if (< start sep) (cons (list start (- sep 1)) acc) acc))))))
             (define rbands (spans rseps h))
             (define cbands (spans cseps w))
             (define blocks
               (flatmap (lambda (rb) (map (lambda (cb) (list rb cb)) cbands)) rbands))
             (define (block-cells block)
               (let* ((rb (fst block))
                      (cb (snd block))
                      (r0 (fst rb))
                      (r1 (snd rb))
                      (c0 (fst cb))
                      (c1 (snd cb)))
                 (flatmap (lambda (r) (map (lambda (c) (list r c)) (range c0 (+ c1 1))))
                          (range r0 (+ r1 1)))))
             (define (nonempty? block)
               (any? (lambda (p) (!= (at g (fst p) (snd p)) 0)) (block-cells block)))
             (let* ((src (fst (filter nonempty? blocks)))
                    (srb (fst src))
                    (scb (snd src))
                    (sr0 (fst srb))
                    (sc0 (fst scb))
                    (sh (+ 1 (- (snd srb) sr0)))
                    (sw (+ 1 (- (snd scb) sc0))))
               (reduce (lambda (acc block)
                         (let* ((rb (fst block))
                                (cb (snd block))
                                (r0 (fst rb))
                                (c0 (fst cb)))
                           (reduce (lambda (a p)
                                     (let* ((rr (fst p))
                                            (cc (snd p))
                                            (dr (- rr sr0))
                                            (dc (- cc sc0))
                                            (nr (+ r0 dr))
                                            (nc (+ c0 dc)))
                                       (if (and
                                             (<= dr (- sh 1))
                                             (<= dc (- sw 1))
                                             (in-bounds? nr nc h w))
                                           (set-cell a nr nc (at g rr cc))
                                           a)))
                                   acc
                                   (block-cells src))))
                       g
                       blocks))))))

written_solution: Swap roles: line endpoints become glyph stamps; glyph centers become line network nodes
program_solution:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (begin
             (define bg (mode g -1))
             (define objs (objects-8 g bg))
             (define (cell-in? cells r c) (member (list r c) cells))
             (define (neighbor-count cells p)
               (for/sum ((d all-8-deltas))
                 (if (cell-in? cells (+ (first p) (first d)) (+ (second p) (second d)))
                     1
                     0)))
             (define (line-endpoints obj)
               (let ((cells (obj-cells obj)))
                 (filter (lambda (p) (= (neighbor-count cells p) 1)) cells)))
             (define line-obj
               (find-first (lambda (obj)
                             (and
                               (> (obj-size obj) 1)
                               (= (length (line-endpoints obj)) 2)))
                           objs))
             (define line-color (obj-color line-obj))
             (define stamp-color
               (find-first (lambda (c) (!= c line-color)) (grid-colors g bg)))
             (define stamp-objs
               (filter (lambda (obj) (= (obj-color obj) stamp-color)) objs))
             (define stamp-cells (normalize-cells (obj-cells (first stamp-objs))))
             (define stamp-bb (bbox-of-cells stamp-cells))
             (define stamp-cr (quotient (+ (first stamp-bb) (third stamp-bb)) 2))
             (define stamp-cc (quotient (+ (second stamp-bb) (fourth stamp-bb)) 2))
             (define endpoints (line-endpoints line-obj))
             (define centers
               (map (lambda (obj)
                      (list (quotient (+ (obj-r1 obj) (obj-r2 obj)) 2)
                            (quotient (+ (obj-c1 obj) (obj-c2 obj)) 2)))
                    stamp-objs))
             (define network
               (for*/fold ((acc (empty-grid h w bg)))
                          ((i (range 0 (length centers))) (j (range (+ i 1) (length centers))))
                          (let ((a (list-ref centers i))
                                (b (list-ref centers j)))
                            (draw-line acc
                                       (first a)
                                       (second a)
                                       (first b)
                                       (second b)
                                       line-color))))
             (foldl (lambda (endpoint acc)
                      (foldl (lambda (p acc2)
                               (let ((nr (+ (first endpoint) (- (first p) stamp-cr)))
                                     (nc (+ (second endpoint) (- (second p) stamp-cc))))
                                 (if (and (>= nr 0) (< nr h) (>= nc 0) (< nc w))
                                     (set-cell acc2 nr nc stamp-color)
                                     acc2)))
                             acc
                             stamp-cells))
                    network
                    endpoints)))))

written_solution: edge markers (1s) extend their aligned 4x4 hollow frame in their direction (up/down/left/right) by repeated frame copies until grid edge
program_solution:
(rule!
 ;; Hollow 4x4 frames sit on a blank field; blue(1) strips on the grid
 ;; edges are extension markers. Each marker points at the frame whose
 ;; span it overlaps: that frame repeats as a chain of 4x4 frames
 ;; marching to the marked edge (clipped at the border). Output the
 ;; frames plus their chains on a clean background.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define frames  ;; (color r1 c1 r2 c2) per hollow 4x4 (12 cells)
       (map (lambda (o) (list (obj-color o) (obj-r1 o) (obj-c1 o)
                              (obj-r2 o) (obj-c2 o)))
            (filter (lambda (o) (and (= (obj-h o) 4) (= (obj-w o) 4)
                                     (= (obj-size o) 12)))
                    (objects-multicolor g 0))))
     (define markers  ;; (dir rmin rmax cmin cmax) per blue strip
       (map (lambda (o)
              (list (cond ((zero? (obj-r1 o)) 'up)
                          ((= (obj-r2 o) (- h 1)) 'down)
                          ((zero? (obj-c1 o)) 'left)
                          ((= (obj-c2 o) (- w 1)) 'right)
                          (else 'unknown))
                    (obj-r1 o) (obj-r2 o) (obj-c1 o) (obj-c2 o)))
            (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) 1)) (objects g 0))))
     (define (draw-frame out color r1 c1 r2 c2)
       (for/fold ((acc out))
                 ((p (filter (lambda (rc) (or (= (first rc) r1)
                                              (= (first rc) r2)
                                              (= (second rc) c1)
                                              (= (second rc) c2)))
                             (positions-in-rect r1 c1 r2 c2))))
         (if (in-bounds? (first p) (second p) h w)
             (set-cell acc (first p) (second p) color)
             acc)))
     (define (overlap? lo1 hi1 lo2 hi2)
       (not (or (< hi2 lo1) (< hi1 lo2))))
     (define (frame-for m)
       (find (lambda (f)
               (cond ((member? (first m) (list 'up 'down))
                      (overlap? (fourth m) (fifth m)
                                (third f) (fifth f)))
                     ((member? (first m) (list 'left 'right))
                      (overlap? (second m) (third m)
                                (second f) (fourth f)))
                     (else #f)))
             frames))
     (define (extend out m)
       (let ((f (frame-for m)) (dir (first m)))
         (cond ((eq? dir 'up)
                (let loop ((r (second f)) (acc out))
                  (if (< (- r 1) 0)
                      acc
                      (loop (- r 4)
                            (draw-frame acc (first f) (- r 4) (third f)
                                        (- r 1) (fifth f))))))
               ((eq? dir 'down)
                (let loop ((r (fourth f)) (acc out))
                  (if (>= (+ r 1) h)
                      acc
                      (loop (+ r 4)
                            (draw-frame acc (first f) (+ r 1) (third f)
                                        (+ r 4) (fifth f))))))
               ((eq? dir 'left)
                (let loop ((c (third f)) (acc out))
                  (if (< (- c 1) 0)
                      acc
                      (loop (- c 4)
                            (draw-frame acc (first f) (second f) (- c 4)
                                        (fourth f) (- c 1))))))
               ((eq? dir 'right)
                (let loop ((c (fifth f)) (acc out))
                  (if (>= (+ c 1) w)
                      acc
                      (loop (+ c 4)
                            (draw-frame acc (first f) (second f) (+ c 1)
                                        (fourth f) (+ c 4))))))
               (else out))))
     (for/fold ((out (for/fold ((o (empty-grid h w 0)))
                               ((f frames))
                       (draw-frame o (first f) (second f) (third f)
                                   (fourth f) (fifth f)))))
               ((m markers))
       (extend out m)))))

             (define tile-bb (bbox-of-cells (find-color g 5)))
             (define r0 (first tile-bb))
             (define c0 (second tile-bb))
             (define r1 (third tile-bb))
             (define c1 (fourth tile-bb))

             (define (col-has-5? c) (for/or ((r (range r0 (+ r1 1)))) (= (at g r c) 5)))

               (filter (lambda (r)
                         (and (row-has-5? r) (or (= r r0) (not (row-has-5? (- r 1))))))
                       (range r0 (+ r1 1))))

               (filter (lambda (c)
                         (and (col-has-5? c) (or (= c c0) (not (col-has-5? (- c 1))))))
                       (range c0 (+ c1 1))))

               (for*/list ((r (range 0 r0)) (c (range 0 w))
                   #:when

                 (list (at g r c) r c)))

               (find-first (lambda (e) (= (first e) color)) key-markers))

               (let* ((hit (key-for color))
                      (kr (second hit))
                      (kc (third hit)))
                 (for*/list ((dr (range 0 2)) (dc (range 0 2))
                     #:when
                     (= (at g (+ kr 1 dr) (+ kc 1 dc)) 1))
                   (list dr dc))))

               (let ((color (at g (+ tr 1) (+ tc 1))))
                 (if (key-for color)
                     (for/fold ((acc out))
                       ((p (mask-for color)))
                       (set-cell acc
                                 (+ (- tr r0) (first p))
                                 (+ (- tc c0) (second p))
                                 color))
                     out)))
             (for*/fold ((out (empty-grid oh ow 0)))
                        ((tr tile-rows) (tc tile-cols))
                        (paint-tile out tr tc))))))

(rule! (lambda (g)

                (w (cols g)))

             (define colors (grid-colors g 0))

                      (hh (+ 1 (- (third bb) (first bb))))

written_solution: Each shape: if has thin tail (perp dim 1, len>=2), move main rect by tail length; else rectangularize to bbox. Moved shapes render on top.
program_solution:
(rule!
 ;; Each color = a solid BODY rectangle plus (maybe) a 1-wide TAIL
 ;; arrow. A straight solid tail of length 2+ launches its body: the
 ;; body jumps tail-length cells in the tail's direction and the tail
 ;; vanishes. A shape without such a tail settles as its filled
 ;; bounding box. Jumpers paint over settlers.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define (largest-rect-in cells)  ;; scan order = tiebreak, as before
       (let ((bb (bbox-of-cells cells)))
         (rest
          (for*/fold ((best (list 1 (first bb) (second bb)
                                  (first bb) (second bb))))
                     ((r1 (range (first bb) (+ (third bb) 1)))
                      (c1 (range (second bb) (+ (fourth bb) 1)))
                      (r2 (range (first bb) (+ (third bb) 1)))
                      (c2 (range (second bb) (+ (fourth bb) 1))))
            (if (and (>= r2 r1) (>= c2 c1)
                     (> (* (+ 1 (- r2 r1)) (+ 1 (- c2 c1)))
                        (first best))
                     (all? (lambda (p) (member p cells))
                           (positions-in-rect r1 c1 r2 c2)))
                (list (* (+ 1 (- r2 r1)) (+ 1 (- c2 c1))) r1 c1 r2 c2)
                best)))))
     (define (process c)  ;; -> (cells color moved?)
       (let* ((cells (find-color g c))
              (bb (bbox-of-cells cells))
              (body (largest-rect-in cells))
              (body-cells (positions-in-rect (first body) (second body)
                                             (third body) (fourth body)))
              (tail (filter (lambda (p) (not (member p body-cells)))
                            cells))
              (settled (list (positions-in-rect (first bb) (second bb)
                                                (third bb) (fourth bb))
                             c #f)))
         (if (null? tail)
             settled
             (let* ((tb (bbox-of-cells tail))
                    (th (+ 1 (- (third tb) (first tb))))
                    (tw (+ 1 (- (fourth tb) (second tb))))
                    (dir (cond ((> (first tb) (third body)) 'down)
                               ((< (third tb) (first body)) 'up)
                               ((> (second tb) (fourth body)) 'right)
                               ((< (fourth tb) (second body)) 'left)
                               (else 'none)))
                    (vert (member? dir (list 'down 'up)))
                    (tlen (if vert th tw)))
               (if (and (not (eq? dir 'none))
                        (= 1 (if vert tw th))
                        (= (length tail) (* th tw))
                        (>= tlen 2))
                   (let ((dr (cond ((eq? dir 'down) tlen)
                                   ((eq? dir 'up) (- 0 tlen))
                                   (else 0)))
                         (dc (cond ((eq? dir 'right) tlen)
                                   ((eq? dir 'left) (- 0 tlen))
                                   (else 0))))
                     (list (map (lambda (p) (list (+ (first p) dr)
                                                  (+ (second p) dc)))
                               body-cells)
                           c #t))
                   settled)))))
     (define processed
       (map process (filter (lambda (c) (> c 0)) (grid-colors g))))
     (for/fold ((out (for/fold ((o (empty-grid h w 0)))
                               ((s (filter (lambda (p) (not (third p)))
                                           processed)))
                       (paint-cells o (first s) (second s)))))
               ((s (filter third processed)))
       (paint-cells out (first s) (second s))))))

written_solution: 8-columns extend down; 2-segments create walls: left wall at leftmost-1 if leftmost is on 8-column, right wall at rightmost+1 if any 8-column past leftmost; blocked 8-cols stop at 2-row
program_solution:
(rule!
 ;; Cyan(8) marks on the top row drop as pipes down the grid. A red(2)
 ;; bar row interrupts them: inside each red segment, every pipe keeps
 ;; the red cell it crosses and clears everything below it; walls rise
 ;; one column outside a pierced segment's ends, joined to the
 ;; outermost pipes by cap runs one row above the bar.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define eight-cols
       (filter (lambda (c) (= (at g 0 c) 8)) (range 0 w)))
     (define two-row
       (find-first (lambda (r) (any? (lambda (c) (= (at g r c) 2))
                                     (range 0 w)))
                   (range 0 h)))
     (define bar-row (- two-row 1))
     (define segments  ;; maximal red runs on the bar row: (start end)
       (let loop ((c 0) (acc (list)))
         (cond ((>= c w) (reverse acc))
               ((not (= (at g two-row c) 2)) (loop (+ c 1) acc))
               (else (let scan ((cc c))
                       (if (or (>= cc w) (not (= (at g two-row cc) 2)))
                           (loop cc (cons (list c (- cc 1)) acc))
                           (scan (+ cc 1))))))))
     (define (vline out c r0)  ;; cyan column from r0 to the floor
       (recolor-cells out (map (lambda (r) (list r c)) (range r0 h))
                      8))
     (define (do-segment out seg)
       (let* ((l2 (first seg)) (r2 (second seg))
              (seg8 (filter (lambda (c) (and (>= c l2) (<= c r2)))
                            eight-cols))
              (has-left (and (not (null? seg8))
                             (= (min-list seg8) l2)))
              (has-right (and (not (null? seg8))
                              (any? (lambda (c) (> c l2)) seg8)))
              (out1 (if has-left  ;; left wall + cap to first pipe
                        (recolor-cells
                         (vline out (- l2 1) bar-row)
                         (map (lambda (c) (list bar-row c))
                              (range (- l2 1) (+ (min-list seg8) 1)))
                         8)
                        out))
              (out2 (if has-right  ;; right wall + cap from last pipe
                        (recolor-cells
                         (vline out1 (+ r2 1) bar-row)
                         (map (lambda (c) (list bar-row c))
                              (range (max-list seg8) (+ r2 2)))
                         8)
                        out1))
              (out3 (for/fold ((o out2)) ((c seg8))  ;; pierce the bar
                      (recolor-cells (set-cell o two-row c 2)
                                     (map (lambda (r) (list r c))
                                          (range (+ two-row 1) h))
                                     0))))
         (for/fold ((o out3)) ((c (range l2 (+ r2 1))))
           (if (= (at g two-row c) 2)
               (set-cell o two-row c 2)
               o))))
     (for/fold ((out (for/fold ((o g)) ((c eight-cols))
                       (vline o c bar-row))))
               ((seg segments))
       (do-segment out seg)))))

         (let* ((all-pos (grid-positions g))
                (colors (unique (filter (lambda (v) (!= v 0))

                (bbox-for (lambda (col)
                            (let ((bb (bbox-of-cells (find-color g col))))
                              (list (first bb) (third bb) (second bb) (fourth bb)))))
                (interruption-set (lambda (col)
                                    (let* ((bbox (bbox-for col))
                                           (r1 (nth bbox 0))
                                           (r2 (nth bbox 1))
                                           (c1 (nth bbox 2))
                                           (c2 (nth bbox 3))
                                           (border (append (map (lambda (c) (list r1 c))
                                                                (range c1 (+ c2 1)))
                                                           (map (lambda (c) (list r2 c))
                                                                (range c1 (+ c2 1)))
                                                           (map (lambda (r) (list r c1))
                                                                (range r1 (+ r2 1)))
                                                           (map (lambda (r) (list r c2))
                                                                (range r1 (+ r2 1)))))
                                           (values (map (lambda (p)
                                                          (at g (first p) (second p)))
                                                        border))
                                           (non-self (filter (lambda (v)
                                                               (and (!= v 0) (!= v col)))
                                                             values)))
                                      (unique non-self))))
                (area-for (lambda (col)
                            (let* ((bbox (bbox-for col))
                                   (h1 (+ 1 (- (nth bbox 1) (nth bbox 0))))
                                   (w1 (+ 1 (- (nth bbox 3) (nth bbox 2)))))
                              (* h1 w1))))
                (sort-order (lambda (cols)
                              (reduce (lambda (state _)
                                        (let ((order (first state))
                                              (remaining (second state)))
                                          (if (null? remaining)
                                              state
                                              (let* ((in-degs (map (lambda (c)
                                                                     (count-if (lambda (other)
                                                                                 (and
                                                                                   (member? other
                                                                                            remaining)
                                                                                   (member? c
                                                                                            (interruption-set other))))
                                                                               remaining))
                                                                   remaining))
                                                     (min-d (min-list in-degs))
                                                     (candidates (filter (lambda (c)
                                                                           (= min-d
                                                                              (count-if (lambda (other)
                                                                                          (and
                                                                                            (member? other

                                                                                                     (interruption-set other))))
                                                                                        remaining)))

                                      (list (list) cols)

                (n (length order))

                              (layer (min r c ar ac)))

                   (when (= (at g r c) 5) (set! result (set-cell result r c 7))))
             (for* ((r (range (+ nine-row 1) h)) (c (range 0 w)))
                   (when (= (at g r c) 6) (set! result (set-cell result r c 7))))

             (for-each (lambda (obj)
                         (define cells (obj-cells obj))
                         (define rs (map first cells))
                         (define cs (map second cells))

                         (define maxr (max-list rs))
                         (define minc (min-list cs))
                         (define maxc (max-list cs))

                         (define bw (+ 1 (- maxc minc)))
                         (define chosen
                           (if (> bh bw)
                               (if (and (< maxr (- h 1)) (= (at g (+ maxr 1) minc) 2))
                                   (list minr minc)
                                   (if (and (> minr 0) (= (at g (- minr 1) minc) 2))
                                       (list maxr minc)
                                       (list maxr minc)))
                               (if (and (> minc 0) (= (at g minr (- minc 1)) 2))
                                   (list minr maxc)
                                   (if (and
                                         (< maxc (- w 1))
                                         (= (at g minr (+ maxc 1)) 2))
                                       (list minr minc)
                                       (list minr minc)))))
                         (define rr (first chosen))
                         (define cc (second chosen))
                         (define ref-r (- (* 2 nine-row) rr))
                         (set! result (set-cell result rr cc 2))
                         (when
                           (and (>= ref-r 0) (< ref-r nine-row))
                           (set! result (set-cell result ref-r cc 5))))
                       (objects six-mask 0))
             (for* ((r (range (+ nine-row 1) h)) (c (range 0 w)))

written_solution: Connect the 9 markers along the clean 8-corridor path farthest from 7 cells
program_solution:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (begin
             (define marks (find-color g 9))
             (if (< (length marks) 2)
                 g
                 (let* ((start (fst marks))
                        (goal (snd marks))
                        (dirs (list (list 0 1) (list 1 0) (list 0 -1) (list -1 0)))
                        (best-path #f)
                        (best-len 999)
                        (best-turns 999))
                   (define (adjacent-7? r c)
                     (for/or ((d dirs))
                             (let ((nr (+ r (fst d)))
                                   (nc (+ c (snd d))))
                               (and (in-bounds? nr nc h w) (= (at g nr nc) 7)))))
                   (define (allowed? r c)
                     (let ((v (at g r c)))
                       (and (or (= v 8) (= v 9)) (or (= v 9) (not (adjacent-7? r c))))))
                   (define (better? len turns)
                     (or (< len best-len) (and (= len best-len) (< turns best-turns))))
                   (define (dfs cur path prev-dir turns)
                     (let ((len (length path)))
                       (when
                         (and
                           (<= len best-len)
                           (or (< len best-len) (< turns best-turns)))
                         (if (equal? cur goal)
                             (when
                               (better? len turns)
                               (set! best-len len)
                               (set! best-turns turns)
                               (set! best-path path))
                             (for-each (lambda (d)
                                         (let* ((nr (+ (fst cur) (fst d)))
                                                (nc (+ (snd cur) (snd d)))
                                                (np (list nr nc)))
                                           (when
                                             (and
                                               (in-bounds? nr nc h w)
                                               (allowed? nr nc)
                                               (not (member np path)))
                                             (dfs np
                                                  (append path (list np))
                                                  d
                                                  (if (or
                                                        (not prev-dir)
                                                        (equal? prev-dir d))
                                                      turns
                                                      (+ turns 1))))))
                                       dirs)))))
                   (dfs start (list start) #f 0)
                   (if best-path (paint-cells g best-path 9) g)))))))

written_solution: Sort pixels by column, fill 3x3 output in snake/boustrophedon order
program_solution:
(rule!
  (lambda (g)
    (let* ((h (rows g))
           (w (cols g))
           ;; Keep each colored cell as an independent (row, column, color)
           ;; record, then order records by column and break ties by row.
           (cells
            (for*/list ((r (range 0 h))
                        (c (range 0 w))
                        #:when (!= (at g r c) 0))
              (list r c (at g r c))))
           (sorted-cells
            (sort cells
                  (lambda (a b)
                    (if (= (second a) (second b))
                        (< (first a) (first b))
                        (< (second a) (second b))))))
           (colors (map third sorted-cells)))
      ;; Pack the ordered colors into a 3x3 snake: even rows run left-to-right
      ;; and the middle row runs right-to-left; unused cells stay black.
      (build-grid 3 3 (r c)
        (let* ((idx
                (if (zero? (remainder r 2))
                    (+ (* r 3) c)
                    (+ (* r 3) (- 2 c)))))
          (if (< idx (length colors))
              (list-ref colors idx)
              0))))))

written_solution: Fill horizontal gaps, then at each gap/vertical column, fill cells above each anchor with its color
program_solution:
(rule!
 ;; Dashed horizontal lines fill solid across their span. Then every
 ;; special column — a dash GAP, or one holding a stray vertical mark —
 ;; floods vertically: each nonzero anchor in the column paints
 ;; everything above it (down to the previous anchor) in its color.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define h-lines  ;; (color row cols) where the color runs 2+ long
       (flatmap
        (lambda (r)
          (map (lambda (v)
                 (list v r (filter (lambda (c) (= (at g r c) v))
                                   (range 0 w))))
               (filter (lambda (v)
                         (let ((cols (filter (lambda (c)
                                               (= (at g r c) v))
                                             (range 0 w))))
                           (any? (lambda (i) (= (+ (nth cols i) 1)
                                                (nth cols (+ i 1))))
                                 (range 0 (- (length cols) 1)))))
                       (remove-duplicates
                        (filter (lambda (v) (> v 0)) (row g r))))))
        (range 0 h)))
     (define (in-h-line? r c)
       (any? (lambda (line) (and (= (second line) r)
                                 (member? c (third line))))
             h-lines))
     (define phase1  ;; dashes solidified (reverse order: leftmost wins)
       (for/fold ((out g)) ((line (reverse h-lines)))
         (paint-cells out
                      (positions-in-rect (second line)
                                         (min-list (third line))
                                         (second line)
                                         (max-list (third line)))
                      (first line))))
     (define gap-cols  ;; in-span columns each dash skipped
       (remove-duplicates
        (flatmap (lambda (line)
                   (filter (lambda (c) (not (member? c (third line))))
                           (range (min-list (third line))
                                  (+ (max-list (third line)) 1))))
                 h-lines)))
     (define stray-cols  ;; columns of nonzero cells outside all dashes
       (remove-duplicates
        (map second
             (filter (lambda (p)
                       (and (> (at g (first p) (second p)) 0)
                            (not (in-h-line? (first p) (second p)))))
                     (grid-positions g)))))
     (for/fold ((out phase1))
               ((col (remove-duplicates (append gap-cols stray-cols))))
       (let loop ((anchors (filter (lambda (rv) (> (second rv) 0))
                                   (map (lambda (r)
                                          (list r (at phase1 r col)))
                                        (range 0 h))))
                  (prev -1) (grid out))
         (if (null? anchors)
             grid
             (loop (rest anchors) (first (first anchors))
                   (paint-cells grid
                                (positions-in-rect
                                 (+ prev 1) col
                                 (- (first (first anchors)) 1) col)
                                (second (first anchors))))))))))

written_solution: 2-color pattern + indicator cells → 2×2 kaleidoscope with color mapping from indicator positions
program_solution:
(rule!
 ;; The largest solid non-background rectangle is the PATTERN, drawn in
 ;; a MAJOR and a MINOR color. It mirrors into a 2x2 arrangement:
 ;; flip-lr to the right, flip-ud below, both on the diagonal.
 ;; Indicator dots dropped outside the pattern tell each mirrored block
 ;; what color its major/minor roles become (a role with no indicator
 ;; vanishes). Rebuild all four blocks on a blank field.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define rect  ;; largest all-nonzero rectangle, scan order as tiebreak
       (rest (for*/fold ((best (list 0 0 0 0 0)))
                        ((r1 (range 0 h)) (r2 (range r1 h))
                         (c1 (range 0 w)) (c2 (range c1 w)))
               (if (and (> (* (+ 1 (- r2 r1)) (+ 1 (- c2 c1)))
                           (first best))
                        (all? (lambda (p) (> (at g (first p) (second p))
                                             0))
                              (positions-in-rect r1 c1 r2 c2)))
                   (list (* (+ 1 (- r2 r1)) (+ 1 (- c2 c1))) r1 c1 r2 c2)
                   best))))
     (define pr1 (first rect))
     (define pc1 (second rect))
     (define pr2 (third rect))
     (define pc2 (fourth rect))
     (define ph (+ 1 (- pr2 pr1)))
     (define pw (+ 1 (- pc2 pc1)))
     (define pat (subgrid g pr1 pc1 pr2 pc2))
     (define ranked
       (sort-by (map (lambda (c) (list c (length (find-color pat c))))
                     (filter (lambda (c) (> c 0)) (grid-colors pat)))
                (lambda (f) (- (second f)))))
     (define major (first (first ranked)))
     (define minor (first (second ranked)))
     (define (block-key r c)
       (+ (* 2 (if (< r (+ pr1 ph)) 0 1)) (if (< c (+ pc1 pw)) 0 1)))
     (define (pat-at r c)  ;; pattern value, mirrored per block; #f outside
       (let ((lr (if (< r (+ pr1 ph)) (- r pr1) (- r (+ pr1 ph))))
             (lc (if (< c (+ pc1 pw)) (- c pc1) (- c (+ pc1 pw)))))
         (and (>= lr 0) (< lr ph) (>= lc 0) (< lc pw)
              (at pat
                  (if (>= r (+ pr1 ph)) (- ph 1 lr) lr)
                  (if (>= c (+ pc1 pw)) (- pw 1 lc) lc)))))
     (define indicators  ;; (block-key role-value color) per outside dot
       (map (lambda (p)
              (list (block-key (first p) (second p))
                    (pat-at (first p) (second p))
                    (at g (first p) (second p))))
            (filter (lambda (p)
                      (and (> (at g (first p) (second p)) 0)
                           (not (and (>= (first p) pr1)
                                     (<= (first p) pr2)
                                     (>= (second p) pc1)
                                     (<= (second p) pc2)))))
                    (grid-positions g))))
     (define (mapped key role)
       (if (zero? key)
           role
           (let ((hit (find (lambda (i) (and (= (first i) key)
                                             (= (second i) role)))
                            indicators)))
             (if hit (third hit) 0))))
     (build-grid h w (r c)
                 (let ((pv (pat-at r c)))
                   (cond ((not pv) 0)
                         ((= pv major) (mapped (block-key r c) major))
                         ((= pv minor) (mapped (block-key r c) minor))
                         (else 0)))))))

written_solution: Each shape forms a path. Pack shapes left-to-right so each entry (leftmost cell) connects to previous shapes exit (other endpoint of path)
program_solution:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (begin
             (define objs (objects-multicolor g 0))
             (define (obj-leftmost-col o) (min-of second (obj-cells o)))
             (define sorted-objs (sort-by objs obj-leftmost-col))
             (define (cell-deg cells c)
               (count-if (lambda (o)
                           (or
                             (and
                               (= (first o) (first c))
                               (= (abs (- (second o) (second c))) 1))
                             (and
                               (= (second o) (second c))
                               (= (abs (- (first o) (first c))) 1))))
                         cells))
             (define (obj-info o)
               (let* ((cells (obj-cells o))
                      (sorted (sort-by cells
                                       (lambda (c) (+ (* 100 (second c)) (first c)))))
                      (leftmost (first sorted))
                      (color (at g (first leftmost) (second leftmost)))
                      (endpoints (filter (lambda (c) (= (cell-deg cells c) 1)) cells))
                      (other-end (find (lambda (c) (!= c leftmost)) endpoints))
                      (exit (if other-end other-end leftmost)))
                 (list cells leftmost exit color)))
             (define infos (map obj-info sorted-objs))
             (define (shift-cells cells dr dc)
               (map (lambda (c) (list (+ (first c) dr) (+ (second c) dc))) cells))
             (define (process is prev-exit acc)
               (if (null? is)
                   acc
                   (let* ((info (first is))
                          (cells (nth info 0))
                          (leftmost (nth info 1))
                          (exit (nth info 2))
                          (color (nth info 3))
                          (target-row (first prev-exit))
                          (target-col (+ (second prev-exit) 1))
                          (dr (- target-row (first leftmost)))
                          (dc (- target-col (second leftmost)))
                          (new-cells (shift-cells cells dr dc))
                          (new-exit (list (+ (first exit) dr) (+ (second exit) dc)))
                          (cells-with-color (map (lambda (c)
                                                   (list (first c) (second c) color))
                                                 new-cells)))
                     (process (cdr is) new-exit (append acc cells-with-color)))))
             (define first-info (first infos))
             (define first-cells (nth first-info 0))
             (define first-color (nth first-info 3))
             (define first-exit (nth first-info 2))
             (define first-with-color
               (map (lambda (c) (list (first c) (second c) first-color)) first-cells))
             (define all-cells (process (cdr infos) first-exit first-with-color))
             (define max-col (max-of second all-cells))
             (define out-w (+ max-col 1))
             (define empty-g (build-grid h out-w (r c) 0))
             (reduce (lambda (gg cell)
                       (set-cell gg (first cell) (second cell) (nth cell 2)))
                     empty-g
                     all-cells)))))

(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((all-vals (apply append g))
                (unique-vals (unique all-vals))
                (color-counts (map (lambda (v)
                                     (cons v (count-if (lambda (x) (= x v)) all-vals)))
                                   unique-vals))
                (sorted-colors (sort-by color-counts (lambda (p) (* -1 (snd p)))))
                (zone-colors (map fst
                                  (list (nth sorted-colors 0) (nth sorted-colors 1))))
                (cell-zone (lambda (r c)
                             (let ((v (at g r c)))
                               (if (member? v zone-colors)
                                   v
                                   (let* ((neighbor-positions (filter (lambda (p)
                                                                        (in-bounds? (fst p)
                                                                                    (snd p)
                                                                                    h
                                                                                    w))
                                                                      (list (cons (- r
                                                                                     1)
                                                                                  c)
                                                                            (cons (+ r
                                                                                     1)
                                                                                  c)
                                                                            (cons r
                                                                                  (- c
                                                                                     1))
                                                                            (cons r
                                                                                  (+ c
                                                                                     1)))))
                                          (neighbor-vals (filter (lambda (v2)
                                                                   (member? v2
                                                                            zone-colors))
                                                                 (map (lambda (p)
                                                                        (at g
                                                                            (fst p)
                                                                            (snd p)))
                                                                      neighbor-positions)))
                                          (counts-each (map (lambda (v2)
                                                              (cons v2
                                                                    (count-if (lambda (x)
                                                                                (= x v2))
                                                                              neighbor-vals)))
                                                            (unique neighbor-vals))))
                                     (if (null? counts-each)
                                         0
                                         (fst (pick-max counts-each snd))))))))
                (marker-cells (filter (lambda (p)
                                        (not (member? (at g (fst p) (snd p))
                                                      zone-colors)))
                                      (grid-positions g)))
                (marker-info (map (lambda (p)
                                    (list (fst p)
                                          (snd p)
                                          (at g (fst p) (snd p))
                                          (cell-zone (fst p) (snd p))))
                                  marker-cells))
                (zone-to-marker (lambda (zone)
                                  (let ((matches (filter (lambda (m) (= (nth m 3) zone))
                                                         marker-info)))
                                    (if (null? matches) 0 (nth (first matches) 2))))))
           (cellmap g
                    (r c v)
                    (let* ((on-diagonal (for/or ((m marker-info))
                                                (let ((mr (nth m 0))
                                                      (mc (nth m 1)))
                                                  (or
                                                    (= (- r c) (- mr mc))
                                                    (= (+ r c) (+ mr mc))))))
                           (zone (cell-zone r c)))
                      (if on-diagonal (zone-to-marker zone) v))))))

(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (begin
             (define markers
               (filter (lambda (rc) (!= (at g (first rc) (second rc)) 0))
                       (apply append
                              (map (lambda (r)
                                     (map (lambda (c) (list r c)) (range 0 w)))
                                   (range 0 h)))))

                                                (max (abs (- r (first m)))
                                                     (abs (- c (second m)))))

                                               (range 0 (length markers))))

                             (man-dists (map (lambda (m)
                                               (+ (abs (- r (first m)))

program_solution:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((bg 7)
                  (zero-comps (filter (lambda (obj)
                                        (and
                                          (zero? (obj-color obj))
                                          (let* ((hh (+ 1 (- (obj-r2 obj) (obj-r1 obj))))
                                                 (ww (+ 1 (- (obj-c2 obj) (obj-c1 obj)))))
                                            (and (>= (max hh ww) 6) (<= (min hh ww) 3)))))
                                      (objects g bg))))
             (define (score-rect r1 c1 r2 c2)
               (for*/sum ((r (range r1 (+ r2 1))) (c (range c1 (+ c2 1))))
                         (let ((v (at g r c))) (if (and (!= v 0) (!= v bg)) 1 0))))
             (define (horizontal? obj)
               (>= (+ 1 (- (obj-c2 obj) (obj-c1 obj)))
                   (+ 1 (- (obj-r2 obj) (obj-r1 obj)))))
             (define (hdir obj)
               (let* ((r1 (obj-r1 obj))
                      (r2 (obj-r2 obj))
                      (c1 (obj-c1 obj))
                      (c2 (obj-c2 obj))
                      (left (score-rect r1 c1 r2 (+ c1 2)))
                      (right (score-rect r1 (- c2 2) r2 c2)))
                 (cond ((> left right) 0) ((> right left) 1) (else #f))))
             (define (vdir obj)
               (let* ((r1 (obj-r1 obj))
                      (r2 (obj-r2 obj))
                      (c1 (obj-c1 obj))
                      (c2 (obj-c2 obj))
                      (top (score-rect r1 c1 (+ r1 2) c2))
                      (bottom (score-rect (- r2 2) c1 r2 c2)))
                 (cond ((> top bottom) 0) ((> bottom top) 1) (else #f))))
             (define hfb
               (let ((dirs (filter (lambda (x) (not (eq? x #f)))
                                   (map hdir (filter horizontal? zero-comps)))))
                 (if (null? dirs) 0 (mode-list dirs))))
             (define vfb
               (let ((dirs (filter (lambda (x) (not (eq? x #f)))
                                   (map vdir
                                        (filter (lambda (obj) (not (horizontal? obj)))
                                                zero-comps)))))
                 (if (null? dirs) 0 (mode-list dirs))))
             (define (copy-block acc sr sc dr dc nr nc)
               (reduce (lambda (a p)
                         (let* ((rr (first p))
                                (cc (second p))
                                (tr (+ dr (- rr sr)))
                                (tc (+ dc (- cc sc))))
                           (set-cell a tr tc (at g rr cc))))
                       acc
                       (positions-in-rect sr sc (+ sr (- nr 1)) (+ sc (- nc 1)))))
             (define (process acc obj)
               (let* ((r1 (obj-r1 obj))
                      (c1 (obj-c1 obj))
                      (r2 (obj-r2 obj))
                      (c2 (obj-c2 obj))
                      (hh (+ 1 (- r2 r1)))
                      (ww (+ 1 (- c2 c1)))
                      (cleared (paint-cells acc (positions-in-rect r1 c1 r2 c2) bg)))
                 (if (horizontal? obj)
                     (let* ((d (let ((x (hdir obj))) (if (eq? x #f) hfb x)))
                            (src-c (if (zero? d) c1 (- c2 2)))
                            (dst-c (if (zero? d) (- c2 2) c1)))
                       (copy-block cleared r1 src-c r1 dst-c hh 3))
                     (let* ((d (let ((x (vdir obj))) (if (eq? x #f) vfb x)))
                            (src-r (if (zero? d) r1 (- r2 2)))
                            (dst-r (if (zero? d) (- r2 2) r1)))
                       (copy-block cleared src-r c1 dst-r c1 3 ww)))))
             (reduce process g zero-comps)))))

written_solution: draw lines from 3-square to axis-aligned colored pixels
program_solution:
(rule! (lambda (g)
  (let* ((h (rows g))
         (w (cols g))
         ;; Find the 3-square
         (threes (find-color g 3))
         ;; Top edge of the threes bbox
         (tr1 (apply min (map first threes)))
         ;; Left edge of the threes bbox
         (tc1 (apply min (map second threes)))
         ;; Bottom edge of the threes bbox
         (tr2 (apply max (map first threes)))
         ;; Right edge of the threes bbox
         (tc2 (apply max (map second threes)))
         ;; Find colored pixels (non-0, non-3)
         (pixels (for*/list ((r (range 0 h)) (c (range 0 w))
                             #:when (let ((v (cell-at g r c)))
                                      (and (not (= v 0)) (not (= v 3)))))
                   (list r c (cell-at g r c))))
         ;; Mutable lookup table for result
         (result (make-hash)))
    ;; Copy grid
    (for* ((r (range 0 h)) (c (range 0 w)))
      (hash-set! result (list r c) (cell-at g r c)))
    ;; For each pixel, check if axis-aligned with 3-square
    (for ((px pixels))
      (let ((pr (first px)) (pc (second px)) (pcolor (third px)))
        ;; Same row as top or bottom of square?
        (cond
          ;; Pixel on same row as square, to the right
          ((and (>= pr tr1) (<= pr tr2) (> pc tc2))
           (for ((c (range (+ tc2 1) pc)))
             (hash-set! result (list pr c) pcolor)))
          ;; To the left
          ((and (>= pr tr1) (<= pr tr2) (< pc tc1))
           (for ((c (range (+ pc 1) tc1)))
             (hash-set! result (list pr c) pcolor)))
          ;; Same col as square, below
          ((and (>= pc tc1) (<= pc tc2) (> pr tr2))
           (for ((r (range (+ tr2 1) pr)))
             (hash-set! result (list r pc) pcolor)))
          ;; Above
          ((and (>= pc tc1) (<= pc tc2) (< pr tr1))
           (for ((r (range (+ pr 1) tr1)))
             (hash-set! result (list r pc) pcolor))))))
    (grid-from-fn h w
      (lambda (r c)
        (hash-ref result (list r c) 0))))))

 ;; top; the last touching blob decides.)

   (let ()
     (define oblocks
       (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) 7)) (objects g 0)))
     (define gblocks
       (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) 5)) (objects g 0)))
     (define (touch-flags ob gb)  ;; (top left bottom right) of ob's bbox
       (let ((r1 (obj-r1 ob)) (c1 (obj-c1 ob))
             (r2 (obj-r2 ob)) (c2 (obj-c2 ob)))
         (for*/fold ((top #f) (left #f) (bottom #f) (right #f)
                     #:result (list top left bottom right))
                    ((gc (obj-cells gb)) (d cardinal-deltas))
           (let ((gr (first gc)) (gcc (second gc))
                 (nr (+ (first gc) (first d)))
                 (nc (+ (second gc) (second d))))
             (if (and (>= nr r1) (<= nr r2) (>= nc c1) (<= nc c2)
                      (= (at g nr nc) 7))
                 (cond ((< gr r1)
                        (cond ((= nc c2) (values top left bottom #t))
                              ((= nc c1) (values top #t bottom right))
                              (else (values #t left bottom right))))
                       ((> gr r2)
                        (cond ((= nc c2) (values top left bottom #t))
                              ((= nc c1) (values top #t bottom right))
                              (else (values top left #t right))))
                       ((< gcc c1)
                        (cond ((= nr r2) (values top left #t right))
                              ((= nr r1) (values #t left bottom right))
                              (else (values top #t bottom right))))
                       ((> gcc c2)
                        (cond ((= nr r2) (values top left #t right))
                              ((= nr r1) (values #t left bottom right))
                              (else (values top left bottom #t))))
                       (else (values #t left bottom right)))
                 (values top left bottom right))))))

               (for/fold ((size 0) (dir 0) #:result (list size dir))
                         ((gb gblocks))

(rule!
  ;; Motif GROUPS on a dominant background: cells cluster at chebyshev
  ;; distance <= 2; the LARGEST single-color cluster is the key group.
  ;; Output = its bbox interior (inset 2), keeping only the group color.
  (lambda (g)
    (let* ((bg (mode g -1))
           (cells (filter (lambda (p) (!= (at g (first p) (second p)) bg))
                          (grid-positions g)))
           (clusters
             (let loop ((remaining cells) (acc (list)))
               (if (null? remaining)
                   acc
                   (let grow ((queue (list (first remaining)))
                              (mine (list))
                              (far (rest remaining)))
                     (if (null? queue)
                         (loop far (cons mine acc))
                         (let* ((cur (first queue))
                                (near (filter (lambda (p)
                                                (and (<= (abs (- (first p) (first cur))) 2)
                                                     (<= (abs (- (second p) (second cur))) 2)))
                                              far))
                                (rest-far (filter (lambda (p) (not (member p near))) far)))
                           (grow (append (rest queue) near) (cons cur mine) rest-far)))))))
           (single-color
             (filter (lambda (cl)
                       (= 1 (length (unique (map (lambda (p) (at g (first p) (second p))) cl)))))
                     clusters))
           (target (pick-max single-color length))
           (color (at g (first (first target)) (second (first target))))
           (bb (bbox-of-cells target))
           (ir1 (+ (first bb) 2))
           (ic1 (+ (second bb) 2)))
      (build-grid (- (- (third bb) (first bb)) 3)
                  (- (- (fourth bb) (second bb)) 3)
                  (i j)
        (let ((v (at g (+ ir1 i) (+ ic1 j))))
          (if (= v color) color bg))))))

written_solution: restore checkerboard, detect frame outline + content shapes from disruptions, draw solid frame with content rects inside
program_solution:
(rule!
 ;; A checkerboard background is disturbed by a FRAME (the most common
 ;; off-pattern color) and loose content blocks. Restore the
 ;; checkerboard, redraw the frame outline empty, and re-shelve the
 ;; blocks inside it: stacked along the frame's long axis with 1-cell
 ;; gaps (the group centered), each block centered on the cross axis.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define bg-even (at g 0 0))
     (define bg-odd (at g 1 1))
     (define (expected r c)
       (if (and (= 1 (modulo r 2)) (= 1 (modulo c 2))) bg-odd bg-even))
     (define disruptions  ;; (r c v) cells breaking the checkerboard
       (fold-cells g (list)
                   (lambda (acc r c v)
                     (if (= v (expected r c))
                         acc
                         (append acc (list (list r c v)))))))
     (define (cells-of col)
       (filter (lambda (cell) (= (third cell) col)) disruptions))
     (define by-count  ;; disruption colors, most frequent first
       (sort-by (unique (map third disruptions))
                (lambda (col) (- 0 (length (cells-of col))))))
     (define frame-color (first by-count))
     (define fbb (bbox-of-cells (cells-of frame-color)))
     (define fr1 (first fbb)) (define fc1 (second fbb))
     (define fr2 (third fbb)) (define fc2 (fourth fbb))
     (define horizontal (>= (- fc2 fc1) (- fr2 fr1)))
     (define contents  ;; (color r1 c1 h w) in shelf order
       (sort-by (map (lambda (col)
                       (let ((bb (bbox-of-cells (cells-of col))))
                         (list col (first bb) (second bb)
                               (+ 1 (- (third bb) (first bb)))
                               (+ 1 (- (fourth bb) (second bb))))))
                     (rest by-count))
                (lambda (c) (nth c (if horizontal 2 1)))))
     (define base  ;; clean board + hollow frame
       (paint-cells (erase-cells (grid-from-fn h w expected)
                                 (positions-in-rect (+ fr1 1) (+ fc1 1)
                                                    (- fr2 1) (- fc2 1))
                                 bg-even)
                    (filter (lambda (p) (or (= (first p) fr1)
                                            (= (first p) fr2)
                                            (= (second p) fc1)
                                            (= (second p) fc2)))
                            (positions-in-rect fr1 fc1 fr2 fc2))
                    frame-color))
     (define ir1 (+ fr1 1))
     (define ic1 (+ fc1 1))
     (define ih (- fr2 fr1 1))
     (define iw (- fc2 fc1 1))
     (define start  ;; centered group start along the long axis
       (+ (if horizontal ic1 ir1)
          (quotient (- (if horizontal iw ih)
                       (+ (apply + (map (lambda (c)
                                          (nth c (if horizontal 4 3)))
                                        contents))
                          (- (length contents) 1)))
                    2)))
     (let loop ((cs contents) (cur start) (grid base))
       (if (null? cs)
           grid
           (let* ((blk (first cs))
                  (bh (nth blk 3))
                  (bw (nth blk 4))
                  (r0 (if horizontal (+ ir1 (quotient (- ih bh) 2)) cur))
                  (c0 (if horizontal cur (+ ic1 (quotient (- iw bw) 2)))))
             (loop (rest cs)
                   (+ cur (if horizontal bw bh) 1)
                   (paint-cells grid
                                (positions-in-rect r0 c0 (+ r0 bh -1)
                                                   (+ c0 bw -1))
                                (first blk)))))))))

         (w (cols g))

          (for/list ((o all-objs)
                     #:when (> (length (obj-cells o)) 1))
            (let ((bb (obj-bbox o)))
              (list (obj-color o) (first bb) (second bb) (third bb) (fourth bb)))))

          (for/list ((o all-objs)
                     #:when (= (length (obj-cells o)) 1))
            (obj-color o)))
         (color-counts
          (let loop ((cs single-colors) (acc (hash)))
            (cond
              ((null? cs) acc)
              (else
               (let ((c (car cs)))
                 (loop (cdr cs) (hash-set acc c (+ 1 (hash-ref acc c 0))))))))))

            (for*/fold ((out g)) ((r (range 0 h)) (c (range 0 w)))
              (let ((v (cell-at g r c)))
                (cond
                  ((= v 0) out)
                  (else
                   ;; Check if this cell is inside any rect bbox of the same color

                          (for/or ((rect rects))
                            (and (= (first rect) v)
                                 (>= r (second rect))
                                 (<= r (fourth rect))
                                 (>= c (third rect))
                                 (<= c (fifth rect))))))
                     (if is-rect out (set-cell out r c 0))))))))

           (out2
            (for/fold ((out out1)) ((color (hash-keys color-counts)))
              (let ((count (hash-ref color-counts color)))
                ;; Find matching rect

                     (let* ((rect (car rs))
                            (r1 (second rect)) (c1 (third rect))
                            (r2 (fourth rect)) (c2 (fifth rect))
                            (rh (+ 1 (- r2 r1)))
                            (rw (+ 1 (- c2 c1)))

                            (iw (- rw 2))

(rule! (lambda (g)

             (define all-pos
               (flatmap (lambda (r) (map (lambda (c) (list r c)) (range 0 (- w 1))))
                        (range 0 (- h 1))))

               (filter (lambda (rc)
                         (let ((r (first rc))

                             (= (at g (+ r 1) c) 2)
                             (= (at g r (+ c 1)) 2)

                       (let ((sq (first squares)))
