                      (sr (first sq))
                      (sc (second sq))
                      (row-aligned (and (>= br sr) (<= br (+ sr 1))))
                      (col-aligned (and (>= bc sc) (<= bc (+ sc 1)))))

program_solution:
(rule! (lambda (g)
  (define seed (first (positions-of g (lambda (v) (= v 3)))))
  (define sr (first seed))
  (define sc (second seed))
  ;; Fixed stencil: a 49-cell spiral from the seed plus a disconnected lower bar.
  (define rels
    (list (list -4 -4) (list -4 -2) (list -4 -1) (list -4 0) (list -4 1)
          (list -4 2) (list -4 3) (list -4 4) (list -3 -4) (list -3 -2)
          (list -3 4) (list -2 -4) (list -2 -2) (list -2 0) (list -2 1)
          (list -2 2) (list -2 4) (list -1 -4) (list -1 -2) (list -1 0)
          (list -1 2) (list -1 4) (list 0 -4) (list 0 -2) (list 0 0)
          (list 0 2) (list 0 4) (list 1 -4) (list 1 -2) (list 1 2)
          (list 1 4) (list 2 -4) (list 2 -2) (list 2 -1) (list 2 0)
          (list 2 1) (list 2 2) (list 2 4) (list 3 -4) (list 3 4)
          (list 4 -4) (list 4 -3) (list 4 -2) (list 4 -1) (list 4 0)
          (list 4 1) (list 4 2) (list 4 3) (list 4 4) (list 6 -5)
          (list 6 -4) (list 6 -3) (list 6 -2) (list 6 -1) (list 6 0)
          (list 6 1) (list 6 2) (list 6 3) (list 6 4) (list 6 5)))
  (define mask
    (filter (lambda (p)
      (and (in-bounds? (first p) (second p) (rows g) (cols g))
           (not (= (at g (first p) (second p)) 2))))
      (map (lambda (p) (list (+ sr (first p)) (+ sc (second p)))) rels)))
  ;; Any blocker anywhere switches to seed-connected mode. This intentionally
  ;; drops the disconnected lower bar even when every blocker lies off-stencil.
  (define has-blockers? (not (empty? (positions-of g (lambda (v) (= v 2))))))
  (define targets
    (if has-blockers?
        (connected-region g sr sc
          (lambda (r c v) (and (member (list r c) mask) (not (= v 2))))
          4)
        mask))
  ;; Paint only zero targets; the seed and blocker cells remain unchanged.
  (for/fold ([out g]) ([p targets])
    (if (= (at out (first p) (second p)) 0)
        (set-cell out (first p) (second p) 3)
        out))))

written_solution: stamp source-panel templates onto sparse target-panel markers, preferring larger anchor matches
program_solution:
(rule!
 ;; The board splits into two halves (along whichever axis makes the
 ;; content most lopsided): a SOURCE half full of multicolor objects
 ;; and a TARGET half of sparse anchor dots. Slide each source object
 ;; so that ALL its cells of some color land exactly on same-color
 ;; dots; among valid placements, more matched anchors win (then
 ;; bigger objects, then earlier objects), each dot used once. Output
 ;; the target half with the placed objects painted in.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define (grid-mode-all x) (mode-list (apply append x)))
     (define (count-non-bg x bg)
       (count-if (lambda (p) (not (= (at x (first p) (second p)) bg)))
                 (grid-positions x)))
     (define (halves-info a b)  ;; (a b a-bg b-bg content-asymmetry)
       (let ((abg (grid-mode-all a)) (bbg (grid-mode-all b)))
         (list a b abg bbg
               (abs (- (count-non-bg a abg) (count-non-bg b bbg))))))
     (define vt
       (and (zero? (modulo w 2))
            (halves-info (subgrid g 0 0 (- h 1) (- (quotient w 2) 1))
                         (subgrid g 0 (quotient w 2) (- h 1) (- w 1)))))
     (define ht
       (and (zero? (modulo h 2))
            (halves-info (subgrid g 0 0 (- (quotient h 2) 1) (- w 1))
                         (subgrid g (quotient h 2) 0 (- h 1) (- w 1)))))
     (define halves
       (if (> (if ht (fifth ht) -1) (if vt (fifth vt) -1)) ht vt))
     (define a-fuller?
       (>= (count-non-bg (first halves) (third halves))
           (count-non-bg (second halves) (fourth halves))))
     (define src (if a-fuller? (first halves) (second halves)))
     (define tgt (if a-fuller? (second halves) (first halves)))
     (define src-bg (if a-fuller? (third halves) (fourth halves)))
     (define tgt-bg (if a-fuller? (fourth halves) (third halves)))
     (define th (rows tgt))
     (define tw (cols tgt))
     (define objs (objects-multicolor src src-bg))
     (define candidates
       ;; every dedup'd translation putting all of an object's
       ;; color-anchors onto same-color dots, whole object in bounds;
       ;; candidate = (n-anchors size oi dr dc cells anchor-targets)
       (for/fold ((acc (list))) ((oi (range 0 (length objs))))
         (let* ((cells (map (lambda (p)
                              (list (first p) (second p)
                                    (at src (first p) (second p))))
                            (obj-cells (list-ref objs oi))))
                (size (length cells)))
           (for/fold ((a2 acc)) ((color (remove-duplicates
                                         (map third cells))))
             (let ((targets  ;; reversed row-major, like the original
                    (reverse (filter (lambda (p)
                                       (= (at tgt (first p) (second p))
                                          color))
                                     (grid-positions tgt))))
                   (anchors (map (lambda (cv) (list (first cv) (second cv)))
                                 (filter (lambda (cv) (= (third cv) color))
                                         cells))))
               (if (null? targets)
                   a2
                   (second
                    (for/fold ((st (list (list) a2)))
                              ((pr (for*/list ((an anchors) (t targets))
                                     (list an t))))
                      (let* ((dr (- (first (second pr))
                                    (first (first pr))))
                             (dc (- (second (second pr))
                                    (second (first pr))))
                             (key (list dr dc)))
                        (if (and (not (member key (first st)))
                                 (all? (lambda (aa)
                                         (member (list (+ (first aa) dr)
                                                       (+ (second aa) dc))
                                                 targets))
                                       anchors)
                                 (all? (lambda (cv)
                                         (in-bounds? (+ (first cv) dr)
                                                     (+ (second cv) dc)
                                                     th tw))
                                       cells))
                            (list (cons key (first st))
                                  (cons (list (length anchors) size oi
                                              dr dc cells
                                              (map (lambda (aa)
                                                     (list (+ (first aa)
                                                              dr)
                                                           (+ (second aa)
                                                              dc)))
                                                   anchors))
                                        (second st)))
                            st))))))))))
     (define ranked
       (sort candidates
             (lambda (x y)
               (cond ((> (first x) (first y)) #t)
                     ((< (first x) (first y)) #f)
                     ((> (second x) (second y)) #t)
                     ((< (second x) (second y)) #f)
                     (else (< (third x) (third y)))))))
     (first  ;; greedy paint: skip placements whose dots are taken
      (for/fold ((st (list (empty-grid th tw tgt-bg) (list))))
                ((cand ranked))
        (if (any? (lambda (p) (member p (second st))) (seventh cand))
            st
            (list (for/fold ((gg (first st))) ((cv (sixth cand)))
                    (set-cell gg (+ (first cv) (fourth cand))
                              (+ (second cv) (fifth cand))
                              (third cv)))
                  (append (seventh cand) (second st)))))))))

(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (begin
             (define (in-b r c) (and (>= r 0) (< r h) (>= c 0) (< c w)))
             (define (is-dot? r c)
               (and
                 (= (at g r c) 1)
                 (not (or
                        (and (in-b (- r 1) c) (= (at g (- r 1) c) 1))
                        (and (in-b (+ r 1) c) (= (at g (+ r 1) c) 1))
                        (and (in-b r (- c 1)) (= (at g r (- c 1)) 1))
                        (and (in-b r (+ c 1)) (= (at g r (+ c 1)) 1))))))
             (define mask0 (cellmap g (r c v) (if (zero? v) 1 0)))
             (define room-objs (objects mask0 0))
             (define (nbrs8 r c)
               (filter (lambda (n) (in-b (first n) (second n)))
                       (list (list (- r 1) (- c 1))
                             (list (- r 1) c)
                             (list (- r 1) (+ c 1))
                             (list r (- c 1))
                             (list r (+ c 1))
                             (list (+ r 1) (- c 1))
                             (list (+ r 1) c)
                             (list (+ r 1) (+ c 1)))))
             (define (is-marker? rc)
               (let ((v (at g (first rc) (second rc)))) (and (!= v 0) (!= v 1))))
             (define (markers-of-room obj)
               (let* ((cells (obj-cells obj))
                      (all-borders (flatmap (lambda (rc) (nbrs8 (first rc) (second rc)))
                                            cells))
                      (marker-cells (filter is-marker? all-borders))
                      (unique-markers (remove-duplicates marker-cells)))
                 (map (lambda (b) (at g (first b) (second b))) unique-markers)))
             (define (majority lst)
               (if (null? lst)
                   1
                   (let* ((unique (remove-duplicates lst))
                          (counts (map (lambda (x)
                                         (list x (count-if (lambda (y) (= y x)) lst)))
                                       unique)))
                     (first (reduce (lambda (a b) (if (> (second b) (second a)) b a))
                                    (first counts)
                                    (cdr counts))))))
             (define room-colors
               (map (lambda (room) (list room (majority (markers-of-room room))))
                    room-objs))
             (define (room-color room)
               (second (find (lambda (rc) (= (first rc) room)) room-colors)))
             (define (find-room-for-dot r c)
               (let* ((nbs (filter (lambda (n)
                                     (and
                                       (in-b (first n) (second n))
                                       (zero? (at g (first n) (second n)))))
                                   (list (list (- r 1) c)
                                         (list (+ r 1) c)
                                         (list r (- c 1))
                                         (list r (+ c 1))))))
                 (if (null? nbs)
                     #f
                     (find (lambda (room)
                             (any? (lambda (cell) (= cell (first nbs)))
                                   (obj-cells room)))
                           room-objs))))
             (define dots
               (filter (lambda (rc) (is-dot? (first rc) (second rc)))
                       (flatmap (lambda (r) (map (lambda (c) (list r c)) (range 0 w)))
                                (range 0 h))))
             (reduce (lambda (gg dot)
                       (let ((room (find-room-for-dot (first dot) (second dot))))
                         (if room
                             (set-cell gg (first dot) (second dot) (room-color room))
                             gg)))
                     g
                     dots)))))

written_solution: cyan(8) lattice with colored dots; same-row pairs fill horizontal, same-column pairs fill vertical, overlap=magenta(6)
program_solution:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (begin
             (define h-lines
               (filter (lambda (r)
                         (> (count-if (lambda (c) (= (at g r c) 8)) (range 0 w))
                            (/ w 2)))
                       (range 0 h)))
             (define v-lines
               (filter (lambda (c)
                         (> (count-if (lambda (r) (= (at g r c) 8)) (range 0 h))
                            (/ h 2)))
                       (range 0 w)))
             (define dots
               (filter (lambda (d) d)
                       (for*/list ((r (range 0 h)) (c (range 0 w)))
                         (let ((v (at g r c)))
                           (and (and (!= v 0) (!= v 8)) (list r c v))))))
             (define (rgap rr) (count-if (lambda (hl) (< hl rr)) h-lines))
             (define (cgap cc) (count-if (lambda (vl) (< vl cc)) v-lines))
             (define colors (remove-duplicates (map third dots)))
             (define fill-map (make-hash))
             (for ((color colors))
               (define cdots (filter (lambda (d) (= (third d) color)) dots))
               (define gdots
                 (map (lambda (d) (list (rgap (first d)) (cgap (second d)))) cdots))
               (for* ((i (range 0 (length gdots))) (j (range (+ i 1) (length gdots))))
                     (define d1 (nth gdots i))
                     (define d2 (nth gdots j))
                     (define r1 (first d1))
                     (define c1 (second d1))
                     (define r2 (first d2))
                     (define c2 (second d2))
                     (cond
                       ((= r1 r2) (define lo (min c1 c2))
                         (define hi (max c1 c2))
                         (for ((kc (range lo (+ hi 1))))
                           (define key (cons r1 kc))
                           (if (hash-has-key? fill-map key)
                               (when
                                 (!= (hash-ref fill-map key) color)
                                 (hash-set! fill-map key 6))
                               (hash-set! fill-map key color))))
                       ((= c1 c2) (define lo (min r1 r2))
                         (define hi (max r1 r2))
                         (for ((kr (range lo (+ hi 1))))
                           (define key (cons kr c1))
                           (if (hash-has-key? fill-map key)
                               (when
                                 (!= (hash-ref fill-map key) color)
                                 (hash-set! fill-map key 6))
                               (hash-set! fill-map key color)))))))
             (cellmap g
                      (rr cc __cm_v)
                      (begin
                        (define v __cm_v)
                        (if (= v 8) 8 (hash-ref fill-map (cons (rgap rr) (cgap cc)) 0))))))))

                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((hh (rows g))
                  (ww (cols g))
                  (template-cells (for*/list ((r (range 0 hh)) (c (range 0 ww))
                                      #:when
                                      (and (!= (at g r c) 0) (!= (at g r c) 5)))
                                    (list r c (at g r c))))
                  (tr1 (min-of first template-cells))
                  (tc1 (min-of second template-cells))
                  (tr2 (max-of first template-cells))
                  (tc2 (max-of second template-cells))
                  (th (+ 1 (- tr2 tr1)))
                  (tw (+ 1 (- tc2 tc1)))
                  (visited (make-hash))
                  (gray-regions (list))
                  (dummy (for* ((r (range 0 hh)) (c (range 0 ww)))
                               (when
                                 (and
                                   (= (at g r c) 5)
                                   (not (hash-has-key? visited (list r c))))
                                 (let ((cells (list)))
                                   (let bfs
                                        ((q (list (list r c))))
                                        (unless
                                          (null? q)
                                          (let ((cr (first (car q)))
                                                (cc (second (car q))))
                                            (cond
                                              ((or
                                                 (hash-has-key? visited (list cr cc))
                                                 (< cr 0)
                                                 (>= cr hh)
                                                 (< cc 0)
                                                 (>= cc ww)
                                                 (!= (at g cr cc) 5)) (bfs (cdr q)))

                                                          (cons (list cr cc) cells))

                                                                 (list (list (- cr 1)
                                                                             cc)
                                                                       (list (+ cr 1)
                                                                             cc)
                                                                       (list cr
                                                                             (- cc 1))
                                                                       (list cr
                                                                             (+ cc 1))))))))))
                                   (set! gray-regions
                                         (append gray-regions (list cells)))))))
                  (result (make-hash)))
             (for* ((r (range 0 hh)) (c (range 0 ww)))
                   (hash-set! result (list r c) (at g r c)))

written_solution: Expand the colored key inside a 2-frame to fill the frame interior

(rule! (lambda (g)
  ;; Find the hollow colour-2 frame and preserve its bounding-box dimensions.
  (define bb (bbox-of-cells (find-color g 2)))
  (define r0 (first bb))
  (define c0 (second bb))
  (define r1 (third bb))
  (define c1 (fourth bb))
  (define oh (+ 1 (- r1 r0)))
  (define ow (+ 1 (- c1 c0)))
  ;; The non-background, non-frame rectangle inside the border is the key.
  (define interior
    (for*/list ([r (in-range (+ r0 1) r1)]
                [c (in-range (+ c0 1) c1)])
      (list r c)))
  (define key-cells
    (filter (lambda (p)
      (let ((v (at g (first p) (second p))))
        (and (not (= v 0)) (not (= v 2)))))
      interior))
  (define kbb (bbox-of-cells key-cells))
  (define kr0 (first kbb))
  (define kc0 (second kbb))
  (define kr1 (third kbb))
  (define kc1 (fourth kbb))
  (define kh (+ 1 (- kr1 kr0)))
  (define kw (+ 1 (- kc1 kc0)))
  ;; Replicate key rows and columns independently to fill the frame interior.
  (define rscale (quotient (- oh 2) kh))
  (define cscale (quotient (- ow 2) kw))
  (grid-from-fn oh ow
    (lambda (r c)
      (if (or (= r 0) (= c 0) (= r (- oh 1)) (= c (- ow 1)))
          2
          (at g
              (+ kr0 (quotient (- r 1) rscale))
              (+ kc0 (quotient (- c 1) cscale))))))))

                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((bg (mode g))
                  (zeros (find-color g 0))
                  (z-rs (map first zeros))
                  (z-cs (map second zeros))
                  (center-r (quotient (+ (min-list z-rs) (max-list z-rs)) 2))
                  (center-c (quotient (+ (min-list z-cs) (max-list z-cs)) 2))
                  (shape-rel (for/list ((z zeros))
                               (list (- (first z) center-r) (- (second z) center-c))))
                  (marker (for/first ((r (range 0 h)) #:when
                                       (for/first ((c (range 0 w)) #:when
                                                    (let ((v (at g r c)))
                                                      (and (!= v bg) (!= v 0))))
                                                  (list r c (at g r c))))
                                     (for/first ((c (range 0 w)) #:when
                                                  (let ((v (at g r c)))
                                                    (and (!= v bg) (!= v 0))))
                                                (list r c (at g r c)))))
                  (mr (first marker))
                  (mc (second marker))
                  (mcolor (third marker))
                  (dr (- mr center-r))
                  (dc (- mc center-c))
                  (sign-r (cond ((> dr 0) 1) ((< dr 0) -1) (else 0)))
                  (sign-c (cond ((> dc 0) 1) ((< dc 0) -1) (else 0)))
                  (manhattan (+ (abs dr) (abs dc)))
                  (step-mag (- manhattan 1))
                  (step-r (* step-mag sign-r))
                  (step-c (* step-mag sign-c))
                  (result (make-hash)))
             (for* ((r (range 0 h)) (c (range 0 w)))
                   (hash-set! result (list r c) (at g r c)))
             (let loop
                  ((k 1))
                  (let* ((cr (+ center-r (* k step-r)))
                         (cc (+ center-c (* k step-c)))
                         (any-in-bounds (for/or ((s shape-rel))
                                                (let ((sr (+ cr (first s)))
                                                      (sc (+ cc (second s))))
                                                  (and
                                                    (>= sr 0)
                                                    (< sr h)
                                                    (>= sc 0)
                                                    (< sc w))))))
                    (when

                        (let ((sr (+ cr (first s)))
                              (sc (+ cc (second s))))

                            (and (>= sr 0) (< sr h) (>= sc 0) (< sc w))
                            (hash-set! result (list sr sc) mcolor))))
                      (loop (+ k 1)))))
             (cellmap g (r c v) (hash-ref result (list r c) bg))))))

(rule! (lambda (g)

                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((div-rows (for/list ((r (range 0 h)) #:when
                                (for/and ((c (range 0 w))) (= (at g r c) 3)))
                              r))
                  (div-cols (for/list ((c (range 0 w)) #:when
                                (for/and ((r (range 0 h))) (= (at g r c) 3)))
                              c))
                  (row-bounds (append (list -1) div-rows (list h)))
                  (col-bounds (append (list -1) div-cols (list w)))
                  (row-ranges (filter (lambda (p) (<= (first p) (second p)))
                                      (let loop
                                           ((bs row-bounds))

                                               (list)
                                               (cons (list (+ (car bs) 1)

                                                     (loop (cdr bs)))))))

                                      (let loop

written_solution: Assemble multicolor pieces by matching exposed marker ports of the same color
program_solution:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (define bg (mode g -1))
         (define objs
           (sort-by (objects-multicolor g bg)
                    (lambda (obj) (+ (* 1000 (obj-r1 obj)) (obj-c1 obj)))))
         (define comps (map (lambda (i) (list i (nth objs i))) (range 0 (length objs))))
         (define dirs (list (list -1 0) (list 1 0) (list 0 -1) (list 0 1)))
         (define (local-cells obj)
           (map (lambda (p)
                  (list (- (first p) (obj-r1 obj)) (- (second p) (obj-c1 obj))))
                (obj-cells obj)))
         (define (port-dir obj lr lc)
           (let ((cells (local-cells obj))
                 (oh (obj-h obj))
                 (ow (obj-w obj)))
             (let ((best (foldl (lambda (d current)
                                  (let* ((dr (first d))
                                         (dc (second d))
                                         (nr (+ lr dr))
                                         (nc (+ lc dc)))
                                    (if (member (list nr nc) cells)
                                        current
                                        (let ((score (+ (if (member (list (- lr dr)
                                                                          (- lc dc))
                                                                    cells)
                                                            10
                                                            0)
                                                        (if (and (= dr -1) (= lr 0))
                                                            5
                                                            0)
                                                        (if (and
                                                              (= dr 1)
                                                              (= lr (- oh 1)))
                                                            5
                                                            0)
                                                        (if (and (= dc -1) (= lc 0))
                                                            5
                                                            0)
                                                        (if (and
                                                              (= dc 1)
                                                              (= lc (- ow 1)))
                                                            5
                                                            0))))
                                          (if (> score (first current))
                                              (list score dr dc)
                                              current)))))
                                (list -1 0 0)
                                dirs)))
               (list (second best) (third best)))))
         (define markers
           (apply append
                  (map (lambda (comp)
                         (let* ((id (first comp))
                                (obj (second comp))
                                (r0 (obj-r1 obj))
                                (c0 (obj-c1 obj)))
                           (map (lambda (cell)
                                  (let* ((lr (- (first cell) r0))
                                         (lc (- (second cell) c0))
                                         (v (at g (first cell) (second cell)))
                                         (d (port-dir obj lr lc)))
                                    (list v id lr lc (first d) (second d))))
                                (filter (lambda (cell)
                                          (not (= (at g (first cell) (second cell)) 1)))
                                        (obj-cells obj)))))
                       comps)))
         (define edges
           (apply append
                  (map (lambda (color)
                         (let ((ps (filter (lambda (p) (= (first p) color)) markers)))
                           (if (= (length ps) 2)
                               (list (list color (first ps) (second ps)))
                               (list))))
                       (range 1 10))))
         (define (find-place placements id)
           (find-first (lambda (p) (= (first p) id)) placements))
         (define (try-place placements from to)
           (let ((from-place (find-place placements (second from)))
                 (to-place (find-place placements (second to))))
             (if (and from-place (not to-place))
                 (append placements
                         (list (list (second to)
                                     (+ (second from-place)
                                        (third from)
                                        (list-ref from 4)
                                        (- (third to)))
                                     (+ (third from-place)
                                        (fourth from)
                                        (list-ref from 5)
                                        (- (fourth to))))))
                 placements)))
         (define (apply-edge placements edge)
           (let ((a (second edge))
                 (b (third edge)))
             (try-place (try-place placements a b) b a)))
         (define seed-placements
           (if (empty? comps) (list) (list (list (first (first comps)) 0 0))))
         (define placements
           (foldl (lambda (step acc)
                    (foldl (lambda (edge inner) (apply-edge inner edge)) acc edges))
                  seed-placements
                  (range 0 (* 3 (max 1 (length comps))))))
         (define full-placements
           (foldl (lambda (comp acc)
                    (if (find-place acc (first comp))
                        acc
                        (append acc (list (list (first comp) 0 0)))))
                  placements
                  comps))
         (define placed-cells
           (apply append
                  (map (lambda (comp)
                         (let* ((id (first comp))
                                (obj (second comp))
                                (placement (find-place full-placements id))
                                (ro (second placement))
                                (co (third placement))
                                (r0 (obj-r1 obj))
                                (c0 (obj-c1 obj)))
                           (map (lambda (cell)
                                  (list (+ ro (- (first cell) r0))
                                        (+ co (- (second cell) c0))
                                        (at g (first cell) (second cell))))
                                (obj-cells obj))))
                       comps)))
         (define bb
           (bbox-of-cells (map (lambda (p) (list (first p) (second p))) placed-cells)))
         (define r1 (first bb))
         (define c1 (second bb))
         (define r2 (third bb))
         (define c2 (fourth bb))
         (define blank (empty-grid (+ 1 (- r2 r1)) (+ 1 (- c2 c1)) bg))
         (foldl (lambda (p acc)
                  (set-cell acc (- (first p) r1) (- (second p) c1) (third p)))
                blank
                placed-cells)))

written_solution: Periodic tile with blue(1) blobs; detect period, reconstruct tile, apply everywhere

(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (begin
             (define period h)
             (for ((p (range 2 12)))
               (define ok #t)
               (for* ((r (range 0 (- h p))) (c (range 0 w)))
                     (define v1 (at g r c))
                     (define v2 (at g (+ r p) c))
                     (when (and (!= v1 1) (!= v2 1) (!= v1 v2)) (set! ok #f)))
               (when (and ok (< p period)) (set! period p)))

               (build-grid period
                           period
                           (tr tc)

                                     (and (= val 1) (!= (at g r c) 1))
                                     (set! val (at g r c))))
                             val)))
             (cellmap g (r c v) (at tile (modulo r period) (modulo c period)))))))

(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((shape-cells (for*/list ((r (range 0 h)) (c (range 0 w))
                                   #:when
                                   (or (= (at g r c) 1) (= (at g r c) 8)))
                                 (list r c)))
                  (sr1 (min-of first shape-cells))
                  (sc1 (min-of second shape-cells))
                  (sr2 (max-of first shape-cells))
                  (sc2 (max-of second shape-cells))
                  (sh (+ 1 (- sr2 sr1)))
                  (sw (+ 1 (- sc2 sc1)))
                  (yellows (for*/list ((r (range 0 h)) (c (range 0 w)) #:when (= (at g r c) 4))
                             (list r c)))
                  (corners (list (list (- sr1 1) (- sc1 1) 0)
                                 (list (- sr1 1) (+ sc2 1) 1)
                                 (list (+ sr2 1) (+ sc2 1) 2)
                                 (list (+ sr2 1) (- sc1 1) 3)))
                  (source-diag 0)
                  (dummy1 (for ((y yellows))
                            (for ((c corners))
                              (when
                                (and (= (first y) (first c)) (= (second y) (second c)))
                                (set! source-diag (third c))))))
                  (cluster (filter (lambda (y)
                                     (not (for/or ((c corners))
                                                  (and
                                                    (= (first y) (first c))
                                                    (= (second y) (second c))))))
                                   yellows))
                  (cmr (quotient (for/sum ((y cluster)) (first y)) (length cluster)))
                  (cmc (quotient (for/sum ((y cluster)) (second y)) (length cluster)))
                  (scr (quotient (+ sr1 sr2) 2))
                  (scc (quotient (+ sc1 sc2) 2))
                  (target-diag (cond
                                 ((and (<= cmr scr) (<= cmc scc)) 0)
                                 ((and (<= cmr scr) (> cmc scc)) 1)
                                 ((and (> cmr scr) (> cmc scc)) 2)
                                 (else 3)))
                  (rot (remainder (+ 4 (- target-diag source-diag)) 4))
                  (result (make-hash)))
             (for* ((r (range 0 h)) (c (range 0 w))) (hash-set! result (list r c) 0))

                   (let* ((v (at g (+ sr1 dr) (+ sc1 dc)))

                                ((zero? rot) dr)
                                ((= rot 1) dc)
                                ((= rot 2) (- (- sh 1) dr))

                          (nc (cond

written_solution: each red(2) 2 projects perpendicular to nearest 8-wall(s); leg of 2s + 3x3 node (8 box with 2 center) on each side
program_solution:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (begin
             (define h-walls
               (filter (lambda (r) (andmap (lambda (c) (= (at g r c) 8)) (range 0 w)))
                       (range 0 h)))
             (define v-walls
               (filter (lambda (c) (andmap (lambda (r) (= (at g r c) 8)) (range 0 h)))
                       (range 0 w)))
             (define twos (find-color g 2))
             (define (max-lt lst x)
               (let ((cands (filter (lambda (y) (< y x)) lst)))
                 (if (null? cands) #f (max-list cands))))
             (define (min-gt lst x)
               (let ((cands (filter (lambda (y) (> y x)) lst)))
                 (if (null? cands) #f (min-list cands))))
             (define (set-if gg r c v)
               (if (and (>= r 0) (< r h) (>= c 0) (< c w)) (set-cell gg r c v) gg))
             (define (draw-node gg cr cc)
               (let* ((g1 (set-if gg (- cr 1) (- cc 1) 8))
                      (g2 (set-if g1 (- cr 1) cc 8))
                      (g3 (set-if g2 (- cr 1) (+ cc 1) 8))
                      (g4 (set-if g3 cr (- cc 1) 8))
                      (g5 (set-if g4 cr (+ cc 1) 8))
                      (g6 (set-if g5 (+ cr 1) (- cc 1) 8))
                      (g7 (set-if g6 (+ cr 1) cc 8))
                      (g8 (set-if g7 (+ cr 1) (+ cc 1) 8)))
                 (set-if g8 cr cc 2)))
             (define (process-two gg p)
               (let* ((r (first p))
                      (c (second p)))
                 (cond
                   ((not (null? h-walls)) (let* ((above (max-lt h-walls r))
                            (below (min-gt h-walls r))
                            (top (if above (+ above 2) r))
                            (bot (if below (- below 2) r))
                            (g-leg (reduce (lambda (gg2 rr) (set-cell gg2 rr c 2))
                                           gg
                                           (range top (+ bot 1))))
                            (g-up (if above (draw-node g-leg above c) g-leg))
                            (g-dn (if below (draw-node g-up below c) g-up)))
                       g-dn))
                   ((not (null? v-walls)) (let* ((left (max-lt v-walls c))
                            (right (min-gt v-walls c))
                            (lc (if left (+ left 2) c))
                            (rc (if right (- right 2) c))
                            (g-leg (reduce (lambda (gg2 cc) (set-cell gg2 r cc 2))
                                           gg
                                           (range lc (+ rc 1))))
                            (g-l (if left (draw-node g-leg r left) g-leg))
                            (g-r (if right (draw-node g-l r right) g-l)))
                       g-r))
                   (else gg))))
             (reduce process-two g twos)))))

(rule! (lambda (g)

      (hash-set! result (list r c) bg))
    (for ((r (range 0 h)))
      (hash-set! result (list r 0) lw)
      (hash-set! result (list r (- w 1)) rw))
    (for ((wc-dir (list (list lw -1) (list rw 1))))
      (let ((wc (first wc-dir)) (dir (second wc-dir))
            ;; Mutable lookup table for visited
            (visited (make-hash))
            (all-objects (list)))
        (for* ((r (range 0 h)) (c (range 1 (- w 1))))
          (when (and (= (cell-at g r c) wc) (not (hash-has-key? visited (list r c))))
            (let ((cells (list))
                  (queue (list (list r c))))
              (let bfs ((q queue))
                (when (not (null? q))
                  (let ((cr (first (car q))) (cc (second (car q))))
                    (cond
                      ((or (hash-has-key? visited (list cr cc))
                           (< cr 0) (>= cr h) (< cc 1) (>= cc (- w 1))
                           (not (= (cell-at g cr cc) wc)))
                       (bfs (cdr q)))
                      (else
                       (hash-set! visited (list cr cc) #t)
                       (set! cells (cons (list cr cc) cells))
                       (bfs (append (cdr q)
                         (list (list (- cr 1) (- cc 1)) (list (- cr 1) cc) (list (- cr 1) (+ cc 1))
                               (list cr (- cc 1)) (list cr (+ cc 1))
                               (list (+ cr 1) (- cc 1)) (list (+ cr 1) cc) (list (+ cr 1) (+ cc 1))))))))))
              (set! all-objects (append all-objects (list cells))))))
        (set! all-objects
          (sort all-objects
            (lambda (a b)
              (if (= dir 1)
                  (> (apply max (map second a)) (apply max (map second b)))
                  (< (apply min (map second a)) (apply min (map second b)))))))
        (for ((obj all-objects))
          (let ((min-shift 999))
            (for ((cell obj))
              (let* ((r (first cell)) (c (second cell))

                                                                    (nth widths

                  (template (car (filter (lambda (f) (list-ref f 7)) frames)))

(rule! (lambda (g)
  ;; Each color has a solid 3x3 block in one corner (bg=6). Scattered same-color
  ;; cells slide onto the block: row-band cells slide horizontally, col-band cells
  ;; vertically, diagonal cells diagonally toward the corner, stopping adjacent to
  ;; the block edge (compositional slide, not a memorized patch table).
  (let* ((H (rows g)) (W (cols g)) (bg 6)
         (palette (filter (lambda (c) (not (= c bg))) (grid-colors g))))
    (foldl
      (lambda (col acc)
        (let* ((corners (list (list 0 0) (list 0 (- W 3)) (list (- H 3) 0) (list (- H 3) (- W 3))))
               (corner (findf
                         (lambda (rc)
                           (andmap (lambda (dr)
                                     (andmap (lambda (dc) (= (cell-at g (+ (first rc) dr) (+ (second rc) dc)) col)) (list 0 1 2)))
                                   (list 0 1 2)))
                         corners))
               (r0 (first corner)) (c0 (second corner))
               (hdir (if (= c0 0) -1 1))
               (vdir (if (= r0 0) -1 1))
               (inblock? (lambda (r c) (and (>= r r0) (<= r (+ r0 2)) (>= c c0) (<= c (+ c0 2)))))
               (scattered (filter (lambda (rc) (not (inblock? (first rc) (second rc)))) (find-color g col))))
          (foldl
            (lambda (rc a)
              (let* ((r (first rc)) (c (second rc))
                     (rowband (and (>= r r0) (<= r (+ r0 2))))
                     (colband (and (>= c c0) (<= c (+ c0 2))))
                     (dr (if colband vdir (if rowband 0 vdir)))
                     (dc (if rowband hdir (if colband 0 hdir))))
                (letrec ((slide (lambda (rr cc)
                                  (let ((nr (+ rr dr)) (nc (+ cc dc)))
                                    (if (or (< nr 0) (>= nr H) (< nc 0) (>= nc W) (inblock? nr nc))
                                        (list rr cc)
                                        (slide nr nc))))))
                  (let* ((dest (slide r c))
                         (a2 (set-cell a r c bg)))
                    (set-cell a2 (first dest) (second dest) col)))))
            acc scattered)))
      g palette))))

(rule! (lambda (g)

             (define (orient acc m d)
               (let loop
                    ((r (+ (fst m) (fst d))) (c (+ (snd m) (snd d))))
                    (cond
                      ((not (in-bounds? r c h w)) acc)
                      ((= (at g r c) 8) (loop (+ r (fst d)) (+ c (snd d))))

                                  acc))))))
             (reduce (lambda (acc m) (reduce (lambda (a d) (orient a m d)) acc dirs))
                     g
                     marks)))))

(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((objs (objects g 0))
                  (rects (map (lambda (o)
                                (let ((bb (obj-bbox o)))
                                  (list (obj-color o)
                                        (first bb)
                                        (second bb)
                                        (third bb)
                                        (fourth bb))))
                              objs))
                  (n (length rects))
                  (bridges (for*/list ((i (range 0 n)) (j (range 0 n)) #:when (< i j))
                             (let* ((a (list-ref rects i))
                                    (b (list-ref rects j))
                                    (ac (first a))
                                    (bc (first b)))
                               (cond
                                 ((!= ac bc) #f)
                                 (else (let* ((ar1 (second a))
                                              (ac1 (third a))
                                              (ar2 (fourth a))
                                              (ac2 (fifth a))
                                              (br1 (second b))
                                              (bc1 (third b))
                                              (br2 (fourth b))
                                              (bc2 (fifth b))
                                              (ro-s (max ar1 br1))
                                              (ro-e (min ar2 br2))
                                              (co-s (max ac1 bc1))
                                              (co-e (min ac2 bc2))
                                              (row-ovlp (<= ro-s ro-e))
                                              (col-ovlp (<= co-s co-e)))
                                         (cond
                                           ((and
                                              row-ovlp
                                              (not col-ovlp)
                                              (= (+ ar1 ar2) (+ br1 br2))) (let ((gap-c1 (if (< ac2 bc1)
                                                               (+ ac2 1)
                                                               (+ bc2 1)))
                                                   (gap-c2 (if (< ac2 bc1)
                                                               (- bc1 1)
                                                               (- ac1 1)))
                                                   (br1x (+ ro-s 1))
                                                   (br2x (- ro-e 1)))
                                               (and
                                                 (and (<= br1x br2x) (<= gap-c1 gap-c2))
                                                 (list br1x gap-c1 br2x gap-c2 i j))))
                                           ((and
                                              col-ovlp
                                              (not row-ovlp)
                                              (= (+ ac1 ac2) (+ bc1 bc2))) (let ((gap-r1 (if (< ar2 br1)
                                                               (+ ar2 1)
                                                               (+ br2 1)))
                                                   (gap-r2 (if (< ar2 br1)
                                                               (- br1 1)
                                                               (- ar1 1)))
                                                   (bc1x (+ co-s 1))
                                                   (bc2x (- co-e 1)))
                                               (and
                                                 (and (<= bc1x bc2x) (<= gap-r1 gap-r2))
                                                 (list gap-r1 bc1x gap-r2 bc2x i j))))
                                           (else #f))))))))
                  (valid-bridges (filter (lambda (x) x) bridges))
                  (unblocked (filter (lambda (br)
                                       (let* ((r1x (first br))
                                              (c1x (second br))
                                              (r2x (third br))
                                              (c2x (fourth br))
                                              (bi (fifth br))
                                              (bj (sixth br))

                                         (not (for/or ((k (range 0 n)))

written_solution: Two crossing lines with specials → woven 2D output rect with VS/HS row patterns based on closest vert spec
program_solution:
(rule!
 ;; Two marked lines cross. Each carries a BASE color plus SPECIAL
 ;; marks; the special marks bound the output rectangle. Weave a plaid
 ;; there on even/odd parity: special vertical rows band between the
 ;; nearest/farthest marks, and whichever line owns the intersection
 ;; cell decides which base dominates the fabric.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define horiz-row  ;; the fullest row / column = the two lines
       (pick-max (range 0 h)
                 (lambda (r) (count-if (lambda (c) (> (at g r c) 0))
                                       (range 0 w)))))
     (define vert-col
       (pick-max (range 0 w)
                 (lambda (c) (count-if (lambda (r) (> (at g r c) 0))
                                       (range 0 h)))))
     (define (line-colors vals)  ;; (base special)
       (let* ((base (pick-max (remove-duplicates vals)
                              (lambda (v) (count-if (lambda (x) (= x v))
                                                    vals))))
              (other (filter (lambda (v) (not (= v base))) vals)))
         (list base (if (empty? other) base (first other)))))
     (define horiz-vals
       (filter (lambda (v) (> v 0))
               (map (lambda (c) (if (= c vert-col) 0 (at g horiz-row c)))
                    (range 0 w))))
     (define vert-vals
       (filter (lambda (v) (> v 0))
               (map (lambda (r) (if (= r horiz-row) 0 (at g r vert-col)))
                    (range 0 h))))
     (define horiz-base (first (line-colors horiz-vals)))
     (define horiz-spec (second (line-colors horiz-vals)))
     (define vert-base (first (line-colors vert-vals)))
     (define vert-spec (second (line-colors vert-vals)))
     (define vert-spec-rows
       (filter (lambda (r) (and (not (= r horiz-row))
                                (= (at g r vert-col) vert-spec)))
               (range 0 h)))
     (define horiz-spec-cols
       (filter (lambda (c) (and (not (= c vert-col))
                                (= (at g horiz-row c) horiz-spec)))
               (range 0 w)))
     (define horiz-primary (= (at g horiz-row vert-col) horiz-base))
     (define min-row (min-list (cons horiz-row vert-spec-rows)))
     (define max-row (max-list (cons horiz-row vert-spec-rows)))
     (define min-col (min-list horiz-spec-cols))
     (define max-col (max-list horiz-spec-cols))
     (define near-vs
       (pick-min vert-spec-rows (lambda (r) (abs (- r horiz-row)))))
     (define far-vs
       (pick-max vert-spec-rows (lambda (r) (abs (- r horiz-row)))))
     (build-grid h w (r c)
                 (if (or (< r min-row) (> r max-row)
                         (< c min-col) (> c max-col))
                     0
                     (let ((warp-row (zero? (remainder (- r min-row) 2)))
                           (warp-col (zero? (remainder (- c min-col) 2))))
                       (if warp-row
                           (let ((in-band (and (>= r (min near-vs far-vs))
                                               (<= r (max near-vs
                                                          far-vs)))))
                             (if in-band
                                 (if warp-col
                                     vert-spec
                                     (if (and (= r near-vs) horiz-primary)
                                         horiz-base
                                         vert-base))
                                 (if warp-col horiz-spec vert-base)))
                           (if horiz-primary
                               horiz-base
                               (if warp-col horiz-base vert-base)))))))))

program_solution:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((visited (make-hash))
                  (obj-grids (list)))
             (for* ((r (range 0 h)) (c (range 0 w)))
                   (when
                     (and (!= (at g r c) 0) (not (hash-has-key? visited (list r c))))
                     (let ((cells (list)))
                       (let bfs
                            ((queue (list (list r c))))
                            (unless
                              (null? queue)
                              (let ((cur (car queue)))
                                (cond
                                  ((hash-has-key? visited cur) (bfs (cdr queue)))
                                  ((or
                                     (< (first cur) 0)
                                     (>= (first cur) h)
                                     (< (second cur) 0)
                                     (>= (second cur) w)) (bfs (cdr queue)))
                                  ((zero? (at g (first cur) (second cur))) (bfs (cdr queue)))
                                  (else (hash-set! visited cur #t)
                                        (set! cells (cons cur cells))
                                        (let ((cr (first cur))
                                              (cc (second cur)))
                                          (bfs (append (cdr queue)
                                                       (list (list (- cr 1) cc)
                                                             (list (+ cr 1) cc)
                                                             (list cr (- cc 1))
                                                             (list cr (+ cc 1)))))))))))
                       (let* ((rs (map first cells))
                              (cs (map second cells))
                              (r1 (min-list rs))
                              (c1 (min-list cs))
                              (r2 (max-list rs))
                              (c2 (max-list cs))
                              (sub (build-grid (+ 1 (- r2 r1))
                                               (+ 1 (- c2 c1))
                                               (rr cc)
                                               (at g (+ r1 rr) (+ c1 cc)))))
                         (set! obj-grids (cons sub obj-grids))))))
             (let ((n (length obj-grids)))
               (let find-dup
                    ((i 0))
                    (if (>= i n)
                        (build-grid 1 1 (r c) 0)
                        (let ((gi (list-ref obj-grids i)))
                          (if (> (count-if (lambda (gj)
                                             (and
                                               (= (rows gi) (rows gj))
                                               (= (cols gi) (cols gj))
                                               (let check
                                                    ((rr 0))
                                                    (cond
                                                      ((>= rr (rows gi)) #t)
                                                      ((let col-check
                                                            ((cc 0))
                                                            (cond
                                                              ((>= cc (cols gi)) #t)
                                                              ((= (at gi rr cc)
                                                                  (at gj rr cc)) (col-check (+ cc 1)))
                                                              (else #f))) (check (+ rr 1)))
                                                      (else #f)))))
                                           obj-grids)
                                 1)
                              gi
                              (find-dup (+ i 1)))))))))))

written_solution: Remove magenta(6) noise: detect periodic tile from non-magenta(6) cells, apply tile to entire grid
program_solution:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((hh (rows g))
                  (ww (cols g))
                  (noise 6)
                  (found #f)
                  (tile-pr 1)
                  (tile-pc 1)
                  (tile (make-hash)))
             (for ((pr (range 1 (+ 1 (quotient hh 2)))))
               (unless
                 found
                 (for ((pc (range 1 (+ 1 (quotient ww 2)))))
                   (unless
                     found
                     (let ((t (make-hash))
                           (ok #t)
                           (complete #t))
                       (for* ((r (range 0 hh)) (c (range 0 ww)))
                             (when
                               ok
                               (let ((v (at g r c)))
                                 (when
                                   (!= v noise)
                                   (let ((tr (remainder r pr))
                                         (tc (remainder c pc)))
                                     (cond
                                       ((not (hash-has-key? t (list tr tc))) (hash-set! t (list tr tc) v))
                                       ((!= (hash-ref t (list tr tc) 0) v) (set! ok #f))))))))
                       (when
                         ok
                         (for* ((tr (range 0 pr)) (tc (range 0 pc)))
                               (unless
                                 (hash-has-key? t (list tr tc))
                                 (set! complete #f))))
                       (when
                         (and ok complete)
                         (set! found #t)
                         (set! tile-pr pr)
                         (set! tile-pc pc)
                         (set! tile t)))))))
             (build-grid hh
                         ww
                         (r c)
                         (hash-ref tile
                                   (list (remainder r tile-pr) (remainder c tile-pc))
                                   0))))))

program_solution:
(rule!
 ;; Concentric L-brackets of one color continue outward forever: detect
 ;; the ring PERIOD (spacing of long-run rows/cols), then either
 ;; replicate any full columns every period toward the open side, or
 ;; grow the longest horizontal run as ever-larger nested Ls in
 ;; whichever diagonal direction covers the most cells. Painted cells
 ;; keep the color; everything else turns gray(5).
 (lambda (g)
   (let ((unused 0))
     (define fg (find-first (lambda (v) (> v 0)) (grid-colors g -999)))
     (define (has? r c) (= (at g r c) fg))
     (define fg-cells (find-color g fg))
     (define (max-run line-len cell-at)  ;; longest fg run along a line
       (first (for/fold ((state (list 0 0))) ((i (range 0 line-len)))
                (if (cell-at i)
                    (list (max (first state) (+ (second state) 1))
                          (+ (second state) 1))
                    (list (first state) 0)))))
     (define sig-rows
       (filter (lambda (r) (>= (max-run w (lambda (c) (has? r c))) 3))
               (range 0 h)))
     (define sig-cols
       (filter (lambda (c) (>= (max-run h (lambda (r) (has? r c))) 3))
               (range 0 w)))
     (define (valid-diffs xs)  ;; consecutive gaps in 2..4
       (if (or (empty? xs) (empty? (rest xs)))
           (list)
           (let ((d (- (second xs) (first xs))))
             (append (if (and (>= d 2) (<= d 4)) (list d) (list))
                     (valid-diffs (rest xs))))))
     (define period
       (let ((diffs (append (valid-diffs sig-rows) (valid-diffs sig-cols))))
         (if (empty? diffs) 2 (mode-list diffs))))
     (define full-cols
       (filter (lambda (c) (all? (lambda (r) (has? r c)) (range 0 h)))
               (range 0 w)))
     (define (any-in-col? c)
       (and (>= c 0) (< c w) (any? (lambda (r) (has? r c)) (range 0 h))))
     (define (replicate-cols)  ;; full columns march off at the period
       (foldl (lambda (c acc)
                (let ((dir (cond ((and (any-in-col? (- c period))
                                       (< (+ c period) w))
                                  1)
                                 ((and (any-in-col? (+ c period))
                                       (>= (- c period) 0))
                                  -1)
                                 ((< (+ c period) w) 1)
                                 (else -1))))
                  (let loop ((a acc) (cc (+ c (* dir period))))
                    (if (and (>= cc 0) (< cc w))
                        (loop (append (for/list ((r (range 0 h)))
                                        (list r cc))
                                      a)
                              (+ cc (* dir period)))
                        a))))
              fg-cells
              full-cols))
     (define (row-runs r)  ;; maximal fg runs: (r start end len)
       (let loop ((c 0) (runs (list)))
         (cond ((>= c w) runs)
               ((not (has? r c)) (loop (+ c 1) runs))
               (else (let scan ((cc c))
                       (if (and (< (+ cc 1) w) (has? r (+ cc 1)))
                           (scan (+ cc 1))
                           (loop (+ cc 1)
                                 (cons (list r c cc (+ 1 (- cc c)))
                                       runs))))))))
     (define chosen-run  ;; longest run (ties: topmost, leftmost)
       (first (sort-by (filter (lambda (run) (>= (fourth run) 3))
                               (flatmap row-runs (range 0 h)))
                       (lambda (run) (- (+ (* 10000 (fourth run))
                                           (* 100 (first run))
                                           (second run)))))))
     (define (grow-Ls rs cs)  ;; nested Ls stepping (rs,cs) per period
       (let ((r0 (first chosen-run))
             (base (if (= cs 1) (third chosen-run) (second chosen-run))))
         (let loop ((k 1) (acc fg-cells))
           (let ((rr (+ r0 (* rs period k)))
                 (cc (+ base (* cs period k))))
             (cond ((or (< rr 0) (>= rr h)) acc)
                   ((and (>= cc 0) (< cc w))
                    (loop (+ k 1)
                          (append (for/list ((hc (if (= cs 1)
                                                     (range 0 (+ cc 1))
                                                     (range cc w))))
                                    (list rr hc))
                                  (for/list ((vr (if (= rs 1)
                                                     (range 0 (+ rr 1))
                                                     (range rr h))))
                                    (list vr cc))
                                  acc)))
                   (else (loop (+ k 1)
                               (append (for/list ((hc (range 0 w)))
                                         (list rr hc))
                                       acc))))))))
     (define complete-cells
       (if (empty? full-cols)
           (pick-max (for*/list ((rs (list -1 1)) (cs (list -1 1)))
                       (grow-Ls rs cs))
                     (lambda (cells) (length (remove-duplicates cells))))
           (replicate-cols)))
     (cellmap g (r c v)
              (if (member (list r c) complete-cells) fg 5)))))

                  (colors (filter (lambda (x) (and (!= x bg) (!= x 8))) (grid-colors g))))

               (and (= (first a) (first b)) (= (second a) (second b))))

             (define (vseg c r1 r2) (map (lambda (r) (list r c)) (between r1 r2)))
             (define (valid-path? path color)
               (for/and ((p path))
                        (let ((v (at g (first p) (second p))))
                          (or (= v bg) (= v color)))))

               (for/or ((cc (range 0 w))) (and (!= cc c) (= (at out r cc) color))))
             (define (has-col? out r c color)
               (for/or ((rr (range 0 h))) (and (!= rr r) (= (at out rr c) color))))
             (define (path-for out a b color)
               (let* ((r1 (first a))
                      (c1 (second a))
                      (r2 (first b))
                      (c2 (second b))
                      (path-h (append (hseg r1 c1 c2) (vseg c2 r1 r2)))
                      (path-v (append (vseg c1 r1 r2) (hseg r2 c1 c2)))
                      (ok-h (valid-path? path-h color))
                      (ok-v (valid-path? path-v color))
                      (prefer-h (or
                                  (has-row? out r1 c1 color)
                                  (not (has-col? out r1 c1 color)))))
                 (cond
                   ((and prefer-h ok-h) path-h)
                   ((and (not prefer-h) ok-v) path-v)
                   (ok-h path-h)
                   (ok-v path-v)
                   (else (list)))))

               (let* ((len (first cand))
                      (a (second cand))

            ((not (inb? nr nc)) (void))

            (else (side r c pr pc) (side r c (- 0 pr) (- 0 pc)))))))
    (define (side r c ur uc)
      (let ((nr (+ r ur)) (nc (+ c uc)))
        (when (and (inb? nr nc) (not (wall? nr nc)) (not (wet? nr nc)))

        ((not (wall? nr nc)) (flow nr nc))

(rule! (lambda (g)
  ;; Kaleidoscope with 4-fold (4mm) symmetry about the off-center pivot (15.5,15.5) — the same
  ;; family as de493100: mirrors r->31-r, c->31-c plus the 90-degree rotations (r,c)->(c,31-r)/
  ;; (31-c,r). Dark-red (9) blobs occlude parts of it; the output is the grid REPAIRED IN PLACE,
  ;; each hidden cell recovered from the nearest VISIBLE member of its symmetry orbit (BFS over
  ;; the group, so compositions cover cells whose direct mirrors are also occluded).
  (let* ((h (rows g)) (w (cols g)))
    (define (visible? r c) (and (>= r 0) (< r h) (>= c 0) (< c w) (!= (at g r c) 9)))
    (define (orbit-value r0 c0)
      (let loop ((frontier (list (list r0 c0)))
                 (seen (list->set (list (list r0 c0)))))
        (if (null? frontier) 9
            (let* ((hit (findf (lambda (p) (visible? (first p) (second p))) frontier)))
              (if hit
                  (at g (first hit) (second hit))
                  (let* ((expand (for*/list ((p frontier)
                                             (q (list (list (- 31 (first p)) (second p))
                                                      (list (first p) (- 31 (second p)))
                                                      (list (second p) (- 31 (first p)))
                                                      (list (- 31 (second p)) (first p))))
                                             #:when (not (set-member? seen q)))
                                   q)))
                    (loop expand (for/fold ((s seen)) ((q expand)) (set-add s q)))))))))
    (grid-from-fn h w (lambda (rr cc)
                        (if (visible? rr cc) (at g rr cc) (orbit-value rr cc)))))))

written_solution: Template completion: largest shape is template. Each other color group completes to match template. Merged-color-first, fallback to per-component.

(rule!
 ;; Background is blue(1). The most numerous color draws the complete
 ;; TEMPLATE shape; every other color is a fragment of it. Slide the
 ;; template (kept in bounds) until the fragment sits inside its
 ;; footprint, then fill the footprint's background cells with the
 ;; fragment's color — the whole color at once when possible, else
 ;; each 8-connected piece on its own.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define bg 1)
     (define present  ;; non-bg colors, first-appearance order
       (filter (lambda (v) (not (= v bg)))
               (remove-duplicates
                (map (lambda (p) (at g (first p) (second p)))
                     (grid-positions g)))))
     (define (cells-of color) (reverse (find-color g color)))
     (define tmpl-color
       (pick-max present (lambda (c) (length (cells-of c)))))
     (define tmpl-rel
       (let ((cells (cells-of tmpl-color)))
         (map (lambda (c) (list (- (first c) (min-of first cells))
                                (- (second c) (min-of second cells))))
              cells)))
     (define (placement-at cell t cells)
       ;; anchor template offset t on cell; ok if the whole fragment
       ;; lands inside the footprint and the footprint stays in bounds
       (let ((or2 (- (first cell) (first t)))
             (oc (- (second cell) (second t))))
         (and (all? (lambda (c2) (member (list (- (first c2) or2)
                                               (- (second c2) oc))
                                         tmpl-rel))
                    cells)
              (all? (lambda (t2) (in-bounds? (+ or2 (first t2))
                                             (+ oc (second t2)) h w))
                    tmpl-rel)
              (list or2 oc))))
     (define (find-origin cells)
       (find-first (lambda (x) x)
                   (for*/list ((cell cells) (t tmpl-rel))
                     (placement-at cell t cells))))
     (define (fill out origin color)
       (for/fold ((acc out)) ((t tmpl-rel))
         (let ((nr (+ (first origin) (first t)))
               (nc (+ (second origin) (second t))))
           (if (= (at acc nr nc) bg)
               (set-cell acc nr nc color)
               acc))))
     (for/fold ((out g))
               ((color (filter (lambda (c) (not (= c tmpl-color)))
                               present)))
       (let* ((cells (cells-of color))
              (origin (find-origin cells)))
         (if origin
             (fill out origin color)
             (for/fold ((o2 out))
                       ((comp (map obj-cells
                                   (objects-8 (paint-cells
                                               (empty-grid h w 0)
                                               cells 1)
                                              0))))
               (let ((co (find-origin comp)))
                 (if co (fill o2 co color) o2)))))))))

written_solution: Color key row 0; find most frequent interior color; draw outer border + inner bbox hollow rectangle in that color
program_solution:
(rule!
 ;; Keep the color key unchanged. Inside the old frame, the unique most-common
 ;; nonzero color other than the frame color selects both the replacement color
 ;; and the cells whose bounding box becomes the inner hollow rectangle.
 (lambda (g)
   (let* ((h (rows g))
          (w (cols g))
          ;; The uniform outer frame begins at row 1; row 0 is the preserved key.
          (bdr (at g 1 0))
          ;; Each entry is (row column color) for a non-background, non-frame
          ;; interior cell.
          (interior
           (for*/list ((r (range 2 (- h 1)))
                       (c (range 1 (- w 1)))
                       #:when (let ((v (at g r c)))
                                (and (!= v 0) (!= v bdr))))
             (list r c (at g r c))))
          (colors (unique (map third interior)))
          (counts
           (map (lambda (clr)
                  (list clr
                        (count-if (lambda (cell) (= (third cell) clr))
                                  interior)))
                colors))
          ;; The task grammar guarantees one strict frequency maximum.
          (winner (first (pick-max counts second)))
          (win-cells (filter (lambda (cell) (= (third cell) winner))
                             interior))
          (r1 (min-of first win-cells))
          (r2 (max-of first win-cells))
          (c1 (min-of second win-cells))
          (c2 (max-of second win-cells)))
     (cellmap g (r c v)
       (cond
         ;; Preserve the key row verbatim.
         ((zero? r) v)
         ;; Recolor the full old outer frame with the winner.
         ((or (= r 1) (= r (- h 1)) (zero? c) (= c (- w 1))) winner)
         ;; Draw the winner bounding box as a hollow rectangle.
         ((or (and (or (= r r1) (= r r2)) (>= c c1) (<= c c2))
              (and (or (= c c1) (= c c2)) (>= r r1) (<= r r2)))
          winner)
         ;; Drop every original interior cell not on that hollow rectangle.
         (else 0))))))

(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((objs (objects-multicolor g 0))
                  (nz (filter (lambda (p) (!= (third p) 0)) (grid-cells g)))
                  (t-order (list 0 1 2 3 4 5 6 7)))
             (define (orth-neighbor? r c)
               (any? (lambda (d)
                       (let ((rr (+ r (first d)))
                             (cc (+ c (second d))))
                         (and (in-bounds? rr cc h w) (!= (at g rr cc) 0))))
                     (list (list -1 0) (list 1 0) (list 0 -1) (list 0 1))))
             (define (source? o)
               (any? (lambda (p) (orth-neighbor? (first p) (second p))) (obj-cells o)))
             (define sources (filter source? objs))
             (define markers
               (filter (lambda (p) (not (orth-neighbor? (first p) (second p)))) nz))
             (define (local-valued obj)
               (let* ((bb (obj-bbox obj))
                      (r0 (first bb))
                      (c0 (second bb)))
                 (map (lambda (p)
                        (list (- (first p) r0)
                              (- (second p) c0)
                              (at g (first p) (second p))))
                      (obj-cells obj))))
             (define (mapped t r c)
               (cond
                 ((zero? t) (list r c))
                 ((= t 1) (list r (- 0 c)))
                 ((= t 2) (list (- 0 r) c))
                 ((= t 3) (list (- 0 r) (- 0 c)))
                 ((= t 4) (list c r))
                 ((= t 5) (list c (- 0 r)))
                 ((= t 6) (list (- 0 c) r))
                 (else (list (- 0 c) (- 0 r)))))
             (define (transform-cells cells t)
               (let* ((raw (map (lambda (cell)
                                  (let ((p (mapped t (first cell) (second cell))))
                                    (list (first p) (second p) (third cell))))
                                cells))
                      (mr (min-of first raw))
                      (mc (min-of second raw)))
                 (map (lambda (cell)
                        (list (- (first cell) mr) (- (second cell) mc) (third cell)))
                      raw)))
             (define (marker-at? r c v)
               (not (null? (filter (lambda (m)
                                     (and
                                       (= (first m) r)
                                       (= (second m) c)
                                       (= (third m) v)))
                                   markers))))
             (define (in-bounds-cells? tr tc cells)
               (all? (lambda (cell)
                       (let ((r (+ tr (first cell)))
                             (c (+ tc (second cell))))
                         (and (>= r 0) (< r h) (>= c 0) (< c w))))
                     cells))
             (define (valid? tr tc specs cells)
               (and
                 (in-bounds-cells? tr tc cells)
                 (all? (lambda (sp)
                         (marker-at? (+ tr (first sp)) (+ tc (second sp)) (third sp)))
                       specs)))
             (define (candidate obj)
               (let* ((base (local-valued obj))
                      (main (mode-list (map third base)))
                      (cands (flatmap (lambda (t)
                                        (let* ((tcells (transform-cells base t))
                                               (specs (filter (lambda (cell)
                                                                (!= (third cell) main))
                                                              tcells)))
                                          (filter (lambda (cand)
                                                    (valid? (first cand)
                                                            (second cand)
                                                            specs
                                                            tcells))
                                                  (flatmap (lambda (sp)
                                                             (map (lambda (m)
                                                                    (list (- (first m)
                                                                             (first sp))
                                                                          (- (second m)
                                                                             (second sp))
                                                                          tcells))
                                                                  (filter (lambda (m)
                                                                            (= (third m)
                                                                               (third sp)))
                                                                          markers)))
                                                           specs))))
                                      t-order)))
                 (first cands)))
             (reduce (lambda (acc obj)
                       (let ((cand (candidate obj)))
                         (stamp-normalized-cells acc
                                                 (third cand)
                                                 (first cand)
                                                 (second cand))))
                     (cellmap g (r c v) 0)
                     sources)))))
