written_solution: Translate detached colored pieces into enclosed holes of large container objects
program_solution:
(rule!
 ;; Jigsaw packing: CONTAINER objects have enclosed background holes;
 ;; the loose non-gray objects are PIECES. Backtracking-search an exact
 ;; cover of every hole by translated pieces (largest pieces first,
 ;; ties by position), then draw containers + placed pieces (in their
 ;; own colors) on a blank canvas. Gray(5) objects are scaffolding and
 ;; disappear.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define (sort-cells cells)
       (sort-by cells (lambda (p) (+ (* 100 (first p)) (second p)))))
     (define (holes-of obj)
       ;; 4-connected bg pockets inside the bbox that never reach its edge
       (let* ((r1 (obj-r1 obj)) (c1 (obj-c1 obj))
              (own (obj-cells obj))
              (mask (grid-from-fn (obj-h obj) (obj-w obj)
                                  (lambda (r c)
                                    (if (and (zero? (at g (+ r1 r) (+ c1 c)))
                                             (not (member (list (+ r1 r)
                                                                (+ c1 c))
                                                          own)))
                                        1 0)))))
         (map (lambda (o)
                (sort-cells (map (lambda (p) (list (+ r1 (first p))
                                                   (+ c1 (second p))))
                                 (obj-cells o))))
              (filter (lambda (o) (and (> (obj-r1 o) 0) (> (obj-c1 o) 0)
                                       (< (obj-r2 o) (- (obj-h obj) 1))
                                       (< (obj-c2 o) (- (obj-w obj) 1))))
                      (objects mask 0)))))
     (define objs (objects g 0))
     (define records
       (for/list ((idx (range 0 (length objs))))
         (list idx (list-ref objs idx) (holes-of (list-ref objs idx)))))
     (define containers
       (filter (lambda (rec) (and (not (= (obj-color (second rec)) 5))
                                  (not (empty? (third rec)))))
               records))
     (define container-ids (map first containers))
     ;; piece = (id color shape bbox size)
     (define pieces
       (map (lambda (rec)
              (let ((obj (second rec)))
                (list (first rec) (obj-color obj)
                      (normalize-cells (obj-cells obj))
                      (obj-bbox obj) (obj-size obj))))
            (filter (lambda (rec)
                      (and (not (= (obj-color (second rec)) 5))
                           (not (member (first rec) container-ids))))
                    records)))
     (define (piece-id p) (first p))
     (define (piece-color p) (second p))
     (define (piece-shape p) (third p))
     (define all-holes
       (sort-by (flatmap third containers)
                (lambda (cells)
                  (let ((bb (bbox-of-cells cells)))
                    (+ (* 10000 (first bb)) (* 100 (second bb))
                       (length cells))))))
     (define (translate-shape shape dr dc)
       (sort-cells (map (lambda (p) (list (+ (first p) dr)
                                          (+ (second p) dc)))
                        shape)))
     (define (placements-for hole piece)
       ;; every translation of the piece that lies fully inside the hole
       (remove-duplicates
        (filter (lambda (placed) (all? (lambda (p) (member p hole)) placed))
                (flatmap (lambda (hp)
                           (map (lambda (sp)
                                  (translate-shape (piece-shape piece)
                                                   (- (first hp) (first sp))
                                                   (- (second hp)
                                                      (second sp))))
                                (piece-shape piece)))
                         hole))))
     (define (intersects? a b) (any? (lambda (p) (member p b)) a))
     (define (option-key opt)  ;; big pieces first, then bbox position
       (let ((piece (first opt)) (bb (fourth (first opt))))
         (+ (* -100000 (list-ref piece 4)) (* 1000 (first bb)) (second bb)
            (piece-color piece))))
     (define (cover-hole hole rem)
       ;; exact-cover DFS: always extend at the first uncovered hole cell
       (define (options-for cell covered rem2)
         (sort-by (filter (lambda (opt)
                            (and (member cell (second opt))
                                 (not (intersects? (second opt) covered))))
                          (flatmap (lambda (piece)
                                     (map (lambda (placed)
                                            (list piece placed))
                                          (placements-for hole piece)))
                                   rem2))
                  option-key))
       (define (try-options opts covered rem2 assigns)
         (if (empty? opts)
             #f
             (let* ((piece (first (first opts)))
                    (placed (second (first opts)))
                    (res (dfs (append placed covered)
                              (filter (lambda (p) (not (= (piece-id p)
                                                          (piece-id piece))))
                                      rem2)
                              (append assigns
                                      (list (list (piece-color piece)
                                                  placed))))))
               (or res (try-options (rest opts) covered rem2 assigns)))))
       (define (dfs covered rem2 assigns)
         (let ((todo (filter (lambda (p) (not (member p covered))) hole)))
           (if (empty? todo)
               (list assigns rem2)
               (try-options (options-for (first todo) covered rem2)
                            covered rem2 assigns))))
       (dfs (list) rem (list)))
     (define (fill-holes holes rem assigns)
       (if (empty? holes)
           (list assigns rem)
           (let ((res (cover-hole (first holes) rem)))
             (and res
                  (fill-holes (rest holes) (second res)
                              (append assigns (first res)))))))
     (define base
       (foldl (lambda (rec acc)
                (recolor-cells acc (obj-cells (second rec))
                               (obj-color (second rec))))
              (empty-grid h w 0)
              containers))
     (let ((solved (fill-holes all-holes pieces (list))))
       (foldl (lambda (asg acc) (recolor-cells acc (second asg) (first asg)))
              base
              (if solved (first solved) (list)))))))

written_solution: Complete missing patterned cells in separator grids by 2x2 flip symmetry

(rule!
 ;; A separator lattice holds tiles. In every 2x2 block of tiles where
 ;; exactly ONE is empty and the other three share a single color, the
 ;; empty tile receives the mirror of its neighbor — flipped
 ;; up-down across the horizontal axis, left-right across the vertical.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define sep-rows
       (filter (lambda (r) (and (> (at g r 0) 0) (row-uniform? g r)))
               (range 0 h)))
     (define sep-cols
       (filter (lambda (c) (and (> (at g 0 c) 0) (col-uniform? g c)))
               (range 0 w)))
     (define rb (append (list -1) sep-rows (list h)))
     (define cb (append (list -1) sep-cols (list w)))
     (define (tr0 ri) (+ (nth rb ri) 1))
     (define (tr1 ri) (- (nth rb (+ ri 1)) 1))
     (define (tc0 ci) (+ (nth cb ci) 1))
     (define (tc1 ci) (- (nth cb (+ ci 1)) 1))
     (define (tile ri ci)
       (subgrid g (tr0 ri) (tc0 ci) (tr1 ri) (tc1 ci)))
     (define (tile-vals ri ci)
       (for*/list ((r (range (tr0 ri) (+ (tr1 ri) 1)))
                   (c (range (tc0 ci) (+ (tc1 ci) 1))))
         (at g r c)))
     (define (empty-tile? ri ci)
       (all? (lambda (v) (zero? v)) (tile-vals ri ci)))
     (define (tile-color ri ci)
       (let ((vals (filter (lambda (v) (> v 0)) (tile-vals ri ci))))
         (if (empty? vals) 0 (first vals))))
     (define (paste out ri ci patch)
       (if (and (= (rows patch) (+ 1 (- (tr1 ri) (tr0 ri))))
                (= (cols patch) (+ 1 (- (tc1 ci) (tc0 ci)))))
           (for/fold ((a out)) ((p (grid-positions patch)))
             (set-cell a (+ (tr0 ri) (first p))
                       (+ (tc0 ci) (second p))
                       (at patch (first p) (second p))))
           out))
     (for*/fold ((out g)) ((ri (range 0 (- (length rb) 2)))
                           (ci (range 0 (- (length cb) 2))))
       (let* ((quads (list (list ri ci) (list ri (+ ci 1))
                           (list (+ ri 1) ci)
                           (list (+ ri 1) (+ ci 1))))
              (empties (filter (lambda (q) (empty-tile? (first q)
                                                        (second q)))
                               quads))
              (fills (filter (lambda (q) (not (empty-tile? (first q)
                                                           (second q))))
                             quads))
              (colors (remove-duplicates
                       (map (lambda (q) (tile-color (first q)
                                                    (second q)))
                            fills))))
         (if (and (= (length empties) 1) (= (length fills) 3)
                  (= (length colors) 1) (> (first colors) 0))
             (let ((er (first (first empties)))
                   (ec (second (first empties))))
               (paste out er ec
                      (cond ((and (= er ri) (= ec ci))
                             (flip-ud (tile (+ ri 1) ci)))
                            ((and (= er ri) (= ec (+ ci 1)))
                             (flip-lr (tile ri ci)))
                            ((and (= er (+ ri 1)) (= ec ci))
                             (flip-ud (tile ri ci)))
                            (else (flip-ud (tile ri (+ ci 1)))))))
             out))))))

(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((l-comps (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-size o) 3)) (objects g 0)))
                (l-colors (map obj-color l-comps))
                (color-counts (map (lambda (c)
                                     (cons c
                                           (length (filter (lambda (x) (= x c))
                                                           l-colors))))
                                   (unique l-colors)))
                (frame-color (fst (find (lambda (p) (= (snd p) 3)) color-counts)))
                (cross-color (fst (find (lambda (p) (= (snd p) 1)) color-counts)))
                (all-l-cells (flatmap obj-cells l-comps))
                (bb (bbox-of-cells all-l-cells))
                (rmin (first bb))
                (cmin (second bb))
                (rmax (third bb))
                (cmax (fourth bb))
                (scan-col (lambda (c r1 r2)
                            (let ((step (if (>= r2 r1) 1 -1)))
                              (let loop
                                   ((i r1))
                                   (cond
                                     ((or
                                        (and (= step 1) (> i r2))
                                        (and (= step -1) (< i r2))) #f)
                                     ((!= (at g i c) 0) (at g i c))
                                     (else (loop (+ i step))))))))
                (scan-row (lambda (r c1 c2)
                            (let ((step (if (>= c2 c1) 1 -1)))
                              (let loop
                                   ((i c1))
                                   (cond
                                     ((or
                                        (and (= step 1) (> i c2))
                                        (and (= step -1) (< i c2))) #f)
                                     ((!= (at g r i) 0) (at g r i))
                                     (else (loop (+ i step)))))))))
           (cellmap g
                    (r c v)
                    (cond
                      ((and (>= r rmin) (<= r rmax) (>= c cmin) (<= c cmax)) (if (or (= r rmin) (= r rmax) (= c cmin) (= c cmax))
                            frame-color
                            cross-color))

                      ((and (>= c cmin) (<= c cmax) (> r rmax)) (let ((m (scan-col c r (+ rmax 1)))) (if m m cross-color)))
                      ((and (>= r rmin) (<= r rmax) (< c cmin)) (let ((m (scan-row r c (- cmin 1)))) (if m m cross-color)))
                      ((and (>= r rmin) (<= r rmax) (> c cmax)) (let ((m (scan-row r c (+ cmax 1)))) (if m m cross-color)))
                      (else v))))))

  ;;      then greedily place largest-first on the shared 8-background canvas.
  (let* ((sep-cols (filter (lambda (c) (all? (lambda (r) (zero? (at g r c))) (range h)))
                           (range w)))
         (starts (cons 0 (map add1 sep-cols)))
         (ends (append sep-cols (list w)))
         (spans (filter (lambda (se) (< (first se) (second se))) (map list starts ends)))
         (parts (map (lambda (se) (subgrid g 0 (first se) (- h 1) (- (second se) 1))) spans))
         (out-w (cols (first parts)))
         (shifts (list (list 0 0) (list 0 -1) (list 0 1) (list -1 0) (list 1 0)
                       (list -1 -1) (list -1 1) (list 1 -1) (list 1 1)
                       (list 0 -2) (list 0 2) (list -2 0) (list 2 0)))
         (placed (make-hash)))
    (define (largest-shape part)
      (let ((objs (objects part 8)))
        (if (empty? objs) #f (argmax obj-size objs))))
    (define (inside? p)
      (and (>= (first p) 0) (< (first p) h)
           (>= (second p) 0) (< (second p) out-w)))
    (define (free? cells)
      (and (all? inside? cells)
           (all? (lambda (p) (not (hash-has-key? placed p))) cells)))
    (for ((obj (in-list (sort (filter values (map largest-shape parts))
                              (lambda (a b) (> (obj-size a) (obj-size b)))))))
      (let place ((ss shifts))
        (unless (empty? ss)
          (let* ((sh (first ss))
                 (cells (map (lambda (p) (list (+ (first p) (first sh))
                                                (+ (second p) (second sh))))
                             (obj-cells obj))))
            (if (free? cells)
                (for ((p (in-list cells))) (hash-set! placed p (obj-color obj)))
                (place (rest ss)))))))
    (build-grid h out-w (r c) (hash-ref placed (list r c) 8))))

written_solution: copy the complete accent template onto matching 4-shapes under D4 transforms
program_solution:
(rule!
 ;; Yellow(4) skeletons repeat around the board; the richest one (most
 ;; decoration colors) is the BASE. For each plain copy, find the
 ;; dihedral orientation mapping the base skeleton onto it — a red(2)
 ;; cell breaks symmetric ties — and stamp the base's decorations
 ;; through that orientation.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define (val p) (at g (first p) (second p)))
     (define comps
       (filter (lambda (o) (any? (lambda (p) (= (val p) 4))
                                 (obj-cells o)))
               (objects-multicolor g 0)))
     (define (deco-colors o)
       (remove-duplicates (filter (lambda (v) (not (= v 4)))
                                  (map val (obj-cells o)))))
     (define base (pick-max comps (lambda (o) (length (deco-colors o)))))
     (define (spin p idx)  ;; the 8 dihedral images of a cell
       (let ((r (first p)) (c (second p)))
         (cond ((zero? idx) (list r c))
               ((= idx 1) (list c (- r)))
               ((= idx 2) (list (- r) (- c)))
               ((= idx 3) (list (- c) r))
               ((= idx 4) (list r (- c)))
               ((= idx 5) (list (- c) (- r)))
               ((= idx 6) (list (- r) c))
               (else (list c r)))))
     (define (sort-pos cells) (sort cells cell<))
     (define (yellows o) (filter (lambda (p) (= (val p) 4))
                                 (obj-cells o)))
     (define (rel cells r0 c0)
       (map (lambda (p) (list (- (first p) r0) (- (second p) c0)))
            cells))
     (define base-y (yellows base))
     (define by-r0 (min-of first base-y))
     (define by-c0 (min-of second base-y))
     (define base-yrel (sort-pos (rel base-y by-r0 by-c0)))
     (define base-deco  ;; (dr dc color) for the base's decorations
       (map (lambda (p) (list (- (first p) by-r0)
                              (- (second p) by-c0)
                              (val p)))
            (filter (lambda (p) (not (= (val p) 4))) (obj-cells base))))
     (define base-twos
       (map (lambda (e) (list (first e) (second e)))
            (filter (lambda (e) (= (third e) 2)) base-deco)))
     (define (rel-after idx p)  ;; spin, then re-anchor on the skeleton
       (let* ((raws (map (lambda (q) (spin q idx)) base-yrel))
              (raw (spin p idx)))
         (list (- (first raw) (min-of first raws))
               (- (second raw) (min-of second raws)))))
     (for/fold ((out g)) ((obj (in-list comps)))
       (if (> (length (deco-colors obj)) 1)
           out
           (let* ((ys (yellows obj))
                  (tr0 (min-of first ys))
                  (tc0 (min-of second ys))
                  (target-yrel (sort-pos (rel ys tr0 tc0)))
                  (target-twos
                   (sort-pos (rel (filter (lambda (p) (= (val p) 2))
                                          (obj-cells obj))
                                  tr0 tc0)))
                  (idx (find-first
                        (lambda (idx)
                          (and (equal? (sort-pos
                                        (map (lambda (p)
                                               (rel-after idx p))
                                             base-yrel))
                                       target-yrel)
                               (or (empty? target-twos)
                                   (any? (lambda (bp)
                                           (member (rel-after idx bp)
                                                   target-twos))
                                         base-twos))))
                        (range 0 8))))
             (if idx
                 (for/fold ((gg out)) ((e (in-list base-deco)))
                   (let ((p (rel-after idx (list (first e)
                                                 (second e)))))
                     (if (in-bounds? (+ tr0 (first p))
                                     (+ tc0 (second p)) h w)
                         (set-cell gg (+ tr0 (first p))
                                   (+ tc0 (second p)) (third e))
                         gg)))
                 out)))))))

written_solution: Concentric L-corner rings: each shape becomes a ring sized by max bbox dim, L arm from input shape, output dim 2n+1 or 2n-1 if center exists
program_solution:
(rule!
 ;; Each color draws a corner glyph: an L whose ARM length shows how
 ;; thick its ring's corners are. Nest all colors as concentric square
 ;; rings (sizes 1,3,5,... when some glyph is a single cell, else
 ;; 3,5,7,...): a glyph needs a ring at least as big as itself; glyphs
 ;; that exactly match a ring size claim theirs largest-first. Draw
 ;; each assigned ring as four corner Ls of the glyph's arm length.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define bg (at g 0 0))
     (define (count-ext col from-r from-c dr dc)
       (let loop ((i 0))
         (let ((nr (+ from-r (* i dr))) (nc (+ from-c (* i dc))))
           (if (and (in-bounds? nr nc h w) (= (at g nr nc) col))
               (loop (+ i 1))
               i))))
     (define (corner-arm col cell dr dc)
       (min (count-ext col (first cell) (second cell) 0 dc)
            (count-ext col (first cell) (second cell) dr 0)))
     (define (color-info c)  ;; (color max-dim arm)
       (let* ((cells (find-color g c))
              (bb (bbox-of-cells cells)))
         (list c
               (max (+ 1 (- (third bb) (first bb)))
                    (+ 1 (- (fourth bb) (second bb))))
               (max-of (lambda (cell)
                         (max (corner-arm c cell 1 1)
                              (corner-arm c cell 1 -1)
                              (corner-arm c cell -1 1)
                              (corner-arm c cell -1 -1)))
                       cells))))
     (define infos
       (map color-info (filter (lambda (c) (not (= c bg)))
                               (grid-colors g))))
     (define n (length infos))
     (define has-center (any? (lambda (i) (= (second i) 1)) infos))
     (define out-size (if has-center (- (* 2 n) 1) (+ (* 2 n) 1)))
     (define ring-sizes
       (map (lambda (i) (+ (if has-center 1 3) (* 2 i))) (range 0 n)))
     (define (exact? info) (member? (second info) ring-sizes))
     (define (assign shps available acc)
       ;; each shape takes the smallest ring that still fits it
       (if (null? shps)
           (list acc available)
           (let ((target (find (lambda (r) (>= r (second (first shps))))
                               available)))
             (assign (rest shps)
                     (filter (lambda (r) (not (= r target))) available)
                     (cons (list (first shps) target) acc)))))
     (define assignments  ;; loose fits first, exact matches biggest-first
       (let* ((step1 (assign (filter (lambda (i) (not (exact? i))) infos)
                             ring-sizes (list)))
              (step2 (assign (sort-by (filter exact? infos)
                                      (lambda (i) (- 0 (second i))))
                             (second step1) (first step1))))
         (reverse (first step2))))
     (define out-mid (quotient out-size 2))
     (define (l-cells arm size)  ;; 4 corner Ls of a size x size ring
       (let ((tl (append (map (lambda (i) (list 0 i)) (range 0 arm))
                         (map (lambda (i) (list i 0)) (range 0 arm)))))
         (append tl
                 (map (lambda (p) (list (first p)
                                        (- (- size 1) (second p))))
                      tl)
                 (map (lambda (p) (list (- (- size 1) (first p))
                                        (second p)))
                      tl)
                 (map (lambda (p) (list (- (- size 1) (first p))
                                        (- (- size 1) (second p))))
                      tl))))
     (define (place-ring gg assn)
       (let* ((shape (first assn))
              (ring-size (second assn))
              (offset (- out-mid (quotient ring-size 2))))
         (recolor-cells gg
                        (map (lambda (p) (list (+ (first p) offset)
                                               (+ (second p) offset)))
                             (l-cells (min (third shape) ring-size)
                                      ring-size))
                        (first shape))))
     (reduce place-ring (empty-grid out-size out-size bg)
             (sort-by assignments (lambda (a) (- 0 (second a))))))))

(rule! (lambda (g)

                               (range 0 w))))
           (define (spans seps limit)
             (let loop
                  ((xs seps) (start 0) (acc (list)))

                      (reverse (if (< start limit)
                                   (cons (list start (- limit 1)) acc)
                                   acc))
                      (let* ((sep (fst xs)))
                        (loop (cdr xs)
                              (+ sep 1)
                              (if (< start sep) (cons (list start (- sep 1)) acc) acc))))))
           (define rbands (spans rseps h))
           (define cbands (spans cseps w))
           (define tiles
             (filter (lambda (tile) (!= (third tile) 0))
                     (flatmap (lambda (rb)
                                (map (lambda (cb) (list rb cb (at g (fst rb) (fst cb))))
                                     cbands))
                              rbands)))

                     (let* ((rb (fst tile))

                            (r1 (snd rb))

                                                (map (lambda (dc) (list dr dc))

                       (hash-set! result (list r (+ dst-c1 dc)) (at g r (+ src-c1 dc))))))

(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((objs (objects-multicolor g))
                (blue-objs (filter (lambda (o)
                                     (for/or ((cl (obj-cells o)))
                                             (= 1 (at g (fst cl) (snd cl)))))
                                   objs)))
           (reduce (lambda (acc obj)
                     (let* ((fr1 (obj-r1 obj))
                            (fr2 (obj-r2 obj))
                            (fc1 (obj-c1 obj))
                            (fc2 (obj-c2 obj))
                            (interior (positions-in-rect (+ fr1 1)
                                                         (+ fc1 1)
                                                         (- fr2 1)
                                                         (- fc2 1)))
                            (dot (find (lambda (p)
                                         (let* ((v (at g (fst p) (snd p))))
                                           (and (!= 0 v) (!= 1 v))))
                                       interior))
                            (dc (if dot (at g (fst dot) (snd dot)) 0)))
                       (if (zero? dc)
                           acc
                           (let* ((top-open (not (all? (lambda (kc) (= 1 (at g fr1 kc)))
                                                       (range (+ fc1 1) fc2)))))
                             (cellmap g
                                      (r kc v)
                                      (cond
                                        ((and
                                           (> r fr1)
                                           (< r fr2)
                                           (> kc fc1)
                                           (< kc fc2)
                                           (zero? (at acc r kc))) dc)
                                        ((and
                                           top-open
                                           (= r fr1)
                                           (> kc fc1)
                                           (< kc fc2)
                                           (zero? v)) dc)
                                        ((and
                                           top-open
                                           (= r (- fr1 1))
                                           (>= (- fr1 1) 0)
                                           (>= kc fc1)
                                           (<= kc fc2)) dc)
                                        ((and
                                           (not top-open)
                                           (= r fr2)
                                           (> kc fc1)
                                           (< kc fc2)
                                           (zero? v)) dc)
                                        ((and
                                           (not top-open)
                                           (= r (+ fr2 1))
                                           (< (+ fr2 1) h)
                                           (>= kc fc1)
                                           (<= kc fc2)) dc)
                                        (else (at acc r kc))))))))
                   g
                   blue-objs))))

written_solution: template (1-shape + 2-markers) gets scaled and stamped at each standalone 2-block; scale = block side length, aligned by matching 2-markers
program_solution:
(rule!
 ;; A TEMPLATE shape (blue 1 body with red 2 marker cells stuck to it)
 ;; plus scattered solid red squares. Each red square is one marker of
 ;; a scaled-up phantom copy (square side = scale): find the marker
 ;; whose implied origin puts EVERY template marker on a red square,
 ;; then stamp the whole template there at that scale. Keep the
 ;; template and squares; everything else clears.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define one-cells (find-color g 1))
     (define two-cells (find-color g 2))
     (define template-twos  ;; red cells touching the blue body
       (filter (lambda (tc)
                 (any? (lambda (d) (member (list (+ (first tc) (first d))
                                                 (+ (second tc)
                                                    (second d)))
                                           one-cells))
                       cardinal-deltas))
               two-cells))
     (define standalone-twos
       (filter (lambda (c) (not (member c template-twos))) two-cells))
     (define tmpl-box (bbox-of-cells (append one-cells template-twos)))
     (define tmpl  ;; normalized template: 1 body / 2 marker / 0 empty
       (grid-from-fn (+ 1 (- (third tmpl-box) (first tmpl-box)))
                     (+ 1 (- (fourth tmpl-box) (second tmpl-box)))
                     (lambda (r c)
                       (let ((gr (+ (first tmpl-box) r))
                             (gc (+ (second tmpl-box) c)))
                         (cond ((= (at g gr gc) 1) 1)
                               ((member (list gr gc) template-twos) 2)
                               (else 0))))))
     (define markers
       (filter (lambda (p) (= (at tmpl (first p) (second p)) 2))
               (grid-positions tmpl)))
     (define blocks  ;; 4-connected components of the standalone reds
       (map obj-cells
            (objects (paint-cells (empty-grid h w 0) standalone-twos 1)
                     0)))
     (define (stamp out origin-r origin-c scale)
       (for*/fold ((acc out)) ((p (grid-positions tmpl))
                               (dr (range 0 scale)) (dc (range 0 scale)))
         (let ((tv (at tmpl (first p) (second p)))
               (pr (+ origin-r (* (first p) scale) dr))
               (pc (+ origin-c (* (second p) scale) dc)))
           (if (and (> tv 0) (in-bounds? pr pc h w))
               (set-cell acc pr pc tv)
               acc))))
     (define base
       (paint-cells (paint-cells (empty-grid h w 0) one-cells 1)
                    (append template-twos standalone-twos) 2))
     (let loop ((bs blocks) (placed (list)) (out base))
       (if (null? bs)
           out
           (let* ((bb (bbox-of-cells (first bs)))
                  (scale (+ 1 (- (third bb) (first bb))))
                  (hit  ;; (key stamp?) for the first origin already
                        ;; placed or fully landing on red squares
                   (let try ((ms markers))
                     (if (null? ms)
                         #f
                         (let ((key (list (- (first bb)
                                             (* (first (first ms)) scale))
                                          (- (second bb)
                                             (* (second (first ms)) scale))
                                     scale)))
                           (cond ((member key placed) (list key #f))
                                 ((all? (lambda (m)
                                          (member
                                           (list (+ (first key)
                                                    (* (first m) scale))
                                                 (+ (second key)
                                                    (* (second m) scale)))
                                           standalone-twos))
                                        markers)
                                  (list key #t))
                                 (else (try (rest ms)))))))))
             (if (and hit (second hit))
                 (loop (rest bs) (cons (first hit) placed)
                       (stamp out (first (first hit)) (second (first hit))
                              scale))
                 (loop (rest bs) placed out))))))))

written_solution: Self-similar fractal tiling: shape arrangement mirrors shape itself, block N marks cell N with cyan(8)
program_solution:
(rule!
 ;; One tile sits somewhere on a separator lattice (green marks are
 ;; noise). Build the tile's FRACTAL: blocks laid out like the tile's
 ;; own nonzero cells, each holding a copy of the tile, colored cyan(8)
 ;; at the cell whose rank inside the tile equals the block's rank
 ;; among the blocks (the self-position) and red(2) everywhere else.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define clean (cellmap g (r c v) (if (= v 3) 0 v)))
     (define sep-rows
       (filter (lambda (r) (all? (lambda (c) (zero? (at clean r c)))
                                 (range 0 w)))
               (range 0 h)))
     (define sep-cols
       (filter (lambda (c) (all? (lambda (r) (zero? (at clean r c)))
                                 (range 0 h)))
               (range 0 w)))
     (define first-row
       (find-first (lambda (r) (any? (lambda (c) (> (at clean r c) 0))
                                     (range 0 w)))
                   (range 0 h)))
     (define first-col
       (find-first (lambda (c) (any? (lambda (r) (> (at clean r c) 0))
                                     (range 0 h)))
                   (range 0 w)))
     (define th
       (let ((nxt (find-first (lambda (r) (> r first-row)) sep-rows)))
         (if nxt (- nxt first-row) (- h first-row))))
     (define tw
       (let ((nxt (find-first (lambda (c) (> c first-col)) sep-cols)))
         (if nxt (- nxt first-col) (- w first-col))))
     (define n-brows (quotient (+ h 1) (+ th 1)))
     (define n-bcols (quotient (+ w 1) (+ tw 1)))
     (define tile  ;; the one block with content
       (find-first
        (lambda (sub) (any? (lambda (v) (> v 0)) (apply append sub)))
        (for*/list ((br (range 0 n-brows)) (bc (range 0 n-bcols)))
          (subgrid clean (* br (+ th 1)) (* bc (+ tw 1))
                   (+ (* br (+ th 1)) (- th 1))
                   (+ (* bc (+ tw 1)) (- tw 1))))))
     (define tile-cells  ;; nonzero tile positions, row-major
       (filter (lambda (p) (> (at tile (first p) (second p)) 0))
               (positions-in-rect 0 0 (- th 1) (- tw 1))))
     (define (rank-of rr cc)  ;; row-major rank among the tile cells
       (count-if (lambda (p) (or (< (first p) rr)
                                 (and (= (first p) rr)
                                      (< (second p) cc))))
                 tile-cells))
     (build-grid h w (r c)
                 (let ((br (quotient r (+ th 1)))
                       (bc (quotient c (+ tw 1)))
                       (tr (remainder r (+ th 1)))
                       (tc (remainder c (+ tw 1))))
                   (if (and (< br n-brows) (< bc n-bcols)
                            (< tr th) (< tc tw)
                            (> (at tile br bc) 0)
                            (> (at tile tr tc) 0))
                       (if (= (rank-of br bc) (rank-of tr tc)) 8 2)
                       0))))))

written_solution: Extract colors of solid square cells between full-row separators
program_solution:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g))
                (full-rows (filter (lambda (r)
                                     (let* ((v (at g r 0)))
                                       (all? (lambda (c) (= (at g r c) v)) (range 0 w))))
                                   (range 0 h))))
           (define (solid-square-color r0 c0 n)
             (let* ((v (at g r0 c0)))
               (and
                 (all? (lambda (p) (= (at g (fst p) (snd p)) v))
                       (flatmap (lambda (r)
                                  (map (lambda (c) (list r c)) (range c0 (+ c0 n))))
                                (range r0 (+ r0 n))))
                 v)))
           (define bands
             (let loop
                  ((seps full-rows) (start 0) (acc (list)))
                  (if (empty? seps)
                      (reverse (if (< start h) (cons (list start (- h 1)) acc) acc))
                      (let* ((sep (fst seps)))
                        (loop (cdr seps)
                              (+ sep 1)
                              (if (< start sep) (cons (list start (- sep 1)) acc) acc))))))
           (define (band-colors band)
             (let* ((r0 (fst band))
                    (r1 (snd band))
                    (n (+ 1 (- r1 r0))))
               (filter (lambda (v) v)
                       (map (lambda (c) (solid-square-color r0 c n))
                            (range 0 (+ 1 (- w n)))))))
           (filter (lambda (row) (not (empty? row))) (map band-colors bands)))))

written_solution: Each cell draws horizontal+vertical cross; different-color intersections become red(2)
program_solution:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((pixels (for*/list ((r (range 0 h)) (c (range 0 w)) #:when (!= (at g r c) 0))
                            (list r c (at g r c)))))
             (cellmap g
                      (r c v)
                      (let loop
                           ((ps pixels) (colors (list)))
                           (cond
                             ((null? ps) (cond
                                 ((null? colors) 0)
                                 ((null? (cdr colors)) (first colors))
                                 (else 2)))
                             (else (let* ((p (car ps))
                                          (pr (first p))
                                          (pc (second p))
                                          (pcol (third p)))
                                     (if (or (= r pr) (= c pc))
                                         (if (member pcol colors)
                                             (loop (cdr ps) colors)
                                             (loop (cdr ps) (cons pcol colors)))
                                         (loop (cdr ps) colors)))))))))))

(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((bb (bbox-of-cells (find-color g 1)))
                (r1 (first bb))
                (c1 (second bb))
                (r2 (third bb))
                (c2 (fourth bb))
                (row-blues (map (lambda (r) (row-count g r 1)) (range 0 h)))
                (col-blues (map (lambda (c) (col-count g c 1)) (range 0 w))))
           (cellmap g
                    (r c v)

                        1
                        (if (and (>= r r1) (<= r r2) (>= c c1) (<= c c2) (zero? v))

                                2
                                0)
                            0))))))

         (let* ((n (length (filter (lambda (v) (!= v 0)) (grid-colors g))))
                (oh (* h n))
                (ow (* w n)))
           (build-grid oh
                       ow
                       (br bc)
                       (let* ((r (quotient br n))
                              (c (quotient bc n))

                              (lc (modulo bc n))

                                                            (and
                                                              (in-bounds? nr nc h w)

                                                              (zero? (at g r nc))

                                                                         (- (- n 1) lc))

written_solution: Each shape has 8 marker at one bbox corner; shape moves diagonally toward that corner by 1, 8 replaced
program_solution:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (begin
             (define bg 7)
             (define colors
               (filter (lambda (c) (and (!= c bg) (!= c 8))) (grid-colors g)))
             (define empty-g (cellmap g (r c v) bg))
             (define (process-color c)
               (let* ((cells (find-color g c))
                      (rs (map first cells))
                      (cs (map second cells))
                      (br1 (min-list rs))
                      (br2 (max-list rs))
                      (bc1 (min-list cs))
                      (bc2 (max-list cs))
                      (corners (list (list br1 bc1)
                                     (list br1 bc2)
                                     (list br2 bc1)
                                     (list br2 bc2)))
                      (missing-corner (find (lambda (corner)
                                              (not (any? (lambda (p)
                                                           (and
                                                             (= (first p)
                                                                (first corner))
                                                             (= (second p)
                                                                (second corner))))
                                                         cells)))
                                            corners))
                      (mr (first missing-corner))
                      (mc (second missing-corner))
                      (dr (if (= mr br1) -1 1))
                      (dc (if (= mc bc1) -1 1)))
                 (list c br1 bc1 br2 bc2 dr dc)))
             (define processed (map process-color colors))
             (reduce (lambda (gg p)
                       (let* ((c (nth p 0))
                              (r1 (+ (nth p 1) (nth p 5)))
                              (c1 (+ (nth p 2) (nth p 6)))
                              (r2 (+ (nth p 3) (nth p 5)))
                              (c2 (+ (nth p 4) (nth p 6)))
                              (cells (apply append
                                            (map (lambda (r)
                                                   (map (lambda (cc) (list r cc))
                                                        (range c1 (+ c2 1))))
                                                 (range r1 (+ r2 1))))))
                         (reduce (lambda (gx pp)
                                   (if (and
                                         (>= (first pp) 0)
                                         (< (first pp) h)
                                         (>= (second pp) 0)
                                         (< (second pp) w))
                                       (set-cell gx (first pp) (second pp) c)
                                       gx))
                                 gg
                                 cells)))
                     empty-g
                     processed)))))

                      (r c v)

written_solution: pack each color's objects into two bottom slots, rightmost source object above leftmost
program_solution:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (begin
             (define objs (objects g 0))
             (define colors (remove-duplicates (map obj-color objs)))
             (define (objs-of color) (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) color)) objs))
             (define (min-left color) (min-of obj-c1 (objs-of color)))
             (define left-color (pick-min colors min-left))
             (define left-width (max-of obj-w (objs-of left-color)))
             (define (start-col color) (if (= color left-color) 0 (+ left-width 1)))
             (define (stamp gg obj top left color)
               (for/fold ((out gg))
                 ((p (obj-cells obj)))
                 (set-cell out
                           (+ top (- (first p) (obj-r1 obj)))
                           (+ left (- (second p) (obj-c1 obj)))
                           color)))
             (for/fold ((out (empty-grid h w 0)))
               ((color colors))
               (let* ((sorted (sort (objs-of color)
                                    (lambda (a b) (> (obj-c1 a) (obj-c1 b)))))
                      (upper (first sorted))
                      (lower (second sorted))
                      (lower-top (- h (obj-h lower)))
                      (upper-top (- lower-top 1 (obj-h upper)))
                      (left (start-col color)))
                 (stamp (stamp out upper upper-top left color)
                        lower
                        lower-top
                        left
                        color)))))))

written_solution: fill closed frame interiors with majority dot color, remove all noise dots
program_solution:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((all-objs (objects g 0))
                  (big-frames (filter (lambda (o) (>= (length (obj-cells o)) 5))
                                      all-objs))
                  (base (cellmap g (r c v) 0))
                  (with-frames (paint-objects-by base
                                                 big-frames
                                                 (lambda (obj) (obj-color obj)))))
             (reduce (lambda (gr frame)
                       (with-bbox frame
                                  (r1 c1 r2 c2)
                                  (let* ((sh (+ 1 (- r2 r1)))
                                         (sw (+ 1 (- c2 c1)))
                                         (frame-cells (obj-cells frame))
                                         (in-frame? (lambda (r c)
                                                      (ormap (lambda (cell)
                                                               (and
                                                                 (= r (first cell))
                                                                 (= c (second cell))))
                                                             frame-cells)))
                                         (mini (build-grid sh
                                                           sw
                                                           (rr cc)
                                                           (if (in-frame? (+ rr r1)
                                                                          (+ cc c1))
                                                               1
                                                               0)))
                                         (bg-comps (objects mini 1))
                                         (interior-comps (filter (lambda (comp)
                                                                   (not (ormap (lambda (cell)
                                                                                 (let ((r (first cell))
                                                                                       (c (second cell)))
                                                                                   (or
                                                                                     (zero? r)
                                                                                     (= r
                                                                                        (- sh
                                                                                           1))
                                                                                     (zero? c)
                                                                                     (= c
                                                                                        (- sw
                                                                                           1)))))
                                                                               (obj-cells comp))))
                                                                 bg-comps))
                                         (interior-cells (flatmap (lambda (comp)
                                                                    (map (lambda (cell)
                                                                           (list (+ (first cell)
                                                                                    r1)
                                                                                 (+ (second cell)
                                                                                    c1)))
                                                                         (obj-cells comp)))
                                                                  interior-comps))
                                         (interior-colors (filter (lambda (v) (!= v 0))
                                                                  (map (lambda (cell)
                                                                         (at g
                                                                             (first cell)
                                                                             (second cell)))
                                                                       interior-cells)))
                                         (unique-colors (unique interior-colors))
                                         (counts (map (lambda (col)
                                                        (list col
                                                              (count-if (lambda (v)
                                                                          (= v col))
                                                                        interior-colors)))
                                                      unique-colors))
                                         (sorted-counts (sort-by counts
                                                                 (lambda (p)
                                                                   (- 0 (second p))))))
                                    (if (null? sorted-counts)
                                        gr
                                        (let ((majority (first (first sorted-counts))))

(rule!
 ;; A gray(5) divider row splits the board. Above it sit a red(2)
 ;; ARROW (its solid bar row marks the direction it points) and a
 ;; colored ATTACHMENT shape; below sits the BASE shape. Output the
 ;; bottom half with the attachment glued to the base — beneath it
 ;; when the arrow points down (bar on top), above when up — aligned
 ;; to the base's left edge.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define divider
       (find-first (lambda (r) (all? (lambda (c) (= (at g r c) 5))
                                     (range 0 w)))
                   (range 0 h)))
     (define (cells-in r1 r2 color)
       (filter (lambda (p) (and (>= (first p) r1) (< (first p) r2)))
               (find-color g color)))
     (define (region-colors r1 r2)
       (remove-duplicates
        (filter (lambda (v) (and (> v 0) (not (= v 5))))
                (flatmap (lambda (r) (row g r)) (range r1 r2)))))
     (define bottom-color (first (region-colors (+ divider 1) h)))
     (define other-color
       (find-first (lambda (c) (and (not (= c 2))
                                    (not (= c bottom-color))))
                   (region-colors 0 divider)))
     (define t-cells (cells-in 0 divider 2))
     (define bar-row  ;; the arrow's solid bar = its most crowded row
       (pick-max (remove-duplicates (map first t-cells))
                 (lambda (r) (count-if (lambda (p) (= (first p) r))
                                       t-cells))))
     (define t-down (= bar-row (min-of first t-cells)))
     (define b-cells (cells-in (+ divider 1) h bottom-color))
     (define o-cells (cells-in 0 divider other-color))
     (define o-r1 (min-of first o-cells))
     (define o-c1 (min-of second o-cells))
     (define o-h (+ 1 (- (max-of first o-cells) o-r1)))
     (define new-b-r1 (- (min-of first b-cells) divider 1))
     (define new-o-r1
       (if t-down
           (+ new-b-r1 (+ 1 (- (max-of first b-cells)
                               (min-of first b-cells))))
           (- new-b-r1 o-h)))
     (define new-o-c1 (min-of second b-cells))
     (define out-h (- h divider 1))
     (for/fold ((out (subgrid g (+ divider 1) 0 (- h 1) (- w 1))))
               ((p (in-list o-cells)))
       (let ((nr (+ (- (first p) o-r1) new-o-r1))
             (nc (+ (- (second p) o-c1) new-o-c1)))
         (if (in-bounds? nr nc out-h w)
             (set-cell out nr nc other-color)
             out))))))

(rule!
 ;; Uniform divider lines split the board into PANELS. A panel carrying
 ;; cyan(8) marks defines a MASK (its cyan cell positions). Same-size
 ;; panels that agree with it outside the mask and hold ONE nonzero
 ;; color under it are matches: the first match's color is the target,
 ;; and every panel in the marked panel's row/col lattice that is
 ;; target-colored under the mask gets the cyan mask stamped in. A mask
 ;; of FULL cyan rows instead stamps, in each same-column panel, the
 ;; single row made entirely of the modal uniform-row color.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define (ranges-between dividers total)  ;; gaps between divider lines
       (let loop ((prev -1) (ds dividers) (acc (list)))
         (cond ((null? ds)
                (reverse (if (<= (+ prev 1) (- total 1))
                             (cons (list (+ prev 1) (- total 1)) acc)
                             acc)))
               (else (loop (first ds) (rest ds)
                           (if (<= (+ prev 1) (- (first ds) 1))
                               (cons (list (+ prev 1) (- (first ds) 1))
                                     acc)
                               acc))))))
     (define row-ranges
       (ranges-between (filter (lambda (r) (row-uniform? g r)) (range 0 h))
                       h))
     (define col-ranges
       (ranges-between (filter (lambda (c) (col-uniform? g c)) (range 0 w))
                       w))
     ;; panel = (ri ci r1 c1 pat has8?)
     (define panels
       (map (lambda (idx)
              (let* ((rr (nth row-ranges (first idx)))
                     (cr (nth col-ranges (second idx)))
                     (pat (subgrid g (first rr) (first cr)
                                   (second rr) (second cr))))
                (list (first idx) (second idx) (first rr) (first cr) pat
                      (any? (lambda (p) (= (at pat (first p) (second p)) 8))
                            (grid-positions pat)))))
            (positions-in-rect 0 0 (- (length row-ranges) 1)
                               (- (length col-ranges) 1))))
     (define (p-ri p) (first p))
     (define (p-ci p) (second p))
     (define (p-r1 p) (third p))
     (define (p-c1 p) (fourth p))
     (define (p-pat p) (fifth p))
     (define (p-has8 p) (sixth p))
     (define (p-h p) (rows (p-pat p)))
     (define (p-w p) (cols (p-pat p)))
     (define (stamp-for out marked)
       (if (not (p-has8 marked))
           out
           (let* ((pat (p-pat marked))
                  (mask (filter (lambda (pos)
                                  (= (at pat (first pos) (second pos)) 8))
                                (grid-positions pat)))
                  (same-shape? (lambda (o)
                                 (and (not (p-has8 o))
                                      (= (p-h o) (p-h marked))
                                      (= (p-w o) (p-w marked)))))
                  (agrees-outside?
                   (lambda (o)
                     (all? (lambda (pos)
                             (= (at pat (first pos) (second pos))
                                (at (p-pat o) (first pos) (second pos))))
                           (filter (lambda (pos) (not (member pos mask)))
                                   (grid-positions pat)))))
                  (mask-val
                   (lambda (o)
                     (let ((u (remove-duplicates
                               (map (lambda (pos)
                                      (at (p-pat o) (first pos)
                                          (second pos)))
                                    mask))))
                       (and (= 1 (length u)) (first u)))))
                  (matches (filter (lambda (o)
                                     (and (same-shape? o)
                                          (agrees-outside? o)
                                          (let ((v (mask-val o)))
                                            (and v (> v 0)))))
                                   panels))
                  (primary
                   (lambda (out2)
                     (let* ((target (mask-val (first matches)))
                            (target-rows
                             (remove-duplicates
                              (cons (p-ri marked)
                                    (map p-ri
                                         (filter (lambda (o)
                                                   (and (= (p-ci o)
                                                           (p-ci marked))
                                                        (= (mask-val o)
                                                           target)))
                                                 matches)))))
                            (target-cols
                             (remove-duplicates
                              (cons (p-ci marked)
                                    (map p-ci
                                         (filter (lambda (o)
                                                   (and (= (p-ri o)
                                                           (p-ri marked))
                                                        (= (mask-val o)
                                                           target)))
                                                 matches))))))
                       (for/fold ((g2 out2)) ((o (in-list panels)))
                         (if (and (member? (p-ri o) target-rows)
                                  (member? (p-ci o) target-cols)
                                  (same-shape? o)
                                  (all? (lambda (pos)
                                          (= (at (p-pat o) (first pos)
                                                 (second pos))
                                             target))
                                        mask))
                             (paint-cells g2
                                          (map (lambda (pos)
                                                 (list (+ (p-r1 o)
                                                          (first pos))
                                                       (+ (p-c1 o)
                                                          (second pos))))
                                               mask)
                                          8)
                             g2)))))
                  (secondary
                   (lambda (out2)
                     (if (null? (filter (lambda (dr)
                                          (all? (lambda (v) (= v 8))
                                                (row pat dr)))
                                        (range 0 (p-h marked))))
                         out2
                         (let* ((col-mates
                                 (filter (lambda (o)
                                           (and (not (p-has8 o))
                                                (= (p-ci o) (p-ci marked))
                                                (= (p-w o) (p-w marked))))
                                         panels))
                                (uniform-vals
                                 (flatmap
                                  (lambda (o)
                                    (flatmap
                                     (lambda (dr)
                                       (let ((rv (row (p-pat o) dr)))
                                         (if (= 1 (length
                                                   (remove-duplicates rv)))
                                             (list (first rv))
                                             (list))))
                                     (range 0 (p-h o))))
                                  col-mates))
                                (base (mode-list uniform-vals)))
                           (if (eq? base #f)
                               out2
                               (for/fold ((g2 out2))
                                         ((o (in-list col-mates)))
                                 (let ((hits (filter
                                              (lambda (dr)
                                                (all? (lambda (v)
                                                        (= v base))
                                                      (row (p-pat o) dr)))
                                              (range 0 (p-h o)))))
                                   (if (= 1 (length hits))
                                       (paint-cells
                                        g2
                                        (positions-in-rect
                                         (+ (p-r1 o) (first hits))
                                         (p-c1 o)
                                         (+ (p-r1 o) (first hits))
                                         (+ (p-c1 o) (p-w o) -1))
                                        8)
                                       g2)))))))))
             (if (null? matches) (secondary out) (primary out)))))
     (for/fold ((out g)) ((m (in-list panels)))
       (stamp-for out m)))))

;; The interior mode is background; side midpoint colors define directions.
;; Preserve the border and clear the interior before moving original cells.
;; Matching side colors step once inward; blocked or unmatched cells stay put.
(rule! (lambda (g)
  (let ((h (rows g)) (w (cols g)))
    (let ((bg (first (sort-by (unique (reduce append (list)
                (map (lambda (r) (map (lambda (c) (at g r c)) (range 1 (- w 1)))) (range 1 (- h 1)))))
              (lambda (v) (- 0 (for/sum ((r (range 1 (- h 1))))
                                  (for/sum ((c (range 1 (- w 1))))
                                    (if (= (at g r c) v) 1 0)))))))))
      (let ((top-c (at g 0 (/ w 2)))
            (bot-c (at g (- h 1) (/ w 2)))
            (left-c (at g (/ h 2) 0))
            (right-c (at g (/ h 2) (- w 1))))
        (let ((base (grid-from-fn h w (lambda (r c)
                (if (or (zero? r) (= r (- h 1)) (zero? c) (= c (- w 1)))
                  (at g r c) bg)))))
          (reduce (lambda (acc r)
            (reduce (lambda (acc2 c)
              (let ((v (at g r c)))
                (if (= v bg) acc2
                  (let ((dr (if (= v top-c) -1 (if (= v bot-c) 1 (if (= v left-c) 0 (if (= v right-c) 0 0)))))
                        (dc (if (= v left-c) -1 (if (= v right-c) 1 (if (= v top-c) 0 (if (= v bot-c) 0 0))))))
                    (let ((nr (+ r dr)) (nc (+ c dc)))
                      (if (and (>= nr 1) (<= nr (- h 2)) (>= nc 1) (<= nc (- w 2)))
                        (set-cell acc2 nr nc v)
                        (if (or (not (zero? dr)) (not (zero? dc)))
                          (set-cell acc2 r c v)
                          (set-cell acc2 r c v))))))))
              acc (range 1 (- w 1))))
            base (range 1 (- h 1)))))))))

written_solution: Rectangles mirror across a full-span line, gaps between rects and line filled with line color
program_solution:
(rule!
 ;; A full one-color LINE mirrors the board. Every solid rectangle (4+
 ;; cells, not line-colored) reflects across it, and line-colored beams
 ;; connect BOTH the rectangle and its mirror image to the line (rows
 ;; strictly between, per rectangle row). Normalize so the line is
 ;; vertical — transpose in and out when it is horizontal.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define (line-col grid)  ;; first full uniform non-bg column
       (let ((bg (mode grid -1)))
         (find-first (lambda (c)
                       (and (not (= (at grid 0 c) bg))
                            (all? (lambda (r) (= (at grid r c)
                                                 (at grid 0 c)))
                                  (range 0 (rows grid)))))
                     (range 0 (cols grid)))))
     (define (solve grid)
       (let* ((ww (cols grid))
              (bg (mode grid -1))
              (pos (line-col grid))
              (line-color (at grid 0 pos))
              (mirror (lambda (c) (- (* 2 pos) c)))
              (rects (filter (lambda (o)
                               (and (not (= (obj-color o) line-color))
                                    (>= (obj-size o) 4)
                                    (= (obj-size o)
                                       (* (obj-h o) (obj-w o)))))
                             (objects grid bg)))
              (mirrored
               (for/fold ((out grid)) ((o rects))
                 (for*/fold ((acc out))
                            ((r (range (obj-r1 o) (+ (obj-r2 o) 1)))
                             (c (range (obj-c1 o) (+ (obj-c2 o) 1))))
                   (if (and (>= (mirror c) 0) (< (mirror c) ww))
                       (set-cell acc r (mirror c) (obj-color o))
                       acc)))))
         (for/fold ((out mirrored)) ((o rects))
           (for/fold ((acc out))
                     ((r (range (obj-r1 o) (+ (obj-r2 o) 1))))
             (let ((own (if (< (obj-c2 o) pos)
                            (range (+ (obj-c2 o) 1) pos)
                            (range (+ pos 1) (obj-c1 o))))
                   (refl (if (> (mirror (obj-c2 o)) pos)
                             (range (+ pos 1) (mirror (obj-c2 o)))
                             (range (+ (mirror (obj-c1 o)) 1) pos))))
               (for/fold ((a2 acc)) ((c (append own refl)))
                 (set-cell a2 r c line-color)))))))
     (if (line-col g)
         (solve g)
         (transpose (solve (transpose g)))))))

written_solution: Snake path on cyan(8) bg: trace connected path from endpoint, reverse the color sequence, keep positions same
program_solution:
(rule! (lambda (g)
  (let* ((h (rows g))
         (w (cols g))
         (bg 8)
         ;; The non-cyan cells are one unbranched path. Find its cells and
         ;; choose either degree-one endpoint as the traversal start.
         (cells
          (for*/list ((r (range 0 h))
                      (c (range 0 w))
                      #:when (not (= (cell-at g r c) bg)))
            (list r c)))
         (cell-set (make-hash))
         (seed-cell-set
          (for ((cell cells))
            (hash-set! cell-set cell #t)))
         (start #f)
         (find-endpoint
          (for ((cell cells))
            (let ((degree
                   (count-if
                    (lambda (neighbor) (hash-has-key? cell-set neighbor))
                    (list (list (- (first cell) 1) (second cell))
                          (list (+ (first cell) 1) (second cell))
                          (list (first cell) (- (second cell) 1))
                          (list (first cell) (+ (second cell) 1))))))
              (when (and (not start) (= degree 1))
                (set! start cell)))))
         ;; Trace the unique path and collect its positions in endpoint order.
         (path (list))
         (visited (make-hash))
         (trace-path
          (let trace ((current start))
            (when (and current
                       (hash-has-key? cell-set current)
                       (not (hash-has-key? visited current)))
              (hash-set! visited current #t)
              (set! path (append path (list current)))
              (let ((next
                     (find
                      (lambda (neighbor)
                        (and (hash-has-key? cell-set neighbor)
                             (not (hash-has-key? visited neighbor))))
                      (list (list (- (first current) 1) (second current))
                            (list (+ (first current) 1) (second current))
                            (list (first current) (- (second current) 1))
                            (list (first current) (+ (second current) 1))))))
                (trace next)))))
         ;; Reverse only the color sequence; every path coordinate is retained.
         (path-colors
          (map (lambda (position)
                 (cell-at g (first position) (second position)))
               path))
         (reversed-colors (reverse path-colors))
         (result (make-hash)))
    (for* ((r (range 0 h)) (c (range 0 w)))
      (hash-set! result (list r c) bg))
    (for ((i (range 0 (length path))))
      (hash-set! result (list-ref path i) (list-ref reversed-colors i)))
    (grid-from-fn h w
                  (lambda (r c) (hash-ref result (list r c) bg))))))
