(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((objs (objects-multicolor g 0))
                (cell-color (lambda (p) (at g (fst p) (snd p))))
                (is-rect-color (lambda (cells color)
                                 (let* ((cc (filter (lambda (p)
                                                      (= color (cell-color p)))
                                                    cells))
                                        (n (length cc)))
                                   (if (zero? n)
                                       #t
                                       (let ((bb (bbox-of-cells cc)))
                                         (= n
                                            (* (+ 1 (- (third bb) (first bb)))
                                               (+ 1 (- (fourth bb) (second bb))))))))))
                (is-seed (lambda (obj)
                           (let* ((cells (obj-cells obj))
                                  (colors (unique (map cell-color cells))))
                             (and
                               (<= (length colors) 2)
                               (all? (lambda (c) (is-rect-color cells c)) colors)))))
                (template (find-first (lambda (o) (not (is-seed o))) objs))
                (seeds (filter is-seed objs))
                (t-cells (obj-cells template))
                (t-colors (unique (map cell-color t-cells)))
                (t-mnr (min-of fst t-cells))
                (t-mnc (min-of snd t-cells))
                (apply-seed (lambda (out seed)
                              (let* ((s-cells (obj-cells seed))
                                     (s-colors (unique (map cell-color s-cells)))
                                     (common (find-first (lambda (c)
                                                           (member? c s-colors))
                                                         t-colors))
                                     (t-other (find-first (lambda (c) (!= c common))
                                                          t-colors))
                                     (new-color (find-first (lambda (c) (!= c common))
                                                            s-colors))
                                     (s-common-cells (filter (lambda (p)
                                                               (= common (cell-color p)))
                                                             s-cells))
                                     (scb (bbox-of-cells s-common-cells))
                                     (sc-mnr (first scb))
                                     (sc-mnc (second scb))
                                     (sc-mxr (third scb))
                                     (sc-mxc (fourth scb))
                                     (sc-h (+ 1 (- sc-mxr sc-mnr)))
                                     (sc-w (+ 1 (- sc-mxc sc-mnc)))
                                     (t-common-cells (filter (lambda (p)
                                                               (= common (cell-color p)))
                                                             t-cells))
                                     (tcb (bbox-of-cells t-common-cells))
                                     (tc-mnr (first tcb))
                                     (tc-mnc (second tcb))
                                     (tc-mxr (third tcb))
                                     (tc-mxc (fourth tcb))
                                     (tc-h (+ 1 (- tc-mxr tc-mnr)))
                                     (tc-w (+ 1 (- tc-mxc tc-mnc)))
                                     (scale (let ((sh (/ sc-h tc-h))
                                                  (sw (/ sc-w tc-w)))
                                              (if (> sh sw) sh sw)))
                                     (cleared (recolor-cells out s-cells 0))
                                     (t-common-lr (- tc-mnr t-mnr))
                                     (t-common-lc (- tc-mnc t-mnc))
                                     (out-tl-r (- sc-mnr (* t-common-lr scale)))
                                     (out-tl-c (- sc-mnc (* t-common-lc scale))))
                                (reduce (lambda (o p)
                                          (let* ((tr (fst p))
                                                 (tc (snd p))
                                                 (v (cell-color p))
                                                 (new-v (if (= v t-other) new-color v))
                                                 (lr (- tr t-mnr))
                                                 (lc (- tc t-mnc)))
                                            (reduce (lambda (o2 dd)
                                                      (let* ((dr (fst dd))
                                                             (dc (snd dd))
                                                             (nr (+ out-tl-r
                                                                    (* lr scale)
                                                                    dr))
                                                             (nc (+ out-tl-c
                                                                    (* lc scale)
                                                                    dc)))
                                                        (if (in-bounds? nr nc h w)
                                                            (set-cell o2 nr nc new-v)
                                                            o2)))
                                                    o
                                                    (positions-in-rect 0
                                                                       0
                                                                       (- scale 1)
                                                                       (- scale 1)))))
                                        cleared
                                        t-cells)))))
           (reduce apply-seed g seeds))))

written_solution: Find marker-free rect; pick widest marker rect as source; anchor each marker to closest corner (with tie handling) and apply to empty rect dimensions
program_solution:
(rule!
 ;; Two rectangles: a plain EMPTY one and a (widest) SOURCE stamped
 ;; with marker dots. Rebuild the empty rectangle with the markers
 ;; transferred edge-relative: each marker keeps its distance to its
 ;; NEAREST edge on each axis; an exact tie mirrors it to both sides.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define bg (at g 0 0))
     (define objs (objects-multicolor g bg))
     (define (colors-of o)
       (unique (map (lambda (p) (at g (first p) (second p)))
                    (obj-cells o))))
     (define blank (find (lambda (o) (= 1 (length (colors-of o)))) objs))
     (define blank-color (first (colors-of blank)))
     (define eh (obj-h blank))
     (define ew (obj-w blank))
     (define source
       (pick-max (filter (lambda (o) (> (length (colors-of o)) 1)) objs)
                 obj-w))
     (define rect-color  ;; the source's majority (frame) color
       (pick-max (colors-of source)
                 (lambda (c) (count-if (lambda (p)
                                         (= (at g (first p) (second p))
                                            c))
                                       (obj-cells source)))))
     (define marker-color
       (find-first (lambda (c) (not (= c rect-color)))
                   (colors-of source)))
     (define markers  ;; marker positions relative to the source bbox
       (map (lambda (p) (list (- (first p) (obj-r1 source))
                              (- (second p) (obj-c1 source))))
            (filter (lambda (p) (= (at g (first p) (second p))
                                   marker-color))
                    (obj-cells source))))
     (define (anchors mr mc)  ;; landing spots in the empty rectangle
       (let* ((bot (- (obj-h source) 1 mr))
              (right (- (obj-w source) 1 mc))
              (rrs (cond ((< mr bot) (list mr))
                         ((> mr bot) (list (- eh 1 bot)))
                         (else (list mr (- eh 1 bot)))))
              (ccs (cond ((< mc right) (list mc))
                         ((> mc right) (list (- ew 1 right)))
                         (else (list mc (- ew 1 right))))))
         (filter (lambda (rc) (in-bounds? (first rc) (second rc) eh ew))
                 (for*/list ((r rrs) (c ccs)) (list r c)))))
     (paint-cells (empty-grid eh ew blank-color)
                  (flatmap (lambda (m) (anchors (first m) (second m)))
                           markers)
                  marker-color))))

written_solution: Stamp-tile-canvas: red(2)/cyan(8) stamp shape, bg/cyan(8) tile pattern, stamp placed where tile has cyan(8), scaled to canvas
program_solution:
(rule!
 ;; Three pieces: a STAMP (bbox of the red-2 markers, extended downward through
 ;; non-empty rows), a TEMPLATE of 8s+bg right of the first 0-gap in the
 ;; stamp's top row, and a solid bg TARGET RECT below the template. The rect is
 ;; a fund grid of stamp-sized cells; the (possibly upscaled) template says
 ;; which cells receive the stamp (red prints as bg, everything else as-is).
 ;; bg = the first non-{0,2,8} cell in row-major order.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define h (rows g))
     (define w (cols g))
     (define (bbox pts)
       (list (apply min (map first pts)) (apply min (map second pts))
             (apply max (map first pts)) (apply max (map second pts))))
     (define bg
       (let ((p (find-first (lambda (p) (not (member (at g (first p) (second p))
                                                     '(0 2 8))))
                            (grid-positions g))))
         (at g (first p) (second p))))
     (define red-bb (bbox (find-color g 2)))
     (define sr1 (first red-bb))
     (define sc1 (second red-bb))
     (define sc2 (fourth red-bb))
     (define (row-nonempty? r)
       (ormap (lambda (c) (not (= (at g r c) 0))) (range sc1 (+ sc2 1))))
     (define sr2                      ; extend below the red bbox; a scan that
       (let loop ((r (+ (third red-bb) 1)))   ; falls off the grid reverts to it
         (cond ((>= r h) (third red-bb))
               ((row-nonempty? r) (loop (+ r 1)))
               (else (- r 1)))))
     (define sh (+ 1 (- sr2 sr1)))
     (define sw (+ 1 (- sc2 sc1)))
     (define stamp (subgrid g sr1 sc1 sr2 sc2))
     (define sep-c
       (let loop ((c (+ sc2 1)))
         (cond ((>= c w) sc2)
               ((= (at g sr1 c) 0) c)
               (else (loop (+ c 1))))))
     (define tile-8 (filter (lambda (p) (>= (second p) sep-c)) (find-color g 8)))
     (define t8-bb (bbox tile-8))
     (define tile-bg
       (filter (lambda (p) (and (<= (first t8-bb) (first p) (third t8-bb))
                                (<= (second t8-bb) (second p) (fourth t8-bb))))
               (find-color g bg)))
     (define tile-bb (bbox (append tile-8 tile-bg)))
     (define rect-bb
       (bbox (filter (lambda (p) (> (first p) (third tile-bb))) (find-color g bg))))
     (define rect-h (+ 1 (- (third rect-bb) (first rect-bb))))
     (define rect-w (+ 1 (- (fourth rect-bb) (second rect-bb))))
     (define cell-h (quotient (+ 1 (- (third tile-bb) (first tile-bb)))
                              (quotient rect-h sh)))
     (define cell-w (quotient (+ 1 (- (fourth tile-bb) (second tile-bb)))
                              (quotient rect-w sw)))
     (grid-from-fn rect-h rect-w
       (lambda (r c)
         (let ((tile-val (at g (+ (first tile-bb) (* (quotient r sh) cell-h))
                             (+ (second tile-bb) (* (quotient c sw) cell-w)))))
           (if (= tile-val 8)
               (let ((sv (at stamp (modulo r sh) (modulo c sw))))
                 (if (= sv 2) bg sv))
               bg)))))))

written_solution: 2x2 color key at corner: marker cells recolored by quadrant position using key mapping. Key at any corner, marker = key color found in main grid.
program_solution:
(rule! (lambda (g)
  (let* ((h (rows g))
         (w (cols g))
         ;; Scan the four 2x2 corner slots in reading order.  The first slot
         ;; whose top edge is neither background 0 nor separator 8 is the key.
         (key-r #f)
         (key-c #f)
         (key-scan
          (for ((pos (list (list 0 0)
                           (list 0 (- w 2))
                           (list (- h 2) 0)
                           (list (- h 2) (- w 2)))))
            (let ((kr (first pos)) (kc (second pos)))
              (when (and (not key-r)
                         (!= (at g kr kc) 0)
                         (!= (at g kr kc) 8)
                         (!= (at g kr (+ kc 1)) 0)
                         (!= (at g kr (+ kc 1)) 8))
                (set! key-r kr)
                (set! key-c kc)))))
         ;; The four key cells are the output colors for TL/TR/BL/BR.
         (k00 (at g key-r key-c))
         (k01 (at g key-r (+ key-c 1)))
         (k10 (at g (+ key-r 1) key-c))
         (k11 (at g (+ key-r 1) (+ key-c 1)))
         (key-set (make-hash))
         (key-set-init
          (begin
            (hash-set! key-set (list key-r key-c) #t)
            (hash-set! key-set (list key-r (+ key-c 1)) #t)
            (hash-set! key-set (list (+ key-r 1) key-c) #t)
            (hash-set! key-set (list (+ key-r 1) (+ key-c 1)) #t)))
         ;; The first non-key, non-0/8 cell in reading order names the marker
         ;; color.  Later body colors are distractors and must stay unchanged.
         (marker #f)
         (marker-scan
          (for* ((r (range 0 h)) (c (range 0 w)))
            (when (and (not marker)
                       (!= (at g r c) 0)
                       (!= (at g r c) 8)
                       (not (hash-has-key? key-set (list r c))))
              (set! marker (at g r c)))))
         ;; Zeros count toward the body bbox; only separator 8 and the key are
         ;; excluded.  Exact midpoint cells therefore belong bottom/right.
         (body-cells
          (for*/list ((r (range 0 h)) (c (range 0 w))
                      #:when (and (!= (at g r c) 8)
                                  (not (hash-has-key? key-set (list r c)))))
            (list r c)))
         (r1 (min-of first body-cells))
         (r2 (max-of first body-cells))
         (c1 (min-of second body-cells))
         (c2 (max-of second body-cells))
         (mid-r2 (+ r1 r2))
         (mid-c2 (+ c1 c2)))
    (build-grid h w (r c)
      (let ((v (at g r c)))
        (if (and (= v marker)

                   (list (reverse acc) c2)))

                 ((>= c w) (reverse acc))
                 ((zero? (at g r c)) (rrloop r (+ c 1) acc))
                 (else (let* ((res (extend2 r c (list)))
                              (cells (first res))
                              (next (second res)))

             (define dots (filter (lambda (rn) (= (length (third rn)) 1)) runs))

               (cond
                 ((null? cs) -1)
                 ((= (first cs) target) i)
                 (else (find-idx-loop (+ i 1) (cdr cs) target))))

                   #f

(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (begin

             (define (put gg r c v) (if (in-bounds? r c h w) (set-cell gg r c v) gg))
             (define comps
               (filter (lambda (o)
                         (let ((vals (map cell-color (obj-cells o))))
                           (and (member 4 vals) (for/or ((v vals)) (!= v 4)))))
                       (objects-multicolor g 0)))
             (define (avg-round xs)
               (let ((n (length xs)) (s (apply + xs))) (quotient (+ (* 2 s) n) (* 2 n))))
             (for/fold ((out g))
               ((comp comps))
               (define cells (obj-cells comp))
               (define fours (filter (lambda (p) (= (cell-color p) 4)) cells))
               (define payload (filter (lambda (p) (!= (cell-color p) 4)) cells))
               (define main-color (mode-list (map cell-color payload)))
               (define frs (map first fours))
               (define fcs (map second fours))
               (define span-r (- (max-list frs) (min-list frs)))
               (define span-c (- (max-list fcs) (min-list fcs)))
               (define cleared (paint-cells out payload 0))
               (if (> span-c span-r)
                   (let* ((axis (avg-round frs))
                          (above (count-if (lambda (p)
                                             (and
                                               (= (cell-color p) main-color)
                                               (< (first p) axis)))
                                           payload))
                          (below (count-if (lambda (p)
                                             (and
                                               (= (cell-color p) main-color)
                                               (> (first p) axis)))
                                           payload))
                          (choose-above (>= above below))
                          (source (filter (lambda (p)
                                            (or
                                              (= (first p) axis)
                                              (if choose-above
                                                  (< (first p) axis)
                                                  (> (first p) axis))))
                                          cells)))
                     (for/fold ((gg cleared))
                       ((p source))
                       (define r (first p))
                       (define c (second p))
                       (define rr (- (* 2 axis) r))
                       (define v (cell-color p))
                       (put (put gg r c v) rr c v)))
                   (let* ((axis (avg-round fcs))
                          (left (count-if (lambda (p)
                                            (and
                                              (= (cell-color p) main-color)
                                              (< (second p) axis)))
                                          payload))
                          (right (count-if (lambda (p)
                                             (and
                                               (= (cell-color p) main-color)
                                               (> (second p) axis)))
                                           payload))
                          (choose-left (>= left right))
                          (source (filter (lambda (p)
                                            (or
                                              (= (second p) axis)
                                              (if choose-left
                                                  (< (second p) axis)
                                                  (> (second p) axis))))
                                          cells)))
                     (for/fold ((gg cleared))
                       ((p source))
                       (define r (first p))
                       (define c (second p))
                       (define cc (- (* 2 axis) c))
                       (define v (cell-color p))
                       (put (put gg r c v) r cc v)))))))))

(rule!
 ;; A rectangular frame of four colored lines holds scattered dots
 ;; whose color matches ONE side. Crop to the frame; inside, every
 ;; occupied scan line smears solid toward the matching wall: dots
 ;; colored like the top wall fill from the wall down to their last
 ;; dot, like the bottom wall from their first dot to the wall, and
 ;; the left/right walls likewise along rows.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define (line? vals total)
       (let* ((colors (filter (lambda (v) (> v 0)) vals))
              (m (mode-list colors)))
         (and (>= (length colors) (- total 2))
              (not (eq? m #f))
              (>= (count-if (lambda (v) (= v m)) colors) (- total 2)))))
     (define line-rows
       (filter (lambda (r) (line? (row g r) w)) (range 0 h)))
     (define line-cols
       (filter (lambda (c) (line? (col g c) h)) (range 0 w)))
     (define top-r (first line-rows))
     (define bot-r (second line-rows))
     (define left-c (first line-cols))
     (define right-c (second line-cols))
     (define (line-mode vals)
       (mode-list (filter (lambda (v) (> v 0)) vals)))
     (define scatter-color
       (mode-list (map (lambda (p) (at g (first p) (second p)))
                       (filter (lambda (p)
                                 (and (> (first p) top-r)
                                      (< (first p) bot-r)
                                      (> (second p) left-c)
                                      (< (second p) right-c)
                                      (> (at g (first p) (second p)) 0)))
                               (grid-positions g)))))
     (define dir  ;; matched wall, checked in the original priority
       (cond ((= scatter-color (line-mode (row g top-r))) 'top)
             ((= scatter-color (line-mode (row g bot-r))) 'bot)
             ((= scatter-color (line-mode (col g left-c))) 'left)
             ((= scatter-color (line-mode (col g right-c))) 'right)
             (else #f)))
     (define vert? (member? dir (list 'top 'bot)))
     (define from-wall? (member? dir (list 'top 'left)))
     (build-grid (+ 1 (- bot-r top-r)) (+ 1 (- right-c left-c)) (orr oc)
                 (cond ((zero? orr) (at g top-r (+ left-c oc)))
                       ((= orr (- bot-r top-r)) (at g bot-r (+ left-c oc)))
                       ((zero? oc) (at g (+ top-r orr) left-c))
                       ((= oc (- right-c left-c))
                        (at g (+ top-r orr) right-c))
                       ((not dir) 0)
                       (else
                        (let* ((ir (+ top-r orr))
                               (ic (+ left-c oc))
                               (occ (if vert?
                                        (filter (lambda (r)
                                                  (> (at g r ic) 0))
                                                (range (+ top-r 1) bot-r))
                                        (filter (lambda (c)
                                                  (> (at g ir c) 0))
                                                (range (+ left-c 1)
                                                       right-c))))
                               (pos (if vert? ir ic)))
                          (if (and (not (null? occ))
                                   (if from-wall?
                                       (<= pos (max-list occ))
                                       (>= pos (min-list occ))))
                              scatter-color
                              0))))))))

               (filter (lambda (p) (not (member? p placed))) rem))

                          (placed (placed-at anchor (snd sh))))

                               (try-offsets rem p sh (cdr offs))))
                         (try-offsets rem p sh (cdr offs))))))

written_solution: detect 6x6 hexagon circles by color; determine blockers (colors at missing hex positions); topological sort (unblocked first); output 6-wide vertical stack of complete hexagon outlines

(rule!
 ;; Overlapping rings all share one 6x6 stencil (12 cells). Each
 ;; color's visible cells anchor its stencil copy; stencil cells it is
 ;; MISSING are hidden under rings lying on top. Order the colors so
 ;; every ring comes after the rings covering it (topmost first), then
 ;; print each ring complete in its own 6x6 tile, stacked vertically.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define bg (mode g 0))
     (define stencil
       (list (list 0 2) (list 0 3) (list 1 1) (list 1 4) (list 2 0)
             (list 2 5) (list 3 0) (list 3 5) (list 4 1) (list 4 4)
             (list 5 2) (list 5 3)))
     (define (anchor-of cells)  ;; stencil offset covering every cell
       (let ((bb (bbox-of-cells cells)))
         (and (<= (- (third bb) (first bb)) 5)
              (<= (- (fourth bb) (second bb)) 5)
              (find-first
               (lambda (t)
                 (all? (lambda (cell)
                         (member (list (- (first cell) (first t))
                                       (- (second cell) (second t)))
                                 stencil))
                       cells))
               (for*/list ((tr (range (max 0 (- (third bb) 5))
                                      (+ (first bb) 1)))
                           (tc (range (max 0 (- (fourth bb) 5))
                                      (+ (second bb) 1))))
                 (list tr tc))))))
     (define circles  ;; (color blockers) per ring color found
       (filter (lambda (x) x)
               (map (lambda (col)
                      (let ((cells (find-color g col)))
                        (and (>= (length cells) 4)
                             (let ((t (anchor-of cells)))
                               (and t
                                    (let* ((rel (map (lambda (cl)
                                                       (list (- (first cl)
                                                                (first t))
                                                             (- (second cl)
                                                                (second t))))
                                                     cells))
                                           (hidden
                                            (filter
                                             (lambda (pos)
                                               (and (not (member pos rel))
                                                    (in-bounds?
                                                     (+ (first pos)
                                                        (first t))
                                                     (+ (second pos)
                                                        (second t))
                                                     h w)))
                                             stencil)))
                                      (list col
                                            (remove-duplicates
                                             (filter
                                              (lambda (v)
                                                (and (not (= v bg))
                                                     (not (= v col))))
                                              (map (lambda (pos)
                                                     (at g
                                                         (+ (first pos)
                                                            (first t))
                                                         (+ (second pos)
                                                            (second t))))
                                                   hidden))))))))))
                    (filter (lambda (c) (not (= c bg))) (grid-colors g)))))
     (define ring-colors (map first circles))
     (define (covered-by col)  ;; ring colors sitting on top of col
       (filter (lambda (b) (member? b ring-colors))
               (second (find (lambda (ci) (= (first ci) col)) circles))))
     (define order  ;; topmost ring first, base ring last
       (let loop ((rem ring-colors) (acc (list)))
         (if (null? rem)
             (reverse acc)
             (let ((next (find-first
                          (lambda (c)
                            (all? (lambda (b) (member? b acc))
                                  (covered-by c)))
                          rem)))
               (if next
                   (loop (remove next rem) (cons next acc))
                   (loop (rest rem) (cons (first rem) acc)))))))
     (for/fold ((out (empty-grid (* (length order) 6) 6 bg)))
               ((i (range 0 (length order))))
       (paint-cells out
                    (map (lambda (pos) (list (+ (first pos) (* i 6))
                                             (second pos)))
                         stencil)
                    (nth order i))))))

(rule!
 ;; A bottom-row red seed grows a two-cell-wide staircase up and right.
 ;; Blue cells matter only when they occupy either prospective step cell:
 ;; skip to the first column beyond that blocker run, then bridge the shift
 ;; horizontally on the row below. Off-path blue cells remain unchanged.
 (lambda (g)
   (let* ((hh (rows g))
          (ww (cols g))
          (red-r #f)
          (red-c #f)
          (blue-map (make-hash))
          (scan-input
           (for* ((r (range 0 hh)) (c (range 0 ww)))
             (cond
               ((= (at g r c) 2)
                (set! red-r r)
                (set! red-c c))
               ((= (at g r c) 1)
                (hash-set! blue-map r
                  (cons c (hash-ref blue-map r (list))))))))
          (result (make-hash))
          (copy-input
           (for* ((r (range 0 hh)) (c (range 0 ww)))
             (hash-set! result (list r c) (at g r c))))
          (left-cols (make-hash))
          (cl red-c)
          ;; First determine the left column of every reachable step.
          (trace-path
           (let process ((row (- red-r 1)))
             (if (or (< row 0) (>= cl ww))
                 (+ row 1)
                 (begin
                   (let ((blues (hash-ref blue-map row (list))))
                     (let shift-past-run ((again #t))
                       (when (or (member cl blues) (member (+ cl 1) blues))
                         (set! cl
                           (+ 1
                              (max-list
                               (filter
                                (lambda (bc)
                                  (or (= bc cl) (= bc (+ cl 1))))
                                blues))))
                         (shift-past-run #f))))
                   (hash-set! left-cols row cl)
                   (set! cl (+ cl 1))
                   (process (- row 1))))))
          (prev-cl red-c)
          ;; Paint each two-cell step, adding a bridge only after a deflection.
          (paint-path
           (let paint-row ((row (- red-r 1)))
             (when (and (>= row 0) (hash-has-key? left-cols row))
               (let ((cl-here (hash-ref left-cols row)))
                 (when (> cl-here (+ prev-cl 1))
                   (let ((bridge-row (+ row 1)))
                     (for ((c (range (+ prev-cl 1) (+ cl-here 1))))
                       (when (and (>= c 0)
                                  (< c ww)
                                  (zero? (hash-ref result
                                                   (list bridge-row c)
                                                   0)))
                         (hash-set! result (list bridge-row c) 2)))))
                 (when (< cl-here ww)
                   (hash-set! result (list row cl-here) 2))
                 (when (< (+ cl-here 1) ww)
                   (hash-set! result (list row (+ cl-here 1)) 2))
                 (set! prev-cl cl-here)
                 (paint-row (- row 1)))))))
     (build-grid hh ww (r c)
       (hash-ref result (list r c) 0)))))

written_solution: Lift gray(5) source shapes into matching holes in the red(2) band, recolored blue(1)

(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (begin
             (define gray-objs
               (sort-by (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) 5)) (objects g 0))
                        (lambda (o)
                          (+ (* -10000 (obj-size o)) (* 100 (obj-r1 o)) (obj-c1 o)))))
             (define (normalize obj)
               (let* ((cells (obj-cells obj))
                      (r0 (min-of first cells))
                      (c0 (min-of second cells)))
                 (map (lambda (p) (list (- (first p) r0) (- (second p) c0))) cells)))
             (define (clear-gray out)
               (for/fold ((acc out))
                 ((obj gray-objs))
                 (for/fold ((a acc))
                   ((p (obj-cells obj)))
                   (set-cell a (first p) (second p) 0))))
             (define (fits? acc shape r0 c0)
               (and
                 (for/and ((p shape))
                          (let ((rr (+ r0 (first p)))
                                (cc (+ c0 (second p))))
                            (and
                              (in-bounds? rr cc h w)
                              (zero? (at g rr cc))
                              (zero? (at acc rr cc)))))
                 (for/and ((p (filter (lambda (q) (zero? (first q))) shape)))
                          (let ((ar (- r0 1))
                                (ac (+ c0 (second p))))
                            (and (in-bounds? ar ac h w) (= (at g ar ac) 2))))))
             (define (first-placement acc shape)
               (for*/first ((r0 (range 1 h)) (c0 (range 0 w))
                             #:when
                             (fits? acc shape r0 c0))
                           (list r0 c0)))
             (define (paint-shape acc shape pos)
               (if pos
                   (for/fold ((a acc))
                     ((p shape))
                     (set-cell a
                               (+ (first pos) (first p))
                               (+ (second pos) (second p))
                               1))
                   acc))
             (for/fold ((acc (clear-gray g)))
               ((obj gray-objs))
               (let* ((shape (normalize obj))
                      (pos (first-placement acc shape)))
                 (paint-shape acc shape pos)))))))

(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((top-line? (for/and ((c (range 0 w))) (= (at g 0 c) 2)))
                  (bot-line? (for/and ((c (range 0 w))) (= (at g (- h 1) c) 2)))
                  (left-line? (for/and ((r (range 0 h))) (= (at g r 0) 2)))
                  (right-line? (for/and ((r (range 0 h))) (= (at g r (- w 1)) 2)))
                  (dir (cond
                         (top-line? 'up)
                         (bot-line? 'down)
                         (left-line? 'left)
                         (right-line? 'right)))
                  (non-2-objs (filter (lambda (o) (!= (obj-color o) 2)) (objects g 0)))
                  (sorted (sort non-2-objs
                                (lambda (a b)
                                  (let ((aa (obj-bbox a))
                                        (bb (obj-bbox b)))
                                    (cond
                                      ((eq? dir 'up) (< (first aa) (first bb)))
                                      ((eq? dir 'down) (> (third aa) (third bb)))
                                      ((eq? dir 'left) (< (second aa) (second bb)))
                                      (else (> (fourth aa) (fourth bb))))))))
                  (base (cellmap g (r c v) (if (= v 2) 2 0)))
                  (occupied (make-hash))
                  (_init (for ((r (range 0 h)))
                           (for ((c (range 0 w)))
                             (when (= (at g r c) 2) (hash-set! occupied (list r c) #t))))))
             (for/fold ((out base))
               ((shape sorted))
               (let* ((cells (obj-cells shape))
                      (cells-colored (map (lambda (c)
                                            (list (first c)
                                                  (second c)
                                                  (at g (first c) (second c))))
                                          cells))
                      (slide-d (let loop
                                    ((d 0))
                                    (let* ((dr (cond
                                                 ((eq? dir 'up) (- 0 (+ d 1)))
                                                 ((eq? dir 'down) (+ d 1))
                                                 (else 0)))
                                           (dc (cond
                                                 ((eq? dir 'left) (- 0 (+ d 1)))
                                                 ((eq? dir 'right) (+ d 1))
                                                 (else 0)))
                                           (can-move (for/and ((c cells))
                                                              (let ((nr (+ (first c) dr))
                                                                    (nc (+ (second c)

                                                                  (< nc w)
                                                                  (not (hash-has-key? occupied
                                                                                      (list nr
                                                                                            nc))))))))
                                      (cond (can-move (loop (+ d 1))) (else d)))))
                      (fdr (cond
                             ((eq? dir 'up) (- 0 slide-d))
                             ((eq? dir 'down) slide-d)
                             (else 0)))
                      (fdc (cond
                             ((eq? dir 'left) (- 0 slide-d))
                             ((eq? dir 'right) slide-d)
                             (else 0))))
                 (for/fold ((o out))
                   ((cc cells-colored))

                         (nc (+ (second cc) fdc))
                         (col (third cc)))
                     (hash-set! occupied (list nr nc) #t)
                     (set-cell o nr nc col)))))))))

(rule!
  ;; Laser from a 2-cell green(3) seed: beams start at every seed cell along
  ;; the seed's axis (one shared row -> horizontal, else vertical), paint
  ;; traversed orange(7) green, SPLIT perpendicular at cyan(8) walls, and stop
  ;; at grid edges. Pure worklist over (r c dr dc) beam states.
  (lambda (g)
    (let* ((h (rows g))
           (w (cols g))
           (open? (lambda (r c) (and (in-bounds? r c h w) (!= (at g r c) 8))))
           (seeds (find-color g 3))
           (horiz (= 1 (length (unique (map first seeds)))))
           (dirs (if horiz
                     (list (list 0 1) (list 0 -1))
                     (list (list 1 0) (list -1 0))))
           (start (flatmap (lambda (p)
                             (map (lambda (d)
                                    (list (first p) (second p) (first d) (second d)))
                                  dirs))
                           seeds))
           (filled
             (let run ((stack start) (visited (list)) (acc seeds))
               (cond
                 ((null? stack) acc)
                 ((member (first stack) visited)
                  (run (rest stack) visited acc))
                 (else
                  (let* ((head (first stack))
                         (dr (third head))
                         (dc (fourth head))
                         (seen (cons head visited)))
                    (let march ((cr (first head)) (cc (second head)) (hit acc))
                      (let ((nr (+ cr dr)) (nc (+ cc dc)))
                        (cond
                          ((open? nr nc) (march nr nc (cons (list nr nc) hit)))
                          ((and (in-bounds? nr nc h w) (= (at g nr nc) 8))
                           (let* ((perp (if (!= dc 0)
                                            (list (list 1 0) (list -1 0))
                                            (list (list 0 1) (list 0 -1))))
                                  (splits (map (lambda (d)
                                                 (list cr cc (first d) (second d)))
                                               (filter (lambda (d)
                                                         (open? (+ cr (first d))
                                                                (+ cc (second d))))
                                                       perp))))
                             (run (append splits (rest stack)) seen hit)))
                          (else (run (rest stack) seen hit)))))))))))
      (cellmap g (r c v)
        (if (and (= v 7) (member (list r c) filled)) 3 v)))))

(rule! (lambda (g)
  (let* ((h (rows g))
         (w (cols g))
         ;; Start from an exact copy so every non-target blue shape is preserved.
         (result (make-hash)))
    (for* ((r (range 0 h)) (c (range 0 w)))
      (hash-set! result (list r c) (at g r c)))
    ;; A target is exactly a 3x3 blue(1) frame surrounding a zero center.
    (for* ((r (range 1 (- h 1))) (c (range 1 (- w 1))))
      (when (and (zero? (at g r c))
                 (= (at g (- r 1) (- c 1)) 1)
                 (= (at g (- r 1) c) 1)
                 (= (at g (- r 1) (+ c 1)) 1)
                 (= (at g r (- c 1)) 1)
                 (= (at g r (+ c 1)) 1)
                 (= (at g (+ r 1) (- c 1)) 1)
                 (= (at g (+ r 1) c) 1)
                 (= (at g (+ r 1) (+ c 1)) 1))
        ;; Replace that frame with a red(2) plus: erase corners, paint cross.
        (hash-set! result (list (- r 1) (- c 1)) 0)
        (hash-set! result (list (- r 1) (+ c 1)) 0)
        (hash-set! result (list (+ r 1) (- c 1)) 0)
        (hash-set! result (list (+ r 1) (+ c 1)) 0)
        (hash-set! result (list (- r 1) c) 2)
        (hash-set! result (list r (- c 1)) 2)
        (hash-set! result (list r c) 2)
        (hash-set! result (list r (+ c 1)) 2)
        (hash-set! result (list (+ r 1) c) 2)))
    ;; Construct a fresh result grid; the input object is never mutated.
    (cellmap g (r c v) (hash-ref result (list r c) 0)))))

written_solution: L-trominos: find open corner of 2x2 bbox, draw diagonal ray from open corner away from L, extending to grid edge
program_solution:
(rule!
  (let ()
    ;; alt: identify each 3-cell L by its missing corner in the 2x2 bbox,
    ;; then march one diagonal step farther in that same direction.
    (define (has-cell? cells r c)
      (member? (list r c) cells))
    (define (paint-ray out color r c dr dc)
      (let loop ([acc out] [rr (+ r dr)] [cc (+ c dc)])
        (if (in-bounds? rr cc (rows g) (cols g))
            (loop (set-cell acc rr cc color) (+ rr dr) (+ cc dc))
            acc)))
    (define (paint-l out obj)
      (let* ([cells (obj-cells obj)]
             [bb (obj-bbox obj)]
             [r0 (first bb)]
             [c0 (second bb)]
             [color (obj-color obj)]
             [misses
              (filter (lambda (p) (not (has-cell? cells (first p) (second p))))
                      (list (list r0 c0)
                            (list r0 (+ c0 1))
                            (list (+ r0 1) c0)
                            (list (+ r0 1) (+ c0 1))))])
        (if (empty? misses)
            out
            (let* ([m (first misses)]
                   [mr (first m)]
                   [mc (second m)]
                   [corner-r (if (= mr r0) (+ r0 1) r0)]
                   [corner-c (if (= mc c0) (+ c0 1) c0)]
                   [dr (- mr corner-r)]
                   [dc (- mc corner-c)])
              (paint-ray out color mr mc dr dc)))))
    (for/fold ([out g])
              ([obj (in-list (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-size o) 3))
                                     (objects g 0)))])
      (paint-l out obj))))

(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))

                  (templates (filter (lambda (o)
                                       (let ((colors (remove-duplicates (map (lambda (c)
                                                                               (at g
                                                                                   (first c)
                                                                                   (second c)))
                                                                             (obj-cells o)))))
                                         (>= (length colors) 2)))
                                     mcomps))
                  (tmpl-rels (map (lambda (t)
                                    (let* ((cells (obj-cells t))
                                           (bb (bbox-of-cells cells))
                                           (r1 (first bb))
                                           (c1 (second bb)))
                                      (map (lambda (c)
                                             (list (- (first c) r1)
                                                   (- (second c) c1)
                                                   (at g (first c) (second c))))
                                           cells)))
                                  templates))
                  (tmpl-set (make-hash))
                  (_1 (for ((t templates))
                        (for ((c (obj-cells t)))
                          (hash-set! tmpl-set (list (first c) (second c)) #t))))
                  (partials (reverse (fold-cells g
                                                 (list)
                                                 (lambda (acc r c v)
                                                   (if (and
                                                         (!= v 0)
                                                         (not (hash-has-key? tmpl-set
                                                                             (list r c))))
                                                       (cons (list r c v) acc)
                                                       acc)))))
                  (partial-set (make-hash))
                  (_2 (for ((p partials))
                        (hash-set! partial-set (list (first p) (second p)) (third p))))
                  (candidates (apply append
                                     (map (lambda (p)
                                            (apply append
                                                   (map (lambda (t-rel)
                                                          (map (lambda (tc)
                                                                 (list (- (first p)
                                                                          (first tc))
                                                                       (- (second p)
                                                                          (second tc))
                                                                       t-rel))
                                                               (filter (lambda (tc)
                                                                         (= (third tc)
                                                                            (third p)))
                                                                       t-rel)))
                                                        tmpl-rels)))
                                          partials)))
                  (scored (filter (lambda (x) x)
                                  (map (lambda (cand)
                                         (let* ((off-r (first cand))
                                                (off-c (second cand))
                                                (t-rel (third cand))
                                                (abs-cells (map (lambda (tc)
                                                                  (list (+ (first tc)
                                                                           off-r)
                                                                        (+ (second tc)
                                                                           off-c)
                                                                        (third tc)))
                                                                t-rel))
                                                (valid (let check
                                                            ((cs abs-cells))
                                                            (cond
                                                              ((null? cs) #t)
                                                              (else (let* ((c (car cs))
                                                                           (ar (first c))
                                                                           (ac (second c))
                                                                           (av (third c)))
                                                                      (cond
                                                                        ((not (in-bounds? ar
                                                                                          ac
                                                                                          h
                                                                                          w)) #f)
                                                                        ((hash-has-key? tmpl-set
                                                                                        (list ar
                                                                                              ac)) #f)
                                                                        ((let ((gv (at g
                                                                                       ar
                                                                                       ac)))
                                                                           (or
                                                                             (zero? gv)
                                                                             (= gv av))) (check (cdr cs)))
                                                                        (else #f)))))))
                                                (covered (if valid
                                                             (filter (lambda (ac)
                                                                       (hash-has-key? partial-set
                                                                                      (list (first ac)
                                                                                            (second ac))))
                                                                     abs-cells)
                                                             '
                                                             ())))
                                           (and
                                             (and valid (> (length covered) 0))
                                             (list (length covered) covered abs-cells))))
                                       candidates)))
                  (sorted (sort scored (lambda (a b) (> (first a) (first b)))))
                  (used (make-hash)))
             (for/fold ((out g))
               ((c sorted))
               (let* ((covered (second c))
                      (abs-cells (third c))
                      (overlap (let check
                                    ((cs covered))
                                    (cond
                                      ((null? cs) #f)
                                      ((hash-has-key? used
                                                      (list (first (car cs))
                                                            (second (car cs)))) #t)
                                      (else (check (cdr cs)))))))
                 (cond
                   (overlap out)
                   (else (for ((cov covered))
                           (hash-set! used (list (first cov) (second cov)) #t))
                         (paint-cells out abs-cells)))))))))

(rule!
  ;; alt: filter `(objects g 0)` by LR symmetry, sort by `obj-size`, then crop the winner's bbox.
  (lambda (g)
    (define objs (objects g 0))
    (define (bbox-lr-symmetric? bb)
      (let* ((r0 (first bb))
             (c0 (second bb))
             (r1 (third bb))
             (c1 (fourth bb))
             (w (+ 1 (- c1 c0))))
        (and (> w 1)
             (for*/and ((r (in-range r0 (+ r1 1)))
                        (c (in-range c0 (+ c1 1))))
               (= (at g r c)
                  (at g r (- (+ c0 c1) c)))))))
    (define symmetric-objs
      (filter (lambda (o) (bbox-lr-symmetric? (obj-bbox o))) objs))
    (define chosen
      (if (empty? symmetric-objs)
          (first objs)
          (first (sort symmetric-objs
                       (lambda (a b) (> (obj-size a) (obj-size b)))))))
    (let* ((bb (obj-bbox chosen))
           (r0 (first bb))
           (c0 (second bb))
           (r1 (third bb))
           (c1 (fourth bb)))
      (subgrid g r0 c0 r1 c1))))

                                   (range 0 w)))

                                           (- (nth row-bounds (+ i 1)) 1)))
                                   (range 0 (- (length row-bounds) 1))))
                (col-bounds (append (list -1) zero-cols (list w)))

                                           (- (nth col-bounds (+ i 1)) 1)))
                                   (range 0 (- (length col-bounds) 1))))
                (dominant (lambda (r1 r2 c1 c2)
                            (let* ((vals (flatmap (lambda (r)
                                                    (filter (lambda (v) (!= 0 v))
                                                            (map (lambda (c) (at g r c))
                                                                 (range c1 (+ c2 1)))))
                                                  (range r1 (+ r2 1))))
                                   (uniq (unique vals))
                                   (counts (map (lambda (v)
                                                  (list v
                                                        (count-if (lambda (x) (= x v))
                                                                  vals)))
                                                uniq))
                                   (sorted (sort-by counts (lambda (p) (- (second p))))))
                              (first (first sorted)))))
                (oh (length row-sections))
                (ow (length col-sections)))
           (build-grid oh
                       ow
                       (rr cc)
                       (let ((rsec (nth row-sections rr))
                             (csec (nth col-sections cc)))
                         (dominant (first rsec)
                                   (second rsec)
                                   (first csec)
                                   (second csec)))))))

                                   ((r 0))
                                   (if (>= r cross-r)
                                       #f
                                       (let cloop
                                            ((c 0))
                                            (if (>= c w)
                                                (loop (+ r 1))
                                                (let ((v (cell-at g r c)))
                                                  (if (and
                                                        (not (= v 0))
                                                        (not (= v 3))
                                                        (not (= v 8)))
                                                      #t
                                                      (cloop (+ c 1)))))))))
                   (key-left (let loop
                                  ((c 0))
                                  (if (>= c cross-c)
                                      #f
                                      (let rloop
                                           ((r 0))
                                           (if (>= r h)
                                               (loop (+ c 1))
                                               (let ((v (cell-at g r c)))
                                                 (if (and
                                                       (not (= v 0))
                                                       (not (= v 3))
                                                       (not (= v 8)))
                                                     #t
                                                     (rloop (+ r 1))))))))))
               (let ((kr1 (if key-above 0 (+ cross-r 1)))
                     (kc1 (if key-left 0 (+ cross-c 1)))
                     (gr1 (if key-above (+ cross-r 1) 0))
                     (gc1 (if key-left (+ cross-c 1) 0))
                     (gr2 (if key-above h cross-r))
                     (gc2 (if key-left w cross-c)))
                 (let ((gh (- gr2 gr1))
                       (gw (- gc2 gc1))
                       (k00 (cell-at g kr1 kc1))
                       (k01 (cell-at g kr1 (+ kc1 1)))
                       (k10 (cell-at g (+ kr1 1) kc1))
                       (k11 (cell-at g (+ kr1 1) (+ kc1 1))))

                                     (if (= (cell-at g (+ gr1 r) (+ gc1 c)) 3)

                                                                                         0)
                                                                                   (list 1
                                                                                         0)
                                                                                   (list 0
                                                                                         -1)
                                                                                   (list 0
                                                                                         1))) (a acc))
                                                                    (cond
                                                                      ((null? deltas) a)
                                                                      (else (let* ((d (car deltas))
                                                                                   (nr (+ r
                                                                                          (first d)))
                                                                                   (nc (+ c
                                                                                          (second d))))
                                                                              (cond
                                                                                ((or

                                                                                   (< nc

                                                                                   (>= nc
                                                                                       w)) (nbr-loop (cdr deltas)

                                                                                                   nr
                                                                                                   nc)))

                                                                                          ((and
                                                                                             (!= v
                                                                                                 0)
                                                                                             (!= v
                                                                                                 5)) (nbr-loop (cdr deltas)
                                                                                                      (cons v
                                                                                                            a)))
                                                                                          (else (nbr-loop (cdr deltas)
                                                                                                          a))))))))))))
                                                 (collect (cdr cs) new-acc))))))
                      (counts (let loop
                                   ((lst indicators) (acc (list)))
                                   (cond
                                     ((null? lst) acc)

                                                  (existing (assoc v acc)))

written_solution: stamp clipped D4 copies of the 1/4 template wherever at least two marker cells agree

(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (begin
             (define ones (positions-of g (lambda (v) (= v 1))))
             (define r0 (min-of first ones))
             (define r1 (max-of first ones))
             (define c0 (min-of second ones))
             (define c1 (max-of second ones))
             (define base
               (filter identity
                       (for*/list ((r (range r0 (+ r1 1))) (c (range c0 (+ c1 1))))
                         (let ((v (at g r c)))
                           (and (or (= v 1) (= v 4)) (list (- r r0) (- c c0) v))))))
             (define all4 (positions-of g (lambda (v) (= v 4))))
             (define (transform-pos p idx)
               (let ((r (first p))
                     (c (second p)))
                 (cond
                   ((zero? idx) (list r c))
                   ((= idx 1) (list c (- r)))
                   ((= idx 2) (list (- r) (- c)))
                   ((= idx 3) (list (- c) r))
                   ((= idx 4) (list r (- c)))
                   ((= idx 5) (list (- c) (- r)))
                   ((= idx 6) (list (- r) c))
                   (else (list c r)))))
             (define (entries-after idx)
               (let* ((raws (map (lambda (e) (transform-pos e idx)) base))
                      (mr (min-of first raws))
                      (mc (min-of second raws)))
                 (map (lambda (e)
                        (let ((p (transform-pos e idx)))
                          (list (- (first p) mr) (- (second p) mc) (third e))))
                      base)))
             (define (valid-candidate? entries ar ac)
               (let* ((placed4 (filter (lambda (p)
                                         (in-bounds? (first p) (second p) h w))
                                       (map (lambda (e)
                                              (list (+ ar (first e)) (+ ac (second e))))
                                            (filter (lambda (e) (= (third e) 4))
                                                    entries))))
                      (placed1 (filter (lambda (p)
                                         (in-bounds? (first p) (second p) h w))
                                       (map (lambda (e)
                                              (list (+ ar (first e)) (+ ac (second e))))
                                            (filter (lambda (e) (= (third e) 1))
                                                    entries)))))
                 (and
                   (>= (length placed4) 2)
                   (for/and ((p placed4)) (member p all4))
                   (for/and ((p placed1))
                            (let ((v (at g (first p) (second p))))
                              (or (zero? v) (= v 1)))))))
             (define candidates
               (flatmap (lambda (idx)
                          (let* ((entries (entries-after idx))
                                 (maxr (max-of first entries))
                                 (maxc (max-of second entries)))
                            (filter identity
                                    (for*/list ((ar (range (- maxr) h)) (ac (range (- maxc) w)))
                                      (and
                                        (valid-candidate? entries ar ac)
                                        (map (lambda (e)
                                               (list (+ ar (first e)) (+ ac (second e))))
                                             (filter (lambda (e) (= (third e) 1))
                                                     entries)))))))
                        (range 0 8)))
             (for/fold ((out g))
               ((cells candidates))
               (for/fold ((gg out))
                 ((p cells))
                 (if (and
                       (in-bounds? (first p) (second p) h w)
                       (zero? (at g (first p) (second p))))
                     (set-cell gg (first p) (second p) 1)
                     gg)))))))

written_solution: extend diagonal of 1s in both directions; bounce off red(2) walls (vertical bar reflects horizontal motion, horizontal bar reflects vertical); pass through and overwrite green(3) cells
program_solution:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (begin
             (define (in-b r c) (and (>= r 0) (< r h) (>= c 0) (< c w)))
             (define ones (find-color g 1))
             (define p1 (first ones))
             (define p2
               (find (lambda (p)
                       (and
                         (!= p p1)
                         (= 1 (abs (- (first p) (first p1))))
                         (= 1 (abs (- (second p) (second p1))))))
                     ones))
             (define dir
               (if p2
                   (list (- (first p2) (first p1)) (- (second p2) (second p1)))
                   (list 1 1)))
             (define (wall-orient r c)
               (let ((up (and (in-b (- r 1) c) (= (at g (- r 1) c) 2)))
                     (dn (and (in-b (+ r 1) c) (= (at g (+ r 1) c) 2))))
                 (if (or up dn) 'vertical 'horizontal)))
             (define max-steps (* h w 4))
             (define (walk gg r c dr dc fuel)
               (if (<= fuel 0)
                   gg
                   (let ((nr (+ r dr))
                         (nc (+ c dc)))
                     (cond
                       ((not (in-b nr nc)) gg)
                       ((= (at g nr nc) 2) (let* ((orient (wall-orient nr nc))
                                (ndr (if (= orient 'horizontal) (- dr) dr))
                                (ndc (if (= orient 'vertical) (- dc) dc)))
                           (walk gg r c ndr ndc (- fuel 1))))
                       (else (walk (set-cell gg nr nc 1) nr nc dr dc (- fuel 1)))))))
             (define sorted-by-row (sort-by ones (lambda (p) (first p))))
             (define start-bwd (first sorted-by-row))
             (define start-fwd (nth sorted-by-row (- (length sorted-by-row) 1)))
             (define after-fwd
               (walk g
                     (first start-fwd)
                     (second start-fwd)
                     (first dir)
                     (second dir)
                     max-steps))
             (walk after-fwd
                   (first start-bwd)
                   (second start-bwd)
                   (- 0 (first dir))
                   (- 0 (second dir))
                   max-steps)))))

written_solution: staircase path between 2 endpoints through stripe markers; transpose for vertical stripes; path goes horizontal-vertical alternating through waypoint middle columns
program_solution:
(rule!
 ;; Two endpoint dots (the color appearing exactly twice) and a stack
 ;; of stripe walls, each pierced by waypoint marks. Route the path:
 ;; drop from the upper endpoint, elbow one row above each stripe over
 ;; to its waypoint column (middle mark when several), punch through,
 ;; and finally hook over to the lower endpoint. Vertical stripes are
 ;; solved by transposing in and out.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define freq (color-frequency g))
     (define bg (mode g))
     (define ep-color
       (find-first (lambda (c) (= (hash-ref freq c 0) 2))
                   (grid-colors g)))
     (define others
       (filter (lambda (c) (and (not (= c bg)) (not (= c ep-color))))
               (grid-colors g)))
     (define stripe-color
       (find-first (lambda (c) (> (hash-ref freq c 0) 30)) others))
     (define wp-color
       (find-first (lambda (c) (and (not (= c stripe-color))
                                    (< (hash-ref freq c 0) 30)
                                    (> (hash-ref freq c 0) 2)))
                   others))
     (define horiz
       (let ((cells (find-color g stripe-color)))
         (> (max-of (lambda (r) (count-if (lambda (p) (= (first p) r))
                                          cells))
                    (remove-duplicates (map first cells)))
            (max-of (lambda (c) (count-if (lambda (p) (= (second p) c))
                                          cells))
                    (remove-duplicates (map second cells))))))
     (define (solve gg)
       (let* ((hh (rows gg)) (ww (cols gg))
              (stripe-rows
               (filter (lambda (r)
                         (>= (count-if (lambda (c) (= (at gg r c)
                                                      stripe-color))
                                       (range 0 ww))
                             (- ww 5)))
                       (range 0 hh)))
              (eps (find-color gg ep-color))
              (upper? (< (first (first eps)) (first (second eps))))
              (start (if upper? (first eps) (second eps)))
              (goal (if upper? (second eps) (first eps)))
              (wp-cells (find-color gg wp-color))
              (marker-col
               (lambda (sr)
                 (let ((cols (sort (map second
                                        (filter (lambda (p)
                                                  (= (first p) sr))
                                                wp-cells))
                                   <)))
                   (cond ((null? cols) -1)
                         ((= (length cols) 1) (first cols))
                         (else (nth cols (quotient (length cols) 2)))))))
              (vseg (lambda (out r1 r2 c)  ;; inclusive vertical run
                      (recolor-cells out
                                     (map (lambda (r) (list r c))
                                          (range (min r1 r2)
                                                 (+ (max r1 r2) 1)))
                                     ep-color)))
              (hseg (lambda (out r c1 c2)  ;; inclusive horizontal run
                      (recolor-cells out
                                     (map (lambda (c) (list r c))
                                          (range (min c1 c2)
                                                 (+ (max c1 c2) 1)))
                                     ep-color))))
         (let loop ((cur-r (+ (first start) 1))
                    (cur-c (second start))
                    (stripes (map (lambda (sr) (list sr (marker-col sr)))
                                  stripe-rows))
                    (out gg))
           (if (null? stripes)
               (hseg (recolor-cells out
                                    (map (lambda (r) (list r cur-c))
                                         (range cur-r (first goal)))
                                    ep-color)
                     (first goal) cur-c (second goal))
               (let ((sr (first (first stripes)))
                     (mc (second (first stripes))))
                 (loop (+ sr 1) mc (rest stripes)
                       (set-cell (hseg (vseg out cur-r (- sr 1) cur-c)
                                       (- sr 1) cur-c mc)
                                 sr mc ep-color)))))))
     (if horiz (solve g) (transpose (solve (transpose g)))))))

written_solution: classify border fragments by oriented bbox edges and repack them into the smallest square
program_solution:
(rule!
 ;; Scattered frame pieces reassemble into an n-by-n border. Classify
 ;; each piece by which full edges it owns: 1-row strips are TOP runs,
 ;; corner pieces own a full row plus a full column (top-left,
 ;; bottom-left, bottom-right), everything else is a SIDE piece. n =
 ;; the widest assembled edge. Corners and strips chain left-to-right
 ;; along their edge; each side piece climbs up from the bottom corner
 ;; it sat closest to in the input.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define bg
       (mode-list (for*/list ((r (range 0 h)) (c (range 0 w)))
                    (at g r c))))
     (define (full-row? cells r ww)
       (all? (lambda (c) (member (list r c) cells)) (range 0 ww)))
     (define (full-col? cells c hh)
       (all? (lambda (r) (member (list r c) cells)) (range 0 hh)))
     (define (classify cells hh ww)
       (cond ((and (= hh 1) (> ww 1)) 'top)
             ((and (> hh 1) (> ww 1)
                   (full-row? cells 0 ww) (full-col? cells 0 hh))
              'top-left)
             ((and (> hh 1) (> ww 1)
                   (full-row? cells (- hh 1) ww) (full-col? cells 0 hh))
              'bottom-left)
             ((and (> hh 1) (> ww 1)
                   (full-row? cells (- hh 1) ww)
                   (full-col? cells (- ww 1) hh))
              'bottom-right)
             (else 'side)))
     ;; entry = (type obj cells hh ww color), cells normalized
     (define entries
       (map (lambda (o)
              (let* ((cells (normalize-cells (obj-cells o)))
                     (hh (+ 1 (max-of first cells)))
                     (ww (+ 1 (max-of second cells))))
                (list (classify cells hh ww) o cells hh ww (obj-color o))))
            (objects g bg)))
     (define (eobj e) (second e))
     (define (ecells e) (third e))
     (define (eh e) (fourth e))
     (define (ew e) (fifth e))
     (define (ecolor e) (sixth e))
     (define (of-type sym)
       (sort (filter (lambda (e) (eq? (first e) sym)) entries)
             (lambda (a b) (< (obj-c1 (eobj a)) (obj-c1 (eobj b))))))
     (define (sum-w xs) (apply + (cons 0 (map ew xs))))
     (define top-lefts (of-type 'top-left))
     (define tops (of-type 'top))
     (define bottom-lefts (of-type 'bottom-left))
     (define bottom-rights (of-type 'bottom-right))
     (define sides (of-type 'side))
     (define n
       (max (+ (sum-w top-lefts) (sum-w tops))
            (+ (sum-w bottom-lefts) (sum-w bottom-rights))
            (max-of (lambda (e) (max (eh e) (ew e))) entries)))
     (define (place out e tr tc)
       (paint-cells out
                    (map (lambda (p) (list (+ tr (first p))
                                           (+ tc (second p))))
                         (ecells e))
                    (ecolor e)))
     (define (chain-right out xs r c)  ;; pieces side by side along a row
       (for/fold ((gg out) (cc c) #:result gg) ((e xs))
         (values (place gg e r cc) (+ cc (ew e)))))
     (define (chain-bottom-right out xs)
       (for/fold ((gg out) (cc n) #:result gg) ((e (reverse xs)))
         (define nc (- cc (ew e)))
         (values (place gg e (- n (eh e)) nc) nc)))
     (define (center2 e) (+ (obj-c1 (eobj e)) (obj-c2 (eobj e))))
     (define bl-center
       (if (null? bottom-lefts) -9999 (center2 (first bottom-lefts))))
     (define br-center
       (if (null? bottom-rights) 9999 (center2 (first bottom-rights))))
     (define bl-start
       (if (null? bottom-lefts) n (- n (eh (first bottom-lefts)))))
     (define br-start
       (if (null? bottom-rights) n (- n (eh (first bottom-rights)))))
     (define (left-side? e)  ;; climb the wall of the nearer bottom corner
       (cond ((= (length (ecells e)) 1) #f)
             ((null? bottom-lefts) #f)
             ((null? bottom-rights) #t)
             (else (<= (abs (- (center2 e) bl-center))
                       (abs (- (center2 e) br-center))))))
     (let* ((g1 (chain-right (empty-grid n n bg) top-lefts 0 0))
            (g2 (chain-right g1 tops 0 (sum-w top-lefts)))
            (g3 (for/fold ((gg g2) (cc 0) #:result gg) ((e bottom-lefts))
                  (values (place gg e (- n (eh e)) cc) (+ cc (ew e)))))
            (g4 (chain-bottom-right g3 bottom-rights)))
       (for/fold ((gg g4)) ((e sides))
         (if (left-side? e)
             (place gg e (max 1 (- bl-start (eh e))) 0)
             (place gg e (max 1 (- br-start (eh e))) (- n (ew e)))))))))

written_solution: Nested rect placement: largest rect = output container, smaller rects placed by aligning shared color markers
