(rule!
 ;; Crop the largest multicolor object as the canvas.  Every smaller piece
 ;; shares one marker color with that canvas; paste it at the unique window
 ;; whose marker cells match exactly.  Process pieces largest-first.
 (lambda (g)
   (define bg (mode g))
   (define objs
     (sort (objects-multicolor g bg)
           (lambda (a b) (> (obj-size a) (obj-size b)))))
   (define container (first objs))
   (define c-fill (mode-in (obj-cells container) g bg))
   (define (palette grid)
     (reverse
      (remove-duplicates
       (filter (lambda (v) (not (= v bg))) (apply append grid)))))
   (define (place out obj)
     (define piece (crop-object g obj))
     (define ph (rows piece))
     (define pw (cols piece))
     (define marker
       (find-first
        (lambda (v) (and (not (= v c-fill)) (member? v (palette out))))
        (palette piece)))
     (if (not marker)
         out
         (let* ((piece-marks (find-color piece marker))
                (hit
                 (find-first
                  (lambda (off)
                    (define dr (first off))
                    (define dc (second off))
                    (equal?
                     piece-marks
                     (for*/list ((r (range 0 ph)) (c (range 0 pw))
                                 #:when (= (at out (+ dr r) (+ dc c)) marker))
                       (list r c))))
                  (for*/list ((dr (range 0 (+ 1 (- (rows out) ph))))
                              (dc (range 0 (+ 1 (- (cols out) pw)))))
                    (list dr dc)))))
           (if hit
               (paint-cells
                out
                (for*/list ((r (range 0 ph)) (c (range 0 pw))
                            #:when (not (= (at piece r c) bg)))
                  (list (+ r (first hit)) (+ c (second hit)) (at piece r c))))
               out))))
   (foldl (lambda (piece out) (place out piece))
          (crop-object g container)
          (rest objs))))

written_solution: markers in chains (gap 3): directional chains; staggered rows use earlier marker evidence
program_solution:
(rule!
 ;; Markers on the busiest row either FALL as full columns or LIE DOWN
 ;; as 3-long floor runs: a 3-spaced marker chain marked with blue(1)
 ;; goes horizontal, the rest drop. In STAGGERED inputs (busiest row
 ;; below the top) each column starts at its own first marker, loose
 ;; blue cells become floor runs reaching toward the next column, and
 ;; single floor gaps between red(2) runs close up.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define (row-markers r)
       (filter (lambda (c) (> (at g r c) 0)) (range 0 w)))
     (define nonzero-rows
       (filter (lambda (r) (not (empty? (row-markers r)))) (range 0 h)))
     (if (empty? nonzero-rows)
         (empty-grid h w 0)
         (let* ((max-count (max-of (lambda (r)
                                     (length (row-markers r)))
                                   nonzero-rows))
                (active-row (find-first
                             (lambda (r) (>= (length (row-markers r))
                                             (- max-count 1)))
                             nonzero-rows))
                (markers (row-markers active-row))
                (staggered (> active-row 0)))
           (define (chain-left c)
             (let loop ((x c))
               (if (member? (- x 3) markers) (loop (- x 3)) x)))
           (define (chain-right c)
             (let loop ((x c))
               (if (member? (+ x 3) markers) (loop (+ x 3)) x)))
           (define (chain-cols c)
             (let ((leftmost (chain-left c))
                   (rightmost (chain-right c)))
               (filter (lambda (m) (and (>= m leftmost)
                                        (<= m rightmost)
                                        (zero? (modulo (- m leftmost)
                                                       3))))
                       markers)))
           (define (chain-start c)  ;; stop before a 2->1 handoff
             (let loop ((x c))
               (let ((prev (- x 3)))
                 (if (and (member? prev markers)
                          (not (and (= 2 (at g active-row prev))
                                    (= 1 (at g active-row x)))))
                     (loop prev)
                     x))))
           (define (horizontal? c)
             (if staggered
                 (any? (lambda (cc) (= 1 (at g active-row cc)))
                       (chain-cols c))
                 (= 1 (at g active-row (chain-start c)))))
           (define (first-row-at-col c)
             (let ((hits (filter (lambda (r) (> (at g r c) 0))
                                 nonzero-rows)))
               (if (empty? hits) active-row (first hits))))
           (define vertical-cols
             (filter (lambda (c) (not (horizontal? c))) markers))
           (define base
             (for/fold ((out (empty-grid h w 0))) ((m markers))
               (let ((color (at g active-row m)))
                 (if (horizontal? m)
                     (recolor-cells out
                                    (map (lambda (cc) (list (- h 1) cc))
                                         (range m (min w (+ m 3))))
                                    color)
                     (recolor-cells out
                                    (map (lambda (r) (list r m))
                                         (range (if staggered
                                                    (first-row-at-col m)
                                                    0)
                                                h))
                                    color)))))
           (if (not staggered)
               base
               (let ((with-ones  ;; loose blues run along the floor
                      (for*/fold ((out base))
                                 ((r (range (+ active-row 1) h))
                                  (c (range 0 w)))
                        (if (and (= 1 (at g r c))
                                 (not (member? c markers)))
                            (let* ((next-vs (filter (lambda (vc)
                                                      (> vc c))
                                                    vertical-cols))
                                   (end-c (if (empty? next-vs)
                                              (min (- w 1) (+ c 2))
                                              (min (- w 1)
                                                   (- (first next-vs)
                                                      2)))))
                              (if (>= end-c c)
                                  (recolor-cells
                                   out
                                   (map (lambda (cc)
                                          (list (- h 1) cc))
                                        (range c (+ end-c 1)))
                                   1)
                                  out))
                            out))))
                 (for/fold ((out with-ones)) ((c (range 1 (- w 1))))
                   (if (and (zero? (at out (- h 1) c))
                            (= 2 (at out (- h 1) (- c 1)))
                            (= 2 (at out (- h 1) (+ c 1))))
                       (set-cell out (- h 1) c 2)
                       out)))))))))

program_solution:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((all-cells (flatmap (lambda (r)
                                        (map (lambda (c) (list r c)) (range 0 w)))
                                      (range 0 h)))
                  (best #f))
             (define (segment? c r0 r1)
               (and
                 (!= (at g r0 c) 0)
                 (= (at g r0 c) (at g r1 c))
                 (all? (lambda (r) (!= (at g r c) 0)) (range r0 (+ r1 1)))))
             (define (guide-cell? p r0 r1 cL cR)
               (and (>= (fst p) r0) (<= (fst p) r1) (or (= (snd p) cL) (= (snd p) cR))))
             (define (pat-cells r0 r1 cL cR)
               (filter (lambda (p)
                         (and
                           (!= (at g (fst p) (snd p)) 0)
                           (not (guide-cell? p r0 r1 cL cR))))
                       all-cells))
             (define (try-pair r0 r1 cL cR)
               (let* ((oh (+ 1 (- r1 r0)))
                      (ow (+ 1 (- cR cL)))
                      (cells (pat-cells r0 r1 cL cR)))
                 (unless
                   (empty? cells)
                   (let* ((pr0 (min-of fst cells))
                          (pr1 (max-of fst cells))
                          (pc0 (min-of snd cells))
                          (pc1 (max-of snd cells)))
                     (when
                       (and
                         (= (+ 1 (- pr1 pr0)) (- oh 2))
                         (= (+ 1 (- pc1 pc0)) (- ow 2)))
                       (set! best (list r0 r1 cL cR pr0 pr1 pc0 pc1)))))))
             (for* ((r0 (range 0 h)) (r1 (range (+ r0 2) h))
                     (cA (range 0 w))
                     (cB (range (+ cA 1) w)))
                   (when
                     (and (not best) (segment? cA r0 r1) (segment? cB r0 r1))
                     (try-pair r0 r1 cA cB)))
             (let* ((r0 (first best))
                    (r1 (second best))
                    (cL (third best))
                    (cR (fourth best))
                    (pr0 (fifth best))
                    (pc0 (seventh best))
                    (pc1 (eighth best))
                    (oh (+ 1 (- r1 r0)))
                    (ow (+ 1 (- cR cL)))
                    (ih (- oh 2))
                    (iw (- ow 2))
                    (left (at g (+ r0 1) cL))
                    (right (at g (+ r0 1) cR))
                    (offsets (flatmap (lambda (dr)
                                        (map (lambda (dc) (list dr dc)) (range 0 iw)))
                                      (range 0 ih))))
               (define (src-val off flip?)
                 (let ((dr (fst off))
                       (dc (snd off)))
                   (at g (+ pr0 dr) (if flip? (- pc1 dc) (+ pc0 dc)))))
               (define (score flip?)
                 (count-if (lambda (off)
                             (let ((dc (snd off))
                                   (v (src-val off flip?)))
                               (or
                                 (and (< dc (quotient iw 2)) (= v left))
                                 (and (>= dc (quotient (+ iw 1) 2)) (= v right)))))
                           offsets))
               (let ((flip? (> (score #t) (score #f))))
                 (build-grid oh
                             ow
                             (r c)
                             (cond
                               ((zero? c) (at g (+ r0 r) cL))
                               ((= c (- ow 1)) (at g (+ r0 r) cR))
                               ((or (zero? r) (= r (- oh 1))) 0)
                               (else (src-val (list (- r 1) (- c 1)) flip?))))))))))

program_solution:
(rule!
 ;; Green(3) marks sketch V-shaped triangles: an apex plus points along its
 ;; two 45-degree arms (grouped when within Chebyshev distance 2 along a
 ;; row, column, or exact diagonal). For every group, apex, depth and
 ;; orientation where both arms are attested (>=1 mark each, >=3 total,
 ;; and some mark sits at full depth), the whole solid triangle is filled
 ;; with cyan(8). The marks themselves stay green.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define marks (find-color g 3))
     (define max-d (max h w))
     (define (near? a b)  ;; aligned or diagonal within Chebyshev 2
       (let ((dr (abs (- (first a) (first b))))
             (dc (abs (- (second a) (second b)))))
         (and (<= (max dr dc) 2)
              (or (= dr dc) (zero? dr) (zero? dc)))))
     (define groups  ;; connected components of marks under near?
       (for/fold ((gs (list))) ((m marks))
         (let ((touch? (lambda (grp) (any? (lambda (x) (near? m x)) grp))))
           (cons (cons m (apply append (filter touch? gs)))
                 (filter (lambda (grp) (not (touch? grp))) gs)))))
     (define (arm-cell orient ar ac k side)  ;; k-th cell of one arm
       (cond ((zero? orient) (list (+ ar k) (+ ac (if (zero? side) (- k) k))))
             ((= orient 1) (list (- ar k) (+ ac (if (zero? side) (- k) k))))
             ((= orient 2) (list (+ ar (if (zero? side) (- k) k)) (+ ac k)))
             (else (list (+ ar (if (zero? side) (- k) k)) (- ac k)))))
     (define (arm-count orient ar ac d side grp)
       (count-if (lambda (k)
                   (let ((p (arm-cell orient ar ac k side)))
                     (and (in-bounds? (first p) (second p) h w)
                          (member? p grp))))
                 (range 1 (+ d 1))))
     (define (far-supported? orient ar ac d grp)
       (any? (lambda (side)
               (let ((p (arm-cell orient ar ac d side)))
                 (and (in-bounds? (first p) (second p) h w)
                      (member? p grp))))
             (list 0 1)))
     (define (valid? orient apex d grp)
       (let ((a (arm-count orient (first apex) (second apex) d 0 grp))
             (b (arm-count orient (first apex) (second apex) d 1 grp)))
         (and (>= (+ 1 a b) 3) (>= a 1) (>= b 1)
              (far-supported? orient (first apex) (second apex) d grp))))
     (define tris  ;; every attested (orient apex d), over all groups
       (flatmap (lambda (grp)
                  (flatmap (lambda (apex)
                             (flatmap (lambda (d)
                                        (filter values
                                                (map (lambda (orient)
                                                       (and (valid? orient apex d grp)
                                                            (list orient apex d)))
                                                     (list 0 1 2 3))))
                                      (range 1 (+ max-d 1))))
                           grp))
                groups))
     (define (inside? orient apex d r c)  ;; cell within the solid triangle
       (let ((ar (first apex)) (ac (second apex)))
         (cond ((zero? orient)
                (and (>= r ar) (<= r (+ ar d))
                     (<= (abs (- c ac)) (- r ar))))
               ((= orient 1)
                (and (<= r ar) (>= r (- ar d))
                     (<= (abs (- c ac)) (- ar r))))
               ((= orient 2)
                (and (>= c ac) (<= c (+ ac d))
                     (<= (abs (- r ar)) (- c ac))))
               (else
                (and (<= c ac) (>= c (- ac d))
                     (<= (abs (- r ar)) (- ac c)))))))
     (cellmap g (r c v)
       (if (and (!= v 3)
                (any? (lambda (t)
                        (inside? (first t) (second t) (third t) r c))
                      tris))
           8 v)))))

written_solution: Expand the matching top glyph into the framed interior, preserving frame/background
program_solution:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (begin
             (define bg 8)
             (define objs (objects g bg))
             (define frame (argmax obj-size objs))
             (define fr1 (obj-r1 frame))
             (define fc1 (obj-c1 frame))
             (define fr2 (obj-r2 frame))
             (define fc2 (obj-c2 frame))
             (define frame-color (obj-color frame))
             (define inner-h (- fr2 fr1 1))
             (define inner-w (- fc2 fc1 1))
             (define fill-values
               (for*/list ((r (range (+ fr1 1) fr2)) (c (range (+ fc1 1) fc2))
                   #:when
                   (let ((v (at g r c))) (and (!= v bg) (!= v frame-color))))
                 (at g r c)))
             (define fill-color (mode-list fill-values))
             (define existing-fill
               (for*/list ((r (range (+ fr1 1) fr2)) (c (range (+ fc1 1) fc2))
                   #:when
                   (= (at g r c) fill-color))
                 (list (- r fr1 1) (- c fc1 1))))
             (define top-glyphs
               (filter (lambda (obj)
                         (and
                           (< (obj-r2 obj) fr1)
                           (!= (obj-color obj) bg)
                           (!= (obj-color obj) frame-color)
                           (!= (obj-color obj) fill-color)))
                       (objects-8 g bg)))
             (define (glyph-cell? glyph gr gc)
               (member (list gr gc) (normalize-cells (obj-cells glyph))))
             (define (glyph-allows? glyph rel-r rel-c)
               (let* ((gh (+ 1 (- (obj-r2 glyph) (obj-r1 glyph))))
                      (gw (+ 1 (- (obj-c2 glyph) (obj-c1 glyph)))))
                 (and
                   (zero? (modulo inner-h gh))
                   (zero? (modulo inner-w gw))
                   (let ((bh (quotient inner-h gh))
                         (bw (quotient inner-w gw)))
                     (glyph-cell? glyph (quotient rel-r bh) (quotient rel-c bw))))))
             (define candidates
               (filter (lambda (glyph)
                         (let ((gh (+ 1 (- (obj-r2 glyph) (obj-r1 glyph))))
                               (gw (+ 1 (- (obj-c2 glyph) (obj-c1 glyph)))))
                           (and
                             (> gh 0)
                             (> gw 0)
                             (zero? (modulo inner-h gh))
                             (zero? (modulo inner-w gw))
                             (all? (lambda (p)
                                     (glyph-allows? glyph (first p) (second p)))
                                   existing-fill))))
                       top-glyphs))
             (define glyph
               (first (sort-by candidates
                               (lambda (obj) (+ (* 1000 (obj-r1 obj)) (obj-c1 obj))))))
             (define gh (+ 1 (- (obj-r2 glyph) (obj-r1 glyph))))
             (define gw (+ 1 (- (obj-c2 glyph) (obj-c1 glyph))))
             (define bh (quotient inner-h gh))
             (define bw (quotient inner-w gw))
             (build-grid (+ 1 (- fr2 fr1))
                         (+ 1 (- fc2 fc1))
                         (r c)
                         (cond
                           ((or (zero? r) (zero? c) (= r (- fr2 fr1)) (= c (- fc2 fc1))) frame-color)
                           ((glyph-cell? glyph
                                         (quotient (- r 1) bh)
                                         (quotient (- c 1) bw)) fill-color)
                           (else bg)))))))

written_solution: 9 hardcoded 9x9 spiral patterns indexed by 3x3 marker position

(rule! (lambda (g)
  ;; The single colored cell in the 3x3 input anchors a 9x9 CLOCKWISE SQUARE SPIRAL: marker at
  ;; (r,c) -> spiral anchor (4r,4c). The turtle starts NORTH and walks segments of 2,2,4,4,6,6,...
  ;; cells, turning clockwise after each; cells outside the canvas are clipped. Drawn in the
  ;; marker's color on a blank 9x9.
  (let* ((mk (first (positions-of g (lambda (v) (!= v 0)))))
         (color (at g (first mk) (second mk)))
         (dirs (list (list -1 0) (list 0 1) (list 1 0) (list 0 -1)))
         (ar (* 4 (first mk))) (ac (* 4 (second mk)))
         (cells
          (let walk ((k 1) (r ar) (c ac) (d 0) (acc (list (list ar ac))))
            (if (> k 30) acc
                (let* ((dr (first (list-ref dirs d))) (dc (second (list-ref dirs d))))
                  (let seg ((i 0) (rr r) (cc c) (a acc))
                    (if (= i (* 2 (quotient (+ k 1) 2)))
                        (walk (+ k 1) rr cc (modulo (+ d 1) 4) a)
                        (seg (+ i 1) (+ rr dr) (+ cc dc)
                             (cons (list (+ rr dr) (+ cc dc)) a)))))))))
    (recolor-cells (empty-grid 9 9)
                   (filter (lambda (p) (in-bounds? (first p) (second p) 9 9)) cells)
                   color))))

(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (begin
             (define comps (objects g 0))
             (define (cells-bbox cells)
               (let ((rs (map first cells))
                     (cs (map second cells)))
                 (list (min-list rs) (min-list cs) (max-list rs) (max-list cs))))
             (define (boxes-overlap? b1 b2)
               (let ((r1a (first b1))
                     (c1a (second b1))
                     (r1b (third b1))
                     (c1b (nth b1 3))
                     (r2a (first b2))
                     (c2a (second b2))
                     (r2b (third b2))
                     (c2b (nth b2 3)))
                 (or
                   (not (or (< r1b r2a) (< r2b r1a)))
                   (not (or (< c1b c2a) (< c2b c1a))))))
             (define groups (map obj-cells comps))
             (define (do-merge gs)
               (if (or (null? gs) (null? (cdr gs)))
                   gs
                   (let* ((cur (first gs))
                          (rest (cdr gs))
                          (bb-cur (cells-bbox cur))
                          (matches (filter (lambda (g)
                                             (boxes-overlap? bb-cur (cells-bbox g)))
                                           rest))
                          (non-matches (filter (lambda (g)
                                                 (not (boxes-overlap? bb-cur
                                                                      (cells-bbox g))))
                                               rest)))
                     (if (null? matches)
                         (cons cur (do-merge rest))
                         (do-merge (cons (apply append (cons cur matches)) non-matches))))))
             (define (merge-fixed gs)
               (let ((m (do-merge gs)))
                 (if (= (length m) (length gs)) m (merge-fixed m))))
             (define merged-groups (merge-fixed groups))
             (reduce (lambda (gg group)
                       (let* ((bb (cells-bbox group))
                              (r1 (first bb))
                              (c1 (second bb))
                              (r2 (third bb))
                              (c2 (nth bb 3))
                              (cells (flatmap (lambda (r)
                                                (map (lambda (c) (list r c))
                                                     (range c1 (+ c2 1))))
                                              (range r1 (+ r2 1)))))
                         (reduce (lambda (gg2 rc)
                                   (if (zero? (at g (first rc) (second rc)))
                                       (set-cell gg2 (first rc) (second rc) 2)
                                       gg2))
                                 gg
                                 cells)))
                     g
                     merged-groups)))))

written_solution: replicate marker to same-parity cells in lattice grid
program_solution:
(rule!
 ;; Full lines of the dominant color rule the board into lattice cells.
 ;; One cell (the last in scan order holding anything) carries a marker
 ;; pattern: stamp that pattern into every cell sharing its row AND
 ;; column parity, clipped to each cell.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define line-color
       (pick-max (filter (lambda (v) (> v 0))
                         (remove-duplicates
                          (map (lambda (p) (at g (first p) (second p)))
                               (grid-positions g))))
                 (lambda (v) (length (find-color g v)))))
     (define row-bounds
       (append (list -1)
               (filter (lambda (r) (all? (lambda (c) (= (at g r c)
                                                        line-color))
                                         (range 0 w)))
                       (range 0 h))
               (list h)))
     (define col-bounds
       (append (list -1)
               (filter (lambda (c) (all? (lambda (r) (= (at g r c)
                                                        line-color))
                                         (range 0 h)))
                       (range 0 w))
               (list w)))
     (define (spans bounds)
       (filter (lambda (p) (<= (first p) (second p)))
               (map (lambda (i) (list (+ 1 (nth bounds i))
                                      (- (nth bounds (+ i 1)) 1)))
                    (range 0 (- (length bounds) 1)))))
     (define row-spans (spans row-bounds))
     (define col-spans (spans col-bounds))
     (define (pattern-at cr cc)  ;; non-line cells relative to the cell
       (let ((rr (nth row-spans cr)) (cs (nth col-spans cc)))
         (for*/list ((r (range (first rr) (+ (second rr) 1)))
                     (c (range (first cs) (+ (second cs) 1)))
                     #:when (let ((v (at g r c)))
                              (and (not (= v 0))
                                   (not (= v line-color)))))
           (list (- r (first rr)) (- c (first cs)) (at g r c)))))
     (define marker  ;; LAST populated cell in scan order: (cr cc pat)
       (for*/fold ((best (list -1 -1 (list))))
                  ((cr (range 0 (length row-spans)))
                   (cc (range 0 (length col-spans))))
         (let ((pat (pattern-at cr cc)))
           (if (null? pat) best (list cr cc pat)))))
     (for*/fold ((out g))
                ((cr (range 0 (length row-spans)))
                 (cc (range 0 (length col-spans)))
                 #:when (and (= (modulo cr 2) (modulo (first marker) 2))
                             (= (modulo cc 2)
                                (modulo (second marker) 2))))
       (let ((rr (nth row-spans cr)) (cs (nth col-spans cc)))
         (for/fold ((gg out)) ((p (third marker)))
           (let ((r2 (+ (first rr) (first p)))
                 (c2 (+ (first cs) (second p))))
             (if (and (<= r2 (second rr)) (<= c2 (second cs)))
                 (set-cell gg r2 c2 (third p))
                 gg))))))))

written_solution: Find symmetry that maps panel inner corners to scattered cells arrangement; apply to panel
program_solution:
(rule!
 ;; A framed panel (blue border) has four distinct interior corner
 ;; colors; scattered dots outside repeat those colors at the corners
 ;; of THEIR bounding box, in some orientation. Output the panel
 ;; rotated/flipped so its corners land like the dots' (missing dots
 ;; read as border blue 1).
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define bb (bbox-of-cells (find-color g 1)))
     (define pr1 (first bb)) (define pc1 (second bb))
     (define pr2 (third bb)) (define pc2 (fourth bb))
     (define panel (subgrid g pr1 pc1 pr2 pc2))
     (define ph (rows panel))
     (define pw (cols panel))
     (define A (at panel 1 1))
     (define B (at panel 1 (- pw 2)))
     (define C (at panel (- ph 2) 1))
     (define D (at panel (- ph 2) (- pw 2)))
     (define scattered
       (filter (lambda (p) (let ((r (first p)) (c (second p)))
                             (and (> (at g r c) 0)
                                  (or (< r pr1) (> r pr2)
                                      (< c pc1) (> c pc2)))))
               (grid-positions g)))
     (define sbb (bbox-of-cells scattered))
     (define (dot r c)  ;; scattered color there, else border blue
       (if (member (list r c) scattered) (at g r c) 1))
     (define signature
       (list (dot (first sbb) (second sbb))
             (dot (first sbb) (fourth sbb))
             (dot (third sbb) (second sbb))
             (dot (third sbb) (fourth sbb))))
     (define transforms  ;; (corner-signature transform), identity first
       (list (list (list A B C D) (lambda (p) p))
             (list (list B A D C) flip-lr)
             (list (list C D A B) flip-ud)
             (list (list D C B A) rotate-180)
             (list (list A C B D) transpose)
             (list (list D B C A)
                   (lambda (p) (rotate-180 (transpose p))))
             (list (list C A D B) rotate-cw)
             (list (list B D A C) rotate-ccw)))
     ((second (find-first (lambda (t) (equal? (first t) signature))
                          transforms))
      panel))))

(rule!
  ;; alt: identify color-5 divider rows/cols, derive macro-cell ranges, and paint the three diagonal ranges via `cellmap`.
  (lambda (g)
    (let* ((h (rows g))
           (w (cols g))
           (div-rows (filter (lambda (r)
                               (all? (lambda (c) (= (at g r c) 5))
                                     (range 0 w)))
                             (range 0 h)))
           (div-cols (filter (lambda (c)
                               (all? (lambda (r) (= (at g r c) 5))
                                     (range 0 h)))
                             (range 0 w)))
           (segments (lambda (n divs)
                       (filter (lambda (p) (<= (first p) (second p)))
                               (map list
                                    (cons 0 (map add1 divs))
                                    (append (map sub1 divs) (list (- n 1)))))))
           (row-ranges (segments h div-rows))
           (col-ranges (segments w div-cols))
           (mid-r (quotient (length row-ranges) 2))
           (mid-c (quotient (length col-ranges) 2))
           (targets (list (list (first row-ranges) (first col-ranges) 1)
                          (list (list-ref row-ranges mid-r) (list-ref col-ranges mid-c) 2)
                          (list (last row-ranges) (last col-ranges) 3))))
      (cellmap g (r c v)
        (let ((hit (find-first
                    (lambda (t)
                      (and (zero? v)
                           (<= (first (first t)) r (second (first t)))
                           (<= (first (second t)) c (second (second t)))))
                    targets)))
          (if hit (third hit) v))))))

written_solution: gray(5) frame interior filled with 2x2 checkerboard of marker colors. Each marker at a corner determines diagonal quadrants via parity
program_solution:
(rule! (lambda (g)
  (let* ((h (rows g)) (w (cols g))
         ;; Positions of every gray(5) cell
         (gray-cells (find-color g 5))
         ;; Top edge of the gray bbox
         (fr1 (apply min (map first gray-cells)))
         ;; Left edge of the gray bbox
         (fc1 (apply min (map second gray-cells)))
         ;; Bottom edge of the gray bbox
         (fr2 (apply max (map first gray-cells)))
         ;; Right edge of the gray bbox
         (fc2 (apply max (map second gray-cells)))
         (ir1 (+ fr1 1)) (ic1 (+ fc1 1))
         (ir2 (- fr2 1)) (ic2 (- fc2 1))
         ;; Positions matching a per-cell condition
         (markers (for*/list ((r (range 0 h)) (c (range 0 w))
                    #:when (and (not (= (cell-at g r c) 0)) (not (= (cell-at g r c) 5))))
                   (list r c (cell-at g r c))))
         (m1 (first markers)) (m2 (second markers))
         (cr (quotient (+ fr1 fr2) 2))
         (cc (quotient (+ fc1 fc2) 2))
         (m1qr (if (< (first m1) cr) 0 1))
         (m1qc (if (< (second m1) cc) 0 1))
         (m1p (remainder (+ m1qr m1qc) 2))
         ;; Mutable lookup table for result
         (result (make-hash)))
    (for* ((r (range 0 h)) (c (range 0 w)))
      (hash-set! result (list r c) (cell-at g r c)))
    (let ((hmid (quotient (+ ir1 ir2) 2))
          (wmid (quotient (+ ic1 ic2) 2)))
      (for* ((r (range ir1 (+ ir2 1))) (c (range ic1 (+ ic2 1))))
        (let* ((qr (if (< r (+ hmid 1)) 0 1))
               (qc (if (< c (+ wmid 1)) 0 1))
               (p (remainder (+ qr qc) 2))
               (color (if (= p m1p) (third m1) (third m2))))
          (hash-set! result (list r c) color))))
    (grid-from-fn h w
      (lambda (r c) (hash-ref result (list r c) 0))))))

(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (begin
             (define cf (color-frequency g))
             (define non-bg-colors (filter (lambda (c) (!= c 0)) (grid-colors g)))
             (define rect-color
               (let loop
                    ((cs non-bg-colors) (best (first non-bg-colors)) (best-cnt 0))
                    (if (null? cs)
                        best
                        (let ((cnt (hash-ref cf (first cs))))
                          (if (> cnt best-cnt)
                              (loop (cdr cs) (first cs) cnt)
                              (loop (cdr cs) best best-cnt))))))
             (define rect-cells (find-color g rect-color))
             (define rs (map first rect-cells))
             (define cs (map second rect-cells))
             (define r1 (min-list rs))
             (define r2 (max-list rs))
             (define c1 (min-list cs))
             (define c2 (max-list cs))
             (define tl-in (list (+ r1 1) (+ c1 1)))
             (define tr-in (list (+ r1 1) (- c2 1)))

written_solution: Exterior pixels shoot rays into diamond interior, stopping at interior pixels (obstacles)
program_solution:
(rule!
 ;; A red(2) rectangle outline holds a few interior pixels; loose
 ;; EXTERIOR pixels shoot into the box along their row or column,
 ;; painting their color from just inside the near wall up to (but not
 ;; through) the first interior pixel — or the far wall.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define (row-span r)  ;; (left right) red walls of the row
       (let ((cs (filter (lambda (c) (= (at g r c) 2)) (range 0 w))))
         (and (>= (length cs) 2) (list (min-list cs) (max-list cs)))))
     (define (col-span c)
       (let ((rs (filter (lambda (r) (= (at g r c) 2)) (range 0 h))))
         (and (>= (length rs) 2) (list (min-list rs) (max-list rs)))))
     (define (pixel? r c)
       (let ((v (at g r c)))
         (and (not (= v 0)) (not (= v 2)))))
     (define (interior? r c)
       (let ((sp (row-span r)))
         (and sp (< (first sp) c) (< c (second sp)))))
     (define (interior-pixel? p)
       (and (pixel? (first p) (second p))
            (interior? (first p) (second p))))
     (define (ray from to step pos-of)  ;; stop at wall or a pixel
       (let loop ((x from) (acc (list)))
         (cond ((if (> step 0) (>= x to) (<= x to)) (reverse acc))
               ((interior-pixel? (pos-of x)) (reverse acc))
               (else (loop (+ x step) (cons (pos-of x) acc))))))
     (for/fold ((out g))
               ((p (filter (lambda (p)
                             (and (pixel? (first p) (second p))
                                  (not (interior? (first p)
                                                  (second p)))))
                           (grid-positions g))))
       (let* ((er (first p)) (ec (second p)) (ev (at g er ec))
              (cs (col-span ec))
              (rs (row-span er)))
         (cond (cs (cond ((< er (first cs))
                          (paint-cells out
                                       (ray (+ (first cs) 1)
                                            (second cs) 1
                                            (lambda (r) (list r ec)))
                                       ev))
                         ((> er (second cs))
                          (paint-cells out
                                       (ray (- (second cs) 1)
                                            (first cs) -1
                                            (lambda (r) (list r ec)))
                                       ev))
                         (else out)))
               (rs (cond ((< ec (first rs))
                          (paint-cells out
                                       (ray (+ (first rs) 1)
                                            (second rs) 1
                                            (lambda (c) (list er c)))
                                       ev))
                         ((> ec (second rs))
                          (paint-cells out
                                       (ray (- (second rs) 1)
                                            (first rs) -1
                                            (lambda (c) (list er c)))
                                       ev))
                         (else out)))
               (else out)))))))

(rule! (lambda (g)
  ;; A red (2) edge marker fires a stream into the grid (down from a top marker, right from a
  ;; left-edge marker). Each bar it lands on STEERS it by color: blue (1) deflects the stream to
  ;; its own LEFT hand, green (3) to its RIGHT; it slides past the bar's end and flows on. A
  ;; left-edge task is solved as its transpose — transposing mirrors chirality, so blue's step
  ;; flips sign.
  (define (flow gg blue-step)
    (let* ((h (rows gg)) (w (cols gg))
           (mk (first (find-color gg 2)))
           (free? (lambda (r c) (and (>= c 0) (< c w) (zero? (at gg r c))))))
      (let fall ((r (first mk)) (c (second mk)) (cells (list mk)))
        (cond ((= r (- h 1)) (recolor-cells gg cells 2))
              ((free? (+ r 1) c) (fall (+ r 1) c (cons (list (+ r 1) c) cells)))
              (else
               (let* ((step (if (= (at gg (+ r 1) c) 1) blue-step (- blue-step))))
                 (let slide ((cc (+ c step)) (acc cells))
                   (if (free? (+ r 1) cc)
                       (fall (+ r 1) cc (cons (list (+ r 1) cc) (cons (list r cc) acc)))
                       (slide (+ cc step) (cons (list r cc) acc))))))))))
  (let* ((mk (first (find-color g 2))))
    (if (and (zero? (second mk)) (!= (first mk) 0))
        (transpose (flow (transpose g) -1))
        (flow g 1)))))

(rule!
 ;; Every color's 8-connected shapes (3+ cells) claim their CONVEX
 ;; territory: cells of any OTHER color lying inside a shape's convex
 ;; hull (built on cell corners, so whole cells count) are erased to 0.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define (erase-inside out obj)
       (let ((hull (convex-hull
                    (remove-duplicates
                     (flatmap (lambda (p)
                                (list (list (- (first p) 0.5)
                                            (- (second p) 0.5))
                                      (list (- (first p) 0.5)
                                            (+ (second p) 0.5))
                                      (list (+ (first p) 0.5)
                                            (- (second p) 0.5))
                                      (list (+ (first p) 0.5)
                                            (+ (second p) 0.5))))
                              (obj-cells obj)))))
             (color (obj-color obj)))
         (if (< (length hull) 3)
             out
             (for*/fold ((acc out))
                        ((r (range (obj-r1 obj) (+ (obj-r2 obj) 1)))
                         (c (range (obj-c1 obj) (+ (obj-c2 obj) 1))))
               (let ((v (at g r c)))
                 (if (and (> v 0) (not (= v color))
                          (point-in-hull? (+ 0.0 r) (+ 0.0 c) hull))
                     (set-cell acc r c 0)
                     acc))))))
     (for/fold ((out g)) ((obj (in-list (filter (lambda (o)
                                                  (>= (obj-size o) 3))
                                                (objects-8 g 0)))))
       (erase-inside out obj)))))

written_solution: Move the gray(5) marker to the selected endpoint of the nearest straight background/zero boundary run
program_solution:
(rule! (lambda (g)
  (define h (rows g))
  (define w (cols g))
  ;; Position of the first gray(5) cell
  (define marker (fst (find-color g 5)))
  (define mr (fst marker))
  (define mc (snd marker))
  (define (md p) (+ (abs (- (fst p) mr)) (abs (- (snd p) mc))))
  (define (bnd? r c)
    (and (in-bounds? r c h w)
         (= (at g r c) 7)
         (for/or ((d cardinal-deltas))
           (let ((nr (+ r (fst d))) (nc (+ c (snd d))))
             (and (in-bounds? nr nc h w) (= (at g nr nc) 0))))))
  (define (run-from r c dr dc)
    (let loop ((rr r) (cc c) (acc (list)))
      (if (bnd? rr cc)
        (loop (+ rr dr) (+ cc dc) (append acc (list (list rr cc))))
        acc)))
  (define dirs (list (list 0 1) (list 1 0) (list 1 1) (list 1 -1)))
  (define infos
    (apply append
      (map (lambda (d)
        (filter (lambda (info) (and (not (empty? info)) (>= (length (fst info)) 2)))
          (map (lambda (p)
            (let* ((r (fst p)) (c (snd p)) (dr (fst d)) (dc (snd d))
                   (pr (- r dr)) (pc (- c dc)))
              (if (and (bnd? r c) (not (bnd? pr pc)))
                (list (run-from r c dr dc) dr dc)
                (list))))
            (grid-positions g))))
        dirs)))
  (if (empty? infos) g
    (let* ((best (fst (sort infos (lambda (a b)
             (let ((da (min-list (map md (fst a)))) (db (min-list (map md (fst b)))))
               (if (= da db)
                 (> (length (fst a)) (length (fst b)))
                 (< da db)))))))
           (run (fst best))
           (dr (snd best))
           (dc (nth best 2))
           (ends (list (fst run) (nth run (- (length run) 1))))
           (dest (fst (sort ends (lambda (a b)
             (if (and (not (= dr 0)) (not (= dc 0)))
               (> (md a) (md b))
               (< (md a) (md b))))))))
      (set-cell (set-cell g mr mc 7) (fst dest) (snd dest) 5)))))

written_solution: stretch each 3x3 motif toward the matching colored bar and repeat its center marker
program_solution:
(rule!
 ;; 3x3 motifs -- a solid ring of one color around a single center cell --
 ;; reach toward a partner: the nearest object of the CENTER color that
 ;; lies outside the motif but shares its row-band or column-band. The
 ;; ring color is painted as a 3-wide corridor from the motif to one cell
 ;; past the partner, and center-color dots repeat every 3rd cell along
 ;; the corridor's middle line (aligned with the motif center).
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define bg (mode-list (map third (grid-cells g))))
     (define (overlap? a1 a2 b1 b2) (<= (max a1 b1) (min a2 b2)))
     (define motifs  ;; (r c ring-color center-color), row-major scan
       (filter values
               (for*/list ((r (range (- h 2))) (c (range (- w 2))))
                 (let* ((ring (for*/list ((dr (range 3)) (dc (range 3))
                                          #:when (not (and (= dr 1) (= dc 1))))
                                (at g (+ r dr) (+ c dc))))
                        (o (first ring))
                        (center (at g (+ r 1) (+ c 1))))
                   (and (!= o bg) (!= center bg) (!= o center)
                        (all? (lambda (v) (= v o)) ring)
                        (list r c o center))))))
     (define (color-objects color)  ;; objects of one color on a bg canvas
       (objects (cellmap g (r c v) (if (= v color) color bg)) bg))
     (define (inside-motif? o mr mc)
       (all? (lambda (p) (and (>= (first p) mr) (<= (first p) (+ mr 2))
                              (>= (second p) mc) (<= (second p) (+ mc 2))))
             (obj-cells o)))
     (define (gap o mr mc)  ;; box distance from the motif's 3x3 box
       (+ (max 0 (- (obj-c1 o) (+ mc 2)) (- mc (obj-c2 o)))
          (max 0 (- (obj-r1 o) (+ mr 2)) (- mr (obj-r2 o)))))
     (define (best-object color mr mc)  ;; nearest banded partner, or #f
       (let ((cands (filter (lambda (o)
                              (and (not (inside-motif? o mr mc))
                                   (or (overlap? (obj-r1 o) (obj-r2 o)
                                                 mr (+ mr 2))
                                       (overlap? (obj-c1 o) (obj-c2 o)
                                                 mc (+ mc 2)))))
                            (color-objects color))))
         (and (not (null? cands))
              (first (sort cands
                           (lambda (a b)
                             (cond ((not (= (gap a mr mc) (gap b mr mc)))
                                    (< (gap a mr mc) (gap b mr mc)))
                                   ((not (= (obj-r1 a) (obj-r1 b)))
                                    (< (obj-r1 a) (obj-r1 b)))
                                   (else (< (obj-c1 a) (obj-c1 b))))))))))
     (define (paint-h out mr mc ring center o)  ;; corridor along the row band
       (let* ((start (if (< (obj-c2 o) mc) (max 0 (- (obj-c2 o) 1)) mc))
              (end (if (> (obj-c1 o) (+ mc 2))
                       (min (- w 1) (+ (obj-c1 o) 1))
                       (+ mc 2)))
              (band (for*/fold ((gg out)) ((r (range mr (+ mr 3)))
                                           (c (range start (+ end 1))))
                      (set-cell gg r c ring))))
         (for/fold ((gg band)) ((c (range start (+ end 1))))
           (if (zero? (modulo (- c (+ mc 1)) 3))
               (set-cell gg (+ mr 1) c center)
               gg))))
     (define (paint-v out mr mc ring center o)  ;; corridor along the col band
       (let* ((start (if (< (obj-r2 o) mr) (max 0 (- (obj-r2 o) 1)) mr))
              (end (if (> (obj-r1 o) (+ mr 2))
                       (min (- h 1) (+ (obj-r1 o) 1))
                       (+ mr 2)))
              (band (for*/fold ((gg out)) ((r (range start (+ end 1)))
                                           (c (range mc (+ mc 3))))
                      (set-cell gg r c ring))))
         (for/fold ((gg band)) ((r (range start (+ end 1))))
           (if (zero? (modulo (- r (+ mr 1)) 3))
               (set-cell gg r (+ mc 1) center)
               gg))))
     (for/fold ((out g)) ((m motifs))
       (let* ((mr (first m)) (mc (second m))
              (ring (third m)) (center (fourth m))
              (o (best-object center mr mc)))
         (cond ((not o) out)
               ((overlap? (obj-r1 o) (obj-r2 o) mr (+ mr 2))
                (paint-h out mr mc ring center o))
               (else (paint-v out mr mc ring center o))))))))

written_solution: remove tail from connected shape, slide body until touching the other rectangle
program_solution:
(rule!
 ;; Two objects: a solid rectangle WALL and a creature made of a solid
 ;; BODY with a tail sticking out one side. The tail points AWAY from
 ;; travel: the body slides toward the wall until flush against it, and
 ;; the tail is consumed. Background elsewhere unchanged.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define objs (objects g 0))
     (define wall (find-first solid-rect? objs))
     (define creature
       (find-first (lambda (o) (not (solid-rect? o))) objs))
     (define cells (obj-cells creature))
     (define body  ;; largest solid rectangle inside the creature
       (rest
        (for*/fold ((best (list 0 0 0 0 0)))
                   ((r1 (range (obj-r1 creature)
                               (+ (obj-r2 creature) 1)))
                    (r2 (range (obj-r1 creature)
                               (+ (obj-r2 creature) 1)))
                    (c1 (range (obj-c1 creature)
                               (+ (obj-c2 creature) 1)))
                    (c2 (range (obj-c1 creature)
                               (+ (obj-c2 creature) 1))))
          (if (and (<= r1 r2) (<= c1 c2)
                   (> (* (+ 1 (- r2 r1)) (+ 1 (- c2 c1))) (first best))
                   (all? (lambda (p) (member p cells))
                         (positions-in-rect r1 c1 r2 c2)))
              (list (* (+ 1 (- r2 r1)) (+ 1 (- c2 c1))) r1 r2 c1 c2)
              best))))
     (define br1 (first body))
     (define br2 (second body))
     (define bc1 (third body))
     (define bc2 (fourth body))
     (define tail  ;; creature cells outside the body rect
       (filter (lambda (p) (not (and (>= (first p) br1)
                                     (<= (first p) br2)
                                     (>= (second p) bc1)
                                     (<= (second p) bc2))))
               cells))
     (define dr (cond ((any? (lambda (p) (< (first p) br1)) tail) -1)
                      ((any? (lambda (p) (> (first p) br2)) tail) 1)
                      (else 0)))
     (define dc (cond ((any? (lambda (p) (< (second p) bc1)) tail) -1)
                      ((any? (lambda (p) (> (second p) bc2)) tail) 1)
                      (else 0)))
     (define steps  ;; distance until flush against the wall
       (cond ((> dc 0) (- (obj-c1 wall) 1 bc2))
             ((< dc 0) (- bc1 (+ (obj-c2 wall) 1)))
             ((> dr 0) (- (obj-r1 wall) 1 br2))
             ((< dr 0) (- br1 (+ (obj-r2 wall) 1)))
             (else 0)))
     (paint-cells (erase-cells g cells 0)
                  (positions-in-rect (+ br1 (* dr steps))
                                     (+ bc1 (* dc steps))
                                     (+ br2 (* dr steps))
                                     (+ bc2 (* dc steps)))
                  (obj-color creature)))))

written_solution: Draw path from red(2) to blue(1): 1 diagonal, then straights in dominant direction, then diagonals to end
program_solution:
(rule! (lambda (g)
  (let* ((h (rows g))
         (w (cols g))
         ;; Locate the unique red source endpoint.
         (red-pos
          (let loop ((r 0) (c 0))
            (cond
              ((>= r h) #f)
              ((>= c w) (loop (+ r 1) 0))
              ((= (at g r c) 2) (list r c))
              (else (loop r (+ c 1))))))
         ;; Locate the unique blue destination endpoint.
         (blue-pos
          (let loop ((r 0) (c 0))
            (cond
              ((>= r h) #f)
              ((>= c w) (loop (+ r 1) 0))
              ((= (at g r c) 1) (list r c))
              (else (loop r (+ c 1))))))
         (rr (first red-pos))
         (rc (second red-pos))
         (br (first blue-pos))
         (bc (second blue-pos))
         ;; Unit signs point from red toward blue.
         (drow (if (> br rr) 1 -1))
         (dcol (if (> bc rc) 1 -1))
         (dr-abs (abs (- br rr)))
         (dc-abs (abs (- bc rc)))
         (max-d (if (> dr-abs dc-abs) dr-abs dc-abs))
         ;; The gap difference is the dominant-axis middle phase length.
         (straights (- max-d (if (> dr-abs dc-abs) dc-abs dr-abs)))
         (is-vert (> dr-abs dc-abs))
         ;; Build interior cells in order: one diagonal, dominant-axis
         ;; straights, then the remaining diagonals into blue.
         (path-cells
          (let loop ((step 1) (cur-r rr) (cur-c rc) (acc (list)))
            (cond
              ((>= step max-d) (reverse acc))
              (else
               (let* ((new-r-c
                       (cond
                         ;; Phase 1: the mandatory first diagonal.
                         ((= step 1) (list (+ cur-r drow) (+ cur-c dcol)))
                         ;; Phase 2: contiguous dominant-axis steps.
                         ((<= step (+ 1 straights))
                          (if is-vert
                              (list (+ cur-r drow) cur-c)
                              (list cur-r (+ cur-c dcol))))
                         ;; Phase 3: trailing diagonals.
                         (else (list (+ cur-r drow) (+ cur-c dcol)))))
                      (nr (first new-r-c))
                      (nc (second new-r-c)))
                 (loop (+ step 1) nr nc (cons (list nr nc) acc))))))))
    ;; Paint only path interiors green; keep both endpoint colors unchanged.
    (for/fold ((out g)) ((cell path-cells))
      (set-cell out (first cell) (second cell) 3)))))

(rule!
 ;; Creatures: a yellow(4) heart with four colored petals and a blue(1)
 ;; tail rooted two cells out. Each creature flies flush to the wall
 ;; OPPOSITE its tail direction and turns around — petals swap across
 ;; the heart (up<->down, left<->right) — with the tail riding along.
 ;; Vacated cells refill with the cyan(8) background.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define bg 8)
     (define (creature center)
       (let* ((cr (first center)) (cc (second center))
              (dir (cond ((and (in-bounds? (- cr 2) cc h w)
                               (= (at g (- cr 2) cc) 1)) 'up)
                         ((and (in-bounds? (+ cr 2) cc h w)
                               (= (at g (+ cr 2) cc) 1)) 'down)
                         ((and (in-bounds? cr (- cc 2) h w)
                               (= (at g cr (- cc 2)) 1)) 'left)
                         ((and (in-bounds? cr (+ cc 2) h w)
                               (= (at g cr (+ cc 2)) 1)) 'right)
                         (else 'none)))
              (seed (cond ((eq? dir 'up) (list (- cr 2) cc))
                          ((eq? dir 'down) (list (+ cr 2) cc))
                          ((eq? dir 'left) (list cr (- cc 2)))
                          ((eq? dir 'right) (list cr (+ cc 2)))
                          (else (list cr cc))))
              (tail (connected-region g (first seed) (second seed)
                                      (lambda (r c v) (= v 1)) 8))
              (body (list (list cr cc) (list (- cr 1) cc)
                          (list (+ cr 1) cc) (list cr (- cc 1))
                          (list cr (+ cc 1))))
              (bb (bbox-of-cells (append body tail)))
              (dr (cond ((eq? dir 'down) (- 0 (first bb)))
                        ((eq? dir 'up) (- (- h 1) (third bb)))
                        (else 0)))
              (dc (cond ((eq? dir 'right) (- 0 (second bb)))
                        ((eq? dir 'left) (- (- w 1) (fourth bb)))
                        (else 0))))
         (list (append body tail)
               ;; petals mirror across the heart: the creature turns
               (list (list (+ cr dr) (+ cc dc) 4)
                     (list (+ cr dr -1) (+ cc dc) (cell-down g cr cc))
                     (list (+ cr dr 1) (+ cc dc) (cell-up g cr cc))
                     (list (+ cr dr) (+ cc dc -1) (cell-right g cr cc))
                     (list (+ cr dr) (+ cc dc 1) (cell-left g cr cc)))
               (map (lambda (p) (list (+ (first p) dr)
                                      (+ (second p) dc)))
                    tail))))

       (map creature
            (filter (lambda (p) (= (at g (first p) (second p)) 4))
                    (grid-positions g))))

               ((c (in-list creatures)))

written_solution: chain-replicate template shape per marker with gap-spacing
program_solution:
(rule!
 ;; The largest object is a TEMPLATE; the loose dots (one shares its
 ;; color — the anchor) list stamp colors along a row or column. Stamp
 ;; one template copy per dot in that dot's color, chained from the
 ;; anchor edge-to-edge with the dots' own gaps as spacing.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define objs (sort (objects-8 g 0)
                        (lambda (a b) (> (obj-size a) (obj-size b)))))
     (define template (first objs))
     (define t-r1 (obj-r1 template))
     (define t-c1 (obj-c1 template))
     (define t-h (obj-h template))
     (define t-w (obj-w template))
     (define pattern (normalize-cells (obj-cells template)))
     (define raw-ms  ;; (color r c) per dot
       (map (lambda (m)
              (let ((c (first (obj-cells m))))
                (list (obj-color m) (first c) (second c))))
            (rest objs)))
     (define horiz?
       (= 1 (length (remove-duplicates (map second raw-ms)))))
     (define ms
       (sort raw-ms (lambda (a b) (if horiz?
                                      (< (third a) (third b))
                                      (< (second a) (second b))))))
     (define n (length ms))
     (define anchor
       (find-first (lambda (i) (= (first (nth ms i))
                                  (obj-color template)))
                   (range 0 n)))
     (define (gap i j)
       (if horiz?
           (- (third (nth ms i)) (third (nth ms j)))
           (- (second (nth ms i)) (second (nth ms j)))))
     (define positions  ;; template corner per dot, chained from anchor
       (let ((fwd (let loop ((i (+ anchor 1)) (prev (list t-r1 t-c1))
                             (acc (list)))
                    (if (>= i n)
                        (reverse acc)
                        (let ((pos (if horiz?
                                       (list t-r1
                                             (+ (second prev) t-w -1
                                                (gap i (- i 1))))
                                       (list (+ (first prev) t-h -1
                                                (gap i (- i 1)))
                                             t-c1))))
                          (loop (+ i 1) pos (cons pos acc))))))
             (bwd (let loop ((i (- anchor 1)) (next (list t-r1 t-c1))
                             (acc (list)))
                    (if (< i 0)
                        acc
                        (let ((pos (if horiz?
                                       (list t-r1
                                             (+ (- (second next)
                                                   (gap (+ i 1) i)
                                                   t-w)
                                                1))
                                       (list (+ (- (first next)
                                                   (gap (+ i 1) i)
                                                   t-h)
                                                1)
                                             t-c1))))
                          (loop (- i 1) pos (cons pos acc)))))))
         (append bwd (list (list t-r1 t-c1)) fwd)))
     (for/fold ((out g)) ((i (range 0 n)))
       (if (= i anchor)
           out
           (paint-cells out
                        (map (lambda (p)
                               (list (+ (first (nth positions i))
                                        (first p))
                                     (+ (second (nth positions i))
                                        (second p))))
                             pattern)
                        (first (nth ms i))))))))

(rule!
  ;; Two containers (bg colors BG1/BG2) each hold a blob of the same inner
  ;; color IN, decorated with 2-cell TABS (IN protrusions or bg dents). A
  ;; tab's TIP is a cell with four in-bounds neighbors splitting 3-vs-1
  ;; between two colors, itself carrying the minority color; its partner is
  ;; the single like-colored neighbor, fully surrounded by that color. Every
  ;; tab is repainted with the OTHER container's background.
  (lambda (g)
    (let* ((h (rows g))
           (w (cols g))
           (nbrs (lambda (r c)
                   (filter (lambda (p) (in-bounds? (first p) (second p) h w))
                           (map (lambda (d) (list (+ r (first d)) (+ c (second d))))
                                cardinal-deltas))))
           (vals (lambda (ps) (map (lambda (p) (at g (first p) (second p))) ps)))
           (tip-at
             (lambda (p)
               (let* ((r (first p))
                      (c (second p))
                      (vs (vals (nbrs r c))))
                 (if (!= 4 (length vs))
                     (list)
                     (let ((uniq (unique vs)))
                       (if (!= 2 (length uniq))
                           (list)
                           (let* ((x (first uniq))
                                  (y (second uniq))
                                  (cx (count-if (lambda (v) (= v x)) vs))
                                  (a (if (= cx 3) x y))
                                  (b (if (= cx 3) y x)))
                             (if (or (and (!= cx 1) (!= cx 3)) (!= (at g r c) b))
                                 (list)
                                 (let ((partner (find-first
                                                  (lambda (q) (= (at g (first q) (second q)) b))
                                                  (nbrs r c))))
                                   (if (and partner
                                            (all? (lambda (v) (= v b))
                                                  (vals (nbrs (first partner) (second partner)))))
                                       (list (list r c a b partner))
                                       (list)))))))))))
           (tips (flatmap tip-at (grid-positions g)))
           (pairs (map (lambda (t) (list (third t) (fourth t))) tips))
           (colors (unique (flatmap (lambda (pr) pr) pairs)))
           (inner (find-first (lambda (col) (all? (lambda (pr) (member col pr)) pairs))
                              colors))
           (bgs (filter (lambda (col) (!= col inner)) colors)))
      (if (or (null? tips) (not inner) (!= 2 (length bgs)))
          g
          (reduce
            (lambda (acc t)

(rule!
 ;; A yellow(4) shape and a magenta(6) bar. Mirror the shape across its
 ;; own bbox edge on the side AWAY from the bar (falling back to the
 ;; near side when the reflection would leave the grid); the bar
 ;; disappears. A vertical bar mirrors horizontally — handled by
 ;; transposing in and out.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define (solve gg)  ;; horizontal bar: mirror across a row edge
       (let* ((yellow (find-color gg 4))
              (yb (bbox-of-cells yellow))
              (ry1 (first yb))
              (ry2 (third yb))
              (six-below (> (first (bbox-of-cells (find-color gg 6)))
                            ry2))
              (up (lambda (r) (- (- (* 2 ry1) 1) r)))
              (down (lambda (r) (- (+ (* 2 ry2) 1) r)))
              (fits? (lambda (mirror)
                       (all? (lambda (p)
                               (let ((nr (mirror (first p))))
                                 (and (>= nr 0) (< nr (rows gg)))))
                             yellow)))
              (mirror (cond ((and six-below (fits? up)) up)
                            (six-below down)
                            ((fits? down) down)
                            (else up))))
         (for/fold ((out (cellmap gg (r c v) (if (= 4 v) 4 0))))
                   ((p yellow))
           (let ((nr (mirror (first p))))
             (if (and (>= nr 0) (< nr (rows gg)))
                 (set-cell out nr (second p) 4)
                 out)))))
     (define sb (bbox-of-cells (find-color g 6)))
     (if (> (- (fourth sb) (second sb)) (- (third sb) (first sb)))
         (solve g)
         (transpose (solve (transpose g)))))))

(rule!
 ;; Each gray(5) line has a decorated pattern hugging one side. The
 ;; pattern (its 4-connected non-gray region) tiles periodically along
 ;; the line's full span, repeating its own bbox as the unit cell.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define (pattern? r c)
       (and (in-bounds? r c h w)
            (let ((v (at g r c)))
              (and (> v 0) (not (= v 5))))))
     (define (tile-line out line)
       (let* ((r1 (obj-r1 line)) (c1 (obj-c1 line))
              (r2 (obj-r2 line)) (c2 (obj-c2 line))
              (horiz (= r1 r2))
              (seeds  ;; pattern cells on the side the pattern hugs
               (if horiz
                   (let ((sr (find-first
                              (lambda (sr)
                                (any? (lambda (c) (pattern? sr c))
                                      (range c1 (+ c2 1))))
                              (list (+ r1 1) (- r1 1)))))
                     (filter (lambda (p) (pattern? (first p) (second p)))
                             (map (lambda (c) (list sr c))
                                  (range c1 (+ c2 1)))))
                   (let ((sc (find-first
                              (lambda (sc)
                                (any? (lambda (r) (pattern? r sc))
                                      (range r1 (+ r2 1))))
                              (list (+ c1 1) (- c1 1)))))
                     (filter (lambda (p) (pattern? (first p) (second p)))
                             (map (lambda (r) (list r sc))
                                  (range r1 (+ r2 1)))))))
              (region (remove-duplicates
                       (flatmap (lambda (p)
                                  (connected-region
                                   g (first p) (second p)
                                   (lambda (r c v)
                                     (and (> v 0) (not (= v 5))))
                                   4))
                                seeds)))
              (sb (bbox-of-cells region))
              (sh (+ 1 (- (third sb) (first sb))))
              (sw (+ 1 (- (fourth sb) (second sb))))
              (rect (if horiz
                        (list (first sb) c1 (third sb) c2)
                        (list r1 (second sb) r2 (fourth sb)))))
         (paint-cells
          out
          (map (lambda (p)
                 (list (first p) (second p)
                       (at g
                           (+ (first sb)
                              (mod (- (first p) (first sb)) sh))
                           (+ (second sb)
                              (mod (- (second p) (second sb)) sw)))))
               (positions-in-rect (first rect) (second rect)
                                  (third rect) (fourth rect))))))
     (reduce tile-line g
             (filter (lambda (o) (= 5 (obj-color o))) (objects g 0))))))

               (sort (filter identity
                             (for*/list ((r (range 0 (- h 2))) (c (range 0 (- w 2))))

                           (and
                             (= ca cb)
                             (or

         (target-c1 (min-of second target-cells))
         (target-c2 (max-of second target-cells))

          (for*/list ((r (range 0 h))
                      (c (range 0 w))

                                  (!= (at g r c) 0)))
            (list r c)))

         (source-c1 (min-of second source-cells))
         (target-width (+ 1 (- target-c2 target-c1))))

    (for*/fold ((out g))
               ((r (range target-r1 (+ target-r2 1)))
                (c (range target-c1 (+ target-c2 1))))

             (col-offset (- c target-c1))
             (source-r (+ source-r1 row-offset))
             (source-c (+ source-c1 (- target-width 1 col-offset))))
        (set-cell out r c (at g source-r source-c)))))))

(rule!
 ;; A small MOVER faces a wider solid WALL (nearest such pair wins,
 ;; bigger wall on ties). The mover teleports through: a doorway its
 ;; own width is cut through the wall, the wall grows sideways by half
 ;; the mover's size (at least 1), and the mover reappears flush on the
 ;; far side (or tucked inside when the wall hugs the grid edge).
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define bg
       (mode-list (for*/list ((r (range 0 h)) (c (range 0 w)))
                    (at g r c))))
     (define objs (objects g bg))
     (define (overlap? a1 a2 b1 b2) (and (<= a1 b2) (<= b1 a2)))
     (define (put gg r c v)
       (if (in-bounds? r c h w) (set-cell gg r c v) gg))
     (define candidates  ;; (gap wall-size dir mover wall)
       (filter (lambda (x) x)
               (for*/list ((m objs) (t objs) #:when (not (eq? m t)))
                 (and (solid-rect? t)
                      (cond ((and (> (obj-r1 t) (obj-r2 m))
                                  (overlap? (obj-c1 m) (obj-c2 m)
                                            (obj-c1 t) (obj-c2 t))
                                  (> (obj-w t) (obj-w m)))
                             (list (- (obj-r1 t) (obj-r2 m) 1)
                                   (obj-size t) 'down m t))
                            ((and (> (obj-r1 m) (obj-r2 t))
                                  (overlap? (obj-c1 m) (obj-c2 m)
                                            (obj-c1 t) (obj-c2 t))
                                  (> (obj-w t) (obj-w m)))
                             (list (- (obj-r1 m) (obj-r2 t) 1)
                                   (obj-size t) 'up m t))
                            ((and (> (obj-c1 t) (obj-c2 m))
                                  (overlap? (obj-r1 m) (obj-r2 m)
                                            (obj-r1 t) (obj-r2 t))
                                  (> (obj-h t) (obj-h m)))
                             (list (- (obj-c1 t) (obj-c2 m) 1)
                                   (obj-size t) 'right m t))
                            ((and (> (obj-c1 m) (obj-c2 t))
                                  (overlap? (obj-r1 m) (obj-r2 m)
                                            (obj-r1 t) (obj-r2 t))
                                  (> (obj-h t) (obj-h m)))
                             (list (- (obj-c1 m) (obj-c2 t) 1)
                                   (obj-size t) 'left m t))
                            (else #f))))))
     (define ranked
       (sort candidates
             (lambda (a b) (cond ((< (first a) (first b)) #t)
                                 ((> (first a) (first b)) #f)
                                 (else (> (second a) (second b)))))))
     (if (null? ranked)
         g
         (let* ((cand (first ranked))
                (dir (third cand))
                (m (fourth cand))
                (t (fifth cand))
                (m-cells (map (lambda (p)
                                (list (first p) (second p)
                                      (at g (first p) (second p))))
                              (obj-cells m)))
                (pad-v (max 1 (quotient (obj-w m) 2)))
                (pad-h (max 1 (quotient (obj-h m) 2)))
                (cleared (paint-cells g (obj-cells m) bg))
                (paint-mover
                 (lambda (gg dr dc)
                   (for/fold ((out gg)) ((cv m-cells))
                     (put out (+ dr (- (first cv) (obj-r1 m)))
                          (+ dc (- (second cv) (obj-c1 m)))
                          (third cv))))))
           (if (member? dir (list 'down 'up))
               (let* ((cut  ;; doorway through the wall, mover-wide
                       (for*/fold ((out cleared))
                                  ((r (range (obj-r1 t)
                                             (+ (obj-r2 t) 1)))
                                   (c (range (obj-c1 m)
                                             (+ (obj-c2 m) 1))))
                         (put out r c bg)))
                      (grown  ;; wall widens by pad-v on both flanks
                       (for*/fold ((out cut))
                                  ((r (range (obj-r1 t)
                                             (+ (obj-r2 t) 1)))
                                   (d (range 1 (+ pad-v 1))))
                         (put (put out r (- (obj-c1 t) d)
                                   (obj-color t))
                              r (+ (obj-c2 t) d) (obj-color t))))
                      (dest-r (if (eq? dir 'up)
                                  (max 0 (- (obj-r1 t) (obj-h m)))
                                  (if (= (obj-r2 t) (- h 1))
                                      (+ (- (obj-r2 t) (obj-h m)) 1)
                                      (+ (obj-r2 t) 1)))))
                 (paint-mover grown dest-r (obj-c1 m)))
               (let* ((cut
                       (for*/fold ((out cleared))
                                  ((r (range (obj-r1 m)
                                             (+ (obj-r2 m) 1)))
                                   (c (range (obj-c1 t)
                                             (+ (obj-c2 t) 1))))
                         (put out r c bg)))
                      (grown
                       (for*/fold ((out cut))
                                  ((c (range (obj-c1 t)
                                             (+ (obj-c2 t) 1)))
                                   (d (range 1 (+ pad-h 1))))
                         (put (put out (- (obj-r1 t) d) c
                                   (obj-color t))
                              (+ (obj-r2 t) d) c (obj-color t))))
                      (dest-c (if (eq? dir 'left)

                                  (if (= (obj-c2 t) (- w 1))
                                      (+ (- (obj-c2 t) (obj-w m)) 1)
                                      (+ (obj-c2 t) 1)))))
                 (paint-mover grown (obj-r1 m) dest-c))))))))

                         (and (not (zero-col? c)) (or (zero? c) (zero-col? (- c 1)))))
                       (range 0 w)))
             (define (row-end s)
               (let ((zs (filter (lambda (r) (zero-row? r)) (range s h))))
                 (if (null? zs) (- h 1) (- (first zs) 1))))
             (define (col-end s)
               (let ((zs (filter (lambda (c) (zero-col? c)) (range s w))))
                 (if (null? zs) (- w 1) (- (first zs) 1))))
             (define bh (+ 1 (- (row-end (first rstarts)) (first rstarts))))
             (define bw (+ 1 (- (col-end (first cstarts)) (first cstarts))))
             (define row-idxs (range 0 (length rstarts)))
             (define col-idxs (range 0 (length cstarts)))
             (define interior-vals
               (flatmap (lambda (i)
                          (flatmap (lambda (j)
                                     (flatmap (lambda (dr)
                                                (map (lambda (dc)
                                                       (at g
                                                           (+ (nth rstarts i) dr)
                                                           (+ (nth cstarts j) dc)))
                                                     (range 1 (- bw 1))))
                                              (range 1 (- bh 1))))
                                   col-idxs))
                        row-idxs))
             (define common (mode-list interior-vals))
             (define colors
               (filter (lambda (v) (and (!= v 0) (!= v common))) (grid-colors g)))
             (define (has-special? color dr dc i j)
               (= (at g (+ (nth rstarts i) dr) (+ (nth cstarts j) dc)) color))
             (define (paint-row acc color dr dc i)
               (let ((js (filter (lambda (j) (has-special? color dr dc i j)) col-idxs)))
                 (if (< (length js) 2)
                     acc
                     (reduce (lambda (a j)
                               (set-cell a
                                         (+ (nth rstarts i) dr)
                                         (+ (nth cstarts j) dc)
                                         color))
                             acc
                             (range (min-list js) (+ (max-list js) 1))))))
             (define (paint-col acc color dr dc j)
               (let ((is (filter (lambda (i) (has-special? color dr dc i j)) row-idxs)))
                 (if (< (length is) 2)
                     acc
                     (reduce (lambda (a i)
                               (set-cell a
                                         (+ (nth rstarts i) dr)
                                         (+ (nth cstarts j) dc)
                                         color))
                             acc
                             (range (min-list is) (+ (max-list is) 1))))))
             (reduce (lambda (acc color)
                       (reduce (lambda (a dr)
                                 (reduce (lambda (a2 dc)
                                           (let ((a3 (reduce (lambda (x i)
                                                               (paint-row x
                                                                          color
                                                                          dr
                                                                          dc
                                                                          i))
                                                             a2
                                                             row-idxs)))
                                             (reduce (lambda (x j)
                                                       (paint-col x color dr dc j))
                                                     a3
                                                     col-idxs)))
                                         a
                                         (range 1 (- bw 1))))
                               acc
                               (range 1 (- bh 1))))
                     g
                     colors)))))

written_solution: remove single-cell noise; recolor each shape by symmetry: top-bottom mirror=1, left-right mirror=3, neither=6

(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (begin
             (define bg (mode g))
             (define objs (objects-8 g bg))
             (define (sym-color obj)
               (let* ((cells (obj-cells obj))
                      (rs (map first cells))
                      (cs (map second cells))
                      (rmin (min-list rs))
                      (rmax (max-list rs))
                      (cmin (min-list cs))
                      (cmax (max-list cs))
                      (oh (+ (- rmax rmin) 1))
                      (ow (+ (- cmax cmin) 1))
                      (norm (map (lambda (c)
                                   (list (- (first c) rmin) (- (second c) cmin)))
                                 cells))
                      (h-sym (andmap (lambda (c)
                                       (any? (lambda (c2)
                                               (= c2
                                                  (list (- (- oh 1) (first c))
                                                        (second c))))
                                             norm))
                                     norm))
                      (v-sym (andmap (lambda (c)
                                       (any? (lambda (c2)
                                               (= c2
                                                  (list (first c)
                                                        (- (- ow 1) (second c)))))
                                             norm))
                                     norm)))
                 (cond (h-sym 1) (v-sym 3) (else 6))))
             (define base (empty-grid h w bg))
             (reduce (lambda (gg obj)
                       (if (> (obj-size obj) 1)
                           (let ((c (sym-color obj)))
                             (recolor-cells gg (obj-cells obj) c))
                           gg))
                     base
                     objs)))))
