(rule! (lambda (g)
	  (let* ((h (rows g))
	         (w (cols g))
	         (bg (mode g))
	         (objs (objects g bg))
	         (bounded (lambda (cells)
	                    (filter (lambda (p) (in-bounds? (first p) (second p) h w)) cells)))
	         ;; Build a hash from color to rect bbox, and list of dots
         (rects
          (let loop ((os objs) (acc (hash)))
            (cond
              ((null? os) acc)
              (else
               (let* ((o (car os))
                      (cells (obj-cells o))
                      (color (obj-color o)))
                 (cond
                   ((> (length cells) 1)
                    (let* ((bb (obj-bbox o))
                           (r1 (first bb)) (c1 (second bb))
                           (r2 (third bb)) (c2 (fourth bb)))
                      (loop (cdr os) (hash-set acc color (list r1 c1 r2 c2)))))
                   (else (loop (cdr os) acc))))))))
         (dots
          (for/list ((o objs)
                     #:when (= (length (obj-cells o)) 1))
            (list (obj-color o) (first (obj-cells o))))))
    (for/fold ((out g)) ((dot dots))
      (let* ((color (first dot))
             (cell (second dot))
             (dr (first cell))
             (dc (second cell)))
        (cond
          ((not (hash-has-key? rects color)) out)
          (else
           (let* ((rect (hash-ref rects color))
                  (r1 (first rect)) (c1 (second rect))
                  (r2 (third rect)) (c2 (fourth rect))
                  ;; Determine direction
                  (dir-info
                   (cond
                     ((and (< dc c1) (<= r1 dr) (<= dr r2))
                      (list 'right (- c1 1)))
                     ((and (> dc c2) (<= r1 dr) (<= dr r2))
                      (list 'left (+ c2 1)))
                     ((and (< dr r1) (<= c1 dc) (<= dc c2))
                      (list 'down (- r1 1)))
                     ((and (> dr r2) (<= c1 dc) (<= dc c2))
                      (list 'up (+ r2 1)))
                     (else #f))))
             (cond
               ((not dir-info) out)
               (else
	                (let* ((direction (first dir-info))
	                       (cap-coord (second dir-info))
	                       ;; Draw flower: erase center, 4 petals
	                       (g5 (paint-cells
	                            (erase-cells out (list (list dr dc)) bg)
	                            (bounded (map (lambda (delta)
	                                            (list (+ dr (first delta)) (+ dc (second delta))))
	                                          cardinal-deltas))
	                            color)))
	                  ;; Draw stem + cap
	                  (cond
	                    ((eq? direction 'right)
	                     (paint-cells
	                      g5
	                      (bounded (append (positions-in-rect dr (+ dc 2) dr cap-coord)
	                                       (list (list (- dr 1) cap-coord) (list (+ dr 1) cap-coord))))
	                      color))
	                    ((eq? direction 'left)
	                     (paint-cells
	                      g5
	                      (bounded (append (positions-in-rect dr cap-coord dr (- dc 2))
	                                       (list (list (- dr 1) cap-coord) (list (+ dr 1) cap-coord))))
	                      color))
	                    ((eq? direction 'down)
	                     (paint-cells
	                      g5
	                      (bounded (append (positions-in-rect (+ dr 2) dc cap-coord dc)
	                                       (list (list cap-coord (- dc 1)) (list cap-coord (+ dc 1)))))
	                      color))
	                    ((eq? direction 'up)
	                     (paint-cells
	                      g5
	                      (bounded (append (positions-in-rect cap-coord dc (- dr 2) dc)
	                                       (list (list cap-coord (- dc 1)) (list cap-coord (+ dc 1)))))
	                      color))
                    (else g5)))))))))))))

(rule!
 (lambda (g)
   ;; Red is the start and green is the destination.  The elbow belongs on
   ;; red's row and green's column, so the horizontal arm is drawn first.
   (define red (first (find-color g 2)))
   (define green (first (find-color g 3)))
   (define rr (first red))
   (define rc (second red))
   (define gr (first green))
   (define gc (second green))
   (define cmin (min rc gc))
   (define cmax (max rc gc))
   (define rmin (min rr gr))
   (define rmax (max rr gr))
   ;; Paint the horizontal arm while preserving the red endpoint.
   (define with-row
     (reduce (lambda (out c)
               (if (= c rc) out (set-cell out rr c 8)))
             g
             (range cmin (+ cmax 1))))
   ;; Paint the vertical arm while preserving the green endpoint.
   (reduce (lambda (out r)
             (if (= r gr) out (set-cell out r gc 8)))
           with-row
           (range rmin (+ rmax 1)))))

(rule! (lambda (g)
  (let* ((h (rows g))
         (w (cols g))

         (bg (mode g 0))

      (let* ((cells (find-color g col))
             ;; Top edge of the bbox

             ;; Bottom edge of the bbox
             (sr2 (apply max (map first cells)))
             ;; Left edge of the bbox
             (sc1 (apply min (map second cells)))
             ;; Right edge of the bbox
             (sc2 (apply max (map second cells)))
             ;; Bbox height (rows)
             (sh (+ 1 (- sr2 sr1)))
             ;; Bbox width (cols)
             (sw (+ 1 (- sc2 sc1)))
             (hole-r1
              (let loop ((r sr1))
                (cond
                  ((<= r 0) 0)
                  ((for/and ((c (range sc1 (+ sc2 1))))
                     (let ((v (cell-at g (- r 1) c)))
                       (or (= v 0) (= v col))))
                   (loop (- r 1)))
                  (else r))))
             (hole-r2
              (let loop ((r sr2))
                (cond
                  ((>= (+ r 1) h) r)
                  ((for/and ((c (range sc1 (+ sc2 1))))
                     (let ((v (cell-at g (+ r 1) c)))
                       (or (= v 0) (= v col))))
                   (loop (+ r 1)))
                  (else r))))
             (hole-c1
              (let loop ((c sc1))
                (cond
                  ((<= c 0) 0)
                  ((for/and ((r (range sr1 (+ sr2 1))))
                     (let ((v (cell-at g r (- c 1))))
                       (or (= v 0) (= v col))))
                   (loop (- c 1)))
                  (else c))))
             (hole-c2
              (let loop ((c sc2))
                (cond
                  ((>= (+ c 1) w) c)
                  ((for/and ((r (range sr1 (+ sr2 1))))
                     (let ((v (cell-at g r (+ c 1))))
                       (or (= v 0) (= v col))))
                   (loop (+ c 1)))
                  (else c)))))

                   ((r (range hole-r1 (+ hole-r2 1)))
                    (c (range hole-c1 (+ hole-c2 1))))

written_solution: sort shapes: hollow-frame shapes to top, pluses to bottom, preserve columns
program_solution:
(rule!
 ;; Hollow frames FLOAT to the top and the solid shapes SINK to the
 ;; bottom, each keeping its columns and taking the first collision-
 ;; free slot (frames placed in top-down input order, sinkers
 ;; bottom-up). Everything lands on a blank canvas.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define (frame? o)
       (let ((rim (filter (lambda (p) (or (= (first p) (obj-r1 o))
                                          (= (first p) (obj-r2 o))
                                          (= (second p) (obj-c1 o))
                                          (= (second p) (obj-c2 o))))
                          (positions-in-rect (obj-r1 o) (obj-c1 o)
                                             (obj-r2 o) (obj-c2 o)))))
         (and (= (obj-size o) (length rim))
              (all? (lambda (p) (member p (obj-cells o))) rim))))
     (define objs (objects g 0))
     (define floaters
       (sort (filter frame? objs)
             (lambda (a b) (< (obj-r1 a) (obj-r1 b)))))
     (define sinkers
       (sort (filter (lambda (o) (not (frame? o))) objs)
             (lambda (a b) (> (obj-r1 a) (obj-r1 b)))))
     (define (drop state shape from step)
       ;; state = (out occupancy); slide the shape's rows to offset t
       (let* ((cells (obj-cells shape))
              (r1 (obj-r1 shape))
              (fits? (lambda (t)
                       (all? (lambda (p)
                               (zero? (at (second state)
                                          (+ t (- (first p) r1))
                                          (second p))))
                             cells))))
         (let loop ((t from))
           (cond ((or (< t 0) (> t (- h (obj-h shape)))) state)
                 ((fits? t)
                  (let ((placed (map (lambda (p)
                                       (list (+ t (- (first p) r1))
                                             (second p)))
                                     cells)))
                    (list (paint-cells (first state) placed
                                       (obj-color shape))
                          (paint-cells (second state) placed 1))))
                 (else (loop (+ t step)))))))
     (first
      (for/fold ((st (for/fold ((st (list (empty-grid h w 0)
                                          (empty-grid h w 0))))
                               ((f floaters))
                       (drop st f 0 1))))
                ((p sinkers))
        (drop st p (- h (obj-h p)) -1))))))

                                                                              (nth s 0))
                                                                            sub-info))
                                                               (lambda (x) x))))
                                    (count-if (lambda (r) (< r sr1)) sorted-rows))))
                (assign-col-idx (lambda (sub)
                                  (let* ((sc1 (nth sub 2))
                                         (sorted-cols (sort-by (unique (map (lambda (s)
                                                                              (nth s 2))
                                                                            sub-info))
                                                               (lambda (x) x))))
                                    (count-if (lambda (c) (< c sc1)) sorted-cols))))
                (num-rows (length (unique (map (lambda (s) (nth s 0)) sub-info))))
                (num-cols (length (unique (map (lambda (s) (nth s 2)) sub-info)))))
           (build-grid num-rows

                                                 (and
                                                   (= r (assign-row-idx s))

written_solution: Cycle icon colors clockwise around red(2) boxes
program_solution:
(rule! (lambda (g)
  (let* (;; Each red object is one hollow square frame.
         (red-objs (filter (lambda (o) (= 2 (obj-color o))) (objects g 0)))
         ;; Recover every frame center and its one non-0/1/2 icon color.
         (box-data (map (lambda (o)
           (let* ((r1 (obj-r1 o)) (r2 (obj-r2 o))
                  (c1 (obj-c1 o)) (c2 (obj-c2 o))
                  (cr (/ (+ 0.0 r1 r2) 2))
                  (cc2 (/ (+ 0.0 c1 c2) 2))
                  (ic (find-first
                        (lambda (v) (and (!= 0 v) (!= 1 v) (!= 2 v)))
                        (apply append (subgrid g r1 c1 r2 c2)))))
             (list cr cc2 ic)))
           red-objs))
         (centroid-r (/ (+ 0.0 (reduce + 0 (map first box-data)))
                        (length box-data)))
         (centroid-c (/ (+ 0.0 (reduce + 0 (map (lambda (b) (nth b 1)) box-data)))
                        (length box-data)))
         ;; Sort clockwise by quadrant, then slope, around the shared centroid.
         (sorted-data (sort-by box-data (lambda (b)
           (let* ((dr (- (first b) centroid-r))
                  (dc (- (nth b 1) centroid-c))
                  (quadrant
                    (cond ((and (< dr 0) (>= dc 0)) 0)
                          ((and (>= dr 0) (> dc 0)) 1)
                          ((and (> dr 0) (<= dc 0)) 2)
                          (else 3)))
                  (slope (if (zero? dc) -99999 (/ (+ 0.0 dr) dc))))
             (+ (* quadrant 100000) slope)))))
         (icon-colors (map (lambda (b) (nth b 2)) sorted-data))
         (n (length icon-colors))
         ;; Frame i receives the icon color from the next clockwise frame.
         (recolor-pairs
           (map (lambda (i)
                  (cons (nth icon-colors i)
                        (nth icon-colors (mod (+ i 1) n))))
                (range 0 n))))
    ;; Only icon colors change; all geometry and structural colors are fixed.
    (cellmap g (r c v)
      (let* ((entry (find (lambda (p) (= v (fst p))) recolor-pairs)))
        (if entry (snd entry) v))))))

                   (hash-set! result (list r c) (at g r c)))
             (for* ((r (range 0 h)) (c (range 0 w)))
                   (when
                     (and (= (at g r c) 6) (not (hash-has-key? visited (list r c))))
                     (let ((cells (list)))

                            ((q (list (list r c))))

                              (null? q)
                              (let ((cr (first (car q)))
                                    (cc (second (car q))))

                                  ((or
                                     (hash-has-key? visited (list cr cc))
                                     (< cr 0)
                                     (>= cr h)
                                     (< cc 0)
                                     (>= cc w)

                                        (set! cells (cons (list cr cc) cells))
                                        (bfs (append (cdr q)
                                                     (list (list (- cr 1) cc)
                                                           (list (+ cr 1) cc)
                                                           (list cr (- cc 1))
                                                           (list cr (+ cc 1))))))))))
                       (let* ((n (length cells))
                              (rmin (min-of first cells))
                              (cmin (min-of second cells))
                              (rmax (max-of first cells))
                              (cmax (max-of second cells))
                              (sh (+ 1 (- rmax rmin)))
                              (sw (+ 1 (- cmax cmin)))

                                       ((= n 3) 4)
                                       ((= n 2) 9)
                                       (else 6))))
                         (for ((cell cells)) (hash-set! result cell color))))))

written_solution: find all maximal 2/8 rectangles, output the unique-content one (the others repeat the same pattern)
program_solution:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (begin
             (define (is-fg? r c) (or (= (at g r c) 2) (= (at g r c) 8)))
             (define (all-fg? r1 c1 r2 c2)
               (andmap (lambda (r)
                         (andmap (lambda (c) (is-fg? r c)) (range c1 (+ c2 1))))
                       (range r1 (+ r2 1))))
             (define (maximal? r1 c1 r2 c2)
               (and
                 (or
                   (zero? r1)
                   (not (andmap (lambda (c) (is-fg? (- r1 1) c)) (range c1 (+ c2 1)))))
                 (or
                   (= r2 (- h 1))
                   (not (andmap (lambda (c) (is-fg? (+ r2 1) c)) (range c1 (+ c2 1)))))
                 (or
                   (zero? c1)
                   (not (andmap (lambda (r) (is-fg? r (- c1 1))) (range r1 (+ r2 1)))))
                 (or
                   (= c2 (- w 1))
                   (not (andmap (lambda (r) (is-fg? r (+ c2 1))) (range r1 (+ r2 1)))))))
             (define all-tuples
               (flatmap (lambda (r1)
                          (flatmap (lambda (c1)
                                     (flatmap (lambda (r2)
                                                (map (lambda (c2) (list r1 c1 r2 c2))
                                                     (range (+ c1 2) w)))
                                              (range (+ r1 2) h)))
                                   (range 0 w)))
                        (range 0 h)))
             (define rects
               (filter (lambda (rect)
                         (and
                           (all-fg? (first rect)
                                    (second rect)
                                    (third rect)
                                    (nth rect 3))
                           (maximal? (first rect)
                                     (second rect)
                                     (third rect)
                                     (nth rect 3))))
                       all-tuples))
             (define (rect-content rect)
               (let ((r1 (first rect))
                     (c1 (second rect))
                     (r2 (third rect))
                     (c2 (nth rect 3)))
                 (build-grid (+ (- r2 r1) 1)
                             (+ (- c2 c1) 1)
                             (r c)
                             (at g (+ r r1) (+ c c1)))))
             (define contents (map rect-content rects))
             (define (count-eq lst x) (count-if (lambda (y) (= y x)) lst))
             (define unique
               (find (lambda (rect) (= 1 (count-eq contents (rect-content rect))))
                     rects))
             (rect-content unique)))))

written_solution: Each shape is grid of 3x3 blocks. 8 is main shape; for each slice along its long axis, stack: padding/smaller-blocks/8-blocks based on 8's relative position
program_solution:
(rule!
 ;; Hollow 4x4 blocks on a coarse lattice form one big cyan(8) group
 ;; and small colored groups; a blue(1) bar marks the gravity edge.
 ;; Per lattice slice (column of the cyan group when it is wide, row
 ;; when tall), count the cyan blocks and the overlapping small-group
 ;; blocks, and emit stacked bars: cyan pressed toward the blue bar,
 ;; the small color on top, empty above.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define (analyze col)  ;; (color bh bw blocks r1 c1) on the lattice
       (let* ((cells (find-color g col))
              (r1 (min-list (map first cells)))
              (c1 (min-list (map second cells)))
              (bh (quotient (+ (- (max-list (map first cells)) r1) 2) 4))
              (bw (quotient (+ (- (max-list (map second cells)) c1) 2) 4)))
         (list col bh bw
               (map (lambda (br)
                      (map (lambda (bc)
                             (if (= (at g (+ r1 (* br 4)) (+ c1 (* bc 4)))
                                    col)
                                 1 0))
                           (range 0 bw)))
                    (range 0 bh))
               r1 c1)))
     (define (i-color i) (nth i 0))
     (define (i-bh i) (nth i 1))
     (define (i-bw i) (nth i 2))
     (define (i-blocks i) (nth i 3))
     (define (i-r1 i) (nth i 4))
     (define (i-c1 i) (nth i 5))
     (define infos
       (map analyze (filter (lambda (c) (and (not (= c 0)) (not (= c 1))))
                            (grid-colors g))))
     (define main (find (lambda (i) (= (i-color i) 8)) infos))
     (define smalls (filter (lambda (i) (not (= (i-color i) 8))) infos))
     (define horizontal? (> (i-bw main) (i-bh main)))
     (define main-at-end  ;; cyan sits past the smalls, away from the bar
       (if horizontal?
           (> (- (i-r1 main)
                 (quotient (apply + (map i-r1 smalls)) (length smalls)))
              0)
           (> (- (i-c1 main)
                 (quotient (apply + (map i-c1 smalls)) (length smalls)))
              0)))
     (define (col-sum blocks i n)
       (sum-list (map (lambda (br) (nth (nth blocks br) i)) (range 0 n))))
     (define (slice-counts i)  ;; (cyan-count small-count small-color)
       (let* ((m-count (if horizontal?
                           (col-sum (i-blocks main) i (i-bh main))
                           (sum-list (nth (i-blocks main) i))))
              (s-info (find (lambda (si)
                              (let ((off (if horizontal?
                                             (quotient (- (i-c1 si)
                                                          (i-c1 main))
                                                       4)
                                             (quotient (- (i-r1 si)
                                                          (i-r1 main))
                                                       4))))
                                (and (>= i off)
                                     (< i (+ off (if horizontal?
                                                     (i-bw si)
                                                     (i-bh si)))))))
                            smalls)))
         (list m-count
               (if s-info
                   (if horizontal?
                       (col-sum (i-blocks s-info)
                                (- i (quotient (- (i-c1 s-info)
                                                  (i-c1 main))
                                               4))
                                (i-bh s-info))
                       (sum-list (nth (i-blocks s-info)
                                      (- i (quotient (- (i-r1 s-info)
                                                        (i-r1 main))
                                                     4)))))
                   0)
               (if s-info (i-color s-info) 0))))
     (define n-slices (if horizontal? (i-bw main) (i-bh main)))
     (define slices (map slice-counts (range 0 n-slices)))
     (define max-h (max-of (lambda (s) (+ (first s) (second s))) slices))
     (define (bar triple)  ;; one stacked slice, padded to max-h
       (let ((m (make-list (first triple) 8))
             (s (make-list (second triple) (third triple)))
             (p (make-list (- max-h (+ (first triple) (second triple)))
                           0)))
         (if main-at-end (append p s m) (append m s p))))
     (define stacks (map bar slices))
     (if horizontal?
         (map (lambda (r) (map (lambda (c) (nth (nth stacks c) r))
                               (range 0 n-slices)))
              (range 0 max-h))
         stacks))))

written_solution: Infer a 2x2 D4 transform/color map from A->B bands, then apply it to C
program_solution:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((positions2 (list (list 0 0) (list 0 1) (list 1 0) (list 1 1)))
                  (t-order (list 0 1 2 3 4 5 6 7)))
             (define (zero-row? r)
               (all? (lambda (c) (zero? (at g r c))) (range 0 (cols g))))
             (define (group-start r) (if (or (zero? r) (zero-row? (- r 1))) r (- r 1)))
             (define (src t r c)
               (cond
                 ((zero? t) (list r c))
                 ((= t 1) (list r (- 1 c)))
                 ((= t 2) (list (- 1 r) c))
                 ((= t 3) (list (- 1 r) (- 1 c)))
                 ((= t 4) (list (- 1 c) r))
                 ((= t 5) (list c (- 1 r)))
                 ((= t 6) (list c r))
                 (else (list (- 1 c) (- 1 r)))))
             (define (block-val gr base r c) (at g (+ gr r) (+ base c)))
             (define (a-val gr t r c)
               (let ((p (src t r c))) (block-val gr 0 (fst p) (snd p))))
             (define (b-val gr r c) (block-val gr 3 r c))
             (define (c-val gr t r c)
               (let ((p (src t r c))) (block-val gr 7 (fst p) (snd p))))
             (define (consistent? gr t)
               (all? (lambda (p)
                       (all? (lambda (q)
                               (or
                                 (!= (a-val gr t (fst p) (snd p))
                                     (a-val gr t (fst q) (snd q)))
                                 (= (b-val gr (fst p) (snd p))
                                    (b-val gr (fst q) (snd q)))))
                             positions2))
                     positions2))
             (define (exact-score gr t)
               (count-if (lambda (p)
                           (= (a-val gr t (fst p) (snd p)) (b-val gr (fst p) (snd p))))
                         positions2))
             (define (mapping gr t v)
               (let ((hits (filter (lambda (p) (= (a-val gr t (fst p) (snd p)) v))
                                   positions2)))
                 (if (null? hits) #f (b-val gr (fst (first hits)) (snd (first hits))))))
             (define (best-t gr)
               (first (sort (filter (lambda (t) (consistent? gr t)) t-order)
                            (lambda (a b)
                              (let ((sa (exact-score gr a))
                                    (sb (exact-score gr b)))
                                (or (> sa sb) (and (= sa sb) (< a b))))))))
             (build-grid h
                         2
                         (r c)
                         (if (zero-row? r)
                             0
                             (let* ((gr (group-start r))
                                    (lr (- r gr))
                                    (t (best-t gr))
                                    (v (c-val gr t lr c))
                                    (m (mapping gr t v)))
                               (if m m v))))))))

written_solution: template+reference: extract line colors from template, positions from reference; special rows map template-to-reference by index
program_solution:
(rule!
 ;; A full gray(5) column splits the board: one side is a REFERENCE
 ;; panel drawn only in 0/4 (yellow marks the line columns, and its
 ;; rarer rows mark SPECIAL rows), the other a TEMPLATE panel of
 ;; colored vertical lines whose special rows show a highlight fill.
 ;; Repaint the reference: line columns take the template line colors;
 ;; each special reference row takes its matching template row's fill,
 ;; keeping a line cell colored only where the template kept it.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define div-col
       (find-first (lambda (c) (all? (lambda (r) (= (at g r c) 5))
                                     (range 0 h)))
                   (range 0 w)))
     (define (panel cstart cend)  ;; non-gray rows of the region, cropped
       (map (lambda (r) (for/list ((cx (range cstart cend))) (at g r cx)))
            (filter (lambda (r) (any? (lambda (cx) (not (= (at g r cx) 5)))
                                      (range cstart cend)))
                    (range 0 h))))
     (define left (panel 0 div-col))
     (define right (panel (+ div-col 1) w))
     (define (ref? mat)
       (all? (lambda (row) (all? (lambda (v) (or (zero? v) (= v 4))) row))
             mat))
     (define ref (if (ref? left) left right))
     (define tmp (if (ref? left) right left))
     (define tmp-w (length (first tmp)))
     (define tmp-normal  ;; the template's most common row
       (pick-max (remove-duplicates tmp)
                 (lambda (row) (count-if (lambda (r2) (equal? r2 row))
                                         tmp))))
     (define line-cols
       (filter (lambda (cx) (not (zero? (nth tmp-normal cx))))
               (range 0 tmp-w)))
     (define line-colors (map (lambda (cx) (nth tmp-normal cx)) line-cols))
     (define tmp-specials
       (filter (lambda (i) (not (equal? (nth tmp i) tmp-normal)))
               (range 0 (length tmp))))
     (define (yellows row) (count-if (lambda (v) (= v 4)) row))
     (define ref-normal  ;; the ref row with the fewest (but >0) yellows
       (pick-min (filter (lambda (row) (> (yellows row) 0)) ref) yellows))
     (define ref-line-cols
       (filter (lambda (cx) (= (nth ref-normal cx) 4))
               (range 0 (length (first ref)))))
     (define ref-specials
       (filter (lambda (i) (and (> (yellows (nth ref i)) 0)
                                (not (equal? (nth ref i) ref-normal))))
               (range 0 (length ref))))
     (define (index-in lst v)
       (let loop ((xs lst) (i 0))
         (cond ((null? xs) -1)
               ((= (car xs) v) i)
               (else (loop (cdr xs) (+ i 1))))))
     (define (fill-of tmp-row)  ;; the row's color off the line columns
       (let loop ((cx 0))
         (cond ((>= cx tmp-w) 0)
               ((member? cx line-cols) (loop (+ cx 1)))
               (else (nth tmp-row cx)))))
     (build-grid (length ref) (length (first ref)) (rr cc)
                 (let ((si (index-in ref-specials rr)))
                   (if (>= si 0)
                       (let* ((tmp-row (nth tmp (nth tmp-specials si)))
                              (fill (fill-of tmp-row)))
                         (if (member? cc ref-line-cols)
                             (let* ((k (index-in ref-line-cols cc))
                                    (tv (nth tmp-row (nth line-cols k)))
                                    (lc (nth line-colors k)))
                               (if (= tv lc) lc fill))
                             fill))
                       (if (member? cc ref-line-cols)
                           (nth line-colors (index-in ref-line-cols cc))
                           0)))))))

written_solution: staircase encoding of colored square counts by size; 3 sizes (2,3,4) with noise filtering
program_solution:
(rule!
 ;; Solid squares are TALLY marks: each size s (2+) appears some number
 ;; of times, one color per size. Redraw the tally as corner-nested
 ;; glyphs: every glyph shows the sizes still active that round stacked
 ;; in one corner (smallest on top), emitted round-robin until all
 ;; counts run dry, each glyph followed by a blank spacer column. If
 ;; the smallest size outnumbers the runner-up, one of its tallies is
 ;; dropped (that square doubles as the size key).
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define bg (mode g -1))
     (define squares  ;; (size color) per solid square, size >= 2
       (filter (lambda (x) x)
               (map (lambda (o)
                      (and (>= (obj-h o) 2)
                           (= (obj-h o) (obj-w o))
                           (= (obj-size o) (* (obj-h o) (obj-w o)))
                           (list (obj-h o) (obj-color o))))
                    (objects g bg))))
     (define sizes (sort (remove-duplicates (map first squares)) <))
     (define (color-of s)
       (second (find (lambda (sq) (= (first sq) s)) squares)))
     (define counts
       (let ((raw (map (lambda (s)
                         (count-if (lambda (sq) (= (first sq) s))
                                   squares))
                       sizes)))
         (if (and (>= (length sizes) 2) (> (first raw) (second raw)))
             (cons (- (first raw) 1) (rest raw))
             raw)))
     (define blocks  ;; glyphs: active-size lists, round-robin
       (let loop ((pairs (zip-lists sizes counts)) (acc (list)))
         (if (null? pairs)
             acc
             (let ((m (min-list (map second pairs))))
               (loop (filter (lambda (p) (> (second p) 0))
                             (map (lambda (p) (list (first p)
                                                    (- (second p) m)))
                                  pairs))
                     (append acc (make-list m (map first pairs))))))))
     (define out-h (+ (max-list sizes) 1))
     (define (glyph-w blk) (+ 1 (max-list blk)))
     (let loop ((bs blocks) (col 0)
                (out (empty-grid out-h
                                 (apply + (map glyph-w blocks))
                                 bg)))
       (if (null? bs)
           out
           (loop (rest bs) (+ col (glyph-w (first bs)))
                 (for*/fold ((acc out))
                            ((r (range 0 out-h))
                             (c (range 0 (glyph-w (first bs)))))
                   (let ((cover (filter (lambda (s)
                                          (>= s (+ 1 (max r c))))
                                        (first bs))))
                     (if (null? cover)
                         acc
                         (set-cell acc r (+ col c)
                                   (color-of (min-list cover))))))))))))

(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))

                  (path-set (make-hash))
                  (_process (for ((hole holes))
                              (unless
                                (null? hole)
                                (let* ((rs (map first hole))
                                       (cs (map second hole))
                                       (r1 (min-list rs))
                                       (r2 (max-list rs))
                                       (c1 (min-list cs))
                                       (c2 (max-list cs))

                                       (touches-bot (= r2 (- h 1)))
                                       (touches-left (zero? c1))
                                       (touches-right (= c2 (- w 1)))

                                    (eq? mirror 'none)
                                    (for ((cell hole))
                                      (let* ((cr (first cell))
                                             (cc (second cell))

                                             (nc (if (eq? mirror 'rows) cc (- w 1 cc))))

                                              (hash-set! path-set (list rr cc) #t)))

                                                  (hash-set! path-set (list rr cc) #t))))))))))

                      (r c v)
                      (cond
                        ((hash-has-key? new-hole-set (list r c)) 0)
                        ((hash-has-key? path-set (list r c)) 7)
                        (else v)))))))

                 (= (at g r c) 5))

    ;; payload, not a marker, so it is copied like every other nonzero color.
    (for*/fold ((out base))

            (co (* bc 3)))

                    (dc (range 0 3)))

written_solution: red(2) pixels on green(3) rect edges project outward as beams: red(2) center line + green(3) sides, width=2*d+1 where d=distance to opposite rect edge
program_solution:
(rule!
 ;; Each red(2) cell sits on the rim of a blob cluster. It fires AWAY
 ;; from the cluster: a red ray to the grid edge, flanked at every step
 ;; by green(3) wings as wide as the cluster's span on the launch axis.
 ;; The cluster box is grown by alternating row/column sweeps before
 ;; reading which rim the red cell occupies.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define (grow start step good?)  ;; slide while the NEXT spot is good
       (let loop ((k start))
         (if (good? (+ k step)) (loop (+ k step)) k)))
     (define (launch out rr cc)
       (let* ((r1 (grow rr -1 (lambda (k) (and (>= k 0)
                                               (not (zero? (at g k cc)))))))
              (r2 (grow rr 1 (lambda (k) (and (< k h)
                                              (not (zero? (at g k cc)))))))
              (c1 (grow cc -1 (lambda (k) (and (>= k 0)
                                               (not (zero? (at g rr k)))))))
              (c2 (grow cc 1 (lambda (k) (and (< k w)
                                              (not (zero? (at g rr k)))))))
              (c1f (grow c1 -1
                         (lambda (k)
                           (and (>= k 0)
                                (any? (lambda (kr)
                                        (not (zero? (at g kr k))))
                                      (range r1 (+ r2 1)))))))
              (c2f (grow c2 1
                         (lambda (k)
                           (and (< k w)
                                (any? (lambda (kr)
                                        (not (zero? (at g kr k))))
                                      (range r1 (+ r2 1)))))))
              (r1f (grow r1 -1
                         (lambda (k)
                           (and (>= k 0)
                                (any? (lambda (kc)
                                        (not (zero? (at g k kc))))
                                      (range c1f (+ c2f 1)))))))
              (r2f (grow r2 1
                         (lambda (k)
                           (and (< k h)
                                (any? (lambda (kc)
                                        (not (zero? (at g k kc))))
                                      (range c1f (+ c2f 1)))))))
              (fdr (cond ((= rr r1f) -1) ((= rr r2f) 1) (else 0)))
              (fdc (cond ((= cc c1f) -1) ((= cc c2f) 1) (else 0)))
              (dr (if (zero? fdc) fdr 0))
              (dc (if (zero? fdr) fdc 0)))
         (if (and (zero? dr) (zero? dc))
             out
             (let ((half (cond ((= dc -1) (- c2f cc))
                               ((= dc 1) (- cc c1f))
                               ((= dr -1) (- r2f rr))
                               (else (- rr r1f)))))
               (let ext ((er (+ rr dr)) (ec (+ cc dc)) (acc out))
                 (if (not (in-bounds? er ec h w))
                     acc
                     (ext (+ er dr) (+ ec dc)
                          (for/fold ((a2 (set-cell acc er ec 2)))
                                    ((k (range 1 (+ half 1))))
                            (let* ((p1 (if (zero? dr)
                                           (list (- er k) ec)
                                           (list er (- ec k))))
                                   (p2 (if (zero? dr)
                                           (list (+ er k) ec)
                                           (list er (+ ec k))))
                                   (a3 (if (in-bounds? (first p1)
                                                       (second p1) h w)
                                           (set-cell a2 (first p1)
                                                     (second p1) 3)
                                           a2)))
                              (if (in-bounds? (first p2) (second p2)
                                              h w)
                                  (set-cell a3 (first p2) (second p2)
                                            3)
                                  a3))))))))))
     (for*/fold ((out g)) ((rr (range 0 h)) (cc (range 0 w)))
       (if (= (at g rr cc) 2) (launch out rr cc) out)))))

(rule! (lambda (g)
  ;; Two-color 5x5 motifs (majority BODY + one odd CORE cell; loose satellite dots join the
  ;; motif whose 5x5 box they share). Output = per-motif color swap: body cells -> core color,
  ;; the core cell -> body color. A motif whose core is OFF-center inherits the body color of a
  ;; CONGRUENT same-core twin whose core IS centered (twin motifs share one color-pair identity).
  ;; Each non-bg CORNER pixel is a marker: every motif whose core matches the marker color is
  ;; stamped at that corner (its own bbox flush inward, marker-colored) — except a motif that
  ;; fully ENCLOSES background stamps only its hole-bounding loop (appendages drop).
  (let* ((h (rows g)) (w (cols g))
         (bg (mode g -1))                        ;; modal color = background (never assume 0)
         (corner-ps (list (list 0 0) (list 0 (- w 1)) (list (- h 1) 0) (list (- h 1) (- w 1))))
         (markers (filter (lambda (p) (!= (at g (first p) (second p)) bg)) corner-ps))
         (g-noc (reduce (lambda (acc p) (set-cell acc (first p) (second p) bg)) g markers))
         (as-rc (lambda (p) (if (pair? (cdr p)) p (list (car p) (cdr p))))))
    (define (fits5? cells)                       ;; union still fits one 5x5 motif box?
      (let* ((b (bbox-of-cells cells)))
        (and (< (- (third b) (first b)) 5) (< (- (fourth b) (second b)) 5))))
    (define (merge-pass gs)                      ;; merge FIRST mergeable pair -> (list did? gs)
      (if (null? gs) (list #f '())
          (let* ((a (first gs))
                 (partner (findf (lambda (o) (fits5? (append a o))) (rest gs))))
            (if partner
                (list #t (cons (append a partner) (remove partner (rest gs))))
                (let ((sub (merge-pass (rest gs))))
                  (list (first sub) (cons a (second sub))))))))
    (define (merge-motifs gs)                    ;; ... to fixpoint (satellite dots -> their motif)
      (let* ((p (merge-pass gs)))
        (if (first p) (merge-motifs (second p)) (second p))))
    ;; motif = (cells body-color core-color core-cell bbox centered?)
    (define (motif-of cells)
      (let* ((cnt (for/fold ((hsh (hash))) ((p cells))
                    (let* ((v (at g (first p) (second p))))
                      (hash-set hsh v (add1 (hash-ref hsh v 0))))))
             (ks (sort (hash-keys cnt) (lambda (a b) (> (hash-ref cnt a) (hash-ref cnt b))))))
        (if (< (length ks) 2) #f                 ;; single-color blob: not a motif, leave alone
            (let* ((body (first ks)) (core (last ks))
                   (cc (findf (lambda (p) (= (at g (first p) (second p)) core)) cells))
                   (b (bbox-of-cells cells))
                   (ctr (list (quotient (+ (first b) (third b)) 2)
                              (quotient (+ (second b) (fourth b)) 2))))
              (list cells body core cc b (equal? cc ctr))))))
    (define (m-cells m) (first m))
    (define (m-body m) (second m))
    (define (m-core m) (third m))
    (define (m-bbox m) (fifth m))
    (define (m-centered? m) (sixth m))
    (define motifs
      (filter (lambda (m) m)
              (map motif-of (merge-motifs (map (lambda (o) (map as-rc (obj-cells o)))
                                               (objects-8 g-noc bg))))))
    (define (core-target m)                      ;; centered-cored twin defines the pair identity
      (let* ((twin (and (not (m-centered? m))
                       (findf (lambda (o) (and (not (eq? o m))
                                               (= (m-core o) (m-core m))
                                               (m-centered? o)
                                               (member (normalize-cells (m-cells m))
                                                       (all-transforms (m-cells o))
                                                       cells-equal?)))
                              motifs))))
        (if twin (m-body twin) (m-body m))))
    (define (hole-cells m)                       ;; bg inside bbox not 8-reachable from its border
      (let* ((b (m-bbox m)) (r1 (first b)) (c1 (second b)) (r2 (third b)) (c2 (fourth b))
             (own (list->set (m-cells m)))
             (inb? (lambda (p) (and (<= r1 (first p) r2) (<= c1 (second p) c2))))
             (seed (filter (lambda (p) (not (set-member? own p)))
                           (for*/list ((y (range r1 (+ r2 1))) (x (range c1 (+ c2 1)))
                                       #:when (or (= y r1) (= y r2) (= x c1) (= x c2)))
                             (list y x)))))
        (let loop ((frontier seed) (vis (list->set seed)))
          (if (null? frontier)
              (for*/list ((y (range r1 (+ r2 1))) (x (range c1 (+ c2 1)))
                          #:when (and (not (set-member? own (list y x)))
                                      (not (set-member? vis (list y x)))))
                (list y x))
              (let* ((p (first frontier))
                     (nbrs (filter (lambda (q) (and (inb? q) (not (set-member? own q))
                                                    (not (set-member? vis q))))
                                   (for*/list ((dy '(-1 0 1)) (dx '(-1 0 1))
                                               #:when (not (and (zero? dy) (zero? dx))))
                                     (list (+ (first p) dy) (+ (second p) dx))))))
                (loop (append (rest frontier) nbrs)
                      (for/fold ((v vis)) ((q nbrs)) (set-add v q))))))))
    (define (stamp-cells m)                      ;; enclosing motif -> only its hole-bounding loop
      (let* ((holes (hole-cells m)))
        (if (null? holes) (m-cells m)
            (filter (lambda (p) (findf (lambda (hh) (and (<= (abs (- (first p) (first hh))) 1)
                                                         (<= (abs (- (second p) (second hh))) 1)))
                                       holes))
                    (m-cells m)))))
    (define swapped
      (for/fold ((acc g)) ((m motifs))
        (let* ((tgt (core-target m)))
          (for/fold ((a2 acc)) ((p (m-cells m)))
            (set-cell a2 (first p) (second p)
                      (if (= (at g (first p) (second p)) (m-body m)) (m-core m) tgt))))))
    (for/fold ((acc swapped)) ((mk markers))
      (let* ((mr (first mk)) (mc (second mk)) (mcol (at g (first mk) (second mk))))
        (for/fold ((a2 acc)) ((m motifs))
          (if (!= (m-core m) mcol) a2
              (let* ((b (m-bbox m))
                     (bh (+ 1 (- (third b) (first b)))) (bw (+ 1 (- (fourth b) (second b))))
                     (br (if (zero? mr) 0 (- h bh))) (bc (if (zero? mc) 0 (- w bw))))
                (for/fold ((a3 a2)) ((p (stamp-cells m)))
                  (set-cell a3 (+ br (- (first p) (first b)))
                            (+ bc (- (second p) (second b))) mcol))))))))))

(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))

             (define marker-colors
               (remove-duplicates (map (lambda (p) (at g (first p) (second p)))
                                       marker-cells)))

               (count-if (lambda (p) (= (at g (first p) (second p)) col)) marker-cells))
             (define center-color
               (find-first (lambda (col) (= (color-count col) 1)) marker-colors))
             (define arm-color
               (find-first (lambda (col) (!= col center-color)) marker-colors))

               (for/or ((e seen)) (and (= (first e) r) (= (second e) c))))

               (let loop
                    ((frontier (list (list (first start) (second start) 0))) (seen (list (list (first start) (second start) 0))))
                    (if (empty? frontier)
                        seen
                        (let* ((e (first frontier))
                               (r (first e))
                               (c (second e))
                               (d (third e))
                               (new (filter identity
                                            (map (lambda (delta)
                                                   (let ((nr (+ r (first delta)))
                                                         (nc (+ c (second delta))))
                                                     (and
                                                       (and

(rule! (lambda (g)
         (define objs (objects g 0))
         (define comps
           (map (lambda (o)
                  (let* ((cells (obj-cells o))
                         (color (at g (first (first cells)) (second (first cells)))))
                    (list color cells)))
                objs))
         (define (normalize cells)
           (let* ((bb (bbox-of-cells cells))
                  (mr (first bb))
                  (mc (second bb)))
             (sort-by (map (lambda (p) (list (- (first p) mr) (- (second p) mc))) cells)
                      (lambda (p) (+ (* (first p) 100) (second p))))))
         (define (vflip cells)
           (map (lambda (p) (list (- 0 (first p)) (second p))) cells))
         (define (add-unique lst item)
           (if (any? (lambda (x) (= x item)) lst) lst (cons item lst)))
         (define (orientations cells allow-rot allow-refl)
           (define result (list (normalize cells)))
           (if allow-rot
               (reverse (let loop
                             ((cur cells) (i 0) (acc result))
                             (if (>= i 3)
                                 acc
                                 (let ((next (rotate-cells-cw cur)))
                                   (loop next (+ i 1) (add-unique acc (normalize next)))))))
               result))
         (define OUT-H 3)
         (define OUT-W 4)
         (define (try-solve allow-rot allow-refl)
           (define comp-or
             (sort-by (map (lambda (c)
                             (let* ((color (first c))
                                    (cells (second c))
                                    (oris (orientations cells allow-rot allow-refl))
                                    (oris-with-refl (if allow-refl
                                                        (let loop
                                                             ((cur (vflip cells)) (i 0)
                                                               (acc oris))
                                                             (if (>= i 4)
                                                                 acc
                                                                 (loop (rotate-cells-cw cur)
                                                                       (+ i 1)

written_solution: Connect rectangles via MST: corridors with walls at extremes of bbox interior overlap, holes in facing walls
program_solution:
(rule!
 ;; Hollow rooms get joined by corridors. Every horizontally/vertically
 ;; facing room pair with an unobstructed gap is a candidate edge
 ;; (cost = gap width, corridor spanning the shared interior rows/
 ;; cols); Kruskal's MST keeps the cheapest set that connects all
 ;; rooms. Each kept corridor draws its two green(3) side walls across
 ;; the gap and knocks door holes through both facing room walls.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define boxes (map obj-bbox (objects g 0)))
     (define n (length boxes))
     (define (box i) (nth boxes i))
     (define (r1 b) (nth b 0))
     (define (c1 b) (nth b 1))
     (define (r2 b) (nth b 2))
     (define (c2 b) (nth b 3))
     (define (edge-h i j)  ;; i strictly left of j, corridor unblocked
       (let ((bi (box i)) (bj (box j)))
         (and (< (c2 bi) (c1 bj))
              (let ((lo (max (+ (r1 bi) 1) (+ (r1 bj) 1)))
                    (hi (min (- (r2 bi) 1) (- (r2 bj) 1))))
                (and (<= lo hi)
                     (not (any? (lambda (k)
                                  (and (not (= k i)) (not (= k j))
                                       (>= (c2 (box k)) (+ (c2 bi) 1))
                                       (<= (c1 (box k)) (- (c1 bj) 1))
                                       (<= (max (+ (r1 (box k)) 1) lo)
                                           (min (- (r2 (box k)) 1) hi))))
                                (range 0 n)))
                     (list (- (c1 bj) (c2 bi) 1) i j 'h lo hi))))))
     (define (edge-v i j)  ;; i strictly above j
       (let ((bi (box i)) (bj (box j)))
         (and (< (r2 bi) (r1 bj))
              (let ((lo (max (+ (c1 bi) 1) (+ (c1 bj) 1)))
                    (hi (min (- (c2 bi) 1) (- (c2 bj) 1))))
                (and (<= lo hi)
                     (not (any? (lambda (k)
                                  (and (not (= k i)) (not (= k j))
                                       (>= (r2 (box k)) (+ (r2 bi) 1))
                                       (<= (r1 (box k)) (- (r1 bj) 1))
                                       (<= (max (+ (c1 (box k)) 1) lo)
                                           (min (- (c2 (box k)) 1) hi))))
                                (range 0 n)))
                     (list (- (r1 bj) (r2 bi) 1) i j 'v lo hi))))))
     (define edges  ;; (gap i j dir lo hi), cheapest first
       (sort-by (filter (lambda (e) e)
                        (flatmap (lambda (i)
                                   (flatmap (lambda (j)
                                              (if (= i j)
                                                  (list)
                                                  (list (edge-h i j)
                                                        (edge-v i j))))
                                            (range 0 n)))
                                 (range 0 n)))
                first))
     (define mst  ;; Kruskal over list components
       (let loop ((comps (map (lambda (i) (list i)) (range 0 n)))
                  (eds edges) (acc (list)))
         (if (null? eds)
             (reverse acc)
             (let* ((e (first eds))
                    (find-comp (lambda (x)
                                 (find (lambda (c) (member? x c)) comps)))
                    (ci (find-comp (second e)))
                    (cj (find-comp (third e))))
               (if (equal? ci cj)
                   (loop comps (rest eds) acc)
                   (loop (cons (append ci cj)
                               (filter (lambda (c)
                                         (and (not (equal? c ci))
                                              (not (equal? c cj))))
                                       comps))
                         (rest eds) (cons e acc)))))))
     (define (corridor out e)
       (let ((bi (box (second e))) (bj (box (third e)))
             (lo (fifth e)) (hi (nth e 5)))
         (if (eq? (fourth e) 'h)
             (let ((gc1 (+ (c2 bi) 1)) (gc2 (- (c1 bj) 1)))
               (paint-cells
                (paint-cells (paint-cells out
                                          (positions-in-rect lo gc1 lo gc2)
                                          3)
                             (positions-in-rect hi gc1 hi gc2) 3)
                (append (positions-in-rect (+ lo 1) (c2 bi)
                                           (- hi 1) (c2 bi))
                        (positions-in-rect (+ lo 1) (c1 bj)
                                           (- hi 1) (c1 bj)))
                0))
             (let ((gr1 (+ (r2 bi) 1)) (gr2 (- (r1 bj) 1)))
               (paint-cells
                (paint-cells (paint-cells out
                                          (positions-in-rect gr1 lo gr2 lo)
                                          3)
                             (positions-in-rect gr1 hi gr2 hi) 3)
                (append (positions-in-rect (r2 bi) (+ lo 1)
                                           (r2 bi) (- hi 1))
                        (positions-in-rect (r1 bj) (+ lo 1)
                                           (r1 bj) (- hi 1)))
                0)))))
     (reduce corridor g mst))))

                                      (let ((c1 (first box))
                                            (c2 (second box)))

                                                 (range 1 (- h 1)))))
                                    box-ranges))

written_solution: corner-anchored shapes (bbox touching a grid corner) rotate clockwise: TL->TR, TR->BR, BR->BL, BL->TL; insert at translated positions
program_solution:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((bg (mode g 0))
                  (comps (objects g bg))
                  (corner-shapes (filter (lambda (x) x)
                                         (map (lambda (o)
                                                (with-bbox o
                                                           (r1 c1 r2 c2)
                                                           (let* ((corner (cond
                                                                            ((and
                                                                               (zero? r1)
                                                                               (zero? c1)) 'tl)
                                                                            ((and
                                                                               (zero? r1)
                                                                               (= c2
                                                                                  (- w
                                                                                     1))) 'tr)
                                                                            ((and
                                                                               (= r2
                                                                                  (- h
                                                                                     1))
                                                                               (= c2
                                                                                  (- w
                                                                                     1))) 'br)
                                                                            ((and
                                                                               (= r2
                                                                                  (- h
                                                                                     1))
                                                                               (zero? c1)) 'bl)
                                                                            (else #f))))
                                                             (cond
                                                               (corner (list corner o))
                                                               (else #f)))))
                                              comps)))
                  (new-cells (apply append
                                    (map (lambda (cs)
                                           (let* ((corner (first cs))
                                                  (o (second cs))
                                                  (cells (obj-cells o))
                                                  (col (obj-color o)))
                                             (with-bbox o
                                                        (r1 c1 r2 c2)
                                                        (let* ((dr (cond
                                                                     ((eq? corner 'tl) 0)
                                                                     ((eq? corner 'tr) (- h 1 r2))
                                                                     ((eq? corner 'br) 0)
                                                                     ((eq? corner 'bl) (- 0 r1))))
                                                               (dc (cond
                                                                     ((eq? corner 'tl) (- w 1 c2))
                                                                     ((eq? corner 'tr) 0)
                                                                     ((eq? corner 'br) (- 0 c1))
                                                                     ((eq? corner 'bl) 0))))
                                                          (map (lambda (cell)
                                                                 (list (+ (first cell)
                                                                          dr)
                                                                       (+ (second cell)
                                                                          dc)
                                                                       col))
                                                               cells)))))
                                         corner-shapes))))
             (for/fold ((out g))
               ((nc new-cells))
               (let ((r (first nc))
                     (c (second nc))
                     (col (third nc)))
                 (cond
                   ((or (< r 0) (>= r h) (< c 0) (>= c w)) out)
                   (else (set-cell out r c col)))))))))

written_solution: draw line between two 2-markers: 0→2 (red(2)), 1→3 (green(3)) along the line
program_solution:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((twos (find-color g 2))
                  (p1 (first twos))
                  (p2 (second twos))
                  (r1 (first p1))
                  (c1 (second p1))
                  (r2 (first p2))
                  (c2 (second p2))
                  (dr (- r2 r1))
                  (dc (- c2 c1))
                  (steps (max (abs dr) (abs dc)))
                  (result (make-hash)))
             (for* ((r (range 0 h)) (c (range 0 w)))
                   (hash-set! result (list r c) (at g r c)))
             (for ((i (range 0 (+ steps 1))))
               (let* ((t (if (zero? steps) 0.0 (/ (+ 0.0 i) (+ 0.0 steps))))
                      (r (inexact->exact (round (+ r1 (* t dr)))))
                      (c (inexact->exact (round (+ c1 (* t dc))))))
                 (when
                   (and (>= r 0) (< r h) (>= c 0) (< c w))
                   (let ((v (at g r c)))
                     (cond
                       ((zero? v) (hash-set! result (list r c) 2))
                       ((= v 1) (hash-set! result (list r c) 3)))))))
             (cellmap g (r c v) (hash-ref result (list r c) 0))))))

                  (count-sig (lambda (obj)
                               (with-bbox obj

                                          (let* ((sh (+ 1 (- r2 r1)))
                                                 (sw (+ 1 (- c2 c1)))
                                                 (cells (obj-cells obj))
                                                 (mini (build-grid sh
                                                                   sw
                                                                   (rr cc)

                                                                                     (first cell))
                                                                                  (= (+ cc
                                                                                        c1)
                                                                                     (second cell))))
                                                                              cells)

                                                                       0)))
                                                 (bg-comps (objects mini 1))
                                                 (touches? (lambda (comp)
                                                             (ormap (lambda (cell)
                                                                      (let ((r (first cell))
                                                                            (c (second cell)))
                                                                        (or

                                                                          (zero? c)

                                                                    (obj-cells comp))))
                                                 (touching (filter touches? bg-comps))

                                                 (holes (- (length bg-comps) concs)))

                  (matching (filter (lambda (obj) (equal? (count-sig obj) red-sig))

written_solution: L-shaped border moves 1 cell inward; old L→bg, new L→border, old/new corners→8, new interior→8 with bg-color diagonal in min-square at corner adjacent to new L
program_solution:
(rule! (lambda (g)
  (let* ((h (rows g))
         (w (cols g)))
    (begin
      ;; Read the two input roles and the corner occupied by the outer L.
      (define bg (mode g))
      (define border (find (lambda (c) (!= c bg)) (grid-colors g)))
      (define top? (= (at g 0 (quotient w 2)) border))
      (define left? (= (at g (quotient h 2) 0) border))
      (define lc-r (if top? 0 (- h 1)))
      (define lc-c (if left? 0 (- w 1)))
      (define dr (if top? 1 -1))
      (define dc (if left? 1 -1))
      (define nlc-r (+ lc-r dr))
      (define nlc-c (+ lc-c dc))
      (define (range-inc a b)
        (if (<= a b) (range a (+ b 1)) (range b (+ a 1))))

      ;; Erase the old L, then draw its two arms one cell inward.
      (define s1 (cellmap g (r c v) bg))
      (define nlrow-cstart (+ lc-c (* 2 dc)))
      (define nlrow-cend (if (= dc 1) (- w 1) 0))
      (define nlrow-cells
        (map (lambda (c) (list nlc-r c))
             (range-inc nlrow-cstart nlrow-cend)))
      (define nlcol-rstart (+ lc-r (* 2 dr)))
      (define nlcol-rend (if (= dr 1) (- h 1) 0))
      (define nlcol-cells
        (map (lambda (r) (list r nlc-c))
             (range-inc nlcol-rstart nlcol-rend)))
      (define s2
        (recolor-cells s1 (append nlrow-cells nlcol-cells) border))

      ;; Fill the region beyond the inward L cyan, reserving both L corners.
      (define ni-rstart (+ nlc-r dr))
      (define ni-rend (if (= dr 1) (- h 1) 0))
      (define ni-cstart (+ nlc-c dc))
      (define ni-cend (if (= dc 1) (- w 1) 0))
      (define ni-cells
        (flatmap
          (lambda (r)
            (map (lambda (c) (list r c))
                 (range-inc ni-cstart ni-cend)))
          (range-inc ni-rstart ni-rend)))
      (define s3 (recolor-cells s2 ni-cells 8))
      (define s4 (set-cell s3 lc-r lc-c 8))
      (define s5 (set-cell s4 nlc-r nlc-c 8))

      ;; Restore a background-colored diagonal through the cyan rectangle.
      (define ni-h (+ 1 (abs (- ni-rend ni-rstart))))
      (define ni-w (+ 1 (abs (- ni-cend ni-cstart))))
      (define m (min ni-h ni-w))
      (define diag-cells
        (map (lambda (i)
               (list (+ ni-rstart (* i dr))
                     (+ ni-cstart (* i dc))))
             (range 0 m)))
      (recolor-cells s5 diag-cells bg)))))

written_solution: concentric ring colors cyclically shifted: each ring color C at index i in unique-rings → unique[(i-1) mod n]
program_solution:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (begin
             (define m (quotient (min h w) 2))
             (define ring-cols (map (lambda (i) (at g i i)) (range 0 (+ m 1))))
             (define unique-rings (remove-duplicates ring-cols))
             (define n (length unique-rings))
             (define (lookup-idx c lst)
               (let loop
                    ((i 0) (l lst))
                    (cond
                      ((null? l) -1)
                      ((= (first l) c) i)
                      (else (loop (+ i 1) (cdr l))))))
             (define (mapping c)
               (let ((idx (lookup-idx c unique-rings)))
                 (if (= idx -1) c (nth unique-rings (modulo (- idx 1) n)))))
             (cellmap g (r c v) (mapping v))))))

written_solution: red(2) pixels connected by green(3): find trunk pair (2 reds sharing row/column), draw green(3) between them, then perpendicular green(3) branches to remaining reds
program_solution:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((reds (for*/list ((r (range 0 h)) (c (range 0 w)) #:when (= (at g r c) 2))
                          (list r c)))
                  (pairs (for*/list ((i (range 0 (length reds))) (j (range (+ i 1) (length reds)))
                             #:when
                             (let ((a (list-ref reds i))
                                   (bb (list-ref reds j)))
                               (or (= (first a) (first bb)) (= (second a) (second bb)))))
                           (list (list-ref reds i) (list-ref reds j))))
                  (trunk-pair (first pairs))
                  (t1 (first trunk-pair))
                  (t2 (second trunk-pair))
                  (result (make-hash)))
             (for* ((r (range 0 h)) (c (range 0 w)))
                   (hash-set! result (list r c) (at g r c)))
             (if (= (second t1) (second t2))
                 (let ((tc (second t1))
                       (r1 (min (first t1) (first t2)))
                       (r2 (max (first t1) (first t2))))
                   (for ((r (range (+ r1 1) r2))) (hash-set! result (list r tc) 3))
                   (for ((red reds))
                     (when
                       (and (not (equal? red t1)) (not (equal? red t2)))
                       (let ((rr (first red))
                             (rc (second red)))
                         (if (< rc tc)
                             (for ((cc (range (+ rc 1) tc)))
                               (hash-set! result (list rr cc) 3))
                             (for ((cc (range (+ tc 1) rc)))
                               (hash-set! result (list rr cc) 3)))))))
                 (let ((tr (first t1))
                       (c1 (min (second t1) (second t2)))
                       (c2 (max (second t1) (second t2))))
                   (for ((cc (range (+ c1 1) c2))) (hash-set! result (list tr cc) 3))
                   (for ((red reds))
                     (when
                       (and (not (equal? red t1)) (not (equal? red t2)))
                       (let ((rr (first red))
                             (rc (second red)))
                         (if (< rr tr)
                             (for ((r (range (+ rr 1) tr)))
                               (hash-set! result (list r rc) 3))
                             (for ((r (range (+ tr 1) rr)))
                               (hash-set! result (list r rc) 3))))))))
             (cellmap g (r c v) (hash-ref result (list r c) 0))))))

written_solution: Copy the one non-empty separator tile into every tile slot
program_solution:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((rseps (map fst (full-rows g)))
                  (cseps (map fst (full-cols g))))
             (define (spans seps limit)
               (let loop
                    ((xs seps) (start 0) (acc (list)))
                    (if (empty? xs)
                        (reverse (if (< start limit)
                                     (cons (list start (- limit 1)) acc)
                                     acc))
                        (let ((sep (fst xs)))
                          (loop (cdr xs)
                                (+ sep 1)
                                (if (< start sep) (cons (list start (- sep 1)) acc) acc))))))
             (define rbands (spans rseps h))
             (define cbands (spans cseps w))
             (define blocks
               (flatmap (lambda (rb) (map (lambda (cb) (list rb cb)) cbands)) rbands))
             (define (block-cells block)
               (let* ((rb (fst block))
                      (cb (snd block))
                      (r0 (fst rb))
                      (r1 (snd rb))
                      (c0 (fst cb))
                      (c1 (snd cb)))
                 (flatmap (lambda (r) (map (lambda (c) (list r c)) (range c0 (+ c1 1))))
                          (range r0 (+ r1 1)))))
             (define (nonempty? block)
               (any? (lambda (p) (!= (at g (fst p) (snd p)) 0)) (block-cells block)))
             (let* ((src (fst (filter nonempty? blocks)))
                    (srb (fst src))
                    (scb (snd src))
                    (sr0 (fst srb))
                    (sc0 (fst scb))
                    (sh (+ 1 (- (snd srb) sr0)))
                    (sw (+ 1 (- (snd scb) sc0))))
               (reduce (lambda (acc block)
                         (let* ((rb (fst block))
                                (cb (snd block))
                                (r0 (fst rb))
                                (c0 (fst cb)))
                           (reduce (lambda (a p)
                                     (let* ((rr (fst p))
                                            (cc (snd p))
                                            (dr (- rr sr0))
                                            (dc (- cc sc0))
                                            (nr (+ r0 dr))
                                            (nc (+ c0 dc)))
                                       (if (and
                                             (<= dr (- sh 1))
                                             (<= dc (- sw 1))
                                             (in-bounds? nr nc h w))
                                           (set-cell a nr nc (at g rr cc))
                                           a)))
                                   acc
                                   (block-cells src))))
                       g
                       blocks))))))

(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((bg (mode g -1))
                  (sep-cols (for/list ((c (range 0 w)) #:when
                                (for/and ((r (range 0 h))) (= (at g r c) bg)))
                              c))
                  (sep-set (make-hash))
                  (dummy (for ((c sep-cols)) (hash-set! sep-set c #t)))
                  (regions (list))
                  (current (list))
                  (dummy2 (for ((c (range 0 w)))
                            (if (hash-has-key? sep-set c)
                                (begin
                                  (unless
                                    (null? current)
                                    (set! regions (append regions (list current))))
                                  (set! current (list)))
                                (set! current (append current (list c))))))
                  (dummy3 (unless
                            (null? current)
                            (set! regions (append regions (list current)))))

                                   (let ((colors (make-hash)))
                                     (for ((c reg))
                                       (for ((r (range 0 h)))
                                         (let ((v (at g r c)))
                                           (when (!= v bg) (hash-set! colors v #t)))))
                                     (car (hash-keys colors)))))
                  (n (length regions))
                  (result (make-hash)))

                   (hash-set! result (list r c) (at g r c)))
             (for ((i (range 0 n)))

                     (repl (list-ref region-colors (remainder (+ i 1) n))))

                   (for ((r (range 0 h)))
                     (when (= (at g r c) bg) (hash-set! result (list r c) repl))))))
             (cellmap g (r c v) (hash-ref result (list r c) 0))))))

written_solution: Swap roles: line endpoints become glyph stamps; glyph centers become line network nodes
program_solution:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (begin
             (define bg (mode g -1))
             (define objs (objects-8 g bg))
             (define (cell-in? cells r c) (member (list r c) cells))
             (define (neighbor-count cells p)
               (for/sum ((d all-8-deltas))
                 (if (cell-in? cells (+ (first p) (first d)) (+ (second p) (second d)))
                     1
                     0)))
             (define (line-endpoints obj)
               (let ((cells (obj-cells obj)))
                 (filter (lambda (p) (= (neighbor-count cells p) 1)) cells)))
             (define line-obj
               (find-first (lambda (obj)
                             (and
                               (> (obj-size obj) 1)
                               (= (length (line-endpoints obj)) 2)))
                           objs))
             (define line-color (obj-color line-obj))
             (define stamp-color
               (find-first (lambda (c) (!= c line-color)) (grid-colors g bg)))
             (define stamp-objs
               (filter (lambda (obj) (= (obj-color obj) stamp-color)) objs))
             (define stamp-cells (normalize-cells (obj-cells (first stamp-objs))))
             (define stamp-bb (bbox-of-cells stamp-cells))
             (define stamp-cr (quotient (+ (first stamp-bb) (third stamp-bb)) 2))
             (define stamp-cc (quotient (+ (second stamp-bb) (fourth stamp-bb)) 2))
             (define endpoints (line-endpoints line-obj))
             (define centers
               (map (lambda (obj)
                      (list (quotient (+ (obj-r1 obj) (obj-r2 obj)) 2)
                            (quotient (+ (obj-c1 obj) (obj-c2 obj)) 2)))
                    stamp-objs))
             (define network
               (for*/fold ((acc (empty-grid h w bg)))
                          ((i (range 0 (length centers))) (j (range (+ i 1) (length centers))))
                          (let ((a (list-ref centers i))
                                (b (list-ref centers j)))
                            (draw-line acc
                                       (first a)
                                       (second a)
                                       (first b)
                                       (second b)
                                       line-color))))
             (foldl (lambda (endpoint acc)
                      (foldl (lambda (p acc2)
                               (let ((nr (+ (first endpoint) (- (first p) stamp-cr)))
                                     (nc (+ (second endpoint) (- (second p) stamp-cc))))
                                 (if (and (>= nr 0) (< nr h) (>= nc 0) (< nc w))
                                     (set-cell acc2 nr nc stamp-color)
                                     acc2)))
                             acc
                             stamp-cells))
                    network
                    endpoints)))))

written_solution: grey shape compresses to a 1-wide line in track direction with same cell count, dividers move to enclose it
program_solution:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((grey-cells (find-color g 5))
                  (n (length grey-cells))
                  (div-rows (filter (lambda (r)
                                      (define vals
                                        (for/list ((c (range 0 w))) (at g r c)))
                                      (or
                                        (andmap (lambda (v) (or (= 5 v) (zero? v)))
                                                vals)
                                        (> (count-if (lambda (v) (zero? v)) vals)
                                           (quotient w 2))))
                                    (range 0 h)))
                  (div-cols (filter (lambda (c)
                                      (define vals
                                        (for/list ((r (range 0 h))) (at g r c)))
                                      (or
                                        (andmap (lambda (v) (or (= 5 v) (zero? v)))
                                                vals)
                                        (> (count-if (lambda (v) (zero? v)) vals)
                                           (quotient h 2))))
                                    (range 0 w)))
                  (cr (quotient (- h 1) 2))
                  (cc (quotient (- w 1) 2))
                  (vertical-track (>= (length div-cols) 2))
                  (base (cellmap g (r c v) 7)))
             (if vertical-track
                 (let* ((g1 (reduce (lambda (gr c)
                                      (reduce (lambda (g2 r) (set-cell g2 r c 0))
                                              gr
                                              (range 0 h)))
                                    base
                                    (list (- cc 1) (+ cc 1))))
                        (g2 (reduce (lambda (gr r)
                                      (reduce (lambda (g3 c) (set-cell g3 r c 0))
                                              gr
                                              (range 0 w)))
                                    g1
