written_solution: edge markers (1s) extend their aligned 4x4 hollow frame in their direction (up/down/left/right) by repeated frame copies until grid edge
program_solution:
(rule!
 ;; Hollow 4x4 frames sit on a blank field; blue(1) strips on the grid
 ;; edges are extension markers. Each marker points at the frame whose
 ;; span it overlaps: that frame repeats as a chain of 4x4 frames
 ;; marching to the marked edge (clipped at the border). Output the
 ;; frames plus their chains on a clean background.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define frames  ;; (color r1 c1 r2 c2) per hollow 4x4 (12 cells)
       (map (lambda (o) (list (obj-color o) (obj-r1 o) (obj-c1 o)
                              (obj-r2 o) (obj-c2 o)))
            (filter (lambda (o) (and (= (obj-h o) 4) (= (obj-w o) 4)
                                     (= (obj-size o) 12)))
                    (objects-multicolor g 0))))
     (define markers  ;; (dir rmin rmax cmin cmax) per blue strip
       (map (lambda (o)
              (list (cond ((zero? (obj-r1 o)) 'up)
                          ((= (obj-r2 o) (- h 1)) 'down)
                          ((zero? (obj-c1 o)) 'left)
                          ((= (obj-c2 o) (- w 1)) 'right)
                          (else 'unknown))
                    (obj-r1 o) (obj-r2 o) (obj-c1 o) (obj-c2 o)))
            (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) 1)) (objects g 0))))
     (define (draw-frame out color r1 c1 r2 c2)
       (for/fold ((acc out))
                 ((p (filter (lambda (rc) (or (= (first rc) r1)
                                              (= (first rc) r2)
                                              (= (second rc) c1)
                                              (= (second rc) c2)))
                             (positions-in-rect r1 c1 r2 c2))))
         (if (in-bounds? (first p) (second p) h w)
             (set-cell acc (first p) (second p) color)
             acc)))
     (define (overlap? lo1 hi1 lo2 hi2)
       (not (or (< hi2 lo1) (< hi1 lo2))))
     (define (frame-for m)
       (find (lambda (f)
               (cond ((member? (first m) (list 'up 'down))
                      (overlap? (fourth m) (fifth m)
                                (third f) (fifth f)))
                     ((member? (first m) (list 'left 'right))
                      (overlap? (second m) (third m)
                                (second f) (fourth f)))
                     (else #f)))
             frames))
     (define (extend out m)
       (let ((f (frame-for m)) (dir (first m)))
         (cond ((eq? dir 'up)
                (let loop ((r (second f)) (acc out))
                  (if (< (- r 1) 0)
                      acc
                      (loop (- r 4)
                            (draw-frame acc (first f) (- r 4) (third f)
                                        (- r 1) (fifth f))))))
               ((eq? dir 'down)
                (let loop ((r (fourth f)) (acc out))
                  (if (>= (+ r 1) h)
                      acc
                      (loop (+ r 4)
                            (draw-frame acc (first f) (+ r 1) (third f)
                                        (+ r 4) (fifth f))))))
               ((eq? dir 'left)
                (let loop ((c (third f)) (acc out))
                  (if (< (- c 1) 0)
                      acc
                      (loop (- c 4)
                            (draw-frame acc (first f) (second f) (- c 4)
                                        (fourth f) (- c 1))))))
               ((eq? dir 'right)
                (let loop ((c (fifth f)) (acc out))
                  (if (>= (+ c 1) w)
                      acc
                      (loop (+ c 4)
                            (draw-frame acc (first f) (second f) (+ c 1)
                                        (fourth f) (+ c 4))))))
               (else out))))
     (for/fold ((out (for/fold ((o (empty-grid h w 0)))
                               ((f frames))
                       (draw-frame o (first f) (second f) (third f)
                                   (fourth f) (fifth f)))))
               ((m markers))
       (extend out m)))))

written_solution: Each shape: if has thin tail (perp dim 1, len>=2), move main rect by tail length; else rectangularize to bbox. Moved shapes render on top.
program_solution:
(rule!
 ;; Each color = a solid BODY rectangle plus (maybe) a 1-wide TAIL
 ;; arrow. A straight solid tail of length 2+ launches its body: the
 ;; body jumps tail-length cells in the tail's direction and the tail
 ;; vanishes. A shape without such a tail settles as its filled
 ;; bounding box. Jumpers paint over settlers.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define (largest-rect-in cells)  ;; scan order = tiebreak, as before
       (let ((bb (bbox-of-cells cells)))
         (rest
          (for*/fold ((best (list 1 (first bb) (second bb)
                                  (first bb) (second bb))))
                     ((r1 (range (first bb) (+ (third bb) 1)))
                      (c1 (range (second bb) (+ (fourth bb) 1)))
                      (r2 (range (first bb) (+ (third bb) 1)))
                      (c2 (range (second bb) (+ (fourth bb) 1))))
            (if (and (>= r2 r1) (>= c2 c1)
                     (> (* (+ 1 (- r2 r1)) (+ 1 (- c2 c1)))
                        (first best))
                     (all? (lambda (p) (member p cells))
                           (positions-in-rect r1 c1 r2 c2)))
                (list (* (+ 1 (- r2 r1)) (+ 1 (- c2 c1))) r1 c1 r2 c2)
                best)))))
     (define (process c)  ;; -> (cells color moved?)
       (let* ((cells (find-color g c))
              (bb (bbox-of-cells cells))
              (body (largest-rect-in cells))
              (body-cells (positions-in-rect (first body) (second body)
                                             (third body) (fourth body)))
              (tail (filter (lambda (p) (not (member p body-cells)))
                            cells))
              (settled (list (positions-in-rect (first bb) (second bb)
                                                (third bb) (fourth bb))
                             c #f)))
         (if (null? tail)
             settled
             (let* ((tb (bbox-of-cells tail))
                    (th (+ 1 (- (third tb) (first tb))))
                    (tw (+ 1 (- (fourth tb) (second tb))))
                    (dir (cond ((> (first tb) (third body)) 'down)
                               ((< (third tb) (first body)) 'up)
                               ((> (second tb) (fourth body)) 'right)
                               ((< (fourth tb) (second body)) 'left)
                               (else 'none)))
                    (vert (member? dir (list 'down 'up)))
                    (tlen (if vert th tw)))
               (if (and (not (eq? dir 'none))
                        (= 1 (if vert tw th))
                        (= (length tail) (* th tw))
                        (>= tlen 2))
                   (let ((dr (cond ((eq? dir 'down) tlen)
                                   ((eq? dir 'up) (- 0 tlen))
                                   (else 0)))
                         (dc (cond ((eq? dir 'right) tlen)
                                   ((eq? dir 'left) (- 0 tlen))
                                   (else 0))))
                     (list (map (lambda (p) (list (+ (first p) dr)
                                                  (+ (second p) dc)))
                               body-cells)
                           c #t))
                   settled)))))
     (define processed
       (map process (filter (lambda (c) (> c 0)) (grid-colors g))))
     (for/fold ((out (for/fold ((o (empty-grid h w 0)))
                               ((s (filter (lambda (p) (not (third p)))
                                           processed)))
                       (paint-cells o (first s) (second s)))))
               ((s (filter third processed)))
       (paint-cells out (first s) (second s))))))

written_solution: 8-columns extend down; 2-segments create walls: left wall at leftmost-1 if leftmost is on 8-column, right wall at rightmost+1 if any 8-column past leftmost; blocked 8-cols stop at 2-row
program_solution:
(rule!
 ;; Cyan(8) marks on the top row drop as pipes down the grid. A red(2)
 ;; bar row interrupts them: inside each red segment, every pipe keeps
 ;; the red cell it crosses and clears everything below it; walls rise
 ;; one column outside a pierced segment's ends, joined to the
 ;; outermost pipes by cap runs one row above the bar.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define eight-cols
       (filter (lambda (c) (= (at g 0 c) 8)) (range 0 w)))
     (define two-row
       (find-first (lambda (r) (any? (lambda (c) (= (at g r c) 2))
                                     (range 0 w)))
                   (range 0 h)))
     (define bar-row (- two-row 1))
     (define segments  ;; maximal red runs on the bar row: (start end)
       (let loop ((c 0) (acc (list)))
         (cond ((>= c w) (reverse acc))
               ((not (= (at g two-row c) 2)) (loop (+ c 1) acc))
               (else (let scan ((cc c))
                       (if (or (>= cc w) (not (= (at g two-row cc) 2)))
                           (loop cc (cons (list c (- cc 1)) acc))
                           (scan (+ cc 1))))))))
     (define (vline out c r0)  ;; cyan column from r0 to the floor
       (recolor-cells out (map (lambda (r) (list r c)) (range r0 h))
                      8))
     (define (do-segment out seg)
       (let* ((l2 (first seg)) (r2 (second seg))
              (seg8 (filter (lambda (c) (and (>= c l2) (<= c r2)))
                            eight-cols))
              (has-left (and (not (null? seg8))
                             (= (min-list seg8) l2)))
              (has-right (and (not (null? seg8))
                              (any? (lambda (c) (> c l2)) seg8)))
              (out1 (if has-left  ;; left wall + cap to first pipe
                        (recolor-cells
                         (vline out (- l2 1) bar-row)
                         (map (lambda (c) (list bar-row c))
                              (range (- l2 1) (+ (min-list seg8) 1)))
                         8)
                        out))
              (out2 (if has-right  ;; right wall + cap from last pipe
                        (recolor-cells
                         (vline out1 (+ r2 1) bar-row)
                         (map (lambda (c) (list bar-row c))
                              (range (max-list seg8) (+ r2 2)))
                         8)
                        out1))
              (out3 (for/fold ((o out2)) ((c seg8))  ;; pierce the bar
                      (recolor-cells (set-cell o two-row c 2)
                                     (map (lambda (r) (list r c))
                                          (range (+ two-row 1) h))
                                     0))))
         (for/fold ((o out3)) ((c (range l2 (+ r2 1))))
           (if (= (at g two-row c) 2)
               (set-cell o two-row c 2)
               o))))
     (for/fold ((out (for/fold ((o g)) ((c eight-cols))
                       (vline o c bar-row))))
               ((seg segments))
       (do-segment out seg)))))

                                                                (range r1 (+ r2 1)))))

                                                        border))

                                                               (and (!= v 0) (!= v col)))
                                                             values)))

                                   (h1 (+ 1 (- (nth bbox 1) (nth bbox 0))))
                                   (w1 (+ 1 (- (nth bbox 3) (nth bbox 2)))))

                                                                     (count-if (lambda (other)
                                                                                 (and

                                                                                            remaining)
                                                                                   (member? c
                                                                                            (interruption-set other))))
                                                                               remaining))

                  (period (if (null? valid-shifts) (list 1 1) (first valid-shifts)))
                  (pr (first period))

written_solution: Connect the 9 markers along the clean 8-corridor path farthest from 7 cells
program_solution:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (begin
             (define marks (find-color g 9))
             (if (< (length marks) 2)
                 g
                 (let* ((start (fst marks))
                        (goal (snd marks))
                        (dirs (list (list 0 1) (list 1 0) (list 0 -1) (list -1 0)))
                        (best-path #f)
                        (best-len 999)
                        (best-turns 999))
                   (define (adjacent-7? r c)
                     (for/or ((d dirs))
                             (let ((nr (+ r (fst d)))
                                   (nc (+ c (snd d))))
                               (and (in-bounds? nr nc h w) (= (at g nr nc) 7)))))
                   (define (allowed? r c)
                     (let ((v (at g r c)))
                       (and (or (= v 8) (= v 9)) (or (= v 9) (not (adjacent-7? r c))))))
                   (define (better? len turns)
                     (or (< len best-len) (and (= len best-len) (< turns best-turns))))
                   (define (dfs cur path prev-dir turns)
                     (let ((len (length path)))
                       (when
                         (and
                           (<= len best-len)
                           (or (< len best-len) (< turns best-turns)))
                         (if (equal? cur goal)
                             (when
                               (better? len turns)
                               (set! best-len len)
                               (set! best-turns turns)
                               (set! best-path path))
                             (for-each (lambda (d)
                                         (let* ((nr (+ (fst cur) (fst d)))
                                                (nc (+ (snd cur) (snd d)))
                                                (np (list nr nc)))
                                           (when
                                             (and
                                               (in-bounds? nr nc h w)
                                               (allowed? nr nc)
                                               (not (member np path)))
                                             (dfs np
                                                  (append path (list np))
                                                  d
                                                  (if (or
                                                        (not prev-dir)
                                                        (equal? prev-dir d))
                                                      turns
                                                      (+ turns 1))))))
                                       dirs)))))
                   (dfs start (list start) #f 0)
                   (if best-path (paint-cells g best-path 9) g)))))))

written_solution: Sort pixels by column, fill 3x3 output in snake/boustrophedon order
program_solution:
(rule!
  (lambda (g)
    (let* ((h (rows g))
           (w (cols g))
           ;; Keep each colored cell as an independent (row, column, color)
           ;; record, then order records by column and break ties by row.
           (cells
            (for*/list ((r (range 0 h))
                        (c (range 0 w))
                        #:when (!= (at g r c) 0))
              (list r c (at g r c))))
           (sorted-cells
            (sort cells
                  (lambda (a b)
                    (if (= (second a) (second b))
                        (< (first a) (first b))
                        (< (second a) (second b))))))
           (colors (map third sorted-cells)))
      ;; Pack the ordered colors into a 3x3 snake: even rows run left-to-right
      ;; and the middle row runs right-to-left; unused cells stay black.
      (build-grid 3 3 (r c)
        (let* ((idx
                (if (zero? (remainder r 2))
                    (+ (* r 3) c)
                    (+ (* r 3) (- 2 c)))))
          (if (< idx (length colors))
              (list-ref colors idx)
              0))))))

written_solution: Fill horizontal gaps, then at each gap/vertical column, fill cells above each anchor with its color
program_solution:
(rule!
 ;; Dashed horizontal lines fill solid across their span. Then every
 ;; special column — a dash GAP, or one holding a stray vertical mark —
 ;; floods vertically: each nonzero anchor in the column paints
 ;; everything above it (down to the previous anchor) in its color.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define h-lines  ;; (color row cols) where the color runs 2+ long
       (flatmap
        (lambda (r)
          (map (lambda (v)
                 (list v r (filter (lambda (c) (= (at g r c) v))
                                   (range 0 w))))
               (filter (lambda (v)
                         (let ((cols (filter (lambda (c)
                                               (= (at g r c) v))
                                             (range 0 w))))
                           (any? (lambda (i) (= (+ (nth cols i) 1)
                                                (nth cols (+ i 1))))
                                 (range 0 (- (length cols) 1)))))
                       (remove-duplicates
                        (filter (lambda (v) (> v 0)) (row g r))))))
        (range 0 h)))
     (define (in-h-line? r c)
       (any? (lambda (line) (and (= (second line) r)
                                 (member? c (third line))))
             h-lines))
     (define phase1  ;; dashes solidified (reverse order: leftmost wins)
       (for/fold ((out g)) ((line (reverse h-lines)))
         (paint-cells out
                      (positions-in-rect (second line)
                                         (min-list (third line))
                                         (second line)
                                         (max-list (third line)))
                      (first line))))
     (define gap-cols  ;; in-span columns each dash skipped
       (remove-duplicates
        (flatmap (lambda (line)
                   (filter (lambda (c) (not (member? c (third line))))
                           (range (min-list (third line))
                                  (+ (max-list (third line)) 1))))
                 h-lines)))
     (define stray-cols  ;; columns of nonzero cells outside all dashes
       (remove-duplicates
        (map second
             (filter (lambda (p)
                       (and (> (at g (first p) (second p)) 0)
                            (not (in-h-line? (first p) (second p)))))
                     (grid-positions g)))))
     (for/fold ((out phase1))
               ((col (remove-duplicates (append gap-cols stray-cols))))
       (let loop ((anchors (filter (lambda (rv) (> (second rv) 0))
                                   (map (lambda (r)
                                          (list r (at phase1 r col)))
                                        (range 0 h))))
                  (prev -1) (grid out))
         (if (null? anchors)
             grid
             (loop (rest anchors) (first (first anchors))
                   (paint-cells grid
                                (positions-in-rect
                                 (+ prev 1) col
                                 (- (first (first anchors)) 1) col)
                                (second (first anchors))))))))))

written_solution: 2-color pattern + indicator cells → 2×2 kaleidoscope with color mapping from indicator positions
program_solution:
(rule!
 ;; The largest solid non-background rectangle is the PATTERN, drawn in
 ;; a MAJOR and a MINOR color. It mirrors into a 2x2 arrangement:
 ;; flip-lr to the right, flip-ud below, both on the diagonal.
 ;; Indicator dots dropped outside the pattern tell each mirrored block
 ;; what color its major/minor roles become (a role with no indicator
 ;; vanishes). Rebuild all four blocks on a blank field.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define rect  ;; largest all-nonzero rectangle, scan order as tiebreak
       (rest (for*/fold ((best (list 0 0 0 0 0)))
                        ((r1 (range 0 h)) (r2 (range r1 h))
                         (c1 (range 0 w)) (c2 (range c1 w)))
               (if (and (> (* (+ 1 (- r2 r1)) (+ 1 (- c2 c1)))
                           (first best))
                        (all? (lambda (p) (> (at g (first p) (second p))
                                             0))
                              (positions-in-rect r1 c1 r2 c2)))
                   (list (* (+ 1 (- r2 r1)) (+ 1 (- c2 c1))) r1 c1 r2 c2)
                   best))))
     (define pr1 (first rect))
     (define pc1 (second rect))
     (define pr2 (third rect))
     (define pc2 (fourth rect))
     (define ph (+ 1 (- pr2 pr1)))
     (define pw (+ 1 (- pc2 pc1)))
     (define pat (subgrid g pr1 pc1 pr2 pc2))
     (define ranked
       (sort-by (map (lambda (c) (list c (length (find-color pat c))))
                     (filter (lambda (c) (> c 0)) (grid-colors pat)))
                (lambda (f) (- (second f)))))
     (define major (first (first ranked)))
     (define minor (first (second ranked)))
     (define (block-key r c)
       (+ (* 2 (if (< r (+ pr1 ph)) 0 1)) (if (< c (+ pc1 pw)) 0 1)))
     (define (pat-at r c)  ;; pattern value, mirrored per block; #f outside
       (let ((lr (if (< r (+ pr1 ph)) (- r pr1) (- r (+ pr1 ph))))
             (lc (if (< c (+ pc1 pw)) (- c pc1) (- c (+ pc1 pw)))))
         (and (>= lr 0) (< lr ph) (>= lc 0) (< lc pw)
              (at pat
                  (if (>= r (+ pr1 ph)) (- ph 1 lr) lr)
                  (if (>= c (+ pc1 pw)) (- pw 1 lc) lc)))))
     (define indicators  ;; (block-key role-value color) per outside dot
       (map (lambda (p)
              (list (block-key (first p) (second p))
                    (pat-at (first p) (second p))
                    (at g (first p) (second p))))
            (filter (lambda (p)
                      (and (> (at g (first p) (second p)) 0)
                           (not (and (>= (first p) pr1)
                                     (<= (first p) pr2)
                                     (>= (second p) pc1)
                                     (<= (second p) pc2)))))
                    (grid-positions g))))
     (define (mapped key role)
       (if (zero? key)
           role
           (let ((hit (find (lambda (i) (and (= (first i) key)
                                             (= (second i) role)))
                            indicators)))
             (if hit (third hit) 0))))
     (build-grid h w (r c)
                 (let ((pv (pat-at r c)))
                   (cond ((not pv) 0)
                         ((= pv major) (mapped (block-key r c) major))
                         ((= pv minor) (mapped (block-key r c) minor))
                         (else 0)))))))

written_solution: Each shape forms a path. Pack shapes left-to-right so each entry (leftmost cell) connects to previous shapes exit (other endpoint of path)
program_solution:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (begin
             (define objs (objects-multicolor g 0))
             (define (obj-leftmost-col o) (min-of second (obj-cells o)))
             (define sorted-objs (sort-by objs obj-leftmost-col))
             (define (cell-deg cells c)
               (count-if (lambda (o)
                           (or
                             (and
                               (= (first o) (first c))
                               (= (abs (- (second o) (second c))) 1))
                             (and
                               (= (second o) (second c))
                               (= (abs (- (first o) (first c))) 1))))
                         cells))
             (define (obj-info o)
               (let* ((cells (obj-cells o))
                      (sorted (sort-by cells
                                       (lambda (c) (+ (* 100 (second c)) (first c)))))
                      (leftmost (first sorted))
                      (color (at g (first leftmost) (second leftmost)))
                      (endpoints (filter (lambda (c) (= (cell-deg cells c) 1)) cells))
                      (other-end (find (lambda (c) (!= c leftmost)) endpoints))
                      (exit (if other-end other-end leftmost)))
                 (list cells leftmost exit color)))
             (define infos (map obj-info sorted-objs))
             (define (shift-cells cells dr dc)
               (map (lambda (c) (list (+ (first c) dr) (+ (second c) dc))) cells))
             (define (process is prev-exit acc)
               (if (null? is)
                   acc
                   (let* ((info (first is))
                          (cells (nth info 0))
                          (leftmost (nth info 1))
                          (exit (nth info 2))
                          (color (nth info 3))
                          (target-row (first prev-exit))
                          (target-col (+ (second prev-exit) 1))
                          (dr (- target-row (first leftmost)))
                          (dc (- target-col (second leftmost)))
                          (new-cells (shift-cells cells dr dc))
                          (new-exit (list (+ (first exit) dr) (+ (second exit) dc)))
                          (cells-with-color (map (lambda (c)
                                                   (list (first c) (second c) color))
                                                 new-cells)))
                     (process (cdr is) new-exit (append acc cells-with-color)))))
             (define first-info (first infos))
             (define first-cells (nth first-info 0))
             (define first-color (nth first-info 3))
             (define first-exit (nth first-info 2))
             (define first-with-color
               (map (lambda (c) (list (first c) (second c) first-color)) first-cells))
             (define all-cells (process (cdr infos) first-exit first-with-color))
             (define max-col (max-of second all-cells))
             (define out-w (+ max-col 1))
             (define empty-g (build-grid h out-w (r c) 0))
             (reduce (lambda (gg cell)
                       (set-cell gg (first cell) (second cell) (nth cell 2)))
                     empty-g
                     all-cells)))))

(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((all-vals (apply append g))
                (unique-vals (unique all-vals))
                (color-counts (map (lambda (v)
                                     (cons v (count-if (lambda (x) (= x v)) all-vals)))
                                   unique-vals))
                (sorted-colors (sort-by color-counts (lambda (p) (* -1 (snd p)))))
                (zone-colors (map fst
                                  (list (nth sorted-colors 0) (nth sorted-colors 1))))
                (cell-zone (lambda (r c)
                             (let ((v (at g r c)))
                               (if (member? v zone-colors)
                                   v
                                   (let* ((neighbor-positions (filter (lambda (p)
                                                                        (in-bounds? (fst p)
                                                                                    (snd p)
                                                                                    h
                                                                                    w))
                                                                      (list (cons (- r
                                                                                     1)
                                                                                  c)
                                                                            (cons (+ r
                                                                                     1)
                                                                                  c)
                                                                            (cons r
                                                                                  (- c
                                                                                     1))
                                                                            (cons r
                                                                                  (+ c
                                                                                     1)))))
                                          (neighbor-vals (filter (lambda (v2)
                                                                   (member? v2
                                                                            zone-colors))
                                                                 (map (lambda (p)
                                                                        (at g
                                                                            (fst p)
                                                                            (snd p)))
                                                                      neighbor-positions)))
                                          (counts-each (map (lambda (v2)
                                                              (cons v2
                                                                    (count-if (lambda (x)
                                                                                (= x v2))
                                                                              neighbor-vals)))
                                                            (unique neighbor-vals))))
                                     (if (null? counts-each)
                                         0
                                         (fst (pick-max counts-each snd))))))))
                (marker-cells (filter (lambda (p)
                                        (not (member? (at g (fst p) (snd p))
                                                      zone-colors)))
                                      (grid-positions g)))
                (marker-info (map (lambda (p)
                                    (list (fst p)
                                          (snd p)
                                          (at g (fst p) (snd p))
                                          (cell-zone (fst p) (snd p))))
                                  marker-cells))
                (zone-to-marker (lambda (zone)
                                  (let ((matches (filter (lambda (m) (= (nth m 3) zone))
                                                         marker-info)))
                                    (if (null? matches) 0 (nth (first matches) 2))))))
           (cellmap g
                    (r c v)
                    (let* ((on-diagonal (for/or ((m marker-info))
                                                (let ((mr (nth m 0))
                                                      (mc (nth m 1)))
                                                  (or
                                                    (= (- r c) (- mr mc))
                                                    (= (+ r c) (+ mr mc))))))
                           (zone (cell-zone r c)))
                      (if on-diagonal (zone-to-marker zone) v))))))

(rule! (lambda (g)

           (let* ((bg 7)
                  (zero-comps (filter (lambda (obj)
                                        (and
                                          (zero? (obj-color obj))
                                          (let* ((hh (+ 1 (- (obj-r2 obj) (obj-r1 obj))))
                                                 (ww (+ 1 (- (obj-c2 obj) (obj-c1 obj)))))
                                            (and (>= (max hh ww) 6) (<= (min hh ww) 3)))))
                                      (objects g bg))))
             (define (score-rect r1 c1 r2 c2)
               (for*/sum ((r (range r1 (+ r2 1))) (c (range c1 (+ c2 1))))
                         (let ((v (at g r c))) (if (and (!= v 0) (!= v bg)) 1 0))))
             (define (horizontal? obj)
               (>= (+ 1 (- (obj-c2 obj) (obj-c1 obj)))
                   (+ 1 (- (obj-r2 obj) (obj-r1 obj)))))
             (define (hdir obj)
               (let* ((r1 (obj-r1 obj))
                      (r2 (obj-r2 obj))
                      (c1 (obj-c1 obj))
                      (c2 (obj-c2 obj))
                      (left (score-rect r1 c1 r2 (+ c1 2)))
                      (right (score-rect r1 (- c2 2) r2 c2)))
                 (cond ((> left right) 0) ((> right left) 1) (else #f))))
             (define (vdir obj)
               (let* ((r1 (obj-r1 obj))
                      (r2 (obj-r2 obj))
                      (c1 (obj-c1 obj))
                      (c2 (obj-c2 obj))
                      (top (score-rect r1 c1 (+ r1 2) c2))
                      (bottom (score-rect (- r2 2) c1 r2 c2)))
                 (cond ((> top bottom) 0) ((> bottom top) 1) (else #f))))
             (define hfb
               (let ((dirs (filter (lambda (x) (not (eq? x #f)))
                                   (map hdir (filter horizontal? zero-comps)))))
                 (if (null? dirs) 0 (mode-list dirs))))
             (define vfb
               (let ((dirs (filter (lambda (x) (not (eq? x #f)))
                                   (map vdir
                                        (filter (lambda (obj) (not (horizontal? obj)))
                                                zero-comps)))))
                 (if (null? dirs) 0 (mode-list dirs))))
             (define (copy-block acc sr sc dr dc nr nc)
               (reduce (lambda (a p)
                         (let* ((rr (first p))
                                (cc (second p))
                                (tr (+ dr (- rr sr)))
                                (tc (+ dc (- cc sc))))
                           (set-cell a tr tc (at g rr cc))))
                       acc
                       (positions-in-rect sr sc (+ sr (- nr 1)) (+ sc (- nc 1)))))
             (define (process acc obj)
               (let* ((r1 (obj-r1 obj))
                      (c1 (obj-c1 obj))
                      (r2 (obj-r2 obj))
                      (c2 (obj-c2 obj))
                      (hh (+ 1 (- r2 r1)))
                      (ww (+ 1 (- c2 c1)))
                      (cleared (paint-cells acc (positions-in-rect r1 c1 r2 c2) bg)))
                 (if (horizontal? obj)
                     (let* ((d (let ((x (hdir obj))) (if (eq? x #f) hfb x)))
                            (src-c (if (zero? d) c1 (- c2 2)))
                            (dst-c (if (zero? d) (- c2 2) c1)))
                       (copy-block cleared r1 src-c r1 dst-c hh 3))
                     (let* ((d (let ((x (vdir obj))) (if (eq? x #f) vfb x)))
                            (src-r (if (zero? d) r1 (- r2 2)))
                            (dst-r (if (zero? d) (- r2 2) r1)))
                       (copy-block cleared src-r c1 dst-r c1 3 ww)))))
             (reduce process g zero-comps)))))

written_solution: draw lines from 3-square to axis-aligned colored pixels
program_solution:
(rule! (lambda (g)
  (let* ((h (rows g))
         (w (cols g))
         ;; Find the 3-square
         (threes (find-color g 3))
         ;; Top edge of the threes bbox
         (tr1 (apply min (map first threes)))
         ;; Left edge of the threes bbox
         (tc1 (apply min (map second threes)))
         ;; Bottom edge of the threes bbox
         (tr2 (apply max (map first threes)))
         ;; Right edge of the threes bbox
         (tc2 (apply max (map second threes)))
         ;; Find colored pixels (non-0, non-3)
         (pixels (for*/list ((r (range 0 h)) (c (range 0 w))
                             #:when (let ((v (cell-at g r c)))
                                      (and (not (= v 0)) (not (= v 3)))))
                   (list r c (cell-at g r c))))
         ;; Mutable lookup table for result
         (result (make-hash)))
    ;; Copy grid
    (for* ((r (range 0 h)) (c (range 0 w)))
      (hash-set! result (list r c) (cell-at g r c)))
    ;; For each pixel, check if axis-aligned with 3-square
    (for ((px pixels))
      (let ((pr (first px)) (pc (second px)) (pcolor (third px)))
        ;; Same row as top or bottom of square?
        (cond
          ;; Pixel on same row as square, to the right
          ((and (>= pr tr1) (<= pr tr2) (> pc tc2))
           (for ((c (range (+ tc2 1) pc)))
             (hash-set! result (list pr c) pcolor)))
          ;; To the left
          ((and (>= pr tr1) (<= pr tr2) (< pc tc1))
           (for ((c (range (+ pc 1) tc1)))
             (hash-set! result (list pr c) pcolor)))
          ;; Same col as square, below
          ((and (>= pc tc1) (<= pc tc2) (> pr tr2))
           (for ((r (range (+ tr2 1) pr)))
             (hash-set! result (list r pc) pcolor)))
          ;; Above
          ((and (>= pc tc1) (<= pc tc2) (< pr tr1))
           (for ((r (range (+ pr 1) tr1)))
             (hash-set! result (list r pc) pcolor))))))
    (grid-from-fn h w
      (lambda (r c)
        (hash-ref result (list r c) 0))))))

written_solution: use same-count singleton anchors to stamp multicolor templates onto partial fragments
program_solution:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (begin
             (define bg
               (mode-list (for*/list ((r (range 0 h)) (c (range 0 w))) (at g r c))))
             (define comps (objects-multicolor g bg))
             (define (cell-color p) (at g (first p) (second p)))
             (define (colors-of obj)
               (remove-duplicates (map cell-color (obj-cells obj))))
             (define singles (filter (lambda (o) (= (length (colors-of o)) 1)) comps))
             (define templates (filter (lambda (o) (> (length (colors-of o)) 1)) comps))
             (define (count-color cells color)
               (count-if (lambda (p) (= (cell-color p) color)) cells))
             (define (anchor-color? color cells)
               (let ((cnt (count-color cells color)))
                 (for/or ((o singles))
                         (and
                           (= (cell-color (first (obj-cells o))) color)
                           (= (obj-size o) cnt)))))
             (define (standalone-cells color cnt)
               (apply append
                      (cons (list)
                            (map obj-cells
                                 (filter (lambda (o)
                                           (and
                                             (= (cell-color (first (obj-cells o)))
                                                color)
                                             (= (obj-size o) cnt)))
                                         singles)))))
             (define (put gg r c v) (if (in-bounds? r c h w) (set-cell gg r c v) gg))
             (for/fold ((out g))
               ((tmpl templates))
               (define cells (obj-cells tmpl))
               (define colors (colors-of tmpl))
               (define anchor-colors
                 (filter (lambda (color) (anchor-color? color cells)) colors))
               (define (anchor? p) (member (cell-color p) anchor-colors))
               (define anchor-cells (filter anchor? cells))
               (define non-anchor-cells (filter (lambda (p) (not (anchor? p))) cells))
               (define stamped? #f)
               (define stamped
                 (for/fold ((gg out))
                   ((ac anchor-cells))
                   (define color (cell-color ac))
                   (define cnt (count-color cells color))
                   (for/fold ((gg2 gg))
                     ((target (standalone-cells color cnt)))
                     (define dr (- (first target) (first ac)))
                     (define dc (- (second target) (second ac)))
                     (define anchors-ok
                       (for/and ((ap anchor-cells))
                                (let ((nr (+ (first ap) dr))
                                      (nc (+ (second ap) dc)))
                                  (and
                                    (in-bounds? nr nc h w)
                                    (= (at g nr nc) (cell-color ap))))))
                     (define fills-bg
                       (for/or ((p non-anchor-cells))
                               (let ((nr (+ (first p) dr))
                                     (nc (+ (second p) dc)))
                                 (and (in-bounds? nr nc h w) (= (at g nr nc) bg)))))
                     (if (and anchors-ok fills-bg)
                         (begin
                           (set! stamped? #t)
                           (for/fold ((gg3 gg2))
                             ((p cells))
                             (put gg3 (+ (first p) dr) (+ (second p) dc) (cell-color p))))
                         gg2))))
               (if stamped?
                   (for/fold ((gg stamped))
                     ((p non-anchor-cells))
                     (if (= (count-color cells (cell-color p)) 1)
                         (put gg (first p) (second p) bg)
                         gg))
                   stamped))))))

(rule!
  ;; Motif GROUPS on a dominant background: cells cluster at chebyshev
  ;; distance <= 2; the LARGEST single-color cluster is the key group.
  ;; Output = its bbox interior (inset 2), keeping only the group color.
  (lambda (g)
    (let* ((bg (mode g -1))
           (cells (filter (lambda (p) (!= (at g (first p) (second p)) bg))
                          (grid-positions g)))
           (clusters
             (let loop ((remaining cells) (acc (list)))
               (if (null? remaining)
                   acc
                   (let grow ((queue (list (first remaining)))
                              (mine (list))
                              (far (rest remaining)))
                     (if (null? queue)
                         (loop far (cons mine acc))
                         (let* ((cur (first queue))
                                (near (filter (lambda (p)
                                                (and (<= (abs (- (first p) (first cur))) 2)
                                                     (<= (abs (- (second p) (second cur))) 2)))
                                              far))
                                (rest-far (filter (lambda (p) (not (member p near))) far)))
                           (grow (append (rest queue) near) (cons cur mine) rest-far)))))))
           (single-color
             (filter (lambda (cl)
                       (= 1 (length (unique (map (lambda (p) (at g (first p) (second p))) cl)))))
                     clusters))
           (target (pick-max single-color length))
           (color (at g (first (first target)) (second (first target))))
           (bb (bbox-of-cells target))
           (ir1 (+ (first bb) 2))
           (ic1 (+ (second bb) 2)))
      (build-grid (- (- (third bb) (first bb)) 3)
                  (- (- (fourth bb) (second bb)) 3)
                  (i j)
        (let ((v (at g (+ ir1 i) (+ ic1 j))))
          (if (= v color) color bg))))))

written_solution: restore checkerboard, detect frame outline + content shapes from disruptions, draw solid frame with content rects inside
program_solution:
(rule!
 ;; A checkerboard background is disturbed by a FRAME (the most common
 ;; off-pattern color) and loose content blocks. Restore the
 ;; checkerboard, redraw the frame outline empty, and re-shelve the
 ;; blocks inside it: stacked along the frame's long axis with 1-cell
 ;; gaps (the group centered), each block centered on the cross axis.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define bg-even (at g 0 0))
     (define bg-odd (at g 1 1))
     (define (expected r c)
       (if (and (= 1 (modulo r 2)) (= 1 (modulo c 2))) bg-odd bg-even))
     (define disruptions  ;; (r c v) cells breaking the checkerboard
       (fold-cells g (list)
                   (lambda (acc r c v)
                     (if (= v (expected r c))
                         acc
                         (append acc (list (list r c v)))))))
     (define (cells-of col)
       (filter (lambda (cell) (= (third cell) col)) disruptions))
     (define by-count  ;; disruption colors, most frequent first
       (sort-by (unique (map third disruptions))
                (lambda (col) (- 0 (length (cells-of col))))))
     (define frame-color (first by-count))
     (define fbb (bbox-of-cells (cells-of frame-color)))
     (define fr1 (first fbb)) (define fc1 (second fbb))
     (define fr2 (third fbb)) (define fc2 (fourth fbb))
     (define horizontal (>= (- fc2 fc1) (- fr2 fr1)))
     (define contents  ;; (color r1 c1 h w) in shelf order
       (sort-by (map (lambda (col)
                       (let ((bb (bbox-of-cells (cells-of col))))
                         (list col (first bb) (second bb)
                               (+ 1 (- (third bb) (first bb)))
                               (+ 1 (- (fourth bb) (second bb))))))
                     (rest by-count))
                (lambda (c) (nth c (if horizontal 2 1)))))
     (define base  ;; clean board + hollow frame
       (paint-cells (erase-cells (grid-from-fn h w expected)
                                 (positions-in-rect (+ fr1 1) (+ fc1 1)
                                                    (- fr2 1) (- fc2 1))
                                 bg-even)
                    (filter (lambda (p) (or (= (first p) fr1)
                                            (= (first p) fr2)
                                            (= (second p) fc1)
                                            (= (second p) fc2)))
                            (positions-in-rect fr1 fc1 fr2 fc2))
                    frame-color))
     (define ir1 (+ fr1 1))
     (define ic1 (+ fc1 1))
     (define ih (- fr2 fr1 1))
     (define iw (- fc2 fc1 1))
     (define start  ;; centered group start along the long axis
       (+ (if horizontal ic1 ir1)
          (quotient (- (if horizontal iw ih)
                       (+ (apply + (map (lambda (c)
                                          (nth c (if horizontal 4 3)))
                                        contents))
                          (- (length contents) 1)))
                    2)))
     (let loop ((cs contents) (cur start) (grid base))
       (if (null? cs)
           grid
           (let* ((blk (first cs))
                  (bh (nth blk 3))
                  (bw (nth blk 4))
                  (r0 (if horizontal (+ ir1 (quotient (- ih bh) 2)) cur))
                  (c0 (if horizontal cur (+ ic1 (quotient (- iw bw) 2)))))
             (loop (rest cs)
                   (+ cur (if horizontal bw bh) 1)
                   (paint-cells grid
                                (positions-in-rect r0 c0 (+ r0 bh -1)
                                                   (+ c0 bw -1))
                                (first blk)))))))))

(rule! (lambda (g)
  (let* ((h (rows g))
         (w (cols g))
         (all-objs (objects g 0))
         ;; Rectangles: multi-cell components
         (rects
          (for/list ((o all-objs)
                     #:when (> (length (obj-cells o)) 1))
            (let ((bb (obj-bbox o)))
              (list (obj-color o) (first bb) (second bb) (third bb) (fourth bb)))))
         ;; Singles: single-cell components, count by color
         (single-colors
          (for/list ((o all-objs)
                     #:when (= (length (obj-cells o)) 1))
            (obj-color o)))
         (color-counts
          (let loop ((cs single-colors) (acc (hash)))
            (cond
              ((null? cs) acc)
              (else
               (let ((c (car cs)))
                 (loop (cdr cs) (hash-set acc c (+ 1 (hash-ref acc c 0))))))))))
    ;; Start by removing all scattered pixels (but keep rect cells)
    (let* ((out1
            (for*/fold ((out g)) ((r (range 0 h)) (c (range 0 w)))
              (let ((v (cell-at g r c)))
                (cond
                  ((= v 0) out)
                  (else
                   ;; Check if this cell is inside any rect bbox of the same color
                   (let ((is-rect
                          (for/or ((rect rects))
                            (and (= (first rect) v)
                                 (>= r (second rect))
                                 (<= r (fourth rect))
                                 (>= c (third rect))
                                 (<= c (fifth rect))))))
                     (if is-rect out (set-cell out r c 0))))))))
           ;; Fill rectangles with checkerboard based on color counts
           (out2
            (for/fold ((out out1)) ((color (hash-keys color-counts)))
              (let ((count (hash-ref color-counts color)))
                ;; Find matching rect
                (let loop ((rs rects))
                  (cond
                    ((null? rs) out)
                    (else
                     (let* ((rect (car rs))
                            (r1 (second rect)) (c1 (third rect))
                            (r2 (fourth rect)) (c2 (fifth rect))
                            (rh (+ 1 (- r2 r1)))
                            (rw (+ 1 (- c2 c1)))
                            (ih (- rh 2))
                            (iw (- rw 2))
                            (n (* ih iw))
                            (half (quotient (+ n 1) 2)))
                       (cond
                         ((and (> ih 0) (> iw 0) (= half count))
                          (for*/fold ((gg out)) ((i (range 0 ih)) (j (range 0 iw))
                                                  #:when (= (modulo (+ i j) 2) 0))
                            (set-cell gg (+ r1 1 i) (+ c1 1 j) color)))
                         (else (loop (cdr rs))))))))))))
      out2))))

written_solution: each blue(1) picks chebyshev-nearest 2x2 square (scan-order tiebreak); if row/column aligned with that square, slides to be 4-connected
program_solution:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (begin
             (define all-pos
               (flatmap (lambda (r) (map (lambda (c) (list r c)) (range 0 (- w 1))))
                        (range 0 (- h 1))))
             (define squares
               (filter (lambda (rc)
                         (let ((r (first rc))
                               (c (second rc)))
                           (and
                             (= (at g r c) 2)
                             (= (at g (+ r 1) c) 2)
                             (= (at g r (+ c 1)) 2)
                             (= (at g (+ r 1) (+ c 1)) 2))))
                       all-pos))
             (define (cheby-dist br bc sr sc)
               (let ((dr (max 0 (max (- sr br) (- br (+ sr 1)))))
                     (dc (max 0 (max (- sc bc) (- bc (+ sc 1))))))
                 (max dr dc)))
             (define (nearest-sq br bc)
               (reduce (lambda (best sq)
                         (let ((d (cheby-dist br bc (first sq) (second sq))))
                           (if (< d (first best)) (list d sq) best)))
                       (let ((sq (first squares)))
                         (list (cheby-dist br bc (first sq) (second sq)) sq))
                       (cdr squares)))
             (define (target br bc)
               (let* ((nb (nearest-sq br bc))
                      (sq (second nb))
                      (sr (first sq))
                      (sc (second sq))
                      (row-aligned (and (>= br sr) (<= br (+ sr 1))))
                      (col-aligned (and (>= bc sc) (<= bc (+ sc 1)))))
                 (cond
                   (row-aligned (if (< bc sc) (list br (- sc 1)) (list br (+ sc 2))))
                   (col-aligned (if (< br sr) (list (- sr 1) bc) (list (+ sr 2) bc)))
                   (else (list br bc)))))
             (define blues (find-color g 1))
             (define cleared (recolor-cells g blues 0))
             (reduce (lambda (gg b)
                       (let ((t (target (first b) (second b))))
                         (set-cell gg (first t) (second t) 1)))
                     cleared
                     blues)))))

(rule! (lambda (g)

    (map (lambda (o)

           (let* ((cells (obj-cells o))
                  (rs (map first cells))
                  (rmin (apply min rs))
                  (rmax (apply max rs)))
             (list rmin rmax (obj-color o) cells)))
         objs))

  (define first-top (first (first sorted-info)))
  (define reversed-info (reverse sorted-info))

    (if (null? infos) gg
        (let* ((info (first infos))
               (orig-top (first info))
               (orig-bot (second info))
               ;; Bbox height (rows)
               (height (+ (- orig-bot orig-top) 1))
               (cells (nth info 3))

               (offset (- cur-row orig-top))

                              (set-cell g3 (+ (first c) offset) (second c) color))
                            gg cells)))
          (place gg2 (cdr infos) (+ cur-row height)))))
  (place base reversed-info first-top)))

program_solution:
(rule! (lambda (g)
  (define seed (first (positions-of g (lambda (v) (= v 3)))))
  (define sr (first seed))
  (define sc (second seed))
  ;; Fixed stencil: a 49-cell spiral from the seed plus a disconnected lower bar.
  (define rels
    (list (list -4 -4) (list -4 -2) (list -4 -1) (list -4 0) (list -4 1)
          (list -4 2) (list -4 3) (list -4 4) (list -3 -4) (list -3 -2)
          (list -3 4) (list -2 -4) (list -2 -2) (list -2 0) (list -2 1)
          (list -2 2) (list -2 4) (list -1 -4) (list -1 -2) (list -1 0)
          (list -1 2) (list -1 4) (list 0 -4) (list 0 -2) (list 0 0)
          (list 0 2) (list 0 4) (list 1 -4) (list 1 -2) (list 1 2)
          (list 1 4) (list 2 -4) (list 2 -2) (list 2 -1) (list 2 0)
          (list 2 1) (list 2 2) (list 2 4) (list 3 -4) (list 3 4)
          (list 4 -4) (list 4 -3) (list 4 -2) (list 4 -1) (list 4 0)
          (list 4 1) (list 4 2) (list 4 3) (list 4 4) (list 6 -5)
          (list 6 -4) (list 6 -3) (list 6 -2) (list 6 -1) (list 6 0)
          (list 6 1) (list 6 2) (list 6 3) (list 6 4) (list 6 5)))
  (define mask
    (filter (lambda (p)
      (and (in-bounds? (first p) (second p) (rows g) (cols g))
           (not (= (at g (first p) (second p)) 2))))
      (map (lambda (p) (list (+ sr (first p)) (+ sc (second p)))) rels)))
  ;; Any blocker anywhere switches to seed-connected mode. This intentionally
  ;; drops the disconnected lower bar even when every blocker lies off-stencil.
  (define has-blockers? (not (empty? (positions-of g (lambda (v) (= v 2))))))
  (define targets
    (if has-blockers?
        (connected-region g sr sc
          (lambda (r c v) (and (member (list r c) mask) (not (= v 2))))
          4)
        mask))
  ;; Paint only zero targets; the seed and blocker cells remain unchanged.
  (for/fold ([out g]) ([p targets])
    (if (= (at out (first p) (second p)) 0)
        (set-cell out (first p) (second p) 3)
        out))))

           (begin
             (define (in-b r c) (and (>= r 0) (< r h) (>= c 0) (< c w)))
             (define (is-dot? r c)
               (and
                 (= (at g r c) 1)
                 (not (or
                        (and (in-b (- r 1) c) (= (at g (- r 1) c) 1))
                        (and (in-b (+ r 1) c) (= (at g (+ r 1) c) 1))
                        (and (in-b r (- c 1)) (= (at g r (- c 1)) 1))
                        (and (in-b r (+ c 1)) (= (at g r (+ c 1)) 1))))))
             (define mask0 (cellmap g (r c v) (if (zero? v) 1 0)))
             (define room-objs (objects mask0 0))
             (define (nbrs8 r c)
               (filter (lambda (n) (in-b (first n) (second n)))
                       (list (list (- r 1) (- c 1))
                             (list (- r 1) c)
                             (list (- r 1) (+ c 1))
                             (list r (- c 1))
                             (list r (+ c 1))
                             (list (+ r 1) (- c 1))
                             (list (+ r 1) c)
                             (list (+ r 1) (+ c 1)))))
             (define (is-marker? rc)
               (let ((v (at g (first rc) (second rc)))) (and (!= v 0) (!= v 1))))
             (define (markers-of-room obj)
               (let* ((cells (obj-cells obj))
                      (all-borders (flatmap (lambda (rc) (nbrs8 (first rc) (second rc)))
                                            cells))
                      (marker-cells (filter is-marker? all-borders))
                      (unique-markers (remove-duplicates marker-cells)))
                 (map (lambda (b) (at g (first b) (second b))) unique-markers)))
             (define (majority lst)
               (if (null? lst)
                   1
                   (let* ((unique (remove-duplicates lst))
                          (counts (map (lambda (x)
                                         (list x (count-if (lambda (y) (= y x)) lst)))
                                       unique)))
                     (first (reduce (lambda (a b) (if (> (second b) (second a)) b a))
                                    (first counts)
                                    (cdr counts))))))
             (define room-colors
               (map (lambda (room) (list room (majority (markers-of-room room))))
                    room-objs))
             (define (room-color room)
               (second (find (lambda (rc) (= (first rc) room)) room-colors)))
             (define (find-room-for-dot r c)
               (let* ((nbs (filter (lambda (n)
                                     (and
                                       (in-b (first n) (second n))
                                       (zero? (at g (first n) (second n)))))
                                   (list (list (- r 1) c)
                                         (list (+ r 1) c)
                                         (list r (- c 1))
                                         (list r (+ c 1))))))
                 (if (null? nbs)
                     #f
                     (find (lambda (room)
                             (any? (lambda (cell) (= cell (first nbs)))
                                   (obj-cells room)))
                           room-objs))))
             (define dots
               (filter (lambda (rc) (is-dot? (first rc) (second rc)))
                       (flatmap (lambda (r) (map (lambda (c) (list r c)) (range 0 w)))
                                (range 0 h))))

                       (let ((room (find-room-for-dot (first dot) (second dot))))

         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((bg (mode g))
                  (zeros (find-color g 0))
                  (z-rs (map first zeros))
                  (z-cs (map second zeros))
                  (center-r (quotient (+ (min-list z-rs) (max-list z-rs)) 2))
                  (center-c (quotient (+ (min-list z-cs) (max-list z-cs)) 2))
                  (shape-rel (for/list ((z zeros))
                               (list (- (first z) center-r) (- (second z) center-c))))
                  (marker (for/first ((r (range 0 h)) #:when
                                       (for/first ((c (range 0 w)) #:when
                                                    (let ((v (at g r c)))
                                                      (and (!= v bg) (!= v 0))))
                                                  (list r c (at g r c))))
                                     (for/first ((c (range 0 w)) #:when
                                                  (let ((v (at g r c)))
                                                    (and (!= v bg) (!= v 0))))
                                                (list r c (at g r c)))))
                  (mr (first marker))
                  (mc (second marker))
                  (mcolor (third marker))
                  (dr (- mr center-r))
                  (dc (- mc center-c))
                  (sign-r (cond ((> dr 0) 1) ((< dr 0) -1) (else 0)))
                  (sign-c (cond ((> dc 0) 1) ((< dc 0) -1) (else 0)))
                  (manhattan (+ (abs dr) (abs dc)))
                  (step-mag (- manhattan 1))
                  (step-r (* step-mag sign-r))
                  (step-c (* step-mag sign-c))
                  (result (make-hash)))
             (for* ((r (range 0 h)) (c (range 0 w)))
                   (hash-set! result (list r c) (at g r c)))

                  ((k 1))

                         (any-in-bounds (for/or ((s shape-rel))
                                                (let ((sr (+ cr (first s)))

                                                    (>= sr 0)
                                                    (< sr h)

                            (and (>= sr 0) (< sr h) (>= sc 0) (< sc w))
                            (hash-set! result (list sr sc) mcolor))))
                      (loop (+ k 1)))))
             (cellmap g (r c v) (hash-ref result (list r c) bg))))))

(rule! (lambda (g)
  (let* ((h (rows g))
         (w (cols g))
         ;; Find all gray (5) connected components using objects
         (objs (objects (grid-from-fn h w (lambda (r c) (if (= (cell-at g r c) 5) 5 0))) 0))
         (result (make-hash)))
    ;; Copy grid
    (for* ((r (range 0 h)) (c (range 0 w)))
      (hash-set! result (list r c) (cell-at g r c)))
    ;; Process each gray rectangle
    (for ((obj objs))
      (let* ((cells (obj-cells obj))
             (rs (map first cells)) (cs (map second cells))
             (fr1 (apply min rs)) (fc1 (apply min cs))
             (fr2 (apply max rs)) (fc2 (apply max cs))
             (fh (+ 1 (- fr2 fr1)))
             (fw (+ 1 (- fc2 fc1)))
             (tl (cell-at g (- fr1 1) (- fc1 1)))
             (tr (cell-at g (- fr1 1) (+ fc2 1)))
             (bl (cell-at g (+ fr2 1) (- fc1 1)))
             (br (cell-at g (+ fr2 1) (+ fc2 1)))
             (mid-r (+ fr1 (quotient fh 2)))
             (mid-c (+ fc1 (quotient fw 2))))
        ;; Remove corner markers
        (hash-set! result (list (- fr1 1) (- fc1 1)) 0)
        (hash-set! result (list (- fr1 1) (+ fc2 1)) 0)
        (hash-set! result (list (+ fr2 1) (- fc1 1)) 0)
        (hash-set! result (list (+ fr2 1) (+ fc2 1)) 0)
        ;; Fill quadrants
        (for* ((r (range fr1 (+ fr2 1))) (c (range fc1 (+ fc2 1))))
          (hash-set! result (list r c)
            (cond
              ((and (< r mid-r) (< c mid-c)) tl)
              ((and (< r mid-r) (>= c mid-c)) tr)
              ((and (>= r mid-r) (< c mid-c)) bl)
              (else br))))))
    (grid-from-fn h w
      (lambda (r c)
        (hash-ref result (list r c) 0))))))

written_solution: Assemble multicolor pieces by matching exposed marker ports of the same color
program_solution:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (define bg (mode g -1))
         (define objs
           (sort-by (objects-multicolor g bg)
                    (lambda (obj) (+ (* 1000 (obj-r1 obj)) (obj-c1 obj)))))
         (define comps (map (lambda (i) (list i (nth objs i))) (range 0 (length objs))))
         (define dirs (list (list -1 0) (list 1 0) (list 0 -1) (list 0 1)))
         (define (local-cells obj)
           (map (lambda (p)
                  (list (- (first p) (obj-r1 obj)) (- (second p) (obj-c1 obj))))
                (obj-cells obj)))
         (define (port-dir obj lr lc)
           (let ((cells (local-cells obj))
                 (oh (obj-h obj))
                 (ow (obj-w obj)))
             (let ((best (foldl (lambda (d current)
                                  (let* ((dr (first d))
                                         (dc (second d))
                                         (nr (+ lr dr))
                                         (nc (+ lc dc)))
                                    (if (member (list nr nc) cells)
                                        current
                                        (let ((score (+ (if (member (list (- lr dr)
                                                                          (- lc dc))
                                                                    cells)
                                                            10
                                                            0)
                                                        (if (and (= dr -1) (= lr 0))
                                                            5
                                                            0)
                                                        (if (and
                                                              (= dr 1)
                                                              (= lr (- oh 1)))
                                                            5
                                                            0)
                                                        (if (and (= dc -1) (= lc 0))
                                                            5
                                                            0)
                                                        (if (and
                                                              (= dc 1)
                                                              (= lc (- ow 1)))
                                                            5
                                                            0))))
                                          (if (> score (first current))
                                              (list score dr dc)
                                              current)))))
                                (list -1 0 0)
                                dirs)))
               (list (second best) (third best)))))
         (define markers
           (apply append
                  (map (lambda (comp)
                         (let* ((id (first comp))
                                (obj (second comp))
                                (r0 (obj-r1 obj))
                                (c0 (obj-c1 obj)))
                           (map (lambda (cell)
                                  (let* ((lr (- (first cell) r0))
                                         (lc (- (second cell) c0))
                                         (v (at g (first cell) (second cell)))
                                         (d (port-dir obj lr lc)))
                                    (list v id lr lc (first d) (second d))))
                                (filter (lambda (cell)
                                          (not (= (at g (first cell) (second cell)) 1)))
                                        (obj-cells obj)))))
                       comps)))
         (define edges
           (apply append
                  (map (lambda (color)
                         (let ((ps (filter (lambda (p) (= (first p) color)) markers)))
                           (if (= (length ps) 2)
                               (list (list color (first ps) (second ps)))
                               (list))))
                       (range 1 10))))
         (define (find-place placements id)
           (find-first (lambda (p) (= (first p) id)) placements))
         (define (try-place placements from to)
           (let ((from-place (find-place placements (second from)))
                 (to-place (find-place placements (second to))))
             (if (and from-place (not to-place))
                 (append placements
                         (list (list (second to)
                                     (+ (second from-place)
                                        (third from)
                                        (list-ref from 4)
                                        (- (third to)))
                                     (+ (third from-place)
                                        (fourth from)
                                        (list-ref from 5)
                                        (- (fourth to))))))
                 placements)))
         (define (apply-edge placements edge)
           (let ((a (second edge))
                 (b (third edge)))
             (try-place (try-place placements a b) b a)))
         (define seed-placements
           (if (empty? comps) (list) (list (list (first (first comps)) 0 0))))
         (define placements
           (foldl (lambda (step acc)
                    (foldl (lambda (edge inner) (apply-edge inner edge)) acc edges))
                  seed-placements
                  (range 0 (* 3 (max 1 (length comps))))))
         (define full-placements
           (foldl (lambda (comp acc)
                    (if (find-place acc (first comp))
                        acc
                        (append acc (list (list (first comp) 0 0)))))
                  placements
                  comps))
         (define placed-cells
           (apply append
                  (map (lambda (comp)
                         (let* ((id (first comp))
                                (obj (second comp))
                                (placement (find-place full-placements id))
                                (ro (second placement))
                                (co (third placement))
                                (r0 (obj-r1 obj))
                                (c0 (obj-c1 obj)))
                           (map (lambda (cell)
                                  (list (+ ro (- (first cell) r0))
                                        (+ co (- (second cell) c0))
                                        (at g (first cell) (second cell))))
                                (obj-cells obj))))
                       comps)))
         (define bb
           (bbox-of-cells (map (lambda (p) (list (first p) (second p))) placed-cells)))
         (define r1 (first bb))
         (define c1 (second bb))
         (define r2 (third bb))
         (define c2 (fourth bb))
         (define blank (empty-grid (+ 1 (- r2 r1)) (+ 1 (- c2 c1)) bg))
         (foldl (lambda (p acc)
                  (set-cell acc (- (first p) r1) (- (second p) c1) (third p)))
                blank
                placed-cells)))

                            (below (min-gt h-walls r))

                            (bot (if below (- below 2) r))
                            (g-leg (reduce (lambda (gg2 rr) (set-cell gg2 rr c 2))

                                           (range top (+ bot 1))))
                            (g-up (if above (draw-node g-leg above c) g-leg))
                            (g-dn (if below (draw-node g-up below c) g-up)))

                            (right (min-gt v-walls c))

                            (g-l (if left (draw-node g-leg r left) g-leg))
                            (g-r (if right (draw-node g-l r right) g-l)))

(rule! (lambda (g)

      (hash-set! result (list r c) bg))
    (for ((r (range 0 h)))
      (hash-set! result (list r 0) lw)
      (hash-set! result (list r (- w 1)) rw))
    (for ((wc-dir (list (list lw -1) (list rw 1))))
      (let ((wc (first wc-dir)) (dir (second wc-dir))
            ;; Mutable lookup table for visited
            (visited (make-hash))
            (all-objects (list)))
        (for* ((r (range 0 h)) (c (range 1 (- w 1))))
          (when (and (= (cell-at g r c) wc) (not (hash-has-key? visited (list r c))))
            (let ((cells (list))
                  (queue (list (list r c))))
              (let bfs ((q queue))
                (when (not (null? q))
                  (let ((cr (first (car q))) (cc (second (car q))))
                    (cond
                      ((or (hash-has-key? visited (list cr cc))
                           (< cr 0) (>= cr h) (< cc 1) (>= cc (- w 1))
                           (not (= (cell-at g cr cc) wc)))
                       (bfs (cdr q)))
                      (else
                       (hash-set! visited (list cr cc) #t)
                       (set! cells (cons (list cr cc) cells))
                       (bfs (append (cdr q)
                         (list (list (- cr 1) (- cc 1)) (list (- cr 1) cc) (list (- cr 1) (+ cc 1))
                               (list cr (- cc 1)) (list cr (+ cc 1))
                               (list (+ cr 1) (- cc 1)) (list (+ cr 1) cc) (list (+ cr 1) (+ cc 1))))))))))
              (set! all-objects (append all-objects (list cells))))))
        (set! all-objects
          (sort all-objects
            (lambda (a b)
              (if (= dir 1)
                  (> (apply max (map second a)) (apply max (map second b)))
                  (< (apply min (map second a)) (apply min (map second b)))))))
        (for ((obj all-objects))
          (let ((min-shift 999))
            (for ((cell obj))
              (let* ((r (first cell)) (c (second cell))
                     (shift 0))
                (if (= dir 1)
                    (let scan ((t c))

(rule! (lambda (g)

                                                      (cons v
                                                            (count-if (lambda (x)
                                                                        (= x v))
                                                                      vals)))
                                                    unique-vals)))
                                   (fst (pick-max freqs snd))))

                                    (or
                                      (zero? c)
                                      (!= (nth col-bg c) (nth col-bg (- c 1)))))
                                  (range 0 w)))

                               (if (< (+ i 1) n) (- (nth starts (+ i 1)) 1) (- w 1)))
                             (range 0 n)))
                  (widths (map (lambda (i) (+ 1 (- (nth ends i) (nth starts i))))
                               (range 0 n)))
                  (all-unique (= n (length (unique widths))))
                  (new-order (if all-unique
                                 (reverse (range 0 n))
                                 (append (map (lambda (i) (+ i 1)) (range 0 (- n 1)))
                                         (list 0)))))

                      (r c v)

                                                                        (nth lst

                                                                                1)))
                                                                    (nth widths
                                                                         (nth new-order
                                                                              i))))))
                                                 (list)
                                                 (range 0 n)))
                             (new-pos (find-first (lambda (i) (< c (nth cum-widths i)))

                             (prev-cum (if (zero? new-pos)

(rule! (lambda (g)
  ;; Each color has a solid 3x3 block in one corner (bg=6). Scattered same-color
  ;; cells slide onto the block: row-band cells slide horizontally, col-band cells
  ;; vertically, diagonal cells diagonally toward the corner, stopping adjacent to
  ;; the block edge (compositional slide, not a memorized patch table).
  (let* ((H (rows g)) (W (cols g)) (bg 6)
         (palette (filter (lambda (c) (not (= c bg))) (grid-colors g))))
    (foldl
      (lambda (col acc)
        (let* ((corners (list (list 0 0) (list 0 (- W 3)) (list (- H 3) 0) (list (- H 3) (- W 3))))
               (corner (findf
                         (lambda (rc)
                           (andmap (lambda (dr)
                                     (andmap (lambda (dc) (= (cell-at g (+ (first rc) dr) (+ (second rc) dc)) col)) (list 0 1 2)))
                                   (list 0 1 2)))
                         corners))
               (r0 (first corner)) (c0 (second corner))
               (hdir (if (= c0 0) -1 1))
               (vdir (if (= r0 0) -1 1))
               (inblock? (lambda (r c) (and (>= r r0) (<= r (+ r0 2)) (>= c c0) (<= c (+ c0 2)))))
               (scattered (filter (lambda (rc) (not (inblock? (first rc) (second rc)))) (find-color g col))))
          (foldl
            (lambda (rc a)
              (let* ((r (first rc)) (c (second rc))
                     (rowband (and (>= r r0) (<= r (+ r0 2))))
                     (colband (and (>= c c0) (<= c (+ c0 2))))
                     (dr (if colband vdir (if rowband 0 vdir)))
                     (dc (if rowband hdir (if colband 0 hdir))))
                (letrec ((slide (lambda (rr cc)
                                  (let ((nr (+ rr dr)) (nc (+ cc dc)))
                                    (if (or (< nr 0) (>= nr H) (< nc 0) (>= nc W) (inblock? nr nc))
                                        (list rr cc)
                                        (slide nr nc))))))
                  (let* ((dest (slide r c))
                         (a2 (set-cell a r c bg)))
                    (set-cell a2 (first dest) (second dest) col)))))
            acc scattered)))
      g palette))))
