(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((objs (objects g 0))
                  (rects (map (lambda (o)
                                (let ((bb (obj-bbox o)))
                                  (list (obj-color o)
                                        (first bb)
                                        (second bb)
                                        (third bb)
                                        (fourth bb))))
                              objs))
                  (n (length rects))
                  (bridges (for*/list ((i (range 0 n)) (j (range 0 n)) #:when (< i j))
                             (let* ((a (list-ref rects i))
                                    (b (list-ref rects j))
                                    (ac (first a))
                                    (bc (first b)))
                               (cond
                                 ((!= ac bc) #f)
                                 (else (let* ((ar1 (second a))
                                              (ac1 (third a))
                                              (ar2 (fourth a))
                                              (ac2 (fifth a))
                                              (br1 (second b))
                                              (bc1 (third b))
                                              (br2 (fourth b))
                                              (bc2 (fifth b))
                                              (ro-s (max ar1 br1))
                                              (ro-e (min ar2 br2))
                                              (co-s (max ac1 bc1))
                                              (co-e (min ac2 bc2))
                                              (row-ovlp (<= ro-s ro-e))
                                              (col-ovlp (<= co-s co-e)))
                                         (cond
                                           ((and
                                              row-ovlp
                                              (not col-ovlp)
                                              (= (+ ar1 ar2) (+ br1 br2))) (let ((gap-c1 (if (< ac2 bc1)
                                                               (+ ac2 1)
                                                               (+ bc2 1)))
                                                   (gap-c2 (if (< ac2 bc1)
                                                               (- bc1 1)
                                                               (- ac1 1)))
                                                   (br1x (+ ro-s 1))
                                                   (br2x (- ro-e 1)))
                                               (and
                                                 (and (<= br1x br2x) (<= gap-c1 gap-c2))
                                                 (list br1x gap-c1 br2x gap-c2 i j))))
                                           ((and
                                              col-ovlp
                                              (not row-ovlp)
                                              (= (+ ac1 ac2) (+ bc1 bc2))) (let ((gap-r1 (if (< ar2 br1)
                                                               (+ ar2 1)
                                                               (+ br2 1)))
                                                   (gap-r2 (if (< ar2 br1)
                                                               (- br1 1)
                                                               (- ar1 1)))
                                                   (bc1x (+ co-s 1))
                                                   (bc2x (- co-e 1)))
                                               (and
                                                 (and (<= bc1x bc2x) (<= gap-r1 gap-r2))
                                                 (list gap-r1 bc1x gap-r2 bc2x i j))))
                                           (else #f))))))))
                  (valid-bridges (filter (lambda (x) x) bridges))
                  (unblocked (filter (lambda (br)
                                       (let* ((r1x (first br))
                                              (c1x (second br))
                                              (r2x (third br))
                                              (c2x (fourth br))
                                              (bi (fifth br))
                                              (bj (sixth br))
                                              (color (first (list-ref rects bi))))
                                         (not (for/or ((k (range 0 n)))
                                                      (and
                                                        (!= k bi)
                                                        (!= k bj)

                                                               (or1 (second o))
                                                               (oc1 (third o))
                                                               (or2 (fourth o))
                                                               (oc2 (fifth o)))

                                                                (min or2 r2x))
                                                            (<= (max oc1 c1x)
                                                                (min oc2 c2x)))))))))
                                     valid-bridges)))
             (for/fold ((out g))
               ((br unblocked))
               (let ((r1x (first br))
                     (c1x (second br))
                     (r2x (third br))
                     (c2x (fourth br)))

written_solution: Two crossing lines with specials → woven 2D output rect with VS/HS row patterns based on closest vert spec
program_solution:
(rule!
 ;; Two marked lines cross. Each carries a BASE color plus SPECIAL
 ;; marks; the special marks bound the output rectangle. Weave a plaid
 ;; there on even/odd parity: special vertical rows band between the
 ;; nearest/farthest marks, and whichever line owns the intersection
 ;; cell decides which base dominates the fabric.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define horiz-row  ;; the fullest row / column = the two lines
       (pick-max (range 0 h)
                 (lambda (r) (count-if (lambda (c) (> (at g r c) 0))
                                       (range 0 w)))))
     (define vert-col
       (pick-max (range 0 w)
                 (lambda (c) (count-if (lambda (r) (> (at g r c) 0))
                                       (range 0 h)))))
     (define (line-colors vals)  ;; (base special)
       (let* ((base (pick-max (remove-duplicates vals)
                              (lambda (v) (count-if (lambda (x) (= x v))
                                                    vals))))
              (other (filter (lambda (v) (not (= v base))) vals)))
         (list base (if (empty? other) base (first other)))))
     (define horiz-vals
       (filter (lambda (v) (> v 0))
               (map (lambda (c) (if (= c vert-col) 0 (at g horiz-row c)))
                    (range 0 w))))
     (define vert-vals
       (filter (lambda (v) (> v 0))
               (map (lambda (r) (if (= r horiz-row) 0 (at g r vert-col)))
                    (range 0 h))))
     (define horiz-base (first (line-colors horiz-vals)))
     (define horiz-spec (second (line-colors horiz-vals)))
     (define vert-base (first (line-colors vert-vals)))
     (define vert-spec (second (line-colors vert-vals)))
     (define vert-spec-rows
       (filter (lambda (r) (and (not (= r horiz-row))
                                (= (at g r vert-col) vert-spec)))
               (range 0 h)))
     (define horiz-spec-cols
       (filter (lambda (c) (and (not (= c vert-col))
                                (= (at g horiz-row c) horiz-spec)))
               (range 0 w)))
     (define horiz-primary (= (at g horiz-row vert-col) horiz-base))
     (define min-row (min-list (cons horiz-row vert-spec-rows)))
     (define max-row (max-list (cons horiz-row vert-spec-rows)))
     (define min-col (min-list horiz-spec-cols))
     (define max-col (max-list horiz-spec-cols))
     (define near-vs
       (pick-min vert-spec-rows (lambda (r) (abs (- r horiz-row)))))
     (define far-vs
       (pick-max vert-spec-rows (lambda (r) (abs (- r horiz-row)))))
     (build-grid h w (r c)
                 (if (or (< r min-row) (> r max-row)
                         (< c min-col) (> c max-col))
                     0
                     (let ((warp-row (zero? (remainder (- r min-row) 2)))
                           (warp-col (zero? (remainder (- c min-col) 2))))
                       (if warp-row
                           (let ((in-band (and (>= r (min near-vs far-vs))
                                               (<= r (max near-vs
                                                          far-vs)))))
                             (if in-band
                                 (if warp-col
                                     vert-spec
                                     (if (and (= r near-vs) horiz-primary)
                                         horiz-base
                                         vert-base))
                                 (if warp-col horiz-spec vert-base)))
                           (if horiz-primary
                               horiz-base
                               (if warp-col horiz-base vert-base)))))))))

                                                       (list (list (- cr 1) cc)
                                                             (list (+ cr 1) cc)
                                                             (list cr (- cc 1))
                                                             (list cr (+ cc 1)))))))))))
                       (let* ((rs (map first cells))
                              (cs (map second cells))
                              (r1 (min-list rs))
                              (c1 (min-list cs))
                              (r2 (max-list rs))
                              (c2 (max-list cs))

                                               (+ 1 (- c2 c1))
                                               (rr cc)
                                               (at g (+ r1 rr) (+ c1 cc)))))
                         (set! obj-grids (cons sub obj-grids))))))

               (let find-dup
                    ((i 0))

                        (build-grid 1 1 (r c) 0)
                        (let ((gi (list-ref obj-grids i)))
                          (if (> (count-if (lambda (gj)
                                             (and

                                                              (else #f))) (check (+ rr 1)))
                                                      (else #f)))))
                                           obj-grids)

written_solution: Complete the partial periodic rectilinear spiral, then fill non-path cells with 5
program_solution:
(rule!
 ;; Concentric L-brackets of one color continue outward forever: detect
 ;; the ring PERIOD (spacing of long-run rows/cols), then either
 ;; replicate any full columns every period toward the open side, or
 ;; grow the longest horizontal run as ever-larger nested Ls in
 ;; whichever diagonal direction covers the most cells. Painted cells
 ;; keep the color; everything else turns gray(5).
 (lambda (g)
   (let ((unused 0))
     (define fg (find-first (lambda (v) (> v 0)) (grid-colors g -999)))
     (define (has? r c) (= (at g r c) fg))
     (define fg-cells (find-color g fg))
     (define (max-run line-len cell-at)  ;; longest fg run along a line
       (first (for/fold ((state (list 0 0))) ((i (range 0 line-len)))
                (if (cell-at i)
                    (list (max (first state) (+ (second state) 1))
                          (+ (second state) 1))
                    (list (first state) 0)))))
     (define sig-rows
       (filter (lambda (r) (>= (max-run w (lambda (c) (has? r c))) 3))
               (range 0 h)))
     (define sig-cols
       (filter (lambda (c) (>= (max-run h (lambda (r) (has? r c))) 3))
               (range 0 w)))
     (define (valid-diffs xs)  ;; consecutive gaps in 2..4
       (if (or (empty? xs) (empty? (rest xs)))
           (list)
           (let ((d (- (second xs) (first xs))))
             (append (if (and (>= d 2) (<= d 4)) (list d) (list))
                     (valid-diffs (rest xs))))))
     (define period
       (let ((diffs (append (valid-diffs sig-rows) (valid-diffs sig-cols))))
         (if (empty? diffs) 2 (mode-list diffs))))
     (define full-cols
       (filter (lambda (c) (all? (lambda (r) (has? r c)) (range 0 h)))
               (range 0 w)))
     (define (any-in-col? c)
       (and (>= c 0) (< c w) (any? (lambda (r) (has? r c)) (range 0 h))))
     (define (replicate-cols)  ;; full columns march off at the period
       (foldl (lambda (c acc)
                (let ((dir (cond ((and (any-in-col? (- c period))
                                       (< (+ c period) w))
                                  1)
                                 ((and (any-in-col? (+ c period))
                                       (>= (- c period) 0))
                                  -1)
                                 ((< (+ c period) w) 1)
                                 (else -1))))
                  (let loop ((a acc) (cc (+ c (* dir period))))
                    (if (and (>= cc 0) (< cc w))
                        (loop (append (for/list ((r (range 0 h)))
                                        (list r cc))
                                      a)
                              (+ cc (* dir period)))
                        a))))
              fg-cells
              full-cols))
     (define (row-runs r)  ;; maximal fg runs: (r start end len)
       (let loop ((c 0) (runs (list)))
         (cond ((>= c w) runs)
               ((not (has? r c)) (loop (+ c 1) runs))
               (else (let scan ((cc c))
                       (if (and (< (+ cc 1) w) (has? r (+ cc 1)))
                           (scan (+ cc 1))
                           (loop (+ cc 1)
                                 (cons (list r c cc (+ 1 (- cc c)))
                                       runs))))))))
     (define chosen-run  ;; longest run (ties: topmost, leftmost)
       (first (sort-by (filter (lambda (run) (>= (fourth run) 3))
                               (flatmap row-runs (range 0 h)))
                       (lambda (run) (- (+ (* 10000 (fourth run))
                                           (* 100 (first run))
                                           (second run)))))))
     (define (grow-Ls rs cs)  ;; nested Ls stepping (rs,cs) per period
       (let ((r0 (first chosen-run))
             (base (if (= cs 1) (third chosen-run) (second chosen-run))))
         (let loop ((k 1) (acc fg-cells))
           (let ((rr (+ r0 (* rs period k)))
                 (cc (+ base (* cs period k))))
             (cond ((or (< rr 0) (>= rr h)) acc)
                   ((and (>= cc 0) (< cc w))
                    (loop (+ k 1)
                          (append (for/list ((hc (if (= cs 1)
                                                     (range 0 (+ cc 1))
                                                     (range cc w))))
                                    (list rr hc))
                                  (for/list ((vr (if (= rs 1)
                                                     (range 0 (+ rr 1))
                                                     (range rr h))))
                                    (list vr cc))
                                  acc)))
                   (else (loop (+ k 1)
                               (append (for/list ((hc (range 0 w)))
                                         (list rr hc))
                                       acc))))))))
     (define complete-cells
       (if (empty? full-cols)
           (pick-max (for*/list ((rs (list -1 1)) (cs (list -1 1)))
                       (grow-Ls rs cs))
                     (lambda (cells) (length (remove-duplicates cells))))
           (replicate-cols)))
     (cellmap g (r c v)
              (if (member (list r c) complete-cells) fg 5)))))

(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((bg (mode g))
                  (colors (filter (lambda (x) (and (!= x bg) (!= x 8))) (grid-colors g))))
             (define (between a b) (range (min a b) (+ 1 (max a b))))
             (define (same-pos? a b)
               (and (= (first a) (first b)) (= (second a) (second b))))
             (define (hseg r c1 c2) (map (lambda (c) (list r c)) (between c1 c2)))
             (define (vseg c r1 r2) (map (lambda (r) (list r c)) (between r1 r2)))
             (define (valid-path? path color)
               (for/and ((p path))
                        (let ((v (at g (first p) (second p))))
                          (or (= v bg) (= v color)))))
             (define (has-row? out r c color)
               (for/or ((cc (range 0 w))) (and (!= cc c) (= (at out r cc) color))))
             (define (has-col? out r c color)
               (for/or ((rr (range 0 h))) (and (!= rr r) (= (at out rr c) color))))
             (define (path-for out a b color)
               (let* ((r1 (first a))
                      (c1 (second a))
                      (r2 (first b))
                      (c2 (second b))
                      (path-h (append (hseg r1 c1 c2) (vseg c2 r1 r2)))
                      (path-v (append (vseg c1 r1 r2) (hseg r2 c1 c2)))
                      (ok-h (valid-path? path-h color))
                      (ok-v (valid-path? path-v color))
                      (prefer-h (or
                                  (has-row? out r1 c1 color)
                                  (not (has-col? out r1 c1 color)))))
                 (cond
                   ((and prefer-h ok-h) path-h)
                   ((and (not prefer-h) ok-v) path-v)
                   (ok-h path-h)
                   (ok-v path-v)
                   (else (list)))))
             (define (candidate-key cand)
               (let* ((len (first cand))
                      (a (second cand))
                      (b (third cand)))
                 (+ (* len 1000000)
                    (* (first a) 10000)
                    (* (second a) 100)
                    (* (first b) 10)
                    (second b))))
             (define (paint-path out path color) (recolor-cells out path color))
             (define (connect-color out color)
               (let ((pts (find-color g color)))
                 (if (< (length pts) 2)
                     out
                     (let loop
                          ((tree (list (first pts))) (rem (rest pts)) (acc out))
                          (if (null? rem)
                              acc
                              (let* ((candidates (flatmap (lambda (a)
                                                            (map (lambda (b)
                                                                   (let ((p (path-for acc
                                                                                      a
                                                                                      b
                                                                                      color)))
                                                                     (list (if (null? p)
                                                                               999
                                                                               (length p))
                                                                           a
                                                                           b
                                                                           p)))
                                                                 rem))
                                                          tree))
                                     (best (first (sort-by candidates candidate-key)))
                                     (b (third best))
                                     (path (fourth best))
                                     (next (paint-path acc path color)))
                                (loop (cons b tree)
                                      (filter (lambda (p) (not (same-pos? p b))) rem)
                                      next)))))))
             (reduce (lambda (acc color) (connect-color acc color)) g colors)))))

(rule!
 ;; Background is blue(1). The most numerous color draws the complete
 ;; TEMPLATE shape; every other color is a fragment of it. Slide the
 ;; template (kept in bounds) until the fragment sits inside its
 ;; footprint, then fill the footprint's background cells with the
 ;; fragment's color — the whole color at once when possible, else
 ;; each 8-connected piece on its own.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define bg 1)
     (define present  ;; non-bg colors, first-appearance order
       (filter (lambda (v) (not (= v bg)))
               (remove-duplicates
                (map (lambda (p) (at g (first p) (second p)))
                     (grid-positions g)))))
     (define (cells-of color) (reverse (find-color g color)))
     (define tmpl-color
       (pick-max present (lambda (c) (length (cells-of c)))))
     (define tmpl-rel
       (let ((cells (cells-of tmpl-color)))
         (map (lambda (c) (list (- (first c) (min-of first cells))
                                (- (second c) (min-of second cells))))
              cells)))
     (define (placement-at cell t cells)
       ;; anchor template offset t on cell; ok if the whole fragment
       ;; lands inside the footprint and the footprint stays in bounds
       (let ((or2 (- (first cell) (first t)))
             (oc (- (second cell) (second t))))
         (and (all? (lambda (c2) (member (list (- (first c2) or2)
                                               (- (second c2) oc))
                                         tmpl-rel))
                    cells)
              (all? (lambda (t2) (in-bounds? (+ or2 (first t2))
                                             (+ oc (second t2)) h w))
                    tmpl-rel)
              (list or2 oc))))
     (define (find-origin cells)
       (find-first (lambda (x) x)
                   (for*/list ((cell cells) (t tmpl-rel))
                     (placement-at cell t cells))))
     (define (fill out origin color)
       (for/fold ((acc out)) ((t tmpl-rel))
         (let ((nr (+ (first origin) (first t)))
               (nc (+ (second origin) (second t))))
           (if (= (at acc nr nc) bg)
               (set-cell acc nr nc color)
               acc))))
     (for/fold ((out g))
               ((color (filter (lambda (c) (not (= c tmpl-color)))
                               present)))
       (let* ((cells (cells-of color))
              (origin (find-origin cells)))
         (if origin
             (fill out origin color)
             (for/fold ((o2 out))
                       ((comp (map obj-cells
                                   (objects-8 (paint-cells
                                               (empty-grid h w 0)
                                               cells 1)
                                              0))))
               (let ((co (find-origin comp)))
                 (if co (fill o2 co color) o2)))))))))

written_solution: Color key row 0; find most frequent interior color; draw outer border + inner bbox hollow rectangle in that color
program_solution:
(rule!
 ;; Keep the color key unchanged. Inside the old frame, the unique most-common
 ;; nonzero color other than the frame color selects both the replacement color
 ;; and the cells whose bounding box becomes the inner hollow rectangle.
 (lambda (g)
   (let* ((h (rows g))
          (w (cols g))
          ;; The uniform outer frame begins at row 1; row 0 is the preserved key.
          (bdr (at g 1 0))
          ;; Each entry is (row column color) for a non-background, non-frame
          ;; interior cell.
          (interior
           (for*/list ((r (range 2 (- h 1)))
                       (c (range 1 (- w 1)))
                       #:when (let ((v (at g r c)))
                                (and (!= v 0) (!= v bdr))))
             (list r c (at g r c))))
          (colors (unique (map third interior)))
          (counts
           (map (lambda (clr)
                  (list clr
                        (count-if (lambda (cell) (= (third cell) clr))
                                  interior)))
                colors))
          ;; The task grammar guarantees one strict frequency maximum.
          (winner (first (pick-max counts second)))
          (win-cells (filter (lambda (cell) (= (third cell) winner))
                             interior))
          (r1 (min-of first win-cells))
          (r2 (max-of first win-cells))
          (c1 (min-of second win-cells))
          (c2 (max-of second win-cells)))
     (cellmap g (r c v)
       (cond
         ;; Preserve the key row verbatim.
         ((zero? r) v)
         ;; Recolor the full old outer frame with the winner.
         ((or (= r 1) (= r (- h 1)) (zero? c) (= c (- w 1))) winner)
         ;; Draw the winner bounding box as a hollow rectangle.
         ((or (and (or (= r r1) (= r r2)) (>= c c1) (<= c c2))
              (and (or (= c c1) (= c c2)) (>= r r1) (<= r r2)))
          winner)
         ;; Drop every original interior cell not on that hollow rectangle.
         (else 0))))))

program_solution:
(rule!
  ;; Position of the first red(2) cell
  (let* ((red (first (find-color g 2)))
         ;; Position of the first blue(1) cell
         (blue (first (find-color g 1))))
    (define (dist-from start)
      ;; Mutable lookup table for dist
      (define dist (make-hash))
      (define queue (list (cons (first start) (second start))))
      (hash-set! dist (first queue) 0)
      (let bfs ([fuel 0])
        (unless (empty? queue)
          (let ((cur (first queue)))
            (set! queue (rest queue))
            (for ([d (in-list cardinal-deltas)])
              (let ((nr (+ (car cur) (first d)))
                    (nc (+ (cdr cur) (second d))))
                (when (and (in-bounds? nr nc (rows g) (cols g))
                           (not (hash-has-key? dist (cons nr nc)))
                           (member? (at g nr nc) (list 1 2 5)))
                  (hash-set! dist (cons nr nc) (+ (hash-ref dist cur) 1))
                  (set! queue (append queue (list (cons nr nc))))))))
          (bfs (+ fuel 1))))
      dist)
    (define red-dist (dist-from red))
    (define blue-dist (dist-from blue))
    (define path-len (hash-ref red-dist (cons (first blue) (second blue)) 999999))
    (define (path-cell? r c)
      (and (= (at g r c) 5)
           (= (+ (hash-ref red-dist (cons r c) 999999)
                 (hash-ref blue-dist (cons r c) 999999))
              path-len)))
    (define (side-region seed-distance)
      ;; Mutable lookup table for seen
      (define seen (make-hash))
      (define queue (list))
      (define direct-starts (list))
      (define fallback-starts (list))
      (for* ([r (in-range (rows g))] [c (in-range (cols g))])
        (when (and (= (at g r c) 5) (not (path-cell? r c)))
          (define touches-direct #f)
          (define touches-path-end #f)
          (for ([d (in-list cardinal-deltas)])
            (let ((nr (+ r (first d))) (nc (+ c (second d))))
              (when (and (in-bounds? nr nc (rows g) (cols g))
                         (= (hash-ref seed-distance (cons nr nc) 999999) 0))
                (set! touches-direct #t))
              (when (and (in-bounds? nr nc (rows g) (cols g))
                         (path-cell? nr nc)
                         (<= (hash-ref seed-distance (cons nr nc) 999999) 1))
                (set! touches-path-end #t))))
          (when touches-direct
            (set! direct-starts (cons (cons r c) direct-starts)))
          (when touches-path-end
            (set! fallback-starts (cons (cons r c) fallback-starts)))))
      (for ([start (in-list (if (empty? direct-starts) fallback-starts direct-starts))])
        (hash-set! seen start #t)
        (set! queue (append queue (list start))))
      (let bfs ([fuel 0])
        (unless (empty? queue)
          (let ((cur (first queue)))
            (set! queue (rest queue))
            (for ([d (in-list cardinal-deltas)])
              (let ((nr (+ (car cur) (first d)))
                    (nc (+ (cdr cur) (second d))))
                (when (and (in-bounds? nr nc (rows g) (cols g))
                           (= (at g nr nc) 5)
                           (not (path-cell? nr nc))
                           (not (hash-has-key? seen (cons nr nc))))
                  (hash-set! seen (cons nr nc) #t)
                  (set! queue (append queue (list (cons nr nc))))))))
          (bfs (+ fuel 1))))
      seen)
    (define red-side (side-region red-dist))
    (define blue-side (side-region blue-dist))
    (grid-from-fn (rows g) (cols g)
      (lambda (r c)
        (let ((v (at g r c)))
          (if (= v 5)
              (cond [(path-cell? r c) 4]
                    [(hash-has-key? red-side (cons r c)) 2]
                    [(hash-has-key? blue-side (cons r c)) 1]

(rule! (lambda (grid)
  (let* ((height (rows grid))
         (width (cols grid)))

      (cell-at grid row (- (- width 1) col)))
    (define (ud-mirror row col)
      (cell-at grid (- (- height 1) row) col))
    (define lr-mismatches
      (for/sum (row (range 0 height))
        (for/sum (col (range 0 width))
          (if (= (cell-at grid row col) (lr-mirror row col)) 0 1))))
    (define ud-mismatches
      (for/sum (row (range 0 height))
        (for/sum (col (range 0 width))
          (if (= (cell-at grid row col) (ud-mirror row col)) 0 1))))
    (define use-lr (not (> lr-mismatches ud-mismatches)))
    (grid-from-fn height width
      (lambda (row col)
        (let ((value (cell-at grid row col))
              (mirror (if use-lr (lr-mirror row col) (ud-mirror row col))))
          (if (and (= value 0) (!= mirror 0)) mirror value)))))))

 ;; Three control cells at the top-left spell (prototype-color,
 ;; transform-code, output-color). A cyan(8) wall frames the answer
 ;; area. Take the prototype shape — the largest blob of the prototype
 ;; color — transform it (1 id / 2 flip-lr / 3 flip-ud / 4 cw / 5 180 /
 ;; 6 ccw), recolor it, and stamp it centered inside the frame crop.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define proto-color (at g 0 0))
     (define code (at g 0 1))
     (define out-color (at g 0 2))
     (define controls (list (list 0 0) (list 0 1) (list 0 2)))
     (define wall-cells
       (flatmap obj-cells
                (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) 8))
                        (objects (erase-cells g controls 0) 0))))
     (define scene (erase-cells g (append controls wall-cells) 0))
     (define proto-cells  ;; largest 4-conn nonzero blob of proto color
       (pick-max
        (filter (lambda (cells)
                  (= (at g (first (first cells)) (second (first cells)))
                     proto-color))
                (map (lambda (o) (sort (obj-cells o) cell<))
                     (objects (cellmap scene (r c v)
                                       (if (zero? v) 0 1))
                              0)))
        length))
     (define proto  ;; its binary silhouette
       (let ((bb (bbox-of-cells proto-cells)))
         (paint-cells (empty-grid (+ 1 (- (third bb) (first bb)))
                                  (+ 1 (- (fourth bb) (second bb)))
                                  0)
                      (map (lambda (p) (list (- (first p) (first bb))
                                             (- (second p) (second bb))))
                           proto-cells)
                      1)))
     (define tile
       (cellmap (cond ((= code 2) (flip-lr proto))
                      ((= code 3) (flip-ud proto))
                      ((= code 4) (rotate-cw proto))
                      ((= code 5) (rotate-180 proto))
                      ((= code 6) (rotate-ccw proto))
                      (else proto))
                (r c v) (if (zero? v) 0 out-color)))
     (define frame-crop
       (let ((bb (bbox-of-cells wall-cells)))
         (subgrid g (first bb) (second bb) (third bb) (fourth bb))))
     (let ((top (quotient (- (rows frame-crop) (rows tile)) 2))
           (left (quotient (- (cols frame-crop) (cols tile)) 2)))
       (for*/fold ((out frame-crop)) ((r (range 0 (rows tile)))
                                      (c (range 0 (cols tile))))
         (let ((v (at tile r c)))
           (if (and (> v 0)
                    (in-bounds? (+ top r) (+ left c)
                                (rows out) (cols out)))
               (set-cell out (+ top r) (+ left c) v)
               out)))))))

title: Build the Transform × Recolor Gallery
written_solution: Crop the exemplar, treat the top row as transform codes and the left column as row colors, then build the full gallery of transformed and recolored copies with one background separator between panels.
program_solution:
(rule!
 ;; The top header row lists transform CODES and the left header column
 ;; lists COLORS; the body holds one prototype shape. Print the whole
 ;; gallery — a row per color, a column per code — each panel the
 ;; prototype transformed (1 id / 2 flip-lr / 3 flip-ud / 4 cw / 5 180
 ;; / 6 ccw) and recolored, with 1-cell gaps between panels.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define codes
       (map (lambda (c) (at g 0 c))
            (filter (lambda (c) (> (at g 0 c) 0)) (range 1 w))))
     (define colors
       (map (lambda (r) (at g r 0))
            (filter (lambda (r) (> (at g r 0) 0)) (range 1 h))))
     (define body  ;; the grid with both header lines blanked
       (cellmap g (r c v)
                (if (or (and (zero? r) (> c 0)) (and (zero? c) (> r 0)))
                    0 v)))
     (define proto  ;; largest 4-connected nonzero blob, as a 0/1 mask
       (let ((cells (normalize-cells
                     (obj-cells
                      (pick-max (objects (cellmap body (r c v)
                                                  (if (zero? v) 0 1))
                                         0)
                                obj-size)))))
         (paint-cells (empty-grid (+ 1 (max-of first cells))
                                  (+ 1 (max-of second cells))
                                  0)
                      cells 1)))
     (define (xform grid code)
       (cond ((= code 2) (flip-lr grid))
             ((= code 3) (flip-ud grid))
             ((= code 4) (rotate-cw grid))
             ((= code 5) (rotate-180 grid))
             ((= code 6) (rotate-ccw grid))
             (else grid)))
     (define panels
       (map (lambda (color)
              (map (lambda (code)
                     (cellmap (xform proto code) (r c v)
                              (if (zero? v) 0 color)))
                   codes))
            colors))
     (let ((ph (rows (first (first panels))))
           (pw (cols (first (first panels))))
           (nr (length panels))
           (nc (length (first panels))))
       (for*/fold ((out (empty-grid (+ (* nr ph) (max 0 (- nr 1)))
                                    (+ (* nc pw) (max 0 (- nc 1)))
                                    0)))
                  ((ri (range 0 nr)) (ci (range 0 nc)))
         (let ((panel (nth (nth panels ri) ci)))
           (for*/fold ((acc out)) ((r (range 0 (rows panel)))
                                   (c (range 0 (cols panel))))
             (let ((v (at panel r c))
                   (rr (+ (* ri (+ ph 1)) r))
                   (cc (+ (* ci (+ pw 1)) c)))
               (if (and (> v 0) (in-bounds? rr cc (rows acc) (cols acc)))
                   (set-cell acc rr cc v)
                   acc)))))))))

                     ;; exactly as the original brute scan found them

               (for*/list ((r0 (in-range 0 (- h 2)))
                           (c0 (in-range 0 (- w 2)))
                           (r1 (in-range (+ r0 2) h))

title: Command Strip Transform
written_solution: Crop the motif below the command row. For each nonzero command code in the top row, output the corresponding transformed motif and pack the results left to right with one background column between them.

  (let ((codes (filter (lambda (v) (member v (list 1 2 3 4))) (first g)))
        (motif (crop-to-content (subgrid g 1 0 (- (rows g) 1) (- (cols g) 1)))))
    (define (tf code)
      (cond [(= code 2) (rotate-cw motif)]
            [(= code 3) (rotate-180 motif)]
            [(= code 4) (flip-ud motif)]
            [else motif]))
    (define grids (map tf codes))
    (define out-h (apply max (map rows grids)))
    (define out-w (+ (apply + (map cols grids)) (max 0 (- (length grids) 1))))
    (let pack ([remaining grids] [left 0] [out (empty-grid out-h out-w 0)])
      (if (empty? remaining)
          out
          (let* ((grid (first remaining))
                 (next (for*/fold ([acc out])
                                   ([r (in-range (rows grid))]
                                    [c (in-range (cols grid))])
                         (let ((v (at grid r c)))
                           (if (not (= v 0)) (set-cell acc r (+ left c) v) acc)))))
            (pack (rest remaining) (+ left (cols grid) 1) next))))))

title: Fill Holes Only for the Selected Color
written_solution: Read the target color from the top-left selector. Fill enclosed holes only inside components of that color; leave all other colors unchanged.
program_solution:
(rule!
  (let* ((target (at g 0 0))
         (work (set-cell g 0 0 0)))
    (define (fill-one out obj)
      (let* ((bb (obj-bbox obj))
             (h (+ (- (third bb) (first bb)) 1))
             (w (+ (- (fourth bb) (second bb)) 1))
             (solid (make-hash))
             (visited (make-hash)))
        (for ([p (in-list (obj-cells obj))])
          (hash-set! solid (cons (- (first p) (first bb)) (- (second p) (second bb))) #t))
        (define queue (list))
        (for* ([r (in-range h)] [c (in-range w)])
          (when (and (or (= r 0) (= c 0) (= r (- h 1)) (= c (- w 1)))
                     (not (hash-has-key? solid (cons r c)))
                     (not (hash-has-key? visited (cons r c))))
            (hash-set! visited (cons r c) #t)
            (set! queue (append queue (list (list r c))))))
        (define (bfs)
          (unless (empty? queue)
            (define p (first queue))
            (set! queue (rest queue))
            (for ([d (in-list cardinal-deltas)])
              (define nr (+ (first p) (first d)))
              (define nc (+ (second p) (second d)))
              (when (and (in-bounds? nr nc h w)
                         (not (hash-has-key? solid (cons nr nc)))
                         (not (hash-has-key? visited (cons nr nc))))
                (hash-set! visited (cons nr nc) #t)
                (set! queue (append queue (list (list nr nc))))))
            (bfs)))
        (bfs)
        (for*/fold ([acc out])
                   ([r (in-range h)]
                    [c (in-range w)])
          (if (and (not (hash-has-key? solid (cons r c)))
                   (not (hash-has-key? visited (cons r c))))
              (set-cell acc (+ (first bb) r) (+ (second bb) c) target)
              acc))))
    (for/fold ([out work]) ([obj (in-list (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) target)) (objects work 0)))])
      (fill-one out obj))))

  (let* ((code (at g 0 0))
         (split (first (filter (lambda (c)
                                 (all? (lambda (r) (= (at g r c) 5)) (range 1 (rows g))))
                               (range 0 (cols g)))))
         (h (- (rows g) 1))

          (if hit 7 0))))))

(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (rect-border? obj)
      (let* ((bb (obj-bbox obj))
             (h (+ (- (third bb) (first bb)) 1))
             (w (+ (- (fourth bb) (second bb)) 1))

        (and (>= h 3) (>= w 3) (= (obj-size obj) border-size)
             (all? (lambda (p)
                     (or (= (first p) (first bb)) (= (first p) (third bb))
                         (= (second p) (second bb)) (= (second p) (fourth bb))))
                   (obj-cells obj)))))
    (define (floor-half x)
      (if (>= x 0) (quotient x 2) (- 0 (quotient (+ (- 0 x) 1) 2))))
    (define (transform motif code)
      (cond [(= code 2) (rotate-cw motif)]
            [(= code 3) (rotate-180 motif)]
            [(= code 4) (flip-ud motif)]
            [else motif]))
    (define source-frame (first (filter rect-border? (objects (keep-only g 9) 0))))
    (define source (subgrid g (+ (obj-r1 source-frame) 1) (+ (obj-c1 source-frame) 1)

    (for/fold ([out g]) ([frame (in-list (filter rect-border? (objects (keep-only g 8) 0)))])
      (let* ((code (if (>= (- (obj-r1 frame) 1) 0) (at g (- (obj-r1 frame) 1) (obj-c1 frame)) 1))

             (iw (- (obj-c2 frame) (obj-c1 frame) 1))

             (sc (+ (obj-c1 frame) 1 (floor-half (- iw mw)))))
        (define cleared

                     ([r (in-range sr (obj-r2 frame))]
                      [c (in-range (+ (obj-c1 frame) 1) (obj-c2 frame))])
            (set-cell acc r c 0)))
        (for*/fold ([acc cleared])
                   ([r (in-range mh)]
                    [c (in-range mw)])

            (if (not (= v 0)) (set-cell acc (+ sr r) (+ sc c) v) acc)))))))
