(rule!
  (let* ((ref (first (find-color g 9)))
         (offsets (map (lambda (p) (list (- (first p) (first ref)) (- (second p) (second ref))))
                       (find-color g 4)))
         (anchors (find-color g 2)))
    (let* ((painted
            (for/fold ([out (paint-cells (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0) anchors 2)])
                      ([anchor (in-list anchors)])
              (for/fold ([acc out]) ([off (in-list offsets)])
                (let ((rr (+ (first anchor) (first off)))
                      (cc (+ (second anchor) (second off))))
                  (if (in-bounds? rr cc (rows acc) (cols acc))
                      (set-cell acc rr cc 4)
                      acc))))))
      (paint-cells painted anchors 2))))

title: Endpoint Segment Fill
written_solution: For each row, find the leftmost and rightmost occurrence of each non-background color. Fill every cell between those endpoints with that same color.
program_solution:
(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (fill-one-row out r color)
      (let ((cols-hit (map second (filter-cells g (lambda (rr c v) (and (= rr r) (= v color)))))))
        (if (< (length cols-hit) 2)
            out
            (for/fold ([acc out]) ([c (in-range (apply min cols-hit) (+ (apply max cols-hit) 1))])
              (set-cell acc r c color)))))
    (for/fold ([out g]) ([r (in-range (rows g))])
      (for/fold ([acc out]) ([color (in-list (remove-duplicates (filter (lambda (v) (not (= v 0))) (row g r))))])
        (fill-one-row acc r color)))))

title: Opposite Corner Rectangle Fill
written_solution: For each non-background color, take its two marked cells as opposite corners of an axis-aligned rectangle. Fill the whole rectangle with that color.
program_solution:
(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define colors (remove-duplicates (map third (filter (lambda (cell) (not (= (third cell) 0))) (grid-cells g)))))
    (define (paint-rect out color)
      (let ((cells (filter-cells g (lambda (r c v) (= v color)))))
        (if (< (length cells) 2)
            out
            (let* ((a (first cells))
                   (b (last cells))
                   (r1 (min (first a) (first b)))
                   (r2 (max (first a) (first b)))
                   (c1 (min (second a) (second b)))
                   (c2 (max (second a) (second b))))
              (paint-cells out (positions-in-rect r1 c1 r2 c2) color)))))
    (for/fold ([out (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0)]) ([color (in-list colors)])
      (paint-rect out color))))

title: Guide Reflection
written_solution: Find the vertical guide made entirely of 8s. For every nonzero non-guide cell on the left, reflect it to the symmetric position on the right and keep the original cells and the guide.
program_solution:
(rule!
  (let* ((guide (first (filter (lambda (c)
                                 (all? (lambda (r) (= (at g r c) 8)) (range 0 (rows g))))
                               (range 0 (cols g))))))
    (for*/fold ([out g])
               ([r (in-range (rows g))]
                [c (in-range guide)])
      (let ((v (at g r c))
            (mc (+ guide (- guide c))))
        (if (and (not (= v 0)) (not (= v 8)) (in-bounds? r mc (rows g) (cols g)))
            (set-cell out r mc v)
            out)))))

title: Sorted Count Strip
written_solution: Count every nonzero cell by color. Output a single row containing each color repeated its count times, ordered from the smallest color to the largest.
program_solution:
(rule!
  (let* ((colors (grid-colors g 0))
         (row-out (for*/list ([color (in-list colors)]
                              [_ (in-range (count-where (lambda (cell) (= (third cell) color)) (grid-cells g)))])
                    color)))
    (list (if (empty? row-out) (list 0) row-out))))

title: Largest Component Crop
written_solution: Find all connected nonzero components. Choose the one with the most cells and output its tight bbox.
program_solution:
(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (nonzero-components grid)
      (let loop ([remaining (filter-cells grid (lambda (r c v) (not (= v 0))))] [acc (list)])
        (if (empty? remaining)
            (reverse acc)
            (let* ((start (first remaining))
                   (cells (connected-region grid (first start) (second start)
                            (lambda (r c v) (not (= v 0))) 4)))
              (loop (filter (lambda (p) (not (member? p cells))) remaining)
                    (cons cells acc))))))
    (let* ((chosen (first
                    (sort (nonzero-components g)
                      (lambda (a b)
                        (let ((ba (bbox-of-cells a)) (bb (bbox-of-cells b)))
                          (cond [(not (= (length a) (length b))) (> (length a) (length b))]
                                [(not (= (first ba) (first bb))) (< (first ba) (first bb))]
                                [else (< (second ba) (second bb))]))))))
           (bb (bbox-of-cells chosen)))
      (subgrid g (first bb) (second bb) (third bb) (fourth bb)))))

title: Complete the 2x2 Blocks
written_solution: In every 2x2 block that contains three copies of the same non-background color and one zero, replace the zero with that color. Apply this everywhere until no such block remains.
program_solution:
(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (step grid)
      (for*/fold ([state (list grid 0)])
                 ([r (in-range (- (rows grid) 1))]
                  [c (in-range (- (cols grid) 1))])
        (let* ((out (first state))
               (changed (second state))
               (vals (list (at out r c) (at out r (+ c 1))
                           (at out (+ r 1) c) (at out (+ r 1) (+ c 1))))
               (nz (filter (lambda (v) (not (= v 0))) vals)))
          (if (and (= (count-where (lambda (v) (= v 0)) vals) 1)
                   (= (length nz) 3)
                   (= (length (remove-duplicates nz)) 1))
              (let* ((idx (let loop ([xs vals] [i 0])
                            (if (= (first xs) 0) i (loop (rest xs) (+ i 1)))))
                     (rr (+ r (quotient idx 2)))
                     (cc (+ c (modulo idx 2))))
                (list (set-cell out rr cc (first nz)) 1))
              (list out changed)))))
    (let loop ([grid g] [fuel (* (rows g) (cols g))])
      (if (= fuel 0)
          grid
          (let ((result (step grid)))
            (if (= (second result) 1)
                (loop (first result) (- fuel 1))
                (first result)))))))

title: Rotated Offset Replay
written_solution: Record the relative positions of the orange(7) cells around the maroon(9). Each anchor color encodes a rotation: red(2) → none, green(3) → 90° clockwise, yellow(4) → 180°, gray(5) → 270° clockwise. Replay the rotated cloud around each anchor and keep the anchor colors.
program_solution:
(rule!
  (let* ((ref (first (find-color g 9)))
         (offsets (map (lambda (p) (list (- (first p) (first ref)) (- (second p) (second ref))))
                       (find-color g 7)))
         (anchors (filter (lambda (cell)
                            (member? (third cell) (list 2 3 4 5)))
                          (grid-cells g))))
    (define (anchor-transform color)
      (cond [(= color 2) 0] [(= color 3) 1] [(= color 4) 2] [else 3]))
    (define (rotate-offset off t)
      (let ((dr (first off)) (dc (second off)))
        (cond [(= t 0) (list dr dc)]
              [(= t 1) (list dc (- dr))]
              [(= t 2) (list (- dr) (- dc))]
              [else (list (- dc) dr)])))
    (let* ((seeded (paint-cells (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0)
                                (map (lambda (cell) (list (first cell) (second cell) (third cell))) anchors)))
           (painted
            (for/fold ([out seeded]) ([anchor (in-list anchors)])
              (let ((t (anchor-transform (third anchor))))
                (for/fold ([acc out]) ([off (in-list offsets)])
                  (let* ((rot (rotate-offset off t))
                         (rr (+ (first anchor) (first rot)))
                         (cc (+ (second anchor) (second rot))))
                    (if (in-bounds? rr cc (rows acc) (cols acc))
                        (set-cell acc rr cc 7)
                        acc)))))))
      (paint-cells painted (map (lambda (cell) (list (first cell) (second cell) (third cell))) anchors)))))

title: Legend Motif Sequencing
written_solution: Read the nonzero colors in the top row from left to right. For each such color, find the disconnected component of that color below, crop it to its bbox, and concatenate the crops horizontally with a zero separator column.
program_solution:
(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (pack-h grids gap)
      (let* ((h (apply max (map rows grids)))
             (w (+ (apply + (map cols grids)) (* gap (max 0 (- (length grids) 1))))))
        (let loop ([out (empty-grid h w 0)] [remaining grids] [left 0])
          (if (empty? remaining)
              out
              (let ((block (first remaining)))
                (loop (for*/fold ([acc out])
                                  ([r (in-range (rows block))]
                                   [c (in-range (cols block))]
                                   #:when (not (= (at block r c) 0)))
                        (set-cell acc r (+ left c) (at block r c)))
                      (rest remaining)
                      (+ left (cols block) gap)))))))
    (let* ((legend (filter (lambda (v) (not (= v 0))) (row g 0)))
           (blocks
            (map (lambda (color)
                   (let* ((matches (filter (lambda (obj)
                                             (and (= (obj-color obj) color) (> (obj-r1 obj) 0)))
                                           (objects g 0)))
                          (chosen (first
                                   (sort matches
                                     (lambda (a b)
                                       (cond [(not (= (obj-size a) (obj-size b))) (> (obj-size a) (obj-size b))]
                                             [(not (= (obj-r1 a) (obj-r1 b))) (< (obj-r1 a) (obj-r1 b))]
                                             [else (< (obj-c1 a) (obj-c1 b))]))))))
                     (subgrid g (obj-r1 chosen) (obj-c1 chosen) (obj-r2 chosen) (obj-c2 chosen))))
                 legend)))
      (pack-h blocks 1))))

title: Chamber Seed Fill
written_solution: Walls of 1 partition the grid into regions. For each non-wall region that contains exactly one nonzero seed color, fill its zero cells with that seed color while keeping the walls unchanged.
program_solution:
(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (let loop ([remaining (filter-cells g (lambda (r c v) (not (= v 1))))] [out g])
      (if (empty? remaining)
          out
          (let* ((start (first remaining))
                 (region (connected-region g (first start) (second start)
                           (lambda (r c v) (not (= v 1))) 4))
                 (colors (remove-duplicates
                           (filter (lambda (v) (> v 1))
                                   (map (lambda (p) (at g (first p) (second p))) region))))
                 (next-remaining (filter (lambda (p) (not (member? p region))) remaining)))
            (if (= (length colors) 1)
                (loop next-remaining
                      (for/fold ([acc out]) ([p (in-list region)])
                        (if (= (at acc (first p) (second p)) 0)
                            (set-cell acc (first p) (second p) (first colors))
                            acc)))
                (loop next-remaining out)))))))

title: Area Winner Matrix
written_solution: Order the component colors numerically. In the output matrix, entry (i,j) is the color of the larger of those two components, or 0 on the diagonal and for equal areas.
program_solution:
(rule!
  (let* ((comps (sort (objects g 0)
                      (lambda (a b)
                        (if (= (obj-color a) (obj-color b))
                            (< (obj-size a) (obj-size b))
                            (< (obj-color a) (obj-color b))))))
         (n (length comps)))
    (grid-from-fn n n
      (lambda (r c)
        (let ((a (nth comps r)) (b (nth comps c)))
          (cond [(= r c) 0]
                [(> (obj-size a) (obj-size b)) (obj-color a)]
                [(> (obj-size b) (obj-size a)) (obj-color b)]
                [else 0]))))))

title: Commanded Extraction
written_solution: The lone nonzero cell in the top row encodes a transform: red(2) → identity, green(3) → 90° clockwise, yellow(4) → 180°, gray(5) → flip horizontal, magenta(6) → flip vertical. Crop the motif below and output the transformed crop.
program_solution:
(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (apply-transform grid cmd)
      (cond [(= cmd 0) grid]
            [(= cmd 1) (rotate-cw grid)]
            [(= cmd 2) (rotate-180 grid)]
            [(= cmd 3) (transpose grid)]
            [(= cmd 4) (flip-lr grid)]
            [else (flip-ud grid)]))
    (define (nonzero-components grid)
      (let loop ([remaining (filter-cells grid (lambda (r c v) (not (= v 0))))] [acc (list)])
        (if (empty? remaining)
            (reverse acc)
            (let* ((start (first remaining))
                   (cells (connected-region grid (first start) (second start)
                            (lambda (r c v) (not (= v 0))) 4)))
              (loop (filter (lambda (p) (not (member? p cells))) remaining)
                    (cons cells acc))))))
    (define (mapped-cmd cmd)
      (cond [(= cmd 2) 0] [(= cmd 3) 1] [(= cmd 4) 2] [(= cmd 5) 4] [else 5]))
    (let* ((cmd (first (filter (lambda (v) (not (= v 0))) (row g 0))))
           ;; Ignore the command row; search the puzzle body for the motif.
           (body (subgrid g 1 0 (- (rows g) 1) (- (cols g) 1)))
           (chosen (first
                    (sort (nonzero-components body)
                      (lambda (a b)
                        (let ((ba (bbox-of-cells a)) (bb (bbox-of-cells b)))
                          (if (= (first ba) (first bb))
                              (< (second ba) (second bb))
                              (< (first ba) (first bb))))))))
           ;; The top-left body component identifies the motif crop bounds.
           (bb (bbox-of-cells chosen))
           ;; Preserve every colored cell inside those bounds, including enclosed islands.
           (motif (subgrid body (first bb) (second bb) (third bb) (fourth bb))))
      (apply-transform motif (mapped-cmd cmd)))))

title: Nested Frame Depth Recolor
written_solution: Each cyan(8) component is a rectangular frame. Order the frames from outside to inside and recolor them using the fixed depth palette red(2), yellow(4), magenta(6), orange(7), … while leaving the background empty.
program_solution:
(rule!
  (let* ((palette (list 2 4 6 7 3 5 9))
         (frames (sort (filter (lambda (obj) (= (obj-color obj) 8)) (objects g 0))
                       (lambda (a b)
                         (> (* (obj-h a) (obj-w a)) (* (obj-h b) (obj-w b)))))))
    (let loop ([out (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0)] [remaining frames] [depth 0])
      (if (empty? remaining)
          out
          (loop (paint-cells out (obj-cells (first remaining)) (nth palette depth))
                (rest remaining)
                (+ depth 1))))))

title: Column Gravity with Obstacles
written_solution: Keep the 1-cells fixed. In every column and in every vertical segment separated by 1s, collect the colored cells and drop them to the lowest available positions of that segment, preserving their order.
program_solution:
(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (segment-values c top bot)
      (filter (lambda (v) (and (not (= v 0)) (not (= v 1))))
              (for/list ([r (in-range top (+ bot 1))]) (at g r c))))
    (define (write-segment out c top bot vals)
      (let loop ([acc out] [remaining (reverse vals)] [r bot])
        (if (empty? remaining)
            acc
            (loop (set-cell acc r c (first remaining)) (rest remaining) (- r 1)))))
    (define (process-col out c)
      (let loop ([r (- (rows g) 1)] [acc out])
        (cond [(< r 0) acc]
              [(= (at g r c) 1) (loop (- r 1) acc)]
              [else
               (let scan ([top r])
                 (if (or (< top 0) (= (at g top c) 1))
                     (let* ((seg-top (+ top 1))
                            (seg-bot r)
                            (vals (segment-values c seg-top seg-bot)))
                       (loop (- seg-top 2) (write-segment acc c seg-top seg-bot vals)))
                     (scan (- top 1))))])))
    (let* ((walls (filter-cells g (lambda (r c v) (= v 1))))
           (base (paint-cells (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0) walls 1)))
      (for/fold ([out base]) ([c (in-range (cols g))])
        (process-col out c)))))

title: Keyed Offset Merge
written_solution: Read the cyan(8) cells as an offset cloud around the maroon(9) origin. Anchor colors red(2), green(3), yellow(4), gray(5) encode rotations 0°, 90°, 180°, 270° and also paint colors yellow(4), gray(5), magenta(6), orange(7). Replay each rotated cloud around its anchor and merge overlaps by taking the maximum color at each cell.
program_solution:
(rule!
  (let* ((ref (first (find-color g 9)))
         (offsets (map (lambda (p) (list (- (first p) (first ref)) (- (second p) (second ref))))
                       (find-color g 8)))
         (anchors (filter (lambda (cell)
                            (member? (third cell) (list 2 3 4 5)))
                          (grid-cells g))))
    (define (anchor-transform color)
      (cond [(= color 2) 0] [(= color 3) 1] [(= color 4) 2] [else 3]))
    (define (paint-color color)
      (cond [(= color 2) 4] [(= color 3) 5] [(= color 4) 6] [else 7]))
    (define (rotate-offset off t)
      (let ((dr (first off)) (dc (second off)))
        (cond [(= t 0) (list dr dc)]
              [(= t 1) (list dc (- dr))]
              [(= t 2) (list (- dr) (- dc))]
              [else (list (- dc) dr)])))
    (for/fold ([out (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0)]) ([anchor (in-list anchors)])
      (let ((t (anchor-transform (third anchor)))
            (new-color (paint-color (third anchor)))
            (with-anchor (set-cell out (first anchor) (second anchor) (third anchor))))
        (for/fold ([acc with-anchor]) ([off (in-list offsets)])
          (let* ((rot (rotate-offset off t))
                 (rr (+ (first anchor) (first rot)))
                 (cc (+ (second anchor) (second rot))))
            (if (in-bounds? rr cc (rows acc) (cols acc))
                (set-cell acc rr cc (max (at acc rr cc) new-color))
                acc)))))))

title: Transform by Example
written_solution: There are three disconnected motifs: A, transformed A, and B. Infer which dihedral transform maps A to its example partner, then apply the same transform to B and output the transformed crop.
program_solution:
(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (apply-transform grid cmd)
      (cond [(= cmd 0) grid]
            [(= cmd 1) (rotate-cw grid)]
            [(= cmd 2) (rotate-180 grid)]
            [(= cmd 3) (transpose grid)]
            [(= cmd 4) (flip-lr grid)]
            [else (flip-ud grid)]))
    ;; Components are 4-connected across all non-zero colours.
    (define (nonzero-components grid)
      (let loop ([remaining (filter-cells grid (lambda (r c v) (not (= v 0))))] [acc (list)])
        (if (empty? remaining)
            (reverse acc)
            (let* ((start (first remaining))
                   (cells (connected-region grid (first start) (second start)
                            (lambda (r c v) (not (= v 0))) 4)))
              (loop (filter (lambda (p) (not (member? p cells))) remaining)
                    (cons cells acc))))))
    (define (crop-cells cells)
      ;; Crop from the original grid, so any disconnected cell inside this
      ;; component's bbox remains part of the visible motif.
      (let ((bb (bbox-of-cells cells)))
        (subgrid g (first bb) (second bb) (third bb) (fourth bb))))
    ;; Reading order chooses A, A', then B; later components are ignored except
    ;; when crop-cells includes them inside one of those bounding boxes.
    (let* ((components (sort (nonzero-components g)
                             (lambda (a b)
                               (let ((ba (bbox-of-cells a)) (bb (bbox-of-cells b)))
                                 (if (= (first ba) (first bb))
                                     (< (second ba) (second bb))
                                     (< (first ba) (first bb)))))))
           (a (crop-cells (first components)))
           (ap (crop-cells (second components)))
           (b (crop-cells (third components)))
           (cmd (find-first (lambda (t) (equal? (apply-transform a t) ap)) (list 0 1 2 3 4 5))))
      (apply-transform b (if (eq? cmd #f) 0 cmd)))))

title: Canonical Packing by Perimeter
written_solution: Find all connected components. Crop each one tightly, sort them by descending 4-neighbor perimeter (breaking ties by size), and concatenate the crops horizontally with a zero separator column.
program_solution:
(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (nonzero-components grid)
      (let loop ([remaining (filter-cells grid (lambda (r c v) (not (= v 0))))] [acc (list)])
        (if (empty? remaining)
            (reverse acc)
            (let* ((start (first remaining))
                   (cells (connected-region grid (first start) (second start)
                            (lambda (r c v) (not (= v 0))) 4)))
              (loop (filter (lambda (p) (not (member? p cells))) remaining)
                    (cons cells acc))))))
    (define (perimeter cells)
      (for*/sum ([p (in-list cells)]
                 [d (in-list cardinal-deltas)])
        (let ((q (list (+ (first p) (first d)) (+ (second p) (second d)))))
          (if (member? q cells) 0 1))))
    (define (pack-h grids gap)
      (let* ((h (apply max (map rows grids)))
             (w (+ (apply + (map cols grids)) (* gap (max 0 (- (length grids) 1))))))
        (let loop ([out (empty-grid h w 0)] [remaining grids] [left 0])
          (if (empty? remaining)
              out
              (let ((block (first remaining)))
                (loop (for*/fold ([acc out])
                                  ([r (in-range (rows block))]
                                   [c (in-range (cols block))]
                                   #:when (not (= (at block r c) 0)))
                        (set-cell acc r (+ left c) (at block r c)))
                      (rest remaining)
                      (+ left (cols block) gap)))))))
    (define (crop-cells cells)
      (let ((bb (bbox-of-cells cells)))
        (subgrid g (first bb) (second bb) (third bb) (fourth bb))))
    (let* ((components (sort (nonzero-components g)
                             (lambda (a b)
                               (let ((pa (perimeter a)) (pb (perimeter b))
                                     (ba (bbox-of-cells a)) (bb (bbox-of-cells b)))
                                 (cond [(not (= pa pb)) (> pa pb)]
                                       [(not (= (length a) (length b))) (> (length a) (length b))]
                                       [(not (= (first ba) (first bb))) (< (first ba) (first bb))]
                                       [else (< (second ba) (second bb))])))))
           (blocks (map crop-cells components)))
      (pack-h blocks 1))))

title: Nearest-Seed Partition with Ties
written_solution: Every zero cell is colored by the nearest seed under Manhattan distance. If two or more seed colors are tied for the minimum distance, the cell becomes cyan(8). Original seed cells stay unchanged.
program_solution:
(rule!
  (let ((seeds (filter (lambda (cell) (not (= (third cell) 0))) (grid-cells g))))
    (define (dist cell r c)
      (+ (abs (- r (first cell))) (abs (- c (second cell)))))
    (define (fill-value r c)
      (let* ((dmin (apply min (map (lambda (cell) (dist cell r c)) seeds)))
             (colors (remove-duplicates
                       (map third (filter (lambda (cell) (= (dist cell r c) dmin)) seeds)))))
        (if (= (length colors) 1) (first colors) 8)))
    (grid-from-fn (rows g) (cols g)
      (lambda (r c)
        (if (= (at g r c) 0) (fill-value r c) (at g r c))))))

title: Composed Transform Strip
written_solution: Read the nonzero command colors in the top row from left to right. Map 2,3,4,5,6 to rotate90, rotate180, rotate270, flip_h, flip_v, apply those transforms sequentially to the lower motif, and output the final crop.
program_solution:
(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (apply-transform grid cmd)
      (cond [(= cmd 0) grid]
            [(= cmd 1) (rotate-cw grid)]
            [(= cmd 2) (rotate-180 grid)]
            [(= cmd 3) (transpose grid)]
            [(= cmd 4) (flip-lr grid)]
            [else (flip-ud grid)]))
    (define (nonzero-components grid)
      (let loop ([remaining (filter-cells grid (lambda (r c v) (not (= v 0))))] [acc (list)])
        (if (empty? remaining)
            (reverse acc)
            (let* ((start (first remaining))
                   (cells (connected-region grid (first start) (second start)
                            (lambda (r c v) (not (= v 0))) 4)))
              (loop (filter (lambda (p) (not (member? p cells))) remaining)
                    (cons cells acc))))))
    (define (mapped-cmd cmd)
      (cond [(= cmd 2) 1] [(= cmd 3) 2] [(= cmd 4) 3] [(= cmd 5) 4] [else 5]))
    (let* ((cmds (filter (lambda (v) (not (= v 0))) (row g 0)))
           (components (filter (lambda (cells) (> (first (bbox-of-cells cells)) 0))
                               (nonzero-components g)))
           (chosen (first (sort components
                            (lambda (a b)
                              (let ((ba (bbox-of-cells a)) (bb (bbox-of-cells b)))
                                (if (= (first ba) (first bb))
                                    (< (second ba) (second bb))
                                    (< (first ba) (first bb))))))))
           (bb (bbox-of-cells chosen))
           (motif (subgrid g (first bb) (second bb) (third bb) (fourth bb))))
      (foldl (lambda (cmd acc) (apply-transform acc (mapped-cmd cmd))) motif cmds))))

title: Size-Matched Frame Insertion
written_solution: Find every hollow rectangular frame of 8s and compute its interior size. Crop the other components, match each crop to the frame whose interior has the same size, and place that crop into that frame’s interior.
program_solution:
(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (nonzero-components grid)
      (let loop ([remaining (filter-cells grid (lambda (r c v) (not (= v 0))))] [acc (list)])
        (if (empty? remaining)
            (reverse acc)
            (let* ((start (first remaining))
                   (cells (connected-region grid (first start) (second start)
                            (lambda (r c v) (not (= v 0))) 4)))
              (loop (filter (lambda (p) (not (member? p cells))) remaining)
                    (cons cells acc))))))
    (define (rect-frame? obj)
      (= (obj-size obj) (- (* 2 (+ (obj-h obj) (obj-w obj))) 4)))
    (define (crop-cells cells)
      (let ((bb (bbox-of-cells cells)))
        (subgrid g (first bb) (second bb) (third bb) (fourth bb))))
    (let* ((frames (sort (map obj-bbox (filter (lambda (obj)
                                                 (and (= (obj-color obj) 8) (rect-frame? obj)))
                                               (objects g 0)))
                         (lambda (a b)
                           (if (= (first a) (first b))
                               (< (second a) (second b))
                               (< (first a) (first b))))))
           (shapes (filter (lambda (cells)
                             (not (= (at g (first (first cells)) (second (first cells))) 8)))
                           (nonzero-components g)))
           (shape-info (map (lambda (cells)
                              (let ((block (crop-cells cells)))
                                (list (rows block) (cols block) block)))
                            shapes)))
      (let loop-frames ([out g] [remaining frames] [used (list)])
        (if (empty? remaining)
            out
            (let* ((fr (first remaining))
                   (ih (- (third fr) (first fr) 1))
                   (iw (- (fourth fr) (second fr) 1))
                   (match (find-first
                            (lambda (item)
                              (and (= (first item) ih) (= (second item) iw)
                                   (not (member? item used))))
                            shape-info)))
              (if (eq? match #f)
                  (loop-frames out (rest remaining) used)
                  (let ((block (third match)))
                    (loop-frames
                      (for*/fold ([acc out])
                                 ([r (in-range (rows block))]
                                  [c (in-range (cols block))]
                                  #:when (not (= (at block r c) 0)))
                        (set-cell acc (+ (first fr) 1 r) (+ (second fr) 1 c) (at block r c)))
                      (rest remaining)
                      (cons match used))))))))))

title: Transform and Palette by Example
written_solution: The upper pair shows a geometric transform together with a color mapping. Infer both from A to A-prime, then apply that same transform and recoloring to the lower motif B and output the result.
program_solution:
(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (apply-transform grid cmd)
      (cond [(= cmd 0) grid]
            [(= cmd 1) (rotate-cw grid)]
            [(= cmd 2) (rotate-180 grid)]
            [(= cmd 3) (transpose grid)]
            [(= cmd 4) (flip-lr grid)]
            [else (flip-ud grid)]))
    (define (nonzero-components grid)
      (let loop ([remaining (filter-cells grid (lambda (r c v) (not (= v 0))))] [acc (list)])
        (if (empty? remaining)
            (reverse acc)
            (let* ((start (first remaining))
                   (cells (connected-region grid (first start) (second start)
                            (lambda (r c v) (not (= v 0))) 4)))
              (loop (filter (lambda (p) (not (member? p cells))) remaining)
                    (cons cells acc))))))
    (define (crop-cells cells)
      (let ((bb (bbox-of-cells cells)))
        (subgrid g (first bb) (second bb) (third bb) (fourth bb))))
    (define (mapping-for a ap cmd)
      (let ((ta (apply-transform a cmd)))
        (if (or (not (= (rows ta) (rows ap))) (not (= (cols ta) (cols ap))))
            #f
            (let loop ([cells (grid-cells ta)] [mapping (list)] [reverse-map (list)])
              (cond [(empty? cells) mapping]
                    [else
                     (let* ((cell (first cells))
                            (r (first cell))
                            (c (second cell))
                            (va (third cell))
                            (vb (at ap r c)))
                       (cond [(not (= (= va 0) (= vb 0))) #f]
                             [(= va 0) (loop (rest cells) mapping reverse-map)]
                             [else
                              (let ((old (find-first (lambda (p) (= (first p) va)) mapping))
                                    (rev (find-first (lambda (p) (= (first p) vb)) reverse-map)))
                                (cond [(and (not (eq? old #f)) (not (= (second old) vb))) #f]
                                      [(and (not (eq? rev #f)) (not (= (second rev) va))) #f]
                                      [else
                                       (loop (rest cells)
                                             (if (eq? old #f) (cons (list va vb) mapping) mapping)
                                             (if (eq? rev #f) (cons (list vb va) reverse-map) reverse-map))]))]))])))))
    (define (lookup color mapping)
      (let ((hit (find-first (lambda (p) (= (first p) color)) mapping)))
        (if (eq? hit #f) color (second hit))))
    (let* ((components (sort (nonzero-components g)
                             (lambda (a b)
                               (let ((ba (bbox-of-cells a)) (bb (bbox-of-cells b)))
                                 (if (= (first ba) (first bb))
                                     (< (second ba) (second bb))
                                     (< (first ba) (first bb)))))))
           (a (crop-cells (first components)))
           (ap (crop-cells (second components)))
           (b (crop-cells (third components)))
           (hit (find-first (lambda (t) (not (eq? (mapping-for a ap t) #f))) (list 0 1 2 3 4 5)))
           (mapping (mapping-for a ap hit))
           (tb (apply-transform b hit)))
      (grid-from-fn (rows tb) (cols tb)
        (lambda (r c)
          (let ((v (at tb r c)))
            (if (= v 0) 0 (lookup v mapping))))))))

title: Highlight plus centers
written_solution: Whenever a nonzero cell has the same color directly above, below, left, and right, recolor that center cell to cyan(8). Leave the arms and every other cell unchanged.
program_solution: (rule! (let ((dummy 0)) (for*/fold ((out g)) ((r (in-range 1 (- (rows g) 1))) (c (in-range 1 (- (cols g) 1)))) (let ((v (at g r c))) (if (and (not (= v 0)) (= (at g (- r 1) c) v) (= (at g (+ r 1) c) v) (= (at g r (- c 1)) v) (= (at g r (+ c 1)) v)) (set-cell out r c 8) out)))))

title: Complete exact L-shapes to squares
