(rule!
  (for/fold ([out (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0)]) ([color (in-list (grid-colors g 0))])
    (let ((cells (find-color g color)))
      (if (= (length cells) 2)
          (let* ((a (first cells))
                 (b (second cells))
                 (r1 (min (first a) (first b)))
                 (r2 (max (first a) (first b)))
                 (c1 (min (second a) (second b)))
                 (c2 (max (second a) (second b))))
            (paint-cells out
                         (remove-duplicates
                          (append (for/list ([c (in-range c1 (+ c2 1))]) (list r1 c))
                                  (for/list ([c (in-range c1 (+ c2 1))]) (list r2 c))
                                  (for/list ([r (in-range r1 (+ r2 1))]) (list r c1))
                                  (for/list ([r (in-range r1 (+ r2 1))]) (list r c2))))
                         color))
          out))))

title: Symmetrize the Largest Shape
written_solution: Find the largest object, crop it to its own local coordinates, reflect it horizontally inside that local box, and take the union of original plus reflection. The result is a vertically symmetric version of the original object.
program_solution: (rule! (let ((dummy 0)) (define (normalize cells) (let* ((bb (bbox-of-cells cells))) (sort (map (lambda (p) (list (- (first p) (first bb)) (- (second p) (second bb)))) cells) cell<))) (define (mirror-h pts) (let ((maxc (apply max (map second pts)))) (sort (map (lambda (p) (list (first p) (- maxc (second p)))) pts) cell<))) (define best (first (sort (objects g 0) (lambda (a b) (if (= (obj-size a) (obj-size b)) (> (length (obj-boundary-cells a)) (length (obj-boundary-cells b))) (> (obj-size a) (obj-size b))))))) (define pts (normalize (obj-cells best))) (define union (remove-duplicates (append pts (mirror-h pts)))) (define out-h (+ 1 (apply max (map first union)))) (define out-w (+ 1 (apply max (map second union)))) (paint-cells (empty-grid out-h out-w 0) union (obj-color best))))

title: Two-Panel XOR Mask
written_solution: Ignore the original colors and interpret non-zero as occupied. In the output panel, paint cyan(8) for cells occupied in exactly one of the two panels and leave cells black(0) when both panels agree.
program_solution:
(rule!
  (let ((div (first (filter (lambda (c)
                              (all? (lambda (r) (= (at g r c) 5)) (range 0 (rows g))))
                            (range 0 (cols g))))))
    (grid-from-fn (rows g) div
      (lambda (r c)
        (if (not (= (= (at g r c) 0) (= (at g r (+ div 1 c)) 0))) 8 0)))))

title: Area-Rank Recolor from Header
written_solution: The top row is a legend sequence. Rank the body objects by their cell counts, then assign the first legend color to the smallest object, the next to the middle one, and so on, keeping each object in place.
program_solution: (rule! (let ((dummy 0)) (define legend (filter (lambda (v) (not (= v 0))) (row g 0))) (define body (subgrid g 1 0 (- (rows g) 1) (- (cols g) 1))) (define comps (sort (objects body 0) (lambda (a b) (if (= (obj-size a) (obj-size b)) (cell< (first (sort (obj-cells a) cell<)) (first (sort (obj-cells b) cell<))) (< (obj-size a) (obj-size b)))))) (for/fold ((out g)) ((obj (in-list comps)) (color (in-list legend))) (paint-cells out (map (lambda (p) (list (+ (first p) 1) (second p))) (obj-cells obj)) color))))

title: Nested Frame Fill by Container
written_solution: This is a region-ownership task. Each black(0) cell inside nested frames belongs to the smallest enclosing frame, not necessarily the outermost one. Fill each annulus with the color of the frame immediately surrounding it, and keep the frames themselves unchanged.
program_solution:
(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (frame? obj)
      (let* ((h (obj-h obj))
             (w (obj-w obj))
             (perim (+ (* 2 w) (* 2 (- h 2)))))
        (and (>= h 3) (>= w 3)
             (= (obj-size obj) perim)
             (all? (lambda (p)
                     (or (= (first p) (obj-r1 obj)) (= (first p) (obj-r2 obj))
                         (= (second p) (obj-c1 obj)) (= (second p) (obj-c2 obj))))
                   (obj-cells obj)))))
    (define frames
      (sort (filter frame? (objects g 0))
            (lambda (a b) (< (* (obj-h a) (obj-w a)) (* (obj-h b) (obj-w b))))))
    (fold-cells g g
      (lambda (out r c v)
        (if (not (= v 0))
            out
            (let ((hits (filter (lambda (fr)
                                  (and (< (obj-r1 fr) r) (< r (obj-r2 fr))
                                       (< (obj-c1 fr) c) (< c (obj-c2 fr))))
                                frames)))
              (if (empty? hits) out (set-cell out r c (obj-color (first hits))))))))))

title: Rotation-Coded Boundary Stamps
written_solution: Extract the boundary of the red(2) template, normalize it, and rotate it according to the code value at each anchor cell. Then place the rotated boundary copy with its top-left corner at that coded cell. The output is a background canvas containing only the stamped cyan(8) outlines.
program_solution: (rule! (let ((dummy 0)) (define (normalize cells) (let* ((bb (bbox-of-cells cells))) (sort (map (lambda (p) (list (- (first p) (first bb)) (- (second p) (second bb)))) cells) cell<))) (define (rot1 pts) (let ((maxr (apply max (map first pts)))) (normalize (map (lambda (p) (list (second p) (- maxr (first p)))) pts)))) (define (rotate pts k) (let loop ((n (modulo k 4)) (acc pts)) (if (= n 0) acc (loop (- n 1) (rot1 acc))))) (define (code-rot v) (cond ((= v 1) 0) ((= v 3) 1) ((= v 4) 2) ((= v 6) 3) (else #f))) (define template (first (sort (filter (lambda (obj) (= (obj-color obj) 2)) (objects g 0)) (lambda (a b) (> (obj-size a) (obj-size b)))))) (define pts (normalize (obj-boundary-cells template))) (fold-cells g (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0) (lambda (out r c v) (let ((rot (code-rot v))) (if (eq? rot #f) out (for/fold ((acc out)) ((p (in-list (rotate pts rot)))) (let ((rr (+ r (first p))) (cc (+ c (second p)))) (if (in-bounds? rr cc (rows g) (cols g)) (set-cell acc rr cc 8) acc)))))))))

title: Select by Hole Count
written_solution: The header specifies a hole count. For each body component, count how many enclosed zero-regions lie inside it; then pick the object with the matching hole count. Output only that object's boundary as a normalized cyan(8) crop.
program_solution: (rule! (let ((dummy 0)) (define (norm-boundary obj) (let* ((bb (bbox-of-cells (obj-cells obj))) (h (+ 1 (- (third bb) (first bb)))) (w (+ 1 (- (fourth bb) (second bb))))) (paint-cells (empty-grid h w 0) (sort (map (lambda (p) (list (- (first p) (first bb)) (- (second p) (second bb)))) (obj-boundary-cells obj)) cell<) 8))) (let* ((k (count-where (lambda (v) (= v 1)) (row g 0))) (body (subgrid g 1 0 (- (rows g) 1) (- (cols g) 1))) (best (find-first (lambda (obj) (= (topo-count-holes body obj 0) k)) (objects body 0)))) (norm-boundary best))))

title: Find the Unpaired Shape Under Symmetry
written_solution: Convert each component to a canonical shape signature under the full dihedral symmetry group. Most signatures appear twice; one appears only once. Output that unmatched component as a tight normalized crop.
program_solution: (rule! (let ((dummy 0)) (define (normalize cells) (let* ((bb (bbox-of-cells cells))) (sort (map (lambda (p) (list (- (first p) (first bb)) (- (second p) (second bb)))) cells) cell<))) (define (mirror-h pts) (let ((maxc (apply max (map second pts)))) (sort (map (lambda (p) (list (first p) (- maxc (second p)))) pts) cell<))) (define (rot1 pts) (let ((maxr (apply max (map first pts)))) (normalize (map (lambda (p) (list (second p) (- maxr (first p)))) pts)))) (define (rotate pts k) (let loop ((n (modulo k 4)) (acc pts)) (if (= n 0) acc (loop (- n 1) (rot1 acc))))) (define (signature obj) (let* ((pts (normalize (obj-cells obj))) (vars (remove-duplicates (apply append (for/list ((k (in-range 4))) (let ((r (rotate pts k))) (list r (mirror-h r)))))))) (first (sort vars (lambda (a b) (string<? (format "~a" a) (format "~a" b))))))) (define objs (objects g 0)) (define sigs (foldl (lambda (obj acc) (let ((sig (signature obj))) (if (member sig acc) acc (append acc (list sig))))) (list) objs)) (define target-sig (first (filter (lambda (sig) (= (count-where (lambda (obj) (equal? (signature obj) sig)) objs) 1)) sigs))) (define target (first (filter (lambda (obj) (equal? (signature obj) target-sig)) objs))) (let* ((bb (bbox-of-cells (obj-cells target))) (h (+ 1 (- (third bb) (first bb)))) (w (+ 1 (- (fourth bb) (second bb))))) (paint-cells (empty-grid h w 0) (sort (map (lambda (p) (list (- (first p) (first bb)) (- (second p) (second bb)))) (obj-boundary-cells target)) cell<) (obj-color target)))))

title: Translate and Split Boundary vs Interior
written_solution: Find the source and target markers and compute their offset. Move the main object by that offset, but do not preserve its old color: boundary cells become orange(7) while strictly interior cells become cyan(8). The output contains only the translated object.
program_solution:
(rule!
  (let* ((src (first (find-color g 1)))
         (dst (first (find-color g 2)))
         (comp (first (sort (filter (lambda (obj) (not (member (obj-color obj) (list 1 2)))) (objects g 0))
                            (lambda (a b) (> (obj-size a) (obj-size b))))))
         (boundary (obj-boundary-cells comp))
         (dr (- (first dst) (first src)))
         (dc (- (second dst) (second src))))
    (for/fold ([out (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0)]) ([p (in-list (obj-cells comp))])
      (let ((nr (+ (first p) dr)) (nc (+ (second p) dc)))
        (if (in-bounds? nr nc (rows g) (cols g))
            (set-cell out nr nc (if (member p boundary) 7 8))
            out)))))

title: Dual Legend: Area and Boundary
written_solution: This header specifies two independent features: total cells and boundary cells. Compute both values for each candidate object, find the one that matches both targets, and return that whole object as a tight crop recolored to cyan(8).
program_solution: (rule! (let ((dummy 0)) (let* ((area (count-where (lambda (v) (= v 1)) (row g 0))) (bcount (count-where (lambda (v) (= v 2)) (row g 0))) (body (subgrid g 1 0 (- (rows g) 1) (- (cols g) 1))) (best (find-first (lambda (obj) (and (= (obj-size obj) area) (= (length (obj-boundary-cells obj)) bcount))) (objects body 0))) (bb (bbox-of-cells (obj-cells best))) (h (+ 1 (- (third bb) (first bb)))) (w (+ 1 (- (fourth bb) (second bb))))) (paint-cells (empty-grid h w 0) (sort (map (lambda (p) (list (- (first p) (first bb)) (- (second p) (second bb)))) (obj-cells best)) cell<) 8))))

title: Common Shape Across Three Panels
written_solution: Compare the three panel objects by canonical shape under rotation/reflection. The majority signature is the common shape. Output that common form once, normalized and recolored to cyan(8).
program_solution: (rule! (let ((dummy 0)) (define (normalize cells) (let* ((bb (bbox-of-cells cells))) (sort (map (lambda (p) (list (- (first p) (first bb)) (- (second p) (second bb)))) cells) cell<))) (define (mirror-h pts) (let ((maxc (apply max (map second pts)))) (sort (map (lambda (p) (list (first p) (- maxc (second p)))) pts) cell<))) (define (rot1 pts) (let ((maxr (apply max (map first pts)))) (normalize (map (lambda (p) (list (second p) (- maxr (first p)))) pts)))) (define (rotate pts k) (let loop ((n (modulo k 4)) (acc pts)) (if (= n 0) acc (loop (- n 1) (rot1 acc))))) (define (canonical cells) (let* ((pts (normalize cells)) (vars (remove-duplicates (apply append (for/list ((k (in-range 4))) (let ((r (rotate pts k))) (list r (mirror-h r)))))))) (first (sort vars (lambda (a b) (string<? (format "~a" a) (format "~a" b))))))) (define bars (filter (lambda (c) (all? (lambda (r) (= (at g r c) 5)) (range 0 (rows g)))) (range 0 (cols g)))) (define c1 (first bars)) (define c2 (second bars)) (define panels (list (subgrid g 0 0 (- (rows g) 1) (- c1 1)) (subgrid g 0 (+ c1 1) (- (rows g) 1) (- c2 1)) (subgrid g 0 (+ c2 1) (- (rows g) 1) (- (cols g) 1)))) (define sigs (map (lambda (p) (let ((obj (first (sort (objects p 0) (lambda (a b) (> (obj-size a) (obj-size b))))))) (canonical (obj-cells obj)))) panels)) (define max-count (apply max (map (lambda (sig) (count-where (lambda (x) (equal? x sig)) sigs)) sigs))) (define common (first (filter (lambda (sig) (= (count-where (lambda (x) (equal? x sig)) sigs) max-count)) sigs))) (define out-h (+ 1 (apply max (map first common)))) (define out-w (+ 1 (apply max (map second common)))) (paint-cells (empty-grid out-h out-w 0) common 8)))

title: Horizontal Span Closure
written_solution: Treat each object independently. For every occupied row in that object, take the segment from the row's first filled cell to its last filled cell and fill the whole segment. Rows that already have no gaps stay the same, while rows like 1-0-1 become solid bars. Put the filled rows back into the original grid with the original colors.
program_solution: (rule! (let ((dummy 0)) (define (row-span-cells obj) (remove-duplicates (flatmap (lambda (r) (let ((cols (map second (filter (lambda (p) (= (first p) r)) (obj-cells obj))))) (if (empty? cols) (list) (for/list ((c (in-range (apply min cols) (+ (apply max cols) 1)))) (list r c))))) (range (obj-r1 obj) (+ (obj-r2 obj) 1))))) (define (row-fill grid banned) (for/fold ((out grid)) ((obj (in-list (objects grid 0)))) (if (member (obj-color obj) banned) out (paint-cells out (row-span-cells obj) (obj-color obj))))) (row-fill g (list))))

written_solution: The rule is the vertical version of span closure. For each object, inspect every column that contains object cells. If a column has two separated occupied cells, fill the gap between them. Apply that to all columns of all objects and keep the original colors.
program_solution: (rule! (let ((dummy 0)) (define (col-span-cells obj) (remove-duplicates (flatmap (lambda (c) (let ((rs (map first (filter (lambda (p) (= (second p) c)) (obj-cells obj))))) (if (empty? rs) (list) (for/list ((r (in-range (apply min rs) (+ (apply max rs) 1)))) (list r c))))) (range (obj-c1 obj) (+ (obj-c2 obj) 1))))) (define (col-fill grid banned) (for/fold ((out grid)) ((obj (in-list (objects grid 0)))) (if (member (obj-color obj) banned) out (paint-cells out (col-span-cells obj) (obj-color obj))))) (col-fill g (list))))

title: Contact Matrix
written_solution: Sort the monochrome objects by the top-left corner of their bounding boxes. Output an N x N matrix with blue(1) on the diagonal and 2 wherever two objects touch orthogonally by at least one 4-connected cell; use 0 elsewhere.

 ;; 1 on the diagonal, 2 at (i,j) and (j,i) where components i and j touch
 ;; cardinally.

   (define (bbox< a b)

           ((!= (third a) (third b)) (< (third a) (third b)))
           ((!= (second a) (second b)) (< (second a) (second b)))

         (set-cell (set-cell out i j 2) j i 2)

title: Oriented cursor follows the remaining aligned waypoints
written_solution: Select the panel after the last full-height separator. Identify the three-cell cursor tip. Repeatedly consume the unique remaining waypoint sharing its row or column. Render a clean panel with the cursor at the final waypoint, oriented along the final leg. Earlier panels are context and do not influence this variant's output.
program_solution:
(rule!
 (lambda (g)
  (let ()
   (define h (rows g))
   (define w (cols g))
   (define bg (mode g -1))
   (define sep-cols
    (filter
     (lambda (c)
      (and (!= (at g 0 c) bg)
           (all? (lambda (r) (= (at g r c) (at g 0 c))) (range 0 h))))
     (range 0 w)))
   (define start (+ 1 (apply max sep-cols)))
   (define panel (subgrid g 0 start (- h 1) (- w 1)))
   (define pw (cols panel))
   (define objs (objects-8 panel bg))
   (define cursor (first (filter (lambda (o) (> (obj-size o) 1)) objs)))
   (define cells (obj-cells cursor))
   (define bb (obj-bbox cursor))
   (define bh (+ 1 (- (third bb) (first bb))))
   (define bw (+ 1 (- (fourth bb) (second bb))))
   (define tip
    (if (> bw bh)
        (first
         (filter
          (lambda (p)
           (= 1 (count-if (lambda (q) (= (first q) (first p))) cells)))
          cells))
        (first
         (filter
          (lambda (p)
           (= 1 (count-if (lambda (q) (= (second q) (second p))) cells)))
          cells))))
   (define dots
    (map (lambda (o) (first (obj-cells o)))
         (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-size o) 1)) objs)))
   (define traced
    (let loop ((pos tip) (remaining dots) (last-delta (list 0 0)))
     (if (empty? remaining)
         (list pos last-delta)
         (let* ((aligned
                 (filter
                  (lambda (q)
                   (or (= (first q) (first pos))
                       (= (second q) (second pos))))
                  remaining))
                (next (first aligned))
                (delta (list (- (first next) (first pos))
                             (- (second next) (second pos)))))
          (loop next
                (filter (lambda (q) (not (equal? q next))) remaining)
                delta)))))
   (define final (first traced))
   (define delta (second traced))
   (define r (first final))
   (define c (second final))
   (define arrow
    (cond ((< (first delta) 0)
           (list (list r c) (list (+ r 1) (- c 1)) (list (+ r 1) (+ c 1))))
          ((> (first delta) 0)
           (list (list r c) (list (- r 1) (- c 1)) (list (- r 1) (+ c 1))))
          ((< (second delta) 0)
           (list (list r c) (list (- r 1) (+ c 1)) (list (+ r 1) (+ c 1))))
          (else
           (list (list r c) (list (- r 1) (- c 1)) (list (+ r 1) (- c 1))))))
   (paint-cells (empty-grid h pw bg) arrow (obj-color cursor)))))

title: Typed cursor follows the remaining final-panel waypoint route
written_solution: Take the panel after the last full-height separator. Identify its two-cell cursor: the head shares its color with the singleton waypoints, while the other color is the tail. Repeatedly move the head to the uniquely aligned unconsumed waypoint. After the last hop, return a clean panel containing the head at that waypoint and the tail one cell opposite the final travel direction. Earlier panels are unused context in this semantic variant.

     (if (empty? remaining)

                       (= (second q) (second pos))))
                  remaining))
                (next (first aligned))
                (delta (list (- (first next) (first pos))
                             (- (second next) (second pos)))))
          (loop next
                (filter (lambda (q) (not (equal? q next))) remaining)

   (define delta (second traced))

                    ((> (first delta) 0) 1)

(rule!
 (lambda (g)
  (let ()
   (define bg (mode g -1))
   (define sep (filter (lambda (c) (and (!= (at g 0 c) bg) (all? (lambda (r) (= (at g r c) (at g 0 c))) (range 0 (rows g))))) (range 0 (cols g))))
   (define start (if (empty? sep) 0 (+ 1 (apply max sep))))
   (define panel (subgrid g 0 start (- (rows g) 1) (- (cols g) 1)))
   (define first-panel (subgrid g 0 0 (- (rows g) 1) (if (empty? sep) (- (cols g) 1) (- (apply min sep) 1))))
   (define obs (objects-8 first-panel bg))
   (define cursor (first (filter (lambda (o) (> (obj-size o) 1)) obs)))
   (define template (obj-cells cursor))
   (define (dot p d) (+ (* (first p) (first d)) (* (second p) (second d))))
   (define dirs (list (list -1 0) (list 0 1) (list 1 0) (list 0 -1)))
   (define (tip-for d)
    (let* ((extent (apply max (map (lambda (p) (dot p d)) template)))
           (end (filter (lambda (p) (= (dot p d) extent)) template)))
     (if (= (length end) 1) (first end) #f)))
   (define initial-heading
    (first (filter
     (lambda (d)
      (let* ((tip (tip-for d)) (perp (list (second d) (- (first d))))
             (back (apply min (map (lambda (p) (dot p d)) template))))
       (and tip (> (count-if (lambda (p) (= (dot p d) back)) template) 1)
            (all? (lambda (p)
                    (let ((off (- (dot p perp) (dot tip perp))))
                     (member (list (- (first p) (* 2 off (first perp)))
                                   (- (second p) (* 2 off (second perp)))) template))) template)))) dirs)))
   (define initial-tip (tip-for initial-heading))
   (define (cw p) (list (second p) (- (first p))))
   (define (spin p n) (if (= n 0) p (spin (cw p) (- n 1))))
   (define ink (map (lambda (p) (list (first p) (second p))) (filter (lambda (p) (!= (third p) bg)) (grid-cells panel))))
   (define matches
    (apply append (map (lambda (n)
     (filter (lambda (candidate) (all? (lambda (p) (member p ink)) (third candidate)))
      (map (lambda (anchor)
       (list anchor (spin initial-heading n)
        (map (lambda (p)
         (let ((v (spin (list (- (first p) (first initial-tip)) (- (second p) (second initial-tip))) n)))
          (list (+ (first anchor) (first v)) (+ (second anchor) (second v))))) template))) ink))) (range 0 4))))
   (define found (first matches))
   (define tip (first found))
   (define heading (second found))
   (define cells (third found))
   (define dots (filter (lambda (p) (not (member p cells))) ink))
   (define (distance p q) (+ (abs (- (first p) (first q))) (abs (- (second p) (second q)))))
   (define trace
    (let loop ((pos tip) (todo dots) (direction heading))
     (if (empty? todo) (list pos direction)
      (let* ((aligned (filter (lambda (p) (or (= (first p) (first pos)) (= (second p) (second pos)))) todo))
             (next (first (sort aligned (lambda (a b) (< (distance a pos) (distance b pos))))))
             (dr (- (first next) (first pos))) (dc (- (second next) (second pos)))
             (length (+ (abs dr) (abs dc))))
       (loop next (filter (lambda (p) (not (equal? p next))) todo) (list (/ dr length) (/ dc length)))))))
   (define target (first trace))
   (define final-heading (second trace))
   (define (rotate p)
    (let turn ((v p) (d heading))
     (if (equal? d final-heading) v (turn (cw v) (cw d)))))
   (define moved
    (map (lambda (p)
      (let ((v (rotate (list (- (first p) (first tip)) (- (second p) (second tip))))))
       (list (+ (first target) (first v)) (+ (second target) (second v))))) cells))
   (paint-cells (empty-grid (rows panel) (cols panel) bg) moved (obj-color cursor)))))

; Direct rule for public evaluation parent edb79dae.
; Default uses simultaneous one-step legend substitutions.
; The template always belongs to the ORIGINAL block color. Nine steps reach
; the terminal color in the admitted acyclic ARC-palette mapping grammar.
(rule!
 (lambda (g)
   (define frequency (color-frequency g))
   (define maximum-frequency (apply max (hash-values frequency)))
   (define backgrounds
     (filter (lambda (c) (= (hash-ref frequency c) maximum-frequency))
             (hash-keys frequency)))
   (unless (= (length backgrounds) 1)
     (error "legend-templates: background mode must be unique"))
   (define bg (first backgrounds))
   (define components (objects g bg))
   (define frames
     (filter
      (lambda (o)
        (and (>= (obj-h o) 5) (>= (obj-w o) 5)
             (= (obj-size o) (- (* 2 (+ (obj-h o) (obj-w o))) 4))
             (for/and ([p (in-list (obj-cells o))])
               (or (= (first p) (obj-r1 o)) (= (first p) (obj-r2 o))
                   (= (second p) (obj-c1 o)) (= (second p) (obj-c2 o))))))
      components))
   (unless (= (length frames) 1)
     (error "legend-templates: expected one complete hollow frame"))
   (define frame (first frames))
   (define fr (obj-r1 frame))
   (define fc (obj-c1 frame))
   (define lr (obj-r2 frame))
   (define lc (obj-c2 frame))
   (define frame-color (obj-color frame))
   (define (outside-frame? r c)
     (not (and (<= fr r lr) (<= fc c lc))))
   (define arrows
     (for*/list ([r (in-range (- (rows g) 2))]
                 [c (in-range (- (cols g) 3))]
                 #:when
                 (let ([s (cell-at g r c)] [t (cell-at g r (+ c 3))])
                   (and (not (= s t))
                        (not (member s (list bg frame-color)))
                        (not (member t (list bg frame-color)))
                        (for*/and ([dr (in-range 3)] [dc (in-range 4)])
                          (and (outside-frame? (+ r dr) (+ c dc))
                               (= (cell-at g (+ r dr) (+ c dc))
                                  (if (or (< dc 2) (and (= dr 1) (= dc 2)))
                                      s t)))))))
       (list r c (cell-at g r c) (cell-at g r (+ c 3)))))
   (when (empty? arrows) (error "legend-templates: missing arrows"))
   (define excluded (make-hash))
   (define mapping (make-hash))
   (for ([a (in-list arrows)])
     (define s (third a))
     (define t (fourth a))
     (when (and (hash-has-key? mapping s) (not (= (hash-ref mapping s) t)))
       (error "legend-templates: conflicting arrows"))
     (hash-set! mapping s t)
     (for* ([dr (in-range 3)] [dc (in-range 4)])
       (hash-set! excluded (list (+ (first a) dr) (+ (second a) dc)) #t)))
   (define external (make-hash))
   (for* ([r (in-range (rows g))] [c (in-range (cols g))])
     (define v (cell-at g r c))
     (when (and (outside-frame? r c)
                (not (= v bg)) (not (= v frame-color))
                (not (hash-has-key? excluded (list r c))))
       (hash-update! external v (lambda (points) (cons (list r c) points)) '())))
   (define templates (make-hash))
   (for ([(color points) (in-hash external)])
     (define top (apply min (map first points)))
     (define left (apply min (map second points)))
     (hash-set! templates color
                (for/list ([p (in-list points)])
                  (list (- (first p) top) (- (second p) left)))))
   (define blocks
     (filter (lambda (o)
               (and (< fr (obj-r1 o)) (< (obj-r2 o) lr)
                    (< fc (obj-c1 o)) (< (obj-c2 o) lc)
                    (= (obj-h o) (obj-w o))
                    (= (obj-size o) (* (obj-h o) (obj-w o)))))
             components))
   (define (mapped-color original)
     (let walk ([color original] [remaining 1])
       (if (or (zero? remaining) (not (hash-has-key? mapping color)))
           color
           (walk (hash-ref mapping color) (sub1 remaining)))))
   (define painted (make-hash))
   (for ([block (in-list blocks)])
     (define original (obj-color block))
     (unless (and (hash-has-key? templates original)
                  (hash-has-key? mapping original))
       (error "legend-templates: block lacks original template or arrow"))
     (define mask (hash-ref templates original))
     (unless (and (= (add1 (apply max (map first mask))) (obj-h block))
                  (= (add1 (apply max (map second mask))) (obj-w block)))
       (error "legend-templates: template and square sizes differ"))
     (define target (mapped-color original))
     (for* ([dr (in-range (obj-h block))] [dc (in-range (obj-w block))])
       (hash-set! painted (list (+ (obj-r1 block) dr) (+ (obj-c1 block) dc))
                  (if (member (list dr dc) mask) target bg))))
   (grid-from-fn (obj-h frame) (obj-w frame)
     (lambda (r c)
       (define source-r (+ fr r))
       (define source-c (+ fc c))
       (hash-ref painted (list source-r source-c)
                 (lambda () (cell-at g source-r source-c)))))))

      (define mask (normalize-cells raw))
      (for*/fold ((acc out)) ((rr (range 0 (- (obj-h plate) 2))) (cc (range 0 (- (obj-w plate) 2))))
       (set-cell acc (+ (obj-r1 plate) 1 rr) (+ (obj-c1 plate) 1 cc)
        (if (member (list rr cc) mask) bg color))))))
   (define bounds (bbox-of-cells (apply append (map obj-cells plates))))
   (subgrid painted (- (first bounds) 1) (- (second bounds) 1)
                    (+ (third bounds) 1) (+ (fourth bounds) 1)))))

(rule!
 ;; Two disconnected figures share an outline color. One is a colored guide;
 ;; the other is an uncolored target whose enclosed cavities may be deformed.
 ;; Isolate each 8-connected figure before cropping (their bounding boxes can
 ;; overlap). Extract its four-connected enclosed non-outline regions. Match
 ;; regions in spatial order: bounding-box center row, then center column.
 ;; Transfer each guide region's color to the corresponding target cavity;
 ;; preserve the target outline and exterior, returning its tight bounding box.
 (lambda (g)
  (let ()
   (define bg (mode g -1))
   (define figures (objects-multicolor g bg))
   (define (colors obj)
    (remove-duplicates (map (lambda (p) (at g (first p) (second p))) (obj-cells obj))))
   (define target-object (first (filter (lambda (o) (= (length (colors o)) 1)) figures)))
   (define guide-object (first (filter (lambda (o) (> (length (colors o)) 1)) figures)))
   (define wall (first (colors target-object)))
   (define (isolated-crop obj)
    (build-grid (obj-h obj) (obj-w obj) (r c)
     (let ((p (list (+ (obj-r1 obj) r) (+ (obj-c1 obj) c))))
      (if (member p (obj-cells obj)) (at g (first p) (second p)) bg))))
   (define guide (isolated-crop guide-object))
   (define target (isolated-crop target-object))
   (define (region<? a b)
    (let* ((aa (bbox-of-cells a)) (bb (bbox-of-cells b))
           (ay (+ (first aa) (third aa))) (by (+ (first bb) (third bb)))
           (ax (+ (second aa) (fourth aa))) (bx (+ (second bb) (fourth bb))))
     (if (= ay by) (< ax bx) (< ay by))))
   (define (cavities canvas)
    (sort
     (filter
      (lambda (cells)
       (andmap (lambda (p) (and (> (first p) 0) (> (second p) 0)
                                (< (first p) (- (rows canvas) 1))
                                (< (second p) (- (cols canvas) 1)))) cells))
      (find-0-regions (cellmap canvas (r c v) (if (= v wall) wall bg)) bg))
     region<?))
   (define guide-regions (cavities guide))
   (define target-regions (cavities target))
   ;; Parallel clauses deliberately zip the already matched region lists.
   (for/fold ((out target)) ((source-region guide-regions) (target-region target-regions))
    (let ()
     (define paint? #t)
     (define color (at guide (first (first source-region)) (second (first source-region))))
     (if paint? (recolor-cells out target-region color) out))))))

(rule!
 ;; The only yellow object is a contiguous segment on one outside edge.
 ;; It defines an inward axis and a band of the same width. Overwrite that
 ;; band with yellow, background, yellow, background, green, background,
 ;; repeated from the marker. On green stripes, recolor every original
 ;; foreground pixel on the whole transverse line, not the gaps between them.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define bg (mode g -1))
     (define marker (find-color g 4))
     (if (null? marker) g
       (let ()
         (define rlo (min-of first marker))
         (define rhi (max-of first marker))
         (define clo (min-of second marker))
         (define chi (max-of second marker))
         (define horizontal (= rlo rhi))
         (define forward (if horizontal (= rlo 0) (= clo 0)))
         (define lo (if horizontal clo rlo))
         (define hi (if horizontal chi rhi))
         (define (depth r c)
           (if horizontal (if forward r (- h 1 r))
                          (if forward c (- w 1 c))))
         (cellmap g (r c v)
           (let* ((d (depth r c))
                  (t (if horizontal c r))
                  (green (= (modulo d 6) 4)))
             (cond ((and (<= lo t) (<= t hi))
                    (cond (green 3) ((= (modulo d 2) 0) 4) (else bg)))
                   ((and green (not (= v bg))) 3)
                   (else v)))))))))

(rule!
 ;; Singleton colored dots encode a miniature pattern on a spaced lattice.
 ;; Larger solid squares are partial evidence for an enlarged copy. Infer
 ;; their common side length, lattice pitch and translation by matching all
 ;; seed colors and relative coordinates against the miniature. Require a
 ;; unique in-bounds registration disjoint from the miniature, then complete
 ;; every non-background template cell as a square. Keep the miniature intact.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define bg (mode g -1))
     (define obs (objects g bg))
     (define dots (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-size o) 1)) obs))
     (define blocks (filter (lambda (o) (> (obj-size o) 1)) obs))
     (if (or (null? dots) (null? blocks)) g
       (let ()
         (define side (obj-h (first blocks)))
         (define top (min-of obj-r1 dots))
         (define left (min-of obj-c1 dots))
         (define bottom (max-of obj-r1 dots))
         (define right (max-of obj-c1 dots))
         (define differences
           (filter (lambda (n) (> n 0))
             (append (for*/list ((a dots) (b dots)) (abs (- (obj-r1 a) (obj-r1 b))))
                     (for*/list ((a dots) (b dots)) (abs (- (obj-c1 a) (obj-c1 b)))))))
         (if (null? differences) g
           (let ()
             (define spacing (min-list differences))
             (define nr (+ 1 (quotient (- bottom top) spacing)))
             (define nc (+ 1 (quotient (- right left) spacing)))
             (define pattern
               (map (lambda (o) (list (quotient (- (obj-r1 o) top) spacing)
                                     (quotient (- (obj-c1 o) left) spacing) (obj-color o))) dots))
             (define (value r c)
               (let ((p (find-first (lambda (p) (and (= (first p) r) (= (second p) c))) pattern)))
                 (if p (third p) bg)))
             (define first-block (first blocks))
             (define candidates
               (filter
                 (lambda (reg)
                   (let* ((ar (first reg)) (ac (second reg)) (pitch (third reg))
                          (endr (+ ar (* (- nr 1) pitch) side))
                          (endc (+ ac (* (- nc 1) pitch) side)))
                     (and (>= ar 0) (>= ac 0) (<= endr h) (<= endc w)
                          (or (<= endr top) (> ar bottom) (<= endc left) (> ac right))
                          (all? (lambda (b)
                                  (let ((dr (- (obj-r1 b) ar)) (dc (- (obj-c1 b) ac)))
                                    (and (= (obj-h b) side) (= (obj-w b) side)
                                         (= (obj-size b) (* side side))
                                         (>= dr 0) (>= dc 0)
                                         (= (modulo dr pitch) 0) (= (modulo dc pitch) 0)
                                         (= (value (quotient dr pitch) (quotient dc pitch)) (obj-color b))))) blocks))))
                 (for*/list ((pitch (range (+ side 1) (+ (max h w) 1)))
                             (p pattern) #:when (= (third p) (obj-color first-block)))
                   (list (- (obj-r1 first-block) (* (first p) pitch))
                         (- (obj-c1 first-block) (* (second p) pitch)) pitch))))
             (if (not (= (length candidates) 1)) g
               (let* ((reg (first candidates)) (ar (first reg)) (ac (second reg)) (pitch (third reg)))
                 (cellmap g (r c v)
                   (let ((dr (- r ar)) (dc (- c ac)))
                     (if (and (>= dr 0) (>= dc 0)
                              (< (quotient dr pitch) nr) (< (quotient dc pitch) nc)
                              (< (modulo dr pitch) side) (< (modulo dc pitch) side))
                       (let ((color (value (quotient dr pitch) (quotient dc pitch))))
                         (if (= color bg) v color))
                       v))))))))))))

(rule!
 ;; Decode the isolated symbol map around its template-colored anchor.
 ;; Map spacing encodes tile offsets, not physical stamp spacing: each
 ;; target displacement is multiplied by the template bounding-box size.
 ;; Erase the map, recolor the central template to the symbol color, and
 ;; stamp the template ink at each remote target in the original ink color.
 (lambda (g)
  (let ()
   (define holes? #f)
   (define bg (mode g -1))
   (define obs (objects g bg))
   (define shape (pick-max obs obj-size))
   (if (or (not shape) (<= (obj-size shape) 1)) g
    (let ()
     (define ink (obj-color shape))
     (define tokens (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-size o) 1)) obs))
     (define anchors (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) ink)) tokens))
     (define marks (filter (lambda (o) (not (= (obj-color o) ink))) tokens))
     (if (or (not (= (length anchors) 1)) (null? marks)) g
      (let ()
       (define anchor (first anchors))
       (define tint (obj-color (first marks)))
       (define (gcd2 a b) (if (= b 0) a (gcd2 b (modulo a b))))
       (define (pitch coord)
        (define nums (sort (remove-duplicates (map coord tokens)) <))
        (if (< (length nums) 2) 1
         (for/fold ((v 0)) ((x (rest nums))) (gcd2 v (- x (first nums))))))
       (define pr (pitch obj-r1))
       (define pc (pitch obj-c1))
       (define sh (obj-h shape))
       (define sw (obj-w shape))
       (define rr (obj-r1 shape))
       (define cc (obj-c1 shape))
       (define cellmask
        (for*/list ((r (range sh)) (c (range sw))
          #:when (if holes? (= (at g (+ rr r) (+ cc c)) bg)
                             (= (at g (+ rr r) (+ cc c)) ink))) (list r c)))
       (define center (recolor-cells (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) bg)
                                     (obj-cells shape) tint))
       (for/fold ((out center)) ((mark marks))
        (define tr (+ rr (* sh (/ (- (obj-r1 mark) (obj-r1 anchor)) pr))))
        (define tc (+ cc (* sw (/ (- (obj-c1 mark) (obj-c1 anchor)) pc))))
        (paint-cells out (map (lambda (p) (list (+ tr (first p)) (+ tc (second p)))) cellmask) ink)))))))))

(rule!
 ;; Rotate every horizontal three-cell orange gate into a vertical magenta
 ;; barrier, making cyan elbows on either side. On each resulting simple cyan
 ;; track, gather its original green endpoint tokens at the lower endpoint,
 ;; packed along the track without loss. Flat tracks keep their token positions.
 ;; Thus the new gate-derived topology, not the old horizontal rails, controls
 ;; both the destination and the number of tokens that settle there.
 (lambda (g)
  (let ()
   (define prefer-lower? #t)
   (define initial (recolor g 3 8))
   (define gates
    (filter (lambda (o) (and (= (obj-color o) 7) (= (obj-size o) 3)
                            (= (obj-h o) 1) (= (obj-w o) 3)
                            (> (obj-r1 o) 0) (< (obj-r1 o) (- h 1))))
            (objects g 0)))
   (define rotated
    (for/fold ((out initial)) ((o gates))
     (let* ((r (obj-r1 o)) (c (+ (obj-c1 o) 1))
            (sides (set-cell (set-cell out r (- c 1) 8) r (+ c 1) 8)))
      (for/fold ((z sides)) ((rr (range (- r 1) (+ r 2))))
       (set-cell z rr c 6)))))
   (define routing-grid rotated)
   (define cyan (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) 8)) (objects routing-grid 0)))
   (define (neighbors p cells)
    (filter (lambda (q) (member q cells))
     (map (lambda (d) (list (+ (first p) (first d)) (+ (second p) (second d)))) cardinal-deltas)))
   (define (walk p prev cells left)
    (if (<= left 0) '()
     (let ((next (filter (lambda (q) (not (equal? q prev))) (neighbors p cells))))
      (cons p (if (null? next) '() (walk (first next) p cells (- left 1)))))))
   (for/fold ((out rotated)) ((o cyan))
    (let* ((cells (obj-cells o))
           (tokens (filter (lambda (p) (= (at g (first p) (second p)) 3)) cells))
           (ends (sort (filter (lambda (p) (<= (length (neighbors p cells)) 1)) cells) cell<))
           (destinations
            (if (or (null? tokens) (not (= (length ends) 2))
                    (= (first (first ends)) (first (second ends))))
             tokens
             (take (walk (if prefer-lower? (second ends) (first ends)) '() cells (length cells))
                   (length tokens)))))
     (for/fold ((z out)) ((p destinations))
      (set-cell z (first p) (second p) 3)))))))

(rule!
 ;; Each foreground color is a possibly disconnected silhouette. Background is
 ;; the most frequent color (smallest color on ties). For each silhouette infer
 ;; the vertical axis retaining the most same-color mirror pairs. Count axis
 ;; cells once; take the leftmost doubled axis on ties. Erase unsupported pixels.
 (lambda (g)
  (let ()
   (define colors (grid-colors g))
   (define background
    (for/fold ((best (first colors))) ((color (in-list colors)))
     (if (> (count-color g color) (count-color g best)) color best)))
   (define (axis-for cells)
    (define lo (min-of second cells))
    (define hi (max-of second cells))
    (define scored
     (for/fold ((best (list -1 (* 2 lo)))) ((k (in-range (* 2 lo) (+ 1 (* 2 hi)))))
      (let ((score (count-if (lambda (p) (member (list (first p) (- k (second p))) cells)) cells)))
       (if (> score (first best)) (list score k) best))))
    (second scored))
   (for/fold ((out g)) ((color (in-list (grid-colors g background))))
    (let* ((cells (find-color g color)) (axis (axis-for cells)))
     (for/fold ((acc out)) ((p (in-list cells)))
      (if (member (list (first p) (- axis (second p))) cells)
          acc
          (set-cell acc (first p) (second p) background))))))))

(rule!
 (let* ((turn-pattern #f)
        (bg (mode g -1))
        (foreground (grid-from-fn (rows g) (cols g)
                      (lambda (r c) (if (= (at g r c) bg) 0 1))))
        (components (objects foreground 0))
        (board-object (argmax (lambda (o) (* (obj-h o) (obj-w o))) components))
        (board-box (obj-bbox board-object))
        (board (crop g (first board-box) (second board-box)
                       (third board-box) (fourth board-box)))
        (loose (filter (lambda (o) (not (equal? o board-object))) components))
        (hole-count
          (lambda (patch)
            (length (objects (grid-from-fn (rows patch) (cols patch)
                               (lambda (r c) (if (= (at patch r c) bg) 1 0))) 0))))
        (patterns (map (lambda (o)
                         (let* ((box (obj-bbox o))
                                (patch (crop g (first box) (second box) (third box) (fourth box))))
                           (list (hole-count patch) patch box))) loose))
        (n (rows (second (first patterns))))
        (side (+ n 2))
        (matches
          (for*/list ((r (in-range 0 (rows board) side))
                      (c (in-range 0 (cols board) side)))
            (let* ((tile (crop board r c (+ r side -1) (+ c side -1)))
                   (clue (hole-count tile))
                   (pattern (first (filter (lambda (p) (= (first p) clue)) patterns))))
              (list r c (at tile 0 0) clue (second pattern) (third pattern))))))
   (for/fold ((out (grid-from-fn (rows board) (cols board) (lambda (r c) bg)))) ((match (in-list matches)))
     (let* ((r0 (first match)) (c0 (second match)) (base (third match))
            (patch (if turn-pattern (rotate-cw (fifth match)) (fifth match))))
       (for*/fold ((next out)) ((r (in-range side)) (c (in-range side)))
         (set-cell next (+ r0 r) (+ c0 c)
           (if (and (< 0 r (- side 1)) (< 0 c (- side 1))
                    (not (= (at patch (- r 1) (- c 1)) bg)))
               (at patch (- r 1) (- c 1)) base)))))))

(rule!
 (lambda (g)
  (define columns? #t)
  (define separator
   (first (filter (lambda (c)
     (all? (lambda (r) (= (at g r c) 4)) (range (rows g)))) (range (cols g)))))
  (define canvas (map (lambda (row) (drop row (+ separator 1))) g))
  (define marker
   (first (for*/list ([r (in-range (rows canvas))] [c (in-range (cols canvas))]
                      #:when (= (at canvas r c) 5)) (list r c))))
  (define (tile p)
   (for/list ([dr (in-range 3)])
    (for/list ([dc (in-range 3)]) (at g (+ (first p) dr) (+ (second p) dc)))))
  (define slots
   (filter (lambda (p) (any? (lambda (v) (> v 0)) (apply append (tile p))))
    (for*/list ([r (in-range 0 (- (rows g) 2) 4)]
                [c (in-range 0 (- separator 2) 4)]) (list r c))))
  (define ordered-slots
   (sort slots (lambda (a b)
    (if columns?
     (or (< (second a) (second b))
         (and (= (second a) (second b)) (< (first a) (first b))))
     (or (< (first a) (first b))
         (and (= (first a) (first b)) (< (second a) (second b))))))))
  (define (decode p)
   (let* ([cells (tile p)]
          [ink (first (filter (lambda (v) (> v 0)) (apply append cells)))]
          [mask (map (lambda (row) (map (lambda (v) (if (= v 0) 0 1)) row)) cells)]
          [motion (cond
           [(equal? mask '((1 1 0) (1 0 1) (0 1 0))) (list 0 1 3)]
           [(equal? mask '((1 0 1) (1 0 1) (1 1 1))) (list 0 -1 2)]
           [(equal? mask '((1 1 1) (0 1 0) (1 0 1))) (list 0 -1 4)]
           [(equal? mask '((1 0 1) (0 1 0) (0 1 0))) (list 1 0 2)]
           [else (error 'glyph "unknown glyph")])])
    (cons ink motion)))
  (define commands (map decode ordered-slots))
  (define instructions commands)
  (define result
   (for/fold ([state (list canvas (first marker) (second marker))]) ([cmd instructions])
    (let* ([sr (+ 1 (second state))] [sc (third state)]
           [dr (second cmd)] [dc (third cmd)] [n (fourth cmd)]
           [cells (for/list ([k (in-range n)]) (list (+ sr (* k dr)) (+ sc (* k dc))))]
           [endpoint (last cells)])
     (list (paint-cells (first state) cells (first cmd)) (first endpoint) (second endpoint)))))
  (first result)))

(rule!
 ;; Bottom red bars identify donor stacks; one green bar identifies a receiver.
 ;; Count donor objects, rather than their pixels. Gray the donor objects, remove
 ;; the command bars and add their total count above the receiver stack. The
 ;; receiver's actual top shape, color and measured stacking pitch are preserved.
 ;; A: aligned stack counts and geometry. B: render that many shifted copies.
 (lambda (g)
  (let ()
   (define bg (mode g -1))
   (define objs (objects g bg))
   (define marker-y (apply max (map obj-r2 objs)))
   (define markers
    (filter (lambda (o) (and (= (obj-r1 o) marker-y) (= (obj-h o) 1)
                              (or (= (obj-color o) 2) (= (obj-color o) 3)))) objs))
   (define bodies (filter (lambda (o) (not (member o markers))) objs))
   (define donors (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) 2)) markers))
   (define receiver-mark (first (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) 3)) markers)))
   (define (stack m)
    (filter (lambda (o) (and (= (obj-c1 o) (obj-c1 m)) (= (obj-c2 o) (obj-c2 m)))) bodies))
   (define donor-counts (map (lambda (m) (length (stack m))) donors))
   (define amount (apply + donor-counts))
   (define receiver (stack receiver-mark))
   (define top (pick-min receiver obj-r1))
   (define bottom (pick-max receiver obj-r1))
   (define pitch (+ (obj-h bottom) (- marker-y (obj-r2 bottom) 1)))
   (define cleared
    (for/fold ((out g)) ((m markers)) (recolor-cells out (obj-cells m) bg)))
   (define grayed
    (for*/fold ((out cleared)) ((m donors) (o (stack m)))
     (recolor-cells out (obj-cells o) 5)))
   (for/fold ((out grayed)) ((k (range 1 (+ amount 1))))
    (recolor-cells out
     (map (lambda (p) (list (- (first p) (* k pitch)) (second p))) (obj-cells top))
     (obj-color top))))))

(rule!
 ;; Assemble the scattered pieces by translation, never rotation. The modal
 ;; background is excluded. Foreground area determines rectangle area; retain
 ;; the most densely occupied candidate rectangle (unique in the grammar).
 ;; Solve the remaining cavities with external same-color 8-components.
 (lambda (g)
  (let ()
   (define selection 0)
   (define bg (pick-max (grid-colors g) (lambda (v) (count-color g v))))
   (define fg (filter (lambda (p) (not (= (at g (first p) (second p)) bg))) (grid-positions g)))
   (define n (length fg))
   (define candidates
    (for*/list ((hh (range 1 (+ h 1))) #:when (= (modulo n hh) 0)
                (ww (list (/ n hh))) #:when (and (> ww 0) (<= ww w))
                (rr (range 0 (+ 1 (- h hh)))) (cc (range 0 (+ 1 (- w ww)))))
     (list (count-if (lambda (p) (and (<= rr (first p)) (< (first p) (+ rr hh))
                                     (<= cc (second p)) (< (second p) (+ cc ww)))) fg)
           rr cc hh ww)))
   (define b (pick-max candidates first))
   (define r0 (second b))
   (define c0 (third b))
   (define hh (fourth b))
   (define ww (fifth b))
   (define scaffold (subgrid g r0 c0 (+ r0 hh -1) (+ c0 ww -1)))
   (define outside (build-grid h w (r c)
     (if (and (<= r0 r) (< r (+ r0 hh)) (<= c0 c) (< c (+ c0 ww))) bg (at g r c))))
   (define originals (objects-8 outside bg))
   (define ordered (sort originals (lambda (a b) (> (obj-size a) (obj-size b)))))
   (define (fit remaining board)
    (if (null? remaining)
        (if (= (count-color board bg) 0) '() #f)
        (let* ((p (first remaining)) (shape (normalize-cells (obj-cells p))))
         (for*/or ((rr (range 0 (+ 1 (- hh (obj-h p)))))
                   (cc (range 0 (+ 1 (- ww (obj-w p))))))
          (let ((cells (map (lambda (q) (list (+ rr (first q)) (+ cc (second q)))) shape)))
           (and (andmap (lambda (q) (= (at board (first q) (second q)) bg)) cells)
                (let ((tail (fit (rest remaining) (recolor-cells board cells (obj-color p)))))
                 (and tail (cons (list (index-of originals p) (obj-color p) cells) tail)))))))))
   (define placements (sort (or (fit ordered scaffold) '()) (lambda (a b) (< (first a) (first b)))))
   (define holes (find-color scaffold bg))
   (define chosen
    (cond ((null? placements) '())
          ((= selection 0) placements)
          ((= selection 1) (filter (lambda (p) (member (first holes) (third p))) placements))
          ((= selection 2) (list (first placements)))
          ((= selection 3) (list (pick-max placements (lambda (p) (length (third p))))))
          ((= selection 4) (list (pick-min placements (lambda (p) (length (third p))))))
          ((= selection 5) (filter (lambda (p) (member (last holes) (third p))) placements))
          ((= selection 6) (list (pick-min placements second)))
          ((= selection 7) (list (pick-max placements second)))
          (else '())))
   (if (= selection 9)
       (let* ((colors (remove-duplicates (map (lambda (p) (at scaffold (first p) (second p)))
                                   (filter (lambda (p) (not (= (at scaffold (first p) (second p)) bg)))
                                           (grid-positions scaffold)))))
              (color (pick-max colors (lambda (v) (count-color scaffold v)))))
        (recolor-cells scaffold holes color))
       (for/fold ((out scaffold)) ((p chosen)) (recolor-cells out (third p) (second p)))))))

(rule!
 ;; Remove the modal background. Trace the induced four-neighbor path from
 ;; the reading-order-first endpoint, preserving every cell and repeated run.
 ;; Canonical output is a vertical column in path order, not spatial order.
 (lambda (g)
  (let ()
   (define mode 0)
   (define rival 0)
   (define bg (pick-max (grid-colors g) (lambda (v) (count-color g v))))
   (define fg (filter (lambda (p) (not (= (at g (first p) (second p)) bg))) (grid-positions g)))
   (define (neighbors p)
    (filter (lambda (q) (and (in-bounds? (first q) (second q) h w)
                             (not (= (at g (first q) (second q)) bg))))
            (map (lambda (d) (list (+ (first p) (first d)) (+ (second p) (second d)))) cardinal-deltas)))
   (define ends (filter (lambda (p) (= (length (neighbors p)) 1)) fg))
   (define (walk p previous remaining)
    (if (= remaining 0) '()
        (let ((next (filter (lambda (q) (not (equal? q previous))) (neighbors p))))
         (cons (at g (first p) (second p))
               (if (null? next) '() (walk (first next) p (- remaining 1)))))))
   (define traced (walk (first ends) #f (length fg)))
   (define colors
    (cond ((= rival 2) (map (lambda (p) (at g (first p) (second p))) fg))
          ((= rival 3) (apply append (map (lambda (o) (make-list (obj-size o) (obj-color o))) (objects g bg))))
          ((= rival 4) (reverse traced))
          ((= rival 5) (sort traced <))
          ((= rival 6) (apply append (map (lambda (v) (make-list (count-if (lambda (x) (= x v)) traced) v)) (remove-duplicates traced))))
          (else traced)))
   (define runs
    (reverse
     (for/fold ((acc '())) ((v colors))
      (if (and (pair? acc) (= v (first (first acc))))
          (cons (cons v (first acc)) (rest acc))
          (cons (list v) acc)))))
   (define k (length (first runs)))
   (define candidates (rest runs))
   (define selected-index (modulo (- k 1) (length candidates)))
   (define answer
    (cond ((= rival 7) (first candidates))
          ((= rival 8) (last candidates))
          ((= rival 9) (pick-max candidates length))
          ((= rival 10) (pick-min candidates length))
          ((= rival 11) (list-ref candidates (modulo k (length candidates))))
          ((= rival 12) (first runs))
          ((= mode 0) colors)
          (else (list-ref candidates selected-index))))

(rule!
 ;; A green boundary source travels inward past edge-attached red barriers.
 ;; Each barrier's blue markers encode clearance equal to their count plus one.
 ;; Turn that far BEFORE its row, then pass that far beyond its free tip.
 ;; Continue in original travel order; all blue markers become red.
 ;; The alternate scope retains the longest lateral segment of the complete
 ;; inferred route, with the earliest-in-travel-order tie break.
 (lambda (g)
  (let ()
   (define scope 'full)
   (define selector 'length)
   (define fixed-clearance -1)
   (define margin 1)
   (define starts (find-color g 3))
   (define (turn x n) (if (= n 0) x (turn (rotate-cw x) (- n 1))))
   (if (not (= (length starts) 1)) g
    (let* ((source (first starts)) (rr (first source)) (cc (second source))
           (k (cond ((= rr 0) 0) ((= cc 0) 1)
                    ((= rr (- (rows g) 1)) 2) (else 3)))
           (t (turn g k)) (H (rows t)) (W (cols t))
           (start (first (find-color t 3)))
           (sr (first start)) (sc (second start)))
     (define walls
      (for/list ((r (range H))
        #:when (for/or ((c (range W))) (member (at t r c) '(1 2))))
       (define cs (filter (lambda (c) (member (at t r c) '(1 2))) (range W)))
       (list r (apply min cs) (apply max cs)
             (count (lambda (c) (= (at t r c) 1)) cs) (length cs))))
     (define (make-legs ws from)
      (if (null? ws) '()
       (let* ((wall (first ws)) (n (list-ref wall 3))
              (d (if (> fixed-clearance 0) fixed-clearance (+ n margin)))
              (to (if (= (second wall) 0) (+ (third wall) d) (- (second wall) d))))
        (cons (list (- (first wall) d) from to n (list-ref wall 4))
              (make-legs (rest ws) to)))))
     (define legs (make-legs walls sc))
     (define (cross leg)
      (for/list ((c (range (min (second leg) (third leg))
                           (+ 1 (max (second leg) (third leg))))))
       (list (first leg) c)))
     (define clean (recolor t 1 2))
     (define drawn
      (if (eq? scope 'full)
       (let ((state
        (for/fold ((st (list clean sr sc))) ((leg legs))
         (define near
          (paint-cells (first st)
           (for/list ((r (range (min (second st) (first leg))
                                (+ 1 (max (second st) (first leg))))))
            (list r (third st))) 3))
         (list (paint-cells near (cross leg) 3) (first leg) (third leg)))))
        (paint-cells (first state)
         (for/list ((r (range (second state) H))) (list r (third state))) 3))
       (if (null? legs) clean
        (let ((winner
          (cond ((eq? selector 'first) (first legs))
                ((eq? selector 'last) (last legs))
                ((eq? selector 'markers) (pick-max legs (lambda (x) (list-ref x 3))))
                ((eq? selector 'width) (pick-max legs (lambda (x) (list-ref x 4))))
                ((eq? selector 'initial-span) (pick-max legs (lambda (x) (abs (- (third x) sc)))))
                (else (pick-max legs (lambda (x) (abs (- (third x) (second x)))))))))
         (paint-cells clean (cross winner) 3)))))
     (turn drawn (modulo (- 4 k) 4)))))))

(rule!
 ;; A red tail identifies the launch direction at the yellow emitter.
 ;; Trace each beam until the first blue/green relay. Reached relays become red
 ;; and launch parallel beams outward from their green boundary port.
 ;; Unreached relays disappear. Re-entering an activated relay terminates that
 ;; beam; breadth-first activation assigns minimum relay-hop depths.

   (let ()
     (define mask (grid-from-fn h w (lambda (r c) (if (member (at g r c) '(1 3)) 1 0))))
     (define obs (objects mask 0))
     (define ids (range (length obs)))
     (define gun (first (find-color g 4)))
     (define launch
       (first (filter (lambda (d)
         (let ((rr (- (first gun) (first d))) (cc (- (second gun) (second d))))
           (and (<= 0 rr) (< rr h) (<= 0 cc) (< cc w) (= (at g rr cc) 2)))) cardinal-deltas)))
     (define (port o) (filter (lambda (p) (= (at g (first p) (second p)) 3)) (obj-cells o)))
     (define (exit-dir o)
       (let ((ps (port o)))
         (cond ((andmap (lambda (p) (= (first p) (obj-r1 o))) ps) '(-1 0))
               ((andmap (lambda (p) (= (first p) (obj-r2 o))) ps) '(1 0))
               ((andmap (lambda (p) (= (second p) (obj-c1 o))) ps) '(0 -1))
               (else '(0 1)))))
     (define (walk rr cc dr dc cells)
       (if (or (< rr 0) (>= rr h) (< cc 0) (>= cc w)) (list cells #f)
         (let* ((p (list rr cc))
                (hit (find-first (lambda (i) (member p (obj-cells (list-ref obs i)))) ids))
                (new (cons p cells)))
           (if hit (list new hit) (walk (+ rr dr) (+ cc dc) dr dc new)))))
     (define initial (grid-from-fn h w (lambda (r c) (if (member (at g r c) '(2 4)) 2 8))))
     (define state
       (let loop ((queue (list (list gun launch 0))) (depths (map (lambda (i) -1) ids)) (out initial))
         (if (null? queue) (list out depths)
           (let* ((item (first queue)) (p (first item)) (d (second item)) (depth (third item))
                  (ray (walk (+ (first p) (first d)) (+ (second p) (second d)) (first d) (second d) '()))
                  (hit (second ray)) (painted (recolor-cells out (first ray) 2)))
             (if (or (not hit) (>= (list-ref depths hit) 0))
                 (loop (rest queue) depths painted)
                 (let* ((o (list-ref obs hit)) (next-depth (+ depth 1))
                        (next-d (map (lambda (i) (if (= i hit) next-depth (list-ref depths i))) ids))
                        (emitted (map (lambda (p) (list p (exit-dir o) next-depth)) (port o))))
                   (loop (append (rest queue) emitted) next-d (recolor-cells painted (obj-cells o) 2))))))))
     (define result (first state))
     (define depths (second state))
     (define reached (filter (lambda (i) (> (list-ref depths i) 0)) ids))
     result)))

(rule!
 ;; A long nonzero vertical separator divides run codes from an empty field.
 ;; Each contiguous nonzero run supplies a color and a period equal to its length.
 ;; Starting adjacent to the separator, emit one pulse per period. Runs closer
 ;; to the separator paint last and win collisions. Zero gaps have no period.
 ;; Source rows may lie on either side; the direction always points away from
 ;; the code. Preserve the code, separator, and every unaffected input cell.
 (lambda (g)
  (let ()
   (define pulse-phase 'leading)
   (define (column-score c)
    (let loop ([r 0] [previous -1] [run 0] [best 0])
     (if (= r (rows g)) best
      (let* ([v (at g r c)] [n (if (= v 0) 0 (if (= v previous) (+ run 1) 1))])
       (loop (+ r 1) v n (max best n))))))
   (define separator (pick-max (range (cols g)) column-score))
   (define (run-records xs)
    (if (null? xs) '()
     (let* ([color (first xs)]
            [length (let count ([ys xs] [n 0])
                      (if (or (null? ys) (not (= (first ys) color))) n
                          (count (rest ys) (+ n 1))))]
            [tail (run-records (drop xs length))])
      (if (= color 0) tail (cons (list color length) tail)))))
   (for/fold ([out g]) ([r (range (rows g))])
    (define left (take (row g r) separator))
    (define right (drop (row g r) (+ separator 1)))
    (define facing-right (ormap (lambda (v) (not (= v 0))) left))
    (define source (if facing-right left (reverse right)))
    (define target-length (if facing-right (- (cols g) separator 1) separator))
    ;; A produces color/period records; B cannot construct pulse masks without them.
    (define records (run-records source))
    (for/fold ([painted out]) ([record records])
     (define period (second record))
     (define phase (if (equal? pulse-phase 'leading) 0 (- period 1)))
     (for/fold ([canvas painted]) ([k (range target-length)]
                                 #:when (= (modulo k period) phase))
      (set-cell canvas r (+ separator (* (if facing-right 1 -1) (+ k 1))) (first record))))))))

(rule!
 ;; Maroon cells are collected into the green box around the red marker.
 ;; Magenta 6 is an impassable wall; orange 7 is floor. Compute shortest
 ;; cardinal path distances from the marker, ignoring unreachable maroon cells.
 ;; Move the nearest reachable cells, up to the number of destination slots,
 ;; into the box in row-major order, including the red center slot. Vacated
 ;; sources become orange. Preserve excess, unreachable tokens, and all walls.
 ;; Distance ties use row-major order (an explicit totalization); generated
 ;; lessons avoid a tie at the capacity cutoff for either episode setting.
 (lambda (g)
  (let ()
   (define collection-order 'nearest)
   (define distance-mode 'geodesic)
   (define positions (grid-positions g))
   (define origin (first (filter (lambda (p) (= (at g (first p) (second p)) 2)) positions)))
   (define slots (filter (lambda (p) (member (at g (first p) (second p)) '(2 3))) positions))
   ;; A: two-list FIFO traversal builds an input-dependent immutable distance map.
   (define distance-map
    (let bfs ([front (list origin)] [back '()] [dist (hash origin 0)])
     (cond
      [(null? front) (if (null? back) dist (bfs (reverse back) '() dist))]
      [else
       (define p (first front))
       (define next
        (filter (lambda (q)
                  (and (in-bounds? (first q) (second q) (rows g) (cols g))
                       (not (= (at g (first q) (second q)) 6))
                       (not (hash-has-key? dist q))))
                (map (lambda (d) (list (+ (first p) (first d)) (+ (second p) (second d)))) cardinal-deltas)))
       (define updated (for/fold ([result dist]) ([q next]) (hash-set result q (+ 1 (hash-ref dist p)))))
       (bfs (rest front) (append (reverse next) back) updated)])))
   (define candidates
    (for/list ([p positions]
               #:when (and (= (at g (first p) (second p)) 9)
                           (or (equal? distance-mode 'manhattan) (hash-has-key? distance-map p))))
     (list p (if (equal? distance-mode 'manhattan)
                 (+ (abs (- (first p) (first origin))) (abs (- (second p) (second origin))))
                 (hash-ref distance-map p)))))
   ;; B consumes reachability and distance; geometry cannot be ranked first.
   (define ranked
    (sort candidates
     (lambda (a b)
      (if (= (second a) (second b)) (cell< (first a) (first b))
       (if (equal? collection-order 'nearest) (< (second a) (second b)) (> (second a) (second b)))))))
   (define selected (take ranked (min (length slots) (length ranked))))
   (define erased (recolor-cells g (map first selected) 7))
   (recolor-cells erased (take slots (length selected)) 9))))

     (for*/list ([ri (range (- (length rs) 1))] [ci (range (- (length cs) 1))]
                 #:when (and (>= (- (list-ref rs (+ ri 1)) (list-ref rs ri)) 4)
                             (>= (- (list-ref cs (+ ci 1)) (list-ref cs ci)) 4)))
       (list (+ (list-ref rs ri) 2) (+ (list-ref cs ci) 2)
             (- (list-ref rs (+ ri 1)) 2) (- (list-ref cs (+ ci 1)) 2))))
   (define (majority xs)
     (pick-max (sort (remove-duplicates xs) <)
               (lambda (v) (count-if (lambda (x) (= x v)) xs))))
   (for/fold ([out g]) ([box boxes])
     (let* ([r0 (first box)] [c0 (second box)] [r1 (third box)] [c1 (fourth box)]
            [horizontal (>= (- c1 c0) (- r1 r0))]
            [n (+ 1 (if horizontal (- c1 c0) (- r1 r0)))]
            [t (+ 1 (if horizontal (- r1 r0) (- c1 c0)))]
            [ring (at g (- r0 1) (- c0 1))])
       (define (cell i j) (if horizontal (at g (+ r0 j) (+ c0 i)) (at g (+ r0 i) (+ c0 j))))
       (define candidates
         (for/list ([p (range 1 (+ 1 (quotient n 2)))])
           (define motif
             (for/list ([phase (range p)])
               (for/list ([j (range t)])
                 (majority (for/list ([i (range phase n p)]) (cell i j))))))
           (define errors
             (for*/sum ([i (range n)] [j (range t)])
               (if (= (cell i j) (list-ref (list-ref motif (modulo i p)) j)) 0 1)))
           (list p errors motif)))
       ;; Earliest minimum = shortest period on a Hamming-error tie.
       (define recovered (pick-min candidates second))
       (define period (first recovered))
       (define motif (third recovered))
       ;; B consumes the recovered period and phase-specific motif.
       (for*/fold ([result out]) ([i (range n)] [j (range t)])
         (define expected (list-ref (list-ref motif (modulo i period)) j))
         (define rr (if horizontal (+ r0 j) (+ r0 i)))
         (define cc (if horizontal (+ c0 i) (+ c0 j)))
         (set-cell result rr cc
                   (if (and mark-errors (not (= (cell i j) expected))) ring expected)))))))

(rule!
 (let ()
   ;; Red line markers are mirror axes; a single red cell is a half-turn
   ;; center. Sources belong to their local 8-connected multicolor group,
   ;; NOT to all objects of the same color. Preserve all observed cells.
   (define turn-lines #f)
   (define bg (mode g -1))
   (define groups (objects-multicolor g bg))
   (for/fold ([out g]) ([obj groups])
     (define reds (filter (lambda (p) (= (at g (first p) (second p)) 2)) (obj-cells obj)))
     (define source (filter (lambda (p) (not (= (at g (first p) (second p)) 2))) (obj-cells obj)))
     (if (or (null? reds) (null? source)) out
         (let* ([box (bbox-of-cells reds)]
                [r0 (first box)] [c0 (second box)] [r1 (third box)] [c1 (fourth box)]
                [point (= (length reds) 1)]
                [horizontal (= r0 r1)]
                [center-r (+ r0 r1)] [center-c (+ c0 c1)])
           ;; A has recovered source cells and marker geometry/midpoint.
           ;; B consumes that geometry to place the newly copied source.
           (for/fold ([result out]) ([p source])
             (define r (first p))
             (define c (second p))
             (define rr (if (or turn-lines point horizontal) (- center-r r) r))
             (define cc (if (or turn-lines point (not horizontal)) (- center-c c) c))
             (if (and (in-bounds? rr cc h w) (= (at g rr cc) bg))
                 (set-cell result rr cc (at g r c)) result)))))))

(rule!
 ;; Slide each black 4-component right until it contacts the vertical gray wall.
 ;; Recover enclosed background holes, excluding the exterior and right strip.
 ;; Only hole cells two columns left of the wall project red through its right
 ;; strip. Open notches and holes behind a thicker black border do not project.
 ;; Largest mode selects the eligible cavity of greatest actual area; ties are
 ;; resolved top-to-bottom then left-to-right, never by bounding-box area.
 (lambda (g)
  (let ()
   (define largest? #f)
   (define bg (mode g -1))
   (define wall (for/first ((c (range w)) #:when (for/and ((r (range h))) (= (at g r c) 5))) c))
   (define shapes (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) 0)) (objects g bg)))
   (define blank (for*/fold ((out g)) ((o shapes) (p (obj-cells o)))
                   (set-cell out (first p) (second p) bg)))
   (define docked
     (for/fold ((out blank)) ((o shapes))
      (let ((delta (- wall 1 (obj-c2 o))))
       (for/fold ((acc out)) ((p (obj-cells o)))
        (set-cell acc (first p) (+ (second p) delta) 0)))))
   (define holes
    (filter (lambda (o)
      (and (= (obj-color o) bg) (> (obj-r1 o) 0) (< (obj-r2 o) (- h 1))
           (> (obj-c1 o) 0) (< (obj-c2 o) (- wall 1))))
      (objects docked -1)))
   (define eligible
    (filter (lambda (o) (ormap (lambda (p) (= (second p) (- wall 2))) (obj-cells o))) holes))
   (define ordered
    (sort eligible (lambda (a b)
     (or (> (obj-size a) (obj-size b))
         (and (= (obj-size a) (obj-size b))
              (or (< (obj-r1 a) (obj-r1 b))
                  (and (= (obj-r1 a) (obj-r1 b)) (< (obj-c1 a) (obj-c1 b)))))))))
   (define selected (if (and largest? (not (null? ordered))) (list (first ordered)) eligible))
   (define signal-rows
    (remove-duplicates
     (append-map (lambda (o) (map first (filter (lambda (p) (= (second p) (- wall 2))) (obj-cells o)))) selected)))
   (for*/fold ((out docked)) ((r signal-rows) (c (range (+ wall 1) w)))
    (set-cell out r c 2)))))

(rule!
 ;; Recover noisy, occluding rectangular layers from long straight runs.
 ;; Remove color specks and restore nonzero corruptions. Original zero cells
 ;; inside the reconstructed layers are holes. Surround chosen holes with
 ;; the other rectangle color, including outside edges, then mark centers 8.
 ;; The alternative keeps every largest four-connected hole cluster.
 (lambda (g)
  (let ()
   (define scope 'all)
   (define colors (filter (lambda (k) (not (= k 0))) (grid-colors g)))
   (define candidates (filter (lambda (o) (>= (obj-size o) 9)) (objects g 0)))
   (define (row-run? o r)
    (for/or ([c (range (obj-c1 o) (- (obj-c2 o) 1))])
     (and (member (list r c) (obj-cells o))
          (member (list r (+ c 1)) (obj-cells o))
          (member (list r (+ c 2)) (obj-cells o)))))
   (define (col-run? o c)
    (for/or ([r (range (obj-r1 o) (- (obj-r2 o) 1))])
     (and (member (list r c) (obj-cells o))
          (member (list (+ r 1) c) (obj-cells o))
          (member (list (+ r 2) c) (obj-cells o)))))
   (define rects
    (filter (lambda (v) v)
     (for/list ([o candidates])
      (let ([rs (filter (lambda (r) (row-run? o r)) (range (obj-r1 o) (+ (obj-r2 o) 1)))]
            [cs (filter (lambda (c) (col-run? o c)) (range (obj-c1 o) (+ (obj-c2 o) 1)))])
       (if (or (null? rs) (null? cs)) #f
        (list (obj-color o) (apply min rs) (apply min cs) (apply max rs) (apply max cs)))))))
   (define (overlap-votes a b color)
    (for*/sum ([r (range (max (second a) (second b)) (+ (min (fourth a) (fourth b)) 1))]
               [c (range (max (third a) (third b)) (+ (min (fifth a) (fifth b)) 1))])
     (if (= (at g r c) color) 1 0)))
   (define edges
    (filter (lambda (v) v)
     (for*/list ([i (range (length rects))] [j (range (+ i 1) (length rects))])
      (let* ([a (list-ref rects i)] [b (list-ref rects j)]
             [na (overlap-votes a b (first a))] [nb (overlap-votes a b (first b))])
       (cond [(or (= (first a) (first b)) (= na nb)) #f]
             [(< na nb) (list i j)] [else (list j i)])))))
   (define ordered
    (let loop ([done '()])
     (if (= (length done) (length rects)) done
      (let ([ready (find-first
                    (lambda (i) (and (not (member i done))
                     (for/and ([e edges]) (or (not (= (second e) i)) (member (first e) done)))))
                    (range (length rects)))])
       (if ready (loop (append done (list ready))) done)))))
   (define restored
    (for/fold ([out (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0)]) ([i ordered])
     (let ([a (list-ref rects i)])
      (for*/fold ([acc out]) ([r (range (second a) (+ (fourth a) 1))]
                              [c (range (third a) (+ (fifth a) 1))])
       (set-cell acc r c (first a))))))
   (define holes
    (for*/list ([r (range (rows g))] [c (range (cols g))]
                #:when (and (= (at g r c) 0) (not (= (at restored r c) 0))))
     (list r c (at restored r c))))
   (define hole-mask
    (grid-from-fn (rows g) (cols g)
     (lambda (r c) (if (and (= (at g r c) 0) (not (= (at restored r c) 0))) 1 0))))
   (define clusters (objects hole-mask 0))
   (define largest (if (null? clusters) 0 (apply max (map obj-size clusters))))
   (define selected-cells
    (apply append (map obj-cells (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-size o) largest)) clusters))))
   (define selected
    (if (eq? scope 'all) holes
     (filter (lambda (p) (member (list (first p) (second p)) selected-cells)) holes)))
   (define painted
    (for/fold ([out restored]) ([p selected])
     (let ([other (first (filter (lambda (k) (not (= k (third p)))) colors))])
      (for*/fold ([acc out]) ([dr '(-1 0 1)] [dc '(-1 0 1)])
       (let ([r (+ (first p) dr)] [c (+ (second p) dc)])
        (if (and (<= 0 r) (< r (rows g)) (<= 0 c) (< c (cols g)))
         (set-cell acc r c other) acc))))))
   (for/fold ([out painted]) ([p selected]) (set-cell out (first p) (second p) 8)))))

(rule!
 ;; Squares are nodes; same-color eight-connected pipe components are edges.
 ;; Infer background and pipe color structurally. The node color appearing
 ;; exactly twice identifies the endpoints. Find a minimum-hop route (or,
 ;; alternatively, minimum pipe-ink route). Break ties by node reading order.
 ;; Paint route pipes 5 and intermediate squares 3, preserving endpoints.
 (lambda (g)
  (let ()
   (define metric 'fewest_edges)
   (define bg (mode g -1))
   (define objs (objects-8 g bg))
   (define colors (filter (lambda (k) (not (= k bg))) (grid-colors g)))
   (define (square? o)
    (and (>= (obj-h o) 2) (= (obj-h o) (obj-w o))
         (= (obj-size o) (* (obj-h o) (obj-w o)))))
   (define pipe-color
    (first (filter (lambda (k)
      (for/or ([o objs]) (and (= (obj-color o) k) (not (square? o))))) colors)))
   (define nodes (filter (lambda (o) (not (= (obj-color o) pipe-color))) objs))
   (define pipes (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) pipe-color)) objs))
   (define endpoint-color
    (first (filter (lambda (k) (= (length (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) k)) nodes)) 2)) colors)))
   (define endpoints
    (filter (lambda (i) (= (obj-color (list-ref nodes i)) endpoint-color)) (range (length nodes))))
   (define (touches? a b)
    (for/or ([p (obj-cells a)])
     (for/or ([q (obj-cells b)])
      (and (<= (abs (- (first p) (first q))) 1)
           (<= (abs (- (second p) (second q))) 1)))))
   (define edges
    (for/list ([pipe pipes])
     (let ([ends (filter (lambda (i) (touches? pipe (list-ref nodes i))) (range (length nodes)))])
      (list (first ends) (second ends) (obj-cells pipe)))))
   (define (lex<? a b)
    (cond [(null? a) (not (null? b))] [(null? b) #f]
          [(< (first a) (first b)) #t] [(> (first a) (first b)) #f]
          [else (lex<? (rest a) (rest b))]))
   (define (state<? a b)
    (or (< (first a) (first b))
        (and (= (first a) (first b)) (lex<? (second a) (second b)))))
   (define route
    (let loop ([queue (list (list 0 (list (first endpoints)) '()))] [visited '()])
     (if (null? queue) (list 0 '() '())
      (let* ([ordered (sort queue state<?)] [state (first ordered)]
             [node (last (second state))])
       (cond [(member node visited) (loop (rest ordered) visited)]
             [(= node (second endpoints)) state]
             [else
              (let ([more
               (filter (lambda (v) v)
                (for/list ([i (range (length edges))])
                 (let* ([edge (list-ref edges i)]
                        [next (cond [(= (first edge) node) (second edge)]
                                    [(= (second edge) node) (first edge)] [else #f])])
                  (if (or (not next) (member next visited) (member next (second state))) #f
                   (list (+ (first state) (if (eq? metric 'fewest_edges) 1 (length (third edge))))
                         (append (second state) (list next))
                         (append (third state) (list i)))))))])
               (loop (append (rest ordered) more) (cons node visited)))])))))
   (define painted-pipes
    (for/fold ([out g]) ([i (third route)]) (paint-cells out (third (list-ref edges i)) 5)))
   (for/fold ([out painted-pipes]) ([i (second route)])
    (if (member i endpoints) out (paint-cells out (obj-cells (list-ref nodes i)) 3))))))

(rule!
 ;; The monochrome object is a stencil; the multicolor object is a tile.
 ;; Infer the background by frequency and segment all foreground with 8-neighbors.
 ;; Crop both roles tightly. An occupied stencil cell expands into one unchanged
 ;; tile, and an empty stencil cell expands into an equally sized background block.
 ;; The alternate family restricts the stencil to its largest 4-connected region,
 ;; breaking ties by reading order without shrinking the original stencil box.
 (lambda (g)
  (let ()
   (define selection "all")
   (define rival "")
   (define bg (mode g -1))
   (define groups (objects-multicolor g bg))
   (define (mono? o)
    (= (length (remove-duplicates
      (map (lambda (p) (at g (first p) (second p))) (obj-cells o)))) 1))
   (define mo (first (filter mono? groups)))
   (define to (first (filter (lambda (o) (not (mono? o))) groups)))
   (define mask (subgrid g (obj-r1 mo) (obj-c1 mo) (obj-r2 mo) (obj-c2 mo)))
   (define source-tile (subgrid g (obj-r1 to) (obj-c1 to) (obj-r2 to) (obj-c2 to)))
   (define regions (objects mask bg))
   (define effective (if (equal? rival "other_setting")
     (if (equal? selection "all") "largest" "all") selection))
   (define raw-active
    (cond
     [(equal? rival "first_component") (obj-cells (first regions))]
     [(equal? rival "last_component") (obj-cells (last regions))]
     [(equal? rival "smallest_component") (obj-cells (pick-min regions obj-size))]
     [(equal? effective "largest") (obj-cells (pick-max regions obj-size))]
     [else (filter (lambda (p) (not (= (at mask (first p) (second p)) bg))) (grid-positions mask))]))
   (define active
    (cond
     [(equal? rival "fill_stencil_box") (grid-positions mask)]
     [(equal? rival "flip_stencil")
      (map (lambda (p) (list (first p) (- (cols mask) 1 (second p)))) raw-active)]
     [else raw-active]))
   (define tile
    (cond
     [(equal? rival "transpose_tile") (transpose source-tile)]
     [(equal? rival "flip_tile") (flip-lr source-tile)]
     [(equal? rival "flat_tile")
      (empty-grid (rows source-tile) (cols source-tile) (first (grid-colors source-tile bg)))]
     [else source-tile]))
   (for/list ([r (in-range (* (rows mask) (rows tile)))])
    (for/list ([c (in-range (* (cols mask) (cols tile)))])
     (if (member (list (quotient r (rows tile)) (quotient c (cols tile))) active)
      (at tile (modulo r (rows tile)) (modulo c (cols tile))) bg))))))

(rule!
 ;; A four-color 4x4 hollow hub has one centered two-cell key on each side.
 ;; Keep that hub, erase source objects, and dock loose pieces of matching colors.
 ;; Rotations, not reflections, orient the centered contiguous two-cell neck
 ;; toward the destination key; rectangles with equivalent rotations are harmless.
 ;; Ignore colors absent from the hub. Preserve the original canvas and background.
 ;; Alternative: dock at the spatially opposite slot while retaining piece colors.
 (lambda (g)
  (let ()
   (define selection "matching")
   (define rival "")
   (define bg (mode g -1))
   (define groups (objects-multicolor g bg))
   (define (colors o)
    (remove-duplicates (map (lambda (p) (at g (first p) (second p))) (obj-cells o))))
   (define hub (first (filter (lambda (o) (> (length (colors o)) 1)) groups)))
   (define hr (obj-r1 hub))
   (define hc (obj-c1 hub))
   (define keys (list (at g hr (+ hc 1)) (at g (+ hr 1) (+ hc 3))
                      (at g (+ hr 3) (+ hc 1)) (at g (+ hr 1) hc)))
   (define parts (filter (lambda (o) (and (= (length (colors o)) 1)
                                        (member (first (colors o)) keys))) groups))
   (define selected (if (equal? rival "only_largest") (list (pick-max parts obj-size)) parts))
   (define base-shift (if (equal? selection "matching") 0 2))
   (define shift (cond [(equal? rival "other_setting") (- 2 base-shift)]
                       [(equal? rival "clockwise_slots") 1]
                       [(equal? rival "counterclockwise_slots") 3]
                       [else base-shift]))
   (define (color-index color ks)
    (for/first ([i (in-range 4)] #:when (= color (list-ref ks i))) i))
