   (define regions
    (objects (grid-from-fn (rows g) (cols g) (lambda (r c) (if (= (at g r c) wall) 0 1))) 0))
   (define (erode cells)
    (if (null? cells) '()
     (let* ((inside
       (filter (lambda (p)
        (andmap (lambda (d) (member (list (+ (first p) (first d)) (+ (second p) (second d))) cells)) all-8-deltas)) cells))
       (edge (filter (lambda (p) (not (member p inside))) cells)))
      (cons edge (erode inside)))))
   (define (marked layer)
    (filter (lambda (p) (not (= (at g (first p) (second p)) bg))) layer))
   (for/fold ((out g)) ((obj regions))
    (let ()
     (define cells (obj-cells obj))
     (define layers (erode cells))
     (define cue-depths (filter (lambda (d) (not (null? (marked (list-ref layers d))))) (range (length layers))))
     (define palette-size (if (null? cue-depths) 1 (+ 1 (apply max cue-depths))))
     (define palette
      (for/list ((d (range palette-size)))
       (let ((cues (marked (list-ref layers d))))
        (if (null? cues) bg
         (let ((colors (sort (remove-duplicates (map (lambda (p) (at g (first p) (second p))) cues)) <)))
          (pick-max colors (lambda (color) (count-if (lambda (p) (= (at g (first p) (second p)) color)) cues))))))))
     (define painting-layers layers)
     (for/fold ((acc out)) ((layer painting-layers) (depth (range (length painting-layers))))
      (let ((index (modulo depth palette-size)))
       (paint-cells acc layer (list-ref palette index)))))))))

(rule!
 ;; Edge-anchored straight poles hold bent monochrome 8-connected strands.
 ;; A strand starts beside the pole's inner endpoint. Its forward obstacle is
 ;; the nearest feasible non-role component, on the same transverse side.
 ;; Measure the strand's cell count and derive the obstacle's per-slice outer
 ;; contour. Approach that contour at unit diagonal speed, follow its surface,
 ;; then turn inward diagonally after its last slice. Stop at the measured
 ;; number of cells or the first canvas boundary. Other components are retained.
 (lambda (g)
  (let ()
   (define extra-length 0)
   (define contour-mode 'exact)
   (define bg (mode g -1))
   (define objs (objects-8 g bg))
   (define (coord p axis) (list-ref p axis))
   (define (point primary transverse axis)
     (if (= axis 0) (list primary transverse) (list transverse primary)))
   (define (extent cells axis smallest)
     (apply (if smallest min max) (map (lambda (p) (coord p axis)) cells)))
   ;; Role record: pole index, strand index, axis, direction, side, anchor.
   (define roles
     (apply append
      (for/list ([i (range (length objs))])
       (define o (list-ref objs i))
       (define cells (obj-cells o))
       (if (< (length cells) 2) '()
        (apply append
         (for/list ([axis '(0 1)])
          (define bound (if (= axis 0) h w))
          (define lo (extent cells axis #t))
          (define hi (extent cells axis #f))
          (define cross (- 1 axis))
          (if (or (not (= (extent cells cross #t) (extent cells cross #f)))
                  (and (not (= lo 0)) (not (= hi (- bound 1))))
                  (and (= lo 0) (= hi (- bound 1)))) '()
           (let* ([direction (if (= lo 0) 1 -1)]
                  [tip (if (= direction 1) hi lo)]
                  [base (extent cells cross #t)])
            (apply append
             (for/list ([side '(-1 1)])
              (define anchor (point tip (+ base side) axis))
              (define j (for/first ([k (range (length objs))]
                                   #:when (and (not (= k i)) (member anchor (obj-cells (list-ref objs k))))) k))
              (if (and j (andmap (lambda (p) (<= (* direction (- (coord p axis) tip)) 0))
                                (obj-cells (list-ref objs j))))
                  (list (list i j axis direction side anchor)) '())))))))))))
   (define used (apply append (map (lambda (role) (list (first role) (second role))) roles)))
   ;; Add a derived obstacle contour to each legal role record.
   (define records
    (filter (lambda (x) x)
     (for/list ([role roles])
      (define axis (list-ref role 2))
      (define direction (list-ref role 3))
      (define side (list-ref role 4))
      (define anchor (list-ref role 5))
      (define (forward p) (* direction (- (coord p axis) (coord anchor axis))))
      (define choices
       (filter (lambda (x) x)
        (for/list ([j (range (length objs))] #:unless (member j used))
         (define cells (obj-cells (list-ref objs j)))
         (define us (sort (remove-duplicates (map forward cells)) <))
         (if (<= (first us) 0) #f
          (let* ([edge (lambda (u)
                         (+ side (apply (if (< side 0) min max)
                           (map (lambda (p) (coord p (- 1 axis)))
                             (filter (lambda (p) (= (forward p) u)) cells)))))]
                 [contour (map (lambda (u) (list u (edge u))) us)]
                 [gap (first us)]
                 [delta (abs (- (second (first contour)) (coord anchor (- 1 axis))))])
           (if (> delta gap) #f (list gap delta j contour)))))))
      (if (null? choices) #f
       (let* ([ordered (sort choices (lambda (a b)
                       (or (< (first a) (first b))
                           (and (= (first a) (first b))
                                (or (< (second a) (second b))
                                    (and (= (second a) (second b)) (< (third a) (third b))))))))]
              [choice (first ordered)])
        (append role (list (fourth choice))))))))
   (define cleared
    (for/fold ([out g]) ([record records])
      (recolor-cells out (obj-cells (list-ref objs (second record))) bg)))
   (for/fold ([out cleared]) ([record records])
    (define source (list-ref objs (second record)))
    (define axis (list-ref record 2))
    (define direction (list-ref record 3))
    (define side (list-ref record 4))
    (define anchor (list-ref record 5))
    (define original-contour (list-ref record 6))
    (define extreme (apply (if (< side 0) min max) (map second original-contour)))
    (define contour (if (eq? contour-mode 'box)
                        (map (lambda (p) (list (first p) extreme)) original-contour)
                        original-contour))
    (define start-u (first (first contour)))
    (define end-u (first (last contour)))
    (define entry-x (second (first contour)))
    (define limit (+ (obj-size source) extra-length))
    (let loop ([u 0] [x (coord anchor (- 1 axis))] [canvas out])
      (if (>= u limit) canvas
       (let* ([next-x
               (cond [(= u 0) x]
                     [(< u start-u) (+ x (cond [(< x entry-x) 1] [(> x entry-x) -1] [else 0]))]
                     [(<= u end-u)
                      (define found (assoc u contour))
                      (if found (second found) x)]
                     [else (- x side)])]
              [p (point (+ (coord anchor axis) (* direction u)) next-x axis)])
        (if (not (in-bounds? (first p) (second p) h w)) canvas
            (loop (+ u 1) next-x (set-cell canvas (first p) (second p) (obj-color source)))))))))))

(rule!
 ;; Magenta markers occupy the left border; orange is empty background.
 ;; Launch a marker when its first encountered upper/lower rail pair has one
 ;; common color. Travel through orange, refreshing the active guide color
 ;; whenever equal-colored walls flank the current heading. A same-guide wall
 ;; ahead turns the marker through the unique open perpendicular direction;
 ;; another color, a blocked/ambiguous turn, or the edge stops it. Move only
 ;; the source marker and its endpoint. Black is a wall color, not background.
 (lambda (g)
  (let ()
   (define update-guide? #t)
   (define (wall? v) (and (>= v 0) (not (= v 6)) (not (= v 7))))
   (define (entry-color r)
    (let scan ((c 1))
     (cond ((>= c w) -1)
           ((not (= (at g r c) 7)) -1)
           (else
            (let ((a (safe-at g (- r 1) c -1)) (b (safe-at g (+ r 1) c -1)))
             (cond ((and (= a 7) (= b 7)) (scan (+ c 1)))
                   ((and (= a b) (wall? a)) a)
                   (else -1)))))))
   (define (route r c dr dc color seen fuel)
    (let* ((a (safe-at g (- r dc) (+ c dr) -1))
           (b (safe-at g (+ r dc) (- c dr) -1))
           (guide (if (and update-guide? (= a b) (wall? a)) a color))
           (state (list r c dr dc guide))
           (front (safe-at g (+ r dr) (+ c dc) -1)))
     (cond ((or (<= fuel 0) (member state seen)) (list r c))
           ((= front 7) (route (+ r dr) (+ c dc) dr dc guide (cons state seen) (- fuel 1)))
           ((= front guide)
            (let ((turns
                   (filter (lambda (d) (= (safe-at g (+ r (first d)) (+ c (second d)) -1) 7))
                           (list (list (- dc) dr) (list dc (- dr))))))
             (if (= (length turns) 1)
              (route r c (first (first turns)) (second (first turns)) guide (cons state seen) (- fuel 1))
              (list r c))))
           (else (list r c)))))
   (define starts
    (for/list ((r (range 1 (- h 1))) #:when (and (= (at g r 0) 6) (wall? (entry-color r))))
     (list r (entry-color r))))
   (define ends
    (map (lambda (s) (route (first s) 0 0 1 (second s) '() (* 32 h w))) starts))
   (define cleared
    (for/fold ((out g)) ((s starts)) (set-cell out (first s) 0 7)))
   (for/fold ((out cleared)) ((p ends)) (set-cell out (first p) (second p) 6)))))

(rule!
 ;; Binary fields contain thin black defects and stray blue impulses/tips.
 ;; Detect BOTH kinds on the original grid, preserving narrow structural channels.
 ;; Erase stray blue, then outline black defects in orange using 8-neighbors.
 ;; A solid 2x2 core distinguishes structural components from thin defects.
 (lambda (g)
  (let ()
   (define (adj p ds)
     (filter (lambda (q) (in-bounds? (first q) (second q) h w))
       (map (lambda (d) (list (+ (first p) (first d)) (+ (second p) (second d)))) ds)))
   (define (has-core? o)
     (for/or ([p (obj-cells o)])
       (and (member (list (+ (first p) 1) (second p)) (obj-cells o))
            (member (list (first p) (+ (second p) 1)) (obj-cells o))
            (member (list (+ (first p) 1) (+ (second p) 1)) (obj-cells o)))))
   (define blues (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) 1)) (objects g -1)))
   (define blacks (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) 0)) (objects g -1)))
   (define stray
     (remove-duplicates (append
       (apply append (map obj-cells (filter (lambda (o) (not (has-core? o))) blues)))
       (filter (lambda (p)
          (<= (count-if (lambda (q) (= (at g (first q) (second q)) 1)) (adj p cardinal-deltas)) 1))
          (find-color g 1)))))
   (define holes
     (remove-duplicates (append
       (apply append (map obj-cells (filter (lambda (o) (not (has-core? o))) blacks)))
       (filter (lambda (p)
          (let* ([ns (adj p cardinal-deltas)]
                 [n (count-if (lambda (q) (= (at g (first q) (second q)) 1)) ns)])
            (or (>= n 3) (= n (length ns))))) (find-color g 0)))))
   (define clean (recolor-cells g stray 0))
   (define (outline ps)
     (filter (lambda (p) (not (member p holes)))
       (remove-duplicates (apply append (map (lambda (p) (adj p all-8-deltas)) ps)))))
   (define rims (outline holes))
   (define painted (recolor-cells clean rims 7))
   painted)))

(rule!
 ;; Recover the tight non-orange motif and its two-dimensional period.
 ;; Center two copies per axis; their foreground is maroon, the outer
 ;; continuation black. Orange is preserved. The admitted extension sets
 ;; output dimensions to 2*input+4; all official inputs are 6x6.
 ;; Tiling: translation; ablation: none.
 (lambda (g)
  (let ()
   (define raw (crop-to-content g 7))
   (define motif raw)
   (define mh (rows motif))
   (define mw (cols motif))
   (define HH (+ (* 2 h) 4))
   (define WW (+ (* 2 w) 4))
   (define sr (- (/ HH 2) mh))
   (define sc (- (/ WW 2) mw))
   (build-grid HH WW (r c)
    (let* ((dr (- r sr)) (dc (- c sc))
           (mr (modulo dr mh)) (mc (modulo dc mw)))
     (if (= (at motif mr mc) 7) 7
         (if (and (<= sr r) (< r (+ sr (* 2 mh))) (<= sc c) (< c (+ sc (* 2 mw)))) 9 0)))))))

(rule!
 ;; Decode colored anchors into four geometric 4x4 symbols.
 ;; A code immediately southeast of its exemplar is a legend, not a target.
 ;; Match only the exemplar's occupied cells: a real anchor can sit in a blank corner.
 ;; Ignore exemplar pixels, preserve canvas dimensions, and clip edge stamps.
 (lambda (g)
  (let ()
   (define (pixel code r c)
    (cond
     ((= code 2) (if (or (= r 0) (= r 3) (= c 0) (= c 3)) 4 0))
     ((= code 3) (if (or (and (or (= r 0) (= r 3)) (or (= c 1) (= c 2)))
                           (and (or (= c 0) (= c 3)) (or (= r 1) (= r 2)))) 1 0))
     ((= code 5) (if (or (and (< r 2) (< c 2)) (and (>= r 2) (>= c 2))) 6 0))
     ((= code 8) (if (or (= r c) (= (+ r c) 3)) 7 0))
     (else 0)))
   (define (legend? p)
    (let ((r (first p)) (c (second p)) (code (at g (first p) (second p))))
     (and (>= r 4) (>= c 4)
       (for*/and ((i (range 4)) (j (range 4)))
        (or (= (pixel code i j) 0)
            (= (at g (+ (- r 4) i) (+ (- c 4) j)) (pixel code i j)))))))
   (define targets
    (filter (lambda (p) (and (member (at g (first p) (second p)) '(2 3 5 8))
                             (not (legend? p)))) (grid-positions g)))
   (define decoded
    (for*/fold ((out (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g))))
      ((p targets) (i (range 4)) (j (range 4)))
     (let ((v (pixel (at g (first p) (second p)) i j))
           (r (+ (first p) i)) (c (+ (second p) j)))
      (if (and (> v 0) (in-bounds? r c (rows g) (cols g)))
          (set-cell out r c v) out))))
   ;; FINISH
   decoded)))

(rule!
 ;; Recover each complete 2- or 8-framed rectangle with a uniform interior different from frame and background.
 ;; Keep its row, size, frame and fill. Border-8 frames pack left; border-2 pack right.
 ;; Within each direction, process original columns nearest the destination first.
 ;; Every later placement consumes the UPDATED positions of overlapping prior boxes.
 ;; The majority cell value, including zero, is the background. No original-grid lookup.
 (lambda (g)
  (let ()
   (define bg (mode g -1))
   (define boxes
    (for*/list ((r (range (- (rows g) 2))) (c (range (- (cols g) 2)))
                #:when (and (not (= (at g (+ r 1) (+ c 1)) bg))
                            (member (at g r c) '(2 8))
                            (= (at g r c) (at g (+ r 1) c))
                            (= (at g r c) (at g r (+ c 1)))
                            (not (= (at g r c) (at g (+ r 1) (+ c 1)))))
                (rr (range (+ r 2) (rows g))) (cc (range (+ c 2) (cols g)))
                #:when (and (= (at g r c) (at g rr c))
                            (= (at g r c) (at g r cc))
                            (= (at g r c) (at g rr cc))
                   (for*/and ((i (range r (+ rr 1))) (j (range c (+ cc 1))))
                    (= (at g i j) (if (or (= i r) (= i rr) (= j c) (= j cc))
                                      (at g r c) (at g (+ r 1) (+ c 1)))))))
      (list r c (+ 1 (- rr r)) (+ 1 (- cc c)) (at g r c) (at g (+ r 1) (+ c 1)) c)))
   (define (priority left? a b)
    (if (= (second a) (second b)) (< (first a) (first b))
      (if left? (< (second a) (second b)) (> (second a) (second b)))))
   (define (settled-col o) (second o))
   (define (pack border left?)
    (define ordered
      (sort (filter (lambda (b) (= (list-ref b 4) border)) boxes)
            (lambda (a b) (priority left? a b))))
    (for/fold ((done '())) ((b ordered))
     (let* ((hits (filter (lambda (p)
                    (and (< (first b) (+ (first p) (third p)))
                         (< (first p) (+ (first b) (third b))))) done))
            (dest (if left?
                    (if (null? hits) 0
                        (apply max (map (lambda (o) (+ (settled-col o) (fourth o))) hits)))
                    (if (null? hits) (- (cols g) (fourth b))
                        (- (apply min (map settled-col hits)) (fourth b))))))
       (append done (list (list (first b) dest (third b) (fourth b)
                               (list-ref b 4) (list-ref b 5) (second b)))))))
   (define placed (append (pack 8 #t) (pack 2 #f)))
   (for*/fold ((out (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) bg)))
               ((b placed) (i (range (third b))) (j (range (fourth b))))
    (let ((r (+ (first b) i)) (c (+ (second b) j)))
     (if (in-bounds? r c (rows g) (cols g))
       (set-cell out r c
         (if (or (= i 0) (= j 0) (= i (- (third b) 1)) (= j (- (fourth b) 1)))
             (list-ref b 4) (list-ref b 5))) out))))))

(rule!
 ;; Assemble disconnected connector-bearing pieces by translation only. The
 ;; yellow piece stays fixed. Bodies never overlap; red connectors overlap in
 ;; pairs, and every connector must be consumed. Connector normals need not be
 ;; opposite: corner contacts are legal. The admitted grammar has one assembly.
 ;; In the alternative policy, recover the red-contact graph of that assembly
 ;; and recolor the unique deepest piece from the yellow anchor to cyan.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define output-policy "assemble")
     (define raw-pieces (objects-multicolor g 0))
     (define pieces
       (for/list ((o raw-pieces) (id (range (length raw-pieces))))
         (list id (for/list ((p (obj-cells o)))
                    (list (first p) (second p) (at g (first p) (second p)))))))
     (define (cells piece) (second piece))
     (define (reds triples)
       (for/list ((p triples) #:when (= (third p) 2)) (take p 2)))
     (define (yellow? piece) (for/or ((p (cells piece))) (= (third p) 4)))
     (define anchor (first (filter yellow? pieces)))
     (define anchor-id (first anchor))
     (define (shift piece dr dc)
       (list (first piece)
             (for/list ((p (cells piece)))
               (list (+ dr (first p)) (+ dc (second p)) (third p)))))
     (define (valid? piece board open)
       (for/and ((p (cells piece)))
         (and (in-bounds? (first p) (second p) h w)
              (or (= (at board (first p) (second p)) 0)
                  (and (= (third p) 2)
                       (= (at board (first p) (second p)) 2)
                       (member (take p 2) open))))))
     (define (options target pending board open)
       (for*/list ((piece pending) (port (reds (cells piece)))
                   #:do ((define moved (shift piece (- (first target) (first port))
                                                  (- (second target) (second port)))))
                   #:when (valid? moved board open))
         moved))
     (define (search placed pending board open)
       (cond
         ((null? pending) (and (null? open) placed))
         ((null? open) #f)
         (else
          (define choices
            (for/list ((target open)) (options target pending board open)))
          (define best (pick-min choices length))
          (for/or ((piece best))
            (define ports (reds (cells piece)))
            (define next-open
              (append (filter (lambda (p) (not (member p ports))) open)
                      (filter (lambda (p) (not (member p open))) ports)))
            (search (cons piece placed)
                    (filter (lambda (p) (not (= (first p) (first piece)))) pending)
                    (paint-cells board (cells piece)) next-open)))))
     (define solution
       (search (list anchor)
               (filter (lambda (p) (not (= (first p) anchor-id))) pieces)
               (paint-cells (empty-grid h w 0) (cells anchor)) (reds (cells anchor))))
     (define (joined? a b)
       (for/or ((p (reds (cells a)))) (member p (reds (cells b)))))
     (define (graph-depths entries)
       (let visit ((frontier (list anchor)) (seen (list anchor-id))
                   (depth 0) (distances (list (list anchor-id 0))))
         (define next
           (filter (lambda (p)
                     (and (not (member (first p) seen))
                          (for/or ((q frontier)) (joined? p q)))) entries))
         (if (null? next) distances
             (visit next (append seen (map first next)) (+ depth 1)
                    (append distances (map (lambda (p) (list (first p) (+ depth 1))) next))))))
     (define (top-left piece)
       (list (apply min (map first (cells piece)))
             (apply min (map second (cells piece)))))
     (define (render entries)
       (for/fold ((board (empty-grid h w 0))) ((p entries)) (paint-cells board (cells p))))
     (if (not solution) g
         (let* ((assembled (render solution))
                (ordered (sort solution < #:key first))
                (distances (graph-depths ordered))
                (moving (filter (lambda (p) (not (= (first p) anchor-id))) ordered))
                (origin (top-left anchor))
                (target
                  (cond
                    ((equal? output-policy "largest_original") (pick-max moving (lambda (p) (length (cells p)))))
                    ((equal? output-policy "smallest_original") (pick-min moving (lambda (p) (length (cells p)))))
                    ((equal? output-policy "most_ports") (pick-max moving (lambda (p) (length (reds (cells p))))))
                    ((equal? output-policy "last_input") (last moving))
                    ((equal? output-policy "shallowest") (pick-min moving (lambda (p) (second (assoc (first p) distances)))))
                    ((equal? output-policy "euclidean")
                     (pick-max moving (lambda (p)
                       (define pt (top-left p))
                       (+ (sqr (- (first pt) (first origin)))
                          (sqr (- (second pt) (second origin)))))))
                    (else (pick-max moving (lambda (p) (second (assoc (first p) distances))))))))
           (if (equal? output-policy "assemble") assembled
               (for/fold ((board assembled))
                         ((p (if (equal? output-policy "all_movers") moving (list target))))
                 (recolor-cells board
                   (map (lambda (c) (take c 2)) (filter (lambda (c) (not (= (third c) 2))) (cells p))) 8))))))))

(rule!
 ;; A full-height magenta divider separates a central canvas from one or two
 ;; instruction sidebars.  Each sidebar supplies a two-color texture, a
 ;; monochrome glyph, a corner cue, and a rotation cue.  Swap the two texture
 ;; colors, rotate the complete glyph, tile the swapped texture over every
 ;; glyph cell, and dock the sparse stamp at the requested canvas corner.
 (lambda (g)
  (let ()
   (define h (rows g))
   (define w (cols g))
   (define separator-cols
    (filter
     (lambda (c) (all? (lambda (r) (= (at g r c) 6)) (range 0 h)))
     (range 0 w)))
   (define bounds (append (list -1) separator-cols (list w)))
   (define segments
    (filter
     (lambda (segment) (<= (first segment) (second segment)))
     (for/list ((i (in-range 0 (- (length bounds) 1))))
      (list (+ (list-ref bounds i) 1)
            (- (list-ref bounds (+ i 1)) 1)))))
   (define (segment-width segment) (+ 1 (- (second segment) (first segment))))
   (define field-segment (pick-max segments segment-width))
   (define field
    (subgrid g 0 (first field-segment) (- h 1) (second field-segment)))
   (define sidebar-segments
    (filter (lambda (segment) (not (equal? segment field-segment))) segments))
   (define (object-colors canvas object)
    (sort
     (remove-duplicates
      (map (lambda (p) (at canvas (first p) (second p))) (obj-cells object)))
     <))
   (define (active-columns canvas)
    (filter
     (lambda (c) (any? (lambda (r) (!= (at canvas r c) 6)) (range 0 (rows canvas))))
     (range 0 (cols canvas))))
   (define (turn-grid canvas turns)
    (if (= turns 0) canvas (turn-grid (rotate-cw canvas) (- turns 1))))
   (define (parse-sidebar segment)
    (let ()
     (define sidebar (subgrid g 0 (first segment) (- h 1) (second segment)))
     (define horizontal-separators
      (filter
       (lambda (r) (all? (lambda (c) (= (at sidebar r c) 6)) (range 0 (cols sidebar))))
       (range 0 (rows sidebar))))
     (define top-end (first horizontal-separators))
     (define control-split (second horizontal-separators))
     (define top (subgrid sidebar 0 0 (- top-end 1) (- (cols sidebar) 1)))
     (define top-clean (cellmap top (r c v) (if (= v 6) 0 v)))
     (define top-objects (objects-multicolor top-clean 0))
     (define swatch-object
      (first
       (filter
        (lambda (object) (= (length (object-colors top-clean object)) 2))
        top-objects)))
     (define swatch-box (obj-bbox swatch-object))
     (define swatch
      (subgrid top-clean
               (first swatch-box) (second swatch-box)
               (third swatch-box) (fourth swatch-box)))
     (define swatch-colors
      (sort
       (remove-duplicates
        (map (lambda (p) (at swatch (first p) (second p)))
             (grid-positions swatch)))
       <))
     (define swapped
      (swap-colors swatch (first swatch-colors) (second swatch-colors)))
     (define ink
      (filter
       (lambda (p)
        (let ((v (at top-clean (first p) (second p))))
         (and (!= v 0) (!= v 6))))
       (grid-positions top-clean)))
     (define glyph-cells
      (normalize-cells
       (filter (lambda (p) (not (member p (obj-cells swatch-object)))) ink)))
     (define glyph-box (bbox-of-cells glyph-cells))
     (define glyph-mask
      (paint-cells
       (empty-grid (+ 1 (third glyph-box)) (+ 1 (fourth glyph-box)) 0)
       glyph-cells 1))
     (define dot-box
      (subgrid sidebar (+ top-end 1) 0 (- control-split 1) (- (cols sidebar) 1)))
     (define bar-box
      (subgrid sidebar (+ control-split 1) 0 (- (rows sidebar) 1) (- (cols sidebar) 1)))
     (define dot-columns (active-columns dot-box))
     (define bar-columns (active-columns bar-box))
     (define dot-position (first (find-color dot-box 4)))
     (define bar-positions (find-color bar-box 7))

     (define dot-col (- (second dot-position) (apply min dot-columns)))

                     (if (= dot-col 0) "W" "E")))

      (map (lambda (p) (list (first p) (- (second p) (apply min bar-columns))))
           bar-positions))

      (if (= (second (first relative-bar)) (second (second relative-bar)))
          (if (= (apply min (map first relative-bar)) 0) 0 2)
          (if (= (apply max (map second relative-bar)) 2) 1 3)))
     (list swapped glyph-cells glyph-mask corner turns)))

    (let ()
     (define recipe (parse-sidebar segment))
     (define tile (first recipe))
     (define selected-cells (second recipe))
     (define normalized-selected (normalize-cells selected-cells))
     (define selected-box (bbox-of-cells normalized-selected))

      (paint-cells
       (empty-grid (+ 1 (third selected-box)) (+ 1 (fourth selected-box)) 0)

     (define tile-width (cols tile))

       (map

          (lambda (tile-cell)

                 (+ anchor-col (* (second glyph-cell) tile-width) (second tile-cell))
                 (at tile (first tile-cell) (second tile-cell))))

(rule!
 ;; Separate hollow square frames from equally sized solid square blocks.
 ;; Order each class top-to-bottom, breaking equal top-row ties left-to-right.
 ;; Place frames in the left output column and solids in the right column.
 ;; Preserve exact block crops; fill missing trailing slots with background.
 (lambda (g)
  (let ()
   (define column-order #f)
   (define bg (mode g -1))
   (define blocks (objects g bg))
   (define size (obj-w (first blocks)))
   (define (before? a b)
    (if column-order
     (or (< (obj-c1 a) (obj-c1 b)) (and (= (obj-c1 a) (obj-c1 b)) (< (obj-r1 a) (obj-r1 b))))
     (or (< (obj-r1 a) (obj-r1 b)) (and (= (obj-r1 a) (obj-r1 b)) (< (obj-c1 a) (obj-c1 b))))))
   (define (ordered xs) (sort xs before?))
   ;; Step A: two ordered lists of classified, input-derived block crops.
   (define frames (ordered (filter (lambda (o) (not (solid-rect? o))) blocks)))
   (define solids (ordered (filter solid-rect? blocks)))
   (define buckets (list frames solids))
   ;; Step B: list lengths set output height; list membership and rank set slots.
   (define slots (max (length (first buckets)) (length (second buckets))))
   (for*/fold ((out (empty-grid (* size slots) (* size 2) bg)))
    ((i (range 0 slots)) (side (range 0 2)))
    (let ((bucket (nth buckets side)))
     (if (>= i (length bucket)) out
      (let ((block (nth bucket i)))
       (paste out (subgrid g (obj-r1 block) (obj-c1 block) (obj-r2 block) (obj-c2 block))
        (* i size) (* side size)))))))))

; General rule for public evaluation parent 38007db0.
; In every separator-bounded tile row, retain the sole tile whose complete
; pattern differs from the repeated tile, then stack those outliers vertically
; in the original row order while preserving the horizontal separator bands.
(rule!
 (lambda (g)
   (define separator (cell-at g 0 0))
   (define (solid-row? r)
     (for/and ([c (in-range (cols g))])
       (= (cell-at g r c) separator)))
   (define (solid-col? c)
     (for/and ([r (in-range (rows g))])
       (= (cell-at g r c) separator)))
   (define (runs indices)
     (if (empty? indices)
         '()
         (let loop ([remaining (rest indices)]
                    [start (first indices)]
                    [finish (first indices)]
                    [answer '()])
           (cond
             [(empty? remaining) (reverse (cons (list start finish) answer))]
             [(= (first remaining) (add1 finish))
              (loop (rest remaining) start (first remaining) answer)]
             [else
              (loop (rest remaining) (first remaining) (first remaining)
                    (cons (list start finish) answer))]))))
   (define (gaps run-list)
     (for/list ([left (in-list run-list)]
                [right (in-list (rest run-list))]
                #:when (<= (add1 (second left)) (sub1 (first right))))
       (list (add1 (second left)) (sub1 (first right)))))
   (define row-runs
     (runs (filter solid-row? (range (rows g)))))
   (define col-runs
     (runs (filter solid-col? (range (cols g)))))
   (unless (and (>= (length row-runs) 3)
                (>= (length col-runs) 4)
                (= (first (first row-runs)) 0)
                (= (second (last row-runs)) (sub1 (rows g)))
                (= (first (first col-runs)) 0)
                (= (second (last col-runs)) (sub1 (cols g))))
     (error "row-outlier: missing complete separator lattice"))
   (define row-bands (gaps row-runs))
   (define col-bands (gaps col-runs))
   (unless (and (= (length row-bands) (sub1 (length row-runs)))
                (= (length col-bands) (sub1 (length col-runs))))
     (error "row-outlier: separators must alternate with nonempty tile bands"))
   (define tile-height (add1 (- (second (first row-bands))
                                (first (first row-bands)))))
   (define tile-width (add1 (- (second (first col-bands))
                               (first (first col-bands)))))
   (unless (and (>= tile-height 2) (>= tile-width 2)
                (for/and ([band (in-list row-bands)])
                  (= (add1 (- (second band) (first band))) tile-height))
                (for/and ([band (in-list col-bands)])
                  (= (add1 (- (second band) (first band))) tile-width)))
     (error "row-outlier: unequal or degenerate tile bands"))
   (define (tile-key row-band col-band)
     (for*/list ([r (in-range (first row-band) (add1 (second row-band)))]
                 [c (in-range (first col-band) (add1 (second col-band)))])
       (cell-at g r c)))
   (define records
     (for/list ([row-band (in-list row-bands)] [row-index (in-naturals)])
       (define tiles
         (for/list ([col-band (in-list col-bands)])
           (tile-key row-band col-band)))
       (define frequencies (make-hash))
       (for ([tile (in-list tiles)])
         (hash-update! frequencies tile add1 0))
       (define uniques
         (filter (lambda (tile) (= (hash-ref frequencies tile) 1))
                 (hash-keys frequencies)))
       (define repeateds
         (filter (lambda (tile) (= (hash-ref frequencies tile)
                                   (sub1 (length tiles))))
                 (hash-keys frequencies)))
       (unless (and (= (hash-count frequencies) 2)
                    (= (length uniques) 1)
                    (= (length repeateds) 1))
         (error "row-outlier: each row needs one outlier and repeated peers"))
       (define unique (first uniques))
       (define repeated (first repeateds))
       (define difference-count
         (for/sum ([a (in-list unique)] [b (in-list repeated)])
           (if (= a b) 0 1)))
       (define repeated-frequency (make-hash))
       (for ([value (in-list repeated)])
         (hash-update! repeated-frequency value add1 0))
       (define maximum-frequency (apply max (hash-values repeated-frequency)))
       (define backgrounds
         (filter (lambda (color)
                   (= (hash-ref repeated-frequency color) maximum-frequency))
                 (hash-keys repeated-frequency)))
       (unless (= (length backgrounds) 1)
         (error "row-outlier: repeated tile background must be uniquely modal"))
       (define background (first backgrounds))
       (define foreground-count
         (length (filter (lambda (value) (not (= value background))) unique)))
       (list row-index unique repeated difference-count foreground-count)))
   (define ordered records)
   (define left-width
     (add1 (- (second (first col-runs)) (first (first col-runs)))))
   (define right-run (last col-runs))
   (define right-width (add1 (- (second right-run) (first right-run))))
   (define output-width (+ left-width tile-width right-width))
   (define (row-slot r)
     (for/first ([band (in-list row-bands)] [index (in-naturals)]
                 #:when (<= (first band) r (second band)))
       index))
   (grid-from-fn (rows g) output-width
     (lambda (r c)
       (define slot (row-slot r))
       (if (and slot (<= left-width c) (< c (+ left-width tile-width)))
           (let* ([band (list-ref row-bands slot)]
                  [record (list-ref ordered slot)]
                  [flat-tile (second record)]
                  [dr (- r (first band))]
                  [dc (- c left-width)])
             (list-ref flat-tile (+ (* dr tile-width) dc)))
           separator)))))

(rule!
 ;; Blue cells are endpoints of one or more exact 45-degree signal segments.
 ;; Complete every such segment in blue. A red cell is active only when it lies
 ;; on a derived blue segment. Each active red cell emits a perpendicular red
 ;; beam through both canvas edges; red beams paint last.
 (lambda (g)
  (let ()
   (define beam-reach 'both_edges)
   (define background (mode g -1))
   (define positions (grid-positions g))
   (define blue (filter (lambda (p) (= (at g (first p) (second p)) 1)) positions))
   (define red (filter (lambda (p) (= (at g (first p) (second p)) 6)) positions))
   ;; A: derive complete diagonal paths and their signed orientations.
   (define segments
    (for*/list ([i (in-range (length blue))]
                [j (in-range (+ i 1) (length blue))]
                #:when
                (let* ([p (list-ref blue i)] [q (list-ref blue j)]
                       [dr (- (first q) (first p))]
                       [dc (- (second q) (second p))])
                 (and (> (abs dr) 0) (= (abs dr) (abs dc)))))
     (let* ([p (list-ref blue i)] [q (list-ref blue j)]
            [dr (- (first q) (first p))]
            [dc (- (second q) (second p))]
            [sr (if (> dr 0) 1 -1)]
            [sc (if (> dc 0) 1 -1)]
            [n (abs dr)]
            [cells (for/list ([k (in-range (+ n 1))])
                     (list (+ (first p) (* k sr)) (+ (second p) (* k sc))))])
       (list cells sr sc))))
   (define signal-cells (apply append (map first segments)))
   (define connected
    (paint-cells g
     (filter (lambda (p) (= (at g (first p) (second p)) background)) signal-cells)
     1))
   ;; B: membership in the derived paths gates red emission, and the stored
   ;; orientation determines the perpendicular forward direction. The episode
   ;; parameter decides whether that ray is mirrored through the trigger.
   (define beam-cells
    (apply append
     (for*/list ([p red] [segment segments]
                 #:when (member p (first segment)))
      (let* ([sr (second segment)] [sc (third segment)]
             [br sr] [bc (- sc)])
       (filter
        (lambda (q)
         (let ([dr (- (first q) (first p))] [dc (- (second q) (second p))])
          (and (= (* dr bc) (* dc br))
               (or (equal? beam-reach 'both_edges)
                   (>= (+ (* dr br) (* dc bc)) 0)))))
        positions)))))
   (paint-cells connected beam-cells 6))))

(rule!
 (let ()
   (define toward #t)
   (define bg (mode g -1))
   (define h (rows g))
   (define w (cols g))
   (define positions (grid-positions g))
   (define (value p) (at g (first p) (second p)))
   (define (active ps found)
     (filter (lambda (p) (not (member p found))) ps))
   (define (uniform-guide ps found)
     (let* ((rest (active ps found))
            (vals (remove-duplicates (map value rest))))
       (and (not (empty? rest)) (= (length vals) 1) (not (= (first vals) bg)))))
   (define (discover-lines found)
     (let* ((row-add
              (apply append
                     (map (lambda (r)
                            (let ((ps (map (lambda (c) (list r c)) (range w))))
                              (if (uniform-guide ps found) (active ps found) '())))
                          (range h))))
            (after-rows (remove-duplicates (append found row-add)))
            (col-add
              (apply append
                     (map (lambda (c)
                            (let ((ps (map (lambda (r) (list r c)) (range h))))
                              (if (uniform-guide ps after-rows) (active ps after-rows) '())))
                          (range w))))

   (define movers (filter (lambda (cells) (member 8 (colors cells))) components))
   (define targets
     (filter (lambda (cells)
               (and (not (empty? cells))
                    (andmap (lambda (p) (= (value p) 9)) cells)))
             components))
   (define (cells-of-color cells color)
     (filter (lambda (p) (= (value p) color)) cells))
   (define (guide-cells color)
     (filter (lambda (p) (= (value p) color)) guides))
   (define (average xs) (/ (apply + xs) (length xs)))
   (define (opposite side)
     (case side ((T) 'B) ((B) 'T) ((L) 'R) (else 'L)))
   (define (target-side color target)
     (let* ((line (guide-cells color))
            (bb (bbox-of-cells line))
            (r1 (first bb)) (c1 (second bb)) (r2 (third bb)) (c2 (fourth bb))
            (th (+ 1 (- r2 r1))) (tw (+ 1 (- c2 c1)))
            (tr (average (map first target)))
            (tc (average (map second target)))
            (side (if (>= tw th)
                      (if (< (/ (+ r1 r2) 2) tr) 'T 'B)
                      (if (< (/ (+ c1 c2) 2) tc) 'L 'R))))

     (let* ((body (filter (lambda (p) (member (value p) '(8 9))) mover))
            (tabs (cells-of-color mover color))
            (vectors
              (apply append
                     (map (lambda (p)
                            (filter-map
                              (lambda (d)
                                (let ((q (list (- (first p) (first d))
                                               (- (second p) (second d)))))
                                  (if (member q body) d #f)))
                              cardinal-deltas))
                          tabs)))
            (dr (apply + (cons 0 (map first vectors))))
            (dc (apply + (cons 0 (map second vectors)))))
       (if (>= (abs dr) (abs dc))
           (if (< dr 0) 'T 'B)
           (if (< dc 0) 'L 'R))))
   (define (transform-delta tid dr dc)
     (case tid
       ((0) (list dr dc))
       ((1) (list dc (- dr)))
       ((2) (list (- dr) (- dc)))
       ((3) (list (- dc) dr))
       ((4) (list dr (- dc)))
       ((5) (list (- dr) dc))
       ((6) (list dc dr))
       (else (list (- dc) (- dr)))))

            (q (transform-delta tid (first v) (second v)))
            (dr (first q)) (dc (second q)))
       (if (>= (abs dr) (abs dc))
           (if (< dr 0) 'T 'B)
           (if (< dc 0) 'L 'R))))
   (define (tab-colors mover)
     (remove-duplicates
       (filter (lambda (v) (and (not (= v 8)) (not (= v 9)))) (colors mover))))

     (let* ((anchor (first (cells-of-color mover 9)))
            (relative
              (map (lambda (p)
                     (let ((q (transform-delta tid (- (first p) (first anchor))
                                                     (- (second p) (second anchor)))))
                       (list (first q) (second q) (value p))))
                   mover))
            (rel-nine (filter (lambda (x) (= (third x) 9)) relative))
            (shift
              (find-first values
                (apply append
                  (map (lambda (x)
                         (map (lambda (p)
                                (let* ((sr (- (first p) (first x)))
                                       (sc (- (second p) (second x)))
                                       (shifted-nine

                                  (if (equal? shifted-nine (sort target cell<))

                              target))
                       rel-nine)))))

           (map (lambda (x) (list (+ (first x) (first shift))
                                  (+ (second x) (second shift))
                                  (third x)))

           #f)))

     (let* ((tabs (tab-colors mover))
            (tid
              (find-first
                (lambda (k)
                  (and
                    (andmap (lambda (color)
                              (equal? (transform-side (source-side mover color) k)
                                      (target-side color target)))
                            tabs)
                    (placed mover target k)))
                (range 8))))
       (placed mover target tid)))
   (define (nine-count cells) (length (cells-of-color cells 9)))
   (define erased
     (erase-cells g (apply append (append movers targets)) bg))
   (define state
     (foldl
       (lambda (mover acc)
         (let* ((out (first acc))
                (remaining (second acc))
                (target (find-first (lambda (x) (= (length x) (nine-count mover))) remaining))
                (stamp (orient mover target)))
           (list (paint-cells out stamp)
                 (remove target remaining))))
       (list erased targets)
       movers))
   (first state)))

(rule!
 ;; Two solid rectangular frames lie in a striped exterior. Their interior
 ;; background colors may differ. One contains repeated multicolor templates;
 ;; the other contains singleton anchors. The anchor color identifies a template.
 ;; Normalize each template around its unique matching marker, not its bbox.
 ;; Crop the target and stamp those relative colored cells at matching markers,
 ;; retaining the frame and the original target markers. The exterior is ignored.
 (lambda (g)
  (let ()
   (define (area frame) (* (rows (second frame)) (cols (second frame))))
   (define candidates
    (for*/fold ((found '())) ((top (range (- (rows g) 4))) (left (range (- (cols g) 4))))
     (let ((border (at g top left)))
      (if (and (= (at g top (+ left 1)) border)
               (= (at g (+ top 1) left) border)
               (not (= (at g (+ top 1) (+ left 1)) border)))
       (for*/fold ((acc found)) ((bottom (range (+ top 4) (rows g))) (right (range (+ left 4) (cols g))))
        (if (and (andmap (lambda (c) (= (at g top c) border)) (range left (+ right 1)))
                 (andmap (lambda (c) (= (at g bottom c) border)) (range left (+ right 1)))
                 (andmap (lambda (r) (= (at g r left) border)) (range top (+ bottom 1)))
                 (andmap (lambda (r) (= (at g r right) border)) (range top (+ bottom 1))))
         (let* ((board (subgrid g top left bottom right))
                (inside (subgrid board 1 1 (- (rows board) 2) (- (cols board) 2)))
                (bg (pick-max (grid-colors inside) (lambda (x) (count-color inside x))))
                (objs (objects-multicolor inside bg)))
          (if (or (= bg border) (null? objs)) acc
           (cons (list (list top left bottom right) board bg objs inside) acc))) acc)) found))))
   (define (overlap? a b)
    (not (or (< (third a) (first b)) (< (third b) (first a))
             (< (fourth a) (second b)) (< (fourth b) (second a)))))
   (define frames
    (for/fold ((kept '())) ((frame (sort candidates (lambda (a b) (> (area a) (area b))))))
     (if (ormap (lambda (old) (overlap? (first old) (first frame))) kept) kept (append kept (list frame)))))
   (define target (find-first (lambda (f) (andmap (lambda (o) (= (obj-size o) 1)) (fourth f))) frames))
   (define source (find-first (lambda (f) (not (equal? f target))) frames))
   (define source-grid (fifth source))
   (define target-grid (fifth target))
   (define board (second target))
   (define marker-colors (grid-colors target-grid (third target)))
   (define templates
    (map (lambda (obj)
     (let* ((cells (obj-cells obj))
            (marker (find-first (lambda (p) (member (at source-grid (first p) (second p)) marker-colors)) cells))
            (color (at source-grid (first marker) (second marker)))
            (anchor-r (first marker)) (anchor-c (second marker)))
      (list color (obj-size obj)
       (map (lambda (p) (list (- (first p) anchor-r) (- (second p) anchor-c)
                             (at source-grid (first p) (second p)))) cells)))) (fourth source)))
   (define largest (apply max (map second templates)))
   (define (chosen? template) #t)
   (for/fold ((out board)) ((obj (fourth target)))
    (let* ((p (first (obj-cells obj))) (ar (+ 1 (first p))) (ac (+ 1 (second p)))
           (color (at target-grid (first p) (second p)))
           (template (find-first (lambda (item) (= (first item) color)) templates)))
     (if (chosen? template)
      (for/fold ((acc out)) ((cell (third template)))
       (let ((r (+ ar (first cell))) (c (+ ac (second cell))))
        (if (and (< 0 r (- (rows board) 1)) (< 0 c (- (cols board) 1))
                 (= (at board r c) (third target)))
         (set-cell acc r c (third cell)) acc))) out))))))

(rule!
 ;; For each non-background color, order its original cells by angle around
 ;; their centroid.  Join consecutive cells (closing the polygon) only when
 ;; they share a row, column, or 45-degree diagonal.  Then treat a singleton
 ;; color adjacent to exactly one differently colored original cell as a
 ;; translated shadow marker: copy that target color's completed polygon by
 ;; the marker-to-anchor offset, painting background only.
 (lambda (g)
  (let ()
   (define bg (mode g -1))
   (define edge-mode 'all_8)
   (define colors (filter (lambda (v) (not (= v bg))) (grid-colors g)))
   (define (inside? p)
    (and (<= 0 (first p)) (< (first p) (rows g))
         (<= 0 (second p)) (< (second p) (cols g))))
   (define (ordered cells)
    (if (<= (length cells) 1) cells
     (let ()
      (define n (length cells))
      (define sr (apply + (map first cells)))
      (define sc (apply + (map second cells)))
      (define (vec p) (list (- (* n (first p)) sr) (- (* n (second p)) sc)))
      (define (angle p) (let ((v (vec p))) (atan (first v) (second v))))
      (define (radius2 p) (let ((v (vec p))) (+ (* (first v) (first v)) (* (second v) (second v)))))
      (sort cells
       (lambda (a b)
        (let ((aa (angle a)) (ab (angle b)))
         (if (= aa ab)
             (if (= (radius2 a) (radius2 b))
                 (or (< (first a) (first b))
                     (and (= (first a) (first b)) (< (second a) (second b))))
                 (< (radius2 a) (radius2 b)))

    (define dr (- (first b) (first a)))
    (define dc (- (second b) (second a)))
    (or (= dr 0) (= dc 0)
        (and (equal? edge-mode 'all_8) (= (abs dr) (abs dc)))))

    (if (not (aligned? a b)) '()
     (let ()
      (define dr (- (first b) (first a)))
      (define dc (- (second b) (second a)))
      (define steps (max (abs dr) (abs dc)))
      (define sr (cond ((< dr 0) -1) ((> dr 0) 1) (else 0)))
      (define sc (cond ((< dc 0) -1) ((> dc 0) 1) (else 0)))
      (for/list ((k (range (+ steps 1))))
       (list (+ (first a) (* k sr)) (+ (second a) (* k sc)))))))

    (define ring (ordered cells))
    (define n (length ring))
    (define edge-count (cond ((< n 2) 0) ((= n 2) 1) (else n)))
    (remove-duplicates
     (append cells
      (for/fold ((all '())) ((i (range edge-count)))
       (append all (segment (list-ref ring i) (list-ref ring (modulo (+ i 1) n))))))))

    (map (lambda (color) (list color (complete (find-color g color)))) colors))
   (define (cells-for color) (second (assoc color completed)))

    (for/fold ((acc out)) ((p cells))
     (if (= (at acc (first p) (second p)) bg)
         (set-cell acc (first p) (second p) color)
         acc)))
   (define base
    (for/fold ((out g)) ((entry completed))
     (paint-bg out (second entry) (first entry))))
   (for/fold ((out base)) ((color colors))
    (define markers (find-color g color))
    (if (not (= (length markers) 1)) out
     (let ()
      (define marker (first markers))
      (define anchors
       (filter
        (lambda (p)
         (and (inside? p)
              (not (= (at g (first p) (second p)) bg))
              (not (= (at g (first p) (second p)) color))))
        (map (lambda (d) (list (+ (first marker) (first d)) (+ (second marker) (second d)))) all-8-deltas)))
      (if (not (= (length anchors) 1)) out
       (let ()
        (define anchor (first anchors))
        (define target (at g (first anchor) (second anchor)))
        (define dr (- (first marker) (first anchor)))
        (define dc (- (second marker) (second anchor)))
        (define shifted
         (map (lambda (p) (list (+ (first p) dr) (+ (second p) dc))) (cells-for target)))
        (paint-bg out (filter inside? shifted) color)))))))))

(rule!
 ;; A separate gray comb enters the open left side of an upright gray vessel.
 ;; Align its baseline with the lowest side opening and its teeth with the lanes.
 ;; Each tooth pushes its gray-cap/colored stack upward by the minimum overlap;
 ;; cells pushed above the vessel's top aperture disappear. Erase the source comb.
 ;; Geometry, tooth heights, gaps and colors are read from this input, not stored.
 (lambda (g)
  (let ()
   (define gray (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) 5)) (objects g 0)))
   (define frame (pick-max gray (lambda (o) (- (fourth (obj-bbox o)) (second (obj-bbox o))))))
   (define fb (obj-bbox frame))
   (define top (first fb))
   (define left (second fb))
   (define bottom (third fb))
   (define comb (pick-max (filter (lambda (o) (< (fourth (obj-bbox o)) left)) gray) obj-size))
   (define cb (obj-bbox comb))
   (define openings (filter (lambda (r) (= (at g r left) 0)) (range (+ top 1) bottom)))
   (define base (apply max openings))
   (define capacity (- base top 1))
   (define count-lanes (+ 1 (quotient (- (fourth cb) (second cb)) 2)))
   ;; A lane record contains its destination column, tooth height and source stack.
   (define lanes
     (for/list ([i (range count-lanes)])
       (let* ([source-col (+ (second cb) (* 2 i))]
              [col (+ left 2 (* 2 i))]
              [tooth (- (count-if (lambda (p) (= (second p) source-col)) (obj-cells comb)) 1)]
              [stack (for/list ([r (range (+ top 1) base)] #:when (not (= (at g r col) 0)))
                       (list r (at g r col)))])
          (list col tooth stack))))
   (define cleared (recolor-cells g (obj-cells comb) 0))
   (define pushed
     (for/fold ([out cleared]) ([lane lanes])
       (let* ([col (first lane)] [tooth (second lane)] [stack (third lane)]
              [gap (- capacity (length stack))]
              [shift (max 0 (- tooth gap))]
              [empty (recolor-cells out (for/list ([r (range (+ top 1) base)]) (list r col)) 0)]
              [moved (for/fold ([a empty]) ([rv stack])
                       (let ([rr (- (first rv) shift)])
                         (if (> rr top) (set-cell a rr col (second rv)) a)))])
         (recolor-cells moved (for/list ([r (range (- base tooth) (+ base 1))]) (list r col)) 5))))
   (define intermediate
     (recolor-cells pushed
       (for/list ([c (range (+ left 2) (+ left 1 (* 2 count-lanes)))]) (list base c)) 5))
   intermediate)))

(rule!
 ;; Recover two multicolor motifs, including integer-scaled copies. The
 ;; greatest common translated color mask supplies an internal anchor.
 ;; Exchange whole motifs while preserving each recipient's anchor and scale.
 ;; Background is the most frequent color, including zero. Components are
 ;; eight-connected; normalized motif shapes, colors and offsets are inferred
 ;; from this input. Admitted instances have exactly two motifs and disjoint,
 ;; in-bounds replacement footprints. No stored examples or answers are used.
 (lambda (g)
  (let ()
    (define replacement 'swap)
    (define align-bbox #f)
    (define preserve-scale #t)
    (define bg (mode g -1))
    (define components (objects-multicolor g bg))
    (define (component-grid object)
      (grid-from-fn (obj-h object) (obj-w object)
        (lambda (r c)
          (define rr (+ r (obj-r1 object)))
          (define cc (+ c (obj-c1 object)))
          (if (member (list rr cc) (obj-cells object)) (at g rr cc) bg))))
    (define (block-scale image)
      (first
        (filter
          (lambda (s)
            (and (= (modulo (rows image) s) 0) (= (modulo (cols image) s) 0)
                 (for*/and ([r (in-range (rows image))] [c (in-range (cols image))])
                   (= (at image r c)
                      (at image (- r (modulo r s)) (- c (modulo c s)))))))
          (reverse (range 1 (+ 1 (min (rows image) (cols image))))))))
    ;; Each record contains the original component, its scale and primitive grid.
    (define records
      (for/list ([object components])
        (define image (component-grid object))
        (define scale (block-scale image))
        (list object scale
          (grid-from-fn (quotient (rows image) scale) (quotient (cols image) scale)
            (lambda (r c) (at image (* r scale) (* c scale)))))))
    (define templates (remove-duplicates (map third records)))
    (unless (= (length templates) 2)
      (error 'motifs "exactly two primitive motifs are required"))
    (define (color-cells image color)
      (for*/list ([r (in-range (rows image))] [c (in-range (cols image))]
                  #:when (= (at image r c) color))
        (list r c)))
    (define (origin cells)
      (list (apply min (map first cells)) (apply min (map second cells))))
    (define (signature image color)
      (define cells (color-cells image color))
      (if (null? cells) '()
          (let ([start (origin cells)])
            (map (lambda (p) (list (- (first p) (first start))
                                  (- (second p) (second start)))) cells))))
    (define anchors
      (filter
        (lambda (color)
          (and (not (= color bg)) (not (null? (color-cells (first templates) color)))
               (equal? (signature (first templates) color)
                       (signature (second templates) color))))
        (range 10)))
    (when (null? anchors) (error 'motifs "no congruent shared color anchor"))
    (define anchor-color
      (first (sort anchors
        (lambda (a b)
          (define na (length (color-cells (first templates) a)))
          (define nb (length (color-cells (first templates) b)))
          (or (> na nb) (and (= na nb) (< a b)))))))
    (define (anchor image) (origin (color-cells image anchor-color)))
    (define (frequency template)
      (length (filter (lambda (record) (equal? (third record) template)) records)))
    (when (and (equal? replacement 'minority)
               (= (frequency (first templates)) (frequency (second templates))))
      (error 'motifs "minority replacement requires unequal instance counts"))
    (define (donor record)
      (cond [(equal? replacement 'swap)
             (first (filter (lambda (template) (not (equal? template (third record)))) templates))]
            [(equal? replacement 'minority) (pick-min templates frequency)]
            [(equal? replacement 'majority) (pick-max templates frequency)]
            [(equal? replacement 'first) (first templates)]
            [(equal? replacement 'last) (second templates)]
            [else (error 'motifs "unknown replacement policy")]))
    ;; Step B consumes the input-derived motif identity, anchor and scale.
    (define painted-cells
      (apply append
        (for/list ([record records])
          (define object (first record))
          (define scale (if preserve-scale (second record) 1))
          (define source-anchor (anchor (third record)))
          (define target (donor record))
          (define target-anchor (anchor target))
          (define row (+ (obj-r1 object)
                         (if align-bbox 0 (* scale (- (first source-anchor) (first target-anchor))))))
          (define col (+ (obj-c1 object)
                         (if align-bbox 0 (* scale (- (second source-anchor) (second target-anchor))))))
          (for*/list ([r (in-range (rows target))] [c (in-range (cols target))]
                      #:when (not (= (at target r c) bg))
                      [dr (in-range scale)] [dc (in-range scale)])
            (list (+ row (* r scale) dr) (+ col (* c scale) dc) (at target r c))))))
    ;; The canvas fixes the output extent. Samplers admit only nonoverlapping,
    ;; in-bounds motif footprints; projection here is also total for ablations.
    (grid-from-fn (rows g) (cols g)
      (lambda (r c)
        (define hit (find-first (lambda (p) (and (= (first p) r) (= (second p) c))) painted-cells))
        (if hit (third hit) bg))))))

(rule!
 ;; The modal background surrounds a spatially spanning wire network.
 ;; Its unique solid 3x3 hub joins mixed-color terminal chambers. Remove the
 ;; hub to recover the terminals; each terminal's pigment majority colors its
 ;; own wires. The hub center takes a second majority, counting the recovered
 ;; terminal value once per external wire contact, not once per chamber.
 ;; All original pigments and the other eight hub cells remain unchanged.
 ;; Lower colors break vote ties; generated lessons exclude all such ties.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define (mode-color xs)
       (pick-max (sort (remove-duplicates xs) <)
                 (lambda (v) (count-if (lambda (x) (= x v)) xs))))
     (define bg (mode-color (apply append g)))
     (define network
       (pick-max (objects g bg) (lambda (o) (* (obj-h o) (obj-w o)))))
     (define wire (obj-color network))
     (define centers
       (for*/list ([r (range 1 (- h 1))] [c (range 1 (- w 1))]
                   #:when (for*/and ([dr '(-1 0 1)] [dc '(-1 0 1)])
                            (= (at g (+ r dr) (+ c dc)) wire)))
         (list r c)))
     (define center (first centers))
     (define hr (first center))
     (define hc (second center))
     (define (in-hub? r c)
       (and (<= (- hr 1) r (+ hr 1)) (<= (- hc 1) c (+ hc 1))))
     (define mask
       (for/list ([r (range h)])
         (for/list ([c (range w)])
           (if (or (in-hub? r c) (= (at g r c) bg)) bg wire))))
     (define terminals
       (for/list ([o (objects mask bg)])
         (let ()
           (define cells (obj-cells o))
           (define pigments
             (for/list ([p cells] #:when (not (= (at g (first p) (second p)) wire)))
               (at g (first p) (second p))))
           (define local-vote (mode-color pigments))
           (define contacts
             (for/sum ([p cells])
               (let ([r (first p)] [c (second p)])
                 (if (and (= (at g r c) wire)
                          (or (in-hub? (- r 1) c) (in-hub? (+ r 1) c)
                              (in-hub? r (- c 1)) (in-hub? r (+ c 1)))) 1 0))))
           (list cells local-vote contacts))))
     (define votes
       (apply append
         (for/list ([terminal terminals])
           (make-list (third terminal) (second terminal)))))
     (define propagated
       (for/fold ([out g]) ([terminal terminals])
         (for/fold ([result out]) ([p (first terminal)])
           (if (= (at g (first p) (second p)) wire)
               (set-cell result (first p) (second p) (second terminal)) result))))
     (set-cell propagated hr hc (mode-color votes)))))

(rule!
 ;; Move the rigid black rectangle along blue cells toward the red goal.
 ;; Build a cell-distance field from red, then a separate graph of top-left
 ;; anchors whose ENTIRE footprint is walkable. Only anchors reachable by
 ;; cardinal unit translations from the original black block are eligible.
 ;; Minimize the sum of goal distances under the footprint; row-major breaks
 ;; ties. The originals all have unique optima. Preserve walls and unoccupied
 ;; red cells, restore the old black footprint to blue, and paint the endpoint.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define halfway #f)
     (define deltas '((-1 0) (0 -1) (0 1) (1 0)))
     (define (neighbors p)
       (for/list ([d deltas]) (list (+ (first p) (first d)) (+ (second p) (second d)))))
     (define (flood starts allowed?)
       (let loop ([front starts]
                  [seen (for/fold ([acc (hash)]) ([p starts]) (hash-set acc p 0))]
                  [level 0])
         (define next
           (remove-duplicates
             (apply append
               (for/list ([p front])
                 (filter (lambda (q) (and (allowed? q) (not (hash-has-key? seen q))))
                         (neighbors p))))))
         (if (null? next) seen
             (loop next
                   (for/fold ([acc seen]) ([p next]) (hash-set acc p (+ level 1)))
                   (+ level 1)))))
     (define zeros (find-color g 0))
     (define goals (find-color g 2))
     (define top (apply min (map first zeros)))
     (define left (apply min (map second zeros)))
     (define sh (+ 1 (- (apply max (map first zeros)) top)))
     (define sw (+ 1 (- (apply max (map second zeros)) left)))
     (define start (list top left))
     (define (free? p)
       (member (safe-at g (first p) (second p) -1) '(0 1 2)))
     (define goal-distances (flood goals free?))
     (define legal
       (for*/fold ([acc (hash)]) ([r (range (+ 1 (- h sh)))] [c (range (+ 1 (- w sw)))])
         (if (for*/and ([a (range sh)] [b (range sw)])
               (member (at g (+ r a) (+ c b)) '(0 1 2)))
             (hash-set acc (list r c) #t) acc)))
     (define reachable (flood (list start) (lambda (p) (hash-has-key? legal p))))
     (define (position-key p) (+ (* (first p) w) (second p)))
     (define (score p)
       (for*/sum ([a (range sh)] [b (range sw)])
         (hash-ref goal-distances (list (+ (first p) a) (+ (second p) b)) (+ (* h w) 1))))
     (define terminal
       (pick-min (sort (hash-keys reachable) < #:key position-key) score))
     (define route
       (let trace ([p terminal] [path (list terminal)])
         (if (equal? p start) path
             (let ([previous
                    (pick-min
                      (filter (lambda (q)
                                (= (hash-ref reachable q -1) (- (hash-ref reachable p) 1)))
                              (neighbors p))
                      position-key)])
               (trace previous (cons previous path))))))
     (define destination (if halfway (list-ref route (quotient (length route) 2)) terminal))
     (define cleared (recolor-cells g zeros 1))
     (for*/fold ([out cleared]) ([a (range sh)] [b (range sw)])
       (set-cell out (+ (first destination) a) (+ (second destination) b) 0)))))

(rule!
 ;; Detached singleton colors form an ordered route through solid framed blocks.
 ;; Match repeated colors to same-colored blocks in reading order. For each
 ;; consecutive aligned pair, fill the empty corridor at the payload thickness
 ;; using the departing block's payload color. Preserve blocks and legend.
 (lambda (g)
  (let ()
   (define bg (pick-max (grid-colors g) (lambda (v) (count-color g v))))
   (define frame
    (pick-max (filter (lambda (v) (not (= v bg))) (grid-colors g))
              (lambda (v) (count-color g v))))
   (define all-objects (objects-multicolor g bg))
   (define raw-blocks
    (sort (filter (lambda (o) (> (obj-size o) 1)) all-objects)
          (lambda (a b) (if (= (obj-r1 a) (obj-r1 b))
                            (< (obj-c1 a) (obj-c1 b))
                            (< (obj-r1 a) (obj-r1 b))))))
   (define legend
    (sort (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-size o) 1)) all-objects)
          (lambda (a b) (if (= (obj-r1 a) (obj-r1 b))
                            (< (obj-c1 a) (obj-c1 b))
                            (< (obj-r1 a) (obj-r1 b))))))
   (define (block-data o)
    (define colors
     (remove-duplicates
      (map (lambda (p) (at g (first p) (second p))) (obj-cells o))))
    (define payload (first (filter (lambda (v) (not (= v frame))) colors)))
    (define payload-cells
     (filter (lambda (p) (= (at g (first p) (second p)) payload)) (obj-cells o)))
    (list payload (obj-r1 o) (obj-c1 o) (obj-r2 o) (obj-c2 o)
          (min-of first payload-cells) (min-of second payload-cells)
          (max-of first payload-cells) (max-of second payload-cells)))
   (define blocks (map block-data raw-blocks))
   (define sequence (map obj-color legend))
   (define route
    (for/list ((color sequence) (i (range (length sequence))))
     (define occurrence
      (count-if (lambda (v) (= v color)) (take sequence i)))
     (list-ref (filter (lambda (b) (= (first b) color)) blocks) occurrence)))
   (define (bridge-cells a b)
    (cond
     ((and (= (list-ref a 5) (list-ref b 5)) (= (list-ref a 7) (list-ref b 7)))
      (define lo (if (< (list-ref a 2) (list-ref b 2))
                     (+ (list-ref a 4) 1) (+ (list-ref b 4) 1)))
      (define hi (if (< (list-ref a 2) (list-ref b 2))
                     (list-ref b 2) (list-ref a 2)))
      (for*/list ((r (range (list-ref a 5) (+ (list-ref a 7) 1)))
                  (c (range lo hi))) (list r c)))
     ((and (= (list-ref a 6) (list-ref b 6)) (= (list-ref a 8) (list-ref b 8)))
      (define lo (if (< (list-ref a 1) (list-ref b 1))
                     (+ (list-ref a 3) 1) (+ (list-ref b 3) 1)))
      (define hi (if (< (list-ref a 1) (list-ref b 1))
                     (list-ref b 1) (list-ref a 1)))
      (for*/list ((r (range lo hi))
                  (c (range (list-ref a 6) (+ (list-ref a 8) 1)))) (list r c)))
     (else '())))
   (for/fold ((out g)) ((i (range (- (length route) 1))))
    (define a (list-ref route i))
    (define b (list-ref route (+ i 1)))
    (paint-cells out (bridge-cells a b) (first a))))))

(rule!
 ;; Crop the large radius-two-connected square tableau.  For every colour in
 ;; that square, count same-colour cue cells outside it and rotate that colour
 ;; layer clockwise by the count modulo four.  Layers rotate independently.
 (lambda (g)
  (let ()
   (define bg (mode g -1))
   (define points
    (filter (lambda (p) (not (= (at g (first p) (second p)) bg)))
            (grid-positions g)))
   (define (near2? a b)
    (and (<= (abs (- (first a) (first b))) 2)
         (<= (abs (- (second a) (second b))) 2)))
   (define (grow frontier remaining seen)
    (if (null? frontier)
        (list seen remaining)
        (let* ([p (first frontier)]
               [near (filter (lambda (q) (near2? p q)) remaining)]
               [left (filter (lambda (q) (not (member q near))) remaining)])
         (grow (append (rest frontier) near) left (append seen near)))))
   (define (components remaining)
    (if (null? remaining)
        '()
        (let* ([start (first remaining)]
               [grown (grow (list start) (rest remaining) (list start))])
         (cons (first grown) (components (second grown))))))
   (define main
    (first (sort (components points)
                 (lambda (a b) (> (length a) (length b))))))
   (define box (bbox-of-cells main))
   (define r0 (first box))
   (define c0 (second box))
   (define r1 (third box))
   (define c1 (fourth box))
   (define side (+ 1 (- r1 r0)))
   (define (inside? p)
    (and (<= r0 (first p) r1) (<= c0 (second p) c1)))
   (define inside-points (filter inside? points))
   (define colors
    (sort (remove-duplicates
           (map (lambda (p) (at g (first p) (second p))) inside-points)) <))
   (define direction 1)
   (define (turn-count color)
    (modulo (* direction
               (count-if (lambda (p)
                           (and (not (inside? p))
                                (= (at g (first p) (second p)) color)))
                         points))
            4))
   (define (rotate-one p)
    (list (second p) (- side 1 (first p))))
   (define (rotate-n p n)
    (if (= n 0) p (rotate-n (rotate-one p) (- n 1))))
   (define transformed
    (apply append
     (for/list ([color colors])
      (for/list ([p inside-points]
                 #:when (= (at g (first p) (second p)) color))
       (let ([q (rotate-n (list (- (first p) r0) (- (second p) c0))
                          (turn-count color))])
        (list (first q) (second q) color))))))
   (build-grid side side (r c)
    (let ([hits (filter (lambda (x) (and (= (first x) r) (= (second x) c)))
                        transformed)])
     (if (null? hits) bg (third (first hits))))))))

(rule!
 ;; Every three-cell foreground object is a pointer.  A chevron points from the
 ;; midpoint of its two arms through its tip; an L points diagonally away from
 ;; its missing corner.  Move five cells in that direction.  Empty destinations
 ;; become maroon, coincident destinations become blue, and a hit recolours the
 ;; entire struck pointer maroon.
 (lambda (g)
  (let ()
   (define bg (mode g -1))
   (define objs
    (filter (lambda (o) (= (length (obj-cells o)) 3)) (objects-8 g bg)))
   (define travel 1)
   (define (diagonal? a b)
    (and (= (abs (- (first a) (first b))) 1)
         (= (abs (- (second a) (second b))) 1)))
   (define (cardinal? a b)
    (= (+ (abs (- (first a) (first b)))
          (abs (- (second a) (second b)))) 1))
   (define (pointer obj)
    (let* ([cells (obj-cells obj)]
           [tips
            (filter (lambda (p)
                      (= (length (filter (lambda (q)
                                           (and (not (equal? p q)) (diagonal? p q)))
                                         cells)) 2))
                    cells)])
     (if (not (null? tips))
         (let* ([tip (first tips)]
                [arms (filter (lambda (q) (not (equal? q tip))) cells)]
                [mr (quotient (+ (first (first arms)) (first (second arms))) 2)]
                [mc (quotient (+ (second (first arms)) (second (second arms))) 2)])
          (list tip (list (- (first tip) mr) (- (second tip) mc))))
         (let* ([elbows
                 (filter (lambda (p)
                           (= (length (filter (lambda (q)
                                              (and (not (equal? p q)) (cardinal? p q)))
                                            cells)) 2))
                         cells)]
                [elbow (first elbows)]
                [arms (filter (lambda (q) (not (equal? q elbow))) cells)]
                [dr (+ (- (first (first arms)) (first elbow))
                       (- (first (second arms)) (first elbow)))]
                [dc (+ (- (second (first arms)) (second elbow))
                       (- (second (second arms)) (second elbow)))])
          (list elbow (list (- dr) (- dc)))))))
   (define endpoints
    (filter (lambda (p) (in-bounds? (first p) (second p) (rows g) (cols g)))
     (for/list ([obj objs])
      (let* ([pd (pointer obj)] [origin (first pd)] [d (second pd)])
       (list (+ (first origin) (* 5 travel (first d)))
             (+ (second origin) (* 5 travel (second d))))))))
   (define hit-objs
    (filter (lambda (obj)
              (any? (lambda (p) (member p endpoints)) (obj-cells obj)))
            objs))
   (define hit-cells
    (if (null? hit-objs)
        '()
        (remove-duplicates (apply append (map obj-cells hit-objs)))))
   (build-grid (rows g) (cols g) (r c)
    (let* ([p (list r c)] [v (at g r c)]
           [n (count-if (lambda (q) (equal? p q)) endpoints)])
     (cond [(member p hit-cells) 9]
           [(not (= v bg)) v]
           [(>= n 2) 1]
           [(= n 1) 9]
           [else bg]))))))

(rule!
 ;; Recover disconnected jigsaw pieces.  One multicolor piece embeds a distinct
 ;; 2x2 or 3x3 palette; a zero palette entry still occupies physical piece area.
 ;; Keep that piece unrotated at the square's top-left, rotate every other piece
 ;; by quarter turns, exactly tile the square, then recolor each placed piece by
 ;; its palette position.  Reflections are not allowed.
 (lambda (g)
  (let ()
   (define (lex-cell<? a b)
    (or (< (first a) (first b))
        (and (= (first a) (first b)) (< (second a) (second b)))))
   (define (norm cells) (sort (normalize-cells cells) lex-cell<?))
   (define (shift cells dr dc)
    (map (lambda (p) (list (+ dr (first p)) (+ dc (second p)))) cells))
   (define (overlap? a b) (ormap (lambda (p) (member p b)) a))
   (define (rotations shape)
    (let loop ((left 4) (current shape) (seen '()) (out '()))
     (if (= left 0) (reverse out)
      (let ((candidate (norm current)))
       (loop (- left 1) (rotate-cells-cw current)
        (if (member candidate seen) seen (cons candidate seen))
        (if (member candidate seen) out (cons candidate out)))))))
   (define objs (objects-multicolor g 0))
   (define piece-count (length objs))
   (define n (cond ((= piece-count 4) 2) ((= piece-count 9) 3)
                   (else (error 'f560132c "expected four or nine pieces"))))
   (define (color-variety obj)
    (length (remove-duplicates
      (map (lambda (p) (at g (first p) (second p))) (obj-cells obj)))))
   (define key-obj
    (foldl (lambda (obj best)
      (if (> (color-variety obj) (color-variety best)) obj best))
     (first objs) (rest objs)))
   (define key-cells (obj-cells key-obj))
   (define (frequency value)
    (length (filter (lambda (p) (= (at g (first p) (second p)) value)) key-cells)))
   (define palette-candidates
    (for*/list ((r0 (in-range 0 (+ 1 (- (rows g) n))))
                (c0 (in-range 0 (+ 1 (- (cols g) n))))
      #:when
      (let* ((coords (for*/list ((r (in-range n)) (c (in-range n)))
                       (list (+ r0 r) (+ c0 c))))
             (vals (map (lambda (p) (at g (first p) (second p))) coords)))
       (and (= (length (remove-duplicates vals)) (* n n))
            (>= (length (filter (lambda (v) (not (= v 0))) vals)) (- (* n n) 1))
            (andmap (lambda (p)
              (or (= (at g (first p) (second p)) 0) (member p key-cells))) coords))))
     (let* ((coords (for*/list ((r (in-range n)) (c (in-range n)))
                      (list (+ r0 r) (+ c0 c))))
            (vals (map (lambda (p) (at g (first p) (second p))) coords))
            (score (length (filter (lambda (v) (and (not (= v 0)) (> (frequency v) 1))) vals))))
      (list score r0 c0 vals coords))))
   (define (candidate<? a b)
    (or (< (first a) (first b))
        (and (= (first a) (first b))
         (or (< (second a) (second b))
             (and (= (second a) (second b)) (< (third a) (third b)))))))
   (define chosen-palette (first (sort palette-candidates candidate<?)))
   (define palette-values (fourth chosen-palette))
   (define palette-coords (fifth chosen-palette))
   (define key-shape (norm (remove-duplicates (append key-cells palette-coords))))
   (define other-objs (filter (lambda (o) (not (equal? o key-obj))) objs))
   (define pieces (cons key-shape (map (lambda (o) (norm (obj-cells o))) other-objs)))
   (define total-area (apply + (map length pieces)))
   (define side
    (for/first ((s (in-range 1 31)) #:when (= (* s s) total-area)) s))
   (unless side (error 'f560132c "piece areas do not form a square"))
   (define key-placement (list 0 0 0 0 key-shape))
   (define all-placements
    (apply append
     (for/list ((shape (in-list (rest pieces))) (piece-id (in-naturals 1)))
      (apply append
       (for/list ((oriented (in-list (rotations shape))) (rotation (in-naturals 0)))
        (let ((ph (+ 1 (apply max (map first oriented))))
              (pw (+ 1 (apply max (map second oriented)))))
         (for*/list ((dr (in-range 0 (+ 1 (- side ph))))
                     (dc (in-range 0 (+ 1 (- side pw))))
           #:when (let ((cells (shift oriented dr dc)))
                    (not (overlap? cells key-shape))))
          (list piece-id rotation dr dc (shift oriented dr dc)))))))))
   (define full-cells (for*/list ((r (in-range side)) (c (in-range side))) (list r c)))
   (define (search occupied remaining selected)
    (if (empty? remaining) (reverse selected)
     (let* ((target (first (filter (lambda (p) (not (member p occupied))) full-cells)))
            (options (filter (lambda (placement)
              (and (member (first placement) remaining)
                   (member target (fifth placement))
                   (not (overlap? (fifth placement) occupied)))) all-placements)))
      (let try ((choices options))
       (if (empty? choices) #f
        (let* ((placement (first choices))
               (piece-id (first placement))
               (result (search (append (fifth placement) occupied)
                               (remove piece-id remaining)
                               (cons placement selected))))
         (if result result (try (rest choices)))))))))
   (define packed-rest (search key-shape (range 1 piece-count) '()))
   (unless packed-rest (error 'f560132c "pieces cannot tile square"))
   (define packed (cons key-placement packed-rest))
   (define owner
    (build-grid side side (r c)
     (first (first (filter (lambda (placement) (member (list r c) (fifth placement))) packed)))))
   (define positions
    (if (= n 2)
     (list (list (at owner 0 0) (at owner 0 (- side 1)))
           (list (at owner (- side 1) 0) (at owner (- side 1) (- side 1))))
     (let* ((tl (at owner 0 0)) (tr (at owner 0 (- side 1)))
            (bl (at owner (- side 1) 0)) (br (at owner (- side 1) (- side 1)))
            (corners (list tl tr bl br))
            (side-piece (lambda (values)
              (first (remove-duplicates (filter (lambda (v) (not (member v corners))) values)))))
            (tm (side-piece (first owner)))
            (bm (side-piece (last owner)))
            (lm (side-piece (map first owner)))
            (rm (side-piece (map last owner)))
            (used (list tl tm tr lm rm bl bm br))
            (center (first (filter (lambda (id) (not (member id used))) (range piece-count)))))
      (list (list tl tm tr) (list lm center rm) (list bl bm br)))))
   (define piece-colors
    (for*/list ((r (in-range n)) (c (in-range n)))
     (list (at positions r c) (list-ref palette-values (+ (* r n) c)))))
   (build-grid side side (r c)
    (second (assoc (at owner r c) piece-colors))))))

(rule!
 ;; Translate disconnected fragments into a rectangle, keeping the L-marked
 ;; corner fixed. Every fragment joins the assembly along a completely matching
 ;; colored contact; other contacts may cross a color boundary. The rectangle's
 ;; outside edge has the marked corner's color. Remove the three-cell L marker.
 ;; In largest_region mode, assemble first, then recolor all maximum-area
 ;; same-color regions other than the background/border to the marker color.
 (lambda (g)
  (let ()
   (define mode "assembly")
   (define colors (range 10))
   (define (color-cells color)
     (for*/list ((r (range h)) (c (range w)) #:when (= (at g r c) color)) (list r c color)))
   (define bg (pick-max colors (lambda (color) (length (color-cells color)))))
   (define marker-info
     (for/or ((color colors) #:when (and (not (= color bg)) (= (length (color-cells color)) 3)))
       (define pts (map (lambda (p) (take p 2)) (color-cells color)))
       (define r0 (apply min (map first pts)))
       (define c0 (apply min (map second pts)))
