       (define square (for*/list ((r (range r0 (+ r0 2))) (c (range c0 (+ c0 2)))) (list r c)))
       (define missing (filter (lambda (p) (not (member p pts))) square))
       (and (= (length missing) 1)
            (let ((p (first missing)))
              (and (in-bounds? (first p) (second p) h w)
                   (not (member (at g (first p) (second p)) (list bg color)))
                   (list color p (= (first p) (+ r0 1)) (= (second p) (+ c0 1))))))))
   (define marker (first marker-info))
   (define corner (second marker-info))
   (define base (at g (first corner) (second corner)))
   (define cleared (recolor g marker bg))
   ;; A binary mask gives four-connected multicolor fragments, rather than the
   ;; eight-connected objects-multicolor helper.
   (define mask (map-grid cleared (lambda (r c v) (if (= v bg) 0 1))))
   (define pieces
     (for/list ((o (objects mask 0)) (id (range (length (objects mask 0)))))
       (list id (for/list ((p (obj-cells o))) (list (first p) (second p) (at g (first p) (second p)))))))
   (define (cells p) (second p))
   (define (xy p) (take p 2))
   (define (adjacent? p q)
     (= (+ (abs (- (first p) (first q))) (abs (- (second p) (second q)))) 1))
   (define anchor (first (filter (lambda (p) (member corner (map xy (cells p)))) pieces)))
   (define area (apply + (map (lambda (p) (length (cells p))) pieces)))
   (define (shift p dr dc)
     (list (first p) (for/list ((v (cells p))) (list (+ (first v) dr) (+ (second v) dc) (third v)))))
   (define (colored p) (filter (lambda (v) (not (= (third v) base))) (cells p)))
   (define (cell-hash triples)
     (define table (make-hash))
     (for ((p triples)) (hash-set! table (xy p) (third p)))
     table)
   (define (match? a b)
     (define table (cell-hash (cells b)))
     (define contacts
       (for*/list ((p (cells a)) (d '((1 0) (-1 0) (0 1) (0 -1)))
                    #:do ((define q (list (+ (first p) (first d)) (+ (second p) (second d)))))
                    #:when (hash-has-key? table q))
         (list (third p) (hash-ref table q))))
     (and (not (null? contacts))
          (andmap (lambda (pair) (= (first pair) (second pair))) contacts)
          (ormap (lambda (pair) (not (= (first pair) base))) contacts)))
   (define (deltas a b)
     (remove-duplicates
       (for*/list ((p (colored a)) (q (colored b))
                   (d '((1 0) (-1 0) (0 1) (0 -1)))
                   #:when (= (third p) (third q)))
         (list (- (+ (first q) (first d)) (first p))
               (- (+ (second q) (second d)) (second p))))))
   ;; Pairwise compatible shifts depend only on source shapes, not search
   ;; order. Cache them once; recomputing all cell cross-products at every node
   ;; exceeds the protected runtime budget on the retained 30x30 regression.
   (define link-cache (make-hash))
   (define (links a b)
     (define key (list (first a) (first b)))
     (unless (hash-has-key? link-cache key)
       (define table (cell-hash (cells b)))
       (hash-set! link-cache key
         (filter (lambda (delta)
                   (define moved (shift a (first delta) (second delta)))
                   (and (not (ormap (lambda (p) (hash-has-key? table (xy p))) (cells moved)))
                        (match? moved b)))
                 (deltas a b))))
     (hash-ref link-cache key))
   (define solution
     (for/or ((H (range 2 (+ h 1))) #:when (zero? (remainder area H)))
       (define W (quotient area H))
       (define r0 (if (third marker-info) (first corner) (- (+ (first corner) 1) H)))
       (define c0 (if (fourth marker-info) (second corner) (- (+ (second corner) 1) W)))
       (define visited (make-hash))
       (define (inside? p)
         (for/and ((v (cells p)))
           (and (<= r0 (first v) (- (+ r0 H) 1))
                (<= c0 (second v) (- (+ c0 W) 1))
                (or (and (not (member (first v) (list r0 (- (+ r0 H) 1))))
                         (not (member (second v) (list c0 (- (+ c0 W) 1)))))
                    (= (third v) base)))))
       (define (search placed pending)
         (define state (sort placed < #:key first))
         (cond
           ((null? pending) placed)
           ((hash-has-key? visited state) #f)
           (else
            (hash-set! visited state #t)
            (define occupied (cell-hash (append-map cells placed)))
            (for/or ((p pending))
              (for/or ((q placed))
                (define original-q (list-ref pieces (first q)))
                (define qr (- (first (first (cells q))) (first (first (cells original-q)))))
                (define qc (- (second (first (cells q))) (second (first (cells original-q)))))
                (for/or ((delta (links p original-q)))
                  (define moved (shift p (+ qr (first delta)) (+ qc (second delta))))
                  (and (inside? moved)
                       (not (ormap (lambda (v) (hash-has-key? occupied (xy v))) (cells moved)))
                       (search (cons moved placed) (remove p pending)))))))))
       (and (<= 2 W w) (<= 0 r0 (- h H)) (<= 0 c0 (- w W)) (inside? anchor)
            (search (list anchor) (remove anchor pieces)))))
   (define assembled (paint-cells (empty-grid h w bg) (append-map cells solution)))
   (define (regions triples)
     (filter (lambda (o) (not (= (obj-color o) base)))
             (objects (paint-cells (empty-grid h w bg) triples) bg)))
   (define final-regions (regions (append-map cells solution)))
   (define raw-regions (append-map (lambda (p) (regions (cells p))) solution))
   (define available (if (equal? mode "raw_largest") raw-regions final-regions))
   (define selected
     (cond
       ((or (equal? mode "assembly") (null? available)) '())
       ((equal? mode "all_regions") available)
       ((equal? mode "smallest_region")
        (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-size o) (apply min (map obj-size available)))) available))
       ((equal? mode "first_region") (list (first available)))
       (else (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-size o) (apply max (map obj-size available)))) available))))
   (for/fold ((out assembled)) ((o selected)) (recolor-cells out (obj-cells o) marker)))))

(rule!
 ;; Complete a dense square color table whose zero cells are erased observations.
 ;; Stage A repairs every zero with a visible transpose partner.  Stage B consumes
 ;; that intermediate and closes any remaining holes under the row/column suffix
 ;; mirrors that leave indices 0 and 1 fixed.  The alternative stops after A.
 (lambda (g)
  (let ()
   (define completion "closure")
   (define rival "")
   (define h (rows g))
   (define w (cols g))
   (define prefix (cond [(equal? rival "wrong_prefix_one") 1]
                        [(equal? rival "wrong_prefix_three") 3]
                        [else 2]))
   (define (mirror-index i n) (if (< i prefix) i (- (+ n prefix -1) i)))
   (define (transpose-source r c)
    (if (equal? rival "anti_diagonal") (list (- h 1 c) (- w 1 r)) (list c r)))
   ;; A: simultaneous transpose repair from the original input.
   (define stage-a
    (if (equal? rival "fold_only") g
     (for*/fold ([out g]) ([r (in-range h)] [c (in-range w)])
      (let* ([p (transpose-source r c)] [rr (first p)] [cc (second p)])
       (if (and (= (at g r c) 0) (in-bounds? rr cc h w) (!= (at g rr cc) 0))
           (set-cell out r c (at g rr cc)) out)))))
   (define b-source (if (equal? rival "stage_b_original") g stage-a))
   (define (candidates r c)
    (let ([mr (mirror-index r h)] [mc (mirror-index c w)])
     (cond [(equal? rival "row_only") (list (list mr c))]
           [(equal? rival "column_only") (list (list r mc))]
           [(equal? rival "double_only") (list (list mr mc))]
           [else (list (list mr c) (list r mc) (list mr mc))])))
   ;; B: fill the residual cells using A's repaired grid as the donor table.
   (define stage-b
    (for*/fold ([out stage-a]) ([r (in-range h)] [c (in-range w)])
     (if (!= (at stage-a r c) 0) out
      (let ([v (for/first ([p (in-list (candidates r c))]
                           #:when (!= (at b-source (first p) (second p)) 0))
                 (at b-source (first p) (second p)))])
       (if v (set-cell out r c v) out)))))
   (define forced-closure
    (member rival '("fold_only" "row_only" "column_only" "double_only"
                    "stage_b_original" "wrong_prefix_one" "wrong_prefix_three")))
   (define use-closure
    (if (equal? rival "other_setting") (equal? completion "transpose_only")
        (or forced-closure (equal? completion "closure"))))
   (cond [(equal? rival "identity") g]
         [(equal? rival "fill_one")
          (for*/fold ([out g]) ([r (in-range h)] [c (in-range w)])
           (if (= (at g r c) 0) (set-cell out r c 1) out))]
         [use-closure stage-b]
         [else stage-a]))))

(rule!
 ;; Blue anchors carry a noncyan strip at one cardinal face. Read the attached
 ;; strip outward from the anchor, including all complete observed slices.
 ;; Its shortest prefix-period is the input-dependent repeated word.
 ;; Preserve every observed slice. Continue only beyond the observed end,
 ;; repeating the word through the boundary. A new trail may cross an old one.
 (lambda (g)
  (let ()
   (define bounce? #f)
   (define phase-offset 0)
   (define max-extension 60)
   (define background-only? #f)
   (define reverse-word? #f)
   (define mirror-lanes? #f)
   (define first-only? #f)
   (define anchors (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) 1)) (objects g 8)))
   (define directions (list (list -1 0) (list 1 0) (list 0 -1) (list 0 1)))
   (define (minimal-period strips)
    (for/first ((p (range 1 (+ 1 (length strips))))
      #:when (for/and ((i (range (length strips))))
               (equal? (nth strips i) (nth strips (modulo i p))))) p))
   (define rays
    (apply append
     (for/list ((o anchors))
      (let ((b (obj-bbox o)))
       (filter (lambda (x) x)
        (for/list ((d directions))
         (let* ((dr (first d)) (dc (second d))
                (face (if (= dc 0)
                    (for/list ((c (range (second b) (+ 1 (fourth b)))))
                     (list (if (< dr 0) (first b) (third b)) c))
                    (for/list ((r (range (first b) (+ 1 (third b)))))
                     (list r (if (< dc 0) (second b) (fourth b)))))))
          (define starts
           (for/list ((p face)
            #:when (and (= (at g (first p) (second p)) 1)
                        (in-bounds? (+ (first p) dr) (+ (second p) dc) h w)
                        (not (member (at g (+ (first p) dr) (+ (second p) dc)) (list 8 1)))))
            (list (+ (first p) dr) (+ (second p) dc))))
          (if (null? starts) #f
           (let ()
            (define strips
             (let loop ((k 0) (acc (list)))
              (if (for/and ((p starts))
                   (and (in-bounds? (+ (first p) (* k dr)) (+ (second p) (* k dc)) h w)
                        (not (member (at g (+ (first p) (* k dr)) (+ (second p) (* k dc))) (list 8 1)))))
               (loop (+ k 1) (append acc (list (map (lambda (p) (at g (+ (first p) (* k dr)) (+ (second p) (* k dc)))) starts))))
               acc)))
            (list dr dc starts strips))))))))))
   (for/fold ((out g)) ((ray (if first-only? (take rays (min 1 (length rays))) rays)))
    (let* ((dr (first ray)) (dc (second ray)) (starts (third ray)) (strips (fourth ray)))
     (define period (minimal-period strips))
     (define initial-word (take strips period))
     (define ordered-word (if reverse-word? (reverse initial-word) initial-word))
     (define word (if mirror-lanes? (map reverse ordered-word) ordered-word))
     (for/fold ((canvas out)) ((k (range (length strips) (min 60 (+ (length strips) max-extension))))
       #:when (for/and ((p starts)) (in-bounds? (+ (first p) (* k dr)) (+ (second p) (* k dc)) h w)))
      (define phase (+ k phase-offset))
      (define cycle (if (and bounce? (> period 1)) (- (* 2 period) 2) period))
      (define slot (modulo phase cycle))
      (define index (if (< slot period) slot (- cycle slot)))
      (for/fold ((painted canvas)) ((lane (range (length starts))))
       (define p (nth starts lane))
       (define rr (+ (first p) (* k dr)))
       (define cc (+ (second p) (* k dc)))
       (if (and background-only? (not (= (at g rr cc) 8))) painted
           (set-cell painted rr cc (nth (nth word index) lane))))))))))

(rule!
 ;; Uniform northeast/southwest strokes bound continuous diagonal spans.
 ;; A stroke is measured by u=r+c, its inclusive range of v=r-c, and length.
 ;; Paint a cyan cell red when one stroke lies on each side in u and both
 ;; continuous spans contain its v. Brackets need not be adjacent. Original
 ;; stroke cells stay unchanged, including strokes inside a filled region.
 (lambda (g)
  (let ()
   (define length-match? #f)
   (define adjacent-only? #f)
   (define first-pair-only? #f)
   (define longest-only? #f)
   (define exact-rays? #f)
   (define union-spans? #f)
   (define preserve-strokes? #t)
   (define same-color? #f)
   (define max-length 60)
   (define point-spans? #f)
   (define measured
    (for*/list ((r (range h)) (c (range w))
     #:when (and (not (= (at g r c) 8))
                  (not (= (safe-at g (- r 1) (+ c 1) 8) (at g r c)))))
      (let ((color (at g r c)))
       (let loop ((rr r) (cc c))
        (if (= (safe-at g (+ rr 1) (- cc 1) 8) color)
            (loop (+ rr 1) (- cc 1))
            (list (+ r c) (- r c) (if point-spans? (- r c) (- rr cc)) (+ 1 (- rr r)) color))))))
   (define ordered
    (sort measured (lambda (a b) (or (< (first a) (first b))
          (and (= (first a) (first b)) (< (second a) (second b)))))))
   (define maximum (apply max (cons 0 (map fourth ordered))))
   (define eligible
    (filter (lambda (s) (and (<= (fourth s) max-length)
                        (or (not longest-only?) (= (fourth s) maximum)))) ordered))
   (define segments (if first-pair-only? (take eligible (min 2 (length eligible))) eligible))
   (for/list ((r (range h)))
    (for/list ((c (range w)))
     (define u (+ r c))
     (define v (- r c))
     (if (and (or (not preserve-strokes?) (= (at g r c) 8))
          (for/or ((i (range (length segments))))
           (define left (nth segments i))
           (and (< (first left) u)
            (for/or ((j (range (+ i 1) (length segments))))
             (define right (nth segments j))
             (define low (if union-spans? (min (second left) (second right)) (max (second left) (second right))))
             (define high (if union-spans? (max (third left) (third right)) (min (third left) (third right))))
             (and (< u (first right))
                  (or (not adjacent-only?) (= j (+ i 1)))
                  (or (not length-match?) (= (fourth left) (fourth right)))
                  (or (not same-color?) (= (nth left 4) (nth right 4)))
                  (<= low v high)
                  (or (not exact-rays?)
                      (and (= (modulo (- v (second left)) 2) 0)
                           (= (modulo (- v (second right)) 2) 0))))))))
       2 (at g r c)))))))

(rule!
 ;; Treat each 8-connected two-color object as a directional ship.  The strict
 ;; majority color is its hull and the minority color its embedded particles.
 ;; Infer the unique nose from hull geometry, erase the embedded particles, and
 ;; emit the same number in a straight ray beyond the nose, clipping at bounds.
 (lambda (g)
  (let ()
   (define occupied
     (filter (lambda (p) (not (= (at g (first p) (second p)) 0)))
             (grid-positions g)))
   (define (components8 cells)
     (let loop ([remaining cells] [out '()])
       (if (empty? remaining)
           (reverse out)
           (let* ([start (first remaining)]
                  [region (connected-region g (first start) (second start)
                            (lambda (r c v) (not (= v 0))) 8)]
                  [next (filter (lambda (p) (not (member p region))) remaining)])
             (loop next (cons region out))))))
   (define (value p) (at g (first p) (second p)))
   (define (count-color cells color)
     (count-if (lambda (p) (= (value p) color)) cells))
   (define dirs '((-1 0) (1 0) (0 -1) (0 1)))
   (define (direction cells body)
     (define candidates
       (filter-map
        (lambda (d)
          (let* ([dr (first d)] [dc (second d)]
                 [extreme (apply max
                    (map (lambda (p) (+ (* (first p) dr) (* (second p) dc))) body))]
                 [tips (filter
                    (lambda (p) (= (+ (* (first p) dr) (* (second p) dc)) extreme))
                    body)])
            (if (not (= (length tips) 1))
                #f
                (let* ([tip (first tips)]
                       [counts
                        (for/list ([depth (in-range 1 5)])
                          (let ([layer
                            (for/list ([offset (in-range (- depth) (+ depth 1))])
                              (list (+ (first tip) (* (- dr) depth) (* (- dc) offset))
                                    (+ (second tip) (* (- dc) depth) (* dr offset))))])
                            (count-if (lambda (p) (member p cells)) layer)))]
                       [cone (apply + counts)]
                       [full (for/sum ([depth (in-range 1 5)] [n (in-list counts)])
                               (if (= n (+ (* 2 depth) 1)) 1 0))]
                       [center (for/sum ([depth (in-range 1 5)])
                                 (if (member
                                      (list (+ (first tip) (* (- dr) depth))
                                            (+ (second tip) (* (- dc) depth)))
                                      cells) 1 0))]
                       [score (+ (* cone 100) (* full 10) center)])
                  (list score dr dc tip)))))
        dirs))
     (pick-max candidates first))
   (define ships
     (filter-map
      (lambda (cells)
        (let ([colors (remove-duplicates (map value cells))])
          (if (not (= (length colors) 2))
              #f
              (let* ([body-color (pick-max colors (lambda (c) (count-color cells c)))]
                     [payload-color (first (filter (lambda (c) (not (= c body-color))) colors))]
                     [body-count (count-color cells body-color)]
                     [payload-count (count-color cells payload-color)])
                (if (<= body-count payload-count)
                    #f
                    (let* ([body (filter (lambda (p) (= (value p) body-color)) cells)]
                           [payload (filter (lambda (p) (= (value p) payload-color)) cells)]
                           [dir (direction cells body)]
                           [dr (second dir)] [dc (third dir)] [tip (fourth dir)]
                           [ray (filter
                              (lambda (p) (in-bounds? (first p) (second p) h w))
                              (for/list ([step (in-range 1 (+ payload-count 1))])
                                (list (+ (first tip) (* dr step))
                                      (+ (second tip) (* dc step)))))])
                      (list cells body-color payload-color payload tip dr dc ray payload-count)))))))
      (components8 occupied)))
   (define cleared
     (for/fold ([out g]) ([ship (in-list ships)])
       (recolor-cells out (fourth ship) 0)))
   (for/fold ([out cleared]) ([ship (in-list ships)])
     (recolor-cells out (list-ref ship 7) (third ship))))))

(rule!
 ;; Reconstruct the fixed 20 by 20 emblem from a unique contiguous crop. The
 ;; minority color is the emblem and the majority color is its background.
 ;; Search all eight rotations/reflections, then render the matching full pose.
 (lambda (g)
  (let ()
   (define mark-enclosed? #f)
   (define h (rows g))
   (define w (cols g))
   (define bg (mode g -1))
   (define colors (remove-duplicates (apply append g)))
   (define fg (first (filter (lambda (x) (not (= x bg))) colors)))
   (define runs
    '(((0 1) (15 16))
      ((0 5) (15 16))
      ((0 6) (15 17))
      ((0 1) (5 7) (15 17))
      ((6 8) (14 18))
      ((7 9) (14 14) (17 18))
      ((8 9) (12 14) (17 18))
      ((9 9) (12 12) (14 14) (17 18))
      ((9 12) (14 14) (17 18))
      ((1 9) (11 12) (14 14) (17 18))
      ((1 1) (9 12) (14 14) (17 18))
      ((1 9) (12 12) (14 14) (17 18))
      ((1 1) (3 3) (9 9) (12 14) (17 18))
      ((0 2) (4 9) (14 14) (17 18))
      ((1 1) (3 4) (9 9) (14 18))
      ((0 2) (4 4) (9 9) (13 14) (16 17))
      ((1 1) (3 4) (9 9) (13 13) (17 18))
      ((0 2) (4 4) (9 9) (13 14) (18 19))
      ((1 1) (3 4) (8 8) (10 10) (14 14) (16 18))
      ((0 2) (7 7) (11 11) (14 16))))
   (define base
    (for/list ((r (in-range 20)))
     (for/list ((c (in-range 20)))
      (if (for/or ((span (list-ref runs r)))
            (and (<= (first span) c) (<= c (second span)))) 1 0))))
   (define poses
    (list base (rotate-cw base) (rotate-180 base) (rotate-ccw base)
          (flip-lr base) (flip-ud base) (transpose base)
          (rotate-180 (transpose base))))
   (define crop
    (for/list ((r (in-range h)))
     (for/list ((c (in-range w))) (if (= (at g r c) fg) 1 0))))
   (define (fits? full)
    (for*/or ((r (in-range (+ 1 (- 20 h))))
              (c (in-range (+ 1 (- 20 w)))))
     (equal? crop (subgrid full r c (+ r h -1) (+ c w -1)))))
   (define matched (or (for/first ((full poses) #:when (fits? full)) full) base))
   (define completed
    (for/list ((row matched))
     (for/list ((v row)) (if (= v 1) fg bg))))
   (if mark-enclosed? (fill-all-enclosed completed 2 bg) completed))))

(rule!
 ;; Extrapolate the growing sequence of objects into the gray corner window.
 ;; Infer bounding-coordinate recurrences and palette cycles from visible objects.
 ;; Single-color shapes use the smallest consistent periodic/border texture;
 ;; multicolor structures use validated alternating rails or layered arches.
 ;; No supplied grid, gold, task hash, or example index is used by this rule.
 ;; Render the selected future member, then crop the gray-bracket rectangle.
 (lambda (g)
  (let ()
   (define (bb cells) (list (apply min (map first cells)) (apply min (map second cells))
                            (apply max (map first cells)) (apply max (map second cells))))
   (define (bh b) (add1 (- (third b) (first b))))
   (define (bw b) (add1 (- (fourth b) (second b))))
   (define crop (bb (find-color g 5)))
   (define objs (sort (objects-multicolor (recolor g 5 0) 0) <
                      #:key (lambda (o) (* (bh (bb (obj-cells o))) (bw (bb (obj-cells o)))))))
   (define boxes (map (lambda (o) (bb (obj-cells o))) objs))
   (define images (map (lambda (b) (subgrid g (first b) (second b) (third b) (fourth b))) boxes))
   (define (period values)
     (take values (for/first ([p (range 1 (add1 (length values)))]
       #:when (for/and ([v values] [i (in-naturals)]) (= v (list-ref values (remainder i p))))) p)))
   (define (diff values) (map - (rest values) (drop-right values 1)))
   (define (extend values index)
     (if (< index (length values)) (list-ref values index)
       (let* ([ds (diff values)] [dd (diff ds)] [steps (add1 (- index (length values)))]
              [lastv (last values)] [lastd (last ds)])
         (cond [(andmap (lambda (x) (= x (first ds))) ds) (+ lastv (* steps (first ds)))]
               [(andmap (lambda (x) (= x (first dd))) dd) (+ lastv (* steps lastd) (quotient (* (first dd) steps (add1 steps)) 2))]
               [else (let ([p (period ds)])
                 (+ lastv (for/sum ([i (range (length ds) index)]) (list-ref p (remainder i (length p))))))]))))
   (define target-row (for/first ([index (range (length images) (+ (length images) 8))]
       #:do [(define bounds (for/list ([j (range 4)]) (extend (map (lambda (b) (list-ref b j)) boxes) index)))]
       #:when (and (<= (first bounds) (first crop)) (>= (third bounds) (third crop))
                   (<= (second bounds) (second crop)) (>= (fourth bounds) (fourth crop))))
       (list index bounds)))
   (define index (first target-row))
   (define target (second target-row))
   (define th (bh target))
   (define tw (bw target))
   (define palettes (map (lambda (im) (grid-colors im 0)) images))
   (define fs (append (list (list 'constant 0))
     (for*/list ([kind '(top bottom)] [p (range 1 5)]) (list kind p))
     (for*/list ([kind '(local-mod global-mod center-mod)] [p (range 2 9)]) (list kind p))))
   (define (feature desc local size origin)
     (let ([kind (first desc)] [p (second desc)])
       (cond [(eq? kind 'constant) 0] [(eq? kind 'top) (min local p)]
             [(eq? kind 'bottom) (min (- size 1 local) p)]
             [(eq? kind 'local-mod) (modulo local p)]
             [(eq? kind 'global-mod) (modulo (+ origin local) p)]
             [else (modulo (+ (* 2 local) (- size) 1) p)])))
   (define (lex< a b)
     (cond [(empty? a) #f] [(< (first a) (first b)) #t]
           [(> (first a) (first b)) #f] [else (lex< (rest a) (rest b))]))
   (define observations (apply append (for/list ([im images] [bounds boxes])
     (for*/list ([r (range (rows im))] [c (range (cols im))])
       (list r c (rows im) (cols im) (first bounds) (second bounds) (if (= (at im r c) 0) 0 1))))))
   (define (learn rf cf)
     (let fill ([remaining observations] [table (hash)])
       (if (empty? remaining) table
         (let* ([p (first remaining)]
                [key (list (feature rf (list-ref p 0) (list-ref p 2) (list-ref p 4))
                           (feature cf (list-ref p 1) (list-ref p 3) (list-ref p 5)))]
                [v (list-ref p 6)] [old (hash-ref table key -1)])
           (and (or (= old -1) (= old v)) (fill (rest remaining) (hash-set table key v)))))))
   (define (texture)
     (define candidates (filter identity (for*/list ([fi (range (length fs))] [fj (range (length fs))])
       (define rf (list-ref fs fi)) (define cf (list-ref fs fj)) (define table (learn rf cf))
       (and table
         (for*/and ([r (range th)] [c (range tw)])
           (hash-has-key? table (list (feature rf r th (first target)) (feature cf c tw (second target)))))
         (list (list (hash-count table) (+ (second rf) (second cf)) (+ fi fj) fi fj) rf cf table)))))
     (define chosen (first (sort candidates lex< #:key first)))
     (define colors (period (map first palettes)))
     (define color (list-ref colors (remainder index (length colors))))
     (grid-from-fn th tw (lambda (r c)
       (* color (hash-ref (fourth chosen)
         (list (feature (second chosen) r th (first target)) (feature (third chosen) c tw (second target))))))))
   (define (chain count colors phase)
     (define height (sub1 (* 4 count))) (define center (sub1 (* 2 count)))
     (grid-from-fn height 2 (lambda (r c)
       (define distance (abs (- r center))) (define t (quotient distance 2))
       (define inner (list-ref colors (remainder t (length colors))))
       (if (even? distance) inner
         (if (= c (modulo (+ phase t) 2)) inner
           (if (< (add1 t) count) (list-ref colors (remainder (add1 t) (length colors))) 0))))))
   (define (arch count colors)
     (define width (add1 (* 4 count)))
     (grid-from-fn (* 2 count) width (lambda (r c)
       (define t (quotient r 2)) (define left (* 2 (- count 1 t))) (define right (- width 1 left))
       (define color (list-ref colors (remainder (- count 1 t) (length colors))))
       (cond [(and (= t 0) (= r 0) (and (<= left c) (<= c right))) color]
             [(and (= t 0) (= r 1) (or (= c left) (= c right))) color]
             [(and (> t 0) (even? r) (or (and (<= left c) (<= c (+ left 2))) (and (<= (- right 2) c) (<= c right)))) color]
             [(and (> t 0) (odd? r) (or (= c left) (= c right))) color]
             [(and (> t 0) (odd? r) (or (= c (+ left 2)) (= c (- right 2))))
              (list-ref colors (remainder (- count t) (length colors)))]
             [else 0]))))
   (define predicted
     (cond [(andmap (lambda (cs) (= (length cs) 1)) palettes) (texture)]
           [(and (= tw 2) (= (modulo th 4) 3)
                 (andmap (lambda (im) (and (= (cols im) 2) (= (modulo (rows im) 4) 3))) images))
            (let* ([big (last images)] [count (quotient (add1 (rows big)) 4)] [middle (quotient (rows big) 2)]
                   [colors (period (for/list ([t (range count)]) (at big (+ middle (* 2 t)) 0)))]
                   [phase (for/first ([p '(0 1)] #:when
                     (andmap (lambda (im) (equal? im (chain (quotient (add1 (rows im)) 4) colors p))) images)) p)])
              (chain (quotient (add1 th) 4) colors phase))]
           [else
            (let* ([big (last images)] [count (quotient (rows big) 2)]
                   [colors (period (for/list ([t (range count)]) (at big (* 2 (- count 1 t)) (* 2 t))))])
              (arch (quotient th 2) colors))]))
   (define cropped (subgrid predicted (- (first crop) (first target)) (- (second crop) (second target))
                                     (- (third crop) (first target)) (- (fourth crop) (second target))))
   cropped)))

(rule!
 (lambda (g)
  (let ()
   (define finish 'combine)
   (define h (rows g))
   (define w (cols g))
   (define bg (mode g -1))
   (define (inside-box? p box)
    (and (<= (first box) (first p) (third box))
         (<= (second box) (second p) (fourth box))))
   (define (box-area box)
    (* (+ 1 (- (third box) (first box)))
       (+ 1 (- (fourth box) (second box)))))
   (define (mask-of cells)
    (paint-cells (empty-grid h w 0) cells 1))
   ;; Detect multicolor 4-connected groups by applying the ordinary object
   ;; finder to a binary non-background mask.
   (define foreground-mask
    (grid-from-fn h w (lambda (r c) (if (= (at g r c) bg) 0 1))))
   (define groups (objects foreground-mask 0))
   (define candidates
    (filter
     (lambda (obj)
      (let* ((cells (obj-cells obj))
             (box (bbox-of-cells cells))
             (r0 (first box)) (c0 (second box))
             (r1 (third box)) (c1 (fourth box))
             (colors (remove-duplicates
                      (map (lambda (p) (at g (first p) (second p))) cells))))
       (and (= (- c1 c0) 1)
            (>= (+ 1 (- r1 r0)) 2)
            (>= (length colors) 2)
            (andmap (lambda (r) (not (= (at g r c0) bg)))
                    (range r0 (+ r1 1))))))
     groups))
   (when (not (= (length candidates) 1))
    (error 'keyed-compose "expected exactly one two-column multicolor key"))
   (define key (first candidates))
   (define key-box (bbox-of-cells (obj-cells key)))
   (define kr0 (first key-box))
   (define kc0 (second key-box))
   (define kr1 (third key-box))
   (define key-cells
    (positions-in-rect (first key-box) (second key-box)
                       (third key-box) (fourth key-box)))
   ;; Entry shape: (source target key-row scene-cells source-components bbox).
   (define entries
    (for/list ((r (in-range kr0 (+ kr1 1))))
     (let* ((source (at g r kc0))
            (target (at g r (+ kc0 1)))
            (scene (filter (lambda (p) (not (member p key-cells)))
                           (find-color g source)))
            (comps (if (empty? scene) '() (objects (mask-of scene) 0)))
            (box (bbox-of-cells scene)))
      (list source target r scene comps box))))
   (define (entry-source e) (first e))
   (define (entry-target e) (second e))
   (define (entry-row e) (third e))
   (define (entry-cells e) (fourth e))
   (define (entry-components e) (fifth e))
   (define (entry-box e) (sixth e))
   (define (transparent? e)
    (or (= (entry-target e) 0) (= (entry-target e) bg)))
   (define (apply-entry e out)
    (if (empty? (entry-cells e))
        out
        (let* ((box (entry-box e))
               (rect (positions-in-rect (first box) (second box)
                                        (third box) (fourth box)))
               (painted
                (if (transparent? e)
                    (paint-cells out
                     (map (lambda (p)
                           (list (first p) (second p)
                                 (at g (first p) (second p))))
                          rect))
                    (recolor-cells out rect (entry-target e)))))
         (if (and (not (transparent? e))
                  (>= (length (entry-components e)) 2))
             (recolor-cells painted (entry-cells e) (entry-source e))
             painted))))
   ;; The lower key row is the bottom layer and the upper key row the top layer.
   (define composed (foldl apply-entry g (reverse entries)))
   (define changed
    (filter
     (lambda (p)
      (and (not (member p key-cells))
           (not (= (at composed (first p) (second p))
                   (at g (first p) (second p))))))
     (grid-positions g)))
   (cond
    ((eq? finish 'combine) composed)
    ((eq? finish 'largest-change)
     (if (empty? changed)
         composed
         (let* ((changed-objects (objects (mask-of changed) 0))
                (selected (pick-max changed-objects obj-size)))
          (recolor-cells composed (obj-cells selected) 9))))
    ((eq? finish 'raw-box)
     (let* ((visible-entries
             (filter (lambda (e)
                      (and (not (empty? (entry-cells e)))
                           (not (transparent? e))))
                     entries))
            (raw (pick-max visible-entries
                           (lambda (e) (box-area (entry-box e)))))
            (selected
             (if raw
                 (filter (lambda (p) (inside-box? p (entry-box raw))) changed)
                 '())))
      (recolor-cells composed selected 9)))
    (else (error 'keyed-compose "unknown finish mode"))))))

(rule!
 (lambda (g)
  (let ()
   (define assignment-mode 0) ; 0 = matching marker color, 1 = nearest anchor line
   (define h (rows g))
   (define w (cols g))
   (define bg (mode g -1))
   (define all-objects (objects-multicolor g bg))
   (define (border? p)
    (or (= (first p) 0) (= (second p) 0)
        (= (first p) (- h 1)) (= (second p) (- w 1))))
   (define (anchor-object? o)
    (and (= (obj-size o) 1) (border? (first (obj-cells o)))))
   (define anchor-points
    (sort (map (lambda (o) (first (obj-cells o)))
               (filter anchor-object? all-objects)) cell<))
   (define movable
    (sort (filter (lambda (o) (not (anchor-object? o))) all-objects)
          (lambda (a b)
           (cell< (first (sort (obj-cells a) cell<))
                  (first (sort (obj-cells b) cell<))))))
   (define anchor-colors
    (remove-duplicates
     (map (lambda (p) (at g (first p) (second p))) anchor-points)))
   (define (color-count cells color)
    (length (filter (lambda (p) (= (at g (first p) (second p)) color)) cells)))
   (define (marker-for o)
    (let* ((cells (sort (obj-cells o) cell<))
           (candidates
            (filter (lambda (p) (member? (at g (first p) (second p)) anchor-colors)) cells)))
     (pick-min candidates
      (lambda (p)
       (+ (* 1000 (color-count cells (at g (first p) (second p))))
          (at g (first p) (second p)))))))
   (define (side p)
    (cond ((= (second p) 0) 'left)
          ((= (second p) (- w 1)) 'right)
          ((= (first p) 0) 'top)
          (else 'bottom)))
   (define (line-distance marker anchor)
    (if (member? (side anchor) '(left right))
        (abs (- (first marker) (first anchor)))
        (abs (- (second marker) (second anchor)))))
   (define (anchor-for marker)
    (let* ((mc (at g (first marker) (second marker)))
           (candidates
            (if (= assignment-mode 0)
                (filter (lambda (p) (= (at g (first p) (second p)) mc)) anchor-points)
                anchor-points)))
     (pick-min candidates
      (lambda (p)
       (if (= assignment-mode 0)
           (pos-manhattan marker p)
           (line-distance marker p))))))
   (define (centered-full-three? o marker)
    (let* ((cells (obj-cells o)) (box (obj-bbox o)))
     (and (= (obj-size o) 9)
          (= (- (third box) (first box)) 2)
          (= (- (fourth box) (second box)) 2)
          (= (first marker) (+ (first box) 1))
          (= (second marker) (+ (second box) 1)))))
   (define records
    (map
     (lambda (o)
      (let* ((marker (marker-for o))
             (anchor (anchor-for marker))
             (s (side anchor))
             (dr (if (member? s '(left right)) (- (first anchor) (first marker)) 0))
             (dc (if (member? s '(top bottom)) (- (second anchor) (second marker)) 0))
             (special (centered-full-three? o marker))
             (ndr (+ dr (if (and special (eq? s 'top)) -1
                           (if (and special (eq? s 'bottom)) 1 0))))
             (ndc (+ dc (if (and special (eq? s 'left)) -1
                           (if (and special (eq? s 'right)) 1 0)))))
       (list o ndr ndc)))
     movable))
   (define cleared
    (for*/fold ((out g)) ((o movable) (p (obj-cells o)))
     (set-cell out (first p) (second p) bg)))
   (for*/fold ((out cleared)) ((record records)
                               (p (sort (obj-cells (first record)) cell<)))
    (let ((nr (+ (first p) (second record)))
          (nc (+ (second p) (third record))))
     (if (in-bounds? nr nc h w)
         (set-cell out nr nc (at g (first p) (second p))) out))))))

(rule!
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define contour-mode 0) ; 0 = fill enclosed holes for the outer contour
     (define h (rows g))
     (define w (cols g))
     (define seed (first (find-color g 6)))
     (define traversable
       (grid-from-fn h w
         (lambda (r c) (if (or (= (at g r c) 8) (= (at g r c) 6)) 0 1))))
     (define region
       (first (filter (lambda (cells) (member? seed cells))
                      (find-0-regions traversable 0))))
     (define complement-mask
       (grid-from-fn h w
         (lambda (r c) (if (member? (list r c) region) 1 0))))
     (define complement (find-0-regions complement-mask 0))
     (define (border? p)
       (or (= (first p) 0) (= (second p) 0)
           (= (first p) (- h 1)) (= (second p) (- w 1))))
     (define holes
       (filter (lambda (cells) (not (any? border? cells))) complement))
     (define hole-cells (if (null? holes) '() (apply append holes)))
     (define wall-mask
       (grid-from-fn h w (lambda (r c) (if (= (at g r c) 1) 0 1))))
     (define wall-components (find-0-regions wall-mask 0))
     (define (touches-region? cells)
       (any?
        (lambda (p)
          (let ((r (first p)) (c (second p)))
            (or (member? (list (- r 1) c) region)
                (member? (list (+ r 1) c) region)
                (member? (list r (- c 1)) region)
                (member? (list r (+ c 1)) region))))
        cells))
     (define kept-walls
       (let ((xs (filter touches-region? wall-components)))
         (if (null? xs) '() (apply append xs))))
     (define domain (if (= contour-mode 0) (append region hole-cells) region))
     (define (boundary? r c)
       (for*/or ((dr (in-range -1 2)) (dc (in-range -1 2))
                 #:unless (and (= dr 0) (= dc 0)))
         (let ((nr (+ r dr)) (nc (+ c dc)))
           (or (< nr 0) (>= nr h) (< nc 0) (>= nc w)
               (not (member? (list nr nc) domain))))))
     (grid-from-fn h w
       (lambda (r c)
         (let ((p (list r c)))
           (cond
             ((member? p region)
              (if (= (at g r c) 6) 6 (if (boundary? r c) 7 8)))
             ((or (member? p hole-cells) (member? p kept-walls)) (at g r c))
             (else 8))))))))

(rule!
 ;; The gray table has square top templates, middle layout fragments and
 ;; bottom recoloring swatches. Overlay the middle fragments; each nonzero
 ;; layout cell selects its source-color template, recolored by that template's
 ;; bottom legend. Default stamps as drawn; the alternative rotates each tile.
 (lambda (g)
  (let ()
   (define n (for/first ((c (in-range w)) #:when (= (at g 0 c) 5)) c))
   (define starts
    (filter (lambda (x)
     (for*/or ((r (in-range n)) (c (in-range n)))
      (and (not (= (at g r (+ x c)) 0)) (not (= (at g r (+ x c)) 5)))))
     (range 0 (+ (- w n) 1) (+ n 1))))
   (define templates
    (for/list ((x starts))
     (let* ((source (for*/first ((r (in-range n)) (c (in-range n))
                       #:when (not (= (at g r (+ x c)) 0))) (at g r (+ x c))))
            (target (for*/first ((r (in-range (+ (* 2 n) 2) h)) (c (in-range n))
                       #:when (and (not (= (at g r (+ x c)) 0))
                                   (not (= (at g r (+ x c)) 5)))) (at g r (+ x c))))
            (offsets (for*/list ((r (in-range n)) (c (in-range n))
                         #:when (= (at g r (+ x c)) source)) (list r c))))
       (list source target offsets))))
   (define layout
    (build-grid n n (r c)
     (let ((v (for/first ((x starts) #:when (not (= (at g (+ n 1 r) (+ x c)) 0)))
                (at g (+ n 1 r) (+ x c))))) (if v v 0))))
   (for*/fold ((out (build-grid (* n n) (* n n) (r c) 0)))
               ((r (in-range n)) (c (in-range n)) #:when (not (= (at layout r c) 0)))
    (let* ((entry (for/first ((t templates) #:when (= (first t) (at layout r c))) t))
           (offsets (third entry)))
     (for/fold ((result out)) ((p offsets))
      (let ((rr (first p)) (cc (second p)))
       (set-cell result (+ (* r n) rr) (+ (* c n) cc) (second entry)))))))))

(rule!
 ;; A full blue cross divides yellow panels. Each has a red square; the one
 ;; with additional colored pixels is the source. Scale its decoration by
 ;; each destination/source red-side ratio. Reflect across changed panel axes.
 ;; Preserve red anchors, the source, and dividers; clip to the target panel.
 ;; Inverse lookup uses mathematical floor for negative anchor offsets.
 (lambda (g)
  (let ()
   (define divider-row
    (for/first ((r (in-range h)) #:when (for/and ((c (in-range w))) (= (at g r c) 1))) r))
   (define divider-col
    (for/first ((c (in-range w)) #:when (for/and ((r (in-range h))) (= (at g r c) 1))) c))
   (define bounds
    (list (list 0 0 (- divider-row 1) (- divider-col 1))
          (list 0 (+ divider-col 1) (- divider-row 1) (- w 1))
          (list (+ divider-row 1) 0 (- h 1) (- divider-col 1))
          (list (+ divider-row 1) (+ divider-col 1) (- h 1) (- w 1))))
   (define records
    (for/list ((b bounds))
     (let ((cells (for*/list ((r (in-range (first b) (+ 1 (third b))))
                             (c (in-range (second b) (+ 1 (fourth b))))
                             #:when (= (at g r c) 2)) (list r c))))
      (list b (bbox-of-cells cells)))))
   (define source
    (for/first ((p records) #:when
     (let ((b (first p)))
      (for*/or ((r (in-range (first b) (+ 1 (third b))))
                (c (in-range (second b) (+ 1 (fourth b)))))
        (and (not (= (at g r c) 4)) (not (= (at g r c) 2)))))) p))
   (define sb (first source))
   (define anchor (second source))
   (define source-size (+ 1 (- (third anchor) (first anchor))))
   (define (floor-ratio a b)
    (if (>= a 0) (quotient a b) (- (quotient (+ (- a) (- b 1)) b))))
   (for/fold ((result g)) ((target records) #:when (not (equal? target source)))
    (let* ((b (first target)) (box (second target))
           (k (+ 1 (- (third box) (first box))))
           (flip-y (not (= (first b) (first sb))))
           (flip-x (not (= (second b) (second sb)))))
     (for*/fold ((out result))
       ((r (in-range (first b) (+ 1 (third b))))
        (c (in-range (second b) (+ 1 (fourth b)))))
      (let* ((dr (- r (first box))) (dc (- c (second box)))
             (rr (if flip-y (- k 1 dr) dr))
             (cc (if flip-x (- k 1 dc) dc))
             (sr (+ (first anchor) (floor-ratio (* rr source-size) k)))
             (sc (+ (second anchor) (floor-ratio (* cc source-size) k))))
       (if (and (= (at g r c) 4)
                (<= (first sb) sr (third sb)) (<= (second sb) sc (fourth sb))
                (not (= (at g sr sc) 4)) (not (= (at g sr sc) 2)))
        (set-cell out r c (at g sr sc)) out))))))))

(rule!
 ;; Separate each monochrome source piece above the horizontal bands.
 ;; Match its original color to a band's interior color; preserve its columns,
 ;; bottom-align it to that band's floor, and paint in that band's rail color.
 ;; Components are independently aligned, not sequentially piled up.
 (lambda (g)
  (let ()
   (define output-policy "all_landings")
   (define bg (at g 0 0))
   (define band-rows
    (filter (lambda (r)
      (and (= (at g r 0) (at g r (- w 1)))
           (not (= (at g r 0) (at g r 1)))
           (not (= (at g r 1) bg))
           (for/and ((c (range 1 (- w 1)))) (= (at g r c) (at g r 1)))))
      (range h)))
   (define bands
    (for/list ((r band-rows)
       #:when (or (= r 0) (not (member (- r 1) band-rows))
                  (not (= (at g (- r 1) 1) (at g r 1)))))
     (list r
       (let loop ((end r))
        (if (and (member (+ end 1) band-rows)
                 (= (at g (+ end 1) 1) (at g r 1))) (loop (+ end 1)) end))
       (at g r 1) (at g r 0))))
   (define top (if (null? bands) h (first (first bands))))
   (define pieces (objects (subgrid g 0 0 (- top 1) (- w 1)) bg))
   (define deliveries
    (for/list ((o pieces))
     (let ((b (for/first ((b bands) #:when (= (third b) (obj-color o))) b)))
      (list o b
       (if b (map (lambda (p) (list (+ (first p) (- (second b) (obj-r2 o))) (second p)))
                  (obj-cells o)) '())))))
   (define cleared
    (for/fold ((out g)) ((d deliveries))
     (if (second d) (recolor-cells out (obj-cells (first d)) bg) out)))
   (define landed
    (for/fold ((out cleared)) ((d deliveries))
     (if (second d) (recolor-cells out (third d) (fourth (second d))) out)))
   (define mask
    (for/fold ((out (empty-grid h w -1))) ((d deliveries))
     (if (second d) (recolor-cells out (third d) (fourth (second d))) out)))
   (define groups (objects mask -1))
   (define selected
    (cond
     ((or (equal? output-policy "all_landings") (null? groups)) '())
     ((equal? output-policy "original_largest")
      (third (pick-max deliveries (lambda (d) (obj-size (first d))))))
     ((equal? output-policy "most_color")
      (let ((col (pick-max (grid-colors mask -1) (lambda (c) (count-color mask c)))))
       (find-color mask col)))
     ((equal? output-policy "most_pieces")
      (let* ((b (pick-max bands (lambda (b)
                   (length (filter (lambda (d) (equal? (second d) b)) deliveries)))))
             (parts (filter (lambda (o) (and (>= (obj-r1 o) (first b))
                                             (<= (obj-r2 o) (second b)))) groups)))
       (obj-cells (pick-max parts obj-size))))
     ((equal? output-policy "per_band")
      (apply append
       (for/list ((b bands))
        (let ((parts (filter (lambda (o) (and (>= (obj-r1 o) (first b))
                            (<= (obj-r2 o) (second b)))) groups)))
         (if (null? parts) '() (obj-cells (pick-max parts obj-size)))))))
     ((equal? output-policy "smallest") (obj-cells (pick-min groups obj-size)))
     ((equal? output-policy "first") (obj-cells (first groups)))
     ((equal? output-policy "last") (obj-cells (last groups)))
     ((equal? output-policy "exact_nine")
      (apply append (map obj-cells (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-size o) 9)) groups))))
     (else (obj-cells (pick-max groups obj-size)))))
   (recolor-cells landed selected 9))))

(rule!
 ;; The black rectangle is a counting board. Each colored legend marker names
 ;; a color to count outside the board. Count eight-connected monochrome objects,
 ;; not pixels (diagonally touching cells are one object), ignoring unlisted colors.
 ;; Crop the board and repeat each marker every two columns, once per object.
 (lambda (g)
  (let ()
   (define output-policy "count_all")
   (define black-parts (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) 0)) (objects g -1)))
   (define board (pick-max black-parts obj-size))
   (define r0 (obj-r1 board))
   (define c0 (obj-c1 board))
   (define r9 (obj-r2 board))
   (define c9 (obj-c2 board))
   (define bh (+ 1 (- r9 r0)))
   (define bw (+ 1 (- c9 c0)))
   (define background
    (mode-list (for/list ((p (grid-positions g))
       #:unless (and (<= r0 (first p) r9) (<= c0 (second p) c9)))
          (at g (first p) (second p)))))
   (define outside (recolor-cells g (positions-in-rect r0 c0 r9 c9) background))
   (define objects-out
    (if (equal? output-policy "four_connected") (objects outside background)
        (objects-8 outside background)))
   (define (object-shape o)
    (map (lambda (p) (list (- (first p) (obj-r1 o)) (- (second p) (obj-c1 o))))
         (sort (obj-cells o) (lambda (a b) (or (< (first a) (first b))
                          (and (= (first a) (first b)) (< (second a) (second b))))))))
   (define entries
    (for/list ((r (range r0 (+ r9 1)))
       #:when (for/or ((c (range c0 (+ c9 1)))) (not (= (at g r c) 0))))
     (let* ((c (for/first ((c (range c0 (+ c9 1))) #:when (not (= (at g r c) 0))) c))
            (color (at g r c))
            (matches (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) color)) objects-out))
            (n (cond
                 ((equal? output-policy "pixels") (apply + (map obj-size matches)))
                 ((equal? output-policy "shape_classes") (length (remove-duplicates (map object-shape matches))))
                 ((equal? output-policy "include_legend") (+ 1 (length matches)))
                 (else (length matches)))))
      (list (- r r0) (- c c0) color n))))
   (define ordered
    (cond
     ((or (equal? output-policy "count_all") (equal? output-policy "cumulative_input_order")) entries)
     ((equal? output-policy "descending_cumulative") (sort entries (lambda (a b) (> (fourth a) (fourth b)))))
     (else (sort entries (lambda (a b) (< (fourth a) (fourth b)))))))
   (for/fold ((out (empty-grid bh bw 0))) ((index (range (length entries))))
    (let* ((slot (list-ref entries index))
           (item (list-ref ordered index))
           (n (if (or (equal? output-policy "count_all") (equal? output-policy "rank_only"))
                  (fourth item)
                  (for/sum ((k (range (+ index 1)))) (fourth (list-ref ordered k))))))
     (recolor-cells out
       (for/list ((k (range n)) #:when (< (+ (second slot) (* 2 k)) bw))
          (list (first slot) (+ (second slot) (* 2 k))))
       (third item)))))))

(rule!
 ;; A monochrome hollow cross determines a center and common arm length.
 ;; Extend its four arms into clockwise interleaved contours, leaving one
 ;; background cell between paths. Radius one first expands to radius two.
 ;; Each contour group runs 2+4*n, bends inward by k-2, then extends by k.
 ;; Move outside the canvas normally and clip only painting: later segments
 ;; can re-enter. The reflected setting reverses every turn, not the input.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define height (rows g))
     (define width (cols g))
     (define cells (filter (lambda (p) (> (at g (first p) (second p)) 0)) (grid-positions g)))
     (define box (bbox-of-cells cells))
     (define center-r (/ (+ (first box) (third box)) 2))
     (define center-c (/ (+ (second box) (fourth box)) 2))
     (define measured-radius (/ (- (third box) (first box)) 2))
     (define radius (max 2 measured-radius))
     (define ink (at g (first (first cells)) (second (first cells))))
     (define handedness 1)
     (define directions (list (list -1 0) (list 0 1) (list 1 0) (list 0 -1)))
     (define (segment state direction distance)
       (let* ((r (second state)) (c (third state))
              (delta (list-ref directions (modulo direction 4)))
              (dr (first delta)) (dc (second delta))
              (points (for/list ((step (range 1 (+ distance 1)))
                         #:when (in-bounds? (+ r (* dr step)) (+ c (* dc step)) height width))
                        (list (+ r (* dr step)) (+ c (* dc step))))))
         (list (recolor-cells (first state) points ink)
               (+ r (* dr distance)) (+ c (* dc distance)))))
     (for/fold ((out (empty-grid height width 0))) ((start (range 0 4)))
       (let loop ((state (segment (list out center-r center-c) start radius))
                  (direction (+ start handedness)) (layer 0))
         (if (>= layer (+ height width))
             (first state)
             (let* ((long (segment state direction (+ 2 (* 4 layer))))
                    (inward (segment long (+ direction handedness) (- radius 2)))
                    (tip (segment inward direction radius)))
               (loop tip (+ direction handedness) (+ layer 1)))))))))

(rule!
 ;; Find the common source edge. Every active line has two same-color seeds,
 ;; the first on that edge, and optionally one later different-color marker.
 ;; The seed separation defines a periodic lattice extending inward.
 ;; Only a marker on the lattice is hit: recolor the whole run to its color
 ;; and stop there. Off-lattice markers remain unchanged and do not stop it.
 ;; The alternate extent preserves the hit color but continues to the edge.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define height (rows g))
     (define width (cols g))
     (define continue-after-hit #f)
     (define (line-values side index)
       (cond ((= side 0) (row g index))
             ((= side 1) (reverse (row g index)))
             ((= side 2) (col g index))
             (else (reverse (col g index)))))
     (define (count-lines side) (if (< side 2) height width))
     (define (occupied values)
       (filter (lambda (i) (> (list-ref values i) 0)) (range 0 (length values))))
     (define (valid-edge? side)
       (and
         (for/or ((i (range 0 (count-lines side)))) (not (null? (occupied (line-values side i)))))
         (for/and ((i (range 0 (count-lines side))))
           (let* ((values (line-values side i)) (ps (occupied values)))
             (or (null? ps)
                 (and (or (= (length ps) 2) (= (length ps) 3))
                      (= (first ps) 0)
                      (= (list-ref values (first ps)) (list-ref values (second ps)))
                      (or (= (length ps) 2)
                          (not (= (list-ref values (third ps)) (list-ref values (first ps)))))))))))
     (define side (first (filter valid-edge? (range 0 4))))
     (define line-length (if (< side 2) width height))
     (define (position line offset)
       (cond ((= side 0) (list line offset))
             ((= side 1) (list line (- width 1 offset)))
             ((= side 2) (list offset line))
             (else (list (- height 1 offset) line))))
     (for/fold ((out g)) ((line (range 0 (count-lines side))))
       (let* ((values (line-values side line)) (ps (occupied values)))
         (if (null? ps) out
             (let* ((spacing (second ps))
                    (seed-color (first values))
                    (marker (if (= (length ps) 3) (third ps) #f))
                    (hit (and marker (= (modulo marker spacing) 0) marker))
                    (ink (if hit (list-ref values hit) seed-color))
                    (end (if (and hit (not continue-after-hit)) hit (- line-length 1)))
                    (points (for/list ((offset (range 0 (+ end 1) spacing))) (position line offset))))
               (recolor-cells out points ink))))))))

(rule!
 (let ()
   (define descending #f)
   (define bg (mode g -1))
   (define h (rows g))
   (define w (cols g))
   (define axis-row
     (first
       (filter (lambda (r)
                 (andmap (lambda (c) (not (= (at g r c) bg))) (range w)))
               (range h))))
   (define axis-color (mode (list (list-ref g axis-row)) bg))
   (define (run-end c color)
     (if (and (< c w) (= (at g axis-row c) color))
         (run-end (+ c 1) color)
         c))
   (define (scan c)
     (cond
       ((>= c w) '())
       ((= (at g axis-row c) axis-color) (scan (+ c 1)))
       (else
         (let* ((color (at g axis-row c))
                (end (run-end c color)))
           (cons (list c end color) (scan end))))))
   (define slots (scan 0))
   (define (filled? r slot)
     (andmap (lambda (c) (= (at g r c) (third slot)))
             (range (first slot) (second slot))))
   (define (top-of slot)
     (let loop ((r axis-row))
       (if (and (> r 0) (filled? (- r 1) slot))
           (loop (- r 1))
           r)))
   (define (bottom-of slot)
     (let loop ((r axis-row))
       (if (and (< (+ r 1) h) (filled? (+ r 1) slot))
           (loop (+ r 1))
           r)))
   (define measured
     (map (lambda (slot) (+ 1 (- (bottom-of slot) (top-of slot)))) slots))
   (define assigned (sort measured (if descending > <)))
   (define specs (map list slots assigned))
   (grid-from-fn h w
     (lambda (r c)
       (if (= r axis-row)
           (at g r c)
           (let ((spec (find-first
                         (lambda (x)
                           (and (<= (first (first x)) c)
                                (< c (second (first x)))))
                         specs)))
             (if spec
                 (let* ((slot (first spec))
                        (height (second spec))
                        (top (- axis-row (quotient height 2))))
                   (if (and (<= top r) (< r (+ top height)))
                       (third slot)
                       bg))
                 bg)))))))

(rule!
 (let ()
   (define longest #f)
   (define bg (mode g -1))
   (define h (rows g))
   (define w (cols g))
   (define obs (objects-8 g bg))
   (define sample (first obs))
   (define sample-cells (obj-cells sample))
   (define direction
     (cond
       ((= (obj-h sample) 1) (list 0 1))
       ((= (obj-w sample) 1) (list 1 0))
       ((= (length (remove-duplicates
                     (map (lambda (p) (- (first p) (second p))) sample-cells))) 1)
        (list 1 1))
       (else (list 1 -1))))
   (define dr (first direction))
   (define dc (second direction))
   (define (projection p) (+ (* dr (first p)) (* dc (second p))))
   (define (perpendicular p) (+ (* (- dc) (first p)) (* dr (second p))))
   (define (min-end obj) (pick-min (obj-cells obj) projection))
   (define (max-end obj) (pick-max (obj-cells obj) projection))
   (define min-ends (map min-end obs))
   (define max-ends (map max-end obs))
   (define min-aligned?
     (= (length (remove-duplicates (map projection min-ends))) 1))
   (define max-aligned?
     (= (length (remove-duplicates (map projection max-ends))) 1))
   (define anchor-min? min-aligned?)
   (define (anchor obj) (if anchor-min? (min-end obj) (max-end obj)))
   (define ordered
     (sort obs (lambda (a b) (< (perpendicular (anchor a))
                                (perpendicular (anchor b))))))
   (define target-length
     (if longest
         (apply max (map obj-size obs))
         (obj-size (list-ref ordered (quotient (length ordered) 2)))))
   (define step-r (if anchor-min? dr (- dr)))
   (define step-c (if anchor-min? dc (- dc)))
   (for/fold ((out (empty-grid h w bg))) ((obj ordered))
     (let ((start (anchor obj)))
       (for/fold ((painted out)) ((i (range target-length)))
         (set-cell painted
                   (+ (first start) (* i step-r))
                   (+ (second start) (* i step-c))
                   (obj-color obj)))))))

(rule!
 ;; Infer the modal background, then discover SAME-COLOR eight-connected objects.
 ;; Measure each object's occupied area. Objects with another object of equal
 ;; area rise to the top; unique-area objects sink to the bottom. Colors, shapes,
 ;; and horizontal coordinates are preserved. Erase before painting, so old
 ;; locations never mask a translated object. Equal-size groups may exceed two.
 ;; Admitted generated scenes have disjoint destination footprints.
 (lambda (g)
  (let ()
    (define match-by 'occupied_area)
    (define connectivity 8)
    (define direction 'normal)
    (define exact-pairs #f)
    (define bg (mode g -1))
    (define components (if (= connectivity 8) (objects-8 g bg) (objects g bg)))
    (define (measure obj)
      (cond [(equal? match-by 'occupied_area) (obj-size obj)]
            [(equal? match-by 'bbox_area) (* (obj-h obj) (obj-w obj))]
            [(equal? match-by 'width) (obj-w obj)]
            [(equal? match-by 'height) (obj-h obj)]
            [(equal? match-by 'bbox_perimeter) (* 2 (+ (obj-h obj) (obj-w obj)))]
            [(equal? match-by 'color) (obj-color obj)]
            [else (error 'measure "unknown matching key")]))
    ;; Step A: input-derived measurements and their multiplicities.
    (define keys (map measure components))
    (define records
      (for/list ([obj components] [key keys])
        (list obj key (length (filter (lambda (x) (= x key)) keys)))))
    ;; Step B consumes those multiplicities to choose a per-object translation.
    (for/fold ([out (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) bg)]) ([record records])
      (define obj (first record))
      (define repeated (if exact-pairs (= (third record) 2) (> (third record) 1)))
      (define top
        (cond [(equal? direction 'reverse) (not repeated)]
              [(equal? direction 'all_top) #t]
              [(equal? direction 'all_bottom) #f]
              [else repeated]))
      (define dr (if top (- (obj-r1 obj)) (- (rows g) 1 (obj-r2 obj))))
      (for/fold ([painted out]) ([p (obj-cells obj)])
        (set-cell painted (+ (first p) dr) (second p) (obj-color obj)))))))

(rule!
 ;; A solid multicolor two-cell-thick table touches a canvas edge. Read each
 ;; color pair INWARD: the edge-facing color is the key, its inner neighbor the
 ;; value. A square 2x2 table uses a touched horizontal edge when one exists.
 ;; Find four-connected background regions not reaching the canvas border.
 ;; A monochromatic enclosing boundary selects its key; unmapped holes and
 ;; open background remain unchanged. Fill all cells of each mapped hole.
 ;; The native largest_per_color variant retains all maximum-area ties per key.
 (lambda (g)
  (let ()
    (define fill-scope 'all)
    (define size-measure 'area)
    (define legend-direction 'inward)
    (define connectivity 4)
    (define bg (mode g -1))
    (define (horizontal? obj)
      (and (= (obj-h obj) 2)
           (or (= (obj-r1 obj) 0) (= (obj-r2 obj) (- (rows g) 1)))))
    (define tables
      (filter
        (lambda (obj)
          (and (= (obj-size obj) (* (obj-h obj) (obj-w obj)))
               (> (length (remove-duplicates
                    (map (lambda (p) (at g (first p) (second p))) (obj-cells obj)))) 1)
               (or (horizontal? obj)
                   (and (= (obj-w obj) 2)
                        (or (= (obj-c1 obj) 0) (= (obj-c2 obj) (- (cols g) 1)))))))
        (objects-multicolor g bg)))
    (unless (= (length tables) 1) (error 'legend "one solid edge legend required"))
    (define table (first tables))
    (define horizontal (horizontal? table))
    (define source-first
      (let ([normal (if horizontal (= (obj-r1 table) 0) (= (obj-c1 table) 0))])
        (cond [(equal? legend-direction 'reverse) (not normal)]
              [(equal? legend-direction 'forward) #t]
              [(equal? legend-direction 'backward) #f]
              [else normal])))
    (define mapping
      (if horizontal
          (for/list ([c (in-range (obj-c1 table) (+ 1 (obj-c2 table)))])
            (if source-first (list (at g (obj-r1 table) c) (at g (obj-r2 table) c))
                             (list (at g (obj-r2 table) c) (at g (obj-r1 table) c))))
          (for/list ([r (in-range (obj-r1 table) (+ 1 (obj-r2 table)))])
            (if source-first (list (at g r (obj-c1 table)) (at g r (obj-c2 table)))
                             (list (at g r (obj-c2 table)) (at g r (obj-c1 table)))))))
    (define raw-regions
      (if (= connectivity 4) (find-0-regions g bg)
          (map obj-cells (objects-8
            (grid-from-fn (rows g) (cols g) (lambda (r c) (if (= (at g r c) bg) 1 0))) 0))))
    (define enclosed
      (filter (lambda (cells)
                (not (ormap (lambda (p)
                       (or (= (first p) 0) (= (first p) (- (rows g) 1))
                           (= (second p) 0) (= (second p) (- (cols g) 1)))) cells))) raw-regions))
    (define (boundary-colors cells)
      (remove-duplicates
        (apply append
          (for/list ([p cells])
            (for/list ([d cardinal-deltas]
                       #:when (let ([rr (+ (first p) (first d))] [cc (+ (second p) (second d))])
                                (and (in-bounds? rr cc (rows g) (cols g)) (not (= (at g rr cc) bg)))))
              (at g (+ (first p) (first d)) (+ (second p) (second d))))))))
    ;; A: discover each hole's exact cells, enclosing color and occupied area.
    (define records
      (filter (lambda (record) (not (null? record)))
        (for/list ([cells enclosed])
          (define colors (boundary-colors cells))
          (define box (bbox-of-cells cells))
          (if (= (length colors) 1)
              (list cells (first colors)
                    (if (equal? size-measure 'area) (length cells)
                        (* (+ 1 (- (third box) (first box))) (+ 1 (- (fourth box) (second box))))))
              '()))))
    ;; B consumes the region records, selects scope and looks up its fill color.
    (for/fold ([out g]) ([record records])
      (define key (second record))
      (define entry (find-first (lambda (p) (= (first p) key)) mapping))
      (define peers (filter (lambda (p) (= (second p) key)) records))
      (define selected
        (or (equal? fill-scope 'all)
            (= (third record) (apply max (map third peers)))))
      (if (and entry selected)
          (for/fold ([painted out]) ([p (first record)])
            (set-cell painted (first p) (second p) (second entry))) out)))))

(rule!
 ;; Each top-row color run encodes a 1-based rank.  For that color, find
 ;; vertical wires whose same-color endpoints enclose a uniform nonzero
 ;; interior of another color.  Sort by interior length descending and recolor
 ;; the ranked wire.  The alternate setting then uses the stage-A result to
 ;; choose the longest selected wire and activate its horizontal 9-filled relay.
 (lambda (g)
  (let ()
   (define relay-mode "rank_only")
   (define rival "")
   (define h (rows g))
   (define w (cols g))
   (define (run-length c color)
    (let loop ([r 0])
     (if (and (< r h) (= (at g r c) color)) (loop (+ r 1)) r)))
   (define legends
    (for/list ([c (in-range w)] #:when (!= (at g 0 c) 0))
     (list (at g 0 c) (run-length c (at g 0 c)) c)))
   (define (middle-fill color c top bottom)
    (if (< (- bottom top) 2) #f
     (let ([v (at g (+ top 1) c)])
      (and (!= v 0) (!= v color)
       (for/and ([r (in-range (+ top 1) bottom)]) (= (at g r c) v))
       v))))
   (define (record<? a b)
    (or (> (first a) (first b))
        (and (= (first a) (first b))
             (or (< (second a) (second b))
                 (and (= (second a) (second b)) (< (third a) (third b)))))))
   (define (candidates color)
    (sort
     (for*/list ([c (in-range w)] [top (in-range (- h 2))]
                 [bottom (in-range (+ top 2) h)]
                 #:when (= (at g top c) color)
                 #:when (= (at g bottom c) color)
                 #:when (middle-fill color c top bottom))
      (list (- bottom top 1) top c bottom (at g (+ top 1) c)))
     record<?))
   (define (select-record entry)
    (let* ([color (first entry)] [rank (second entry)] [records (candidates color)])
     (and (<= rank (length records)) (list-ref records (- rank 1)))))
   (define selected
    (filter (lambda (p) (second p))
     (for/list ([entry legends]) (list entry (select-record entry)))))
   (define (fill-vertical out pair)
    (let* ([entry (first pair)] [record (second pair)] [color (first entry)]
           [top (second record)] [c (third record)] [bottom (fourth record)])
     (for/fold ([canvas out]) ([r (in-range (+ top 1) bottom)])
      (set-cell canvas r c color))))
   (define stage-a (for/fold ([out g]) ([pair selected]) (fill-vertical out pair)))
   (define (solid-in-stage? color record)
    (let ([top (second record)] [c (third record)] [bottom (fourth record)])
     (for/and ([r (in-range top (+ bottom 1))]) (= (at stage-a r c) color))))
   (define stage-selected
    (filter (lambda (p) (second p))
     (for/list ([entry legends])
      (let ([color (first entry)])
       (list entry (for/first ([record (in-list (candidates color))]
                              #:when (solid-in-stage? color record)) record))))))
   (define raw-longest
    (for/list ([entry legends]) (list entry (first (candidates (first entry))))))
   (define (pick-longest pairs)
    (for/fold ([best #f]) ([pair pairs])
     (if (or (not best) (> (first (second pair)) (first (second best)))) pair best)))
   (define winner
    (if (equal? rival "relay_longest_candidate")
        (pick-longest raw-longest)
        (pick-longest stage-selected)))
   (define (relay-records color)
    (for*/list ([r (in-range h)] [left (in-range (- w 2))]
                [right (in-range (+ left 2) w)]
                #:when (= (at g r left) color)
                #:when (= (at g r right) color)
                #:when (for/and ([c (in-range (+ left 1) right)]) (= (at g r c) 9)))
     (list r left right)))
   (define (fill-relay out record color)
    (for/fold ([canvas out]) ([c (in-range (+ (second record) 1) (third record))])
     (set-cell canvas (first record) c color)))
   (if (and (equal? relay-mode "selected_longest") winner)
       (for/fold ([out stage-a]) ([record (relay-records (first (first winner)))])
        (fill-relay out record (first (first winner))))
       stage-a))))

(rule!
 ;; A modal-color separator lattice contains one ordinary tile pattern and
 ;; repeated copies of one anomalous tile.  The anomalous tile introduces one
 ;; new ink color.  Its ink cells form a micro mask; translate that same mask
 ;; over macro-tile coordinates so that it covers every anomalous clue tile,
 ;; then copy the complete anomalous tile into every selected macro position.
 (lambda (g)
  (let ()
   (define scope-mode 0)
   (define bg (pick-max (grid-colors g) (lambda (v) (count-color g v))))
   (define sep-rows
    (filter (lambda (r) (all? (lambda (c) (= (at g r c) bg)) (range 0 (cols g))))
            (range 0 (rows g))))
   (define sep-cols
    (filter (lambda (c) (all? (lambda (r) (= (at g r c) bg)) (range 0 (rows g))))
            (range 0 (cols g))))
   (define (bands separators)
    (filter (lambda (p) (<= (first p) (second p)))
     (for/list ((i (range 0 (- (length separators) 1))))
      (list (+ (list-ref separators i) 1)
            (- (list-ref separators (+ i 1)) 1)))))
   (define row-bands (bands sep-rows))
   (define col-bands (bands sep-cols))
   (define records
    (for*/list ((ri (range 0 (length row-bands)))
                (ci (range 0 (length col-bands))))
     (let ((rb (list-ref row-bands ri)) (cb (list-ref col-bands ci)))
      (list ri ci (subgrid g (first rb) (first cb) (second rb) (second cb))))))
   (define base-record
    (pick-max records
     (lambda (rec)
      (count-if (lambda (other) (equal? (third rec) (third other))) records))))
   (define base (third base-record))
   (define anomalies (filter (lambda (rec) (not (equal? (third rec) base))) records))
   (define anomaly (third (first anomalies)))
   (define base-colors (grid-colors base))
   (define ink
    (first (filter (lambda (v) (not (member v base-colors))) (grid-colors anomaly))))
   (define full-mask (find-color anomaly ink))
   (define mask-grid (paint-cells (empty-grid (rows anomaly) (cols anomaly) 0) full-mask 1))
   (define components (objects mask-grid 0))
   (define selected-mask
    (if (= scope-mode 0)
        full-mask
        (obj-cells (pick-max components obj-size))))
   (define clues (map (lambda (rec) (list (first rec) (second rec))) anomalies))
   (define anchors
    (for*/list ((ar (range 0 (+ 1 (- (length row-bands) (rows anomaly)))))
                (ac (range 0 (+ 1 (- (length col-bands) (cols anomaly)))))
                #:when
                (all? (lambda (q)
                        (member (list (- (first q) ar) (- (second q) ac)) full-mask))
                      clues))
     (list ar ac)))
   (define anchor (first anchors))
   (define paints
    (apply append
     (for/list ((p selected-mask))
      (let* ((mr (+ (first anchor) (first p)))
             (mc (+ (second anchor) (second p)))
             (rb (list-ref row-bands mr))
             (cb (list-ref col-bands mc)))
       (for*/list ((r (range 0 (rows anomaly))) (c (range 0 (cols anomaly))))
        (list (+ (first rb) r) (+ (first cb) c) (at anomaly r c)))))))
   (paint-cells g paints))))

(rule!
 ;; A gray wire selects two center-aligned beads. Diagonal wire links count
 ;; unless a gray cardinal corner already joins the same pixels. Recover both
 ;; leaves, assign distinct aligned beads whose center colors name donor beads,
 ;; and copy each donor's center color into its receiver. Erase all other beads;
 ;; gray wire pixels remain unchanged. Uniform and boundary-clipped beads work.
 ;; The follow-chain variant repeatedly resolves the new color in the ORIGINAL
 ;; bead dictionary, stopping on a missing key or the first repeated color.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define transfer-policy "one_hop")
     (define wire (find-color g 5))
     (define (connected p q)
       (let ((dr (- (first q) (first p))) (dc (- (second q) (second p))))
         (and (not (equal? p q)) (<= (abs dr) 1) (<= (abs dc) 1)
              (or (= dr 0) (= dc 0)
                  (and (not (member (list (first q) (second p)) wire))
                       (not (member (list (first p) (second q)) wire)))))))
     (define ends (filter (lambda (p) (= 1 (length (filter (lambda (q) (connected p q)) wire)))) wire))
     (define raw (objects (grid-from-fn h w (lambda (r c) (if (member (at g r c) '(0 5)) 0 1))) 0))
     (define beads
       (for/list ((o raw))
         (let* ((body (mode-list (map (lambda (p) (at g (first p) (second p))) (obj-cells o))))
                (different (filter (lambda (p) (not (= (at g (first p) (second p)) body))) (obj-cells o)))
                (center (if (null? different)
                            (list (quotient (+ (obj-r1 o) (obj-r2 o)) 2)
                                  (quotient (+ (obj-c1 o) (obj-c2 o)) 2))
                            (first different))))
           (list body center (at g (first center) (second center)) (obj-cells o)))))
     (define body-colors (map first beads))
     (define (candidates p)
       (filter
        (lambda (b)
          (and (member (third b) body-colors)
               (or (= (first p) (first (second b))) (= (second p) (second (second b))))
               (for/or ((q (fourth b)))
                 (= 1 (+ (abs (- (first p) (first q))) (abs (- (second p) (second q))))))))
        beads))
     (define assignments
       (for*/list ((a (candidates (first ends))) (b (candidates (second ends)))
                   #:when (not (= (first a) (first b))))
         (list a b)))
     (define selected (first assignments))
     (define (resolve value budget seen)
       (let ((donor (find-first (lambda (b) (= (first b) value)) beads)))
         (if (or (= budget 0) (not donor) (member value seen)) value
             (resolve (third donor) (- budget 1) (cons value seen)))))
     (define steps
       (cond ((equal? transfer-policy "follow_chain") (+ 1 (length beads)))
             ((equal? transfer-policy "two_hops") 2)
             ((equal? transfer-policy "three_hops") 3)
             ((equal? transfer-policy "raw_center") 0)
             (else 1)))
     (define blank (grid-from-fn h w (lambda (r c) (if (= (at g r c) 5) 5 0))))
     (for/fold ((out blank)) ((b selected))
       (let* ((copied (for/fold ((acc out)) ((p (fourth b)))
                        (set-cell acc (first p) (second p) (at g (first p) (second p)))))
              (center (second b))
              (value (resolve (third b) steps '())))
         (set-cell copied (first center) (second center) value))))))

(rule!
 ;; Read the distinct non-background, non-green colors inside the green key.
 ;; Each separate multicolor panel contains a black rectangle and colored marks.
 ;; Replace every panel containing ALL key colors with orange. Extra colors,
 ;; duplicate marks and the positions of marks do not affect set containment.
 (lambda (g)
  (let ()
   (define output-policy "all_matches")
   (define bg 7)
   (define key-box (bbox-of-cells (find-color g 3)))
   (define key-cells (positions-in-rect (first key-box) (second key-box) (third key-box) (fourth key-box)))
   (define key-colors
    (remove-duplicates (filter (lambda (v) (and (not (= v bg)) (not (= v 3))))
     (map (lambda (p) (at g (first p) (second p))) key-cells))))
   (define without-key (recolor-cells g key-cells bg))
   (define panels (objects-multicolor without-key bg))
   (define (palette o)
    (remove-duplicates (filter (lambda (v) (not (= v 0)))
      (map (lambda (p) (at g (first p) (second p))) (obj-cells o)))))
   (define (matches? o) (for/and ((v key-colors)) (member v (palette o))))
   (define matches (filter matches? panels))
   (define survivors (filter (lambda (o) (not (matches? o))) panels))
   (define erased
    (cond
     ((equal? output-policy "exact_colors")
      (filter (lambda (o) (and (matches? o) (= (length (palette o)) (length key-colors)))) panels))
     ((equal? output-policy "any_color")
      (filter (lambda (o) (for/or ((v key-colors)) (member v (palette o)))) panels))
     (else matches)))
   (define stage-one
    (for/fold ((out g)) ((o erased)) (recolor-cells out (obj-cells o) bg)))
   (define area
    (cond
     ((or (null? matches) (member output-policy (list "all_matches" "exact_colors" "any_color"))) -1)
     ((equal? output-policy "smallest_area") (obj-size (pick-min matches obj-size)))
     ((equal? output-policy "largest_any") (obj-size (pick-max panels obj-size)))
     ((equal? output-policy "first_match") (obj-size (first matches)))
     ((equal? output-policy "key_count") (length key-colors))
     ((equal? output-policy "most_colors") (obj-size (pick-max matches (lambda (o) (length (palette o))))))
     ((equal? output-policy "second_largest")
      (if (> (length survivors) 1)
       (obj-size (second (sort survivors (lambda (a b) (> (obj-size a) (obj-size b)))))) -1))
     ((equal? output-policy "largest_duplicate")
      (let ((repeated (filter (lambda (o)
                       (> (count-if (lambda (x) (= (obj-size x) (obj-size o))) panels) 1)) panels)))
       (if (null? repeated) -1 (obj-size (pick-max repeated obj-size)))))
     (else (obj-size (pick-max matches obj-size)))))
   (for/fold ((out stage-one)) ((o survivors) #:when (= (obj-size o) area))
    (recolor-cells out (obj-cells o) bg)))))

(rule!
 ;; Four equal panels sit inside a monochrome frame.  The first panel contains
 ;; an 8-connected divider plus a singleton marker.  Flood the marker side
 ;; without crossing the divider.  In the fourth panel, take the second panel
 ;; on that side and the third panel on the other side; both may contribute on
 ;; the divider, with the marked-side source winning overlaps.
 (lambda (g)
  (let ()
   (define h (rows g))
   (define w (cols g))
   (define frame (at g 0 0))
   (define (full-frame-row? r)
    (andmap (lambda (c) (= (at g r c) frame)) (range w)))
   (define (full-frame-col? c)
    (andmap (lambda (r) (= (at g r c) frame)) (range h)))
   (define active-rows (filter (lambda (r) (not (full-frame-row? r))) (range h)))
   (define r0 (apply min active-rows))
   (define r1 (apply max active-rows))
   (define starts
    (for/list ((c (range w))
               #:when (and (not (full-frame-col? c))
                           (or (= c 0) (full-frame-col? (- c 1))))) c))
   (define runs
    (for/list ((s starts))
     (list s (let loop ((c s))
               (if (or (= c w) (full-frame-col? c)) (- c 1) (loop (+ c 1)))))))
   (define panels
    (for/list ((run runs)) (subgrid g r0 (first run) r1 (second run))))
   (define bg (mode-list (apply append (map (lambda (p) (apply append p)) panels))))
   (define control (first panels))
   (define objects0 (objects-multicolor control bg))
   (define divider (obj-cells (argmax obj-size objects0)))
   (define marker-object (argmin obj-size objects0))
   (define marker (first (obj-cells marker-object)))
   (define marked
    (connected-region control (first marker) (second marker)
