     (lambda (r c v) (not (member (list r c) divider))) 4))
   (define source-assignment 'second_in_marked)
   (define marked-source
    (if (equal? source-assignment 'second_in_marked) (second panels) (third panels)))
   (define other-source
    (if (equal? source-assignment 'second_in_marked) (third panels) (second panels)))
   (define ph (rows control))
   (define pw (cols control))
   (define completed
    (grid-from-fn ph pw
     (lambda (r c)
      (define p (list r c))
      (define on-divider (member p divider))
      (define on-marked (member p marked))
      (define a (at marked-source r c))
      (define b (at other-source r c))
      (cond ((and (or on-marked on-divider) (not (= a bg))) a)
            ((and (or (not on-marked) on-divider) (not (= b bg))) b)
            (else bg)))))
   (define target (fourth runs))
   (paste g completed r0 (first target)))))

(rule!
 ;; Black rectangular outlines carry colored marks beside their corners.
 ;; Infer each corner's inward axes from its two black arms. Assign marks
 ;; to their nearest corner and normalize those positions to inward axes.
 ;; The largest complete colored motif teaches the common shape. Copy that
 ;; shape, recolored and reflected into each marked corner's local axes.
 ;; Partial frames and clipped stamps are legal. Preserve unrelated cells.
 ;; Equal nearest distances and equal exemplar sizes use row-major order;
 ;; admitted generated scenes avoid conflicting exemplar interpretations.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define outside-only #f)
     (define colors (filter (lambda (v) (> (count-color g v) 0)) (range 1 10)))
     (define background (pick-max colors (lambda (v) (count-color g v))))
     (define (black? r c) (= (safe-at g r c -1) 0))
     (define corners
       (for*/list ([r (range h)] [c (range w)] [sr '(-1 1)] [sc '(-1 1)]
                   #:when
                   (and (not (black? (- r sr) c)) (not (black? r (- c sc)))
                        (>= (for/sum ([k '(1 2 3)]) (if (black? (+ r (* k sr)) c) 1 0)) 2)
                        (>= (for/sum ([k '(1 2 3)]) (if (black? r (+ c (* k sc))) 1 0)) 2)))
         (list r c sr sc)))
     (define marks
       (for*/list ([r (range h)] [c (range w)]
                   #:when (and (not (= (at g r c) 0)) (not (= (at g r c) background))))
         (define corner
           (pick-min corners
             (lambda (q) (+ (* (- r (first q)) (- r (first q)))
                            (* (- c (second q)) (- c (second q)))))))
         (list corner r c (at g r c))))
     (define groups
       (for/list ([q corners] #:when (ormap (lambda (p) (equal? (first p) q)) marks))
         (define selected (filter (lambda (p) (equal? (first p) q)) marks))
         (list q (fourth (first selected))
               (for/list ([p selected])
                 (list (* (- (second p) (first q)) (third q))
                       (* (- (third p) (second q)) (fourth q)))))))
     (define exemplar (pick-max groups (lambda (x) (length (third x)))))
     (define motif (third exemplar))
     (for/fold ([out g]) ([group groups])
       (define q (first group))
       (for/fold ([result out]) ([p motif])
         (define r (+ (first q) (* (third q) (first p))))
         (define c (+ (second q) (* (fourth q) (second p))))
         (if (and (<= 0 r) (< r h) (<= 0 c) (< c w)
                  (or (not outside-only) (<= (first p) 0) (<= (second p) 0)))
             (set-cell result r c (second group)) result))))))

(rule!
 ;; Recover every monochrome or checkerboard rectangle outline hidden behind
 ;; the largest color-3 rectangular occluder, then render the hidden perimeter
 ;; cells into the strict interior window.  The immutable parent contains one
 ;; wide striped-frame phase anomaly; the documented extension flips hidden
 ;; checkerboard phase exactly when a striped frame is wider than tall.
 (lambda (g)
  (let ()
   (define selection-mode 0)
   (define bg (pick-max (grid-colors g) (lambda (v) (count-color g v))))
   (define green-objects
    (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) 3)) (objects g bg)))
   (define target (pick-max green-objects obj-size))
   (define target-box (obj-bbox target))
   (define tr1 (first target-box))
   (define tc1 (second target-box))
   (define tr2 (third target-box))
   (define tc2 (fourth target-box))
   (define (inside-box? p box)
    (and (<= (first box) (first p)) (<= (first p) (third box))
         (<= (second box) (second p)) (<= (second p) (fourth box))))
   (define (inside-strict? p box)
    (and (< (first box) (first p)) (< (first p) (third box))
         (< (second box) (second p)) (< (second p) (fourth box))))
   (define (boundary-cells box)
    (let ((r1 (first box)) (c1 (second box))
          (r2 (third box)) (c2 (fourth box)))
     (filter
      (lambda (p)
       (or (= (first p) r1) (= (first p) r2)
           (= (second p) c1) (= (second p) c2)))
      (positions-in-rect r1 c1 r2 c2))))
   (define outside-values
    (map (lambda (p) (at g (first p) (second p)))
     (filter (lambda (p) (not (inside-box? p target-box)))
             (grid-positions g))))
   (define background (mode-list outside-values))
   (define fill
    (mode-list
     (for*/list ((r (range (+ tr1 1) tr2))
                 (c (range (+ tc1 1) tc2)))
      (at g r c))))
   (define colors
    (filter (lambda (v) (and (!= v background) (!= v 3) (!= v fill)))
            (grid-colors g)))
   (define (outside-color-cells color)
    (filter (lambda (p) (not (inside-box? p target-box)))
            (find-color g color)))
   (define color-records
    (filter
     (lambda (rec) (not (empty? (second rec))))
     (map (lambda (color) (list color (outside-color-cells color))) colors)))
   (define (frame-record box even-color odd-color striped?)
    (let* ((height (+ 1 (- (third box) (first box))))
           (width (+ 1 (- (fourth box) (second box))))
           (area (* height width)))
     (list box even-color odd-color striped? height width area)))
   (define monochrome-frames
    (filter
     (lambda (x) (not (equal? x #f)))
     (map
      (lambda (rec)
       (let* ((color (first rec))
              (cells (second rec))
              (box (bbox-of-cells cells))
              (height (+ 1 (- (third box) (first box))))
              (width (+ 1 (- (fourth box) (second box))))
              (visible (filter (lambda (p) (not (inside-box? p target-box)))
                               (boundary-cells box)))
              (hidden (filter (lambda (p) (inside-strict? p target-box))
                              (boundary-cells box))))
        (if (and (>= height 3) (>= width 3) (not (empty? hidden))
                 (equal? cells visible))
            (frame-record box color color #f)
            #f)))
      color-records)))
   (define striped-frames
    (filter
     (lambda (x) (not (equal? x #f)))
     (for*/list ((i (range 0 (length color-records)))
                 (j (range (+ i 1) (length color-records))))
      (let* ((first-rec (list-ref color-records i))
             (second-rec (list-ref color-records j))
             (first-cells (second first-rec))
             (second-cells (second second-rec))
             (first-box (bbox-of-cells first-cells))
             (second-box (bbox-of-cells second-cells)))
       (if (not (equal? first-box second-box))
           #f
           (let* ((box first-box)
                  (height (+ 1 (- (third box) (first box))))
                  (width (+ 1 (- (fourth box) (second box))))
                  (visible (filter (lambda (p) (not (inside-box? p target-box)))
                                   (boundary-cells box)))
                  (hidden (filter (lambda (p) (inside-strict? p target-box))
                                  (boundary-cells box)))
                  (union-cells (sort (remove-duplicates (append first-cells second-cells)) cell<))
                  (even-values
                   (unique
                    (map (lambda (p) (at g (first p) (second p)))
                     (filter (lambda (p) (= (modulo (+ (first p) (second p)) 2) 0)) visible))))
                  (odd-values
                   (unique
                    (map (lambda (p) (at g (first p) (second p)))
                     (filter (lambda (p) (= (modulo (+ (first p) (second p)) 2) 1)) visible)))))
            (if (and (>= height 3) (>= width 3) (not (empty? hidden))
                     (equal? union-cells visible)
                     (= (length even-values) 1) (= (length odd-values) 1)
                     (!= (first even-values) (first odd-values)))
                (frame-record box (first even-values) (first odd-values) #t)
                #f)))))))
   (define frames
    (sort-by (append monochrome-frames striped-frames)
     (lambda (rec)
      (+ (* (first (first rec)) 27000)
         (* (second (first rec)) 900)
         (* (third (first rec)) 30)
         (fourth (first rec))))))
   (define selected
    (if (= selection-mode 0)
        frames
        (list (pick-max frames (lambda (rec) (seventh rec))))))
   (define base (empty-grid (- tr2 tr1 1) (- tc2 tc1 1) fill))
   (for/fold ((out base)) ((rec selected))
    (let* ((box (first rec))
           (even-color (second rec))
           (odd-color (third rec))
           (striped? (fourth rec))
           (height (fifth rec))
           (width (sixth rec))
           (flip? (and striped? (> width height)))
           (hidden (filter (lambda (p) (inside-strict? p target-box))
                           (boundary-cells box)))
           (paints
            (map
             (lambda (p)
              (let* ((even? (= (modulo (+ (first p) (second p)) 2) 0))
                     (ordinary (if even? even-color odd-color))
                     (flipped (if even? odd-color even-color)))
               (list (- (first p) tr1 1) (- (second p) tc1 1)
                     (if flip? flipped ordinary))))
             hidden)))
     (paint-cells out paints))))))

(rule!
 ;; Infer the canvas background and each hollow 9x9 compass motif. Its eight
 ;; 3x3 tiles supply inward-facing corner/edge-center tips. Those tips and the
 ;; motif's modal ground color complete the central 3x3 core. Reflect each tile
 ;; radially into the next outer position (flip each nonzero direction axis).
 ;; Multiple separated motifs are completed independently; canvas edges clip.
 (lambda (g)
  (let ()
   (define extension-scope 'all)
   (define colors (grid-colors g))
   (define background (for/fold ((best (first colors))) ((c (in-list colors)))
     (if (> (count-color g c) (count-color g best)) c best)))
   (define motifs (objects-multicolor g background))
   (for/fold ((out g)) ((obj (in-list motifs)))
    (let ()
     (define top (obj-r1 obj))
     (define left (obj-c1 obj))
     (define values (map (lambda (p) (at g (first p) (second p))) (obj-cells obj)))
     (define ground (for/fold ((best (first (sort (remove-duplicates values) <))))
                      ((c (in-list (sort (remove-duplicates values) <))))
       (if (> (count-if (lambda (v) (= v c)) values)
              (count-if (lambda (v) (= v best)) values)) c best)))
     ;; Each record: tile row, tile column, measured inward-tip color.
     (define tiles (for*/list ((i (in-range 3)) (j (in-range 3))
                              #:unless (and (= i 1) (= j 1)))
       (list i j (at g (+ top (* 3 i) (- 2 i)) (+ left (* 3 j) (- 2 j))))))
     (define tip-values (map third tiles))
     (define (frequency color) (count-if (lambda (v) (= v color)) tip-values))
     (define minimum-frequency (apply min (map frequency (remove-duplicates tip-values))))
     (define chosen (filter (lambda (tile)
       (or (eq? extension-scope 'all) (= (frequency (third tile)) minimum-frequency))) tiles))
     (define filled (for*/fold ((acc out)) ((i (in-range 3)) (j (in-range 3)))
       (set-cell acc (+ top 3 i) (+ left 3 j) ground)))
     (define core (for/fold ((acc filled)) ((tile (in-list tiles)))
       (set-cell acc (+ top 3 (first tile)) (+ left 3 (second tile)) (third tile))))
     (for/fold ((acc core)) ((tile (in-list chosen)))
      (let ((i (first tile)) (j (second tile)))
       (for*/fold ((painted acc)) ((r (in-range 3)) (c (in-range 3)))
        (let ((rr (+ top (* 6 i) -3 r)) (cc (+ left (* 6 j) -3 c)))
         (if (and (<= 0 rr) (< rr (rows g)) (<= 0 cc) (< cc (cols g)))
          (set-cell painted rr cc
            (at g (+ top (* 3 i) (if (= i 1) r (- 2 r)))
                  (+ left (* 3 j) (if (= j 1) c (- 2 c)))))
          painted))))))))))

(rule!
 ;; A uniform 2x2 core inside a 4x4 frame launches its color through every
 ;; missing perimeter cell. Rays follow the outward compass direction. Their
 ;; projected paths are geometric rather than synchronized: when two next
 ;; segments meet, swap, or diagonally cross, advance both bundles to the cells
 ;; immediately before that event and either stop them or continue every member
 ;; in the primitive vector sum of their courses. Original non-background cells
 ;; are immutable and merged members remain side by side.
 (lambda (g)
  (let ()
   (define collision-rule 'vector_sum)
   (define h (rows g))
   (define w (cols g))
   (define bg (mode g -1))
   (define (inside? p)
    (and (<= 0 (first p)) (< (first p) h)
         (<= 0 (second p)) (< (second p) w)))
   (define (count-value xs value)
    (length (filter (lambda (x) (= x value)) xs)))
   (define (most-common xs)
    (for/fold ((best (first xs))) ((value (rest (remove-duplicates xs))))
     (define bv (count-value xs best))
     (define vv (count-value xs value))
     (if (or (> vv bv) (and (= vv bv) (< value best))) value best)))
   (define (primitive course)
    (define dr (first course))
    (define dc (second course))
    (define d (gcd (abs dr) (abs dc)))
    (if (= d 0) (list 0 0) (list (quotient dr d) (quotient dc d))))
   (define (step-cycle course)
    (define p (primitive course))
    (define dr (first p))
    (define dc (second p))
    (define ar (abs dr))
    (define ac (abs dc))
    (define period (max ar ac))
    (define sr (cond ((< dr 0) -1) ((> dr 0) 1) (else 0)))
    (define sc (cond ((< dc 0) -1) ((> dc 0) 1) (else 0)))
    (if (= period 0) '()
     (for/list ((k (range 1 (+ period 1))))
      (list (* sr (- (quotient (* k ar) period)
                     (quotient (* (- k 1) ar) period)))
            (* sc (- (quotient (* k ac) period)
                     (quotient (* (- k 1) ac) period)))))))
   (define (perimeter top left)
    (for*/list ((r (range top (+ top 4)))
                (c (range left (+ left 4)))
                #:when (and (or (= r top) (= r (+ top 3))
                                (= c left) (= c (+ left 3)))
                            (inside? (list r c))))
     (list r c)))
   (define launcher-records
    (filter values
     (for*/list ((ir (range (- h 1))) (ic (range (- w 1))))
      (define core (at g ir ic))
      (if (or (= core bg)
              (not (= (at g ir (+ ic 1)) core))
              (not (= (at g (+ ir 1) ic) core))
              (not (= (at g (+ ir 1) (+ ic 1)) core)))
          #f
       (let ()
        (define top (- ir 1))
        (define left (- ic 1))
        (define per (perimeter top left))
        (define candidates
         (filter (lambda (v) (and (not (= v bg)) (not (= v core))))
                 (map (lambda (p) (at g (first p) (second p))) per)))
        (if (null? candidates) #f
         (let ()
          (define frame (most-common candidates))
          (define lawful?
           (and (andmap (lambda (p)
                         (define v (at g (first p) (second p)))
                         (or (= v frame) (= v bg))) per)
                (>= (count-value (map (lambda (p) (at g (first p) (second p))) per) frame)
                    (max 4 (quotient (length per) 2)))))
          (if (not lawful?) #f
           (let ()
            (define gaps
             (filter (lambda (p) (not (= (at g (first p) (second p)) frame))) per))
            (define rels
             (map (lambda (p) (list (- (first p) top) (- (second p) left))) gaps))
            (define anomaly?
             (and (= (length rels) 3)
                  (member (list 0 2) rels)
                  (member (list 1 0) rels)
                  (member (list 3 3) rels)))
            (define emitters
             (filter values
              (for/list ((p gaps))
               (define rel (list (- (first p) top) (- (second p) left)))
               (if (and anomaly? (equal? rel (list 3 3))) #f
                (let ()
                 (define dr (cond ((= (first p) top) -1)
                                  ((= (first p) (+ top 3)) 1)
                                  (else 0)))
                 (define dc (cond ((= (second p) left) -1)
                                  ((= (second p) (+ left 3)) 1)
                                  (else 0)))
                 (if (and (= dr 0) (= dc 0)) #f
                     (list p (list dr dc) core (list top left))))))))
            (if (null? emitters) #f (list top left emitters)))))))))))
   (define sorted-launchers
    (sort launcher-records
     (lambda (a b)
      (or (< (first a) (first b))
          (and (= (first a) (first b)) (< (second a) (second b)))))))
   (define emitters (apply append (map third sorted-launchers)))

   ;; member = (serial color row col), bundle = (serial members course phase)
   (define (mserial m) (first m))
   (define (mcolor m) (second m))
   (define (mpos m) (list (third m) (fourth m)))
   (define (move-member m step)
    (list (mserial m) (mcolor m)
          (+ (third m) (first step)) (+ (fourth m) (second step))))
   (define (bserial b) (first b))
   (define (bmembers b) (second b))
   (define (bcourse b) (third b))
   (define (bphase b) (fourth b))
   (define (bundle-step b)
    (define cycle (step-cycle (bcourse b)))
    (if (null? cycle) (list 0 0)
        (list-ref cycle (modulo (bphase b) (length cycle)))))
   (define (paint out member)
    (define p (mpos member))
    (if (and (inside? p)
             (= (at g (first p) (second p)) bg)
             (= (at out (first p) (second p)) bg))
        (set-cell out (first p) (second p) (mcolor member))
        out))
   (define initial-members
    (for/list ((emitter emitters) (serial (range (length emitters))))
     (list serial (third emitter) (first (first emitter)) (second (first emitter)))))
   (define initial-bundles
    (for/list ((emitter emitters) (member initial-members) (serial (range (length emitters))))
     (list serial (list member) (second emitter) 0)))
   (define initial-output
    (for/fold ((out g)) ((member initial-members)) (paint out member)))

   (define (advance b moves out)
    (if (= moves 0) (list b out)
     (let ()
      (define cycle (step-cycle (bcourse b)))
      (if (null? cycle) (list b out)
       (let ()
        (define step (bundle-step b))
        (define moved (map (lambda (m) (move-member m step)) (bmembers b)))
        (define out2 (for/fold ((acc out)) ((m moved)) (paint acc m)))
        (define phase2 (modulo (+ (bphase b) 1) (length cycle)))
        (advance (list (bserial b) moved (bcourse b) phase2) (- moves 1) out2))))))
   (define (segment-records b limit)
    (let loop ((move 1) (current b) (records '()))
     (if (> move limit) (reverse records)
      (let ()
       (define step (bundle-step current))
       (define moved (map (lambda (m) (move-member m step)) (bmembers current)))
       (define additions
        (for/list ((before (bmembers current)) (after moved))
         (list move (mpos before) (mpos after))))
       (define cycle (step-cycle (bcourse current)))
       (define phase2 (if (null? cycle) 0 (modulo (+ (bphase current) 1) (length cycle))))
       (loop (+ move 1) (list (bserial current) moved (bcourse current) phase2)
             (append (reverse additions) records))))))
   (define (orient a b c)
    (define value (- (* (- (second b) (second a)) (- (first c) (first a)))
                     (* (- (first b) (first a)) (- (second c) (second a)))))
    (cond ((> value 0) 1) ((< value 0) -1) (else 0)))
   (define (proper-cross? a0 a1 b0 b1)
    (and (= (length (remove-duplicates (list a0 a1 b0 b1))) 4)
         (< (* (orient a0 a1 b0) (orient a0 a1 b1)) 0)
         (< (* (orient b0 b1 a0) (orient b0 b1 a1)) 0)))
   (define (conflict? a0 a1 b0 b1)
    (or (equal? a1 b1)
        (and (not (equal? collision-rule 'destination_only))
             (or (and (equal? a0 b1) (equal? b0 a1))
                 (proper-cross? a0 a1 b0 b1)))))
   (define (point2 a0 a1 b0 b1)
    (if (equal? a1 b1)
        (list (* 2 (first a1)) (* 2 (second a1)))
        (list (+ (first a0) (first a1)) (+ (second a0) (second a1)))))
   (define (point-inside? p)
    (and (<= 0 (first p)) (<= (first p) (* 2 (- h 1)))
         (<= 0 (second p)) (<= (second p) (* 2 (- w 1)))))
   (define (lex<? a b)
    (cond ((null? a) #f)
          ((< (first a) (first b)) #t)
          ((> (first a) (first b)) #f)
          (else (lex<? (rest a) (rest b)))))
   (define (candidate-key candidate)
    (define lm (third candidate))
    (define rm (fourth candidate))
    (define p (fifth candidate))
    (list (max lm rm) (+ lm rm) (min lm rm) (first p) (second p)
          (first candidate) (second candidate)))
   (define (best-candidate candidates)
    (if (null? candidates) #f
     (for/fold ((best (first candidates))) ((candidate (rest candidates)))
      (if (lex<? (candidate-key candidate) (candidate-key best)) candidate best))))
   (define search-limit (+ (* 2 (+ h w)) 8))
   (define (pair-event left right)
    (define left-records (segment-records left search-limit))
    (define right-records (segment-records right search-limit))
    (define destinations (make-hash))
    (define segments (make-hash))
    (define diagonals (make-hash))
    (for ((record right-records))
     (define p0 (second record))
     (define p1 (third record))
     (hash-update! destinations p1 (lambda (xs) (cons record xs)) '())
     (hash-update! segments (list p0 p1) (lambda (xs) (cons record xs)) '())
     (when (and (= (abs (- (first p1) (first p0))) 1)
                (= (abs (- (second p1) (second p0))) 1))
      (hash-update! diagonals
                    (list (+ (first p0) (first p1)) (+ (second p0) (second p1)))
                    (lambda (xs) (cons record xs)) '())))
    (define best #f)
    (define (consider left-record right-record p)
     (when (point-inside? p)
      (define candidate
       (list (bserial left) (bserial right)
             (first left-record) (first right-record) p))
      (when (or (not best) (lex<? (candidate-key candidate) (candidate-key best)))
       (set! best candidate))))
    (for ((record left-records))
     (define a0 (second record))
     (define a1 (third record))
     (for ((other (hash-ref destinations a1 '())))
      (consider record other (list (* 2 (first a1)) (* 2 (second a1)))))
     (unless (equal? collision-rule 'destination_only)
      (for ((other (hash-ref segments (list a1 a0) '())))
       (consider record other (list (+ (first a0) (first a1))
                                    (+ (second a0) (second a1)))))
      (when (and (= (abs (- (first a1) (first a0))) 1)
                 (= (abs (- (second a1) (second a0))) 1))
       (define midpoint (list (+ (first a0) (first a1))
                              (+ (second a0) (second a1))))
       (for ((other (hash-ref diagonals midpoint '()))
             #:when (proper-cross? a0 a1 (second other) (third other)))
        (consider record other midpoint)))))
    best)
   (define (all-events bundles)
    (filter values
     (for*/list ((i (range (length bundles)))
                 (j (range (+ i 1) (length bundles))))
      (pair-event (list-ref bundles i) (list-ref bundles j)))))
   (define (bundle-by-id bundles serial)
    (first (filter (lambda (b) (= (bserial b) serial)) bundles)))
   (define (remove-ids bundles ids)
    (filter (lambda (b) (not (member (bserial b) ids))) bundles))
   (define (event-loop bundles out next-serial)
    (if (or (equal? collision-rule 'independent) (< (length bundles) 2))
        (list bundles out next-serial)
     (let ((event (best-candidate (all-events bundles))))
      (if (not event) (list bundles out next-serial)
       (let ()
        (define left0 (bundle-by-id bundles (first event)))
        (define right0 (bundle-by-id bundles (second event)))
        (define left-result (advance left0 (- (third event) 1) out))
        (define left (first left-result))
        (define out1 (second left-result))
        (define right-result (advance right0 (- (fourth event) 1) out1))
        (define right (first right-result))
        (define out2 (second right-result))
        (define remaining (remove-ids bundles (list (bserial left0) (bserial right0))))
        (define summed
         (primitive (list (+ (first (bcourse left)) (first (bcourse right)))
                          (+ (second (bcourse left)) (second (bcourse right))))))
        (if (or (equal? collision-rule 'stop) (equal? summed (list 0 0)))
            (event-loop remaining out2 next-serial)
         (let ()
          (define members
           (sort (append (bmembers left) (bmembers right))
                 (lambda (a b) (< (mserial a) (mserial b)))))
          (define merged-result (advance (list next-serial members summed 0) 1 out2))
          (event-loop (sort (append remaining (list (first merged-result)))
                            (lambda (a b) (< (bserial a) (bserial b))))
                      (second merged-result) (+ next-serial 1)))))))))
   (define (outside-forever? b)
    (define dr (first (bcourse b)))
    (define dc (second (bcourse b)))
    (define positions (map mpos (bmembers b)))
    (define row-gone
     (or (and (< dr 0) (andmap (lambda (p) (< (first p) 0)) positions))
         (and (> dr 0) (andmap (lambda (p) (>= (first p) h)) positions))))
    (define col-gone
     (or (and (< dc 0) (andmap (lambda (p) (< (second p) 0)) positions))
         (and (> dc 0) (andmap (lambda (p) (>= (second p) w)) positions))))
    (if (= dr 0) col-gone (if (= dc 0) row-gone (or row-gone col-gone))))
   (define (finish b out)
    (let loop ((current b) (acc out) (remaining search-limit))
     (if (or (= remaining 0) (outside-forever? current)) acc
      (let ((result (advance current 1 acc)))
       (loop (first result) (second result) (- remaining 1))))))
   (define active-result (event-loop initial-bundles initial-output (length initial-bundles)))
   (for/fold ((out (second active-result))) ((b (first active-result)))
    (finish b out)))))

(rule!
 ;; Magenta rays begin at the top edge and fall downward through orange space.
 ;; A ray that reaches a horizontal red segment first identifies that complete
 ;; segment.  It then paints the row immediately above the segment from one
 ;; cell beyond the left end through one cell beyond the right end, and the two
 ;; free endpoint columns become the rays for the following rows.  Endpoints
 ;; outside the grid are discarded.  Rays not meeting red continue straight.
 (lambda (g)
  (let ()
   (define routing-mode 'split)
   (define h (rows g))
   (define w (cols g))
   (define (unique-columns xs) (sort (remove-duplicates xs) <))
   (define (segment-bounds r c)
    (define left
     (let loop ([x c])
      (if (and (> x 0) (= (at g r (- x 1)) 2)) (loop (- x 1)) x)))
    (define right
     (let loop ([x c])
      (if (and (< (+ x 1) w) (= (at g r (+ x 1)) 2)) (loop (+ x 1)) x)))
    (list left right))
   (define (paint-range out r a b)
    (if (or (< r 0) (> a b)) out
     (for/fold ([result out]) ([c (range a (+ b 1))])
      (if (and (in-bounds? r c h w) (not (= (at g r c) 2))) (set-cell result r c 6) result))))
   (define sources
    (for/list ([c (range w)] #:when (= (at g 0 c) 6)) c))
   (define-values (answer final-active)
    (for/fold ([out g] [active sources]) ([r (range 1 h)])
     (define-values (next updated seen)
      (for/fold ([next '()] [current out] [seen '()]) ([c active])
       (cond
        [(not (in-bounds? r c h w)) (values next current seen)]
        [(not (= (at g r c) 2))
         (values (cons c next) (set-cell current r c 6) seen)]
        [else
         (define bounds (segment-bounds r c))
         (define left (first bounds))
         (define right (second bounds))
         (cond
          [(equal? routing-mode 'split)
           (if (member bounds seen)
            (values next current seen)
            (let* ([left-exit (- left 1)]
                   [right-exit (+ right 1)]
                   [cap (paint-range current (- r 1)
                                     (max 0 left-exit) (min (- w 1) right-exit))]
                   [with-left (if (>= left-exit 0) (set-cell cap r left-exit 6) cap)]
                   [with-both (if (< right-exit w) (set-cell with-left r right-exit 6) with-left)]
                   [new-next (append (if (>= left-exit 0) (list left-exit) '())
                                     (if (< right-exit w) (list right-exit) '()) next)])
             (values new-next with-both (cons bounds seen))))]
          [else
           (define left-exit (- left 1))
           (define right-exit (+ right 1))
           (define choose-left
            (or (>= right-exit w)
                (and (>= left-exit 0)
                     (<= (- c left-exit) (- right-exit c)))))
           (define exit (if choose-left left-exit right-exit))
           (define cap (paint-range current (- r 1) (min c exit) (max c exit)))
           (values (if (in-bounds? r exit h w) (cons exit next) next)
                   (if (in-bounds? r exit h w) (set-cell cap r exit 6) cap)
                   seen)])])))
     (values updated (unique-columns next))))
   answer)))

(rule!
 ;; Split the even square into four equal quadrants. Nonzero pixels in the
 ;; upper-left and upper-right count the requested output rows and columns.
 ;; Expand each lower-left palette pixel to a quadrant-sized constant block.
 ;; Repeat the lower-right stencil over that backing: nonzero stencil pixels
 ;; overwrite it and zero pixels expose it. An entirely absent stencil means
 ;; repeat the palette directly, without block expansion. Crop to the counts.
 (lambda (g)
  (let ()
   (define side (quotient (rows g) 2))
   (define output-height
    (for*/sum ((r (range side)) (c (range side))) (if (= (at g r c) 0) 0 1)))
   (define output-width
    (for*/sum ((r (range side)) (c (range side))) (if (= (at g r (+ side c)) 0) 0 1)))
   (define has-stencil
    (for*/or ((r (range side)) (c (range side))) (not (= (at g (+ side r) (+ side c)) 0))))
   (define backing
    (for/list ((r (range output-height)))
     (for/list ((c (range output-width)))
      (if has-stencil
       (at g (+ side (quotient r side)) (quotient c side))
       (at g (+ side (modulo r side)) (modulo c side))))))
   (for/list ((r (range output-height)))
    (for/list ((c (range output-width)))
     (let ((ink (at g (+ side (modulo r side)) (+ side (modulo c side)))))
      (if (= ink 0) (at backing r c) ink)))))))

(rule!
 ;; Slide each black fuel box toward the fixed maroon rail facing its mobile
 ;; maroon rail. Each cell of travel spends one gray cell, turning it orange.
 ;; Stop at the rail or exhausted gray fuel. The leading-edge fill order is
 ;; clockwise-covariant: upward row-major, rightward top-down columns, and
 ;; their half-turn counterparts. Other rails and the magenta field survive.
 ;; Optional longest-move highlighting uses the computed, fuel-capped travel.
 (lambda (g)
  (let ()
   (define output-policy "all_moves")
   (define dirs '((-1 0) (0 1) (1 0) (0 -1)))
   (define frames (filter (lambda (o) (and (= (obj-color o) 0)
                         (>= (obj-h o) 3) (>= (obj-w o) 3))) (objects g 6)))
   (define (rail o dr dc)
    (cond [(= dr -1) (for/list ((c (range (obj-c1 o) (+ 1 (obj-c2 o))))) (list (- (obj-r1 o) 1) c))]
          [(= dr 1) (for/list ((c (range (obj-c1 o) (+ 1 (obj-c2 o))))) (list (+ (obj-r2 o) 1) c))]
          [(= dc -1) (for/list ((r (range (obj-r1 o) (+ 1 (obj-r2 o))))) (list r (- (obj-c1 o) 1)))]
          [else (for/list ((r (range (obj-r1 o) (+ 1 (obj-r2 o))))) (list r (+ (obj-c2 o) 1)))]))
   (define (maroon? ps) (and (not (null? ps)) (for/and ((p ps)) (= (safe-at g (first p) (second p) -1) 9))))
   (define (shift ps dr dc n) (map (lambda (p) (list (+ (first p) (* dr n)) (+ (second p) (* dc n)))) ps))
   ;; frame rows: black object, mobile rail, direction, gap, gray cells, travel.
   (define data
    (for/list ((o frames))
     (let* ((d (or (for/first ((d dirs) #:when (maroon? (rail o (first d) (second d)))) d) '(0 0)))
            (dr (first d)) (dc (second d)) (rr (rail o dr dc))
            (gap (if (equal? d '(0 0)) 0 (or (for/first ((n (range 1 31)) #:when (maroon? (shift rr dr dc n))) n) 0)))
            (gray (filter (lambda (p) (= (at g (first p) (second p)) 5))
                          (positions-in-rect (obj-r1 o) (obj-c1 o) (obj-r2 o) (obj-c2 o)))))
      (list o rr dr dc gap gray (min gap (length gray))))))
   (define (travel f) (list-ref f 6))
   (define (score f)
    (let ((o (first f)) (fuel (length (list-ref f 5))) (dist (travel f)))
     (cond [(equal? output-policy "max_gap") (list-ref f 4)]
           [(equal? output-policy "max_fuel") fuel]
           [(equal? output-policy "min_remaining") (- dist fuel)]
           [(equal? output-policy "max_final_orange") (+ (- (* (- (obj-h o) 2) (- (obj-w o) 2)) fuel) dist)]
           [(equal? output-policy "largest_box") (* (obj-h o) (obj-w o))]
           [(equal? output-policy "shortest_move") (- dist)]
           [else dist])))
   (define winner (if (null? data) #f
     (cond [(equal? output-policy "first") (first data)]
           [(equal? output-policy "last") (last data)]
           [else (pick-max data score)])))
   (define cleared (for/fold ((out g)) ((f data))
     (let ((o (first f))) (recolor-cells out (append (positions-in-rect (obj-r1 o) (obj-c1 o) (obj-r2 o) (obj-c2 o)) (second f)) 6))))
   (for/fold ((out cleared)) ((f data))
    (let* ((o (first f)) (dr (third f)) (dc (fourth f)) (n (travel f))
           (gray (list-ref f 5))
           (key (lambda (p)
              (cond [(= dr -1) (+ (* 31 (first p)) (second p))]
                    [(= dr 1) (- (+ (* 31 (first p)) (second p)))]
                    [(= dc 1) (+ (* -31 (second p)) (first p))]
                    [else (- (* 31 (second p)) (first p))])))
           (spent (take (sort gray < #:key key) n))
           (highlight (and (not (equal? output-policy "all_moves")) (equal? f winner)))
           (painted
            (for/fold ((b out)) ((p (positions-in-rect (obj-r1 o) (obj-c1 o) (obj-r2 o) (obj-c2 o))))
             (let ((v (at g (first p) (second p))))
              (set-cell b (+ (first p) (* dr n)) (+ (second p) (* dc n))
                (cond [(and highlight (= v 0)) 8] [(member p spent) 7] [else v]))))))
     (recolor-cells painted (shift (second f) dr dc n) 9))))))

(rule!
 ;; Repair uniquely colored orthogonal paths on black. Red cells mark path
 ;; vertices and reverse that path's observed over/under crossing relation.
 ;; Yellow cells point away from a pivot: replace its opposite terminal arm
 ;; with a straight extension toward the indicated edge. Recover topology
 ;; and crossing order BEFORE rerouting, so a new crossing inherits the order.
 ;; Axial runs and three alternating samples support missing cells; a gap
 ;; between two transverse runs alone does not establish a connecting edge.
 ;; Unobserved/cyclic crossing orders use a deterministic color-order fallback.
 (lambda (g)
  (let ()
   (define reverse-marked? #t)
   (define (v p) (safe-at g (first p) (second p) -1))
   (define (add p d) (list (+ (first p) (first d)) (+ (second p) (second d))))
   (define (mul d n) (list (* (first d) n) (* (second d) n)))
   (define (perp d) (list (list (second d) (first d)) (list (- (second d)) (- (first d)))))
   (define colors (filter (lambda (x) (not (member x '(0 2 4)))) (grid-colors g)))
   (define (recover color)
    (define (ok p) (or (= (v p) color) (= (v p) 2)))
    (define (support p d)
     (or (ok (add p d))
         (and (ok (add p (mul d 2)))
              (or (ok (add p (mul d 3))) (ok (add p (mul d 4)))))))
    (define (transverse p d) (for/or ((e (perp d))) (ok (add p e))))
    (define (corner p d)
     (or (= (v p) 2) (and (= (v p) color) (for/or ((e (perp d))) (support p e)))))
    (define (end p d)
     (if (corner p d) p
      (let walk ((q (add p d)) (last p))
       (cond ((= (v q) -1) last)
             ((and (ok q) (corner q d)) q)
             (else (walk (add q d) (if (ok q) q last)))))))
    (define segments
     (remove-duplicates
      (for*/list ((p (grid-positions g)) (d '((0 1) (1 0))) (distance '(1 2))
        #:when
        (let ((q (add p (mul d distance))))
         (and (ok p) (ok q) (or (= (v p) color) (= (v q) color))
              (or (= distance 1) (ok (add p (mul d -2))) (ok (add q (mul d 2))))
              (not (and (= distance 2) (transverse p d) (transverse q d))))))
       (let ((q (add p (mul d distance))))
        (list (end p (mul d -1)) (end q d))))))
    (define cells
     (remove-duplicates
      (append (find-color g color)
       (apply append
        (map (lambda (s)
               (positions-in-rect (first (first s)) (second (first s))
                                  (first (second s)) (second (second s)))) segments)))))
    (list color cells (for/or ((p cells)) (= (v p) 2))))
   (define paths (map recover colors))
   (define observed-over
    (filter (lambda (x) x)
     (for*/list ((i (range (length paths))) (j (range (+ i 1) (length paths))))
      (let* ((a (list-ref paths i)) (b (list-ref paths j))
             (overlap (filter (lambda (p) (member p (second b))) (second a)))
             (na (count-if (lambda (p) (= (v p) (first a))) overlap))
             (nb (count-if (lambda (p) (= (v p) (first b))) overlap)))
       (if (= (+ na nb) 0) #f
        (if (>= na nb) (list (first b) (first a)) (list (first a) (first b))))))))
   (define (record color) (for/first ((p paths) #:when (= (first p) color)) p))
   (define edges
    (map (lambda (edge)
           (if (and reverse-marked?
                    (or (third (record (first edge))) (third (record (second edge)))))
               (reverse edge) edge)) observed-over))
   (define paint-order
    (let loop ((pending colors) (done '()))
     (if (null? pending) (reverse done)
      (let ((next
             (or (for/first ((color pending)
                   #:when (not (for/or ((edge edges))
                     (and (= (second edge) color) (member (first edge) pending))))) color)
                 (first pending))))
       (loop (filter (lambda (x) (not (= x next))) pending) (cons next done))))))
   (define (route item)
    (define mask (second item))
    (define turns
     (for*/list ((q (find-color g 4)) (d cardinal-deltas)
       #:when (let ((pivot (add q (mul d -1))) (old (add q (mul d -2))))
        (and (member pivot mask) (member old mask) (not (member q mask))
             (for/or ((e (perp d))) (member (add pivot e) mask)))))
      (list (add q (mul d -1)) d)))
    (define (old-arm turn)
     (define pivot (first turn))
     (define initial (add pivot (mul (second turn) -1)))
     (let loop ((todo (list initial)) (seen (list pivot)) (found '()))
      (if (null? todo) found
       (let ((p (first todo)))
        (if (or (member p seen) (not (member p mask)))
            (loop (rest todo) seen found)
            (loop (append (map (lambda (d) (add p d)) cardinal-deltas) (rest todo))
                  (cons p seen) (cons p found)))))))
    (define removed (apply append (map old-arm turns)))
    (define added
     (apply append
      (map (lambda (turn)
             (let loop ((p (first turn)) (out '()))
              (if (in-bounds? (first p) (second p) h w)
                  (loop (add p (second turn)) (cons p out)) out))) turns)))
    (remove-duplicates (append (filter (lambda (p) (not (member p removed))) mask) added)))
   (for/fold ((out (build-grid h w (r c) 0))) ((color paint-order))
    (recolor-cells out (route (record color)) color)))))

(rule!
 ;; The six-row legend maps obstacle colors to left or right turns. A solid
 ;; color-8 square emits four square-width rays. Each ray advances through the
 ;; original scene; immediately before a colored obstacle it turns according to
 ;; that obstacle's legend command. Repeated position/direction states stop.
 ;; Remove the legend and paint traversed background cells color 8.
 (lambda (g)
  (let ()
   (define turn-policy 'legend)
   (define sh (- h 6))
   (define scene (build-grid sh w (r c) (at g (+ r 6) c)))
   (define border (at g 0 0))
   (define legend
    (for/list ((i (range (quotient w 6))))
     (let* ((base (* i 6))
            (colored
             (for*/list ((r (range 1 5)) (lc (range 1 5))
                         #:when (let ((v (at g r (+ base lc))))
                                  (and (not (= v 0)) (not (= v border)))))
              (list lc (at g r (+ base lc)))))
            (first-cell (first colored))
            (lc (first first-cell))
            (color (second first-cell)))
      (list color (if (<= lc 2) 'left 'right)))))
   (define bg (mode scene -1))
   (define seed
    (for*/list ((r (range sh)) (c (range w)) #:when (= (at scene r c) 8))
     (list r c)))
   (define r0 (apply min (map first seed)))
   (define r1 (apply max (map first seed)))
   (define c0 (apply min (map second seed)))
   (define c1 (apply max (map second seed)))
   (define size (+ 1 (- r1 r0)))
   (define (footprint r c)
    (for*/list ((rr (range r (+ r size))) (cc (range c (+ c size)))) (list rr cc)))
   (define (inside? r c)
    (and (<= 0 r) (<= 0 c) (<= (+ r size) sh) (<= (+ c size) w)))
   (define (command color)
    (let* ((named (second (assoc color legend)))
           (selected (if (eq? turn-policy 'legend) named
                         (if (eq? named 'left) 'right 'left))))
     selected))
   (define (turned dr dc side)
    (if (eq? side 'left) (list (- dc) dr) (list dc (- dr))))
   (define (walk r c dr dc seen)
    (define state (list r c dr dc))
    (if (member state seen) '()
     (let* ((here (footprint r c)) (nr (+ r dr)) (nc (+ c dc)))
      (if (not (inside? nr nc)) here
       (let ((hits
        (remove-duplicates
         (for/list ((p (footprint nr nc))
                    #:when (let ((v (at scene (first p) (second p))))
                             (and (not (= v bg)) (not (= v 8)))))
          (at scene (first p) (second p))))))
        (if (null? hits)
            (append here (walk nr nc dr dc (cons state seen)))
            (let* ((next (turned dr dc (command (first hits))))
                   (ndr (first next)) (ndc (second next)))
             (append here (walk r c ndr ndc (cons state seen))))))))))
   (define marks
    (remove-duplicates
     (apply append
      (for/list ((d '((-1 0) (1 0) (0 -1) (0 1))))
       (walk r0 c0 (first d) (second d) '())))))
   (build-grid sh w (r c)
    (if (and (= (at scene r c) bg) (member (list r c) marks)) 8 (at scene r c))))))

(rule!
 ;; Identify the large connected TEMPLATE, then classify its background holes
 ;; by shape up to all rotations/reflections. Count external GLYPHS of each
 ;; matching shape by color. Fill each hole with its most frequent matching
 ;; color; numeric minimum resolves exact vote ties. Preserve the template.
 (lambda (g)
  (let ()
   (define least-frequent? #f)
   (define background (mode g -1))
   (define objs (objects-8 g background))
   (define template (pick-max objs obj-size))
   (define bb (obj-bbox template))
   (define template-color (obj-color template))
   (define crop (apply subgrid g bb))
   (define holes (objects crop template-color))
   (define (in-template? p)
    (and (<= (first bb) (first p) (third bb)) (<= (second bb) (second p) (fourth bb))))
   (define glyphs (filter (lambda (o) (not (ormap in-template? (obj-cells o)))) objs))
   (define (matches? a b)
    (member (sort (normalize-cells (obj-cells a)) cell<) (all-transforms (obj-cells b))))
   (for/fold ((out crop)) ((hole (in-list holes)))
    (define matching (filter (lambda (o) (matches? hole o)) glyphs))
    (define palette (unique (map obj-color matching)))
    (define counts (map (lambda (color) (count-if (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) color)) matching)) palette))
    (if (null? palette) out
     (let* ((best (apply (if least-frequent? min max) counts))
            (chosen (apply min (for/list ((color (in-list palette)) (n (in-list counts)) #:when (= n best)) color))))
      (recolor-cells out (obj-cells hole) chosen)))))))

(rule!
 ;; Decode four square panels and their two enclosing groups from a noisy
 ;; canvas. The complete pair teaches a relation: routed endpoint completion,
 ;; reflection closure, sparse-key/palette transfer, or periodic mask inversion.
 ;; Recover the relation and its palette/orientation from the reference pair,
 ;; then apply it to the nonempty panel paired with the unique blank panel.
 ;; Conflicting supported interpretations fail rather than silently guessing.
 (lambda (g)
  (let ()
   (define changes-only #f)
   (define (border? r c rr cc)
    (let ((v (at g r c)))
     (and (not (= v 0))
      (for/and ((x (range c (+ cc 1)))) (and (= (at g r x) v) (= (at g rr x) v)))
      (for/and ((y (range r (+ rr 1)))) (and (= (at g y c) v) (= (at g y cc) v))))))
   (define (frames-at size)
    (for*/list ((r (range (+ (- h size) 1))) (c (range (+ (- w size) 1)))
      #:when (and (border? r c (+ r size -1) (+ c size -1))
       (for*/or ((y (range (+ r 1) (+ r size -1))) (x (range (+ c 1) (+ c size -1)))) (= (at g y x) 0))))
     (list r c (+ r size -1) (+ c size -1) (subgrid g (+ r 1) (+ c 1) (+ r size -2) (+ c size -2)))))
   (define sizes (filter (lambda (s) (= (length (frames-at s)) 4)) (reverse (range 5 (+ (min h w) 1)))))
   (define frames (if (null? sizes) (error 'analogy "four equal square frames required") (frames-at (first sizes))))
   (define n (rows (fifth (first frames))))
   (define (cells p) (for*/list ((r (range n)) (c (range n)) #:when (not (= (at p r c) 0))) (list r c)))
   (define blanks (filter (lambda (i) (null? (cells (fifth (list-ref frames i))))) (range 4)))
   (define blank (if (= (length blanks) 1) (first blanks) (error 'analogy "exactly one blank required")))
   (define bf (list-ref frames blank))
   (define choices
    (apply append
     (for/list ((mate (range 4)) #:unless (= mate blank))
      (let* ((mf (list-ref frames mate)) (rlo (min (first bf) (first mf))) (clo (min (second bf) (second mf)))
             (rhi (max (third bf) (third mf))) (chi (max (fourth bf) (fourth mf))))
       (for*/list ((r (range rlo)) (c (range clo)) (rr (range (+ rhi 1) h)) (cc (range (+ chi 1) w))
        #:when (and (border? r c rr cc)
         (for/and ((i (range 4)) #:unless (or (= i blank) (= i mate)))
          (let ((f (list-ref frames i))) (not (and (< r (first f)) (< c (second f)) (< (third f) rr) (< (fourth f) cc)))))))
        (list (* (+ (- rr r) 1) (+ (- cc c) 1)) mate))))))
   (define mate (if (null? choices) (error 'analogy "outer group missing")
                (second (first (sort choices (lambda (a b) (< (first a) (first b))))))))
   (define refs (for/list ((i (range 4)) #:unless (or (= i blank) (= i mate))) (fifth (list-ref frames i))))
   (define query (fifth (list-ref frames mate)))
   (define (route p)
    (let* ((ns (cells p))
           (between? (lambda (a b t)
            (or (and (and (= (first a) (first b)) (= (first b) (first t))) (and (< (min (second a) (second b)) (second t)) (< (second t) (max (second a) (second b)))))
                (and (and (= (second a) (second b)) (= (second b) (second t))) (and (< (min (first a) (first b)) (first t)) (< (first t) (max (first a) (first b))))))))
           (edges (for*/list ((i (range (length ns))) (j (range (+ i 1) (length ns)))
             #:when (let ((a (list-ref ns i)) (b (list-ref ns j)))
              (and (or (= (first a) (first b)) (= (second a) (second b)))
                   (not (ormap (lambda (t) (between? a b t)) ns)))))
            (list (list-ref ns i) (list-ref ns j))))
           (degree (lambda (pt) (length (filter (lambda (e) (member pt e)) edges))))
           (ends (filter (lambda (pt) (= (degree pt) 1)) ns)))
     (if (not (and (>= (length ns) 3) (= (length ends) 2) (= (length edges) (- (length ns) 1))
                   (andmap (lambda (pt) (member (degree pt) '(1 2))) ns))) #f
      (let* ((color (at p (first (first ends)) (second (first ends))))
             (valid (and (= color (at p (first (second ends)) (second (second ends))))
                 (andmap (lambda (pt) (or (member pt ends) (not (= color (at p (first pt) (second pt)))))) ns))))
       (if (not valid) #f
        (for/fold ((out p)) ((edge edges))
         (let ((a (first edge)) (b (second edge)))
          (for*/fold ((out out)) ((r (range (min (first a) (first b)) (+ (max (first a) (first b)) 1)))
                                 (c (range (min (second a) (second b)) (+ (max (second a) (second b)) 1))))
           (if (= (at out r c) 0) (set-cell out r c color) out)))))))))
   (define (reflect p)
    (define (values-at r c)
     (remove-duplicates (filter (lambda (v) (not (= v 0)))
       (for*/list ((y (list r (- n r 1))) (x (list c (- n c 1)))) (at p y x)))))
    (if (for*/and ((r (range n)) (c (range n))) (<= (length (values-at r c)) 1))
     (grid-from-fn n n (lambda (r c) (let ((vs (values-at r c))) (if (null? vs) 0 (first vs))))) #f))
   (define (turn p) (grid-from-fn n n (lambda (r c) (at p (- n c 1) r))))
   (define (flip p) (grid-from-fn n n (lambda (r c) (at p r (- n c 1)))))
   (define (transforms p)
    (let* ((a (turn p)) (b (turn a)) (c (turn b)) (d (flip p)) (e (turn d)) (f (turn e)) (i (turn f)))
      (list p a b c d e f i)))
   (define (transfer src dst)
    (if (>= (length (cells src)) (length (cells dst))) '()
     (filter (lambda (x) x)
      (for/list ((a (transforms src)) (b (transforms dst)))
       (let* ((pairs (remove-duplicates (for*/list ((r (range n)) (c (range n))) (list (at a r c) (at query r c)))))
              (keys (map first pairs)) (vals (map second pairs)))
        (if (and (= (length keys) (length (remove-duplicates keys)))
                 (= (length vals) (length (remove-duplicates vals)))
                 (andmap (lambda (p) (equal? (= (first p) 0) (= (second p) 0))) pairs)
                 (for*/and ((r (range n)) (c (range n))) (assoc (at b r c) pairs)))
         (list 'transfer (grid-from-fn n n (lambda (r c) (second (assoc (at b r c) pairs))))) #f))))))
   (define (inverse a b)
    (if (not (for*/and ((r (range n)) (c (range n))) (not (equal? (= (at a r c) 0) (= (at b r c) 0))))) #f
     (let* ((texture (grid-from-fn n n (lambda (r c) (if (= (at a r c) 0) (at b r c) (at a r c)))))
            (periodic (ormap (lambda (period)
                         (for*/and ((r (range n)) (c (range n)))
                           (= (at texture r c) (at texture (modulo r (first period)) (modulo c (second period))))))
                       '((1 1) (1 2) (2 1) (2 2))))
            (pairs (remove-duplicates (for*/list ((r (range n)) (c (range n)) #:when (not (= (at query r c) 0)))
                                       (list (at texture r c) (at query r c)))))
            (keys (map first pairs)) (vals (map second pairs)))
      (if (and periodic (= (length keys) (length (remove-duplicates keys)))
               (= (length vals) (length (remove-duplicates vals)))
               (for*/and ((r (range n)) (c (range n))) (assoc (at texture r c) pairs)))
       (list 'complement (grid-from-fn n n (lambda (r c) (if (= (at query r c) 0) (second (assoc (at texture r c) pairs)) 0)))) #f))))
   (define candidates
    (append
     (filter (lambda (x) x)
      (for*/list ((order (list refs (reverse refs))) (op (list route reflect)))
       (let ((a (first order)) (b (second order)))
        (if (and (not (equal? a b)) (equal? (op a) b) (op query)) (list 'completion (op query)) #f))))
     (transfer (first refs) (second refs)) (transfer (second refs) (first refs))
     (let ((answer (inverse (first refs) (second refs)))) (if answer (list answer) '()))))
   (define completed (if (null? candidates) (error 'analogy "no supported relation") (second (first candidates))))
   (if (not (andmap (lambda (entry) (equal? (second entry) completed)) candidates))
    (error 'analogy "ambiguous reference relation")
    (if changes-only (grid-from-fn n n (lambda (r c) (if (= (at completed r c) (at query r c)) 0 (at completed r c)))) completed)))))

(rule!
 ;; Blue T glyphs point from a source region toward the first different region
 ;; on their ray. A nonblue center supplies the new ink; a blue center means
 ;; the original source ink. Restore the overwritten regions before routing,
 ;; freeze all destinations, and recolor simultaneously rather than cascading.
 ;; A five-cell burgundy top-corner glyph is erased and requests a quarter-turn:
 ;; a left corner turns clockwise; a right corner turns counterclockwise.
 (lambda (g)
  (let ()
   (define use-payload #t)
   (define dirs '((-1 0) (1 0) (0 -1) (0 1)))
   (define (value r c) (if (and (<= 0 r) (< r h) (<= 0 c) (< c w)) (at g r c) -1))
   (define arrows
    (filter (lambda (x) x)
     (for*/list ((r (range h)) (c (range w)))
      (let ((arms (filter (lambda (d) (= (value (+ r (first d)) (+ c (second d))) 1)) dirs)))
       (if (not (= (length arms) 3)) #f
        (let* ((missing (first (filter (lambda (d) (not (member d arms))) dirs)))
               (dr (- (first missing))) (dc (- (second missing)))
               (one (value (+ r dr dc) (+ c dc dr))) (two (value (+ r dr (- dc)) (+ c dc (- dr))))
               (pts (cons (list r c) (map (lambda (d) (list (+ r (first d)) (+ c (second d)))) arms))))
         (if (and (= one two) (not (member one '(-1 1))))
          (list r c dr dc one (if (= (at g r c) 1) one (at g r c)) pts) #f)))))))
   (define (frequency v values) (length (filter (lambda (x) (= v x)) values)))
   (define turns
    (apply append
     (for/list ((obj (objects g -1)) #:when (and (= (obj-color obj) 9) (= (length (obj-cells obj)) 5)
              (= (- (obj-r2 obj) (obj-r1 obj)) 2) (= (- (obj-c2 obj) (obj-c1 obj)) 2)))
      (let ((r0 (obj-r1 obj)) (c0 (obj-c1 obj)) (r1 (obj-r2 obj)) (c1 (obj-c2 obj)) (pts (obj-cells obj)))
       (filter (lambda (x) x)
        (for/list ((corner (list c0 c1)) (k '(1 -1)))
         (let ((shape (remove-duplicates
                       (append (for/list ((c (range c0 (+ c1 1)))) (list r0 c))
                               (for/list ((r (range r0 (+ r1 1)))) (list r corner))))))
          (if (not (andmap (lambda (p) (member p pts)) shape)) #f
           (let* ((votes (filter (lambda (v) (not (member v '(-1 1 9))))
                          (apply append (for/list ((p pts))
                           (for/list ((d dirs) #:unless (member (list (+ (first p) (first d)) (+ (second p) (second d))) pts))
                             (value (+ (first p) (first d)) (+ (second p) (second d))))))))
                  (palette (remove-duplicates votes))
                  (source (if (null? palette) (error 'arrows "missing rotation background")
                            (first (sort palette (lambda (a b) (> (frequency a votes) (frequency b votes))))))))
             (list source k pts))))))))))
   (define restored-arrows
    (for/fold ((out g)) ((a arrows))
     (for/fold ((out out)) ((p (list-ref a 6))) (set-cell out (first p) (second p) (list-ref a 4)))))
   (define clean
    (for/fold ((out restored-arrows)) ((t turns))
     (for/fold ((out out)) ((p (third t))) (set-cell out (first p) (second p) (first t)))))
   (define regions (objects clean -1))
   (define actions
    (for/list ((a arrows))
     (let* ((r (first a)) (c (second a)) (dr (third a)) (dc (fourth a)) (source (list-ref a 4))
            (hit (let seek ((y (+ r dr)) (x (+ c dc)))
              (if (not (and (<= 0 y) (< y h) (<= 0 x) (< x w))) (error 'arrows "ray leaves canvas")
               (if (= (at clean y x) source) (seek (+ y dr) (+ x dc)) (list y x)))))
            (target (find-first (lambda (obj) (member hit (obj-cells obj))) regions)))
       (if (not target) (error 'arrows "destination missing")
        (list (if use-payload (list-ref a 5) source) (obj-cells target))))))
   (define painted
    (for/fold ((out clean)) ((action actions))
     (for/fold ((out out)) ((p (second action))) (set-cell out (first p) (second p) (first action)))))
   (define (clockwise p)
    (grid-from-fn (cols p) (rows p) (lambda (r c) (at p (- (rows p) c 1) r))))
   (define steps (modulo (apply + (map second turns)) 4))
   (for/fold ((out painted)) ((k (range steps))) (clockwise out)))))

(rule!
 ;; Split at complete magenta (6) divider bands into equal-sized panels.
 ;; Orange (7) is background. Match WHOLE foreground contact sets, ignoring
 ;; color, across opposite borders. The unique open head-to-tail chain fixes
 ;; its order and whether the panels must be laid out vertically or horizontally.
 ;; Preserve panel pixels and divider thickness; do not rotate the panels.
 ;; Optional prefix_parity highlights panels with an odd cumulative foreground
 ;; cell count in the reconstructed chain, not in their input presentation order.
 (lambda (g)
  (let ()
   (define count-policy "canonical")
   (define prefix-scope "assembled")
   (define height (length g))
   (define width (length (first g)))
   (define (spans flags)
    (let loop ([i 0] [start #f] [out '()])
     (cond [(= i (length flags)) (if start (append out (list (list start i))) out)]
           [(list-ref flags i) (loop (+ i 1) #f (if start (append out (list (list start i))) out))]
           [else (loop (+ i 1) (if start start i) out)])))
   (define rr (spans (for/list ([row g]) (andmap (lambda (v) (= v 6)) row))))
   (define cc (spans (for/list ([c (range width)]) (andmap (lambda (row) (= (list-ref row c) 6)) g))))
   (define thick (if (> (length rr) 1) (- (first (second rr)) (second (first rr)))
                     (- (first (second cc)) (second (first cc)))))
   (define tiles
    (for*/list ([rb rr] [cb cc])
     (for/list ([r (range (first rb) (second rb))])
      (for/list ([c (range (first cb) (second cb))]) (list-ref (list-ref g r) c)))))
   (define n (length tiles))
   (define th (length (first tiles)))
   (define tw (length (first (first tiles))))
   (define (edge t axis end?)
    (define vals (if (equal? axis "vertical") (if end? (last t) (first t))
                       (map (lambda (row) (if end? (last row) (first row))) t)))
    (for/list ([i (range (length vals))] #:when (not (= (list-ref vals i) 7))) i))
   (define (search axis path)
    (define port (edge (list-ref tiles (last path)) axis #t))
    (cond [(= (length path) n) (if (null? port) (list path) '())]
          [(null? port) '()]
          [else (apply append
           (for/list ([i (range n)] #:when (and (not (member i path))
                     (equal? port (edge (list-ref tiles i) axis #f))))
            (search axis (append path (list i)))))]))
   (define candidates
    (apply append
     (for/list ([axis (list "vertical" "horizontal")])
      (apply append
       (for/list ([i (range n)] #:when (null? (edge (list-ref tiles i) axis #f)))
        (map (lambda (path) (list axis path)) (search axis (list i))))))))
   (define axis (first (first candidates)))
   (define order (second (first candidates)))
   (define (area t) (for*/sum ([row t] [v row]) (if (= v 7) 0 1)))
   (define score-order (if (equal? prefix-scope "input") (range n) order))
   (define (prefix-count target)
    (let loop ([rest score-order] [total 0])
     (define i (first rest))
     (define next (+ total (area (list-ref tiles i))))
     (if (= i target) next (loop (rest-list rest) next))))
   (define (rest-list xs) (cdr xs))
   (define ordered
    (for/list ([i order])
     (define change? (and (equal? count-policy "prefix_parity") (odd? (prefix-count i))))
     (for/list ([row (list-ref tiles i)])
      (map (lambda (v) (if (and change? (not (= v 7))) 8 v)) row))))
   (if (equal? axis "vertical")
    (apply append (for/list ([i (range n)])
      (append (list-ref ordered i) (if (= i (- n 1)) '() (make-list thick (make-list tw 6))))))
    (for/list ([r (range th)])
     (apply append (for/list ([i (range n)])
      (append (list-ref (list-ref ordered i) r) (if (= i (- n 1)) '() (make-list thick 6))))))))))

(rule!
 ;; Four distinct colored pieces tile a solid square after quarter-turns.
 ;; Gray 5 belongs to the orange 7 piece and anchors the instructed corner.
 ;; Group by color: a piece may contain cells connected only diagonally.
 ;; First place the marker piece; its occupied cells constrain completion.
 ;; Preserve colors and use rotations only, never reflections. The declared
 ;; input grammar has exactly one reconstruction at the instructed corner.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define anchor-corner 'northwest)
     (define cells
       (for*/list ((r (range 0 (length g)))
                   (c (range 0 (length (first g))))
                   #:when (positive? (list-ref (list-ref g r) c)))
         (list r c (list-ref (list-ref g r) c))))
     (define side
       (let seek ((n 1))
         (cond ((= (* n n) (length cells)) n)
               ((> (* n n) (length cells))
                (error 'jigsaw "Non-square total piece area"))
               (else (seek (+ n 1))))))
     (define target-column (if (eq? anchor-corner 'northwest) 0 (- side 1)))
     (define (cell-less? a b)
       (or (< (first a) (first b))
           (and (= (first a) (first b)) (< (second a) (second b)))))
     (define (normalize piece)
       (define top (apply min (map first piece)))
       (define left (apply min (map second piece)))
       (sort (map (lambda (p)
                    (list (- (first p) top) (- (second p) left) (third p)))
                  piece) cell-less?))
     (define (turn piece)
       (normalize (map (lambda (p) (list (second p) (- (first p)) (third p))) piece)))
     (define (orientations piece)
       (define a (normalize piece))
       (define b (turn a))
       (define c (turn b))
       (remove-duplicates (list a b c (turn c))))
     (define (translate piece dr dc)
       (map (lambda (p) (list (+ dr (first p)) (+ dc (second p)) (third p))) piece))
     (define (inside? piece)
       (andmap (lambda (p)
                  (and (<= 0 (first p)) (< (first p) side)
                       (<= 0 (second p)) (< (second p) side))) piece))
     (define (position p) (+ (* side (first p)) (second p)))
     (define (mask piece)
       (for/fold ((bits 0)) ((p piece))
         (bitwise-ior bits (arithmetic-shift 1 (position p)))))
     (define anchor
       (filter (lambda (p) (or (= (third p) 5) (= (third p) 7))) cells))
     (define colors
       (sort (remove-duplicates
              (map third (filter (lambda (p) (and (!= (third p) 5) (!= (third p) 7))) cells))) <))
     (define anchors
       (filter inside?
         (map (lambda (piece)
                (define marker (first (filter (lambda (p) (= (third p) 5)) piece)))
                (translate piece (- (first marker)) (- target-column (second marker))))
              (orientations anchor))))
     (define placements
       (for*/list ((id (range 0 (length colors)))
                   (piece (orientations (filter (lambda (p) (= (third p) (list-ref colors id))) cells)))
                   (dr (range 0 (- side (apply max (map first piece)))))
                   (dc (range 0 (- side (apply max (map second piece))))))
         (define moved (translate piece dr dc))
         (list (arithmetic-shift 1 id) (mask moved) moved)))
     (define by-cell
       (let ((table (make-vector (* side side) (list))))
         (for-each
           (lambda (placement)
             (for-each (lambda (p)
                         (define i (position p))
                         (vector-set! table i (cons placement (vector-ref table i))))
                       (third placement)))
           placements)
         table))
     (define full-mask (- (arithmetic-shift 1 (* side side)) 1))
     (define (first-empty occupied)
       (let scan ((i 0))
         (if (zero? (bitwise-and occupied (arithmetic-shift 1 i))) i (scan (+ i 1)))))
     (define (complete occupied used chosen)
       (if (= occupied full-mask)
           chosen
           (let try ((choices (vector-ref by-cell (first-empty occupied))))
             (cond
               ((null? choices) #f)
               (else
                 (define placement (first choices))
                 (define answer
                   (and (zero? (bitwise-and used (first placement)))
                        (zero? (bitwise-and occupied (second placement)))
                        (complete (bitwise-ior occupied (second placement))
                                  (bitwise-ior used (first placement))
                                  (cons (third placement) chosen))))
                 (if answer answer (try (rest choices))))))))
     (define solution
       (let try-anchor ((choices anchors))
         (cond
           ((null? choices) (error 'jigsaw "No rotation-only reconstruction"))
           (else
             (define piece (first choices))
             (define answer (complete (mask piece) 0 (list piece)))
             (if answer answer (try-anchor (rest choices)))))))
     (define output (make-vector (* side side) 0))
     (for-each (lambda (piece)
                 (for-each (lambda (p) (vector-set! output (position p) (third p))) piece))
               solution)
     (for/list ((r (range 0 side)))
       (for/list ((c (range 0 side)))
         (vector-ref output (+ (* side r) c)))))))

(rule!
 ;; Fill enclosed background pockets selected by marker-adjacent indicator chains.
 ;; A marker is a singleton color. Its directly adjacent path/indicator color points
 ;; toward framed background pockets. Frame colors are inferred structurally from
 ;; colors adjacent to indicators (with a pure-enclosure test for alternates), so
 ;; outer walls and contaminating tokens do not become frames. Multiple singleton
 ;; markers independently color the pockets reached by their clean indicator chain.
 (lambda (g)
  (let ()
   (define H (rows g))
   (define W (cols g))
   (define D cardinal-deltas)
   (define (inside? p) (and (<= 0 (first p)) (< (first p) H) (<= 0 (second p)) (< (second p) W)))
   (define (nbrs p)
    (filter inside? (map (lambda (d) (list (+ (first p) (first d)) (+ (second p) (second d)))) D)))
   (define colors (remove-duplicates (flatten g)))
   (define (freq v) (count-color g v))
   (define (most-common xs)
    (if (null? xs) #f
     (car (sort (remove-duplicates xs)
                (lambda (a b) (let ((ca (count (lambda (x) (= x a)) xs))
                                     (cb (count (lambda (x) (= x b)) xs)))
                                 (if (= ca cb) (< a b) (> ca cb))))))))
   (define bg (car (sort colors (lambda (a b) (> (freq a) (freq b))))))
   (define markers (sort (filter (lambda (v) (and (not (= v bg)) (= (freq v) 1))) colors) <))
   (define (cells-of v) (find-color g v))
   (define (indicator-for m)
    (let* ((p (first (cells-of m)))
           (vals (filter (lambda (v) (and (not (= v bg)) (not (member v markers))))
                         (map (lambda (q) (at g (first q) (second q))) (nbrs p)))))
     (most-common vals)))
   (define marker-info (map (lambda (m) (list m (indicator-for m))) markers))
   (define indicators (remove-duplicates (filter identity (map second marker-info))))
   (define excluded (append (list bg) markers indicators))
   (define (component start v)
    (let loop ((todo (list start)) (seen '()))
     (if (null? todo) seen
      (let* ((p (car todo)) (rest (cdr todo)))
       (if (member p seen)
        (loop rest seen)
        (let ((more (filter (lambda (q) (and (= (at g (first q) (second q)) v)
                                             (not (member q seen)))) (nbrs p))))
         (loop (append rest more) (cons p seen))))))))
   (define (components-of v)
    (let loop ((left (cells-of v)) (out '()))
     (if (null? left) (reverse out)
      (let* ((c (component (car left) v))
             (remain (filter (lambda (p) (not (member p c))) left)))
       (loop remain (cons c out))))))
   (define bg-components (components-of bg))
   (define (boundary comp)
    (let ((S comp))
     (remove-duplicates
      (apply append
       (map (lambda (p) (filter (lambda (q) (not (member q S))) (nbrs p))) comp)))))
   (define fsadj
    (apply append
     (for/list ((va indicators))
      (apply append
       (for/list ((p (cells-of va)))
        (filter (lambda (v) (not (member v excluded)))
                (map (lambda (q) (at g (first q) (second q))) (nbrs p))))))))
   (define candidates
    (if (null? fsadj)
     (filter (lambda (v) (not (member v excluded))) colors)
     fsadj))
   (define fdom (most-common candidates))
   (define (pure-frame? v)
    (ormap (lambda (comp)
            (let ((b (boundary comp)))
             (and (not (null? b)) (andmap (lambda (p) (= (at g (first p) (second p)) v)) b))))
           bg-components))
   (define fothers
    (if fdom
     (filter (lambda (v) (and (not (= v fdom)) (pure-frame? v))) (remove-duplicates candidates))
     '()))
   (define frames (if fdom (cons fdom fothers) '()))
   (define vdec
    (remove-duplicates
     (append (filter (lambda (v) (not (member v (append (list bg) markers indicators frames)))) colors)
             (filter (lambda (v) (not (member v frames))) (remove-duplicates candidates)))))
   (define pockets
    (filter (lambda (comp)
             (let ((b (boundary comp)))
              (and (not (null? frames)) (not (null? b))
                   (andmap (lambda (p) (member (at g (first p) (second p)) frames)) b))))
            bg-components))
   (define (chain-contaminated? va start)
    (let loop ((todo (list start)) (seen '()))
     (cond
      ((null? todo) #f)
      ((member (car todo) seen) (loop (cdr todo) seen))
      (else
       (let* ((p (car todo)) (ns (nbrs p)))
        (if (ormap (lambda (q) (member (at g (first q) (second q)) vdec)) ns) #t
         (loop (append (cdr todo)
                       (filter (lambda (q) (and (= (at g (first q) (second q)) va)
                                                (not (member q seen)))) ns))
               (cons p seen))))))))
   (define (clean? comp va)
    (ormap
     (lambda (fp)
      (ormap (lambda (q) (and (= (at g (first q) (second q)) va)
                              (not (chain-contaminated? va q))))
             (nbrs fp)))
     (filter (lambda (p) (member (at g (first p) (second p)) frames)) (boundary comp))))
   (define (rect? comp)
    (let* ((rs (map first comp)) (cs (map second comp))
           (r0 (apply min rs)) (r1 (apply max rs)) (c0 (apply min cs)) (c1 (apply max cs)))
     (= (length comp) (* (+ 1 (- r1 r0)) (+ 1 (- c1 c0))))))
   (define targets
    (if (and (= (length markers) 1) (not (null? fothers)))
     (filter-map
      (lambda (comp)
       (let ((exclusive (andmap (lambda (p) (= (at g (first p) (second p)) fdom)) (boundary comp))))
        (if (and (rect? comp) exclusive) #f (list comp (first markers))))) pockets)
     (let* ((assigned
             (filter-map
              (lambda (comp)
               (let loop ((mi marker-info))
                (cond ((null? mi) #f)
                      ((and (second (car mi)) (clean? comp (second (car mi)))) (list comp (first (car mi))))
                      (else (loop (cdr mi)))))) pockets))
            (any? (not (null? assigned))))
      (if any? assigned (map (lambda (comp) (list comp (first markers))) pockets)))))
   (for/fold ((out g)) ((item targets))
    (paint-cells out (first item) (second item))))))

(rule!
 ;; Read the color of each horizontal input row.  Fold the first h-1 rows
 ;; around the center as one-cell concentric square layers, producing a
 ;; 2(h-1) by 2(h-1) output.  The repeated final input row supplies the same
 ;; center color as the innermost retained layer.
 (lambda (g)
  (let ()
   (define finish-mode 0)
   (define h (rows g))
   (define side (* 2 (- h 1)))
   (define layers (range 0 (- h 1)))
   (define (layer-index r c)
    (min r c (- side 1 r) (- side 1 c)))
   (define rings
    (build-grid side side (r c)
     (at g (layer-index r c) 0)))
   (define sequence (map (lambda (r) (at g r 0)) layers))
   (define runs
    (let loop ((i 1) (start 0) (current (first sequence)) (out '()))
     (if (= i (length sequence))
      (reverse (cons (list start (- i 1) current) out))
      (let ((value (list-ref sequence i)))
       (if (= value current)
        (loop (+ i 1) start current out)
        (loop (+ i 1) i value (cons (list start (- i 1) current) out)))))))
   (define (run-length run) (+ 1 (- (second run) (first run))))
   (define (run-cells run)
    (for*/list ((r (range 0 side)) (c (range 0 side))
                #:when (and (<= (first run) (layer-index r c))
                            (<= (layer-index r c) (second run))))
     (list r c)))
   (define components (objects rings -1))
   (define colors (remove-duplicates sequence))
   (define most-frequent
    (pick-max colors
     (lambda (v) (count-if (lambda (x) (= x v)) sequence))))
   (define largest-total
    (pick-max colors (lambda (v) (count-color rings v))))
   (define outer
    (first (filter (lambda (o) (member (list 0 0) (obj-cells o))) components)))
   (define center-cell (list (- (/ side 2) 1) (- (/ side 2) 1)))
   (define inner
    (first (filter (lambda (o) (member center-cell (obj-cells o))) components)))
   (define selected
    (cond
     ((= finish-mode 1) (obj-cells (pick-max components obj-size)))
     ((= finish-mode 2) (run-cells (pick-max runs run-length)))
     ((= finish-mode 3) (find-color rings most-frequent))
     ((= finish-mode 4) (find-color rings largest-total))
     ((= finish-mode 5) (obj-cells outer))
     ((= finish-mode 6) (obj-cells inner))
     (else '())))
   (if (= finish-mode 0) rings (paint-cells rings selected 9)))))

(rule!
 ;; Color 8 is a rectangular occluder. The 4b-2 square is generated from a
 ;; 2b seed mirrored across both far axes; its off-diagonal b-blocks are
 ;; transposes. Recover each hidden cell from its full symmetry orbit.
 (lambda (g)
  (let ()
   (define crop-marker #f)
   (define n (rows g))
   (define b (/ (+ n 2) 4))
   (define axis (+ n 1))
   (define hidden (find-color g 8))
   (define r0 (min-of first hidden))
   (define r1 (max-of first hidden))
   (define c0 (min-of second hidden))
   (define c1 (max-of second hidden))
   (define (inside? p)
    (and (>= (first p) 0) (< (first p) n) (>= (second p) 0) (< (second p) n)))
   (define (mirrors r c)
    (filter inside?
     (list (list r c) (list (- axis r) c) (list r (- axis c))
           (list (- axis r) (- axis c)))))
   (define (orbit r c)
    (let* ((rr (min r (- axis r))) (cc (min c (- axis c)))
           (off-diagonal
            (or (and (< rr b) (>= cc b) (< cc (* 2 b)))
                (and (< cc b) (>= rr b) (< rr (* 2 b))))))
     (if off-diagonal (append (mirrors r c) (mirrors cc rr)) (mirrors r c))))
   (define (recover r c)
    (let ((source
           (first (filter (lambda (p) (!= (at g (first p) (second p)) 8))
                          (orbit r c)))))
     (at g (first source) (second source))))
   (define patch
    (build-list (+ 1 (- r1 r0))
     (lambda (dr)
      (build-list (+ 1 (- c1 c0))
       (lambda (dc) (recover (+ r0 dr) (+ c0 dc)))))))
   (if crop-marker
    (let* ((colors (grid-colors patch))
           (rare
            (for/fold ((best (first colors))) ((color (in-list (rest colors))))
             (if (< (count-color patch color) (count-color patch best)) color best)))
           (cells (find-color patch rare))
           (mr0 (min-of first cells)) (mr1 (max-of first cells))
           (mc0 (min-of second cells)) (mc1 (max-of second cells)))
     (subgrid patch mr0 mc0 mr1 mc1))
    patch))))

(rule!
  (define bg (mode g -1))
  (define ignore-color #f)
  (define separators
    (filter (lambda (r) (and (not (= (at g r 0) bg))
                             (andmap (lambda (c) (= (at g r c) (at g r 0))) (range w)))) (range h)))
  (define top (first separators))
  (define bottom (second separators))
  (define (runs xs)
    (if (null? xs) (list)
      (let loop ([lo (first xs)] [hi (first xs)] [rest-xs (rest xs)] [acc (list)])
        (cond [(null? rest-xs) (reverse (cons (list lo hi) acc))]
              [(= (first rest-xs) (+ hi 1)) (loop lo (first rest-xs) (rest rest-xs) acc)]
              [else (loop (first rest-xs) (first rest-xs) (rest rest-xs) (cons (list lo hi) acc))]))))
  (define rb (runs (filter (lambda (r) (ormap (lambda (c) (not (= (at g r c) bg))) (range w))) (range (+ top 1) bottom))))
  (define cb (runs (filter (lambda (c) (ormap (lambda (r) (not (= (at g r c) bg))) (range (+ top 1) bottom))) (range w))))
  (define hc (runs (filter (lambda (c) (ormap (lambda (r) (not (= (at g r c) bg))) (range top))) (range w))))
  (define (signature r1 c1 r2 c2)
    (define cells (filter (lambda (p) (not (= (at g (first p) (second p)) bg))) (positions-in-rect r1 c1 r2 c2)))
    (define mr (apply min (map first cells)))
    (define mc (apply min (map second cells)))
    (map (lambda (p) (list (- (first p) mr) (- (second p) mc)
                           (if ignore-color 1 (at g (first p) (second p))))) cells))
  (define wanted (map (lambda (b) (signature 0 (first b) (- top 1) (second b))) hc))
  (define matched
    (for*/list ([r (range (length rb))] [c (range (length cb))]
                #:when (member (signature (first (list-ref rb r)) (first (list-ref cb c))
                                          (second (list-ref rb r)) (second (list-ref cb c))) wanted))
      (list r c)))
  (define success
    (or (ormap (lambda (r) (andmap (lambda (c) (member (list r c) matched)) (range (length cb)))) (range (length rb)))
        (ormap (lambda (c) (andmap (lambda (r) (member (list r c) matched)) (range (length rb)))) (range (length cb)))))
  (define highlighted
    (for/fold ([out g]) ([p matched])
      (define y (list-ref rb (first p)))
      (define x (list-ref cb (second p)))
      (for*/fold ([acc out]) ([r (range (- (first y) 1) (+ (second y) 2))]
                               [c (range (- (first x) 1) (+ (second x) 2))])
        (if (= (at g r c) bg) (set-cell acc r c 3) acc))))
  (build-grid h w (r c)
    (cond [(> r bottom) (if success 3 2)]
          [(and success (< r top) (= (at g r c) bg)) 3]
          [else (at highlighted r c)])))
